name: 4D Toto
description:
Keep your Singapore 4D and TOTO results and numbers together on your iPhone.

4D Toto fetches real draw results from 4dlivetoday.com, an independent results provider. See the draw number, date, source and last checked time. Results refresh every minute while the app is open, after the source publishes a complete result.

• View six TOTO winning numbers and the additional number.
• View all 23 4D prize positions.
• Check ordinary TOTO and ordinary 4D Big/Small entries.
• Save entries with the exact selected draw, locally on your device.
• Read cached results offline, with clear saved-copy notices.
• Set local reminders to check your entries.

There are no demo draws in this version. Manual entries are labelled separately. Updates depend on the data provider and can be delayed. Always verify results and payouts with Singapore Pools. System, iBet, Roll and iTOTO entries are not supported.

Results from 4dlivetoday.com, compiled from each operator’s official site, under CC BY 4.0. Dates and number display are formatted for the app.

4D Toto is independent and is not affiliated with Singapore Pools. It does not sell tickets, accept bets, process payments or award prizes.

name: Aether - IPTV Player
description:
Aether er en afspiller til dit eget IPTV-abonnement. Log ind med den Xtream Codes-konto, du har fra din udbyder, og få dine kanaler, film og serier samlet i én hurtig og smuk app.

Aether leverer ikke selv indhold. Appen indeholder ingen kanaler, film eller serier, og den sælger eller formidler ikke abonnementer. Du skal have din egen konto hos en udbyder, der understøtter Xtream Codes, og du er selv ansvarlig for, at du har ret til at se det, din udbyder leverer.

LIVE TV
• Kanaler med logo, kvalitet og hvad der kører lige nu
• "Fortsæt med at se" med de kanaler, du sidst så
• Dine favoritkanaler med det aktuelle program
• Stryg op og ned i afspilleren for at skifte kanal

TV-GUIDE OG GENAFSPILNING
• TV-guide med det, der kører nu, og det, der kommer bagefter
• Se afsluttede udsendelser igen på kanaler med arkiv
• Sæt en påmindelse om en udsendelse, der kommer senere

FILM OG SERIER
• Plakater, beskrivelser, sæsoner og afsnit
• Filtrér efter kvalitet og danske undertekster
• Fortsæt, hvor du slap, på tværs af film og afsnit

ÉN SØGNING
• Søg i kanaler, udsendelser, film og serier på én gang

LAVET TIL IPHONE
• Fanelinje i Liquid Glass, mørkt design og store, tydelige kort
• Afspilleren vender selv til liggende format
• Dit login gemmes krypteret på din enhed og sendes kun til din udbyder

Aether har ingen reklamer, ingen konto hos os og indsamler ingen data.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description:
Catch Me If You Can turns your daily steps into a race against your friends.

Every day is a new race, and it closes at 9pm. Every step you take before then counts towards your score. Finish on the podium and win coins.

RACE YOUR FRIENDS
Invite friends with a link or a code and see who is ahead, live. Watch your character run the track and see exactly how many steps it takes to catch the person in front.

POWER-UPS
Spend your coins in the shop:
• Turbo Sneakers boost your own score for the day
• Ankle Weights slow a rival down
• Force Field blocks the next Ankle Weights thrown at you

CREWS AND LEAGUES
Start a crew with your office, your family or the group chat. Crews are ranked every week in Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond leagues.

MAKE IT YOURS
Design your own runner: body, hair, face, outfit and more.

FAIR PLAY
Every step is checked before it counts, so nobody can win by shaking their phone or typing steps in by hand.

Catch Me If You Can reads your steps, walking distance and active energy from Apple Health, with your permission. Your health data is only used to run the game and is never used for advertising.

name: Chess Cafe
description:
Chess Café — An innovative platform bringing together live chess tournaments and friendly matches at your favorite cafés!

Enjoy your favorite coffee while testing your skills over the board, improving your ELO rating, and joining a growing community of chess enthusiasts.

 KEY FEATURES

Cafés & Interactive Map

Easily discover nearby chess cafés and clubs using our interactive map. Explore each venue's location, photos, available chess boards, and upcoming tournament schedules.

Live Tournaments & Swiss System

Join weekly and special chess tournaments hosted at cafés with just one tap. Check in quickly using a QR code when you arrive and compete in fair, automatically generated pairings through our Swiss or Bracket tournament systems.

ELO Rating & Chess Titles

Every official game is recorded in the system. Earn an ELO rating that reflects your skill level and progress through prestigious titles such as **Amateur, Expert, Master, and GOAT** based on your performance.

Leaderboards

See where you stand among the best players in your city, country, or favorite cafés. Build winning streaks, climb the rankings, and compete for the title of city champion!

Chess Community & Friends

Meet new friends and find opponents at your skill level. Explore player profiles, discover their favorite openings, and track your head-to-head match statistics.

---

With Chess Café, chess is more than just a game — it's about great experiences, good coffee, friendly competition, and intellectual connections.

Download Chess Café and secure your spot in the next tournament!

name: Chronode
description:
Το Chronode είναι ένας ήρεμος και όμορφα οργανωμένος σύντροφος μελέτης για τις ημέρες που όλα μοιάζουν επείγοντα. Ενώνει μαθήματα, εργασίες, υπενθυμίσεις και λεπτά εστίασης σε έναν καθαρό χώρο, ώστε το επόμενο βήμα να φαίνεται πιο εύκολο.

ΜΑΘΗΜΑΤΑ ΠΟΥ ΤΑΙΡΙΑΖΟΥΝ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΒΔΟΜΑΔΑ ΣΟΥ  
Πρόσθεσε μαθήματα, διδάσκοντες, αίθουσες και εβδομαδιαίες ώρες. Δες το εξάμηνο συνολικά, άνοιξε κάθε μάθημα για πρόγραμμα, υλικό και εκκρεμότητες και κράτησε την πρόοδο ορατή χωρίς περιττά υπολογιστικά φύλλα.

ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΜΕ ΣΑΦΗΝΕΙΑ  
Δημιούργησε εργασίες για ένα μάθημα ή για προσωπική μελέτη. Όρισε προθεσμία, εκτιμώμενη διάρκεια, προτεραιότητα και τύπο. Το Chronode οργανώνει τα επόμενα βήματα και μπορεί να στείλει μια διακριτική τοπική υπενθύμιση 30 λεπτά πριν από την προθεσμία.

ΧΡΟΝΟΜΕΤΡΟ ΠΟΥ ΣΕΒΕΤΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΠΡΟΣΟΧΗ  
Ξεκίνα συνεδρία 15, 25, 50 ή 90 λεπτών, επίλεξε μάθημα και άφησε το τηλέφωνο ανάποδα. Όταν ολοκληρωθεί το χρονόμετρο, η συνεδρία καταγράφεται αυτόματα στην ιστορία μελέτης σου.

ΑΝΑΛΥΣΕΙΣ ΧΩΡΙΣ ΠΙΕΣΗ  
Εξέτασε τον ρυθμό της εβδομάδας και των τελευταίων τεσσάρων εβδομάδων, τη μέση εστίαση, την πρόοδο προς τον στόχο και τον χρόνο ανά μάθημα. Ένας καθαρός χάρτης συνέπειας δείχνει τις ημέρες που επέστρεψες στη μελέτη, όχι μόνο τις τέλειες ημέρες.

ΗΡΕΜΟΣ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΙΣΜΟΣ  
Θέσε έναν ρεαλιστικό εβδομαδιαίο στόχο και μια βραδινή υπενθύμιση προγραμματισμού. Το Chronode καταγράφει σειρές και μικρές νίκες χωρίς ενοχές ή θόρυβο.

ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟ  
Χωρίς λογαριασμό, αναγνωριστικά διαφημίσεων ή αναλύσεις τρίτων. Τα μαθήματα, οι εργασίες και οι συνεδρίες αποθηκεύονται τοπικά στο iPhone σου. Οι ειδοποιήσεις προγραμματίζονται τοπικά από το iOS και η εξαγωγή CSV είναι διαθέσιμη όποτε θέλεις τα δικά σου αρχεία.

Το αρχικό εξάμηνο είναι επεξεργάσιμο δείγμα και σε βοηθά να δοκιμάσεις αμέσως κάθε λειτουργία. Αντικατέστησέ το με τα δικά σου μαθήματα και τις δικές σου εργασίες από την πρώτη μέρα.

name: CleanCommand
description:
Follow the markets, research companies.Enjoy the smooth and exquisite native experience.

Build a watchlist and explore stock prices with interactive charts. Browse major indices across nine markets, see which U.S. stocks are rising, falling, or trading most actively, and track upcoming reports on the U.S. earnings calendar.

Dig into company profiles, valuation metrics, and annual or quarterly financial statements. Review dividend and stock split history, then compare a security’s historical returns, drawdowns, and volatility with SPY or QQQ.

Read market news with clearly identified publishers and bookmark stories to revisit later. The app supports light and dark appearance on iPhone.

Practice buying and selling USD-quoted stocks and ETFs in a paper portfolio. Track your virtual cash, open positions, and order history. Keep a private trade journal with photo attachments stored on your device, or use the compound growth calculator to explore how contributions and hypothetical returns affect a balance over time.

name: Days & Discoveries
description:
Entre a lista do mercado, o nome de um vinho e a próxima leitura, é fácil deixar boas ideias espalhadas. Days & Discoveries dá um lugar para essas pequenas partes da sua vida e para os planos que você quer tirar do papel.

Guarde suas descobertas
Registre bebidas, comidas, lugares, livros, filmes e séries. Dê uma nota, acrescente uma foto se quiser e encontre depois aquilo que vale repetir. Os cadastros rápidos mostram o essencial; você abre os detalhes quando precisar.

Cuide do dia a dia
Monte sua lista de compras, aproveite produtos que já cadastrou e veja o que ainda falta levar para casa. Registre gastos manualmente, acompanhe metas e organize hábitos e treinos. Lembretes ajudam você a voltar ao que escolheu fazer.

Transforme ideias em planos
Escolha pelo seu próprio histórico, conecte um lugar a um passeio e guarde as lembranças depois. No acesso vitalício, Viagens reúne destinos, reservas, tickets e PDFs escolhidos por você.

Encontre sem começar do zero
Use a busca, os filtros e os favoritos para chegar mais rápido ao que procura. Países, estilos e outras opções que você usa com frequência podem ficar no começo das listas.

Compartilhe quando fizer sentido
Envie pelo AirDrop uma cópia dos itens que você escolher, com fotos e avaliações selecionadas separadamente. Quem recebe confere antes de guardar, e reenvios não duplicam os itens. As cópias enviadas não acompanham mudanças futuras no original.

Seu espaço fica com você
Os registros ficam cifrados no iPhone. O app funciona sem conta própria e sem servidor do desenvolvedor para armazenar seu conteúdo. Você pode proteger a abertura com a autenticação do aparelho e exportar um backup cifrado. Guarde a senha e uma cópia em um lugar seguro.

Comece gratuitamente
Experimente com até 10 itens pendentes na lista de compras, 10 produtos e 10 por tipo de bebida ou comida; 5 por categoria de livros, filmes, séries e lugares; 3 hábitos e 3 treinos. Suas marcações e seu histórico continuam guardados.

Se o app fizer sentido na sua rotina, o desbloqueio vitalício remove esses limites e libera Viagens. É uma compra única, sem assinatura. Escolha Individual ou Família Apple e confira o preço apresentado pela App Store antes de confirmar. O plano Família permite o acesso do comprador e de até cinco familiares elegíveis do grupo Apple. Ele compartilha a licença; os seus registros continuam sob seu controle.

Os cadastros são manuais. Fotos e PDFs são anexos opcionais. Calendários, localização e notificações dependem da sua permissão. Os lembretes podem aparecer no Apple Watch conforme o espelhamento e os ajustes do iPhone; não há app independente para o relógio.

name: DF StudioHub
description:
StudioHub is the internal operations app for Fordjour Studios in the Bronx, NY. It gives the studio team one shared place to track supplies, artwork in progress, and where everything is stored.

INVENTORY
• Scan store barcodes to add purchased supplies, with product details filled in automatically
• Generate and print QR code labels for items without a barcode, such as canvases and vendor-made pieces
• Track quantity, room, spot, vendor and price, with a photo of every item
• Group and sort the inventory by room, category or quantity

ROOMS
• See everything stored in each room and on each rack or shelf
• Scan a shelf or item label to jump straight to it

PAINTING
• Move canvases from blank stock through each stage of a painting
• Photograph every stage and see the status of all paintings at a glance

SCULPTURE
• Track each project's status with photos
• Attach .stl and .obj files and rotate, zoom and inspect them in 3D

TEAM
• Changes sync to everyone on the team through iCloud
• Every change is logged with who made it and when
• Admins approve new members and set what each person can edit

StudioHub is intended for Fordjour Studios staff. A demo with sample data is available from the welcome screen.

name: ErodeRootRain
description:
Land conditions rarely change for one reason alone.
ErodeRootRain brings nine ground-response calculations into one study workspace.

GROUND LOSS & WATER MOVEMENT
Explore soil erosion using values required by the selected method.
Review surface-water runoff as a separate influence on terrain.
Examine how changing assumptions affects each modeled outcome.

ROOT SUPPORT & GROUND DISTURBANCE
Study root reinforcement as an influence on soil behavior.
Review excavation changes through a dedicated calculation.
Keep vegetation support and ground disturbance as distinct questions.

LOADS & CHANGING CONDITIONS
Explore equipment loads in a hypothetical ground-loading case.
Examine seasonal variation through the values you enter.
Review wind erosion separately from water-driven erosion.
Consider soil aging with the assumptions of its selected method.

COMBINED HAZARD PERSPECTIVE
Examine the combined hazard indicator for a broader modeled view.
Read the indicator alongside its assumptions and source values.
Do not mistake the result for a certified site-risk classification.

NUMBERS WITH EXPLICIT LIMITS
Choose a calculation and enter the quantities it requires.
Review the formula, units and computed outcome together.
Revise a value to explore another illustrative scenario.
All outputs are estimates, not live soil measurements.
The app does not provide real-time safety monitoring.
Use these tools for education and preliminary analysis.
Field testing and qualified geotechnical evaluation remain essential.
Never rely on an app estimate alone for safety-critical decisions.

name: Felicity Dating
description:
Hear their voice before you see their face.

Felicity is dating without the swiping. Every morning you get two introductions, chosen for you. You hear them first: a short voice intro, no photos. Pick one. If they pick you too, you talk.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your voice: record a 60–90 second voice intro. We’ll coach you past “I love travel and good food”; you do the talking.
• Two a day: two introductions every morning. Faces come later.
• One choice: pick one person. If they don’t pick you, nobody is told, and tomorrow brings two more.
• Ten messages: ten voice messages each, one a day. Long enough to know if the laugh is real.
• The reveal: then you see each other. Photos, names, the works.

REAL PEOPLE ONLY
Every member is ID-verified with a government ID and a live selfie before they join the pool. No bots, no catfish.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos stay private until you’ve both reached a reveal. Your voice and photos are never used to train AI, ours or anyone else’s. You can report or block anyone, any time.

Manhattan first. Felicity is opening in New York City; join now to be on the list for the first introductions. For adults 18 and over.

name: Flix Jump
seller_name: FLIX TOYS OYUNCAKCILIK SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Jump into the sky with the Flix toys! Bounce from platform to platform, grab coins and rare Flix feathers, and stomp the zombies, bats and ghosts that get in your way.

• 20 levels with a giant boss fight every 5 levels
• Endless mode: how high can you go?
• 9 visual themes: clay, cartoon, pixel, retro console and more
• Hero and villain costumes
• Three control options: tilt the phone, drag your finger, or tap the left or right side of the screen
• English, Turkish, Spanish and Chinese

The game is free. Optional in-app purchases are available: feather and coin packs, themes, a costume and "Remove ads". Ads: optional rewarded ads to continue once after falling and to double a level reward, and an interstitial every few games. "Remove ads" turns interstitials off.

Privacy Policy: https://www.flixtoysofficial.com/sayfa/flix-toys-privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Fold Cat: Desk Pet
description:
Fold your phone to 90 degrees and set it on the desk. The top screen becomes a wall, the bottom one becomes a floor, and a round orange cat named Sarman moves into the corner.

He lives there on his own. He looks at you, then slowly pushes the yarn ball off the front edge of the phone and onto your actual desk. Every casualty goes into the crime log.

What he does:
- Pushes things off the edge while making eye contact: a yarn ball, a toy mouse, a potted plant, and a new "item of the day" (a sock, a bottle cap, a pen, earbuds, a key).
- Close the phone slowly and the ceiling comes down on him. He gets squished, then sleepy.
- Leave a small gap and the room goes dark. Two glowing eyes keep watching you.
- Open it again and he pops back into shape. Slam it shut and he gets scared.
- Lay the phone flat and he rolls onto his back for belly rubs. Pet him and he purrs.
- Fill his bowl and he gets rounder. Eventually he is a ball and rolls instead of walking.
- The room follows your real clock: day, sunset, night. At night he sleeps on his cushion.
- Tilt the phone and the toys roll, he slides, and he gives you a look.

Four cats, all included: Sarman, Tux, Smoky and Cotton.

Made for iPhone Duo. Also runs on non-folding iPhones in a single-screen room view.

One price. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. Nothing leaves your phone.

Also from KRVL Games:
Fat Cat: Tap & Grow, where Sarman first showed up. Bartender Barry, a bartending sim.

name: FQ Loyalty
description:
FQ Loyalty replaces paper stamp cards with digital ones that live in your phone.

FOR CUSTOMERS
• Scan a shop's QR code to join. No account needed.
• Add your card to Apple Wallet and watch it update after every stamp.
• Collect stamps and redeem your reward when the card is full.
• Keep all your cards in one place.

FOR BUSINESSES
• Create your own branded loyalty card in minutes.
• Scan a customer's card to add a stamp or redeem a reward.
• See customers, activity and insights.
• Print your QR poster so customers can join at the counter.

The camera is used only to scan QR codes.

name: Golboo: Beauty & Fragrance
description:
Golboo is a beauty shop for makeup, skincare, hair care, fragrance and personal care, with thousands of products from brands you know.

What you can do in Golboo:
• Browse by category or brand, or search by name, in English, Persian, Arabic or Turkish
• Filter by price, brand, stock and discount, and sort by best selling, newest or price
• See every shade and size of a product, with its price and availability
• Save favourites to your wishlist and get a message when a product is back in stock
• Keep your addresses, track your orders and see their history
• Get notified when your order is paid, shipped and delivered

Shop in Persian, Arabic, Turkish or English, each with prices in its own local currency. The app picks the language from your time zone, and you can change it any time.

Website: https://golboo.shop

name: HAEWON: Fog of Grudges
description:
"Seal them and it ends. Free them and they leave."

1880s Korea. Mountain villages where the fog never lifts. The famous exorcist Baegun has vanished, and his daughter Yeoni sets out with his notebook and a single jojokdeung lantern. In every village a ghost bound by a grudge walks the night, and every villager is hiding something.

Haewon (解冤) means "untying a grudge." You can seal a ghost with a talisman — or find out who they were and what they cannot let go of, and set them free.

■ Investigate by day, face the dead by night
· Each chapter lasts three days. By day, examine the village and talk to its people to gather clues — but your looks are limited.
· At night only your lantern lights the way. Call out the ghost and lead them to the place of release before the oil runs out.
· Who were they? What can't they let go of? What will set them free? Fill in the notebook and the way appears.

■ A new mystery in every chapter
· A misty ferry where reflections reveal the truth, a market town where a child ghost plays hide-and-seek
· A charcoal village whose names were stolen, a county court full of false testimony
· A snowy pass where lantern shadows betray the fox, a goblin's bridge won by wrestling
· A plague village warded with Cheoyong charms, a sisters' house strewn with planted lies
· And at the end of the mist, Yeoni learns what became of her father and mother.

■ Stand your ground in the underworld
· Anger a ghost and you're dragged into the underworld. Read the warning signs, roll and slash, and survive each spirit's own attacks: drowning hands, spinning tops, coiling serpents, needle rain, fox-fire clones, a curtain of mist…
· Win, then trace the talisman with your finger to seal them. Sealed ghosts can be revisited and freed later.

■ Collect and grow
· A relic book: four keepsakes and their stories for every ghost
· Spend soul beads to strengthen your lantern, talisman, blade and empathy
· Two endings, shaped by whom you freed and whom you sealed

■ Made with care
· No ads. Part 1 (Chapters 1–5) is free; Part 2 (Chapters 6–10 and the ending) unlocks forever with one purchase.
· Hand-drawn cartoon art and a ¾-view night village
· Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty; right- or left-handed controls
· English and Korean
· Best played with headphones.

name: Hearthnote
description:
Hearthnote er en rolig og praktisk bakefølgesvenn for deg som bryr deg om detaljene – fra første røre i surdeigsstarteren til siste notat om en åpen crumb.

Ha oppskriftene nær deg, skaler dem til akkurat den mengden du trenger, og følg hvert bak med tydelige steg og timer. Planlegg hevingen rundt dagen din, regn ut deigmengden før du begynner, og ta vare på det du lærte underveis.

**OPPSKRIFTER DU KAN GJØRE TIL DINE**
Utforsk et gjennomtenkt utvalg av brød, boller, kaker, wiener og småkaker. Søk etter navn eller ingrediens, filtrer etter type, lagre favoritter og skaler alle ingrediensene uten å strekke deg etter kalkulatoren. Legg inn egne oppskrifter og ta vare på notatene som betyr noe.

**BAK MED GOD RYTME**
Gjør en oppskrift om til en veiledet økt med stegtimere, visuell progresjon og rolige holdepunkter. Produksjonsplanen viser når baket bør starte og bli ferdig. Deigkalkulatoren hjelper deg fra ønsket deigvekt til mel, vann og salt.

**EN DAGBOK SOM GJØR DEG BEDRE**
Logg hvert bak med vurdering, crumb, stemning og noen ærlige ord. Se rytmen de siste ukene, gå tilbake til tidligere notater og lås opp små milepæler etter hvert som arkivet vokser.

**ET KJØKKEN MED OVERSIKT**
Hold styr på beholdningen i skapet, varer som nærmer seg tomme og utløpsdatoer. Lag handleliste og legg ingrediensene fra en oppskrift rett dit.

**PERSONVERN SOM STANDARD**
Ingen konto, ingen feed og ingen analyseverktøy. Oppskrifter, notater og innstillinger blir liggende på iPhonen din. Den valgfrie ukentlige påminnelsen bruker Apples lokale varsler og kan slås av når som helst.

name: LargeObserver
description:
Explore U.S. stocks, read market stories. Build a watchlist.

See who published each story, open the original article in the built-in reader, and bookmark it for later. The app includes a reading room and clearly labeled sample quotes. When the online feed is enabled, you can browse recent market news, check available quotes and price charts, and explore company profiles, earnings, dividends, and financial statements for supported stocks.

Use the compound growth calculator to see how different monthly contributions and growth rates affect a projection. Keep notes and optional photo attachments in an on-device journal, and choose a light or dark appearance or follow your iPhone’s settings.

name: Listenshelf: Audiobook Player
description:
Looking for an audiobook player for the M4B and MP3 files you already own, without a subscription?

Listenshelf plays audiobooks you bring yourself: DRM-free purchases, LibriVox recordings, CDs you ripped. Import a file or a whole folder from the Files app and listen offline. Your place is saved for every book, every few seconds.

YOUR FIRST 2 BOOKS ARE FREE
Every feature, no time limits, no ads. One purchase unlocks as many books as you like, shared with your family. There is no subscription and nothing to sign up for.

BUILT FOR LONG BOOKS
• Reads the chapters inside M4B files, with titles
• A folder of MP3s becomes one book, in the right order (Part 2 before Part 10), and you can drag files into a different order
• Speed from 0.5× to 3× without the chipmunk voice, remembered per book
• Skip back and forward 10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 seconds
• Sleep timer, including "end of chapter", with a gentle fade
• Rewinds a few seconds when you come back after a pause
• Bookmarks with notes, exported as plain text whenever you want

YOUR BOOKS STAY YOURS
Imported books sit in the Files app under Listenshelf › Audiobooks, so you can copy them out at any time. Bookmarks and notes export as text. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

WORKS LIKE AN iPHONE APP
Lock screen and Control Center controls, AirPods and headphone buttons, Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and iPad.

Supported formats: M4B, M4A, MP3, AAC. Listenshelf does not sell or stream audiobooks and cannot play DRM-protected files from Audible or Apple Books.

name: Lunoya Tarot: Card Reading
description:
In Lunoya, a moonlit back alley, twenty tarot readers have set up shop, and each one has a story. Every month or two, a new reader moves in.
Tell them what's on your mind. They'll ask you a question or two, then read the cards you draw in the light of your story.

■ A conversation, not a canned horoscope
• Describe your situation in your own words; your reader asks back to sharpen the question
• Each card is read in connection with the ones before it
• Finish with a full reading on one page: the flow, the advice, and what to watch for
• Still curious? Ask follow-up questions or draw one more card

■ 20 readers, 20 voices
Sis Ruby, a bar owner with 20 years of love advice on tap. Nyx, a talking black cat in charge of today's card. Vex, a retired Wall Street trader with zero patience. Black Envoy Kim, an overworked civil servant of the afterlife. Granny Otama, fifty years reading in an Osaka arcade. Kohaku, a nine-tailed fox shrine maiden. El Destino, a masked luchador who reads tarot between matches…
Readers from Korea, Japan, Taiwan, the US, Mexico, Brazil and Indonesia, each with their own stage and voice. Six of them even bring a signature spread.

■ Draw with your own hand, in 3D
• Spin a ring of 78 cards with your finger and stop where your heart does
• 35 spreads, from a single card to the Celtic Cross, the Tree of Life and a year ahead
• Spreads suggested for your question: love, reconciliation, their feelings, career, money, family, timing

■ Collect and grow
• Four decks in four art styles (Classic Gold, Eastern Ink, Neon Pop, Fiesta) and a 312-card collection book
• Bond levels that deepen as you visit, unlocking every reader's hidden episodes and special outfit
• A daily card with a streak to keep
• Save your reading as a story or feed image and share it

■ No sign-up
No account needed. Your chat history and what your readers remember stay on your device.

■ 7 languages
English · 한국어 · 日本語 · 繁體中文 · Español · Português · Bahasa Indonesia

■ Pass Membership (optional)
The core experience is free, and readings include ads along the way. With a Pass Membership (monthly or yearly subscription) you can continue with passes instead of ads. See prices and benefits in the app. You can cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Subscriptions renew automatically each month or year and are charged to your Apple Account unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

■ Please note
• Readings are generated live by AI in each character's voice. They are not human readers.
• For entertainment and self-reflection only. Readings don't predict the future; for health, legal or financial decisions, talk to a professional.
• If you share that you're in crisis, the reading pauses and shows helpline numbers.
• Report any strange or upsetting reply with the flag button next to it.

Contact: eleventech.service@gmail.com
Privacy policy: https://xipicks.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://xipicks.com/terms.html

name: MeatCutPick
description: MeatCutPick muuttaa illan kypsennystavan palaksi, grammamääräksi ja annoshinnaksi. Valitse nauta, sika, lammas, siipikarja tai kala, tapa ja aika, niin kolme ehdotusta näyttää ostogrammat ja hinnan. Tiskilista on muistilappu ennen maksua. Jääkaapin päivät ovat muistio, eivät säilyvyystuomiota. Hinnat ovat viite. Simpukat ja sisäelimet eivät ole hyllyssä.

name: Metodo Magrin
description:
Sono Andrea Magrin e questo è lo spazio dove tengo il mio metodo. L'ho fatto per me, poi l'ho dato alle persone che seguo, e adesso è un'app.

Dentro ci sono i Voglio: le cose che vuoi davvero, scritte con parole tue e messe nell'area della vita a cui appartengono. Quando un Voglio è grande si spezza in Loop: i comportamenti che ripeti, quelli che alla lunga fanno la differenza.

Il cuore sono le sessioni: un momento alla volta, con il timer che tiene il tempo e le parole che ti guidano. Non serve essere bravi, serve esserci.

Ogni volta che porti a casa qualcosa puoi registrare la realizzazione, con una foto se vuoi: va in un diario che è solo tuo, e ti resta. È così che dopo qualche settimana vedi il percorso invece della giornata storta di ieri.

L'app si spiega da sola: primi passi, tutorial e novità arrivano quando servono. I tuoi dati sono tuoi: puoi chiederne una copia e cancellare l'account quando vuoi. Non è un social, non ci sono like e non c'è pubblicità: è un posto tranquillo per fare, un passo alla volta, quello che hai deciso di fare.

name: Nurse Shift Book
description:
Plan nursing shifts and find time for friends and family. Nurse Shift Book pairs a personal shift calendar with optional private Circles for making plans. Other shift workers can use the same tools.

- Add day, evening and overnight shifts, save repeating rotations, and track paid or unpaid days off.
- Review hours and estimated pay using your own rates, overtime settings, and night or weekend extras.
- Import one person's schedule from text or a photo, then check dates and times before adding. Undo stays available until your next calendar edit.
- Set shift reminders, send shifts to a dedicated phone calendar with a manual, one-way export, and save or restore a manual backup.
- In Circles, share chosen free days or time windows and find overlaps for selected people.
- Vote on times in a poll, turn the chosen time into a plan, RSVP separately and coordinate in replies. Reporting and blocking are available.

Your personal calendar works offline without an account. Circles is for adults 18+ and needs a separate account and internet access. It stores the availability and content you choose to share, without automatically uploading your shifts, notes, workplaces or pay. Review and republish your availability when your schedule changes.

Pay figures are estimates and exclude taxes. Exported shifts may sync through your phone's calendar account. Keep patient information and confidential workplace material out of the app.

name: Onarnauta
description:
Onarnauta is a musical journey in flight. Its name joins the Ancient Greek ónar, dream, with nauta: the navigator of dreams.

Take the stick of a small plane and go. Soar over islands and mountains, slip under a bridge, look for a hidden bay. Then point upward: the other planets are really there, and you reach them by flying, with no loading screens.

All the music is original and follows the way you fly. Each world has its own sound. Rings bring in the band one part at a time, a loop climbs in pitch as you fly it.

Choose the Direct or Aeronautical stick and put the controls on either side. Follow your plane in External view or look along the nose from the Cockpit. As you fly toward a planet, Gentle Approach can ease the descent and level the plane above the surface.

Explore in Free Flight or turn on Rings, Time Trial, Targets or Rival. Add notes to the music, beat your lap time, hit targets with Light or dodge bubbles from another plane.

Works offline, with no account, ads or purchases. The game does not collect your data.

name: Outrider Events
description:
Outrider Events is the attendee app for conferences, workshops and exercises run on the Outrider Events platform.

Enter the event code from your organisers, then the email address you registered with and the 6-digit code we email you. Only confirmed attendees can sign in. One app holds every event you attend, and each event keeps its own sign-in and saved information on your phone.

- Agenda by day and track, with the sessions you save
- Updates from the organisers, with optional notifications
- Live questions and polls in sessions
- Documents and useful links
- Speakers and their sessions
- Your ticket and QR code for the welcome desk
- An opt-in attendee directory, messages and meeting requests
- Surveys and feedback
- Works offline: the agenda, your ticket, updates, documents and speakers stay readable with no signal

Your information stays private. Each event's information is encrypted on your phone with a key that stays on the phone.

name: ParkEasy Tbilisi
description:
arkEasy makes Tbilisi zone parking simple. Start and stop parking from your existing parking balance in one tap — or let the app do it for you.

PARK IN ONE TAP
• Pick your car and spot, or tap "Use my location" to find the spot you are at
• Your recent spots are one tap away
• See your balance and how long you have been parked

AUTOMATIC PARKING
Choose how much ParkEasy does on its own:
• Ask me — when you park, you get a notification; one tap starts parking
• Automatic at familiar spots — starts by itself where you have parked before
• Fully automatic — starts by itself whenever the spot is recognised
• Stop when I leave — parking stops as soon as you drive away, even if you started it yourself

ParkEasy uses your location, motion and your car connection (CarPlay or the car's Bluetooth) to tell parking from traffic. All of this is processed on your phone.

YOUR CARS
Add, rename and remove cars, and choose an icon for each.

GEORGIAN AND ENGLISH
The app is fully available in Georgian and English, with a light and dark theme.

IMPORTANT
ParkEasy is an independent app and is not affiliated with Tbilisi City Hall or the Municipal Services Development Agency. You sign in with your own parking account on the official city sign-in page. Parking is paid from your balance on that account. To top up your balance, pay fines or buy subscriptions, use the official app or parking.tbilisi.gov.ge.

Automatic detection is a helper, not a guarantee — check the notifications, and make sure parking is running when it matters.

name: Picassoffa TV
description:
Picassoffa is a drawing and guessing game for the whole family. It plays on Apple TV, and the phones are the controllers.

How it works
Everyone gets a secret word and draws it on their phone at the same time. Then the drawings show up on the TV one by one, and the others guess what they are. Right answers score, and faster answers score more. The artist scores for every person who got it.

What you need
• An Apple TV with Picassoffa TV
• 2 to 10 players, each with an iPhone and the free Picassoffa app
• The same Wi-Fi

No login, no ads and no accounts. Everything stays in your home.

Over 600 words in Swedish and English. Mix languages in the same game: typing "elefant" when someone drew an elephant counts just the same.

More word packs are available in the app: School, Christmas, Sports, Jobs, Summer and Space. With Family Sharing, one purchase covers the whole family.

name: PlantMedic: Leaf Care & Water
description:
Struggling houseplant? Snap a photo of any yellowing, spotted, or drooping leaf and get an instant diagnosis, a step-by-step recovery checklist, and a tailored watering schedule.

Meet Sprout Medic, your calm botanical guide inside PlantMedic. Instead of generic watering calendars, PlantMedic combines your leaf photo with your actual room light, watering routine, and pot drainage to pinpoint what your plant needs today.

What PlantMedic gives you: • Leaf Photo Diagnosis: Snap with your camera or pick from your Photo Library to identify the plant and spot overwatering, underwatering, fungus gnats, spider mites, fungal spots, sunburn, or low light stress. • Smart Photo Caching: Re-checking the same leaf photo with the same care context loads your result instantly from cache without using your daily checks. • Interactive Recovery Checklist: Follow numbered, time-framed treatment steps (what to do today, in 3–5 days, and over 2 weeks) and check off each step as you go. • Adaptive Watering & 2-Day Snooze: Save any plant to My Plants to get a recovery-adjusted watering interval, soil dryness check instructions, local reminders, and a one-tap "Still Damp (+2 days)" snooze. • Care Journal & Follow-Ups: Keep past leaf checkups with thumbnails in History and link follow-up checks to track recovery over time. • Targeted Care Supplies: When treatment calls for yellow sticky traps, perlite, neem oil, or a moisture meter, PlantMedic opens a direct Amazon search in Safari.

name: PsychroDew
description:
Huurtuvatko ikkunat tai tuntuuko laattalattia kostealta? PsychroDew auttaa selvittämään omien mittaustesi avulla, mille pinnoille kosteus voi tiivistyä ja milloin ulkoilma on sisäilmaa kuivempaa.

Arvioi pintojen tiivistymisriskiä
Syötä huoneen lämpötila ja suhteellinen kosteus, niin saat selville sisäilman kastepisteen. Lisää halutessasi ikkunalasin, lattialaatan tai muun pinnan lämpötila. Valitse mittauspiste kartalta ja katso sen lämpötilaero kastepisteeseen. Jos kastepiste on 20 °C ja lattialaatta on 18 °C, laatan pinnalle voi tiivistyä kosteutta. Voit myös kirjata, oliko pinta kuiva, huurtunut vai näkyikö siinä vesipisaroita.

Seuraa muutoksia huoneittain
Tallenna mittaukset ja palaa niihin kalenterin kautta. Kuvaajat näyttävät, miten huoneen lämpötila, kosteus ja kastepiste ovat muuttuneet. Mittaa sama huone esimerkiksi ennen tuuletusta ja sen jälkeen ja vertaa tuloksia. Voit merkitä pinnan, jonka haluat mitata seuraavalla kerralla uudelleen.

Kokeile, mikä muuttaa tiivistymisriskiä
Säädä kokeilussa ilmankosteutta tai lasin lämpötilaa ja katso, miten tiivistyminen muuttuu simulaatiossa. Tallenna lähtötilanne vertailuarvoksi ja tarkastele kahta tilannetta rinnakkain. Näet, miten esimerkiksi ilmankosteuden lasku muuttaa lasin lämpötilan ja kastepisteen välistä eroa.

Valitse sopiva aika tuuletukselle
Syötä omat sisä- ja ulkoilman mittauksesi ja vertaile kastepisteitä ennen ikkunan avaamista. Valikoiduille Kiinan kaupungeille voit tarkastella seuraavan 24 tunnin tuntiennustetta. Valitse kellonaika aikajanalta ja katso sen lämpötila, kosteus ja kastepiste. Vertaa ennustetta huoneesi lukemiin ja etsi sopiva tuuletusaika.

name: R-4 Recorder
description:
A MACHINE, NOT AN APP

Four tracks in your hand, on a real length of tape. Pull it out and press
REC — a reel comes up armed on its next open track, so one key gets you
to tape, and it only ever arms an empty one, so that key can't erase a
take you already have.

WHO IT IS FOR
Songwriters, players, and anyone who finishes things. Headphones on,
house dark, one red LED.

THE TAPE
Five minutes to start; it grows a minute at a time as you record, so the
length is never a decision you make before you have played anything.
Recording over something erases it — the erase head is honest — and
MERCY walks back ten passes when you need it. Rewinding takes a moment.
Hiss is real unless HUSH is on.

THE CONSOLE
Every strip takes at once, each off its own input: hi cut, lo cut, pan,
fader, mute, arm. Cream-faced VU needles with real ballistics. What you
hear is what prints. Bounce to make room — chosen tracks play through
the console onto one, then the sources clear. Commit, then move on.

THE FORM
Load a shape and the tape cuts itself to the song — sections band the
reel, named pins at every boundary, the section under the head in the
window. Templates for the standard shapes, or drop pins through a take
and make the sections yours. A form never writes a note and never
checks your math.

IDEA MODE
Eject the reel and the machine is a recorder: one press takes a mono
idea, the next keeps it, with its key and tempo written into the file.
Nothing is transcribed and nothing leaves the phone.

OUT
Mixdown to WAV for the session or M4A for the pocket. Export stems —
every track on its own, from bar 1, 48 kHz Float32 — as one zip for any
desk. Dock a USB desk and the deck opens to six tracks.

ALSO AN AUDIO UNIT
R-4 installs as an AUv3 effect: the tape's colour — drive, lows, top,
wow, hiss — on any track in GarageBand, Logic or AUM.

Reels live in Files and in your own iCloud. Nothing is uploaded. There
is no account.

name: Retro Club Fencing
description:
Only two fencers stand on the piste. One step closer and you can hit; one step late and you get hit.

Retro Club Fencing brings épée to pixel art as a one-on-one fencing game. Move back and forth to judge the distance, and thrust when you see an opening. A lunge reaches a distant opponent in one go, but if it misses, it leaves you just as open.

Read the height of your opponent's blade and parry it. A successful parry gives you a chance to riposte right away. The épée rule that a simultaneous hit scores for both fencers is here too. At 4-4 or in overtime, though, a double touch scores nothing and the bout goes on.

Modes
Cup — A tournament of 8 fencers. Get through the quarterfinal and semifinal, then win the final.
Friendly — Choose your fencer, your opponent and the difficulty, and fence one bout at a time.
Team — A relay in which three fencers take turns, racing to be first to 15 touches. (Retro Pass)
Tutorial — Practice step by step, from moving and thrusting to the lunge, changing blade height, and parry and riposte. You can start without knowing the rules of fencing.

There are three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal and Hard. Buying the Retro Pass unlocks Pro, the strongest difficulty, and the Team mode. The Retro Pass is a one-time purchase that stays with you.

Available in 13 languages.

JJJI STUDIO (contact@jjjistudio.com)

name: Roth Slots Quasar
description: Roth Slots Quasar is an offline glyph puzzle game built around ten abstract Marks and three independent rule sets. Challenge yourself in Lumen Lanes deduction, Orbit Rings gear logic, and Pulse Tracks timing. Clear 145 deterministic levels, track Marks as scores only, replay rounds, practice freely, and enjoy Focus and Flow sessions. Progress stays on your device. No ads, no purchases, and no account required.

name: RUB A DUB & CYPHER PLAYER
description:
RUB A DUB & CYPHER PLAYER

レゲエディージェイ＆ラッパーのための練習用ミュージックプレイヤー！

好きなリディムやビートを読み込んで、いつでもどこでもラバダブやサイファーの練習ができるiPhoneアプリです。

【主な機能】

・ワンタッチMUTEでリディムやビートを瞬時に消音
・ピッチ調整＆KEY LOCKでテンポを自由にコントロール
・ターンテーブル操作によるスクラッチ
・CUEポイントの設定
・BPMの自動解析と手動設定
・リディムやビートのライブラリ管理
・練習音声の録音
・効果音サンプラー
・オフラインでの使用に対応

レゲエのラバダブからヒップホップのサイファーまで。

自分のスタイルで、自由に練習しよう！

name: Scan Keeper: PDF Scanner & OCR
description:
Need to send a contract, receipt or form as a clean PDF?
Scan Keeper finds the edges of the paper, straightens it, removes shadows to make the page white, and turns it into a PDF.

■ Scan or import
· Scan several pages in a row with the camera — edges are detected automatically, even when the page is tilted
· Import photos you already took and they get straightened the same way

■ Shadows gone, paper white
· Document: removes shadows and yellow light, keeps text crisp
· Or choose B&W, Gray or Original for each page
· Rotate, reorder, remove or add pages

■ PDFs you can search
· Reads the text right on your phone
· Search and copy the text inside the PDFs you make
· Find documents in your library by the words inside them (e.g. "deposit", "invoice number")
· Documents are named automatically from their first line

■ Send
· Pick a PDF size: Full quality / Standard / Small (for email and uploads)
· Share to Mail, Messages, Files and more with the iPhone share sheet
· Copy all text from a document

■ Kept safe
· Every scan is saved on your phone right away, so documents don't vanish if the app closes
· Deleted documents wait in the trash for 30 days

■ No login, no uploads
No account, no server, no ads. Edge detection, shadow removal and text recognition all run on your phone, and your documents are never sent anywhere. No more waiting on "uploading".

■ No subscription
Buy once and keep using it. No trials that turn into weekly or yearly subscriptions.

Questions? Let us know on the support page.

name: Sign PDF: Signature & Stamp
description:
Sign and stamp PDFs right on your iPhone.
Got a quote, invoice or agreement? Pick the PDF, tap your signature or stamp, drag it into place and save.

SIGNATURES & STAMPS
• Signature: draw with your finger and get a clean, transparent signature
• Status stamps: APPROVED, PAID, RECEIVED, CHECKED or COPY, with an optional date
• Name and company seals: round, square and date stamps in red, blue or black
• From a photo: snap a stamp on white paper and keep only the ink as a clean digital stamp (paper edges and shadows are removed automatically)
• Four ink colors and an optional inked look

PLACE THEM ON YOUR PDF
• Drag to move, pinch or drag the corner to resize
• Stamp several pages, or put the same stamp on every page at once
• The original text stays as text, so it's still searchable and copyable

TIDY UP YOUR PDF
• Merge PDFs; reorder, rotate or remove pages; save selected pages as a new PDF
• Turn photos into a PDF
• Compress to under 1, 2, 5 or 10 MB, or as small as possible. Images are shrunk first, and if the result would be bigger, the original is kept
• Open password-protected PDFs with their password
• Open PDFs from other apps with "Sign PDF"

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
• Pay once: your first 3 PDF exports need no purchase. To keep going, buy once inside the app. It's not a subscription, so you're never charged again.
• No ads, no login, no account
• No uploads: everything happens on your phone, and your stamps and signatures stay there too.

Note: image stamps and signatures are not certified digital signatures. For contracts that require a legally binding e-signature, use an e-signature service.

name: Sociopathway
description:
Sociopathway is a private group chat for friends, families and teams, with a clever AI friend called Hal who keeps everything organised while you talk.

Chat like normal. Say you need sunscreen and chargers and they appear on the shared packing list. Mention dinner on Saturday at 8 and it lands on the calendar. Say you paid €36 for taxis and the cost is added and split. Ask Hal for ideas, prices, news or a recap with a quick /hal.

EVERYTHING YOUR GROUP NEEDS, NEXT TO THE CHAT
• Ideas: capture and sort the things you want to do
• Lists: shared packing, shopping and to-do lists
• Calendar: plans everyone can see, with a countdown to the next one
• Money: split costs, see who owes who, track a budget with tables and charts, in any currency
• Notes: keep tips, links and details together
• Polls: settle it with a vote

MADE FOR REAL GROUPS
• Invite only: join with a link or a QR code
• Photos, voice messages, files and locations
• Mention people with @, reply, forward, star and pin
• Disappearing and scheduled messages
• Read receipts, mute, archive, block and report
• Available in many languages

HAL PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
Sociopathway is free to use and every group gets a few free Hal replies each month. Hal Premium unlocks Hal for the whole group when any one member subscribes: £5.99 per month with a one-week free trial, or £49.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple ID settings.

Terms: https://sociopathway.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://sociopathway.com/privacy.html

Hal is an AI and can make mistakes, so check anything important.

name: TalkyCar - Scanner OBD2 ELM327
description:
Hai una spia accesa sul cruscotto e vuoi capire cosa succede? TalkyCar si collega a un lettore OBD2 ELM327 e ti dice cosa sta comunicando la tua auto, in parole semplici e senza gergo da officina.

LEGGI I CODICI DI ERRORE, SPIEGATI
Per più di 3.700 codici trovi una spiegazione in italiano di cosa significa e, per i codici del motore, le cause più probabili. Vedi anche se la spia del motore è accesa e quali codici sono ancora in attesa di conferma.

CANCELLA GLI ERRORI IN SICUREZZA
Dopo una riparazione puoi spegnere la spia. TalkyCar lo permette solo ad auto ferma e a motore spento, ti chiede conferma e tiene traccia di ogni cancellazione. Ti ricorda anche che cancellare un codice non ripara il guasto.

IL CRUSCOTTO DELLA TUA AUTO, IN DIRETTA
Giri del motore, temperatura, velocità, tensione della batteria e tutti i dati che la tua auto mette a disposizione. Scegli tu quali vedere e in che ordine, come i widget di iPhone.

LA TUA AUTO, RICONOSCIUTA
TalkyCar legge il numero di telaio e lo standard diagnostico dell'auto e ti mostra solo i dati che è davvero in grado di fornire.

COLLEGAMENTO GUIDATO
Ti accompagniamo passo per passo: dove si trova la presa diagnostica, come accendere il quadro, come scegliere il lettore. Se qualcosa non va, ti diciamo cosa e come risolvere.

I TUOI DATI RESTANO SUL TELEFONO
Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun dato inviato a noi o ad altri.

COSA TI SERVE
- Un lettore OBD2 ELM327 Bluetooth LE (Bluetooth 4.0) oppure Wi-Fi. I lettori Bluetooth "classici" non funzionano con iPhone: è un limite di iOS, non dell'app.
- Un'auto con presa diagnostica OBD-II / EOBD. In Europa ce l'hanno di norma le auto a benzina dal 2001 e quelle diesel dal 2004 circa.

TalkyCar legge i dati standard OBD-II del motore. Le funzioni specifiche di ogni marca (per esempio la rigenerazione del filtro antiparticolato o l'azzeramento del tagliando) non sono comprese.

Non usare il telefono mentre guidi: guarda i dati solo ad auto ferma o fatti aiutare da un passeggero.

TalkyCar è un'app indipendente e non è affiliata ad alcun costruttore di auto.

name: THXO
description:
THXO คือระบบ ERP สำหรับธุรกิจไทย ใช้กับบัญชี THXO ของบริษัทคุณ

• ขายและซื้อ: ใบเสนอราคา ใบสั่ง ใบแจ้งหนี้ ใบกำกับภาษี รับและจ่ายเงิน
• สต๊อกและคลัง: ดูคงเหลือ รับ ส่ง โอน ตรวจนับ — สแกนบาร์โค้ดด้วยกล้องของเครื่องได้ทันที
• บัญชีและภาษี: สมุดบัญชี งบการเงิน ภ.พ.30 หัก ณ ที่จ่าย
• บุคลากร: ลา ลงเวลา ใบเบิก สลิปเงินเดือน
• อนุมัติงานที่รออยู่ได้จากมือถือ

ในแอป:
• สแกนบาร์โค้ดและ QR ด้วยกล้อง ใส่รหัสลงช่องที่กำลังกรอกได้เลย
• พิมพ์ หรือบันทึกเอกสารเป็น PDF แล้วแชร์ต่อ
• ไฟล์ CSV / PDF ที่ดาวน์โหลดเก็บในแอป และเปิดจากแอป "ไฟล์" ได้
• ล็อกแอปด้วย Face ID
• บัญชีเดียวเข้าได้ทุกบริษัทที่คุณเป็นผู้ใช้

ต้องมีบัญชีผู้ใช้ THXO ที่บริษัทของคุณเพิ่มให้ก่อน

name: THXO POS
description:
THXO POS คือแอปขายหน้าร้านสำหรับร้านที่ใช้ระบบ THXO ทุกบิลที่ขายลงบัญชี ตัดสต๊อก และออกใบกำกับภาษีอย่างย่อให้เอง ไม่ต้องคีย์ซ้ำ

ขายได้แม้เน็ตหลุด
• เลขบิลจองไว้ล่วงหน้าในเครื่อง ขายต่อได้ทันทีเมื่อเน็ตหลุด

name: Tickrate: Watch Accuracy
description:
Is your mechanical watch running fast or slow, and by how much? Tickrate tells you how many seconds a day it gains or loses, and how sure that number is.

ATOMIC TIME CHECKS
Tap the moment your second hand reaches 12, or type the time your watch shows. Tickrate compares it with network time from Apple's time server. Check again a few hours or days later and you get the rate the watch really keeps between checks. Every result comes with a range: two checks a day apart typically land within about ±0.4 s/day. Any check can be edited or deleted, and after you regulate the watch you can start over with a clean run.

LISTEN, WITH A RANGE
Hold the iPhone's microphone against the watch for 20 to 60 seconds. Instead of a single number, Tickrate shows a range, for example "Gaining 1 to 7.5 s/day", and explains what makes it wide: scatter between ticks, disagreement between two independent methods, the watch itself changing, and the iPhone's own clock. When the signal isn't good enough, it shows no number at all, tells you why, and suggests what to try. The beat rate is detected automatically, from 12,000 to 43,200 bph.

CALIBRATE THIS IPHONE
Every iPhone's sound clock runs a little fast or slow. On one iPhone we measured 2 s/day. Leave yours on the charger with the calibration page open for about an hour, once, and listening results are corrected from then on. With Unlimited, a quartz watch offers a quicker way to calibrate.

YOUR WATCHES
Each watch has its own page: a chart of its rate over time, the full history of checks, and the COSC chronometer band (−4 to +6 s/day) drawn in for reference.

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
Tickrate measures rate only. It doesn't measure amplitude or beat error, and it doesn't replace a watchmaker's bench timegrapher.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your watches and checks stay on your iPhone.

FREE, PLUS ONE PURCHASE
One watch is free, with unlimited checks and listens; its history shows the last 30 days. Tickrate Unlimited is a one-time purchase of $7.99, not a subscription. It adds unlimited watches, full history, CSV and JSON export and import, and calibration with a quartz watch. Family Sharing is supported.

name: Timeless Rush: Maze Escape
description:
The lights are out, the clock is ticking, and the exit is somewhere in the dark. Something is hunting you.

Timeless Rush is a fast pixel-art maze adventure you can play on your own or race against real players online. Every maze is new, you only see a little around you, and you have to find the way out before time runs out. One thumb, a few seconds to learn, and one more maze is always a minute away.

16 HEROES, 16 STORIES
A devil lawyer who lost his first case, an angel accountant, a vampire countess, a pirate Santa, a zombie office worker and more. Every hero has a region of their own: run its story mazes, collect its gems and strange items, and wake the boss at the end.

BOSS FIGHTS
Dodge the magic, grab your weapon and strike. Every boss has its own special attack (rows of fire, a wall of water, lightning, whirlwinds, poison, smoke) and the later the hero, the tougher the boss.

THE TIME HUNTER
Deeper in, a creature wakes in the maze and hunts you by sight. Break its line of sight, hide behind a corner, and run.

LIVE ONLINE RACES
Race real players through the same maze, live. Stun your rival, raise your shield, climb 7 leagues and the weekly board, or invite a friend to a friendly race.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Endless Free Mode with 11 maze worlds, each with its own look and music
• Abilities: Speed, Time Freeze, Vision and the Guide that lights the path
• Permanent upgrades, heroes with gifts, pets that help, trails that glow
• Daily quests, a weekly login calendar with growing prizes
• Chests with every prize's chance shown before you open them
• Plays offline; sign in with Apple to keep your progress on any iPhone

Timeless Rush is free to play. It contains ads (a one-time purchase removes the ads between levels) and optional in-app purchases of gold, including chests with random items.

Character art: Liberated Pixel Cup (LPC) contributors, CC-BY-SA 3.0 / OGA-BY 3.0 — full list of artists in the game's Credits screen. Fonts: Orbitron, Rajdhani, Grimoire of Death (SIL Open Font License). Music and sound effects made for Timeless Rush.

name: Tuckwall: Card Deck Catalog
description:
Tuckwall is the catalog and marketplace for card decks: playing cards, tarot, oracle, Lenormand and more. Every deck, every edition, every printing, with the details collectors care about.

THE CATALOG
• Browse by type, publisher, printer, card stock, finish, gilding, print run and more
• Deck and edition pages with photos, specs, credits and price history
• Search decks, editions, people, publishers and collectors
• Scan the barcode on a box with your iPhone's camera to find its edition in seconds

YOUR WALL
• Keep every copy you own, sealed or opened, with its condition, shelf and notes
• See what your collection is worth and what's still sealed
• Keep a wantlist and get a notification when a deck you want is for sale

BUY AND SELL
• List a copy in a minute, with photos, condition and price hints from real sales
• Make and answer offers, check out per seller and follow each order to your door
• Message buyers and sellers, leave feedback, and report problems

CONTRIBUTE
• Add decks and editions the catalog doesn't have yet, with photos and sources
• Follow your contributions through review

Tuckwall is in private beta: the catalog is open to everyone, and accounts are by invitation for now. On the market you pay the seller directly; Tuckwall charges no fee during the beta.

Privacy: the app sends anonymous usage stats (you can turn them off in Settings → Privacy) and crash reports to Tuckwall's own servers. When you're signed in, your iPhone's push token goes to Tuckwall so it can send you notifications through Apple's push service. Privacy policy: https://tuckwall.com/legal/privacy

name: Undertone: Speaking Coach
description:
Speak with more confidence by practising out loud, before the conversation that matters.

Undertone is an AI speaking coach. You hold a live voice call with an illustrated AI character, then get clear feedback on how you sounded, how you held the conversation and how you structured what you said.

PRACTISE REAL CONVERSATIONS
Choose a call type and just talk:
- Job interview: answer a realistic hiring manager's questions, one at a time. Paste a job ad and your CV for interview prep (Plus and Pro).
- Phone a business: book a vet visit and practise a clear, confident opening.
- Small talk at an event: meet someone new and keep the chat going.
- Raise an issue at work: stay calm and specific with a defensive colleague.
- Give a short talk: talk for up to three minutes to a small team, then take their questions.
- Tell a story: tell a friend what happened, with a voice that keeps them listening.

Meet six characters, each with their own style. The AI character is not a person, and the app says so.

FEEDBACK AFTER EVERY CALL
Your summary shows a speaking score and what to work on next. It covers three areas:
- Voice: pace, pauses, filler words, how your sentences end and how much energy you bring.
- Conversation: following up, picking up details and taking turns.
- Structure: answering first, being specific and keeping to one point.

Each strength and fix points to a moment in your call, so you know exactly what to try next time.

COACH MODE
Switch from Realistic to Coach mode for one quick tip after each answer and a chance to try again, with live cue chips as you speak (Plus and Pro).

SEE YOURSELF IMPROVE
- Earn XP, level up and build a daily streak.
- Set a weekly goal and close your ring.
- Unlock badges as your skills grow, from steady practice to mastering a skill.
- Track your speaking score and 24 skills over time on the Progress tab.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your audio is analysed on your iPhone and never leaves it. Only the text of your calls is sent, with your consent, to our server and a trusted AI provider to write and speak the character's replies and to score your skills. It is not used to train models. You can turn this off at any time in Profile, and export or erase your data in Settings.

CHOOSE A PLAN
Undertone needs a subscription. Your plan and progress follow your Apple Account, with no sign-up.
- Starter: 30 minutes of calls a week, calls up to 15 minutes, all 6 call types, a natural AI character voice and a voice report after every call.
- Plus: 2 hours of calls a week, calls up to 20 minutes, Coach mode with live tips, AI scores for how you talk and structure answers, and interview prep from a job ad and your CV.
- Pro: 5 hours of calls a week, calls up to 30 minutes, and everything in Plus.

Plans are monthly or yearly, with no free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Prices shown in the app come from the App Store and may differ by region.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.reboundgames.dev/undertone/privacy

Undertone is for ages 13 and over (16 in some countries). The characters are AI. It is a practice tool for everyday speaking habits, not a medical or professional service.

name: Uppik CRM
description:
Uppik CRM brings customers, sales, projects and support together in one place – and with the app you have it all in your pocket.
The app is for businesses that use Uppik CRM, the WordPress plugin from Arctic IT. Connect your phone with a QR code from Uppik, or type your address and log in as usual.
PHOTOGRAPH RECEIPTS Take a picture of a receipt or a bill. The phone finds the edges, straightens the page and reads the text, and Uppik fills in the expense with supplier, amount and date. You check it and tap Register. Without a connection the receipt waits on the phone and is sent when you are online again.
NOTIFICATIONS Reminders, new tickets, mail and everything else under the bell in Uppik – as push notifications on your phone.
ALL OF UPPIK Overview, customers, tasks, quotes, invoices, tickets, time and the rest of your modules, in a layout made for the phone. The tab bar takes you straight to Overview, Tasks, Receipt, Customers and Menu.
YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU Uppik runs on your own server. The app only keeps the connection in the phone’s secure keychain, and push notifications carry no names or text – the text is fetched from your Uppik. Lock the app with Face ID or a passcode. No ads and no tracking.
Requires Uppik CRM 1.34 or later with the module "App and notifications" turned on.
Made by Arctic IT in Sisimiut, Greenland.

HABITS AND GOALS

MEMORY JAR
• Write one good thing each evening

WAKE-UP AND BEDTIME

AND MORE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets

Your planner never leaves your phone. Only the shared calendars you choose to create or join are stored on YOMI's server, so everyone in them can see the events. No tracking, no ads, no selling data.

Made with care by FCK Studios.

■ 사진은 휴대폰 밖으로 나가지 않아요
로그인도 서버도 없어요. 비슷한 사진·흐린 사진 찾기를 포함한 모든 분석이 휴대폰 안에서 이뤄지고, 사진을 어디로도 보내지 않아요.

궁금한 점은 지원 페이지로 알려 주세요.

3. 빈틈없는 큐브 재고 & 신선도 관리 (Inventory)

name: 自分ランキング - 星で評価してランキング作成
description:
好きなもの・行った場所を、自分で決めた基準で星をつけて、ランキングとして残せるアプリです。

「ラーメン」「カフェ」「映画」のように題目を作ると、そのまま1つのランキングになります。お店や作品を追加して星をつけるだけで、順位が自動で並びます。

■ 自分の基準で評価
・「味」「スープ」「価格」など、評価の項目（小項目）を題目ごとに自由に作れます
・項目ごとに重み（×1〜×3）をつけられ、総合点は重み付きの平均で自動計算
・小項目を使わず、総合点だけを0.1刻みでつけることもできます
・小項目ごとの順位に並べ替えたり、星を使わず手で並べたりもできます

■ 見やすいランキング
・いつもの一覧／トップ3を大きく／1行ずつ（たくさん並べる）の3つの見え方
・同点は同じ順位に。まだ評価していないものは最後に並びます
・一覧の画像を1枚決めると、順位と名前のあいだに表示

■ 記録も残せる
・項目ごとにメモと写真（カメラ・アルバムから）
・ダークモード、大きな文字、VoiceOver に対応

■ データは iPhone の中だけ
・アカウント登録なし、広告なし、データを外部へ送信しません
・データと写真を1つのファイルに書き出すバックアップで、機種変更にも対応

■ 自分ランキング Pro（買い切り）
家族や友達と、同じ基準で評価して順位を比べられます。
・題目ごとに評価する人を追加し、点数とメモを人ごとにつけられます
・人ごとの順位の切り替えと、全員の平均の順位の「比較」
ひとりでの評価・ランキング・写真・バックアップは無料で使えます。

name: Merry Arrow
description:
Welcome to a tiny theater where every direction is part of the show. The arrows do not sit still. You swipe them, hold them, and cue them, and the stage answers.

Merry Arrow is not a menu of reading. Each act is a short performance you play with your hands.

ARROW ORCHESTRA — THE CONDUCTOR'S STAND
Four arrow musicians share one stage. Swipe the matching direction on beat. Flick the fast notes, hold the long ones, and press two pads together when a chord arrives. The window is the music. Miss the beat and the phrase drops. Later performances add mirrored hands, tighter timing, and phrases you have to remember.

CHEER WAVE — THE SEATING BOWL
The crowd is a fan of sections, each with its own arrow. Swipe across an arrow to stand that section, and along it to sit them down. Some rows only join a wave that reaches them. Match the small preview before you run out of actions. A cleared pattern can be played again as a stricter Encore.

CONFETTI CUE — THE FINALE PRESS
Colored shells drift in toward marked zones. Press the cue the current rule asks for, right as a shell arrives. The rule can flip: follow the arrow, answer with its opposite, or turn it clockwise. Two buttons at once fire a diagonal. Land the burst inside the circle and the pattern fills in.

A COMPLETE FESTIVAL
• 78 levels, thirty in Arrow Orchestra and twenty-four in each of the other acts, all free and retryable.
• Three Festival Specials, one for each act, with a harder Encore remix on every level you have cleared.
• Three stars on every level, from a clear to a precise performance.
• Three assists on each level. They widen a phrase, preview a wave, or reveal the next cues.
• Thirteen posters on the festival wall, each with a real unlock condition.
• A daily festival note, plus arrow costumes, finger trails, and a practice room for swipe and rhythm.
• High-contrast arrows, a visual beat flash, and calmer decorations when you want a quieter stage.

name: Lexicoggle
description:
An excellent vocabulary might just save a very peculiar little life.
Meet the Coggles: small creatures with impeccable hats and questionable survival instincts. In Lexicoggle, your words become their way out. Solve crossword-style clues, arrange the letter blocks, and build a connected escape route through a wonderfully strange world.
Every expedition brings six predicaments. Every answer brings your unlikely adventurers one step closer to safety.
WORDS THAT BUILD THE WAY
Turn answers into bridge decks, ladder rungs, slide sections, tunnel supports, and bomb locks. Watch the Coggles walk, climb, duck, and slide through the route you create.
THREE CURIOUS WORLDS
Explore The Cloudreach, The Underbloom, and The Sundrift. Discover storybook landscapes with changing routes, scenery, and obstacles across your expeditions.
A LITTLE PERIL. OR A LITTLE PEACE.
Race a shared clock as ledges crumble and fuses burn. Correct answers buy precious time. Prefer a gentler adventure? Take the scenic route and enjoy the rescue without a timer.
THINK A FEW STEPS AHEAD
Explore the course and tackle obstacles in your own order. Unfinished answers and completed structures stay in place as you move between clues. Need a nudge? Use a letter hint, shuffle the blocks, or try a different word.
KEEP NOTES FROM THE PECULIAR
Collect solved words in your personal word cabinet and track your rescues and best streak. Return to your discoveries whenever curiosity strikes.
Your next expedition is waiting. The Coggles would tip their hats, but they’re rather busy being in trouble.

name: Heatwave: Launch Companion
description:
Your field journal for the biggest open-world launch of the year.

Heatwave counts you down to midnight, then keeps a map of everything you find once you're in.

COUNT DOWN TO MIDNIGHT
• A live countdown to launch in your local time
• Launch alerts 24 hours out, 1 hour out, and the moment it unlocks
• The Final Countdown: a live timer on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Home and Lock Screen widgets

MAP EVERY FIND
• Drop pins for collectibles, stashes, shops, vehicles, viewpoints and more
• Filter by type, pinch to zoom, add notes
• Couch Mode: a big, glanceable map for your phone next to the TV
• Log a find hands-free with Siri

SEE WHAT OTHER PLAYERS FOUND
• Share a pin with the community in one tap
• Pins are verified once three players confirm them, and hidden if players say they're not there
• Report and block tools keep it clean

TRACK YOUR ROAD TO 100%
• Goals with progress rings for missions, collectibles, properties, cars and anything else
• See which regions you've explored

KNOW THE MAP BEFORE YOU LAND
• A guide to all six confirmed regions
• Verified cheats, only codes tested on a real copy

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
New regions, landmarks and cheats arrive in the app as they're confirmed, with no update needed.

HEATWAVE+
One purchase, no subscription: unlimited goals, Couch Mode, voice logging and alternate app icons.

Your pins and goals stay on your iPhone. Community pins are shared only when you choose to share them.

Heatwave is an unofficial fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All map art and text in the app is original.

name: CraftBench Studio
description:
CraftBench Studio brings five focused workshop utilities together in one clean, structured workspace—designed for makers, printmakers, technicians, and studio creators.

FIVE SPECIALIZED STUDIO TOOLS

• Registration
Measure print alignment offsets, account for material tolerances, and export compensated PDF sheets with clear reference marks.

• Reassemble
Document step-by-step teardown and assembly workflows with numbered stages, part checklists, photos, and printable summary reports.

• Swatch Lab
Compare fabric dimensions before and after washing, track directional shrinkage, and calculate accurate cut allowances.

• QuietLab
Measure ambient sound levels, review frequency balance, and log acoustic checks for workspaces, studios, or listening rooms.

• Motif
Plan repeating patterns, seam alignments, and continuous roll layouts with visual previews and exportable layout sheets.

BUILT FOR STRUCTURED WORKFLOWS
• Unified project hub with search, filtering, and sample templates to get started quickly.
• Share and export clean PDF reports, reference sheets, and structured project archives via the system share sheet or Files.
• Clean typography, light-mode studio palette, and adaptive layouts for iPhone and foldable displays.
• Optional one-time CraftBench Studio Pro upgrade ($4.99) for expanded archives, full-resolution exports, and custom presets—no subscriptions required.

name: Bible Rise
description:
Start the day with a moment in the Word.

Bible Rise brings scripture into your morning routine. Set an alarm, open your daily verse, and read it aloud three times. Follow the highlighted words and three-step progress indicator. Your third verified reading completes the morning and cancels follow-up reminders; tap Rise & Shine for a morning blessing.

YOUR MORNING RHYTHM
• One verse, three readings.
• Morning alarms and follow-up reminders.
• Current streak, longest streak and total mornings saved on your iPhone.
• 69 encouraging World English Bible verses across seven themes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account is needed. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone, with no cloud-transcription fallback. Bible Rise does not save audio or transcripts or sync your streak to a server.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Start free with one alarm, the Morning Mercies theme and local streak tracking. An optional auto-renewing Premium subscription unlocks unlimited alarms and all seven verse themes. Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store account settings.

Requires iOS 26 and on-device English speech recognition. Microphone, speech and alarm permissions are required.

name: Apuntia: AI Flashcards
description:
Turn your notes into study material in seconds.

PHOTO → SUMMARY, FLASHCARDS AND QUIZ
Scan your notes or a book (multiple pages), pick photos, import a PDF or paste text. Apuntia reads the text —even clear handwriting— and the AI builds a summary of the key points, question-and-answer flashcards and a multiple-choice quiz with explanations.

SPACED REPETITION
Every day you see only the cards that are due. The ones you missed come back soon; the ones you know, later. Remember more while studying less, with a daily streak, widget and reminder.

PRIVATE
Your notes are processed with Apple Intelligence right on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded. No accounts, no ads.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 1 AI deck per day, unlimited spaced repetition and manual cards.
Apuntia Pro: unlimited AI decks and practice quizzes. Try it free for a week.

Creating AI decks and quizzes requires an Apple Intelligence–compatible iPhone (iPhone 15 Pro or later) with Apple Intelligence turned on; manual cards and review work on any iPhone with iOS 26.

name: Tinge: Film Looks
description:
Give your photographs a distinctive look with Tinge, a photo editor built around a considered collection of presets.

Choose a photo from your library, try different looks, adjust their strength, and refine the image with light, colour, curve and grain controls. Press and hold to compare with your original. Save a full-resolution copy, or update an editable Photos item while keeping its original available to revert in Photos.

Create your own looks, import supported Tinge JSON, 3D LUT and Lightroom preset files, and explore the free Tinge catalogue. Tinge processes photos on your device. Editing and exporting remain available offline. The catalogue is downloaded when a connection is available and cached locally; no photograph is uploaded.

Optional one-time support may be available through Apple. All editing tools and exports remain free.

Imported presets may look different from their source applications, and some formats and settings are not supported.

name: Undisturbed: Deep Work Timer
description:
Undisturbed is a deep work timer with one rule: the phone stays face down.

Set a length with a swipe, put the phone face down, and the session begins. There is no button to start. The screen stays dark and quiet until the time is up, then the phone chimes and buzzes through the silent switch so you know you can surface.

PICK IT UP AND THE CLOCK STOPS
Need to check the time left? Lift the phone and the timer pauses for thirty seconds while a ring counts down. Put it back and nothing happened. Switch to another app and that is a strike. Three strikes and the session is over.

EVERY FINISHED SESSION LANDS ON YOUR GRID
A year of days, one square each, deeper blue the longer you worked. Interrupted days show in a soft warm tone, never red. Tap any day to see each session on a 24-hour strip, your streak, your longest block, and exactly when you got pulled away.

BADGES WORTH BRAGGING ABOUT
Sixteen badges for the moments that matter: your first flip, your first unbroken hour, seven days in a row, a three-hour haul, an early start, a late night. Each one can be shared as a card. Shake the phone on the History tab to share your grid.

THE SMALL THINGS
- Hold the timer to adjust by the minute
- Shake to reset
- A reminder to silence the phone, placed next to the actual switch
- History syncs between your iPhones through your own iCloud
- Light and dark, following your phone

NO ADS. NO DATA COLLECTION.
Undisturbed has no accounts, no analytics and no servers. Your sessions live on your phone and in your iCloud. The app is paid, with a one-dollar first month, so it never has to sell your attention to anyone.

PLANS
Monthly, with the first month at an introductory price. Six months at a lower rate. Or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and are managed in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy policy: https://rituraj-io.github.io/undisturbedapp-site/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cuentaluna: Bedtime Stories
description:
Cuentaluna creates unique bedtime stories starring your child, and reads them aloud in a calm voice.

A NEW STORY TONIGHT
Choose where it happens (a forest, outer space, the sea, a castle…), who comes along (a teddy bear, a little dragon, a puppy…) and what they’ll learn: friendship, courage, sharing, not being afraid of the dark, welcoming a baby sibling, the first day of school. In seconds, the AI writes an original story, always gentle and with a calm, sleepy ending.

NARRATION FOR BEDTIME
Listen to the story read aloud, with adjustable speed and a sleep timer. It keeps playing with the screen locked.

A LIBRARY OF ORIGINAL STORIES
24 stories written for bedtime, in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

PRIVATE AND AD-FREE
Stories are created with Apple Intelligence right on your iPhone. Neither your child’s name nor the stories are sent to the internet. No accounts, no ads.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 1 AI story every night, 6 library stories, narration and one profile.
Cuentaluna Pro: unlimited AI stories, the full library and profiles for all your kids. Try it free for a week.

name: 269 Group
description:
269 Group lleva tus compras de Miami a Venezuela. Con la app tienes tu casillero en el bolsillo:

• Mira cada paquete que llega a tu casillero en Miami, con peso, medidas y fotos.
• Elige si se va por aéreo o marítimo y si quieres reempaque.
