name: CoMo Pet Care
description:
CoMo Pet Care is the app for CoMo Pet Care families in Columbia, Missouri.

Book care
- Dog walks, drop-in visits and pet sitting, with clear prices before you book
- Start with Meet Your Caregiver, a $25 Welcome Visit where your caregiver gets to know your pets and your home
- Pick your arrival window, and see your upcoming visits in one place

CoMo Club
- A monthly plan with credits for your regular visits
- Your usual days, booked for you each month
- Member prices and member perks

After every visit
- Photos and a report card from your sitter
- Watch your dog's walk live on a map, then see the route, distance and time in the walk report
- A note when your sitter is on the way, and when the visit is done

Stay in touch
- Message your sitter and CoMo Pet Care in the app
- Notifications for messages and visit updates

Your account
- Sign in with email, Apple or Google
- Your pets' details, care notes and home instructions, kept private
- CoMo Rewards points for completed visits
- Delete your account any time from the app

For the CoMo Pet Care team, the same app holds their schedule, visits, clock and team chat.

Payments for care are handled securely by Stripe. CoMo Pet Care serves Columbia, Missouri and nearby areas.

name: Panic Attack & Anxiety: Pufflo
description:
Panic attack right now? Open Pufflo and tap SOS. A soft, fluffy companion breathes with you, slowly, until the wave passes.

Pufflo is a self-help app for panic attacks and anxiety. It gives you something clear to do in the hardest minutes, and helps you understand panic in the calm ones.

WHEN PANIC HITS
• SOS in one tap from the home screen: breathe in for 4, out for 6, together with Pufflo.
• 5-4-3-2-1 grounding: notice what you see, touch and hear, and come back to the room.
• Comfort cards: short, steady words for the moment and for afterwards.
• Your trusted person and crisis help lines for 38 countries, one tap away.

CALM YOUR BODY
• Breathing exercises: long exhale, box breathing, 4-7-8, double inhale sigh, even five.
• Grounding guides: feet on the floor, cool water reset, body scan, muscle release.
• Calming games: pop a bubble on every slow breath out, trace a wave, squeeze and let go.

UNDERSTAND PANIC
• 14 short lessons on what a panic attack is, why the body does it and what loosens its grip. Every lesson lists its sources.
• Thought check: a simple CBT-style way to weigh a scary thought.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• A private journal of attacks, daily check-ins and thought checks.
• Insights: attacks per week, common triggers, intensity before and after.
• A PDF report you can show your doctor or therapist.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your journal stays on your iPhone and is not uploaded.

PUFFLO PRO
SOS, the journal, two breathing rhythms, 5-4-3-2-1, the Bubbles game, the first three lessons and part of the comfort cards are open to everyone. Pufflo Pro opens every breathing rhythm, grounding guide, game, lesson and comfort card, unlimited thought checks, 8-week insights and the PDF report. Pro is an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription, or a single lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

IMPORTANT
Pufflo offers self-help tools and general education. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment or emergency care. If you are in danger, or your symptoms are new or severe, call your local emergency number or talk to a doctor.

Privacy Policy: https://flirta.app/privacy-flirta

name: Tresso. Шлях до багатства
description:
Tresso — простий щоденний помічник, який допомагає зберегти частину кожного доходу й дійти до своїх фінансових цілей. В основі — перевірені правила з книги «Найбагатша людина у Вавилоні»: спершу собі, потім — усе інше.

ЯК ЦЕ ПРАЦЮЄ
• Додайте дохід за три дотики — у гривні, доларах чи євро.
• Розподіліть його будь-коли: частка собі, обов’язкові витрати, фінансові цілі й вільні кошти.
• Щодня бачите, скільки можна витратити сьогодні. Не витратили — завтра можна більше.
• Наприкінці місяця Tresso підсумує, скільки лишилося на руках, і перенесе це в новий місяць.

ПОДУШКА БЕЗПЕКИ
Бачите не суму, а скільки місяців зможете прожити без доходу. Підказки, як тримати подушку в різних валютах.

ФІНАНСОВІ ЦІЛІ
Лікування, ремонт, авто, власне житло чи капітал на старість. Топ-3 цілі з прогресом, черга решти, досягнуті й реалізовані цілі. Пауза перед тим, як забрати гроші з цілі, нагадує, чого ви насправді хочете.

ВИХІД З БОРГІВ
План 70/20/10 і метод «Лавина»: мінімальні платежі всім, решта — на найдорожчий борг. Видно дату, коли ви вийдете в плюс.

ВАЛЮТИ ТА КУРСИ
Приблизні суми в гривні за курсом НБУ, ПриватБанку чи monobank. Записуйте реальні обміни з курсом і місцем обміну.

МУДРІСТЬ ДНЯ ТА УРОКИ
Щодня — одна коротка думка про гроші від Баффета, Франкліна, героїв Вавилону та інших, з одним конкретним кроком для вас. Короткі уроки відкриваються саме тоді, коли вони потрібні.

ПЕРЕМОГИ
Зібрали подушку, закрили борг чи досягли цілі — Tresso відзначить це разом з вами. А власне житло — окрема, головна перемога.

ПРИВАТНІСТЬ
Без реєстрації, без серверів і без реклами. Усі дані зберігаються лише на вашому iPhone. Захист Face ID.

Tresso не є фінансовим, інвестиційним чи податковим радником. Рішення ви ухвалюєте самі.

name: 1 in 8 Billion: Life Sim
description:
One tap. One random life. Anywhere on Earth.

There are 8 billion people – where would you have been born? 1 in 8 Billion drops you into a real country, a real family and a real point in history, with odds based on real-world birth numbers. Then life happens.

LIVE A WHOLE LIFE IN MINUTES
• Be born in Japan, Brazil, Nigeria, Germany or anywhere else
• Make choices: school, friends, career, love, family, moving abroad
• Your country and era shape your chances – health, school, work and history
• Every life ends with a life card – your story in one picture

TIME TRAVEL
• Be born in any era from 1500 to 2050 – from the Renaissance to the future

COLLECT THE WORLD
• Fill your world atlas with every country you have lived in
• Earn quilts and keep your life cards
• Try again: city or village, rich or poor – every life is different

A thoughtful, surprising game about luck, chance and how differently life can turn out.

Free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads.

name: 1Day1Diary - Everyday Diary
description:
Leave today's entry in just a few lines, even on busy days.
No sign-up needed.

Write

name: 1Rush Game
description:
A fast, colorful run-and-jump platformer you can play anywhere, with no Wi-Fi, no ads and no account. Your hero runs on their own. You time the jumps, slides and stomps. Simple to learn, hard to master.

400 LEVELS IN 4 WORLDS
• Green Valley: grassy hills, first gaps and friendly tutorials
• Desert Rush: cactus fields, rolling boulders and sun-baked ledges
• Frozen Peaks: icy platforms, high jumps and tricky drops
• Lava Kingdom: fire traps, lava pools and the hardest runs in the game
Each world has 100 levels, and every one is tested to be beatable. No impossible jumps.

ONE-TAP CONTROLS, DEEP SKILL
• Tap to jump, tap again in the air for a double jump
• Slide under barriers and low obstacles
• Stomp enemies from above to clear the path
• Checkpoints inside longer levels
• Short tutorial levels teach every move

COLLECT, UNLOCK, IMPROVE
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level and chase your best score
• Grab coins and rare gems hidden along the route
• Open treasure chests and claim a free daily reward
• Power-ups: coin magnet, shield and double coins
• Unlock 4 heroes: Kai, Mia, Max and Whiskers the cat

PAY ONCE. NO ADS. NO TRACKING.
• One-time purchase: every hero and level is earned by playing
• No ads and no in-app purchases
• No sign-up, no login, no data collected
• Plays fully offline: flights, the subway, road trips
• Progress is saved only on your device

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Bright cartoon art, cheerful music and no violence beyond bopping cartoon critters. A casual game for kids, teens and adults, and a real challenge for platformer fans chasing three stars on every stage.

Music, sound and haptics can be adjusted in Settings. Portrait mode, playable with one thumb.

name: a.do
description:
a.do is a to-do app built around one idea: every task should be one tap from done.

Write "call Dr. Patel about lab results" and a.do gives you a call button. "Pay the electric bill" opens the payment page. "Pick up the prescription" opens directions. You stop managing a list and start finishing it.

CAPTURE ANYTHING
• Type in plain language. a.do works out the action, the timing and the urgency.
• Hold the mic and talk. One ramble becomes several separate tasks.
• Snap a bill, flyer, screenshot, PDF or handwritten note and pull the tasks out of it.
• Share links, text and files to a.do from any app.
• Add tasks with Siri, Shortcuts and widgets.

REMINDERS THAT DON'T LET GO
• Four urgency levels, from a quiet nudge to an alarm that breaks through Silent and Focus.
• Live Activities keep the next task on your Lock Screen.
• Snooze something too often and a.do offers to shrink it, park it, or drop it.

THE RIGHT MOMENT
• Schedule tasks into the free slots in your calendar.
• Get errands when you arrive at saved places or near a pharmacy or grocery store.
• Turn several errands into one multi-stop route in Apple Maps.
• Clear quick tasks in a 2-Minute Blitz.

ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
• Areas, lists and smart lists.
• Private lists locked with Face ID.
• Two-way sync with Apple Reminders.
• Send a task to someone else as a link.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No tracking. No analytics.
• Your tasks are read and organized on your device.
• iCloud sync is optional and uses your own private iCloud.
• An optional setting lets Apple's Private Cloud Compute read dense documents. It is off by default.

Some capture features use Apple Intelligence and need a supported device. Without it, a.do still understands plain-language tasks.

A.DO PRO
a.do is free to use with limits: 15 open tasks, 3 lists, 1 smart list, 1 private list, 2 saved places, and 1 or 2 uses a month of Snap to Do, voice capture, free-slot scheduling, errand routes, 2-Minute Blitz and task sharing.

a.do Pro removes every limit. Choose one:
• Yearly: $19.99 a year, with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers.
• Lifetime: $49.99, paid once.

The yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

name: ABMLvix
description:
Designed for clarity and everyday use, this app brings together practical training tools in a simple, focused interface that feels easy to navigate from the first open.

Training works best when the next step is obvious. This experience is built to help lifters organize the week, record working sets with weight, reps, and RPE, review weekly volume and strength progress, and keep lift-day protein on track.

Reliable, responsive, and continually refined, it supports a complete powerlifting routine—weekly planning, live bout logging, progress review, fuel tracking, and training preferences—in one clear workflow.

name: Abyss Pinball
description:
Drop into the deep. Abyss is a neon deep-sea pinball game built for two thumbs and short dives.

Shoot Kraken's Lair to accept a mission, follow the lit arrows, and sink one depth rank further each time you finish one, from Snorkeler all the way down to Abyss Master.

MISSIONS
• Current Run: ride the Current Ramp 3 times
• Pearl Diver: drop all three pearl targets
• Jelly Bloom: hit the jellyfish bumpers 12 times
• Deep Lanes: light all three top lanes

REAL PINBALL FEEL
• Hold the left or right side of the screen to flip, with full multi-touch
• Pull down and release to fire the plunger
• Tilt your phone and the ball rolls towards the low side
• Shake to nudge the ball, but three nudges in a row is a TILT
• Haptic feedback on every hit

CHASE THE HIGH SCORE
• Each finished mission pays 25,000 × your depth rank
• Light the top lanes to raise your bonus multiplier up to 5×
• 3 balls, a ball save at the start of each ball, and an extra ball at 250,000
• Your best score is saved between dives

ATMOSPHERE
Original ambient music and sound effects, glowing jellyfish, sonar sweeps and a watchful Kraken. Music, sound and tilt can each be switched off.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Works completely offline.

name: Acclimate Chapters
description:
Acclimate is a journal for the months when your GLP-1 dose is being stepped up.

Each dose step is a chapter. You log your shots and how you feel. Acclimate counts what you logged and shows it week by week, so you can see what your own entries say about each step.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Keep each dose step as its own chapter, with the schedule your prescriber gave you
• Log a shot in a few taps and see how long each injection site has rested
• Check in on how you feel: pick what bothered you, and how much
• Put week 1 of a step next to the latest week, counted from your own entries
• Log your weight, or share weight with Apple Health if you choose to
• Get a reminder at the time you set; the notification names neither the medication nor the amount
• Hand your prescriber a one-page PDF summary

WHAT ACCLIMATE DOES NOT DO
• It does not suggest a dose or a date
• It does not calculate or convert doses
• It makes no guess at medication levels
• It does not give medical advice

YOUR ENTRIES STAY YOURS
• No sign-up. Nothing advertised, nothing tracked
• Stored only on your phone, never in iCloud
• Save a backup file whenever you like; it brings everything back on a new phone
• Export every entry as CSV

SUBSCRIPTION
Adding entries needs a subscription, monthly or yearly, with a free trial for new subscribers. Before you start, the app shows the date of the first charge.
If you stop subscribing, everything you logged stays readable, and the summary, PDF, CSV export and backup keep working. Only adding entries and reminders pause.

Acclimate is a personal journal. It is no substitute for your prescriber, and it is not a medical device.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://hayriodabas.github.io/acclimate/privacy.html

name: Aftersight: Delay Mirror
description:
Aftersight is a mirror that runs a few seconds late.

Do the lift, the swing or the turn. Then look up. The screen is still showing you doing it, so you can check your form without walking to your phone, stopping a recording and scrubbing back.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO

• It stands by itself. Open your Duo part-way and stand it like a greeting card. No tripod, no water bottle to lean it on.
• Best camera, and you can still see yourself. The main cameras film you while the cover display, right beside them, is your mirror.
• Two sides, two jobs. The inner display becomes a coach's desk: live picture on one half, what the athlete is seeing on the other, with the fold between them.
• A stance guide that reads the hinge. It shows how far the screen is turned away from the cameras at the angle you've set.

It also works as a one-screen delay mirror on any iPhone.

WHAT IT DOES

• Delay: choose how far behind the mirror runs, from 1 to 10 seconds.
• Replay: one tap loops the last 10 seconds.
• Scrub: drag the last minute back and forth; step frame by frame. On a Duo, whatever the coach holds on screen is what the athlete sees.
• Keep: save the moment you just watched as a clip. Nothing is written to storage until you ask.
• Study: draw lines and measure angles over a clip, at full, half or quarter speed.

AFTERSIGHT PRO — ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION

• Auto Replay: stop moving and your last effort starts looping by itself. Start moving and the mirror comes back.
• Skeleton overlay: your joints drawn on the mirror, the replay and your clips, with knee and hip angles beside them, and the path of the bar traced through every rep.
• Slow motion replays, filmed at 60 frames a second.
• Unlimited kept clips, and two clips side by side, one on each half of the fold.
• Delays up to 60 seconds, for whole routines.

PRIVATE BY CONSTRUCTION

No account. No analytics. No ads. No sound is ever recorded. Video stays in your iPhone's memory and is discarded as it ages; a clip exists only if you keep it, and leaves the app only if you share it.

name: Afterword: Sales Coach & Notes
description:
Afterword takes notes on your in-person appointments and helps make sure the important details are not missed.

Bring the Plaud you already own and use it for all your in-person appointments. Afterword takes AI notes, generates custom summaries shaped to your sales process, and creates coaching resources like scorecards your team can use to identify training opportunities.

Bring your whole team. It is fully customizable for your workflow, and it integrates with your CRM and the tools you already run, including Salesforce, Podio, and GoHighLevel. It also has an MCP and an API to connect it to the rest of your stack.

The official Plaud app leaves something to be desired. Afterword closes that gap: the notes, the coaching, and the connection into the systems your business already uses.

name: AG Mobile Bridge
description:
AG Mobile Bridge 是专为开发者自托管 Mac 守护桥（ag-mobile-bridge / ACP 协议）打造的原生 iOS 与 iPadOS 随身客户端，让你离开电脑时也能顺畅查看项目进展、审阅代码改动，并直接在原电脑会话中无缝继续推进任务。

核心能力：
- 原生会话无缝接续：连接你自己的 Mac 本地守护桥同步工作区与对话历史，手机端回复直接落入桌面原会话，不产生分叉副本。
- 同网与异地加密自愈连接：局域网支持 Bonjour 自动寻址与 6 位动态配对码；外出可通过二维码完成 HMAC 校验与加密隧道自动重连，Wi-Fi 与蜂窝网络切换顺滑无感，并内置四跳连接诊断面板。
- 清晰易读的开发对话流：每轮思考与工具调用步骤智能折叠汇总，告别刷屏；原生排版支持标题、语法代码块（一键复制）、表格、列表与提示块。
- 灵动岛与远程放行审批：长耗时构建与测试支持锁屏实时活动与灵动岛进度展示，关键工具授权可直接在手机端审阅放行。
- 免电脑离线演示模式：无需配对任何电脑，首次打开点击「体验演示模式」即可在设备本地完整体验工作区筛选、代码块阅读、工具折叠与模拟流式回复。

name: Agentia
description:
A Agentia é o ambiente de trabalho da sua empresa para criar e acompanhar agentes de IA de atendimento.

Com o app você pode:
• Entrar com o e-mail e a senha da sua conta Agentia, em uma tela de login nativa.
• Ver o painel da sua organização, com pendências e próximos passos.
• Criar e configurar agentes: nome, personalidade, perguntas frequentes e limites.
• Testar o agente em conversas e acompanhar o histórico de atendimento.
• Começar mais rápido com modelos prontos por setor.
• Gerenciar privacidade e dados: exportar dados e solicitar exclusão dentro do app.
• Compartilhar e salvar arquivos pela folha de compartilhamento do iOS.
• Recuperar o acesso quando a conexão cai, com uma tela nativa que tenta de novo.

O acesso é feito com uma conta Agentia da sua organização, normalmente criada por convite do administrador.

name: Aheadtalk
description:
Talk your way to fluent English. Aheadtalk is a voice tutor you speak with out loud, like a real call.

Pick a situation and start talking. Your tutor plays the other side and keeps the conversation going. When you make a mistake, it says the sentence back the right way, so you hear it in context.

PRACTISE THE CONVERSATIONS THAT MATTER AT WORK
- Job interview
- Team update and meeting
- Client call and negotiation
- Presentation
- Networking and small talk
Travel and daily life are there too: the restaurant, the airport and the hotel. Or just talk about anything in open practice.

AFTER EVERY CALL
You get a short report with your corrected sentences, new phrases and what to work on next. The full transcript stays in the app.

LEARN NEW WORDS EVERY DAY
Five new words a day by default, with example sentences and short spoken drills. Words come back for review when you are about to forget them. Tap any word to see its meaning, or ask "How do I say this in English?"

MADE FOR YOUR LANGUAGE
Explanations and the app itself are in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Turkish and Arabic. Choose a female or male tutor voice.

AHEADTALK PRO
- 200 minutes of conversation every month
- Monthly or yearly subscription. The monthly plan starts with a lower price for the first month.
- Need more time? Extra minute packs never expire.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Your voice is processed by OpenAI to run the conversation, and only after you agree in the app. You can delete your account and data in Settings.

name: AI Celebrity
description:
Create any celebrity and chat with them like you're texting a star.

TYPE A NAME, START CHATTING
Type who you want to talk to and AI Celebrity writes their personality for you: their attitude, their slang, their energy. Want to tweak it? Edit the personality prompt any way you like.

GROUP CHATS
Put up to 5 of your favorites in one chat and watch them react to you and to each other.

TALK OUT LOUD
Voice mode listens to you and your celebrity talks back through your speaker. Pick from different voices and styles like Hype, Deep, Smooth and Chill.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence. No account, no servers, no tracking, no ads.

SIMPLE PRICING
Your first 40 messages are free. Then try everything free for 30 days. Love it? Keep it forever with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

Characters are AI-generated parodies for entertainment and aren't affiliated with or endorsed by any real person.

REQUIRES APPLE INTELLIGENCE: iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max, any iPhone 16 or iPhone 17, iPhone Air, or newer, on iOS 26 or later, with Apple Intelligence turned on.

name: AI Grocery Calculator
description:
Trying to keep a running total in your head while you shop? AI Grocery Calculator does it for you. Point your camera at a shelf price tag and it reads the item and the price, then adds it to your cart.

POINT AT A PRICE TAG. THAT’S IT.
• Reads the item name, price, regular price and card or member deals in one go
• Works with paper tags and electronic shelf labels
• Text recognition runs on your phone. Your photos never leave it

A LIVE TOTAL, DEALS INCLUDED
• Counts BOGO, buy 2 get 1 and buy 3 get 1 deals, plus card and member prices
• Switch discounted prices on and off to see what you’ll actually pay
• Set a budget and watch how much is left as you shop

WHICH IS CHEAPER? COMPARE UNIT PRICES
• Compares the same kind of product per ounce
• See right away whether the gallon or the half gallon is the better deal

EVERY TRIP AT A GLANCE
• Finished trips are saved to your history
• See what you spent by category over the last 7 days, 30 days or year

BACK UP AND KEEP GOING
• Email yourself a backup of your history and cart, then import it on your new phone

PRICE TAGS FROM 25 COUNTRIES
• Reads the currencies and price tags of the US, Canada, the UK, Australia, Korea, Japan, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Brazil, Mexico and more

Prefer no ads? Remove them forever with a single one-time purchase.

name: Alarmize: Mission Alarm Clock
description:
Snooze is over. Alarmize is an alarm clock that makes you get up for real.

When your alarm goes off, the only way to stop it is to finish a quick mission: shake your phone, solve a few sums, find something in your home and photograph it, or do some push-ups. Hit Stop without finishing, and Alarmize rings again two minutes later, until you're properly up.

MISSIONS THAT WAKE YOUR BODY AND BRAIN
• Shake Phone: shake until the bar fills.
• Math: solve problems to switch your brain on.
• Object Hunt: find and photograph a mug, a toothbrush, your shoes… The photo is checked right on your phone.
• Push-ups, Squats and Dance: your camera counts every rep, with a live skeleton on screen.
• Daily Random Quest: a surprise every morning.
Stack up to three missions per alarm, choose Easy, Medium or Hard, and practise any of them before bedtime.

A REAL ALARM, NOT A REMINDER
• Rings like the built-in Clock app, even in silent mode and Focus.
• 20 alarm tones, from gentle chimes and birdsong to bells, sirens and an air horn.
• No snooze by default. Need one? Turn it on in Settings.

KNOW HOW YOU WAKE UP
• See how fast you respond to your alarm, and whether you're getting quicker.
• Build a wake-up streak and track your average wake-up time across the week.

YOUR BEDTIME COMPANION
• A bedside clock that stays on all night, with a "Dim screen" button for dark rooms.
• Five cuddly wake-up buddies, each with their own animated bedroom.
• Calming sleep sounds (rain, storms, ocean waves, fireplace, white noise and more) with a sleep timer, playing even with the screen off.
• Home Screen and StandBy widgets show your next alarm and your sleeping buddy.
• And every morning, after your mission, your buddy greets you with a cup of coffee.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos and videos for missions are checked on your phone and deleted. Nothing is uploaded, and no account is needed.

Available in English, 繁體中文, 日本語 and 한국어.

ALARMIZE PRO
Alarmize is free to use with one alarm, the Shake mission, Pip as your buddy and the Light Rain sleep sound.
Alarmize Pro unlocks unlimited alarms, every mission, all five buddies and bedtime scenes, every sleep sound, and removes ads. Choose monthly or yearly, both with a 7-day free trial.

name: Alibi Gambit
description:
Solve nine number puzzles to uncover what happened to a missing archivist.

Ada Mercer has vanished. In her locked study, a clock and a train ticket give you somewhere to start. Follow the numbers through three acts, unlock evidence with each correct answer, and see whose story holds up.

• Solve arithmetic clues using number patterns, missing values, and the order of operations. Open a hint whenever you need one.
• Review nine clues on the evidence wall. Compare times, photographs, and physical evidence before naming your suspect.
• Pick up where you left off with progress saved on your device, or reopen the case for a fresh investigation.
• Play offline without an account. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese, choose light paper or dark ink, and control clue sounds in Settings.

name: Align Me: Posture Reminder
description:
Align Me is a posture reminder that uses your front camera. Prop your phone next to your desk and it nudges you the moment you start slouching, hunching, craning your neck forward or frowning, before your neck and shoulders start to ache.

Long hours at the desk, studying or reading pull everyone into bad posture without noticing. Align Me helps you catch it early and sit up straight again.

TWO MODES
• Posture: phone low and further away. Watches for forward head posture (text neck), hunching, slumping and raised shoulders.
• Face: phone at eye level. Watches for frowning, squinting and pressed lips, so you can relax your face.

NO CAMERA ON SCREEN
During a session you only see a penguin that mirrors your posture. Tense areas change colour and go back to normal as you straighten up.

NUDGES THAT MAKE SENSE
• Compared with your own relaxed baseline from calibration, not one threshold for everyone.
• Only reminds you when bad posture lasts, so talking or laughing won't set it off.
• Vibration, soft sounds and adjustable sensitivity.
• Tap "Not right" and it backs off that reminder.

MADE FOR
• Office workers and anyone working from home at a computer all day.
• Students studying or revising for exams.
• Readers who spend hours with a paper book.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your phone. No images are stored or sent anywhere, no account needed, and it works offline.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Each session ends with a summary: how much of the time you sat straight and stayed relaxed, and which posture habit tripped you up most. Your history shows the trend day by day.

FREE PLAN
2 sessions a day, up to 25 minutes each. Pro unlocks unlimited and longer sessions, full history, all 6 sounds and every character.

Align Me is not a medical device and does not replace advice from a doctor.

The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or turn off auto-renew in your App Store account settings after purchase.

name: Alıştırma Defteri: İlkokul
description:
Alıştırma Defteri, 1, 2, 3 ve 4. sınıf öğrencileri için hazırlanmış bir Matematik ve Türkçe alıştırma uygulamasıdır. Oyun değil, gerçek bir çalışma defteri: çocuğunuz sınıfını seçer, konusunu seçer ve her seferinde yeni sorularla alıştırma yapar. Sorular ilkokul kazanımlarına göre sınıf sınıf hazırlanmıştır.

MATEMATİK (17 ALIŞTIRMA TÜRÜ)
• Toplama: eldeli, eldesiz ya da karışık; alt alta veya yan yana
• Çıkarma: onluk bozmalı, bozmasız ya da karışık
• Çarpma ve bölme: kalanlı ve kalansız bölme
• Basamak sayısını siz seçin: 1, 2, 3 veya 4 basamaklı sayılarla işlem
• Çarpım tablosu: istediğiniz tabloları seçin (2'ler, 7'ler...)
• Karışık işlemler, eksik sayıyı bulma (□ + 4 = 9)
• Büyük-küçük-eşit, tek ve çift sayılar, sayı okuma ve yazma
• Basamak ve basamak değeri, örüntüler ve ritmik sayma, yuvarlama
• Saat okuma: tam, yarım, çeyrek ve dakika; "Saat üçü çeyrek geçiyor" gibi okunuşlar
• Kesirler: bütün, yarım, çeyrek ve kesir gösterimi
• Geometrik şekiller, kenar ve köşe sayısı
• Problemler: okuyup çözülen günlük hayat problemleri

TÜRKÇE (20 ALIŞTIRMA TÜRÜ)
• Sesli ve sessiz harfler, kelimedeki sesli/sessiz harfleri dokunarak bulma
• Kalın ve ince ünlüler, büyük ünlü uyumu
• Alfabe sırası, eksik harf
• Hecelere ayırma: harflerin arasına dokunarak heceleri ayırın, "Kontrol Et"e basın. Yanlış yere konan çizgiler kırmızı görünür, doğru heceleme renkli olarak gösterilir.
• Heceleri birleştirme, hece sayısı, eksik hece
• Resim ve kelime, çoğul eki (-ler / -lar)
• Eş anlamlı ve zıt anlamlı kelimeler, doğru yazım, kelime anlamı
• Alfabetik sıralama, cümle kurma, noktalama işaretleri, büyük harf kullanımı
• Okuduğunu anlama: kısa metinler ve sorular

ÇOCUĞA GÖRE ÇALIŞMA
• Seviye seçimi: Matematik ve Türkçe için 1-4. sınıf ayrı ayrı seçilir.
• Yanlış cevapta bir deneme hakkı daha verilir; ikinci yanlışta doğru cevap ve kısa bir açıklama gösterilir.
• Set sonunda hatalar tek tek listelenir, "Yanlışları Tekrar Çöz" ile yeniden çalışılır.
• Sevimli civciv maskot doğru cevapta sevinir, yanlışta cesaret verir.

ÇALIŞMA SAYACI VE HATIRLATICI
• Çalışma sayacı: 5, 10, 20 dakika ya da istediğiniz süreyi başlatın. Süre dolunca uygulama kapalı olsa bile bildirim gelir ve o sürede kaç soru çözüldüğü gösterilir.
• Günlük hatırlatıcı: ebeveyn bölümünden çalışma saatini ve günlerini seçin.

İLERLEME TAKİBİ
• Bugün çözülen soru sayısı, üst üste çalışılan gün serisi, son 7 günün grafiği
• Her alıştırma için yıldızlar ve başarı yüzdesi

AİLELER İÇİN
• Hesap açmak gerekmez, kişisel bilgi istenmez; ilerleme yalnızca cihazda saklanır.
• Ayarlar ve satın alma ebeveyn kontrolüyle korunur.
• Tüm alıştırmalar ücretsizdir. Çocuklara uygun reklamlar yalnızca ana sayfada ve alıştırma setleri arasında gösterilir; soru çözerken reklam çıkmaz.

REKLAMSIZ ABONELİK

Пресметаната цена е ориентациона и не е обврзувачка понуда. ALUSET ја потврдува цената по професионално мерење на лице место.

description:

name: AnatomyTouch: Japanese Anatomy
description:
Where is LI4? Where does the biceps brachii originate? Where is the inferior angle of the scapula?
AnatomyTouch is a study app where you answer by tapping a body figure.

Note: the content (names, readings and location texts) is in Japanese, made for Japanese national exams (acupuncture, judo therapy, physical and occupational therapy, nursing). Buttons and menus are in English.

TAP TO ANSWER
Whole-body figures drawn from 3D anatomy data (Z-Anatomy, based on BodyParts3D), from front, back, left and right, with muscle, bone and acupoint layers. Acupoints are judged by distance and muscles and bones by the part you tap. If you miss, the correct spot is circled in green.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 361 acupoints on 14 meridians, located to match the WHO/WPRO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008)
- Key points: source, connecting, cleft, front-mu, back-shu, five transport, influential, confluence, lower sea and four command points
- 183 muscles with origin, insertion, nerve, segments and action
- 64 bones and 414 bony landmarks shown as spots on the figure

QUESTION TYPES
- Tap the location on the figure
- Name the highlighted muscle or bone or the marked acupoint (multiple choice, then typed once you get it right)
- Origins, insertions, nerves and key points
- Hide and reveal cells of the key point table

DAILY ROUNDS
10, 20 or 30 questions. Items come back just before you'd forget them, based on days since your last answer and your streak. Missed items go into the mistake notebook until you get them right 3 times in a row.

ALSO
Search by name, reading, code (LI4) or English name. Lists by meridian and region. Streaks and progress by layer, synced through your iCloud. Side-by-side layout on iPad and iPhone Duo. With VoiceOver, figure questions switch to text multiple choice.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. The only network use is iCloud sync; the developer collects no data.

Not an official app of any exam body, school or publisher. No past exam questions included. For study only; not for treatment or diagnosis.
Figures: based on Z-Anatomy (CC BY-SA 4.0) and BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science (CC BY 4.0). The app's figures are CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Anla
description:
Anla is a free app for learning sign language. It starts with American Sign Language (ASL).

A friendly character shows each sign. Its hands and arms move the way real signers' did, and you can replay it, pause it, slow it down or mirror it.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Learn: short lessons by topic, from greetings and family to food, actions and time.
• Look up: search a word, browse topics, or type a few words and see them signed one after another.
• Practise: sign next to the character with your front camera as a mirror, then rate yourself. Nothing is recorded or sent.
• Review: signs you have learned come back when it is time to remember them.
• Progress: signs learned, practice days and how long you have practised, kept on your phone only.

THE APP SPEAKS FOUR LANGUAGES
English, Русский, Azərbaycanca and Türkçe.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, and the app does not connect to any server. Your progress stays on your phone.

AN HONEST NOTE
The signs come from the public PopSign ASL research dataset (CC BY 4.0). They were extracted by machine and a sign language teacher has not checked them yet, so mistakes are possible. Anla is a dictionary and practice tool, not a translator. If a sign looks wrong, tap "Report a wrong sign" and tell us.

name: ARR Flow
description:
ARR Flow is UniqLearn's internal workspace for its own staff. It needs a UniqLearn account, which is created by invitation; there is no public sign-up.

On your iPhone, ARR Flow brings together the work you do every day:

HOME
See today's meetings, the to-dos that are due and the reminders you set, with one tap to join a call.

MEETINGS
Record a meeting in the room with you. Recording keeps going with the screen locked, speech is turned into text on your phone, and ARR Flow writes the notes, summary and action items for you. Read the transcript by speaker, ask a question about what was said, and share the notes with colleagues.

MAIL
Your work inbox, sorted into Customers, Investors, Team and more. Snooze, file, turn an email into a to-do, and get help writing a reply. Connect Google once on a computer and Mail works on your phone.

CRM
Deals by stage, companies and people. Move a deal, set a reminder, log a note and see what is due.

CUSTOMER SUCCESS
Your school districts, their plans and what needs attention.

FUNDRAISING AND FINANCE
For the people with access: the raise, the firms you are talking to, and the company's cash plan.

BOB
Ask Bob, the built-in assistant, which deals have gone quiet, what was agreed in a meeting, or what is in your inbox. When Bob suggests a change, nothing happens until you tap Confirm.

NOTIFICATIONS
Reminders when they come due, and new email from the people who matter, if you want them.

ARR Flow has no ads and no tracking. What it handles, and why, is set out at arrflow.co/privacy.

name: Arrivant
description:
Congratulations on your move. Arrivant helps you settle in through the language: understand everything around you, and learn it as you go.

UNDERSTAND WHAT'S AROUND YOU
• Translate photos of signs, letters, menus and screens. The text is read on your phone first.
• Translate text and files, in any language pair, both ways.
• Ask in Chat. Not sure what your rental contract says? Attach the photo and ask.
• Your iPhone's translator: pick Arrivant as the default translation app, then select text in any app and tap Translate.
• One tap from the lock screen: add the button or a widget, and the camera is ready.
• History keeps everything you translated, with its words.

LEARN THE WORDS YOU MEET
• New words and grammar from your translations become flashcards.
• Flashcards, multiple choice and writing, with spaced repetition.
• A daily goal and a streak worth keeping. Bori and friends keep you company.
• Decks and progress sync with iCloud across your devices.

NEEDS CHATGPT
Translation and Chat run on your own ChatGPT account, so you need ChatGPT Plus or a higher plan. Flashcards work without it.

Arrivant isn't made by or affiliated with OpenAI.

name: Arrowbrush: Arrow Puzzle
description:
Arrowbrush is a calm arrow puzzle for relaxing moments. A picture is completely filled with colorful arrows. Your task: send the arrows out one after another in the right order until the picture is revealed and the colors come together.

How it works
Tap an arrow. If its path is clear, it glides out in its direction. If another arrow is in the way, it bumps, costs one heart and waits in place. When the path clears later, it glides out on its own. You have 3 hearts per level.

Once all arrows are gone, the finished painting appears in a brush style.

What awaits you
• 300 painted pictures in 30 albums such as animals, vehicles, garden, sea, farm, sweets, fruit and vegetables, forest, space, music, sports, toys, celebrations, weather, insects, birds, pets, kitchen, beach, winter, dinosaurs, fairy tales, camping, clothes, school, workshop and flowers – no picture ever repeats
• Daily puzzle and challenge
• Gallery with your collection and free choice of pictures
• Profile with statistics and awards in bronze, silver and gold
• Calendar
• Hints when you get stuck
• Zoom for large pictures
• Selectable puzzle size
• Dark mode
• Calm sounds and music of their own, each can be turned off separately
• Progress backup through your phone backup
• Gentle daily puzzle reminders, only if you want them
• Playable without an internet connection

Fair ads
Arrowbrush is free with ads. Interstitial ads appear only after you win a level, and reward videos are optional. A one-time purchase, "Ad-free", removes banners and interstitial ads.

There is no rush here. Take your time, lean back and let one picture after another take shape, at your own calm pace.

name: Ashes of the Nile: Mummy Siege
description:
Lead your squad through the ruins of ancient Egypt in Ashes of the Nile: Mummy Siege. Position your fighters, control their movement, choose weapons and survive attacks from the dead.

SAGA MAP
Take on a 50-level expedition, develop your characters and equip your squad for the next operation.

ENDLESS EXPEDITION
Push through successive nights and decide when to bring your winnings home. Manage your squad, supplies and field cash as the danger grows.

TACTICAL CONTROL
Move selected fighters directly, set their areas and let them engage enemies while you plan. Play offline with local saved progress, separate music and sound controls, and reduced-motion options.

OPTIONAL PURCHASES AND AD REWARDS
Play without buying anything. The Royal Treasury offers six field-cash packs and a one-time Remove Ads purchase through Apple. Remove Ads turns off automatic ads; optional rewarded ads remain available by choice. A completed reward ad grants 100 field cash when available.

Field cash is used in the active mission or expedition. Normal game rules apply: Endless winnings, including purchased cash, can be lost through death or leaving a run; cash out between cleared nights. Read the purchase details before buying. Purchases and ads require an internet connection.

No game account or subscription is required. Local progress stays on this device.

name: Atelier Morbido
description:
Atelier Morbido reinventa il classico album da colorare e lo trasforma in un laboratorio creativo, tattile e sempre personale.

UN’ESPERIENZA CREATIVA ORIGINALE

• Interfaccia morbida ispirata ai giocattoli in argilla
• Sei mondi illustrati con personaggi originali
• 24 colori e tre diverse punte
• Controlli adattivi per iPhone e iPad
• Supporto per dito, Apple Pencil, mouse e trackpad
• Tre temi visivi per cambiare atmosfera  

CREA SENZA LIMITI

Non ci sono timer, errori o punteggi da inseguire. Ogni tratto viene salvato sul dispositivo, così puoi interrompere il disegno e continuare quando vuoi. Una volta completata l’opera, puoi conservarla, salvarla nelle Foto o preparare una scheda da condividere.

UNA SORPRESA OGNI GIORNO

Torna nell’atelier per avanzare nel percorso di sette giorni, aprire nuove scatole di colori e seguire i tuoi progressi creativi.

• Esperienza principale completamente offline
• Nessun account necessario
• Musica ed effetti regolabili
• Galleria e statistiche salvate localmente
• Un ambiente rilassante, senza gare o penalità  

Apri Atelier Morbido e trasforma ogni colore in una storia.

name: Athar: Quran & Kids Learning
description:
Athar is a family app that brings the Quran, reading challenges and learning games for children together in one place.

THE QURAN
• The Uthmani text (Hafs recitation) from the Tanzil project, unchanged
• An index of surahs and parts, search, and bookmarks
• Your reading position is saved automatically
• Verse-by-verse recitation by four reciters, with repeat and a sleep timer
• A plan to complete the Quran in the number of days you choose, and a daily portion with a goal you set
• Night mode and font size control

MEMORISATION AND REVIEW
• Mark surahs as in progress or memorised
• A spaced review schedule reminds you of the verses due each day

GROUP CHALLENGES
• Complete the Quran, read a daily portion, or memorise a surah, together with family and friends
• Create and join a challenge with a single link
• Everyone reads on their own; the group gathers around the goal
• Fixed, ready-made encouragement phrases, with no chat

LEARNING FOR CHILDREN
• Games for three age groups: 3–5, 6–8 and 9–12
• Math, logic, patterns, building words, shapes, colours, nature and memory
• Coding with the robot Siraj: 30 levels in four worlds
• A garden that grows as the child learns new skills
• A short daily path
• A profile for each child, created by the parent, with a 5-digit PIN for switching between profiles

CODE & AI LAB
• Train a robot with examples
• Decision trees
• Pixels and binary
• Sorting and bug hunting

POINTS AND THE WEEKLY CONTEST
• Points come from learning games only, never from reading or memorisation
• A weekly contest of 10 questions for each age group

• A link challenge between siblings or friends, with the same questions

ACCOUNT AND PRIVACY
• The Quran, games and lab work without an account, and progress is kept on your device
• An account is optional, with an email code or a password, to sync progress between devices
• There is no chat between users
• You can delete your account and all its data from inside the app
• Optional daily reminder at a time you choose, at most one notification a day

LANGUAGES
• Arabic and English interface

Athar is an independent project. For feedback and suggestions: info@athaar-app.com

name: Atlas Caper: Daily Detective
description:
A new geography mystery every day. Hear the witnesses, follow the thief from city to city and issue one warrant before the trail goes cold. About 5 minutes a case.

HOW TO PLAY
• A new case opens at midnight, your local time. Everyone gets the same case.
• In each city, tap a witness to hear their clue. Clues point to real places and facts, and each one is checked against a public source.
• Fly to the next city. You have 6 moves for a trail of 4 flights. A flight to the wrong city costs 1 move, and flying back to the trail is free.
• Some witnesses describe the thief. Every trait you hear goes into your suspect notebook: hair, hobby, accessory and vehicle.
• In the thief's city, filter the 6 suspects by your notebook and issue your one warrant. Name the wrong person and the trail goes cold.

FEATURES
• Daily case: one new trail every day, the same for every player.
• Streaks: keep your daily streak going and beat your best.
• Case Archive: replay past cases at your own pace. Archive cases don't change your streak.
• Stats: cases played, solved rate, current and best streak, and average time on solved cases.
• Spoiler-free share card: share your moves, time and streak without giving away the answer.
• Training case: learn the ropes in about 2 minutes, and replay it anytime.
• Bonus cases you can play offline.
• Optional daily reminder: one notification a day, only if you haven't played yet. You pick the time.
• Light and dark mode.
• Play in English, Spanish or Portuguese (Brazil). Change the language in Settings.

FICTIONAL CASES, REAL PLACES
Every case, character and theft is fictional. The cities, landmarks and facts in the clues are real.

PRIVACY
No account and no login. Your progress, streak and stats stay on your device. Anonymous stats are off unless you turn them on. When on, the app sends anonymous case events to TelemetryDeck to help improve the cases. No name, email, contacts or location, and never used for ads. You can change this anytime in Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://atlascaper.graflogic.dev/privacy
Terms of Use: https://atlascaper.graflogic.dev/terms
Support: https://atlascaper.graflogic.dev/support

name: Ato: Stamp your days
description:
People you met, places you went, things you did. Stamp it with one tap. No streaks to keep. Look back, and it's all there.

Make a rally for anything you want to collect: cafés you visited, books you read, shows you went to, people you met. Give it a name and an emoji, and you're ready.

- One tap to stamp. Add a note or up to four photos if you like.
- See every stamp a rally has collected, newest first.
- Look back by day on the calendar, or through your photos in the album.
- Remembered it later? Stamp it on that day.
- In English and Japanese.

Your stamps stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Moving to a new iPhone? Export your rallies, stamps, and notes to a file and import it there. Photos aren't included yet.

name: Attachment Style Test – Map
description:
Answer 8 quick questions to see which attachment style you lean toward.
Subscribe to take the full 36-statement test and see your exact spot on a two-scale map: anxious and avoidant.
Check in whenever you like and watch your trail on the map. No ads, no AI, no account.

Attachment research describes how we act in close relationships on two scales: how much we worry about closeness being lost (anxiety) and how much we keep our distance (avoidance). Where you sit on both scales shapes four familiar patterns: secure, anxious, avoidant and fearful.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start with 8 questions and get your leaning, with a short explanation.
• Take the full test: 36 statements, each rated on a 7-point scale, in about 6 minutes.
• See your scores on both scales and your dot on the map.
• Do a quick 8-statement check-in any time. Each one adds a small dot, so you can see where you are this week and how it has shifted over time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no login, no ads, no chatbot.
• Your answers stay on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
• Delete everything with one tap.

SUBSCRIPTION
The full test, your map and check-ins need a subscription. Attachment Style Test – Map offers weekly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://fod-team-org.github.io/app-legal/attachment-style-test/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://fod-team-org.github.io/app-legal/attachment-style-test/terms/

This app is for self-reflection. It is not a psychological assessment, diagnosis or therapy, and it gives no professional advice.

name: AttendField
description:
AttendField helps you keep a clear, reusable record of small activities and who actually attended.

Reuse rosters across activities. Freeze participant names at activity creation. Record Present, Absent or Unmarked separately. Keep actual check-in and optional check-out, plus the old and new values whenever a record is corrected. Create independent PDF and CSV attendance reports.

Unmarked is never silently treated as absent. Completed minutes include only recorded check-in/out pairs. AttendField does not track location or calculate payroll.

Your library stays in this device’s app sandbox. Exported files can be shared using the system share sheet. No login or subscription is required.

name: Aurora Gambit
description:
Step into a quiet radio room where every card carries a clue. Aurora Gambit is an original sequence-deduction game: five different cards form a hidden transmission, and your job is to find their exact order.

Build your own probes and read honest evidence. Exact matches identify how many positions agree; misplaced matches reveal how many other cards belong somewhere in the signal. Spend limited instrument charges on suit counts, rank totals, positional parity and rank groups. Keep a notebook of evidence-consistent hypotheses, then choose your next thoughtful transmission.

Explore 20 authored frequencies across two alphabet sizes, return for a signal that changes at midnight UTC, or enter a practice seed for a repeatable puzzle. Efficient decoding earns precision points and permanent instrument-charge upgrades. Saved sessions and notes let you return at your own pace.

Original glass-radio artwork, tactile controls, subtle sound, light and dark appearances, make the receiver your own. No accounts, ads, purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Autumn Breeze Animated
description:
Bring the colors of autumn to your Apple Watch.

Autumn Breeze is an Apple Watch app with falling autumn leaves drifting over beautiful fall scenery. Now and then a gust of wind sends the leaves spinning across the screen. The big time shines with a soft gradient, and the date, moon phase, weather and your daily stats are always at hand.

FEATURES
• Animated falling leaves, with a gust of wind now and then
• 14 autumn scenes: maple forest path, misty lake, cozy cabin, Japanese temple garden, stone bridge, mountain valley, birch forest, vineyard at sunset, park bench, rainy old town street, waterfall, pumpkin patch, window with a cup of tea and a golden avenue
• Big time with 20 color gradients
• 5 fonts for the time
• 40 color themes for the icons, stats and date
• 8 styles for the stat boxes: glass, leaves, wood, bronze, bouquet, garland, outline or none
• Current weather with day and night icons
• Moon phase next to the date
• Heart rate, active calories, steps and battery at a glance
• 12-hour or 24-hour time
• Dimmed always-on look that keeps the time and date easy to read

CUSTOMIZE FROM YOUR IPHONE
Open the app on your watch, then use the companion iPhone app to pick a scene, a font, a time gradient, a color theme and a box style. A live preview shows the look before you send it to the watch. You can also turn the falling leaves and the weather on or off and choose 12-hour or 24-hour time.

WATCH APP AND WATCH FACE
Autumn Breeze is a watch app: the leaves and scenes show while the app is open on your Apple Watch. From the iPhone app you can also install a matching Apple photo watch face with all 14 autumn scenes. It includes a complication that opens the app with a single tap. You can also add the complication to your favorite watch face or to the Smart Stack.

Tip: to keep the app on screen longer, open Settings on your watch, go to General, then Return to Clock, and choose After 1 hour.

WEATHER AND HEALTH DATA
The weather comes from Apple Weather and uses your watch's location while the app is open. Autumn Breeze reads your steps, heart rate and active calories from Apple Health to show them on your watch. Your data stays on your devices.

HELP AND SUPPORT
The iPhone app includes a FAQ section with answers to common questions and a contact page if you need us. The More tab shows our other animated watch faces.

REQUIREMENTS
Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or newer, paired with an iPhone running iOS 17 or newer.

Enjoy the autumn breeze!

name: Avinix CRM
description:
Avinix CRM is the mobile app for teams that already use Avinix CRM. Sign in and manage your sales work from your phone.

Stay on top of every lead. Open the dashboard for a quick view of your day, then work through leads, follow-ups, meetings, and tasks. Update a lead, log a call, schedule a meeting, or add a task without going back to the desktop.

Move deals forward. Track prospects in the pipeline, group leads into target lists, and run call campaigns. Use quick replies for messages you send often, and review your team's activity from one place.

Lead details stay with the record, including status, source, custom fields, and activity history, so the next follow-up starts with the full context.

Avinix CRM helps you:
• View your dashboard and daily work
• Create and update leads
• Schedule follow-ups, meetings, and tasks
• Track prospects in the pipeline
• Build target lists and quick replies
• See team activity and notifications

An Avinix CRM account is required. Sign in with the email and password from your organization.

name: Avvgo: Road Trip Average Speed
description:
Avvgo is a road-trip companion that shows the two numbers that tell the truth about a drive, keeps your fuel log, and lets the family follow along.

TWO AVERAGES, SIDE BY SIDE
Your moving average leaves the breaks out, so it shows how you actually drive. Your overall average runs door to door, so it shows how long the trip really takes. Both update every second. Distance, driving time, breaks and a drive-and-break timeline sit just below, and recording carries on with the screen locked or while you use another app.

BREAKS THAT MARK THEMSELVES
Stopped for five minutes? That becomes a break, counted from the moment you stopped. A red light or a slow patch stays as driving. Tap "It was traffic" to turn a stop back into driving time, or tap Break yourself when you pull over. Avvgo learns from your corrections.

A FUEL LOG THAT KNOWS CNG TOO
Log a fill-up in seconds: type any two of quantity, rate and amount and Avvgo works out the third. Petrol and CNG are both covered, and bi-fuel cars keep both fuels side by side. Mark a full tank and your real mileage is worked out from one full fill to the next, so trip costs use your own figures, not the brochure's. Add tolls and other trip expenses too.

YOUR UNITS, AUTOMATICALLY
Kilometres or miles and your local fuel units follow your region on their own, and you can change them in Settings.

RUNNING LOW? FIND THE NEXT STATION
When your tank is down to about 50 km (30 miles) of range, Avvgo tells you once and shows fuel and CNG stations ahead, with the ones you have filled at before first.

ROUTES WITH AN ARRIVAL TIME AT YOUR PACE
Search places, compare route options and pick one. Next to the usual estimate, Avvgo shows when you are likely to arrive based on your own moving average and usual breaks. It is a trip companion, not turn-by-turn navigation.

THE WHOLE TRIP ON ONE PAGE
Each leg and break on a timeline, fuel used and what it cost, tolls, and every time you went over the speed alert you set for yourself.

A LIVE LINK FOR THE FAMILY
Send one link before you leave. Family open it in any browser to see where the car is, both averages, distance and your arrival time. No app or sign-up for them. The link stops when the trip ends, and you can switch it off at any time.

ASK AVVGO
Ask about your trips or plan the next one: "How long were our breaks last month?" "What did tolls cost in October?" Every number in an answer is checked against your own data. The assistant sees trip summaries, never your GPS trail.

ON THE LOCK SCREEN AND WITH SIRI
Your averages stay on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while a trip runs. Ask Siri to start a trip, mark a break or read your averages out loud. Spoken updates and speed alerts are optional.

AN ICON FOR EVERY FESTIVAL
The app icon can dress up for Diwali, Eid, Christmas and more, or keep a year-round style.

EXPORT AND SHARE
Make a share card with both averages and the trip timeline, a PDF report, or a CSV for spreadsheets.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Recording works without a signal. Trips are saved on your iPhone first; cloud backup is your choice and can be turned off in Settings. Location is used in the background only while a trip is recording. No ads, no tracking, nothing sold.

AVVGO ULTRA
Trip recording, both averages, breaks, the fuel log, reports and exports are free. Routes, live speed limits, the station finder, Ask Avvgo, live links and cloud backup are part of Avvgo Ultra or Ultra Family (you and up to four people), auto-renewing subscriptions with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account after the trial. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.avvgo.me/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.avvgo.me/privacy

Avvgo is made by Sammed Technosol in Kota, India.

name: Awenfell
description:
Awenfell is a shadow work journal that keeps its questions quiet.

Each day, draw three cards and read what they might mean for you. Once a week, look into the Mirror: a reflection on what you have been answering. At each full moon, the Mirror gathers your Patterns.

Answer in writing or with your voice. Spoken answers are turned into words on your iPhone, and your recordings never leave the device. There is no account, no sign-in, no analytics and no server. Export your whole journal, restore a backup or delete everything, whenever you choose.

Membership adds the weekly Reflection, the full Mirror with its Patterns, every Exploration, a three-card reading every day, and voice notes kept for good. Choose yearly, monthly or lifetime. Payment and renewal are handled by your Apple Account.

Awenfell is a tool for reflection, not therapy.

name: Azulevra
description:
Restore a palace one tile panel at a time in Azulevra, a landscape puzzle game inspired by Portuguese azulejo ceramics.

Tap an arrow to shift an entire row or column. All three tiles move together, and the tile that slips off one edge wraps around to the other. Match the target pattern to restore the panel and unlock the next challenge.
- Solve 24 puzzles across three palace chapters.
- Discover nine ceramic motifs, from swallows to armillary spheres.
- Learn row and column shifts in three step-by-step practice lessons.
- Undo moves freely or use optional guidance when you get stuck.
- Replay completed panels to improve your star rating and reach the masterwork move target.
- Pause and resume with locally saved progress, and adjust music, sound effects, haptics, and reduced motion in Settings.
Designed for iPhone in landscape orientation.

name: B SmokeLog
description:
I believe knowing exactly how often and when you smoke is where quitting begins.
What I wanted was an app with no warnings and no nagging, one that simply shows when and how much I smoked.
Log it, look back, cut down.
B Smoke Log makes that process of self-care quick and easy to keep track of.

◼ 24-hour clock
Your day laid out as 24 segments. Hours you smoked get darker with each cigarette, and every entry is a dot at its exact time.

◼ Calendar
See how much you smoked each day, and compare how today differs from yesterday.

◼ Stats
Daily average, total, average gap and your peak hour for the last week, month or 3 months.

◼ Turn your log into self-care
· Compare with yesterday at this time, last month and the previous period to see the trend going down
· Set a daily threshold as your own goal and spot the days over it right on the calendar
· Start small, like delaying your first cigarette or stretching the gap, and watch it in numbers

◼ Log without opening the app
· One tap on the Home Screen widget adds +1

◼ Types
Split entries into cigarettes, e-cigarettes, nicotine gum and more, each with its own color.

◼ Your data stays yours
· No account, no ads, no analytics
· Stored on your device; sync only through your own iCloud if you choose
· Export as CSV and open it in Excel or Numbers
· Available in Korean and English

B Smoke Log is a record-keeping tool that helps adults cut down and quit smoking on their own, and it does not encourage smoking. It is not a substitute for medical advice or cessation treatment. If you need support, please reach out to a healthcare professional or a local quitline.

name: Backseat - Vibe Coding 键盘
description:
Backseat 把 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 变成 Vibe Coding 的语音键盘。

按住说话，文字直接出现在 Mac 当前的输入框里：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor，或者任何能打字的地方。不用戴耳机，不用单独买麦克风，人也不用一直坐在桌前。

【能做什么】
· 按住说话：声音送到 Mac，由 Mac 上的语音输入法转成文字，松手结束，上滑取消。
· 抬手批准：Claude Code 要运行命令、改文件时，手机和手表上弹出请求，点一下「允许」或「拒绝」。
· 手机当触控板：单指移动指针，双指滚动，轻点点击。
· 常用键：回车、Esc、Tab、方向键、数字键，一排就在手边。
· 状态一眼可见：正在工作、等你回复、等你批准、已完成。
· Apple Watch：抬腕按住就能说，表冠滚动，手腕上批准。

【它不是什么】
不是远程桌面，也不是 AI 客户端。它只是一把键盘：把你的话和按键送到 Mac。

【需要什么】
· 一台 Mac，装上开源的 Backseat Mac 端（免费，见 GitHub：wxkingstar/Backseat）。
· Mac 上装一个语音输入法（例如豆包输入法）。
· 手机和 Mac 在同一个 Wi-Fi 下，输入 4 位配对码即可连接。

【隐私】
没有账号，没有服务器，不收集任何数据。声音和按键只在你的设备和你的 Mac 之间传输。

项目完全开源。

name: Baller Coach
description:
Baller Coach is your assistant coach for basketball practice, built for new and volunteer coaches.

TELL IT ABOUT YOUR TEAM
Choose your age group (U8 to 16+) and ability level, then set how many players turned up. Baller Coach only shows drills that suit your team and your numbers.

75+ DRILLS YOU CAN SEE
Every drill has an animated court diagram you can switch between 2D and 3D. Rotate and zoom the 3D court to see it from any angle. Each drill tells you what it teaches, what to call out and the common mistakes to watch for. Includes fun games young teams love.

PLAN SESSIONS IN MINUTES
Pick your own drills or let Baller Coach build a session around what you want to work on. Rename sessions, add notes, build a library and share sessions with other coaches.

RUN PRACTICE FROM YOUR PHONE
Live session mode shows the whole practice down the side, a big timer, and the key coaching cues in large type. It alerts you when it's time to move to the next drill.

MAKE YOUR OWN DRILLS
Draw your own drills on the court, step by step, and they animate just like the built-in ones.

LEARN TO COACH
A short course covering running a practice, spacing, defence and game day.

Free for 30 days, no card needed. Then choose a monthly or yearly subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in Settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bamti Line Cutter
description:
Waiting in line is boring. Bamti can't stand it.
There is an endless line in front of the rice cake shop. Slip past people one by one while the goblin guard isn't looking. Your score is how many people you pass.

■ Rules you get in 3 seconds
• If the person ahead stands on the left, the gap is on the right.
• Tap the side with the gap to pass one person.
• When the guard's eyes pop open, stop tapping.
• Move while he is looking and you're caught.
• Tap the wrong side and you bump into someone and get dizzy for a moment.

■ Read the guard
• The guard has little habits right before he turns around.
• He might pound the rice cake mallet three times, or hum a tune.
• Learn his habits and you will go much further.
• The run ends when the rice cakes sell out. Every pass fills the bar a little.
• Watch out for big Bamtis, and for sly ones who cut in right behind you.

■ Fever and stages
• Keep passing without a slip and you hit Fever.
• Every 50 people you move on to a new stage.

■ Your Sneak Age card
• After each run you get your Sneak Age.
• It is a just-for-fun number based on how fast you stop and how fast you tap.
• Share the card and see which of your friends is the sharpest.

■ 46 Bamti buddies
• Collect coins and pull for buddies. Pulls use only coins earned in the game.
• Every buddy has one small trait.
• Some buddies always join you when you beat a record.
• All pull odds are shown on the pull screen.

■ Today's Line
• Every day, everyone stands in the same line.
• See who passed the most today on the Game Center leaderboard.

No sign-up. A run takes about a minute. Supports English, Korean and Japanese. Free to play with ads. Buy "Remove Ads" to drop the ads between runs and get ad rewards instantly.

name: banasor: yardım asistanı
description:
İnternette ya da telefonda bir işi yapamadınız mı? banasor'a söyleyin, birlikte halledelim.

Mikrofona dokunun ve derdinizi kendi cümlelerinizle anlatın: "e-Devlet şifremi unuttum", "hastaneden randevu almak istiyorum", "bu abonelik her ay para çekiyor, nasıl iptal ederim?" banasor size işlemi adım adım, büyük yazıyla gösterir ve her adımı doğal bir sesle okur.

NELERDE YARDIM EDER
• Banka: müşteri temsilcisine bağlanma, bankada unutulan parayı sorgulama
• e-Devlet: şifre alma, belgeler, sorgulamalar
• Hastane randevusu: MHRS ve 182
• Abonelik iptali: telefondan para çeken abonelikler
• Telefon ayarları: yazıları büyütme ve daha fazlası
• Haklarınız ve başvurular: SGK hizmet dökümü ve diğerleri

KOLAY KULLANIM
• Büyük yazı, büyük düğmeler, her ekranda tek iş
• Her adım sesli okunur; takıldığınız yerde "Takıldım" deyin
• Telefon numarasını ya da sayfayı tek dokunuşla açın
• Arşiv: sorduklarınız hep elinizde, dilediğiniz an yeniden açın
• Notlar: randevunuzu, iptal gününüzü yazın; vakti gelince telefonunuz hatırlatsın

GÜVENLİĞİNİZ
banasor sizden asla şifre, kart bilgisi ya da SMS kodu istemez. Hesap açmanız gerekmez. Arşiviniz ve notlarınız yalnız telefonunuzda saklanır.

banasor plus
