Gizlilik: https://kolayuygulamalar.com/banasor/gizlilik

name: Band Critic
description:
Band Critic is the quickest way to rate the local bands you see live.

Find shows near you on a simple calendar. After a show, tap a star to rate each band. That's it. Add a couple of quick tags or a short comment if you feel like it.

- A calendar of live music at local venues
- One-tap star ratings for every band on the bill
- Rate the venue too, with pros and cons like sound, sightlines and parking
- Scan the Band Critic code at a venue to rate tonight's bands
- See which local bands and venues people rate highest
- Playing a show? Send it in and it goes on the calendar

No account needed. No ads. Free.

Band Critic is starting in Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill and Carrboro, North Carolina.

name: Bar Craft: Cocktail Master
description:
Learn the bartender's craft in a quiet late-night bar.

Amber light, polished glass, the clink of ice. Step behind a realistic bar and finish each cocktail by hand.

SERVICE
Take a guest's order, then choose the glass, technique, ice, ingredients, garnish — and slide the finished drink down the counter onto their coaster. You're scored on everything from the recipe to the serve.

TRAINING
• Jigger: pour exactly 30ml or 45ml
• Free pour: measure by count alone
• Shake: swipe, or shake your iPhone itself — and try some flair
• Stir: turn smoothly and silently to chill
• Float: layer liqueurs by density over the back of a spoon

KNOWLEDGE QUIZ
Recipes, techniques, glassware, tools, etiquette — and "swap the base and what do you get?"

COCKTAIL BOOK
67 cocktails, from the Gin & Tonic, Martini and Negroni to the Margarita and Mojito, based on IBA official recipes and standard Japanese bar measures.

No ads and no in-app purchases. Available in English and Japanese.

Please drink responsibly. Never drink and drive.

name: BarBQNite
description:
Get the best experience with the BarBQNite Official App:

Best Prices
- Ordering directly from the BarBQNite app saves you money (including any delivery fees).
- Be the first to know about discounts & coupons.
- Our best prices are always shown in the app.
- Earn free food with rewards points.

Convenient
- Re-order your favorites in seconds.
- Get your food fast. BarBQNite Official App orders reach the kitchen first.
- Skip the search. Just tap BarBQNite.

Reliable
- Real-time order tracking.
- Accurate pickup and delivery time windows.
- Secure payments using bank-level encryption.

Support a Local Business
- You're helping a local business every time you use the BarBQNite app!

name: Barelink: Tracker Remover
description:
Share links, not trackers.

Links you share from social apps, newsletters and search results are full of tracking parameters: who shared the link, from which app, which campaign. Barelink removes them, so the person you send a link to – and the site – learn nothing extra about you.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap Share on any link – in Safari, social apps or anywhere else.
• Choose Copy Clean Link from the list of actions.
• Paste it. Trackers are gone.

It works like the built-in Copy action, takes a moment and closes by itself. Add it to your Favorites to keep it at the top of the share sheet.

WHAT BARELINK CLEANS
• Tracking parameters such as utm_source, fbclid, gclid, igsh and many more
• Share identifiers added by social networks and video sites, while keeping what the link needs, like a video's time stamp
• Redirect wrappers from search results, social networks and email security services – you get the real address
• Long shopping links, shortened to the bare product page

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Links are cleaned on your device and never sent to us
• No account, no analytics, no ads
• Rules are updated regularly, so new trackers are handled without waiting for an app update

TEST FIELD – FREE
Paste a link or text containing a link into the app to see the clean version and exactly what was removed. The test field is always free.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Barelink Basic – Copy Clean Link in the share sheet and rule updates.
Barelink Pro – everything in Basic, plus:
• Expand short links (bit.ly, t.co and others) to the real address
• Custom rules and exceptions for any site
• History of cleaned links, with page titles
• Settings synced across your devices with iCloud
Barelink Pro Family – Pro for up to 6 family members with Family Sharing.

All subscriptions start with a 14-day free trial and renew yearly.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://barelink.staniek.uk/privacy

name: Baton: Baby Tracker for Two
description:
Two parents. One tap. Every feed.

When one of you logs a feed, it shows up on the other's iPhone right away. Feeds, diapers, sleep and pumping — and at night, you simply pass the baton.

■ Night shifts, shared fairly
• Tonight's Duty: decide who's up tonight, and you both see it
• Baton handover card: last feed, diaper and sleep on one card when you switch
• Night mode: a dark, warm-red screen that won't blind you at 3 a.m.

■ Log from the Lock Screen (Baton Plus)
The feeding timer lives on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Switch sides or stop without unlocking. Also log from Control Center, widgets, Siri and Apple Watch.

■ One-tap logging (free)
Breast (left/right), bottle, solids, sleep, diapers (with stool color) and pumping — big buttons made for one hand.

■ Real-time sync for two (free)
Send an invite link by Messages or any chat app. No account to create — your data stays in your family's own iCloud. You'll always see who logged what.

■ The whole family
• Multiple babies and twins
• Simple mode for grandparents and sitters
• A daily summary that's easy to copy into daycare notes

■ See the patterns
• 24-hour timeline and weekly charts (sleep time, feeds, how you split the work)
• A PDF of your logs to bring to pediatrician visits
• Vaccination checklist, medicine log and frozen breast milk stock

■ Free vs. Baton Plus
Logging, two-parent sync and the timeline are free.
Baton Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, with a 7-day free trial. It unlocks the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, Controls, widgets, Apple Watch, full charts and PDF, multiple babies, and a third caregiver or more.
No ads. No AI.

Baton is a logging tool, not a medical device, and does not give medical advice. If you have questions about your baby's health, talk to your pediatrician.

name: BATTLYN
description:
Claim lands. Plan your formation. Take the crown.

BATTLYN is a fast strategy war game. Every war lasts 40 turns or 7 minutes, and the highest score wins. Claim free lands, scout your rival, and attack when you are ready.

BLIND WAR, REAL BATTLES
Your army fights on five levels, from the far wing to the near wing. Choose the weapon for every rank and send more men to the levels that matter. You never see exactly what the enemy brings. Win all five levels and the land falls at once.

SIX WEAPONS, ONE WHEEL
Spears stop cavalry. Cavalry rides down archers. Archers shoot axes. Axes break shields. Shields stand against spears. Swords hold it together.

CHAMPION DUELS
Before every battle, your champion faces theirs. Win duels, earn rating and make your champion stronger.

TWELVE WARS
Heart of Europe, Balkans and Danube and Japan are open from the start. Win campaigns to open Three Kingdoms, Italy, the Nordic lands, Ancient Greece, Anatolia, the Turkic Steppe, Britannia, Latin America and the United States.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from ten banners or add your own picture as a flag. Name your empire. Rename your three champions.

WEATHER, WIND AND LANDMARKS
Rain, snow and strong wind change how weapons fight. The wind can help one army and hurt the other. Every land shows its own landmark.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No sign-in. Your progress stays on your device.

Each campaign uses one credit. You start with credits and get a free credit every day. Credit packs and the one-time "Unlimited" pass (all maps and every campaign) are optional purchases.

name: BayanAI: Quran & Tafsir Q&A
description:
BayanAI is an AI study assistant for the Qur'an. Ask about the meaning of a verse or a word, the occasion of revelation, or what the commentators said on a point. BayanAI searches 100+ books of tafsir, creed and Qur'anic sciences, writes you a clear answer, and cites the book, author, volume and page for every point so you can check it yourself.

Why BayanAI?
• From the books, not the web: answers are built on the texts of the tafsir and creed books themselves.
• A source for every point: each point carries a number that opens the book, author, volume and page, with an excerpt.
• Understands how you ask: with or without vowel marks, in your own words, with follow-up questions in the same conversation.
• Arabic and English: it answers in your language, citing the Arabic sources it used.
• Share any conversation with a link.

The library
100+ books: 41 on tafsir, 52 on creed and 8 on Qur'anic sciences, including al-Tahrir wa al-Tanwir (Ibn Ashur), al-Jami li-Ahkam al-Qur'an (al-Qurtubi), Tafsir Ibn Kathir, Taysir al-Karim al-Rahman (al-Sa'di), Adwa al-Bayan (al-Shinqiti), Fath al-Qadir (al-Shawkani), Ma'alim al-Tanzil (al-Baghawi) and al-Burhan fi Ulum al-Qur'an (al-Zarkashi). New books are added regularly.

Plans
• Free start: 10 messages to try everything.
• Hourly session: unlimited messages for the length of the session.
• Pro: unlimited messages for 30 days.

Note: BayanAI is a learning tool that helps you understand and find what the scholars wrote. It does not issue fatwas; for rulings on your own situation, ask a qualified scholar.

Privacy Policy: https://bayanai.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://bayanai.com/terms

name: BC Collect
description:
BC Collect is the official mobile destination for discovering and acquiring rare match-worn football memorabilia. Explore a curated collection of match-worn, match-issued and player-worn boots and equipment from some of the game’s biggest names, all presented through a refined and intuitive mobile experience.

Browse the full BC Collect catalogue, filter pieces with ease, save favourites to your personal watchlist, and complete purchases directly through the app. Each item is supported by BC Collect’s specialist authentication process and is presented with clear product detail, provenance-led information and a streamlined viewing experience designed specifically for mobile.

The app also includes BC Match Verification™, BC Collect’s proprietary photo-match verification system for match-worn memorabilia, alongside editorial content through Vault Journal and Behind the Boots, giving collectors deeper insight into the pieces, the market and the stories behind the game’s most significant items.

BC Collect brings together collecting, authentication and storytelling in one place — offering a premium platform for serious football memorabilia collectors.

name: Beamkit
description:
Beamkit is a night emergency HUD for iPhone: a huge power control and radial tool ring for torch, strobe, SOS practice blink, banknote color-wash overlays, an on-screen ruler, a Core Motion level, a magnetic compass, and a brightness / color-temperature screen lamp.

When LED torch hardware is unavailable (including Simulator), Beamkit falls back to a bright screen lamp so every mode stays usable offline. Compass requests Location When In Use only for magnetic heading.

No account. No network required. SOS does not contact emergency services.

name: BEATRAY: Live Rhythm Game
description:
Play well and the vocals come back. Miss, and they fade away.
BEATRAY is a 4-lane rhythm game built around one idea: Vocal Restore.
Your performance is what completes the song.

■ BEATRAY 2.0 — the whole game is a live concert
Lights, a crowd and a singer on stage who sings with you. Male-vocal songs bring a male singer to the stage.

■ Only in this rhythm game — Vocal Restore
Miss a note and the vocals sink beneath the instrumental. Hit clean and the voice returns, sharp and full, while the lyrics fill in like karaoke on screen. Clearing the song isn't the goal. Getting the song back is.

■ 131 songs, 18 genres, every track original
K-POP · J-POP · City Pop · EDM · Trance · Techno · Drum & Bass · Hip-hop · Reggaeton · Baile Funk · Afrobeats · Rock · Hyperpop · Anisong · Metal and more.
Nothing here is licensed from someone else. Every song was written for this game — and new songs arrive every month.

■ New notes
Flick, Wide, Voice Line and Hold-end Flick. Trace the voice line as if you were singing along.

■ Four difficulties
· EASY — never played a music game? Three minutes is all you need
· NORMAL / HARD — the climb that makes your hands happy
· EXTRA — a real wall, unlocked only by clearing HARD with an S rank

■ Global leaderboards — Season 2
Every song, every difficulty has its own world ranking. Claim a spot in the TOP 50 and check the weekly chart to see what the world is playing right now.

■ Make the stage yours
Stage lights (auras), frames and outfits.

■ Details that matter
· Precision timing calibration for accurate judgment on any device
· One-handed portrait play
· Light install — songs download only when you want them

Start now with 12 free songs. Unlock more with coins, or get every song with BR Pass.

BR Pass is an optional auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://playbeatray.com/privacy

name: Bee Kingdom: Cozy Hive
description:
Every kingdom starts small... Build a cozy honeycomb hive inside a giant blossoming tree, raise the cutest bees in the meadow, and defend your kingdom in epic raids!

BUILD A COZY HIVE
Add Pollen Stores, Honey Vaults, Nurseries, Royal Jelly Kitchens and more. Every room grows the hive, and upgrading the Royal Chamber opens whole new wings of comb.

HATCH ADORABLE BEES
Watch baby bees wiggle out of their eggs and buzz off to work. Your foragers fly to real flowers in the meadow, wiggle happily as they gather pollen, and carry it home to turn into honey.

COLLECT 13 BEE BREEDS
Workers, gatherers, builders, ninja bees, ember bees, frost bees, crystal bees and more. Every breed has its own look and its own bonus.

DEFEND YOUR KINGDOM
Ants, beetles, spiders, wasps and stranger raiders want your honey. Train guard bees, archers and royal knights, then tap raiders to sting them, chain combos into a FRENZY, and call on the Queen's powers: Rally, Honey Bomb, Wax Shield and Royal Wrath.

EXPLORE THE MEADOW KINGDOM
Unlock Sunflower Fields, Lavender Hills, the Lily Pond and more on the world map, each with its own bonus, and raid enemy nests stage by stage for honey and royal jelly.

Free to play. Optional in-app purchases and optional reward videos are available. No account needed.

name: BeetleCare - Stag&Rhino Beetle
description:
Your beetle is acting strange, and you don't know what to do.
"It won't eat." "The larva keeps coming up to the surface." Just pick the symptom.
BeetleCare tells you what to check and what to do, in order, right now.


■ Don't search after it's too late — care that starts from the symptom

You don't need to know the jargon. Just pick what looks wrong.
· Something is wrong with my adult
· Something is wrong with my larva
· Something is wrong with the pupa or emergence
· Something is wrong with the tank or substrate
· She won't lay eggs

One card holds the whole answer.
Check now → Do now → Don't do → Possible causes → Aftercare

Mold, mites, fruit flies, substrate reheating, failed emergence, a broken pupal cell,
no eggs, refusing food. The situations beginners actually face, in 33 urgent guides and care cards.


■ A guide to 30 popular species

From Dorcus hopei, Dorcus titanus and Prosopocoilus inclinatus to
Hercules, Caucasus and Atlas beetles and the Giraffe stag beetle.

Each species comes with photos, ideal temperature, larval period, adult lifespan,
egg-laying method (substrate or wood) and difficulty for keeping, breeding and growing large.
Pick a species and jump straight to the care that fits it.


■ Logs that never lose track of a beetle

· Record stage (egg / larva / pupa / adult), size, weight and photos
· See what comes next: emergence → first feeding → pairing → egg-laying setup → digging out
· Link the parents and the family tree draws itself with generations (F1, F2…)
· Pair suggestions that avoid inbreeding


■ Never forget again — calendar, alerts, widget

Put substrate changes, jelly changes and dig-out dates on the calendar and get an alert on the day.
Check this month's schedule from the home screen widget without opening the app.


■ Tools that only need a number

· Emergence calculator — enter species and hatch date, get the expected window and days left
· Jaw-type calculator — check wide, short or long jaw type from measurements
· Sexing larvae — how to spot the ovaries
· How to measure, labelled anatomy diagrams, glossary
· QR label maker — scan the QR on the tank and that beetle's record opens (save as PDF or Word)


■ Made for

· First-time stag or rhino beetle keepers
· Anyone who caught a beetle and isn't sure what to do next
· Anyone who was given a larva and doesn't know when to change the substrate
· Parents keeping beetles with their kids who want something to look things up in together
· Keepers who want bloodlines and records in order


■ Also

· Every feature works without signing in
· Sign in with Apple or Google to keep your records when you change phones (optional)
· 한국어 · 日本語 · English
· Remove ads with a one-time purchase


When beetle care feels overwhelming, open BeetleCare instead of a search box.

name: Belegblick: ZUGFeRD XRechnung
description:
Businesses in Germany must be able to receive electronic invoices. But an XRechnung is an XML file, and XML is not meant to be read by people. Belegblick turns it into a clear invoice that looks like the paper ones you know.

OPEN
• XRechnung in both syntaxes (UBL and CII)
• ZUGFeRD 2.x and Factur-X: the XML data embedded in the PDF is read for you
• Peppol invoices and credit notes in UBL
• On the Mac: double-click, Open With, drop on the app icon or a window, open several invoices at once
• On iPhone and iPad: from the Files app and the share sheet

CLEAR
• Seller, buyer, invoice number, date and due date at a glance
• Buyer reference (Leitweg-ID), order and contract numbers
• Line items with quantity, unit price, VAT rate and amount
• VAT by rate, allowances and charges, amount due
• Payment details with the IBAN in groups of four, BIC and payment reference
• Notes, delivery address and attachments
• Data that doesn't fit a field is listed at the end instead of being dropped

ZUGFeRD WITH A WARNING
For ZUGFeRD you see the invoice data and the original PDF side by side. If the amount due in the XML doesn't appear in the PDF, Belegblick tells you. The XML data is legally binding.

PRINT AND FILE
• Print on A4 with page breaks and page numbers
• Save as PDF for your records or your accountant
• Save embedded attachments and the XML data separately

PRIVATE
• Everything is processed on your device
• No internet connection, no account, no subscription
• No data collected

Buy once, use on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

Note: Belegblick displays invoices. It does not check invoice rules and does not create invoices.

name: Belly After 40: Menopause Fit
description:
Your body changed after 40. Your plan should too.

If you're eating the same but your belly keeps changing, you're not alone, and it's not your fault. Falling estrogen, muscle loss, stress and short nights all play a part after 40. Belly After 40 gives you a simple 12-week plan built around your body, not someone else's.

TAKE THE 2-MIN QUIZ
Find your belly type (Stress & Sleep, Muscle Loss or Evening Cravings) and get a plan that matches your level, your equipment and your days.

YOUR DAILY 3
• Strength: short workouts at your level, with no jumping. Clear drawings and animations, gentle sound cues, and one tap to make a move easier or harder.
• Protein: the palm method, a barcode scan and "Same as yesterday". No calorie counting.
• Evening: one small habit for calmer evenings and better nights.

KIND TO YOUR JOINTS
Tell us about sore knees, back, hips, shoulders or wrists, and your plan swaps in calmer moves. Something hurts during a workout? One tap gives you a softer option.

AT HOME OR AT THE GYM
Train with nothing, dumbbells or bands at home. At the gym, log your sets and weights in a simple logbook and see the muscles you worked this week.

A PLAN THAT LISTENS
Rough night? Take a Gentle Day: a shorter workout that still counts. Missed a few days? No guilt, no starting over.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Week by week through your 12 weeks, a Waist Check every Sunday, a simple chart, and the wins the scale misses: sleep, energy and how your clothes fit. Weight tracking is optional. Private progress photos stay on your phone.

EAT FOR YOUR BODY
30 high-protein recipes, a meal idea every day and a weekly shopping list. Vegetarian, vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free filters.

LEARN WHAT'S HAPPENING
Short lessons on hormones, muscle, stress and sleep, unlocked week by week. Plus a 10-min wind-down for nights when you can't sleep.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account needed. Your answers, waist and photos stay on your iPhone. Anonymous usage stats are off unless you turn them on. We don't sell your data.

AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH, FRENCH, SPANISH, GERMAN AND ITALIAN


SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Belly After 40 is free to download and requires a subscription to use the plan: yearly (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Deleting the app doesn't cancel your subscription.

Belly After 40 is a wellness app, not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before starting a new exercise program or if you have symptoms that worry you.

Terms of Use: https://bellyafter40.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://bellyafter40.com/privacy.html

name: Benda
description:
Benda simplifie le voyage en bus et l'envoi de colis en République démocratique du Congo.

VOYAGER
• Cherchez un trajet entre deux villes et comparez les départs des compagnies partenaires.
• Choisissez votre siège sur le plan du bus.
• Payez par Mobile Money (M-Pesa, Orange Money, Airtel Money) ou au guichet.

ENVOYER UN COLIS

• Suivez chaque étape : reçu en agence, en route, disponible à destination, livré.

VOTRE COMPTE

name: BijliBuddy
description:
BijliBuddy is one app for a family of home-built smart devices.

• Water Monitor — see if water is flowing right now, get alerts when supply starts, stops or the pump runs dry, and track daily usage.
• Smart Switch — turn sockets on and off from anywhere, set off-timers, rename sockets and restart the board remotely.
• UnitMeasure energy meter — live power, voltage and current, units used this month, and a warning before you cross your monthly limit.
• Health Box — connect to the box on your bike or scooter over Bluetooth to see live speed, lean and battery voltage, record rides automatically, get ride scores, service reminders and a bike-health score, and view every route on a map.
• RGB Light — pick effects, themes, colours, brightness and speed for your monitor backlight.
• RC Car — drive the car with a touch D-pad over its own Wi-Fi.

BijliBuddy needs the matching BijliBuddy hardware. No ads, no tracking.

name: bioo · Tu tienda online

name: Biorhythm 4
description:
Biorhythm 4 calculates and draws the four biorhythm cycles — physical, emotional, intellectual and intuitive — for anyone whose date of birth you know. A clear, colourful graph shows the whole month at a glance, with today highlighted.

THE FOUR CYCLES
• Physical (23 days): strength, endurance and vitality
• Emotional (28 days): mood, creativity and sensitivity
• Intellectual (33 days): logic, learning and memory
• Intuitive (38 days): intuition and creative insight
Each cycle starts at zero on the day of birth and rises and falls like a wave, crossing the zero line on the so-called critical days.

YOUR PEOPLE
• Add the people you care about with their name and date of birth
• Or simply allow access to Contacts: everyone with a birthday appears automatically
• Under every name, today's values for the four cycles, with an arrow showing whether each one is rising or falling
• Edit or delete with a swipe, and choose the person whose graph opens at startup

THE GRAPH
• A whole month at a glance, with today and the day of birth clearly marked
• Change month with the arrows, the menus or a two-finger swipe
• Pinch to zoom in on a few days, double-tap to see the whole month again
• Tap a cycle in the legend to show or hide it
• Export the graph as a PDF to save, print or send

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• On iPad, the list stays on the left and the graph on the right
• Choose between a list and tiles with a small graph for every person
• Colours and line thickness of every cycle, the grid and the current day are fully customisable
• Light and dark theme, large text and high contrast, designed to be easy to read
• Built-in guide with the history of biorhythms and every feature explained

FREE AND RESPECTFUL
Biorhythm 4 is free, has no ads and collects no data at all: your list and your contacts never leave your device. If you like it, you can support its development with a small optional tip.

Biorhythms are a tool for self-awareness, not a forecast: use them as a mirror for reflection.

Available in English, Italian and French.

name: Bisqo
description:
Bisqo turns your paper stamp card into a digital one that lives in your customers' phones. They scan a QR code at your counter and add your card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. No app for them to download, no password, no paper cards to lose.

Made for cafés, bakeries, barbers, salons and every small shop with regulars.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set up your shop in a minute and design your card: color, logo, stamp icon, number of stamps and the reward.
• Print your counter QR poster and put it next to the till.
• Customers scan it and add the card to their wallet in seconds. All they type is their first name.
• On every visit, scan the card on their phone: one scan, one stamp. The card in their wallet updates by itself.
• When a card is full, Bisqo tells you. Redeem the reward with one tap and the card starts over.

FOR YOUR SHOP
• Today's numbers at a glance: stamps given, rewards redeemed, new cards.
• All your customers and their progress in one list. Can't scan? Add a stamp by hand.
• Added a stamp by mistake? Undo it.
• Make the card yours: any color, a pattern, gradient or your own photo behind the stamps, 15 stamp icons or your own stamp picture, and your logo from Photos or Files, round, square or wide. Change it any time; cards already in wallets update too.
• Add your details to the wallet card: opening hours or your Instagram, your own line under the QR code and how many stamps are left.
• Free promotions: welcome stamps, birthday stamps, double-stamp days, a come-back bonus and optional stamp expiry.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

FOR YOUR CUSTOMERS
• Nothing to install and no account to create.
• Their card is always on their phone, next to their tickets and boarding passes.
• After each stamp, they see how close they are to their reward.

FREE TO START
The free plan works forever and includes everything above. All you need to sign up is an email address.

BISQO PRO
Bisqo Pro is an optional subscription with more features for growing shops, billed monthly or yearly. The price and what's included are shown in the app before you subscribe.

• Staff accounts – Every barista scans with their own login
• Customer insights – Returning visits, busiest days, top regulars
• Messages to wallets – “Double stamps today” on every customer’s phone
• More locations – All your shops in one account

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

description:
「BJJ Scoreboard」は、ブラジリアン柔術（BJJ）の道場でのスパーリング、部内戦、合同練習の運営に特化したシンプルかつ本格的なスコアボード＆タイマーアプリです。

iPhone・iPad の大画面を活かした高い視認性と、審判やタイムキーパーが迷わず操作できる直感的なUIで、白熱する試合進行をスマートにサポートします。

■ 見やすいリアルタイムスコアボード
・ポイント（+2 / +3 / +4）、アドバンテージ（ADV）、ペナルティ（PEN）をワンタップで素早く加算

Asia Pacific Region: Australia, Brunei, Cambodia, China, Fiji, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, Laos, Lebanon, Macao, Malaysia, Myanmar, New Zealand, Pakistan, Philippines, Taiwan, Singapore, Korea, Thailand, Vietnam

name: Bloom Nest
description:
You are a garden keeper guiding cute leaf-ants (couriers) that clear colored mosaic
tiles. Seat "ant boxes" into five holding slots. When a box color matches a reachable
tile on the painting, ants march from the nest hole, carry the tile away, and reduce
the box count. Reveal the full mosaic, uncover hidden treasure chests, and unlock
new courier routes.

This project is an original garden-nest theme inspired by sorting / color-clear
puzzle loops (front-row queues, linked pairs, power-ups), not a clone of any single
title’s art or brand.

Core Gameplay
-------------
1. Only the first row of ant boxes is freely selectable.
2. Place a box into an empty slot (five slots max).
3. Matching reachable mosaic tiles are cleared by animated ants.
4. Linked boxes must both be reachable and need two empty slots.
5. Power-ups:
   - 2x Speed: ants move twice as fast
   - Free Pick: grab one box from rows 2–6 into a slot
   - Shuffle: reshuffle single boxes in the first four rows
6. Chests hide under tiles — clear covering tiles to claim them.
7. Fill all slots with no productive matches and you jam the nest (lose / revive).

name: Boat Simulator: Boating School
description:
Study for your boater education exam, then take the helm and put the rules to work on open water. Built for Apple Vision Pro.

THE COURSE
• 8 chapters and 40+ short lessons that follow the national standard for basic boating knowledge, the outline NASBLA-approved state courses use
• Know your boat, required equipment, planning a trip, operating safely, rules of the road, buoys and markers, emergencies, and sharing the water
• Every lesson cites its official source: U.S. Coast Guard Navigation Rules, the U.S. Aids to Navigation System, and federal equipment requirements
• A Quick Reference to review the essentials before test day

PRACTICE TESTS
• 170+ practice questions, each with an explanation and the official source behind the answer
• Chapter quizzes to check yourself as you go
• A 60-question practice exam drawn from every chapter and scored against the 80% most states require
• Questions you miss come back until you get them right

TAKE THE HELM
• Sit at the wheel of a 25-foot sport boat on an immersive open sea
• Grab the wheel and throttle with your own hands, use PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers, or look and pinch
• Seven on-water lessons, each built around one rule: Know Your Boat, Red Right Returning, Slow No Wake, Meeting Head-On, Crossing as the give-way boat, Crossing as the stand-on boat, and Overtaking
• A coach talks you through each lesson from a panel over the bow, then marks how you handled it
• Free cruise: open water, islands, a buoyed channel and other boats going about their business
• A helm screen with your speed, a chart and your Apple Music playlists
• Calm or choppy seas, and a steady or lively ride to suit your comfort

GET YOUR BOATER CARD
There is no federal boating license. Each state decides who must pass a boating safety course and issues a boater education card to those who do. The app explains the steps and links to each state's requirements and boating agency.

Boat Simulator: Boating School is a study aid. It follows the national standard and cites U.S. Coast Guard sources, but it is not itself a state-approved course. Your boater education card comes from a course and exam approved by your state.

name: BoatKnect: Sydney Boating
description:
Know the rules, read the water and plan a better day out on Sydney Harbour, Pittwater, Botany Bay and the coast.

BoatKnect puts the boating rules, depth, wind and live traffic for your boat on one map. Tell it what you drive, from a jet ski to a 50-foot cruiser, and everything adapts: how much water you need right now, which zones apply, and where you'll be comfortable today.

ON THE MAP
• Speed, no-wash, no-towing and restricted zones from Transport for NSW, with the rule that applies where you are
• Depth for your boat at the current tide: too shallow, less than 1 m under the keel, or plenty
• Public, emergency and private moorings, anchorages, ramps, wharves, fuel and pump-out
• Channel and cardinal marks
• Live ferries and AIS ships, with alerts when something is closing on you
• Wind with animated streaks, hour by hour, and rain radar

DIRECTIONS BY WATER
• Routes that keep to water deep enough for your boat at this tide
• Slows for speed and no-wash zones, with distance, time and fuel for your boat
• Passes channel marks on the correct side and keeps to starboard
• Crosses ferry routes and shipping lanes at right angles instead of running along them
• Picks sheltered water in a blow and brings you in heading into the wind

PLAN YOUR DAY
• Pick a date and where you launch: wind, gusts, tide, rain, sunrise, sunset and moon
• "Where to go": beaches, anchorages and waterside cafés ranked by shelter from the day's wind and what you're after (swim, lunch, fishing, overnight)
• Star your favourite spots and launch places; recent ones are one tap away

COMMUNITY REPORTS
• Report hazards, police, wildlife or a free mooring, and confirm what others report

YOUR BOATS
• A garage with about 90 popular models (Sea Ray, Riviera, Maritimo, Princess, Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon, Sea-Doo, Yamaha and more) or any size you enter
• Draft, air draft and cruise speed drive the depth shading, routes and fuel estimates

Home and Lock Screen widgets show wind and tide at a glance.

IMPORTANT
BoatKnect is a training and planning aid, not an approved navigation chart. Data comes from Transport for NSW, NSW government seabed surveys, OpenStreetMap, Open-Meteo, RainViewer and AIS, and may be incomplete or out of date. Always check official charts, signage and Bureau of Meteorology warnings, keep a proper lookout and follow the skipper's judgement. In an emergency call 000 or Marine Rescue NSW on VHF 16.

Coverage: Sydney and nearby NSW waters (Port Jackson, Middle Harbour, Parramatta and Lane Cove rivers, Pittwater, Broken Bay, Botany Bay, Port Hacking).

name: Body Fat by SyncScale
description:
Get a clearer picture of your body fat.

Enter your weight and tape measurements to compare estimates from up to six methods. See where they agree, understand the differences and follow changes over time.

Start with a tape measure

Add your profile and measurements at your own pace. Built-in guides show where and how to measure for each method.

Compare different methods

Explore estimates from US Navy, YMCA, Modified YMCA, Relative Fat Mass, CUN-BAE and Covert Bailey. Choose the methods you want to include and see their average alongside the individual results.

Follow your progress

Save check-ins and see how your average estimate changes over time. Review previous measurements and edit or delete entries whenever you need to.

Keep it simple

Use kilograms and centimeters or pounds and inches. Everything works offline, with your profile and check-ins stored on your iPhone.

Pay once for the complete app. No subscription, signup or extra password.

Designed for adults aged 18 and over. Available methods depend on your age and the measurements you provide. Body fat results are estimates for personal tracking and can differ from your actual body composition.

name: Boost: Share with Friends
description:
Boost is where you and your friends share what matters to you, in a chat.

Send messages and photos, find the perfect GIF, and share YouTube videos your friends can watch without leaving the conversation.

• Chats and groups: talk one-on-one or bring everyone together.
• Photos: share the moment.
• GIFs: search GIFs from KLIPY, or browse what's trending.
• YouTube videos: search YouTube or paste a link. Your friends tap to watch, right in the chat.
• Friends by phone number: pick someone from your contacts, or type their number, and Boost checks whether they're here. Your address book is never uploaded.
• You choose who reaches you: chats from people you don't know, and groups someone adds you to, wait in Message requests until you say yes. Report or block anyone, any time.
• No tracking, and no ads of our own.

Your account is your phone number and your Apple ID together, so it stays yours even if your number changes hands. You can delete it from the app at any time.

Terms of service: https://boost-friends.web.app/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://boost-friends.web.app/privacy.html

name: Boxling: Widget Pet
description:
Boxling is a small pet that lives in your widgets. Pick a cat, a dog or a hamster, give it a name, and it climbs out of its cardboard box onto your Home Screen.

CARE IN ONE TAP
Feed it, play with it and put it to bed straight from the widget, without opening the app. Tap the pet to give it a pat. The widget shows its bowl, its toy and how it feels right now, and it shifts pose through the day so it never looks frozen.

THREE PETS, THREE PACES
The dog wants the most play and gets hungry soonest. The cat is somewhere in the middle. The hamster mostly looks after itself. Each has three needs, Tummy, Joy and Rest, that drift down slowly over hours.

TWO LOOKS
Flat: a few calm colours on linen. Pixel: a 16 by 12 sprite on a dark shelf. Switch in Settings and the widget redraws.

COZY BY DESIGN
Your pet never gets sick and never dies. If you are busy, it naps more. After a few days without care it leaves a note and goes exploring. One tap brings it home, carrying a souvenir. Nights are for sleeping, so it needs nothing from you then.

GENTLE REMINDERS
If you allow them, your pet sends a short note in its own voice when a need runs low. A few a day at most, never at night, with Feed, Play or Bed buttons on the notification itself. Choose gentle, regular or off, and set quiet hours. Ignored reminders get fewer, not louder.

WIDGETS
Small, medium and large widgets on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Small: tap the pet or its bowl. Medium: Feed, Play and Bed, with a ring for each need. Large: Feed, Play, Wash and Bed.

NO LOGIN, NO ADS
There is no account to create and there are no ads. Food is never for sale. Your pet stays on your device unless you turn on sync.

BOXLING PLUS
Plus keeps the same pet on all your devices, with no sign-up: your devices find each other through your iCloud account. Plus also unlocks all three pets and both looks.
- Plus Monthly: auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly.
- Plus Yearly: auto-renewing subscription, billed yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.
- Plus Lifetime: a single purchase, no subscription.
Without Plus you can also buy an extra pet, or the second look, once each.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you subscribe.

Terms of Use: https://app-lab.ai/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://app-lab.ai/privacy-policy

name: BrainGym
description:
O BrainGym transforma estudo em hábito. Cada dia estudado vira mais um dia na sua sequência — e, com os amigos do lado, fica bem mais difícil parar.

COMO FUNCIONA
• Estude: ligue o cronômetro ou registre a sessão depois.
• Faça check-in com foto: uma foto da sua mesa, tirada na hora, prova que o estudo aconteceu. A foto fica guardada só no seu aparelho.
• Mantenha a sequência: um check-in por dia soma na sua sequência. O dia vira à meia-noite no seu fuso, e o app te lembra no horário que você escolher se o dia ainda estiver em aberto.

ESTUDE COM A TURMA
• Desafios com amigos: crie um desafio, convide com um código de 6 letras e acompanhe o ranking e a meta da semana.
• Feed: veja quem está estudando agora e reaja aos check-ins da turma.

ACOMPANHE SEU PROGRESSO
• Mapa de estudos do ano, recordes, nível, XP e conquistas.
• Sequência por matéria.
• Widgets para a tela de início e a tela bloqueada.

BRAINGYM PRO (OPCIONAL)
• Proteção da sequência: salve sua sequência uma vez por semana.
• Matérias e desafios ilimitados, e desafios com até 50 pessoas.
• Estatísticas avançadas e histórico completo de fotos.
• Ranking global e selo PRO no perfil.

O BrainGym é gratuito. O PRO é uma assinatura opcional, mensal ou anual, com renovação automática. Cancele quando quiser nos Ajustes do iOS.

Termos de Uso: https://braingym-site.vercel.app/terms
Política de Privacidade: https://braingym-site.vercel.app/privacy

name: Brake Line
description:
Brake Line lays out a sheet-metal part with several bends.

Enter the thickness, the inside radius, and the K factor. Add a flange for each leg and set the angle and the direction of each bend. The flat length is the flanges plus the bend allowance, minus the setback at each bend. Compare that length with the blank in hand.

Short lips are bent first. The hit list shows the part after each bend and marks a leg that would hit the ram. The die page gives the V opening and an air-bend tonnage for mild steel.

Parts stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This picture is a shop sketch. Check the flat on the brake before you cut.

name: Bridleline
description:
Every flight, every field, every kite — remembered.

Bridleline is a logbook for kite fliers. Time your flights at the field, record the wind and the kite you flew, keep your quiver organised, and see which kite suits today's wind. It works for single-line kites, stunt kites and quad-line kites alike.

GO FLY
• Tap Go fly when you reach the field. Bridleline times your airtime and counts launches and tangles while you fly.
• When you land, add the field, wind speed and direction, gusts, sky, how the air felt and how much line you had out.
• Tag tricks and moments (loops, axels, hovers, line laundry…), rate the flight and add notes.
• Attach field photos from the camera or your photo library (optional).
• You can also log a past flight at any time.

TODAY'S AIR
• Set the wind and see the Beaufort force, what it looks like on land and what it means for kites.
• Bridleline checks every kite in your quiver against the wind and tells you which are in their sweet spot.
• Show wind in km/h, mph, knots or m/s.

YOUR QUIVER
• Add your kites: diamond, delta, sled, box, rokkaku, parafoil, fighter, dual-line stunt and quad-line.
• Set each kite's wind range, sail colour, span and line set.
• See every kite's total airtime and flights. Retire old kites without losing their history.

FIELD SOUNDS
Meadow wind, a singing line, skylarks, ripstop flutter, beach surf and rain on the grass, in four scenes or your own mix. Set a fade-out timer. Sounds keep playing with the screen locked.

INTRO FILM
"First Launch" is a one-minute, five-part intro to kite flying: reading the wind, picking a safe field, launching, flying and landing. Cast it to an Apple TV or AirPlay TV.

KITE FIELD
Flying with friends or at a festival? Everyone on the same Wi-Fi or personal hotspot joins one four-letter field code. See who's flying which kite and how much line they have out, share the wind you measure, and send line calls like "Launching!", "Landing!" and "Tangle!" that buzz every phone on the field.

FIELD GUIDE
The wind window, Beaufort for kite fliers, kite families, launching single-line and stunt kites, two essential knots, festival etiquette and a clear safety code.

SHARE YOUR FLIGHTS
Share a flight summary with your photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account or login. No ads, no analytics. Your flights, kites and photos stay on your iPhone.

name: Brisk: Read More, Faster
description:
Brisk shows text one word at a time, in one spot, so your eyes stay still and the words come to you. Read articles, books, PDFs and anything you paste, at a pace you set.

READ WHAT YOU LIKE
• Articles: open a site in Brisk's browser and tap Read. Brisk reads just the article, without the rest of the page.
• Books and PDFs: open an EPUB or a PDF from Files, even a scanned one.
• Text: paste it, share it from another app, or take a photo of a page.
• Sources: add the sites you read, and their newest articles show up on Home.
• Feed: go through those articles one at a time. Swipe up for the next, right to save one for later, left to remove it, and tap Read on the one you want.

READ YOUR WAY
• Set the pace, from easy to brisk. Smart Pace slows a little for long words and at commas, full stops and paragraph ends.
• Pause any time to see the whole page, and tap any word to go on from there.
• Pick the font, the size and the colour of the focus letter.
• Add a calm sound under the words: rain, or a distant thunderstorm.

LISTEN
Switch to Listen and Brisk reads aloud while the words go by: in natural voices that run on your device for English, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese, and in your device's own voices for other languages.

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• No account and no ads. Brisk collects no data.
• Your library and settings are kept in your own iCloud, so your iPhone, iPad and next phone have them too.
• Made for iPhone and iPad, and optimized for iPhone Duo.

FREE TO START
Without a plan, Brisk reads the example with everything, and one source with all its articles, one book, one PDF and one text at a time. A plan opens everything: Monthly or Yearly, each with the first week free, or Lifetime, paid once.

Terms of Use: https://briskapp.pages.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://briskapp.pages.dev/privacy

name: BuHuang: Take It Slow
description:
Write down one thing you want to achieve in this stage of life, and seal it away — for 7 days, 30 days, 3 months, up to 5 years. You choose.

While it is sealed, no one can read it. Not even you. No progress bars, no streak pressure — just come back once a day and tap how it is going: close to giving up, still going, or almost there. When the time is up, the seal opens, and the words you wrote meet the person you have become.

BuHuang has two more quiet corners:
· The Sunset Ritual — every evening, note one small thing you got done today. Small counts. Then read one comforting line.
· The Life-Pace Wall — share where you honestly are in life, anonymously, and see how many people are taking it slow, just like you.

No sign-up. Just open it. Take it slow — everyone has their own pace.

name: Bulino: CNC Speeds and Feeds
description:
Speeds and feeds for lathe, mill and drill, starting from the tool in your hand. Type or scan the insert code, pick the material and the diameter: Bulino works out cutting speed, RPM, feed and depth of cut as starting values, kept within the limits of your CNC or manual machine.

FROM THE TOOL TO THE RPM
• Turning, boring, parting and grooving, single-point threading pass by pass.
• Drilling with HSS, solid carbide, indexable and gun drills; tapping with cutting and forming taps; reaming and countersinking.
• Milling with solid, indexable and ball end mills: face milling, slotting, trochoidal. Thread milling with helical interpolation.
• Cutting speed (SFM or m/min), RPM, feed per rev and per tooth (chip load), depth of cut, expected surface finish, power, torque and cutting time.
• Every result is a range: the minimum, where to start and the maximum.

READS THE INSERT CODE
Point the camera at the box: Bulino reads the ISO code (for example CNMG 432 or CNMG 120408), works out shape, nose radius and cutting edges, and you confirm it before the calculation. The photo is read on the device and goes nowhere.

YOUR MACHINE
Save minimum and maximum RPM, spindle power and torque, maximum feed, rigidity and the RPM limit for G96 constant surface speed. If a value goes past the machine, Bulino lowers it and tells you.

ANY MATERIAL NAME
Type 1045, C45, 1.0503 or S45C: Bulino finds the material among 97, with its ISO group (P, M, K, N, S, H) and typical hardness.

SHOP-FLOOR ADVICE
• The right coolant for the tool, the material and the operation.
• How many parts one cutting edge makes, with an estimate that learns from your own parts.
• "I have a problem": chatter, long chips, poor finish, edge wearing out or chipping? Bulino lists the likely causes and corrects the values.

MACHINING RECIPES
Save material, tool, machine, values, photo and a note. Next time Bulino suggests the recipe that worked first.

TOOL COMPARISON
Compare two tools: cost per part, savings per year, machine hours saved. Create a PDF to send to the customer: handy for tooling sales reps too.

SHOP FLOOR MODE
Big numbers, screen always on and a part counter for each cutting edge, with the parts expected before the change.

MACHINIST TOOLS AND FORMULAS
• ISO hole and shaft tolerances and fits (H7, g6…), clearance and interference.
• Metric, UNC, UNF and pipe threads, with the tap drill size.
• Hardness conversion between HRC, HB, HV and tensile strength.
• Tapers, chamfers and countersinks.
• Equivalent materials across standards.
• Conversions between inches and millimeters, speed, power and torque.
• Machining formulas: G96 constant surface speed, circular interpolation, chip thinning, tap drills, bolt hole circle, sine bar, part weight, dividing head, bolt tightening torque, punching and bending force.

CERTIFICATES: LICENSES AND COURSES
Keep your forklift license, aerial lift and crane training, safety courses, first aid, fire safety, welder qualification and technical courses in one place, with a photo or PDF of each certificate.
• See at a glance what is valid, expires soon or has expired.
• A reminder before each expiration date, even offline. Photos and dates stay on the device.
• Create a "Training record" PDF to send to an employer.
• Occupational health check-up: only the date of the next one, no health data.

BUILT FOR THE PEOPLE AT THE MACHINE
• Works offline, no account.
• Inches and millimeters.
• Light and dark mode, large text, iPhone and iPad.
• In 12 languages.

Values are starting points: always check the tool maker's catalog and the machine's safety rules.

name: Bun & Bell: Picnic Puzzles
description:
A little spin. A lovely picnic.

Welcome to Pip’s picnic kitchen! Milo the bear, Rosie the bunny, Finn the fox and their friends are stopping by for burgers. Read each guest’s order and turn a shared ingredient ring to build the requested layers, one delicious choice at a time.

It starts with a simple choice: left or right? Soon, you'll be planning for two orders, saving an ingredient in your pocket, and swapping whole plates to find a better route. Watch the pantry, prepare your final layers, and ring the picnic bell at just the right moment.

HAPPY GUESTS, FRESHLY MADE BURGERS
Six charming animal guests arrive with their own orders. Follow the pictured layers from bottom to top, add the top bun, and tap Serve to hand over the finished burger. Watch your guest leave happy as the next customer steps up. Serving costs no moves.

THOUGHTFUL PUZZLES, LITTLE AHA MOMENTS
Explore 100 levels across 10 cheerful chapters. New ideas arrive gradually, from simple layering to finite pantry refills, warm orders, and paired deliveries.

ONE RING. TWO PLATES.
Every turn changes the choices at both ingredient gates. Read the tickets, plan each layer from bottom to top, and make one small decision work for both plates.

A POCKET FULL OF POSSIBILITIES
Save one ingredient for later. Pass it to either plate, swap your orders, and discover a satisfying route through the kitchen.

TAKE YOUR TIME
There is no real-time countdown. Warmth and paired burger-finishing windows count moves, so you can pause, think, undo, and try again. Serving does not spend a move or reduce another order’s warmth. Helpful lessons and optional hints are always close by.

YOUR OWN LITTLE PICNIC WORLD
Earn stars and Picnic Stamps, collect chapter postcards, and unlock cozy color themes. Stop by for a daily gift. Cosmetic rewards never change the puzzle rules.

FRIENDLY COMPETITION, CLOSE TO HOME
Create up to four local chefs and compare genuine achievements saved on the same device. Keep separate progress and see your best scores without an online account.

READY WHEN YOU ARE
Play the full campaign offline. No accounts, ads, in-app purchases, or energy limits. Just rounded cartoon charm, gentle sounds, and a lovely little puzzle break.

name: Bushytail: Squirrel Hunting
description:
A free map of where you can hunt squirrels and small game in Wisconsin, and where the oak and hickory woods are.
Public land, plus private land the DNR lists as open to the public, colored by whether hunting is open. Works with no signal, statewide. No account, no ads, nothing uploaded.
Wisconsin only. It does not show private property lines or owner names, and it isn't made by the Wisconsin DNR.

WHERE CAN I HUNT?
• Public land across the state, colored open, special rules, or closed, with the reason in plain words.
• Private land the DNR lists as open to public hunting (Managed Forest Law and Voluntary Public Access).
• Tap any piece of land for its name, acres, how much is oak and hickory, and the nearest parking.

FIND SQUIRREL WOODS
• Oak and hickory woods drawn on the map, from U.S. Forest Service data.
• A list of the best squirrel woods on open land near you, with distances.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
• The whole state's land and woods download once, about 62 MB, and stay on your phone.
• Save satellite and topo pictures of your spots before you leave the truck.

MARK IT AND WALK IT
• Drop pins for den trees, nut trees, sightings and parking. Add notes and photos.
• Record your walk as a track. It keeps going with the phone locked in your pocket.
• Sunrise and sunset times, and a forecast for any spot.

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• No account. No ads. No tracking. Your pins, tracks and photos stay on your phone.
• English, Hmong and Spanish.
• Light and dark looks, so it's easy on the eyes at 5:30 in the morning.

FREE, WITH A TIP JAR
The map is free. If it's useful, you can buy the maker a box of shells from the tip jar, or pick up an icon pack that changes your map pins and app icon. Tips and packs unlock nothing on the map. The public land map stays free.

Always check posted signs, DNR rules and local gun ordinances before you hunt. Land status comes from public records and can be out of date or wrong.

Not made by, or endorsed by, the Wisconsin DNR, the U.S. Forest Service, the U.S. Geological Survey or the National Weather Service.

name: Busy Basket: Supermarket Game
description:
Busy Basket is a paid app: the first full shopping trip is free, then an in-app purchase is required (a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, unlocked by a parent behind a parental gate). There is no free trial.

Walk to the store with Mom, fill the basket, pay at the register and bring the food home. Busy Basket turns a real grocery run into a calm pretend-play game for toddlers aged 2 to 4.

EVERY SHOPPING TRIP (PURCHASE REQUIRED AFTER THE FIRST FREE TRIP)
• A picture shopping list: find each item in the fruit and vegetable aisles and drop it in the basket (purchase required after the free trip)
• 28 real fruits and vegetables shown as real photos, each named aloud (purchase required after the free trip)
• Pay at the register, carry the bag home and put the food away in the fridge (purchase required after the free trip)
• Choose a fruit, wash it under the tap and serve it to Mom, Montessori-style practical life (purchase required after the free trip)
• A new shopping list on every trip (purchase required after the free trip)

The first complete trip, from the front door to washing a fruit, is free with no purchase. After that, a parent unlocks all further trips with a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. There is no free trial.

FOR PARENTS
• Spoken and written in English, Turkish, Dutch, German and French. Change the language in the parents' corner.
• No ads, no tracking, no account. Purchases, restore and settings are behind a parental gate.
• Plays offline; buying and restoring need an internet connection.

Yearly subscription: payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews yearly unless canceled in your App Store account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Lifetime: one payment, no renewal.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://moz6.com/privacy-kids
Support: https://moz6.com

name: Caeruz
description:
Caeruz is the dealership management system for independent car dealers. Your whole team works from one account: owners, managers, finance, salespeople and brokers each see what their role needs.

• Inventory: every vehicle with photos, prices, costs and ready-to-share promo cards
• Leads: a clear board from first contact to sale, with customer conversations by SMS and WhatsApp
• Sales and commissions: deals, payments and each salesperson's own sales and commission
• Cost control: what every vehicle really cost, so you know your margin
• Team: invite people by email, set their role, approve who joins
• Works in English, Portuguese, Spanish and Haitian Creole

Caeruz is for dealership staff. Sign in with your dealership account.

name: Camera 4K Gold
description:
Camera 4K Gold is a creative photo camera for iPhone, built around shooting modes the built-in camera doesn't offer.

FIVE SHOOTING MODES
• BURST – 5, 10, 20 or 30 photos back to back with one press
• BRACKET – three photos at −1/0/+1 or −2/0/+2 EV for tricky light and later merging
• INTERVAL – one photo every 2 s to 1 min, for 10, 30, 100 photos or until you stop; the screen stays on
• PHOTO – single shots with flash and a 2 to 30 second self-timer
• VIDEO – 4K or 1080p at 30 or 60 fps (depending on your iPhone)

12 LIVE COLOUR EFFECTS
Golden, Vivid, Mono, Noir, Sepia, Chrome, Fade, Instant, Aqua, Posterize and Negative. You see the effect live in the viewfinder, every effect shows a live thumbnail of your scene, and it is applied to every photo you save – burst, bracket and interval shots included.

SMART VIEWFINDER
• Face detection with focus and exposure that follow the main face
• Compass heading and a level line that turns gold when your phone is straight
• Rule of thirds, crosshair, diagonal and square 1:1 grids
• White balance presets: incandescent, fluorescent, daylight, cloudy and shade
• Exposure compensation and focus modes: continuous, single tap, infinity and locked
• Tap to focus, long-press to lock focus and exposure, pinch or tap 0.5× / 1× / 2× / 3× to zoom (lenses depend on your iPhone)

SESSION GALLERY
Swipe through everything you shot in this session, see which burst or bracket frame it is and share it straight away. Everything is also saved to your photo library as HEIF or JPEG.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Camera 4K Gold collects no data; your photos stay on your device.

name: Capy.io
description:
Snakes vs. capybaras – who rules the island?

Capy.io is a cozy-chaotic arena game. Slither in as the snake and hunt the capybaras – or switch sides, eat your way up and become the biggest capy on the map. Quick rounds, big laughs, total chaos.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Snake mode: hunt capybaras, grow longer and clear each level's goal
• Capy mode: eat, grow and be the biggest capybara when the timer runs out

FEATURES
• Fast rounds you can finish in a couple of minutes
• Colorful 3D island worlds
• Unlock skins, hats and the Legendary Set
• Capy Pass with seasonal rewards
• Missions, trophies and new levels to beat
• Play offline – no internet needed to play

Free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads.

Grab some oranges. Watch out for snakes.

name: carfyo: Fuel Prices & Charging
description:
carfyo shows you where fuel is cheapest right now, where to charge your EV and what your car really costs. No ads, no account and no tracking.

FUEL PRICES
• Official prices from the German Market Transparency Unit for Fuels (MTS-K) for Super E5, E10 and diesel, and from the ministry MITECO in Spain
• List by price or distance, or as a map
• Price history for 24 hours, 72 hours and a month
• "Better wait": when prices around you usually drop, calculated from the real price data
• Price alerts by notification as soon as your target price is reached

CHARGING
• Charging stations from the official registries (Bundesnetzagentur, DGT in Spain)
• Filter by charging power and publicly accessible chargers

MY CAR
• Fuel log, service and costs with payment interval
• Reminders for inspection, service, tyres and contract changes
• Scan your registration document and fuel receipts; text recognition runs on your device only

LOGBOOK
• Business, commute and private trips, chained without gaps

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Widgets for the home and lock screen
• Apple Watch and Siri shortcuts
• iPad with map and app side by side

CARFYO PLUS
Fuel prices, price alerts and the logbook are always free. Plus adds unlimited vehicles, cost analysis, exports (CSV, PDF, DATEV), a receipt archive and charging cards. Monthly, yearly or at the founder price, each with a 14-day free trial and Family Sharing. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://carfyo.de/nutzungsbedingungen
Privacy: https://carfyo.de/datenschutz

name: Carpi Time
description: Carpi Time is a free personal work-hours tracker for anyone. A person can create their own account with an email address, verify it with a 6-digit code sent to that email, then clock in and out, mark break times, review daily, weekly and monthly totals, use a calendar and weekly chart, mark leave or days off. English and Arabic are supported, and the app includes dark mode.

name: Casi Mexa: Mexico Citizenship
description:
Casi Mexa is in Spanish. The lessons, questions and menus are all in Spanish, and the SRE study guide also asks for command of Spanish, so you practice in the language you will need.

Applying for Mexican nationality by naturalization (carta de naturalización)? Casi Mexa teaches you Mexico's history and culture before it quizzes you, so you get to your exam knowing it, not just memorizing it.

LEARN FIRST
Each topic comes in short lessons: you read a card and practice with it right away. There are multiple-choice, true-or-false and matching questions, and events and dates to put in order.

BASED ON THE SRE GUIDE'S READINGS
The lessons use the history and culture readings recommended by the study guide of the SRE, Mexico's foreign ministry. The guide also asks for command of Spanish: that part is not in the app.

EVERY ANSWER WITH ITS SOURCE
Every card and every question has its source: tap “Ver fuente” to see where it comes from and check what you study. When the sources disagree on a detail, we don't ask about it.

A PLAN UNTIL YOUR EXAM
Set your exam date and the app tells you how many lessons to do each day. Review what you miss when you need it most, keep your streak, and check topic by topic whether you are ready.

TIMED MOCK EXAMS
Practice with 10 or 20 questions, timed or untimed, and keep your history. We have not confirmed the real exam format with the SRE: the mock exams are for practice.

MADE WITH CARE
Two looks: a history book with engravings drawn for each topic, which is the starting look and comes with Casi Mexa completo (without paying, you see it in the first topic and in the free mock exam), and a modern book, with white paper and a current typeface, from day one. Pick a color, green, pink or blue, and the book on the app icon changes with you. Dark mode, sounds you can turn off, and on an unfolded iPhone Duo it reads as two pages.

FREE AND PAID
Free: the first topic, Ancient Mexico (México antiguo), complete and with all its lessons open from the start, one mock exam, and both looks in that topic and that mock exam.
Casi Mexa completo, with a single payment: all 13 topics, all the questions and unlimited mock exams. No subscription and no ads.

NO ACCOUNT, NO TRACKING
You don't need to sign up. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

Casi Mexa is not an app of the SRE or of the Mexican government. Always confirm the requirements for your application on the official websites; the app links to them in the “El trámite” section.

name: Cask & Co.
description:
Cask & Co. reads a whisky label — or its barcode — and tells you what you are holding.

Photograph the front of a bottle and the app names it: the distillery, the age, the strength, the cask and how it tastes. When it cannot be certain, it says so, and shows you what it read along with the closest matches. It does not guess at you.

Then it shows what that bottle costs near you. Every price in Cask & Co. is a real listing, recorded at a named shop on a date we show you, with a link to where it came from. No estimates, no averages, no invented "from" figures. A price that has gone stale stops being shown as current.

THE COLLECTION
1,240 whiskies from 289 distilleries across 17 countries, browsable by style and region — Scotch, Irish, American, Japanese, Indian and more. Keep the ones worth remembering.

WHERE TO BUY, WHERE TO DRINK
A map of licensed shops and 96 whisky bars, built on OpenStreetMap. Branch-level detail: opening hours, directions, and the local rules before you set off. Plan a Tasting Trail between a few bars, save it, and walk it.

EIGHT MARKETS, EIGHT SETS OF RULES
The UAE, the UK, the United States, Canada, France, Germany, Hong Kong and Taiwan — each with its own currency, legal drinking age and local law. In Taiwan, where selling alcohol online is prohibited, Cask & Co. shows no buy links at all.

THE LOUNGE
Enrol and you get a cabinet of what you own, a record of every pour with your own score and notes, and a feed of what other members have been drinking. Everything a member writes can be reported, and any member can be blocked.

Cask & Co. is an information service for adults of legal drinking age. It does not sell alcohol, take payment for it or deliver it — every purchase happens at a licensed merchant under that market's own rules. Please drink responsibly.

name: Cat metro station
description:
Which entrance should you take? Will the next train stop at your station? Cat metro station helps you find your way through an unfamiliar subway.

Explore Tokyo, Kyoto, Beijing, Shanghai, New York, Los Angeles, and London. Search by station name or code, browse the rail map offline, or look up departures. At supported stations, follow signs from the entrance to the platform. Choose a destination to check whether a listed train stops there. Departure boards distinguish scheduled times from live predictions where available.

Open the illustrated city handbooks for local advice on fares, tickets, signs, and where to find station staff. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese, choose your home city, or use your location to find a nearby mapped station.

No account is required.

name: Cat Ring: Rotate Rings Puzzle
description:
Twist plush rings, slide felt bars and set the kitty free!

Rotate the rings, solve the puzzle and save the cat!

Cat Ring is a cozy logic puzzle about a curious cat tangled up in soft, colorful rings. Rotate each ring until its gap meets the clip, slide the bars out of their sleeves and free every piece in the right order. One clever move can unlock everything; one wrong turn can block the way.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Satisfying ring puzzles: turn, slide and untangle with one finger
• Every puzzle is a picture: flowers, hearts, butterflies, snowmen, a bicycle and more
• A cute cat that meows with joy and dashes away when it is free
• Relaxing play: no timer, no rush, undo any move
• Smart helpers when you get stuck: the Fish frees a piece, the Laser makes the next right move and the Ghost lets a piece pass through obstacles
• A new Daily Puzzle every day
• Open the treasure vault and collect 50 festive keepsakes
• Cozy Christmas theme with soft plush visuals and gentle sounds
• Play in 13 languages

Brain teaser fans, logic lovers and cat people: grab a cup of cocoa and start untangling.

Cat Ring is free to play and contains ads. A one-time purchase removes banner and interstitial ads.

name: CelpMock: CELPIP Mock Tests
description:
CelpMock helps you get ready for the CELPIP-General test, the English test used for Canadian immigration and work. Take CELPIP practice tests and full mock tests on your phone, and see your estimated level after every test.

FULL MOCK TESTS
Sit a full CELPIP mock test, timed part by part: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking, one part after another. Try the free sample test first, with no pass needed.

PRACTICE BY PART
Work on one part at a time. Pick Listening, Reading, Writing or Speaking, answer, and review each question when you finish.

AI MARKING OF WRITING AND SPEAKING
Your Writing and Speaking answers are marked by AI, with feedback on what to fix. The app tells you this before you start and asks for your agreement. Your Listening and Reading levels come from your right answers.

DAILY CHALLENGE AND WEEKLY BOARD
A short challenge every day, with points, a streak and badges. The weekly board is off until you turn it on, and then others see only your first name, the first letter of your last name and your points.

PASSES THAT NEVER RENEW
Buy a 7-day, 30-day or 90-day pass in the app. Each pass ends on its own date and never renews, so there is nothing to cancel.

CelpMock is an independent practice site. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the organisation that runs the CELPIP test. Levels shown are estimates. CELPIP is a registered trademark of Paragon Testing Enterprises Inc., used here only to name the test.

Terms of use: https://celpmock.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://celpmock.com/privacy

name: Century Mart
description:
Century Mart helps wholesale customers browse products, view promotions, place orders, and track order updates from a simple mobile app.

With Century Mart, users can search brands and products, check available promotions and discounts, manage cart items, submit orders, and review order history. The app also provides notifications for order updates and account-related information.

name: České křížovky s tajenkou
description:
Švédské křížovky v češtině jako z časopisu. Legendy přímo v mřížce, šipky, které ukazují, kam se píše, a na konci tajenka, kterou si budete chtít přečíst nahlas.

KAŽDÝ DEN NOVÁ KŘÍŽOVKA
• Denní křížovka s pranostikou na dnešní den, třeba na svatého Martina nebo Medarda.
• Na kartě dne uvidíte, kdo má svátek.
• Klidná řada dní: když jeden den vynecháte, týdenní volný den vám řadu podrží.

TAJENKA, KTEROU SI BUDETE SBÍRAT
• Přes 600 přísloví, pranostik a citátů klasiků.
• Každá vyluštěná tajenka se uloží do vaší sbírky, méně známá přísloví i s vysvětlením.
• U delších přísloví je napsaný začátek a vy luštíte konec, jako v klasické doplňovačce.

KŘÍŽOVKA S VAŠÍM VZKAZEM
• Napište přání nebo vzkaz a aplikace z něj udělá křížovku s tajenkou.
• Pošlete ji blízkým odkazem, nebo ji vytiskněte na papír i s řešením.

LUŠTĚNÍ BEZ ZMATKŮ
• Velké, dobře čitelné písmo a nastavitelná velikost textu.
• Česká klávesnice s diakritikou v horní řadě a klávesou CH (CH je jedno políčko, jako v časopisech).
• Celé znění legendy vždy nad klávesnicí.
• Nápověda, kontrola písmen i slov, krok zpět a automatické ukládání.
• Tři velikosti křížovek a tři obtížnosti, od známých slov po méně obvyklé.

PRO IPHONE, IPAD I SKLÁDACÍ IPHONE
• Na iPadu i na rozloženém iPhonu je mřížka vlevo a legendy s klávesnicí vpravo.
• Funguje i bez připojení k internetu. Nepotřebujete žádný účet.
• Řada dní, sbírka a statistiky se přes iCloud přenesou na vaše další zařízení.

Křížovky jsou zdarma s reklamou po vyluštění. Reklamy můžete vypnout jednorázovým nákupem „Bez reklam navždy“, který platí navždy a díky Rodinnému sdílení i pro celou rodinu.

Našli jste chybnou legendu? Nahlaste ji přímo v aplikaci, opravíme ji. Dotazy a nápady pište na mail@adamvyborny.cz.

name: ChatbotX - AI Chat Marketing
description:
ChatbotX is a chat marketing platform for teams that talk to customers on several channels. This app puts your inbox on your phone.

Inbox
Read and answer conversations from the channels you have connected to ChatbotX: WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Zalo, TikTok, email and website chat. Conversations from every channel appear in one list. You can assign a conversation to a teammate and see each contact's details next to the chat.

Push notifications
The app alerts you when a new message arrives and when a conversation is assigned to you. Notification text follows your workspace language.

AI agents and automation
Flows and AI agents that you build on the ChatbotX web app reply to customers on their own. From your phone you can step in at any point and take over the conversation.

You need a ChatbotX account and a workspace. Create one at app.chatbotx.io. You can delete your account from the app at any time.

name: ChefMatch: Food Match Puzzle
description:
The smell of fresh wraps fills the street and the queue keeps growing! In ChefMatch you match ingredient tiles to cook your customers' orders and grow a tiny street cart into the most famous restaurant in town – "Sokaktan Sofraya", from the street to the table.

MATCH, COOK & SERVE
Line up three of the same ingredient: flatbread, minced meat, tomato, onion, cheese… Every match cooks part of an order. Dürüm wraps, şiş kebab, lahmacun, pizza, burgers, İskender, künefe, ayran and Turkish tea are all on the menu. Serve before your customers lose patience and collect happy faces!

MOVE-BASED LEVELS ON A COLOURFUL MAP
Travel level by level along a winding map. Every level gives you a limited number of moves – play smart and earn stars. The difficulty ramps up slowly, so everyone can jump right in.

SPECIAL TILES
• Skewer: clears a whole row or column.
• Spice Bomb: blasts a 3×3 area.
• Super Wrap: collects every tile of the kind you pick.
Combine specials and chain combos to blast the board!

BOOSTERS
Use the Mallet, Rolling Pin and Shuffle during a shift, or start with a Skewer, Spice Bomb or Super Wrap already on the board to beat tricky levels.

FROM STREET CART TO BIG RESTAURANT
Start with a humble street cart, move up to a food truck, open a restaurant and finally run a big restaurant. Every stage brings new customers, new recipes and new surprises.

A MENU THAT GROWS BY ITSELF
New recipes unlock as you play and are added to your menu automatically. Browse every dish in your recipe book and fine-tune your menu any time.

UPGRADES & DECOR
More moves, a bigger shelf, bigger tips… upgrade your kitchen. Decorate your shop with awnings, signs, string lights, plants, tables and wall art.

DAILY REWARDS
Fill the daily hunt chest and collect gifts from the 7-day login calendar.

RIVAL CHEF DUELS
Challenge the rival chef, finish the orders first and prove you are the best cook on the block!

LIVES & FAIR PLAY
Losing a level costs a life, and lives refill over time. Coins and diamonds are earned by playing; optional packs are also available in the Shop.

CUTE CARTOON STYLE
Smiling ingredients, cheerful customers, warm colours and sweet sounds.

Available in 15 languages.
No internet and no account needed: your progress is stored only on your device.

Tie your apron, chef – the street is waiting!

name: ChiAha
description:
ChiAha is the phone app for ChiAha's own team. Owners and staff sign in with their work email and see what needs them, in one place:

• Needs you: to-dos, drafted emails and follow-ups waiting for an OK, each with a one-tap button and Undo.
• Ask the assistant: ask about contacts and follow-ups in plain words. Anything that would email someone asks you first.
• Numbers: this week so far against last week (new contacts, website visits, posts), each with its source.
• Inbox: read and reply to the business inbox. Nothing is sent without a confirm.
• Promote: approve, schedule and make social posts.
• Alerts: choose which notifications this phone gets.

The app is a window onto ChiAha's own business system: everything stays on ChiAha's server, not on the phone. Sign-in is by a 6-digit code emailed to an address on ChiAha's team.

Not on the team? Tap "Try the demo" on the sign-in screen to look around with sample data.

name: Chicken Cop: Road Cross Puzzle
description:
Why did the chicken cross the road? To get away from the cops, of course!

Chicken Cop is a cheeky road crossing puzzle game with a police chase twist, made for the whole family. Hop across busy roads one square at a time, dodge the traffic and get home to the coop. But watch out: every time you hop, the cop chickens hop too.

TRICK THE COPS
Cops chase you when you get too close. Lead them into the traffic and watch them get bonked right off the board.

THINK BEFORE YOU HOP
Every level is a little puzzle. Finish in fewer moves to earn all three stars. Grab power-up bubbles when the road gets busy, and look out for the chicken cannon!

FIVE WORLDS, 1,000 LEVELS
Start in Hometown, then make a break for the City, the Motorway, a Military Base and even Space. Each world has 100 levels with a carefully paced difficulty curve and new tricks every few levels.

NIGHT MODE
Finish level 10 to unlock Night Mode and play every level again in the dark, lit only by your torch and the street lights. That makes 1,000 levels in all.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
Hats, colours, trails and sparkly FX skins, bought with coins you earn just by playing.

MADE WITH FAMILIES IN MIND
- No sign-up, no chat, no personal information
- Plays offline, no wifi needed
- Anything that costs real money sits behind a grown-ups check
- Short, family-safe ads that are never personalised. A one-time purchase switches off the ads between levels; optional reward videos stay, and only play when chosen

Coins and outfits are saved on your device. No Ads can be restored any time from Settings > Grown-ups.

Terms of Use: https://labailey.github.io/chickencop-site/terms
Privacy Policy: https://labailey.github.io/chickencop-site/privacy

name: chiik
description:
chiik is purpose-built for dining at Jongsamyook (종삼육) in Korea.

Scan your Jongsamyook table QR code to join your meal, browse the restaurant menu, and build an order that suits your table. Save a customizable usual, send quick re-ups, or choose individual items whenever you want another round.

During your meal, view your table order history and running totals for cost, meat, and drinks. Follow order submission progress with animated feedback, and inspect backend action timings in Diagnostics.
