Choose English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese. A paired Apple Watch can send selected quick orders when enabled in phone settings.

Ordering requires a supported Jongsamyook table QR code, an active table session, and an internet connection. Menu availability and prices come from the restaurant ordering service.

name: Chorewheels
description:
Welcome! We’ve put great care into building this product and look forward to your valuable suggestions.

Stop arguing about whose turn it is. Chorewheels puts a pointer on a household dial: whoever it lands on does the chore, and when it’s done the wheel advances—so every dish, trash run and bathroom wipe builds a fair rotation everyone can see.

HOW THE WHEEL WORKS
Add at least two members and the chores you share, then spin from the Wheel screen:
- Pick a chore chip; the dial shows who’s up right now
- Tap Done & advance when the job is finished—the pointer moves to the next person
- Need to pass? Skip with Away today, Let someone else go first, or a plain Skip
- Skips still advance the wheel and count toward fairness, so nobody quietly disappears from the rota
- Today lists what’s due; Digest shows the household pulse—chores due and who’s lined up next

FAIRNESS YOU CAN SEE
- Completed vs skipped bars per member after a few turns of the wheel
- History of every complete and skip on this device
- Share a fairness digest as plain text when you want a snapshot outside the app

YOUR HOUSEHOLD
- Manage members and chores anytime from the menu
- Set cadence per chore—daily, every other day, or weekly
- Optional daily local reminder so the wheel doesn’t go quiet
- Reset the household wheel in Settings if you want a clean start
- A Home Screen widget shows who’s up next without opening the app

NO ACCOUNT, NO TRACKING
There is no sign-in, no ads, no analytics and no cloud sync. Members, chores and history live in an on-device event log only you can see. Use nicknames; clear or reset anytime in Settings.

Chorewheels is a household chore rotation tool, not payroll, HR or surveillance. Keep it kind, keep it local, and let the pointer settle the debate.

name: Chrono: Feel the Seconds
description:
How close can you get? Chrono is a timing game for iPhone and iPad. Try it on iPhone Duo and challenge a friend.

Press START. The display flashes random digits while you guess how much time has passed. Press STOP when you think you’ve reached your target. The display shows dashes until you tap the screen to reveal the actual elapsed time.

Play three free rounds each day. Chrono Pro unlocks unlimited rounds and removes ads, with monthly and yearly subscription options.

name: Chutemap: 3D Ski & Hiking Maps
description:
Chutemap shows the mountains the way you see them: in 3D.

PLAN IN 3D
• Fly around any mountain in realistic 3D terrain
• Winter imagery, satellite imagery and national topo maps (Switzerland, Austria, Germany, France, Spain, Norway, Canada, Japan, USA)
• Slope-angle and aspect overlays for ski touring, plus your own terrain filter
• Ski runs and lifts for thousands of resorts worldwide, coloured by difficulty
• Ski tours from the camptocamp and Skitour.fr guidebooks

CONDITIONS
• Avalanche bulletins on the map for the Alps, North America and more
• Mountain weather: hour by hour, snowfall, snow line and freezing level
• Snow reports for ski areas and fresh-snow alerts

RECORD YOUR ADVENTURES
• Record ski tours, runs, hikes and rides with GPS, also with the screen off
• Distance, elevation gain, speed and an elevation profile
• Import and export GPX
• Fly through any route in 3D afterwards

GO TOGETHER
• Follow friends, share tours and see what they did
• Chat and plan group tours
• Your own guidebooks: collect routes in lists

CHUTEMAP PRO
Offline maps (3D terrain, imagery, topo maps and slope angles with no signal), the rain and snow radar, and private tours. Pro is a yearly subscription, renewing automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Always free: the 3D map, avalanche bulletins, tours, recording and the community.

Safety: Chutemap is a planning aid. Slope angles and maps do not show avalanche danger. Always check the local avalanche bulletin and conditions, and travel with the right training and equipment.

Terms of Use: https://chutemap.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://chutemap.com/privacy

name: CineDuel: Trailers & Compare
description:
Can't decide what to watch tonight? CineDuel puts two movies — or two TV shows — side by side and shows you, row by row, which one comes out ahead. Watch the official trailers, compare the facts and pick the winner in seconds.

DUEL ANY TWO TITLES
• Start a duel right from Home: pick Side A and Side B, then tap Start duel
• Compare user score and votes, release year, runtime or seasons and episodes, genres, shared cast and status
• The stronger side of every row is highlighted, with an overall pick at the top
• Swap sides with one tap; movies duel movies, shows duel shows
• Share the result as an image

WATCH TRAILERS FIRST
• Official trailers and teasers play right in the app, full screen
• Simple controls: play and pause, skip 10 seconds, scrub and mute

DISCOVER WHAT'S ON
• Trending, now playing, on the air and upcoming movies and TV shows
• Search any movie or series by name
• Title pages with overview, score, genres, top cast and every trailer

YOUR DUELS, SAVED
• Your last 20 comparisons are kept on your device
• No account and no sign-in
• Light and dark appearance

BUILT FOR IPAD
• Wide two-column layouts and side-by-side trailers on the big screen

Movie and TV data is provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

name: Çizdizi: Short Drama Series
description:
Çizdizi brings you short drama series made for your phone's vertical screen, released episode by episode. Most episodes run a minute or two, so you can watch one on the bus, in a queue or before bed, and pick up right where you left off.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Short episodes: a minute or two each, with a hook at the end of every one.
• Swipe for the next episode: swipe up to move on; when an episode ends, the next one starts by itself.
• Continue watching: your progress is saved on your phone and waits for you when you come back.
• My List: save the series you like with one tap.
• Popular now: the most watched series and this week's top episodes.
• New episodes: fresh episodes show up first on Home.
• Share: send a favorite episode to a friend with a link.

SERIES
• Kan Grubu (Blood Type), drama and mystery: before her daughter's surgery, Zeynep reads three lines on a lab sheet: mother O, father O, daughter AB.
• Yılanların Gelini (The Snakes' Bride), fantasy drama: on her wedding night, nurse Yelda is locked in a well in her husband's mansion. Hundreds of snakes wait in the dark, and none of them bite.
• Yanlış Beşik (The Wrong Cradle), family drama: a seamstress learns that the daughter she raised for seven years was switched at birth.
• Kovulan Gelin (The Banished Bride), revenge drama: thrown out with her forty-day-old baby, Derya returns five years later as the secret owner of the same mansion.
• 7 Numara (Number 7), drama: the building's group chat humiliates Elif every day, but nobody knows she owns seven of its twelve flats.
More series are on the way.

FREE, NO ACCOUNT
Every released episode is free. You do not need an account; your list and progress stay on this phone.

LANGUAGE
The series are in Turkish with Turkish subtitles. The app itself is available in English and Turkish, and more subtitle languages are coming.

All series are original fiction; characters and events are imaginary.

Questions, feedback or copyright matters: iletisim@cizdizi.com

name: Clash Esports
description:
Clash Esports is the member app for the Clash Esports gaming lounge. Sign in with your lounge account and manage your visit from your phone.

- See which PCs are free on a live map of every hall and room
- Open your PC from your phone when you sit down
- Follow your remaining time during a session
- Check your balance, hours and points
- Buy time and top up your balance
- See this month's top players
- Get offers and news from the lounge
- Ask for a game to be installed, and vote for other requests
- Send a help request or a complaint to the staff

The app works in English and Arabic. You need a Clash Esports member account; you can create one in the app or at the lounge. New accounts open after our team checks your national ID.

name: Clear Desk
description:
Clear Desk is an agent app for osTicket. It is for people who answer support tickets and sometimes need to do it away from a desk.

You sign in with the agent login you already have. Nothing is installed on your helpdesk and nothing on it is changed. The app works with the agent panel the same way your browser does.

Reading is free. Replying and the other actions need a subscription, described below. Try the free plan first to check it works with your helpdesk.

WHAT IT DOES

Queues. All of them, with their counts. Sort by the orders your helpdesk offers, and search by ticket number, email address or keyword.

Tickets. The whole thread: what the customer wrote, what your team replied, and the internal notes. Pictures in a message are shown where they sit.

Attachments. Tap a file to open it, then save or share it. PDFs, pictures and other common types.

Reply and note. Answer the customer, or leave a note that only your colleagues see.

Resolve. When you close a ticket you choose whether the customer is emailed. The screen states which, and you confirm it, so you don't send an email you didn't mean to or forget one you did.

Assign. To an agent or a team. Close, resolve and reopen.

Dashboard. Tickets created and closed each day, and totals by department, help topic and agent, over a week, two weeks, a month or a quarter.

Widgets. Open, overdue and assigned counts, and your most recent tickets, on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.

Offline. Tickets you have opened, and the first few in each list, can be read without a connection.

Sign-in. Password, with osTicket's emailed verification code if your helpdesk uses it. The app locks with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.

WHAT YOU NEED

A self-hosted osTicket, version 1.17 or later, that you can reach over https. An agent account on it.

TESTED VERSIONS

Before each update, every feature is run against real installs of osTicket 1.17, 1.17.2 to 1.17.8, and 1.18 to 1.18.4. Other versions may work but are not tested.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

There are no instant notifications. Widgets show the figures from the last time the app was open, and say when that was.

Offline is for reading only. To reply, resolve, assign, search or see the dashboard you need a connection. Pictures and attachments are not saved for offline reading.

It does not create tickets, send attachments, or use canned responses. Messages appear as plain text with their pictures; bold, tables and other formatting are not kept. It has no tasks, no merging, no saved or advanced searches, and it cannot edit ticket fields.

It does not support single sign-on (OAuth or SAML) or authenticator-app codes. If your helpdesk uses emailed codes, it will ask for a new one each time its session runs out.

It does not work with the hosted osTicket service, only with installs you host yourself.

Because the app works through the agent panel, an osTicket upgrade can change something it relies on. If that happens, a feature may stop working until the app is updated.

The dashboard appears only if your agent account is allowed to see it in osTicket.

PRICE

Free: sign in, browse queues, read tickets and open their files, search, and see the dashboard.

Clear Desk Full: reply, add notes, resolve, assign, widgets and offline reading. It is a subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is taken through your Apple Account and renews until you cancel, which you can do in Settings up to 24 hours before the period ends.

YOUR DATA

Your password is kept in the Keychain on your device. Ticket content travels between your device and your helpdesk and nowhere else. The app has no analytics and no third-party services.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://bartraigures.github.io/ClearDesk-app/privacy.html

Clear Desk is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Enhancesoft or the osTicket project. osTicket is a trademark of Enhancesoft LLC.

name: Clivr
description:
Next stop. Pick a place, keep a memory.
Too many saved places, no idea where to go? Clivr helps curious locals, couples, and friends turn “someday” into a day out.
Save cafés, parks, and scenic spots on your map. Choose a destination or filter your favorites and spin the wheel to decide.
After each visit, capture photos, videos, notes, moods, and companions’ messages. Every return gets its own entry, so you can remember who came along, what you tried, and what made that day different. Add forgotten details later.
Revisit memories by place or companion. Bring scattered moments together in themed memory books, then share them with the people who were there.
Spend less time choosing. Keep more of what matters.

name: Cloche,
description:
Cloche is a finished focus timer. A person keeps projects and tasks, places one or more timed boxes on today, and runs a single box at a time. A box is 5, 10, 15, or 25 minutes. The clock reaching zero does not complete the box. The user must return and tick it. Only that confirmed tick is stored as completed time. Partial time from Pause or Stop Here is not kept.

The first launch plays a short animation, then asks the reviewer to read Privacy and Terms and check an agreement before entering. 

Projects, Today, and Recap are empty until the reviewer adds work. That emptiness is the real first-run state, not a missing download or a placeholder. Cloche does not ship sample projects, sample photos, or sample history.

The interface has four areas. Projects holds long-term projects and their tasks, including covers, archive, restore, and delete. Today is the plan for the current day. Recap is the journal of confirmed ticks, optional notes and photos, search, ordering, and a twelve-week summary of minutes that come from real ticks. Settings contains tick sound, haptics, the default box length, How Cloche Works, Buy Bells, Privacy, and Terms.

Bells are a consumable in-app balance used only for Hold Streak. The first time the balance is prepared, Cloche places 69 Bells. Hold Streak spends 10 Bells on an eligible day that has no tick. It continues a streak and does not add completed minutes or a completed box. Buying a pack adds Bells through Apple’s purchase sheet. The purchase itself does not hold the day. Box finishes unlock from real ticks, not from Bells: the default finish is available at once, another finish after 3 ticks, and a third after 12 ticks.

name: Cloister Cast
description:
Cloister Cast is a quiet screenplay editor for iPhone, iPad and Mac. You write in Fountain, the plain text screenplay format, and Cloister Cast shows the formatted page and exports a standard US Letter, Courier 12 point PDF or a Final Draft (.fdx) file. Your scripts are ordinary text files in your own iCloud Drive, so they open in any text editor.

WRITE
Type scene headings, action, character names and dialogue in plain text; Fountain turns them into a screenplay. No templates to learn, no proprietary file. Keep notes beside your pages as markdown files in the same library.

TAGS AND MEMOS
Tag scripts the way you tag files in Finder, and filter your library by tag. Give any file a memo: a private note kept with that file that never appears in the script or the PDF.

DICTATION
Dictate into the script at the cursor. Speech recognition runs on your device only; your audio never leaves it and is never saved.

READ ALOUD
Hear your script read back with a voice for each character and a narrator for the action, using the voices built into your device. Nothing is sent anywhere.

OPTIONAL AI, OFF BY DEFAULT
Cloister Cast is an editor, not a ghostwriter, and everything above works without AI. If you want it, turn on Use AI in Settings and add your own key for Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you choose. Ask then answers a question about the passage you highlight, and you decide whether to replace, insert, or save the answer as a note. AI voices can read your cast in OpenAI, Grok or endpoint voices. The app sends only the question and the passage you highlight, or the line being spoken, directly to the service you chose, on your own key. We never receive it. Your keys stay in this device's Keychain.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No analytics. No telemetry. No ads. No servers of ours. We do not receive your scripts.

PRICE
Free to download with a 7-day trial of the whole app. Then one purchase, once, unlocks it on your devices. No subscription. If you do not buy, your scripts stay yours and readable: open them, read them, and export them any time.

WE ANSWER
Questions or problems: contact@sevenswordsproductions.com
Privacy policy: https://sevenswordsproductions.com/cloister-cast/privacy.html

name: CloserCrew
description:
CloserCrew City is where remote closers are made.

Walk the city, meet Kit, and save your free seat at the next live masterclass with Shane and Yarden. Learn how high-ticket closers get paid and how the crew gets you placed on a remote sales team.

Crew members unlock the whole city:
- The Vault: every lesson, the stage quizzes and the closer exam
- The Gym: live practice calls with AI prospects, and a scorecard after every call
- The Rooftop Lounge: the crew's own chat, General for everyday talk and Wins for closes
- HQ Tower: your progress and your next live call
- The Career Office: your closer resume and the offers board

Anyone can create a free account to explore the city, register for the masterclass and apply to join the crew.

name: Cloud Maidens
description:
Cloud Maidens is a cozy puzzle game in the sky. Pick a cloud maiden, and hop from cloud to cloud to get to the other side.

Three cotton-candy clouds float toward you at a time. Only one will hold you. The other two puff apart and you fall. Every level has a secret: the clouds that hold you all belong together. Fruits. Things with a wick. Animals with feathers. Words that sound like a letter. Work out what the right clouds have in common, ten hops in a row, and you made it.

What is inside:

• 165 levels on eleven pages of sky, from fruits and fables to music, maps and words.
• Twelve cloud maidens to play as, each on her own kind of cloud.
• Nineteen real skies: sunrise, northern lights, the Milky Way, a solar eclipse, a double rainbow and more, each with its own things floating by.
• Mystery clouds between hops. Open one and it could be a powerup, a trick or a growing plant. You won't know until you touch it.
• Hearts, shields, slow motion and more to save for when you need them.
• Two baddies to watch for: Rotten Candy, who drifts across the sky, and Thunder Idol Lei Gong, who makes you hop your way back.
• A hint button when you want the level's topic, and automatic play when you just want to keep going.
• Fastest times, levels finished and fewest falls, kept on your phone.

There are no lives to run out of. A fall starts the level again, and you can try as often as you like.

Buy it once and it is all yours. No ads, no sign-in and nothing more to buy. Cloud Maidens works without the internet and does not collect anything about you; your progress and times stay on your phone.

name: Coffee Cupping Panel
description:
Coffee Cupping Panel lays out blind triangle cups for a roast batch, then scores the cups against a saved standard.

Open Harbor Blend. The table shows three-digit codes. Ana taps the odd cup on B-2204. Drag Acidity on the radar and the total moves. The stamp is Recup when the mean sits 0.75 above the standard, and Hold when the triangle calls the batch different.

The panel list shows who scores high or low. Record decision keeps the stamp you accepted. Share report writes a one-page PDF through the system share sheet.

Sessions, coffees, and scores stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. The stamp checks the rules you entered. It does not replace a Q Grader or the roastery protocol.

name: Color Play - Puzzle Box
description:
Color Play is a set of color puzzles made for kids 7 to 10. Find, sort and match colors while thinking a few moves ahead.

8 games • Ant Picnic: send boxes, and ants carry off food of their color, bite by bite. • Unscrew It: unscrew toys apart. Screws go to boxes of their color. • Color Bottles: pour water so each color gets its own bottle. • Parking Escape: tap cars with a clear way out to empty the lot. • Train Tracks: turn track pieces to link same-color stations. • Block Slide: slide blocks out through exits of their color. • Hexa Stack: place tile stacks to group colors together. • Fruit Merge: matching fruits merge into bigger ones.

Why parents like it • 300 levels per game that start easy and grow slowly • A hint button shows the next move when kids get stuck • No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up • Plays fully offline • Collects no personal data • Works on iPhone and iPad

name: Comet Rush: Dodge the Mines
description:
Slide your finger to steer a blazing comet through endless rows of mines. One touch and it's BOOM. How long can you last?

SIMPLE TO PLAY, HARD TO PUT DOWN
• Slide left and right to dodge. Push up to go faster for a bigger score.
• Skim past mines for NEAR MISSES and chain them into huge streaks.
• Hit boost pads for a burst of speed.
• The longer you survive, the wilder it gets: drifting rows, closing gates and blinking lasers.

ADVENTURE: 30 NEW LEVELS EVERY MONTH
Every month brings a fresh set of 30 levels with new twists: Fog, Turbo, Tiny Comet, Laser Grid, Boost Storm and more. Earn up to 3 stars per level, beat the boss levels and win the monthly trophy.

CLASSIC: BEAT YOUR BEST
Endless mode. A gold line shows exactly where your best run ended. Can you pass it?

COLLECT 18 COMETS
From glowing embers to black holes, flame wings and lightning. Every comet looks different in flight and gives you a bonus.

POWER UP
• Upgrades: Slim Comet, Long Boost, Daredevil, Coin Magnet and more
• Shields, mini comets and magnets to grab mid-run
• Daily rewards, quests and chests

COMPETE
Sign in with Apple, Google or your phone number to climb the global leaderboards.

One more go? Go on.

name: Comic Quire
description:
Comic Quire is a private planning desk for comic, manga, and motion-comic creators. Organize projects from first logline to finished episode — with covers front and center.
WORKS
Break a story into chapters, cast, and world notes. Track production status, page estimates, and completion as your breakdown grows.
PLANS
Set objectives, priorities, and milestones. Link plans to a work and keep delivery dates where you can see them.
BOARDS
Storyboard frame by frame: captions, dialogue, camera notes, shot types, and optional sketch photos.
VAULT
Save lighting refs, prop notes, color ideas, and tags. Attach photos when you need them — everything stays on this device.
BUILT FOR CREATORS
• Cover-first gallery layouts
• Local-only library (no accounts, no cloud sync)
• Sample library to explore the workflow
• Restore or erase your studio data anytime in Settings
Comic Quire is made for writers, storyboard artists, and indie teams who want a focused, offline place to plan pages and episodes — without clutter or social noise.

name: ConfectLane
description:
Confect Lane muuttaa makeisten pakkauslinjan rauhalliseksi logiikkapeliksi.

Kuljetushihnalla odottaa makeisia, ja työpöydällä täyttyy kaksi purkkia. Kumpikin purkki hyväksyy vain yhden värisiä makeisia ja sille määrätyn määrän. Makeisia ei voi pilkkoa, niiden väriä ei voi vaihtaa eikä uusia purkkeja voi lisätä. Lyhyen lajitteluhetken aikana voit vaihtaa vierekkäisten makeisten paikkoja, siirtää makeisen rajalliseen säilytyslaatikkoon ja lähettää jonon ensimmäisen makeisen, kun sopiva purkki pystyy ottamaan sen vastaan.

Kun purkki täyttyy täsmälleen oikeaan määrään, se sulkeutuu. Seuraava odottava purkki siirtyy paikalleen. Jos lähetät makeisen liian aikaisin tai jätät jäljelle väärän määrän tiukasti mitoitettuun purkkiin, linja pysähtyy, kunnes suunnittelet järjestyksen uudelleen. Jokainen makeinen pysyy näkyvissä, ja jokainen tilavuusmäärä noudattaa tarkkoja rajojaan.

Etene tasoissa, jotka opettavat vierekkäisten makeisten vaihtamista, säilytyslaatikon käyttöä, kolmansia värejä, erikokoisia makeisia ja kahden säilytyslaatikon käyttöön perustuvaa suunnittelua. Tutustu resepteihin, tallenna suosikkiratkaisusi ja pelaa onnistuneet tasot uudelleen, kun haluat tarkastella sujuvaa pakkausratkaisua.

Suunnittele etukäteen, pidä kuljetushihna liikkeessä ja täytä jokainen tilaus täydellisesti Confect Lanessa.

Alkuperäinen sovellus. Kirjautumista ei tarvita.

name: ContactSweep: Contact Cleaner
description:
Is your address book full of unknown numbers, duplicates and badly saved phone numbers? ContactSweep makes it spotless in seconds.

No ads. Ever. You will never see advertising in the app.

SMART CLEANUP
• Duplicate names: find and merge duplicates into one contact without losing phones, emails or addresses.
• Duplicate numbers: spot the same number saved in several contacts.
• Invalid numbers: too short, containing letters, or fake (0000000, 1234567…).
• No name: just a number and no idea who it is.
• No phone and empty contacts.

FAST, SAFE BULK DELETE
• Select hundreds of contacts and delete them in one tap.
• Two-finger swipe to select many at once.
• Swipe to delete a single contact.
• Made a mistake? Tap Undo. Every change saves an automatic backup.

FULL CONTACT MANAGEMENT
• Open any contact to call, message, edit or delete.
• Create new contacts.
• Search by name, number or email.
• Export your whole address book as a .vcf file.
• "Address book health" score.

100% PRIVATE
• No internet, no accounts, no ads, no tracking.
• Your contacts never leave your iPhone.
• Face ID lock.
• Encrypted backups that delete themselves after 30 days.

CONTACTSWEEP PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Free download: see the full analysis of your contacts and open or edit any contact. To delete and merge, subscribe to ContactSweep Pro: 7 days free, then $9.99 per year.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or when the free trial ends).
• The subscription renews automatically every year unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel it in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://flashbinah.com/contactsweep-privacy.html

name: ContentFlow365
description:
ContentFlow365 es la app de tu equipo de marketing con IA. Lleva en el bolsillo todo lo que tu empresa crea en ContentFlow365.

AGENTE IA
• Pídele ideas, guiones y cambios escribiendo o con una nota de voz.
• Sigue en directo cómo prepara cada pieza.

BIBLIOTECA
• Todos tus vídeos, reels, carruseles y carteles en un solo sitio.
• Revísalos, descárgalos y compártelos desde el móvil.

CALENDARIO Y PUBLICACIONES
• Consulta qué se publica y cuándo en cada red.

BANDEJA
• Responde a los mensajes de tus clientes desde la app.

AVISOS
• Te avisamos cuando una pieza está lista o necesita tu aprobación.

FORMACIÓN Y COMUNIDAD
• Academia, directos y comunidad de ContentFlow365.

Necesitas una cuenta de ContentFlow365 para entrar.

name: Court Footage
description:
Court Footage turns your iPhone into an instant replay camera for pickleball, tennis, padel, and other court sports.

Mount your iPhone courtside in portrait or landscape and open the app. Court Footage keeps the most recent footage as you play. After a point worth keeping, tap the camera preview to save the preceding clip to Photos. You can watch the replay in Court Footage while the camera keeps recording.

• Choose a clip length from 5 to 60 seconds. Skip up to 10 seconds just before your tap to leave out the walk back to the phone.
• Use the front or rear camera. Pinch to zoom or tap a zoom preset to frame the court.
• Choose 720p, 1080p, or 4K where supported by your camera. Turn court audio on or off.

Court Footage works offline. The app processes footage on your iPhone, uploads no information, and does not track you. Saved clips follow your Photos and iCloud settings. Court Footage is open source under the MIT License.

name: Cozylings: Logic Puzzle
seller_name: TECH SOLUTIONS CONSULTORIA EM TI LTDA
description:
Cozylings is a calm, colorful logic puzzle game to play at your own pace.

HOW TO PLAY
Each board is split into colored areas. Place one critter in every row, every column and every area. Just one catch: two critters can never touch, not even diagonally. Every level has a single solution and can be solved with pure reasoning, no guessing.

WHAT YOU GET
• Hundreds of levels, from small 5×5 boards up to 10×10 challenges
• Daily challenge: the same board for everyone, with its own leaderboard
• Online leaderboards with fun, automatically generated nicknames
• Hints that explain the reasoning, so you learn as you play
• Undo, automatic marking of blocked cells and a color-blind friendly mode
• 8 themes to choose from: Little Farm, Sweet Shop, Dinos, Deep Sea, Pop Stage, Magic School, Space and Capybaras
• Play offline: the leaderboard syncs when you are back online
• Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Italian

FREE TO PLAY
Cozylings is free and shows ads. Videos are optional: you choose to watch one to get an extra hint, the daily gift or to unlock a theme.

YOUR PRIVACY
No sign-up needed. We only keep a random device code, your nickname, your avatar and your level results so the leaderboards work. You can delete your data from inside the game.

Privacy policy: https://cozylings.techsolutionsce.com.br/en/privacy
Contact us: contato@techsolutionsce.com.br

name: Crafted Home: AI Room Design
description:
Crafted Home turns a photo of your room into three design concepts for that same room, in about a minute.

Take a photo, tell it how you use the room, swipe through styles, pick a palette and choose how much should change. Crafted Home keeps your walls, windows and doors where they are and redesigns what you can move: furniture, rugs, lighting, color and decor.

EACH DESIGN COMES WITH
• A before and after view you can slide between
• A mood board and color palette
• A list of the specific changes to make
• A match score against the styles you chose

YOUR ROOM, NOT A STOCK PHOTO
Crafted Home edits your actual photo, so every design shows your room. Tell it what to keep, like a favorite sofa or dining table, and it designs around it.

15 STYLES
Modern Minimal, Japandi, Mid-Century, Coastal, Scandinavian, Warm Bohemian, Art Deco, Modern Farmhouse and more. Swipe through all 15 and the app learns what you like.

A REAL DESIGNER
Love a concept? Talk to Diane, the designer behind Crafted Home, about bringing it to life.

In English and Portuguese.

SUBSCRIPTION
Crafted Home Monthly includes 12 designs a month. New subscribers start with a free trial that includes 2 designs. Payment is charged to your Apple account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple account settings.

Terms of use: https://design.craftedhomespaces.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://design.craftedhomespaces.com/privacy

name: CRT8: Analog Camera
description:
Turn your iPhone sideways and shoot through an analog viewfinder. CRT8 brings the texture of old screens and videotape to photos and short videos, with controls you can adjust while watching the image.

CHOOSE YOUR LOOK
Start clean, or choose CRT, VHS, or Arcade. Adjust intensity, scanlines, color bleed, grain, glow, and screen curvature to make the look your own.

SHOOT AND KEEP GOING
Take a photo or record a video. Finished captures save automatically to Photos, and the last-capture thumbnail lets you review what you just made.

MADE FOR LANDSCAPE
A full-screen horizontal viewfinder keeps the image in front of you, with simple controls at the sides.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Effects are processed on your device. No account, ads, tracking, or subscription.

Capture details: 720p output, videos up to 60 seconds, and microphone audio when permission is granted. Camera and Photos add-only permissions are required for shooting and automatic saving. CRT8 is a camera for new captures; it does not import existing photos or videos.

name: Crumb Bowl
description:
Crumb Bowl is for the moment the flour is in the bowl and the scale is still on. You write the flour in grams, the hydration and the salt as percents of the flour, and the name of this bowl.

This iPhone multiplies the flour by those percents, rounds half up, and shows the water, the salt, and the weight of the dough. The bowl stays on this iPhone for you. Nothing is shared and no file is written.

There is no account, no network, no recipe library, and no sample dough. Grams and percents are used in every region. The water is arithmetic from the numbers you type. It is not nutrition advice. The record is removed with the app.

name: CT Call Desk
description:
CT Call Desk is the help desk app from Corporate Technology Partners, Inc. (CorporateTech) for IT service teams that run on Webex Calling and Autotask.

When a call comes in, Call Desk shows who is calling, their company and their open tickets, so your technicians can answer and open a ticket with the caller's details already filled in.

CALLS
- See incoming Webex calls with the caller's company and recent tickets
- Answer, hold and transfer, and move calls between your iPhone and your computer
- Call history and voicemail
- AI call notes from Webex call recordings, added to the ticket

TICKETS
- Your tickets and unassigned tickets in one list
- Open, update and close Autotask tickets without leaving the app
- Search tickets by number, company, contact or text

TIME AND SITE VISITS
- See your Autotask timesheet and add or fix time entries
- Optional: when you arrive at a client's site, start a site-visit ticket with the timer running

TEAM TOOLS
- IT Glue documentation for your clients, read-only (passwords stay in IT Glue)
- Computers from Datto RMM and site status from Cisco Meraki
- Microsoft Teams chat with your team
- Admins invite people from their own company

Works on iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your organization's Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace account. Your organization needs a Call Desk account; contact CorporateTech at help@corporatetech.com.

name: Cuenty
description:
Cuenty es la forma sencilla de llevar el presupuesto de casa, solo o en pareja.

El día de cobro repartes todo el dinero: facturas, gastos del día a día, ahorro y deudas. Después apuntas cada gasto en el momento, en dos toques, y Cuenty te dice siempre cuánto queda y si vas bien de ritmo.

LO QUE VES AL ABRIRLA
• Cuánto queda por gastar este mes.
• Cuánto puedes gastar hoy sin salirte del presupuesto.
• El próximo recibo y cuánto falta por pagar.
• Con cuánto cerrarás el mes al ritmo actual.

PRESUPUESTO MES A MES
• Ingresos, facturas y suscripciones, gastos del día a día, ahorros, inversiones y deudas.
• Copia el presupuesto del mes anterior y ajusta solo lo que cambia.
• Marca cada recibo como pagado con un toque.

RECIBOS Y CALENDARIO
• Calendario con el día de cada recibo.
• Gastos fijos programados: alquiler, luz, seguros o el IBI de cada año se apuntan solos cuando llega su fecha.
• Avisos opcionales el día que vence cada recibo.

ENTIENDE TU DINERO
• Gráficos de a dónde va el dinero y de presupuesto frente a gasto real.
• Tasa de ahorro, compromisos fijos y comparación con el reparto 50/30/20.
• Evolución de los últimos meses y resumen del año.
• Reparto equitativo: cuánto aporta cada uno según lo que ingresa.

TUYA Y PRIVADA
• Funciona sin cuenta y sin conexión: tus datos se guardan en tu dispositivo.
• Sin anuncios y sin seguimiento.
• Bloqueo con Face ID, Touch ID o código.
• Copia de seguridad en un archivo y exportación de movimientos a hoja de cálculo.

EN PAREJA, SI QUIERES
• Crea una cuenta opcional para compartir las mismas cuentas en varios dispositivos.
• Cifrado de extremo a extremo: tus datos se cifran en tu dispositivo con tu contraseña antes de subir. Nadie más puede leerlos, tampoco nosotros.
• Puedes eliminar tu cuenta y todos sus datos desde la app en cualquier momento.

Cuenty no se conecta a tu banco: los importes los apuntas tú, y por eso sabes siempre en qué se va cada euro.

name: Cult Girls
description:
Talia is thirty, newly single, and done asking permission. Run with her through eight levels, from a girls’ night downtown to the cliffs of Santorini, and make the choices that decide how her story ends.

Tap to jump. Grab candles, books, hearts and roses. Dodge gossip, ringing phones and a storm of certified letters. Between runs, Talia chooses how to answer her family, her friends and the group she grew up in.

• Eight levels, each with its own setting and hazards
• A branching story with four endings
• Cover and character art from the graphic novel Cult Girls by Natalie Grand, illustrated by Cassandre Bolan
• No ads, no purchases, no accounts, and it plays offline

Cult Girls: The Game is a work of fiction. The Lantern Assembly and its members are invented.

name: Cuvée Audio
description:
Cuvée Audio ist die moderne Fernbedienung für Netzwerk-Musikserver der cocktailAudio-X-Serie und N-Serie. Seit die Hersteller-App keine Updates mehr erhält, bringt Cuvée Audio die Steuerung deines Players zurück aufs iPhone und iPad – schneller, übersichtlicher und im Dunkelmodus.

JETZT LÄUFT
• Großes Cover, Titel, Format und Fortschritt in Echtzeit
• Play/Pause, Vor/Zurück, Spulen, Lautstärke, Zufall und Wiederholen
• Warteschlange ansehen, umsortieren und bearbeiten

DEINE MUSIKSAMMLUNG
• Alben, Künstler, Genres und Titel der Musikdatenbank des Players
• Schnelle Suche über die gesamte Sammlung
• Playlisten anlegen, bearbeiten und abspielen
• „Als Nächstes spielen“ und „Zur Warteschlange hinzufügen“ überall
• Ordner auf Festplatte, USB, NAS und UPnP-Servern durchsuchen

RADIO UND STREAMING
• Tausende Internetradio-Sender und Podcasts mit einem Tipp
• UKW und DAB+ mit Sendersuchlauf
• Streamingdienste, soweit dein Player sie anbietet
• Aufnahmen auf die Festplatte des Players, auch zeitgesteuert

CD UND EINGÄNGE
• Audio-CDs abspielen und rippen
• Digitale Eingänge (koaxial, optisch) umschalten

GERÄT
• Alle Einstellungen des Players übersichtlich in der App
• Gruppenwiedergabe mit mehreren Playern
• Player in Standby schalten oder ausschalten

Ohne Player ausprobieren: Der eingebaute Demo-Modus zeigt alle Funktionen mit Beispielmusik.

Cuvée Audio gibt es auf Deutsch, Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Spanisch, Koreanisch, Japanisch und Chinesisch.

Voraussetzungen: ein kompatibler cocktailAudio-Player (z. B. X14, X35, X45, X50, N25) im selben Netzwerk. Cuvée Audio ist eine unabhängige App und steht in keiner Verbindung zum Hersteller Novatron. Funktionen, die Online-Dienste des Herstellers benötigen, hängen von deren Verfügbarkeit ab.

name: CYPDUŞ
description:
CYPDUŞ, CYPDUŞ UĞURTAN IMPORT & EXPORT LTD çalışanları ve yetkili bayileri için iş uygulamasıdır.

Hesapları şirket açar; uygulama içinden herkese açık kayıt yoktur.

name: Dabba Grid
description:
Dabba Grid – Smart Spice Organizer
Organize Your Spices, Build Your Collection, and Bring Color to Your Kitchen!
Welcome to Dabba Grid, a colorful and interactive spice management app inspired by traditional South Asian masala boxes. Discover a fresh way to organize your spices, manage containers, create custom masala blends, and keep track of your kitchen essentials.
With its vibrant block-based interface, Dabba Grid transforms everyday spice organization into a visually engaging experience.
Key Features
Colorful Spice Blocks Explore your spice collection through a beautiful grid of colorful blocks. Organize turmeric, chili, cumin, coriander, cardamom, and other kitchen essentials in a unique visual layout.
Smart Spice Collection Create and manage individual spice containers. Add names, categories, quantities, and personal notes. Easily update or remove entries whenever needed.
Custom Masala Blends Organize your favorite spice combinations and homemade masala recipes. Record ingredients, proportions, and preparation details in one convenient place.
Dish & Spice Pairings Keep track of which spices work best with your favorite dishes. Create personalized combinations and organize your cooking ideas.
Freshness Tracking Record storage information and best-before dates to help manage your spice collection and maintain an organized kitchen.
Refill Management Track spices that need restocking, create refill entries, and manage your kitchen shopping requirements.
Interactive Overview View your collection through an attractive dashboard featuring colorful blocks, useful statistics, and quick access to important sections.
Personalized Kitchen Organization Add, edit, save, and delete your own entries with a simple interface. Your information is stored locally on your device.
Why Choose Dabba Grid?
Dabba Grid combines traditional masala box inspiration with modern block-style design. Whether you enjoy Pakistani, Indian, or other flavorful cuisines, the app offers a creative and practical way to organize your spices and kitchen essentials.
Build your collection, manage your blends, and enjoy a more colorful kitchen experience.
Download Dabba Grid and give every spice its own special place!

name: Dailies Studio
description:
Dailies Studio turns your video calls into captioned vertical shorts, published on your networks. This app is your client space on your phone: everything our team prepares for you, at hand.

APPROVE YOUR SHORTS
Each short arrives ready to go. Watch it full screen, then approve it, ask for a retouch in a sentence, or set it aside. An approved short is scheduled on your networks, at your pace.

FOLLOW YOUR SCHEDULE
The week day by day: what goes out, when and on which network. Move a post or take it off the schedule.

SEE WHAT WORKS
Your posts' views, network by network and day after day, over the week, the month, the quarter or the year.

FILM WITH YOUR PHONE
Scan the QR code of the Dailies Studio Chrome extension: set behind your screen, your phone films your calls far better than a webcam.

Your networks: YouTube Shorts, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads.

The app is for Dailies Studio clients: sign in with your account's address.

name: Daily Date: Selfie Dating
description:
Daily Date is dating for people who actually show up.

Every day starts with one fresh, in-app selfie. Take it, and swiping unlocks for the day. Skip it, and you sit the day out. That means every profile you see belongs to someone who checked in today, not a ghost account from last year.

HOW IT WORKS
• Snap your daily selfie with the in-app camera. No uploads from your camera roll.
• Swipe through people who checked in today.
• Match, say hello, and keep it going in chat.
• Check-ins reset every day, so tomorrow is a fresh start.

SAFETY FIRST
• Adults 18+ only.
• Report or block anyone from their profile, your matches, or any chat. Blocking takes effect immediately.
• Every report is reviewed within 24 hours.
• Delete your account anytime from Settings.

DAILY DATE PREMIUM
Free members get 10 swipes a day and unlimited matches. Premium adds:
• Unlimited swipes
• See who liked you
• Advanced age and location filters
• Rewind your last swipe
• Priority visibility in Discover

Premium is $9.99 per month, an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms, Privacy & Community Guidelines: https://daily-sparkle-meet.lovable.app/guidelines

name: Daily Sum
description:
Three math problems a day, and a private league with your friends. Your best five days of the week count.

Every day Daily Sum deals you a warm-up and three ranked problems at your level, across arithmetic, algebra, systems of equations, logarithms, geometry and powers. Solve them on your own for 20, 40 and 70 pts. Everyone has the same 130 pts of daily potential and there’s no speed bonus, so the league rewards showing up, not rushing.

• Problems at your level. A short level check sets where each topic starts, and each topic grows as you solve. There’s no top.
• Real math input. A keyboard built for fractions, powers, roots, logs and π, with exact answers.
• Learn when you miss. A wrong answer or a hint turns the problem into practice, with a hint and a worked solution.
• A league with your people. Create a group, share the invite, and follow the week’s standings in pts.
• A widget and a daily reminder help keep your streak.

DAILY SUM PLUS
Free accounts include one group of up to 3 people. Daily Sum Plus lets you be in up to 5 groups and makes room for up to 20 people in the groups you own. Plus never changes ranked play or pts.

Daily Sum Plus is $2.99 a month or $19.99 a year. The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it’s cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
