Privacy Policy: https://be.daily-sum.readyyyk.com/privacy

name: Daktilo: Typewriter Words
description:
You're sitting at an old typewriter. The paper slides along on its own, and you have to hit the right letter the moment the empty box reaches the red mark. Too early doesn't count; too late and the box slips away.

Knowing the word isn't enough, you have to nail the timing too. When a word is done, the bell rings, the carriage returns, and your lines keep piling up on the page.

As you go on, the paper speeds up, more keys appear, and after a while they start swapping places. Lose focus for a second and the page is ruined.

In Classic, the word is right in front of you and it's all about timing. In Secret Word you only get a clue. Word of the Day is one word a day, the same for everyone.

name: Dao & Thara Thaï Spa
description:
L'appli officielle de Dao Thaï Spa (Chatou) et Thara Thaï Spa (Saint-Germain-en-Laye).

Réservez votre massage en quelques secondes, sans appeler :
• Choisissez votre soin : massage thaï, à l'huile chaude, pierres chaudes, pieds, tête, femme enceinte, gommage…
• Choisissez votre praticienne, ou la première disponible.
• Voyez les créneaux libres en temps réel et réservez seul(e) ou en duo.

Gérez vos rendez-vous :
• Retrouvez tous vos rendez-vous à venir et votre historique.
• Recevez un rappel la veille et 2 heures avant.
• Ajoutez votre rendez-vous à votre calendrier.
• Annulez en un geste jusqu'à 24 h avant.

Votre forfait toujours avec vous :
• Ajoutez votre carte forfait avec son code et suivez les séances restantes.

Infos pratiques : adresse, itinéraire, horaires et appel du salon en un geste.

Pas de mot de passe à retenir, pas de publicité, aucune revente de vos données.

name: Dartbound
description:
Can't decide where to go? Let a dart decide.

Dartbound turns a map into a dartboard. Pick a range — the whole world, a country, a state, a city, or a radius around you — and the map goes up on the wall across the room. Flick to throw. Between the wind and a shaky hand, it rarely lands where you aim. Wherever it sticks, that's where you're going.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a range: anywhere on Earth, or within any distance of where you are
• Throw: a real flick with wind and scatter, not just tapping a button
• Get your ticket: a keepsake destination ticket, valid for life, non-refundable

ON THE ROAD
• Local weather, nearby spots and local trivia for your destination
• The nearest station or stop, so remote landings are still reachable
• Three travel missions for every trip
• GPS-verified arrival stamps when you get there
• A ticket book that keeps every trip you've taken

EXPLORER PASS (one-time in-app purchase)
• Tour tickets: throw 2–5 darts and link them into one journey
• Scratch map: color in every country you reach, plus US states or Japanese prefectures
• Gear: satellite and antique maps; gold, lacquer and bamboo darts

Throwing darts is always free, with no limit.

Travel safely. If a dart lands somewhere private or unsafe, don't go in. Getting close, or reaching the nearest station, counts as arriving.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://shosukesato.github.io/dartbound/privacy/

name: Dasees: Odd One Out Party
description:
Everyone knows the secret word… except one!

Dasees (Arabic for “the sneaky one”) is a pass-and-play party game for 3 to 8 players free (up to 12 with Majlis Pass) on a single phone. One player is the odd one and has no idea what the word is. Can your group spot them — or will they bluff their way out?

HOW IT PLAYS
• Pass the phone. Each player presses and holds their card to see the word in secret.
• The odd one only sees the category, and has to blend in.
• Everyone gives one hint word (said aloud or typed) for one, two or three rounds.
• Debate, then vote in secret on who you think the odd one is.
• Caught? The odd one gets a last chance to guess the word and steal the win!

NEAR-WORD MODE
Instead of seeing only the category, the odd one receives a look-alike word (for example kabsa vs mandi) and may not even know they are the odd one. The cards look identical, so nobody can tell.

WHAT YOU GET
• Eight free Arabic word packs (320 words): majlis & hospitality, cities & landmarks, dishes & feasts, desert & nature, sports & games, sweets & drinks, around the house, travel & trips.
• Full right-to-left Arabic interface with an English switch.
• A “majlis night” look: geometric patterns, lanterns and stars, with Dallool, a cheerful coffee-pot mascot.
• A discussion timer and a scoreboard after every round.
• Soft sound effects and haptics; music is off by default.
• Two modes: Classic and Near word.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL EXTRAS
• The core game is free and ad-free: 8 packs, up to 8 players, both modes.
• Optional one-time purchases, no subscription and no renewal: “Majlis Pass” unlocks all 14 packs, up to 12 players and your own custom words; a Ramadan Pack and an Eid Pack add 40 words each. You can restore your purchases at any time.

YOUR PRIVACY
• Works fully offline, anywhere.
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no data collected.

Great for friends, family and holiday evenings. Gather your crowd and find the odd one.

Support and word suggestions: hi@jigsawlab.com

name: Data Doppel
description:
Companies keep a detailed record of what you search, watch and browse. You can ask for a copy, and Data Doppel turns it into a portrait of you: one bold fact per card.

YOUR QUEST
• Tap Get my data and follow the steps to request your Google Takeout export.
• When it arrives, pick the zip (or the unzipped folder) in Files.
• Tap Doppel me and meet your data double.

WHAT YOU'LL SEE
• Your obsessions: what you search for most
• Your daily rhythm: night owl or early bird?
• Rabbit holes: your longest video binges
• Then vs now: how you've changed
• What you're into, and the ads they showed you
• They knew where you were: how often your location was attached
• Your spirit animal and a share-ready summary
• Your move: set a goal, rediscover old loves and take back control, and your Doppel earns rewards as you go

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is read on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Nothing about you is saved: Delete everything wipes it instantly.
• Your files are read where they are, never copied into the app.

Just curious? Try the demo with made-up data, no download needed.

name: Date Print Camera
description:
Date Print Camera stamps the date on your photos in glowing orange digits, just like a 1980s film camera.

There are no filters that change color or quality. Your iPhone's camera quality stays as it is; only the date is added.

DATE AND TIME
• Thin digital digits with a soft glow, inspired by classic date backs
• 4 date formats, 12 or 24-hour clock
• Orange, red, yellow, or white; three sizes; bottom right or left
• Optional thin black or white outline, so the date stays readable on any background

PLACE
• An approximate place name such as "Wellington, NZ" under the date
• Country, city, or district; English or Japanese
• Or type your own place name

WATERMARK STAMPS
• 12 stamps including CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT and APPROVED
• Your own text or a transparent PNG logo
• Adjust opacity, size, angle, and position (drag anywhere)

AUTO POSITION
• Moves the date to the other corner when it would cover a face or text (analyzed on your iPhone only)

QUALITY
• Compact, Standard, High, or Maximum (48 MP on supported models)

PRIVACY
• No accounts, ads, or tracking
• Photos and location are never sent to the developer

FREE AND PRO
• Save up to 3 photos with date, place, or watermark every day for free
• Pro, a one-time purchase, removes the limit. No subscription.

name: DaysLeft: Supply Countdown
description:
One number: how many days your household is covered.

Most preparedness apps give you a checklist. DaysLeft gives you an answer. Tell it how many people live in your home, log supplies when you buy them, and it shows how long you'd last — and which item runs out first.

• SEE YOUR DAYS. One big number, limited by whatever runs out first.
• LOG IN ONE TAP. Bought a 40-pack of water? Tap +40. Done.
• KNOW WHAT TO BUY. Pick a goal of 10, 20 or 30 days and see exactly what's missing.
• STAYS HONEST. Every number shows where it comes from: your own records, or a standard. Water is never counted below 1 gallon per person per day, the FEMA and Red Cross guideline.
• WORKS OFFLINE. No account. No sign-up. Your records stay on your device, and you can export them as CSV any time.
• IPHONE AND IPAD. On iPad, your days and your supplies sit side by side.

Free to track 5 supplies and all your gear. Unlock unlimited supplies and your own custom items with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

DaysLeft is a planning aid, not a guarantee.

name: DEEP VOICE: Voice Training
description:
A 30, 60 or 90-day challenge for a fuller, calmer, more resonant voice. Each day: a short guided warm-up, one small voice mission and an honest note to yourself.

An honest promise: how high or low your voice sits depends mostly on your anatomy, so no app can promise a lower pitch. What daily practice can build is better breath support, more resonance, a slower pace and a steadier sound. That's what every day works on.

HOW IT WORKS
• Warm up: a 2½-minute guided routine with an animated figure, a big timer and spoken cues.
• Do today's mission: one small, real-life task, like reading a paragraph slower than feels natural or sending a voice note instead of a text.
• Press and hold to complete, rate how hard it felt and write a short reflection if you like.

FREE, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
• 90 missions in three levels: The Foundation (Days 1–30), Go Deeper (31–60) and Own the Room (61–90), each ending with a two-day test
• Five voice areas: Breath, Resonance, Relaxation, Pace & Pauses and Projection
• 10 warm-ups built from 30 voice exercises, such as belly breathing, lip trills, straw phonation, humming, chest hum and descending sirens; several are adapted from documented voice-therapy exercises
• A baseline: record yourself reading the same short text on Day 1 and every 10th day (in your voice memos, or in the app with Pro)
• Streaks, a calendar, weekly reviews, achievements and a report at the end of your challenge
• A journal for your reflections
• Daily reminders, scheduled on your phone
• Six one-minute articles with their sources, and voice-safety notes

DEEP VOICE PRO
• A voice note every day: record 30 seconds, hear Day 1 next to today and see an estimate of your average pitch, measured on your phone
• Six ready-made plans: Podcast & Video Voice, Phone & Video-Call Voice, Presentation Voice, Calm Voice under Pressure, Morning Voice Routine and Deep & Resonant
• Build your own plan from the mission library and missions you write
• No ads (the free version shows a short note about Pro before a warm-up)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your progress, journal and recordings stay on your phone. Nothing is uploaded, pitch is measured on the device, and there is no ad tracking.

LOOK AFTER YOUR VOICE
Stay in your comfortable range, never press on your throat, and stop if anything hurts or feels hoarse. DEEP VOICE is practice, not medical treatment. If hoarseness lasts more than four weeks, see an ENT doctor or a speech-language therapist.

SUBSCRIPTION
DEEP VOICE Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: 1 year (29,99 €) or 1 month (9,99 €), or the price shown in the app for your country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://deepvoiceapp.io/privacy
Terms of Use: https://deepvoiceapp.io/terms

name: Denkpack
description:
Four brain games, one pack: Denkpack challenges mental arithmetic, planning ahead, spatial thinking and a feel for language – no timer, no ads, no distractions. Every puzzle can be solved, and points reward thinking, not fast tapping.

Made for kids and teens from about 10 years – and for everyone who loves a good puzzle.

THE FOUR GAMES
• Numbers Puzzle: six numbers, one target. Combine them with + − × ÷ until you hit the target. The shortest calculation earns the most points.
• Logic Puzzle: the glider slides across the ice until a rock or the edge stops it. Sand stops it at once. Find the way to the goal in as few moves as possible.
• Spatial Puzzle: rotate the pieces and place them on the board so that no gap remains.
• Word Puzzle: which words belong together? Find the groups with a common theme – and don't be fooled by words that fit two themes.

ONE PUZZLE A DAY FOR EVERYONE
• The daily puzzle of each game is the same for everybody – perfect for comparing with friends and family.
• Practice in three levels: easy, medium, hard. Puzzles are generated fresh every time and never run out.

THINKING PAYS OFF
• No clock, no time pressure. Full points go to the best way, shown as "Best".
• Only your first attempt at a puzzle counts for your points – "Again" is there for learning.
• After every round you can have the solution shown.
• Each game explains itself with a short introduction the first time you start it.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Five languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish. Please note: the words of the Word Puzzle are currently available in German only.
• Light and dark mode, a modern look, its own sounds (can be switched off).
• Fully offline. No ads, no account, no data collection – your points stay on your device.

TRY FIRST, BUY ONCE
In each of the four games, 5 puzzles are free. After that you unlock everything with a single purchase – no subscription, no extra purchases, Family Sharing included.

name: Dentasky
description:
Dentasky is the ultimate all-in-one digital dental ecosystem connecting dentists, clinic owners, dental laboratories, supply stores, distributors, instructors, space providers, and patients in one seamless platform.

Key Features of the Dentasky Ecosystem:

1. 7 Specialized Professional Roles:
• Dentists & Job Seekers: Build your clinical dossier, upload your CV and Clinical Portfolio, showcase your Portable Dental Kit (or list tools for sale in the Used Marketplace), and apply to dental positions including clinical roles as well as Dental Graphic Designer, Dental Motion Graphic Designer, and Dental Video Editor.
• Clinic & Medical Center Owners: Create a verified clinic profile showcasing your medical specialties and equipment, filter and hire top talent by position and location, receive direct B2B offers from labs and suppliers, and regulate patient appointments.
• Dental Laboratories: Showcase CAD/CAM digital prosthetics, zirconia, veneers, and orthodontic appliances, and collaborate directly with clinics.
• Dental Material Stores: List dental consumables, instruments, and materials, and send supply offers directly to clinics.
• Wholesale Distributors: Connect with dental stores and medical centers to supply authorized brands at wholesale rates.
• Clinic & Chair Space Providers: List equipped dental clinics and operatory chairs for rent by the hour, day, or month.
• Academic Instructors: Publish hands-on workshops, accredited dental courses, and clinical lectures.

2. Patient & Special Needs Care + Smart Appointment Regulation:
• General Dental Care & Special Needs Care pathways (automatically prioritizing equipped Special Needs Dental Units nearest to the patient's governorate and city first, followed by nearby dental clinics).
• Advanced Clinic Filtration by governorate, city, specialty, facilities, Special Needs Unit availability, and online booking support.
• End-to-End Reservation & Appointment Regulation System for patients and clinic owners.

3. Dental Equipment Marketplace & Community:
• Buy and sell new and used dental equipment, share clinical cases in the Dental Community, and communicate via dedicated Patient and Professional Network messaging channels.

name: Derma Viva
description:
Derma Viva – Skin Wellness & Hair Removal Tracker
Your skin deserves thoughtful care, and every treatment deserves a better way to track progress.
Welcome to Derma Viva, a personal skin wellness companion designed to help you organize your waxing and laser hair removal journey. From treatment sessions to daily skin comfort, Derma Viva brings your records, observations, and aftercare activities together in one beautifully designed experience.
With an elegant health-inspired dashboard, interactive progress indicators, and easy-to-use tracking tools, Derma Viva makes it simple to understand your personal skin care journey.
KEY FEATURES
Personal Skin Wellness Dashboard
View your latest skin comfort ratings, treatment activity, and personal wellness observations through a modern dashboard featuring visual indicators, progress rings, and informative summaries.
Laser & Waxing Treatment Tracker
Keep a detailed record of your hair removal sessions. Organize treatment dates, methods, body areas, clinic information, and personal notes. Easily create, update, and manage your treatment history.
Daily Skin Check-Ins
Record how your skin feels after treatments. Track self-reported comfort, redness, sensitivity, dryness, and other observations using simple rating tools and structured entries.
Skin Wellness Insights
Explore your recorded information through visual charts, symptom indicators, and progress summaries. Review changes in your personal observations over time.
Aftercare & Recovery Journal
Organize your post-treatment care activities with practical checklists, progress indicators, and personal recovery notes. Keep track of completed activities and maintain your preferred care routine.
Hair Regrowth Monitoring
Document your hair regrowth observations between treatments. Record visible changes in hair density, smoothness, and regrowth patterns to maintain a clear personal history.
Beautiful & Intuitive Experience
Enjoy an elegant interface with colourful wellness cards, interactive monitoring visuals, smooth navigation, and thoughtfully organized information.
YOUR PERSONAL SKIN JOURNEY
Whether you receive professional laser hair removal treatments, prefer regular waxing sessions, or simply want to maintain a personal skin wellness journal, Derma Viva helps you stay organized and informed.
All wellness ratings and observations are entered by you. Derma Viva is a personal tracking and journaling application, not a medical diagnostic or measurement device.
Take a more organized approach to skin wellness.
Download Derma Viva and make every step of your hair removal journey easier to track.

name: Deskmate: Focus & Study Timer
description:
Someone's across the desk.

Deskmate is a focus timer with a companion who works alongside you. Start a block and Juniper the library cat opens a book across the desk. Halfway through she's deep in it. Near the end she speeds up. When the timer ends, you both finished something.

WORK TOGETHER, NOT ALONE
Body doubling is the simple trick of working next to someone else. Deskmate gives you that quiet company any time: a hand-drawn companion who focuses, takes breaks and celebrates with you, in six moods.

NO PENALTY, EVER
Need to stop? Set the block aside. The time you focused still counts, and the rest waits on your Later shelf so you can pick it up exactly where you left off. Nothing withers, nothing dies, nobody scolds you.

POMODORO OR FLOW
Pick 15, 25, 45, 50, 60 or 90 minutes, or switch to Flow and count up for as long as it lasts. Short and long breaks start on their own if you like, with a gentle chime.

MADE TOGETHER
Every finished block adds something to your shelf: books Juniper bound, lattes Pip poured, plants Moss potted, gadgets Otto built. Watch the collection grow.

SEE YOUR FOCUS
Today's goal ring, streaks, a week chart, a 20-week heatmap, time by tag and your best hours of the day. Edit any session, export everything as CSV.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
A Live Activity and Dynamic Island show your companion and the timer, with pause and stop right there. Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen widgets, a Control Center button and Siri Shortcuts ("Start a focus block in Deskmate").

AMBIENT SOUND
Rain on glass and brown noise are free. Plus adds station hum, café corner, greenhouse breeze and a fireplace.

FREE, FOR REAL
The timer, Flow mode, breaks, the Later shelf, stats, widgets, the Live Activity and the Library scene with Juniper are free. Deskmate Plus adds three more scenes (Otto's space station, Pip's café, Moss's greenhouse) and every sound: yearly with a 1-week free trial, or once for life. No ads, no account.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Devocional PIBI
description:
O Devocional PIBI traz todos os dias uma reflexão a partir das pregações da Primeira Igreja Batista em Indaiatuba.

Cada devocional tem:
• Um áudio curto, para ouvir em poucos minutos, mesmo com o celular bloqueado
• O texto resumido e o texto completo, com as referências bíblicas
• O link para a pregação completa no YouTube e nas plataformas de áudio

Feito para ser simples:
• Letra grande e ajustável
• Lembrete diário no horário que você escolher
• Os últimos 7 dias sempre à mão

Você também pode:
• Curtir e comentar (comentários públicos passam por moderação)
• Guardar anotações privadas sobre o que aprendeu
• Enviar um pedido de oração, lido apenas pela equipe pastoral

Não precisa de cadastro para ler, ouvir, curtir ou pedir oração. O login é opcional, sem senha, por um código enviado por e-mail ou WhatsApp.

Primeira Igreja Batista em Indaiatuba
pibindaiatuba.com

name: DFW MTB Trail Hub
description:
Can I ride today? DFW MTB Trail Hub shows the status of 50 Dallas–Fort Worth mountain bike trails and 11 skills parks, from the trail stewards, the clubs (DORBA, FWMBA, WMBC) and the weather.

• Trail status at a glance: open, closed, or wet, with reopening estimates after rain
• Push alerts for your trails: Reopened, Hero Dirt, Closed or every change
• Offline trail maps: save a trail's map and route, and see where you are with no signal
• Trails nearest you, drive times and directions
• Location for 911 on every trail's Safety card
• Group rides and events, skills coaching, and local bike shops

Free, with no ads and no account. Always check with local trail stewards before riding.

name: Dipnet
description:
What's living in your pond? Sweep, tip, tap — and find out.

Dipnet is a pond-dipping logbook for families, teachers, wildlife gardeners and young naturalists. Take a net to a pond, tip your catch into a tray, and tap each creature you find. Dipnet keeps a record of every dip and gives each pond a simple health score based on the creatures living there.

DIP AND TAP
• Start a dip at the water's edge. Dipnet times your visit and counts your sweeps.
• Tap each creature in the tray: tap again to change the count from 1 to 2–10, 11–50 or 50+.
• Search by name or filter by group to find a creature quickly.
• Add the water clarity, the weather, an optional water temperature, notes and field photos from the camera or your photo library.

HOW HEALTHY IS YOUR POND?
Every creature has a sensitivity number from 1 (copes with murky water) to 10 (needs very clean water). Dipnet averages the creatures in your tray into a pond score — Struggling, Fair, Good or Thriving — and charts how each pond changes over time. It's an easy, educational way to see what a pond's wildlife says about it.

CREATURE GUIDE
38 pond creatures, from mayfly and stonefly nymphs to water boatmen, freshwater shrimps, snails, leeches, newts and sticklebacks. Each has what to look for, its size, its sensitivity and a fact to share.

YOUR PONDS
Keep a page for every pond you visit: a score chart over time, a chart of families found, every creature ever recorded there and when you first saw it, and all your dips.

TRAY SHARE
Dipping as a class, a family or a group of friends? Everyone at the pond opens Tray Share on the same Wi-Fi or personal hotspot and uses one pond code, like NEWT42. Each group taps the creatures in its own tray, and every device shows the combined finds and pond score live. Save the combined tray as a dip when you're done.

POND SOUNDS
Frog chorus, wind in the reeds, an inflow trickle, dragonfly wings, rain on the water and waterbirds, in four moods or your own mix, with a sit timer that fades out. Sounds keep playing with the screen locked.

INTRO FILM
"Your First Dip" is a one-minute, five-part guide: staying safe at the edge, sweeping, tipping into a tray, looking closely and returning everything gently. Cast it to an Apple TV or AirPlay TV for a class.

DIP SAFELY
A clear dipping code: dip with an adult, kneel on firm ground, wash your hands, return creatures where you found them, and check, clean and dry your kit between ponds.

SHARE YOUR DIPS
Share a dip summary with your photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account or login. No ads. Your ponds, dips and photos stay on this device. Read the Privacy Policy in Settings.

name: Divine War
description:
Divine War is chess like you have never seen it: Heaven against Hell, fought by living warriors on a cinematic 3D battlefield. Every piece is a photoreal soldier — seraph knights, archon queens, demon kings — who marches, strikes and falls in battle when you move.

THREE WAYS TO WAGE WAR
• VS Computer — duel four ranks of AI, from Imp Grubnik to the Godlike mind
• Same Board — two players, one screen, pass-and-play on your device
• Online Battle — ranked matches through Game Center, from Novice to Godlike

AN ARMY FOR EVERY FAITH
Win battles to earn relics, then unlock legendary armies and boards in the Armory — Valkyrie Riders, storm gods, fire titans and more. Unlocks are yours forever.

A LIVE-ACTION BATTLEFIELD
A cinematic camera sweeps the field as your warriors fight. Watch your knight charge, your archon cast, your king fall — every capture plays out on the board.

Climb the ranks, master the clock, and claim the summit. The war between Heaven and Hell is waiting — Enter Battle.

name: DJ My Music
description:
DJ My Music turns your iPhone into a live radio station with your own AI DJ.

Tell the DJ the vibe — a backyard BBQ, a road trip, a holiday party, a 60-minute run — and it spins a set from your own music library, talks between songs like a real rock-radio DJ, and drops a piece of trivia about every track.

YOUR OWN RADIO DJ
• Talks over the end of each song and introduces the next one, while the music keeps playing
• Real song trivia: who wrote it, how it was recorded, chart records and backstage stories
• Talk back hands-free with the live AI voice, or type and tap

RUN OR WORK OUT HARDER WITH 15-SECOND SNIPPETS
• Snippet mode plays just the best part of each song — a fresh hit every 15, 30, 45, 60 or 90 seconds
• Or switch to full songs any time

SHOUT-OUTS FOR YOUR PARTY
• Add your name, team and event, and the DJ puts them on the air
• Edit them mid-show — the music never stops

IT LEARNS YOUR TASTE
• Thumbs up the songs you love, thumbs down the ones you don't
• Every set leans toward your favorites, and disliked songs never come back

TAP A VIBE, GET A SET
• "Up next" buttons suggest where to go next based on what's playing
• Genre pills switch the music instantly
• The song strip under the record shows what's next, and lets you jump to any song

PLAYS YOUR MUSIC
DJ My Music plays songs from your Apple Music library through Apple's music player. Without library access, the DJ plays 30-second Apple Music previews.

DJ PRO
Everyone gets 30 free minutes of the live AI DJ voice. After that the DJ keeps going with the free on-device Apple voice and the music keeps playing. DJ Pro gives you unlimited live AI DJ voice:
• DJ Pro Monthly — $4.99 per month
• DJ Pro Yearly — $44.99 per year
Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://djmymusic-api-165749924806.us-central1.run.app/privacy

The DJ is AI — song trivia may not always be exact.

name: Doban: Buddhism Made Easy
description:
Stories of the Buddha, three minutes a day.
Nothing to memorize. A little monk named Bori walks along with you.

Doban means "a companion on the way." You listen to stories that read like fables, and practice bringing them into your own life. Each lesson leaves you with one small thing to try today. A wrong answer costs you nothing.

A day has three steps: a three-minute lesson, a verse from the Dhammapada to read slowly, and a minute of breathing to the sound of a bell. You decide at the start how much time to give each day. If you miss a few days, Bori simply dozes on the veranda until you come back.

There are 440 lessons in 88 units, across ten parts. They begin with the Buddha's life and the core of the teaching, then move on to his disciples, Buddhism in many lands, reading the sutras (the Dhammapada, the Heart Sutra, the Diamond Sutra and others), practice, Buddhism in Korea, temples and culture, and life's questions. You can start with whichever of four paths fits what you came for: the Buddha's story, a path to rest the mind, the heart of the teaching, or wisdom for daily life. Every unit has a short guide with a summary and its key words.

Bori lives on a temple veranda that looks out over a yard, and the yard changes with the season, the weather and the time of day. With the lotus flowers you gather along the way, and the gifts that come on streak milestones, you can set things out on the veranda and give Bori a hat or a scarf. One widget shows Bori's day on your Home Screen. Another puts today's verse on your Home Screen or Lock Screen.

Every lesson is free, all the way to the end, and so are the three daily steps. You don't need an account.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://doban-app.vercel.app/privacy/en

name: Doc Holliday Lawbrary
description:
Doc Holliday Lawbrary points out your rights and the laws that apply, with links to official sources. We are not attorneys. This is not legal advice.

“Say When.” Tap the badge when a collector, an ex, or a traffic stop is on the phone, and Doc shows quiet tips while you talk. Or skip the call and open the Lawbrary: search and browse selected laws by topic and by state, and do your own research.

Download free. Try the full app for 2 days. Then unlock once for $2.99 — no subscription. That unlock covers one person (you). This is a personal license only, one user per purchase, not for corporate or business multi-user use. Corporations have to buy a future separate heavy business version. After you unlock, add your college kid for $0.99 — help with a landlord, a debt call, or a traffic stop. You can add up to 5 extra people ($0.99 each, 6 people total including you). Family Sharing is off. Restore Purchases brings back the $2.99 unlock.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Open the Lawbrary and browse areas of law, or search what you need, without starting a call.
• Pick your state so official links use that state’s sources when we have them, or a federal source when we don’t.
• Get live, on-device tips during a debt-collector, family, or traffic-stop call (on speaker, with a second device).
• Photograph a letter, pull out dates and deadlines, and draft a reply you can share.
• Keep a case log, letters, and short key-point notes on this device.

WHAT THIS APP IS NOT

Doc Holliday Lawbrary is a reference library of selected laws from official sources. It’s not every law, and it’s not legal advice. We do not represent you. For your specific situation, talk to a licensed attorney.

Notes and letter photos stay on this device. Doc never saves audio and does not keep a word-for-word transcript. Speech-to-text uses the phone’s or browser’s speech service.

Developed by MJR Industries LLC. Support: https://straightcache.app/support/doc-holliday/ or sales@mjrillc.com. Privacy: https://straightcache.app/privacy/doc-holliday/

name: Dogual: Dog Training & Care
description:
Dogual is a calm, clever companion for life with your dog. Tell it about your dog once, and every day it shows you what matters: what to train, what's due, and whether it's a good time for a walk.

TRAINING THAT FOLLOWS YOUR DOG
• A few minutes a day at home, with every step shown as you go
• A plan built around your goals, your dog's age and breed, and what they can already do
• New skills arrive when your dog is ready. Miss a day and nothing is lost
• A built-in clicker, and sessions read aloud if you like
• Toilet training, alone time and the crate as gentle routines through the day
• Adapted for deaf, blind, older and three-legged dogs

THE INVISIBLE LEAD
Eight steps, from the kitchen to the high street, to a dog who walks with you as if there were no lead. One walk a day, big text you can read on the go, and a celebration at every step.

CARE, WITHOUT THE NAGGING
• Reminders for flea treatment, worming, boosters, nails and more
• A week's notice for things you need to book, and one gentle follow-up if you miss one
• Weight tracking, a dog ID card for sitters and vets, and a journal of milestones

WALK WEATHER
Heat, cold, storms, ice, UV and wind, with the best times to walk today. Powered by Apple Weather.

A MANUAL YOU CAN TRUST
1,000 articles and breed guides on health, behaviour, food, safety, puppies and the law, written in plain English and checked carefully. When something needs a vet, Dogual says so.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no adverts, no tracking. Your dog's details stay on your iPhone.

DOGUAL PRO
Free includes your dog's daily page, care reminders, walk weather, the manual and the first skills in your plan. Pro unlocks the full training plan, The Invisible Lead, more than one dog, and the larger widgets.
• Yearly, with a free week to try it
• Monthly
• Lifetime, pay once

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your iPhone's Settings.

Dogual gives general guidance, not veterinary advice. If you're worried about your dog, talk to your vet.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tommys-apps.github.io/dogual/privacy.html

name: Downhill Race!
description:
How far can you ride before the hill wins?

Downhill Race! puts you behind a shopping cart on a winding mountain road through a rainy autumn forest. The cart accelerates as you ride. Lean into the bends, dodge rocks, and keep your wheels on the asphalt.

KNOW WHEN TO JUMP
Keep riding to push your distance, or swipe up to eject and slide to safety. A successful exit turns your miles into coins. Crash and the run ends without adding coins to your bank.

SIMPLE TOUCH CONTROLS
Hold and slide across the bottom of the screen to lean. Release to center your rider. Swipe up from the steering area to prepare your jump.

A WINDING FOREST DESCENT
Ride past autumn trees beneath an overcast mountain sky, with rain, rolling wheels, and a road that keeps unfolding ahead.

CHASE YOUR BEST
Your best distance and banked coins are saved on your device. Jump back in and see how far your next run takes you.

No account is required.

name: Dream Highway
description:
Dream Highway is a calm, hypnotic rhythm drive over an endless sea of clouds, beneath alien megastructures and ringed planets so large they fill half the sky.

The whole road is built from the music. It bends and climbs with the melody, the car's speed follows the song's energy, the neon pulses on every beat and the world changes as the track moves from part to part.

HOW TO PLAY
• Left thumb: hold the left or right arrow the way the road bends, and drive through the glowing orbs.
• Right thumb: hold the up button to boost whenever you like.
• Fall off the road and you float back on anti-gravity. Keep the run clean for a higher rank.
• Finish a song with rank C or better to open the next level.

FEATURES
• Two hand-charted synthwave levels: "Chillwave Nightdrive" by Bogart VGM and "Future Travel" by Zodik. More levels are coming in future updates.
• A fully procedural dream world: highway, megastructures, tunnels, cloud sea and sky are generated as you drive.
• Three camera views, including a driver's-seat cockpit view.
• Auto Play mode: lean back and let the car drive while the music plays.
• Reduced flashes & camera shake option, graphics quality option.
• English and Simplified Chinese.

Completely free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, and no internet connection needed.

Music licensed under Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), from OpenGameArt.org.

name: Duo Clipboard
description:
Save everything you copy, find it in a second, and paste it anywhere.
Designed for iPhone Duo: optimized for the cover display and the big inner display, and great on every iPhone.
Your clips stay on your device. No account, no ads, no subscription.

CLOSED: ONE-HANDED
On the cover display your history is a single column with big targets. Copy your last clip straight from the side bar, right under your thumb.

OPEN: THE BIG SCREEN
Unfold and get a sidebar, a grid of clips and a large preview side by side. In laptop pose, the preview sits on top and your history below, with nothing on the crease.

SAVE IN ONE TAP
• Open the app and tap Paste to save what you just copied
• Share from any app with "Save to Duo Clipboard"
• Drag clips in from other apps, or drag them out in Split View
• Add photos, files or scanned text from the + menu
• Use Shortcuts, the Action button or Control Center
iOS does not let apps watch your clipboard in the background, so Duo Clipboard saves only when you ask it to.

FIND ANYTHING
Instant search with filters like kind:link or board:Work. Smart categories for links, images, text, code, colors, addresses, phone numbers and emails.

BUILT FOR REAL CLIPS
Large previews for text, links, images, files and colors. Clean tracking parameters from URLs, change case, trim, encode and more. Edit text clips any time.

PASTE FROM ANY APP
Add the Duo Clipboard keyboard to paste clips from your history into any text field.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your clips stay on your device. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Anonymous usage statistics and crash reports help us improve the app, never include your clips, and can be turned off in Settings. One-time codes, card numbers and passwords are detected on device, hidden in lists and deleted automatically.

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME PRO
Free: your last 30 clips, one board, the keyboard with your last 5 clips, the small widget, and every way to save.
Duo Clipboard Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription, Family Sharing): unlimited history and boards, the full keyboard with boards and search, all categories and transforms, all widgets and the Control Center control, zip export with media, cleanup rules, themes and alternate icons.

Terms of Use: https://itechx.dev/apps/duo-clipboard/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://itechx.dev/apps/duo-clipboard/privacy/

name: e-Tebligatım
description:
e-Tebligatım, mali müşavirler ve muhasebe ofisleri için e-Tebligat takibini kolaylaştıran bir araçtır. Mükelleflerinizin tebligatlarını tek ekranda listeler; belge türüne ve ada göre süzmenizi, belgeleri görüntülemenizi ve PDF/Excel olarak indirmenizi sağlar.

• Tek ekranda tüm mükelleflerin tebligatları
• Ada ve belge türüne göre süzme, tarih sıralaması
• Tebligat belgesini görüntüleme ve indirme 
• Excel ve PDF rapor alma
• Telefona uyarlı tasarım

e-Tebligatım bir kamu kurumu uygulaması değildir; Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, PTT veya herhangi bir kamu kurumuyla direkt bir bağlantısı yoktur.

name: Earbound: Scan & Listen
description:
Take your reading along for the ride.

Earbound turns printed pages into a personal listening library. Scan a chapter, check the text, and press play when you're ready to go.

Scan now. Listen later. Capture each page when you're ready, crop out the facing page, and keep your chapter in reading order. You can also import photos or a PDF. Helpful scanning tips guide you toward flatter pages, better lighting, and clearer text.

Build your own bookshelf! Keep pages together in books and chapters. Add a photo of the cover, correct recognized text, rearrange pages, and leave blank pages out of listening. Your original page stays available for comparison.

Find your reading voice. Choose from supported Apple voices installed on your device and adjust playback speed. An in-app guide explains how to download Enhanced and Premium Apple voices in device Settings. Voice availability varies by language and device. These voices do not require Earbound Pro.

Take the story with you. Follow the highlighted sentence, switch to large driving controls, or continue listening with the screen locked. Earbound saves your place so you can return to the story. Set up playback before travelling and use your device safely.

Scan on iPad, listen on iPhone. Optionally sync your books, page text, covers, and listening position through your private iCloud account. Use the same Apple Account and enable sync on each device. Let sync finish before switching devices. Downloaded books remain available offline.

Your reading stays personal. Text recognition and speech happen on your device. Earbound does not operate a document-processing server. Optional advertising and Apple services are described in the privacy policy.

Start for free! Add more if you need it. Start with free page credits. Completed optional rewarded videos add credits, or subscribe to Earbound Pro for unlimited new scanned and imported pages while your subscription is active. Listening to saved books and correcting text remain available after a subscription ends.

Earbound Pro is offered monthly or yearly. The localized price and billing period appear before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Apple Account subscriptions. Restore Earbound purchases in Settings.

Scan only content you are authorized to reproduce. Earbound does not provide a commercial audiobook catalog. Recognition can contain mistakes; review text before listening.

Privacy policy: https://tildraev.github.io/earbound-support/privacy.html
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: earboundsupport@gmail.com

name: Earth Protect
description:
Un geste de fronde pour protéger tout un monde.

Dans Earth Protect, maintenez un satellite ou une base, tirez en arrière puis relâchez pour lancer votre impacteur. Anticipez les trajectoires des astéroïdes et des comètes, et trouvez le bon moment pour les dévier.

TROIS TERRAINS À DÉCOUVRIR
• Orbite : commandez les satellites Alpha, Bêta et Gamma.
• Terre : lancez des impacteurs depuis des batteries au sol.
• Lune : protégez les avant-postes de Tranquillité et de Tycho avec une gravité plus faible et sans perte atmosphérique.

NOUVEAU : LA NUIT DE LA COMÈTE
Une comète s’est brisée près du Soleil. Interceptez son noyau et ses éclats de glace, chacun suivi de deux queues lumineuses, sous les aurores polaires et une pluie d’étoiles filantes.

FUSÉES DE RENFORT
Gagnez des fusées en mission ou équipez-vous au hangar. Avant le combat, mettez Nova et Orion en orbite pour ajouter deux lanceurs à votre réseau.

UNE FRONDE ACCESSIBLE
La tolérance du geste vous aide à réussir vos premiers tirs, puis se resserre au fil de la campagne. Les trajectoires visibles et le ralenti à l’approche de l’impact permettent de suivre l’action. Zoomez, déplacez la caméra ou masquez les commandes pour profiter de tout l’écran.

22 MISSIONS ET UNE VRAIE PROGRESSION
Gagnez des crédits et des données scientifiques, équipez votre réseau et financez la recherche. Répartissez les tirs entre les lanceurs, gérez leur énergie et relevez les objectifs étoilés.

UN UNIVERS SPATIAL EN 3D
Découvrez une Terre lumineuse, une surface lunaire cratérisée, des comètes, des traînées de projectiles et des impacts spectaculaires, accompagnés d’une ambiance sonore que vous pouvez couper à tout moment.

Les trajectoires reposent sur une simulation gravitationnelle simplifiée. Le terrain lunaire représente une défense locale autour de la Lune.

name: Echo Steps: Time Puzzle
description:
You can't be in two places at once… unless your past self helps.

In Echo Steps, every attempt is recorded. Save it, and a translucent Echo of Orbi replays those exact steps while you try again. Stand on pressure plates to open doors, let your Echoes hold them for you, and time everything so you walk out together.

HOW TO PLAY
• Move Orbi with arrows or swipes. Every move, or a wait, uses one of six steps
• Save your steps as an Echo. Next attempt, it replays them beside you
• Plates open doors while someone stands on them. Echoes count too
• Reach the glowing exit to win. Fewer Echoes and turns earn three stars

EDIT THE PAST
• Open the Echo Editor and change any single step of a recording
• A live preview replays the whole level, so you see how one change ripples through every Echo and door

120 PUZZLES, 9 CHAPTERS
• A gentle, guided start with Kai, Orbi's friend from Twin Path
• Then timing puzzles, editor challenges and three-Echo choreography
• Every level is checked by an exhaustive solver: always solvable, and par is the true best

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Undo, retry and restart are always free
• Kai gives three hints per level, up to the exact solution
• Your Echoes are saved if you leave mid-level

ECHO STEPS FULL
• Levels 1–10 are free. One optional purchase unlocks levels 11–120 and unlimited solutions

• Charming animations, gentle music and haptics
• Play offline, no ads, no data collected
• In 8 languages

Think in loops. Walk with your Echoes.

name: Echo Trail: Sound Maze
description:
The screen is dark. Somewhere ahead, a sound is calling.

Echo Trail: Sound Maze is a game you play with your ears. Put on your headphones and follow the sound: it grows louder, clearer and faster as you get closer, and your left and right ear tell you which way to turn. You cannot see the walls, trees and water in your way, but you can hear and feel them. But wherever you walk, the dark gives way: the ground you crossed stays lit, showing a strip of the scene and the obstacles you slipped past. Reach the sound, and the whole picture of the place opens in front of you.

LISTEN
• True left/right sound: turn toward what you hear.
• Closer means louder, clearer and faster. A sound behind you turns dull and low.
• Bump into something and you hear a soft thud from its side and feel a tap.
• Your path stays lit behind you in colour, so you can see where you have been and what stood in the way.

FOUR JOURNEYS, 120 LEVELS
• Zen: a day-long walk through nature, from a forest at dawn to a hill under the stars. No rush; when time runs out you simply keep walking.
• Mystery: someone vanished in an old mansion. Thirty rooms, thirty letters, one story to piece together.
• Tension: something follows you through the night. Keep moving.
• Cheerful: a day at the fair, with stars to collect and rainbow trails.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Three ways to move: follow your finger, a joystick, or tilt your device.
• Three difficulty levels.
• Hints that light the way when you are stuck.
• Hidden sounds to find, each flashing now and then as a small note: extra time, album details and pieces of the story.
• An album that fills with the pictures you reveal, and joins them into one long landscape.

NO HEADPHONES?
Headphones are best, but not required: without them, soft wave rings show where the sound is coming from.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play, with ads between some levels. One optional purchase removes them and gives you an extra free hint in every level.
• No account and no sign-up. Your progress stays on your device.
• English and Turkish.

name: Einbürgerungstest 2027 Coach
description:
Pass the German naturalisation test (Einbürgerungstest) and the "Leben in Deutschland" test on your first attempt – with a coach that tells you what to practise each day, explains every mistake and shows you the day you will be ready.

All 310 official questions for your federal state (300 general + 10 state questions), explained clearly, in English if you like. No ads, no subscription, no account.

WHY THIS APP
• All 310 exam questions for your federal state, matching the current BAMF catalogue
• A short explanation for every answer
• Translations and explanations in English, Turkish, Arabic, Russian and Ukrainian
• Mock exam just like the real test: 33 questions, 60 minutes, 17 correct answers to pass
• Smart practice: questions you get wrong come back until you know them
• Chance of passing: always see how well prepared you are
• Practise by topic: basic rights, the state, elections, history, Europe, society
• Works offline, no account, no ads

YOUR PERSONAL COACH
• Daily plan: every day you see which questions are due and how many new ones to take on, matched to your exam date
• Forecast: on which day will you be ready at your pace? And if it gets tight, how much more you need each day
• "Why not?": for every wrong answer you learn exactly why your choice does not fit. Over 1,200 explanations, written with AI and independently double-checked
• Often confused: Bundestag or Bundesrat? Erststimme or Zweitstimme? The coach notices what you mix up and puts the terms side by side
• Coach tab with a weekly review: what improved, which questions keep tripping you up, which have slipped back and how well you know your state's questions
• Debrief after every mock exam: where your mistakes are, whether you rushed, what to practise next
• Optional daily reminder at your usual study time
• Everything stays on your device: no account, no data in the cloud

GERMAN STAYS IN FOCUS
The real test is in German. That is why the original German question is always shown first, with the translation beneath it. You can hide the translation with one tap, so you learn the content and the German terms at the same time.

FAIR, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The first 60 questions, your state's questions and one mock exam are free. A single one-time purchase unlocks everything. No subscription, no follow-up costs.

NOTE
This app is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with the Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF) or any other authority. Source of the questions: the official catalogue of approved exam questions (Annex 1 of the Einbürgerungstestverordnung), available at gesetze-im-internet.de/einbtestv, and the BAMF question catalogue at bamf.de. Explanations and translations are a study aid and not part of the official catalogue.

name: Eliot One
description:
# Eliot One — Seu assistente pessoal com IA

**Organize sua vida. Simplifique seu dia. Deixe o Eliot ajudar você.**

Conheça o Eliot One, seu assistente pessoal com inteligência artificial, criado para facilitar sua rotina e ajudar você a organizar seus compromissos, lembretes, tarefas, anotações e muito mais.

Com o Eliot One, você pode conversar naturalmente com seu assistente pelo aplicativo ou pelo WhatsApp, usando mensagens de texto ou áudio.

**UMA AGENDA MAIS INTELIGENTE**

Organize seus compromissos, reuniões e eventos em um só lugar. Peça ao Eliot para adicionar compromissos, consultar sua programação e ajudar você a não esquecer datas importantes.

**LEMBRETES QUE FACILITAM SUA VIDA**

Crie lembretes pontuais ou recorrentes para pagamentos, atividades, compromissos e tarefas do dia a dia. Receba avisos conforme suas preferências de notificação.

**NOTAS E LISTAS DE TAREFAS**

Guarde ideias, informações e anotações importantes. Crie listas de compras, organize atividades e acompanhe o que já foi concluído.

**CONVERSE COM SUA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL**

Não precisa decorar comandos. Converse naturalmente com o Eliot para consultar informações e organizar sua rotina. Você também pode enviar mensagens de áudio.

**SEU DIA ORGANIZADO EM UM RESUMO**

name: ElmScanner
description:
ElmScanner turns the barcode on the back of a book into a citation-ready record. Hold the book up to your camera, and the title, author, publisher, year and more are filled in for you. When you're done, export the whole list for your reference manager.

SCAN OR TYPE
• Point the camera at an ISBN barcode in any orientation. On iPhone it starts on the back camera, with a button to switch; on the Mac you can choose among connected cameras. A green check confirms a book was recognized; a red X means the barcode wasn't a book.
• Or type an ISBN by hand.
• Scan a book twice and ElmScanner won't add it again. It scrolls to the one you already have.
• Books you've looked up before are remembered on your device, so scanning them again works without an internet connection.

REVIEW AND EDIT
• See exactly what will be exported for every book, with missing details flagged.
• Tap (iPhone) or double-click (Mac) any book to correct or complete it.
• Book details come from Open Library (a project of the Internet Archive) and from the national libraries of Japan (NDL Search), Germany (Deutsche Nationalbibliothek), France (Bibliothèque nationale de France) and Spain (Biblioteca Nacional de España) for books in those languages.

EXPORT TO MANY FORMATS
• RIS, BibTeX, Excel (.xlsx) and CSV first, then BibLaTeX, CSL JSON, MODS, MARC, MARCXML, EndNote XML, RefWorks, Web of Science, Refer/BibIX, Zotero RDF, Bibliontology RDF, Dublin Core RDF and XML ContextObject.
• These are formats that reference managers such as Zotero can import.
• Keep one running Excel list: choose an Excel or CSV file you exported earlier and the new books are added to the end (books already in it are skipped).
• On iPhone, save to the Files app or send the file by email as an attachment.

NEVER LOSE YOUR LIST (iPHONE)
• Books you've scanned but not yet exported are kept safely, even if the app closes unexpectedly.
• One tap clears the list when you want a fresh start.

EARN RANKS
• As you scan more different books, you reach new ranks, from Beginner up to Little Bookstore on the Corner, with a little celebration.

A FRIENDLY LITTLE EXTRA
• Smile at the camera and ElmScanner says hello. It's all on your device; nothing about a face is saved or sent.

ENGLISH AND JAPANESE
• Fully localized in English and Japanese, including Japanese book lookups.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
• The source code is available under the MIT license.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• The camera image never leaves your device (smile detection runs on the device too). Only a book's ISBN goes to Open Library or, for Japanese, German, French and Spanish books, the national library of that country, to look up its details; your email address (which Open Library asks every app to send) goes to Open Library only.

ElmScanner works with Zotero's import formats but is not made by or endorsed by Zotero.

name: Emlak Tycoon: Buy & Sell Homes
description:
Start with one table and an empty listing board, and build the biggest real estate office in the city.

Sign listing agreements, show homes to clients and earn commissions. Turn your savings into investments: study listings, walk through homes in 3D, test walls with a moisture meter and search the title deed. Don't trust everything an owner says; fresh paint can hide a defect.

• Find hidden flaws with a moisture meter, crack gauge and thermal camera
• Every buyer wants something different: find the right pitch
• Renovations, tenants, bank loans and shifting neighborhood prices
• Five offices, from Coffee Corner to Plaza Headquarters

The game runs in real time: one game day lasts three hours, and business goes on while you're away. An internet connection is required. You start without an account; after your first few deals you link one to keep your progress safe.

name: Epimelio
description:
Epimelio is the salon app for owners and their team. Your bookings, clients and checkout, all in one place, wherever you are.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE

name: EZ Return
description:
EZ Return picks up your return packages at your door and sends them back to the retailer for you. No more lines at the post office or the UPS store.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a return: choose the carrier (USPS, UPS, FedEx, Amazon or DHL), add a photo of the package and your return label.
2. Pick a day: pickups run on Sundays and Wednesdays, in the morning or the afternoon.
3. We pick it up: a driver collects the package at your door.
4. We send it back: we sort it at our warehouse and hand it to the carrier. You follow every step in the app.

NO PRINTER? NO BOX?
Add packaging and we wrap your item and print the label for you. With a QR code return, just upload the QR code and we show it at drop-off.

PLANS
- Free Trial: one free pickup of one package.
- Pay-per-use: $12 per pickup, 2 packages included (up to 4).

SERVICE AREA
EZ Return serves Ocean County, New Jersey, including Lakewood, Toms River, Jackson, Brick, Manchester and Howell. Enter your zip code in the app to check if we serve your address.

TRACK EVERYTHING

name: ezcamp: Free Camping and Trips
description:
Find a campsite you can trust before you drive out.

ezcamp maps 29,105 campsites across all 50 states from open public data: the National Park Service, Recreation.gov, the Forest Service, BLM and OpenStreetMap. Spots without details stay hidden until you zoom in, so the map shows places you can actually judge.

ASK EZCAMP
Chat over the map. "Free camps near Moab with water?" "Can I camp here?" "Plan 3 nights from Denver to Moab." Answers come from ezcamp's own data, say where they come from, and the map follows along. Runs on Apple Intelligence on your iPhone, or with your own Claude or OpenAI key.

CAN I CAMP HERE?
Long-press anywhere to see who manages the land and the usual rules, plus Forest Service road access.

TONIGHT'S CONDITIONS
Overnight lows, wind, rain, smoke and active wildfires within 50 miles.

SAFETY HEADS-UP
What other campers reported, current park alerts, the nearest hospital and police or ranger station, and county context from FBI data.

FISHING & HUNTING
Fish and game recorded near each site, live river flow, and license rules for every state.

PACK LISTS AND MY GEAR
Water, food and gear for camping, hiking, biking, fishing or hunting, sized to the forecast. Every line cites its source. Photograph your gear and it becomes cut-out stickers you tick off as you pack.

ROAD TRIPS
Pick where you're going and how far you like to drive. ezcamp suggests a camp at the end of every day, free sites first, with gas, groceries and hospitals nearby.

TRIP REELS
Keep photos and videos with each camp and turn the trip into a reel to share with family. Want music on the beat, captions and a YouTube cut too? Open it in ezReels.

RATINGS YOU CAN TRUST
Ratings logged at the campsite are marked verified and count double, and older ones count less.

Free. No ads, no tracking.

name: Fabrick:AI
description:
Fabrick:AI je provozní aplikace pro výrobní závody. Jedno místo, kde směna vidí, co je dnes potřeba udělat — a kde mistr vidí, jestli se to opravdu stalo.

Předávání směny

Úkoly pro směnu na jednom místě, s termínem a odpovědnou osobou. Mistr vidí, co je hotovo a co visí.

Checklisty a 5S
Kontroly na lince a pravidelné obchůzky přímo v telefonu. Bez papírů a bez dohadování, kdo co odbavil a kdy.

Zmetky a přepracování
Rychlý zápis zmetku nebo přepracování s fotkou a poznámkou, tam kde k němu došlo.

Kvalifikace a školení
Kdo je proškolený na kterou pozici a kdy mu platnost končí. Mistr obsazuje směnu jen lidmi, kteří na to mají.

Materiál a sklad
Stav materiálu a návrhy doplnění, aby nic nedošlo uprostřed směny.

Asistent, který sleduje provoz a navrhne další krok. Rozhodnutí vždy zůstává na člověku.

Pro závody, kde dnes směna běží na papírech, tabulkách a skupinových chatech. Fabrick:AI nenahrazuje MES ani ERP — pracuje vedle nich a doplňuje to, co na dílně chybí.

name: Faraway Stations at Night
description:
Faraway Stations at Night is a fictional radio landscape for falling asleep.

Turn the dial and find a station coming in from far away. A late-night host talks the hours away and takes calls from people who can't sleep either. A gospel hour preaches from somewhere past the edge of town. The news arrives from places you've never heard of. There are lessons and readings, and, if you turn slowly, voices reading out lists of quiet things, one after another. Between the stations, there's static.

THE VOICES FORGET THEIR LINES
As the night goes on, the voices lose their place, start again and trail off. The signal drifts and the stations slow down with you. So no night ever plays the same, and the radio remembers what you've already heard and plays you something else. New stations and episodes keep arriving with updates, for every listener.

It draws on things people do to fall asleep, like listening to someone talk without needing to follow along, and running through unrelated pictures in your head. It isn't a treatment for anything. It's a radio.

NOTHING TO SIGN UP FOR
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything plays from your phone, so it works in airplane mode, and it keeps playing with the screen locked. Pause it from the lock screen or your headphones.

FREE, THEN KEEP IT IN TUNE
Your first four nights of listening are free: every station, all night. After that, the radio plays clearly for five minutes each night and then slowly drifts out of tune. To keep it in tune, unlock it monthly, yearly, or once for good. With Family Sharing, one unlock covers your family.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

FeelMyPhone gives your phone a character with a voice. Plug in the charger and Drama Queen sighs with relief. Unplug it and Hothead takes it personally. Let the battery hit 5% and Robot calmly announces that system failure is imminent.

PAY ONCE, THAT'S IT

name: Feudville
description:

name: Field Electrical Calculator
description:
Field Electrical Calculator is an offline-first reference toolkit for anyone who sizes wire, batteries, and solar systems for a living — or for a project. No account, no internet connection required, no ads. Every calculation runs right on your device.

GUIDED WIZARD
Not sure where to start? Tap “What Size Do I Need?” and answer a few questions about your power source, application, load, and distance — the wizard walks you from there straight to a recommended wire size, with the full reasoning shown alongside the result.

WIRE & CONDUCTOR TOOLS

Wire/Ampacity Sizing — AWG and kcmil, copper or aluminum, 60/75/90°C insulation columns
Voltage Drop — target a max % drop and get the smallest wire that still meets it
Ampacity Lookup — ambient temperature correction and conductor bundling adjustments built in
Conduit Fill & Box Fill — EMT, PVC, RMC, IMC and flexible conduit, standard box-fill allowances
Fuse/Breaker Sizing — standard overcurrent device ratings
Wire Gauge Reference, Visual Size Comparison, Wire Identifier, and a full Cable Reference (THHN, THWN-2, XHHW-2, Romex/NM-B, UF-B, automotive, and marine wire)

BATTERY TOOLS

Battery Bank Sizing and Runtime estimates
Nine chemistries supported out of the box — AGM, Flooded, Gel, SLA, LiFePO4, Li-ion, NMC, LTO, and Custom — each with sensible default depth-of-discharge and round-trip efficiency you can override
Battery wiring/cable sizing and a quick battery reference table

SOLAR TOOLS

Panel Configuration (series/parallel arrays)
Charge Controller sizing for both PWM and MPPT
Solar + Battery system sizing
PV Wire sizing and Inverter sizing

ELECTRICAL FUNDAMENTALS

Ohm’s Law solver (solve for any value from the other three)
Power, Energy Cost, and Motor full-load current estimates

BUILT FOR THE FIELD, NOT JUST THE OFFICE
This isn’t a phone-only app squeezed to fit a bigger screen. The layout adapts from a one-handed iPhone grid all the way up to a wide multi-column iPad layout, every tap target is sized for gloves and sunlight, and every screen has been checked against WCAG contrast guidelines in both light and dark mode so nothing washes out outdoors.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose Light, Dark, or System mode, pick from five built-in neon presets, or set your own background, text, and accent colors with a live contrast readout so you can see exactly how readable your choice is before you commit to it.

SAVE YOUR WORK
Favorite the tools you use most for one-tap access from the home screen, and every completed calculation is automatically saved to your history so you can reference it again later — all stored locally on your device.

WHAT THIS APP IS — AND ISN’T
Every number in this app is either a physical/geometric constant (wire geometry, resistivity, Ohm’s law) or a widely published trade reference figure (ampacity tables, conduit/box-fill allowances, standard overcurrent ratings) — never a black box. That said, this app provides engineering-reference calculations and general trade data for planning purposes. It is not a substitute for the National Electrical Code (NEC), your local adopted code, ABYC standards, manufacturer documentation, a licensed electrician, or a qualified engineer. Battery and high-voltage work carries real risk of fire, arc flash, and shock — always verify your final design against the current code edition and manufacturer specifications, and follow proper lockout/tagout and PPE practices, before energizing any circuit.

WHO IT’S FOR
Electricians and apprentices, solar installers, marine and RV technicians, HVAC and automotive 12V/24V techs, and anyone doing their own wiring who wants a fast, reliable reference instead of flipping through a code book or guessing.

No subscriptions, no sign-up, no network access required to use any calculator in this app.

name: FieldArc
description:
FieldArc is a work app for organisations whose staff work in the field: loan officers at a microfinance institution, sales and distribution reps, collection agents, inspectors, community workers and similar teams. Your employer gives you an account; you cannot sign up on your own.

EVERY CASE
The latest case, a countdown to the next one, and every case so far with a search box. Each one plays right there in the app.

Someone has been in the living room. Two pictures of the same felt room, and a few things are not as Fig left them. Tap what is different. Ten rooms, from easy to sneaky, a new scene of the day, and stars to collect. No words to read and no clock on the screen.

A 10-second check-in: how heavy does today feel, and what is here (tired, numb, angry, lonely, grateful). See your last 14 days without judgment. No streaks and no guilt: your fir only ever grows.

TRACK YOUR HUNT

ADD CARDS FAST

SHARE AND TRADE

TWO LOOKS, TWO MOODS

CURIOUS WHAT IT'S WORTH?
Market prices are there when you want them, on each card and for your collection as a whole. Turn off price badges in Settings and they stay out of the way.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Export your collection whenever you like. You can delete your account and all of its data from inside the app.

COME SAY HI
Feedback, trading talk and support on the FoF Cards Discord: https://discord.gg/cwy38Vkrf3

name: Fold Supply Arcade
description:
Fold Arcade brings the alley roller back, and puts it on a phone that folds.

Open your iPhone Duo like a laptop and the game becomes a machine: the lane lies flat on the table and the board stands up in front of you. Tilt the screen back and the board leans with it. Put a finger on the ball, flick it up the lane, and watch it climb the ramp and drop into a pocket.

HOT ROLL
• Nine balls a game. Pockets score from 10 to 100.
• Land two balls in a row in 20 or better and the next one pays double. Keep the streak going and it pays triple.
• Real arcade sounds: the roll, the thump, the jingle for a good shot.
• Enter your initials on a pixel high-score board.

TICKETS AND PRIZES
• Every 10 points is a ticket, and the machine feeds them out as you play.
• Take them to the prize counter, under the neon sign.
• Twenty prizes to collect, from spider rings and sticky hands to a boombox and a lava lamp.
• Fill your collection and the counter throws you a party.

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO, PLAYS ON ANY iPHONE
• On iPhone Duo the fold is part of the game: board on the upright half, lane on the flat half.
• On any other iPhone, lay it flat and play the same machine on one screen.

NO STRINGS
• No ads.
• No in-app purchases. Tickets are won, never bought.
• No account and no internet connection needed.
• Nothing about you leaves your phone.

Fold Arcade is made by Fold Supply, makers of wallpapers for iPhone Duo.

name: FoldCove
description:
Make a paper tray, a simple sleeve or an envelope from your own measurements. FoldCove generates a fresh flat net with clear cut lines, fold lines and glue areas.

Set dimensions in millimeters or inches, adjust a simple paper allowance, and inspect the net before printing. Choose A4 or US Letter, portrait or landscape, printable margins and tile overlap. Larger designs are split into numbered sheets at their original scale.

Export a vector PDF with a 100 mm calibration ruler, then print at Actual Size / 100% and check the ruler before assembly. Save designs to edit or duplicate later, and keep immutable PDF copies in your export history.

Includes an assembly guide for each template. Paper allowances are approximate and cannot account for every material or printer. Start with a small test build. This app does not control printer scaling.

name: Foldlet: Daily Puzzle Game
description:
A tiny puzzle with very big dimensions.

Foldlet is a daily puzzle game. Every day there's one new puzzle. Help a little astronaut reach the exit by folding the world between four dimensions: flatten 3D into 2D to cross a gap, squash it into a single line, or unfold into 4D to slip between slices of space.

No math needed. If you can picture squashing a cardboard box flat, you can play!

HOW IT WORKS
• One new puzzle every day at midnight, your time. Easiest on Monday, hardest on Sunday.
• Fewer moves and folds is better. There's no undo, so every move counts!
• Share your result without spoiling the solution: your moves, folds and a tiny chart of the dimensions you used.
• Climb the daily leaderboard and keep your streak going.
• A nudge at 8am when the new puzzle is up, if you want one.

FREE TO PLAY
Today's puzzle is free, every day. Foldlet Pro unlocks every past puzzle in the calendar.

No ads. Your data isn't for sale.

Questions and ideas: hello@foldlet.net

name: FORTUNE — Biscuit 3D
description:
A secret waiting to unfold.

A 3D fortune cookie, a paper slip and a thought to take into your day. FORTUNE offers a small pause in a vermilion, jade and gold setting, with two illustrated dragons in the background.

A GESTURE, A SURPRISE
Move the cookie, open it and discover a piece of life advice. The shell breaks, crumbs appear and the message unfolds on the paper. Turn on the sounds when you want them, or enjoy the experience in silence.

THOUGHTS TO COME BACK TO
Explore advice about relationships, habits, decisions, confidence and other everyday situations. Keep your favorites and revisit your discoveries in the local history. The selection system limits repetition within a finite set of formulations.

THE SAME THOUGHT IN TWO LANGUAGES
Switch between French and English without drawing another message. Share the text or create a square, portrait or story PNG card: 1080 × 1080, 1080 × 1350 or 1080 × 1920.

YOUR COLLECTION STAYS WITH YOU
Play offline, without an account. Favorites, history and settings stay on your device. Export a JSON backup to Files before changing devices or deleting the app. A validated import can merge your collection while preserving existing favorites and current settings. Automatic syncing between devices is not included.

AT YOUR OWN PACE
Pause the background, choose the graphics quality or quick reveal, and use the experience with reduced motion.

No ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions or remote text generation.

Created by Romain TERRAS.

name: frlmods

frlmods is a community for drift racing fans: thousands of car liveries made by members, chat channels, direct messages, a forum and a wiki.

LIVERIES

IMAGE TO LIVERY

CHAT
Join community channels, talk in direct messages, share pictures and voice messages, and get a notification when someone replies, mentions you or writes to you.

FORUM AND WIKI
Ask questions, show your builds and read guides written by members.

PROFILES
Follow members, see their uploads and build your own collection.

A SAFE COMMUNITY
Every post, comment, forum thread, profile and chat message can be reported, any member can be blocked, and the moderation team reviews every report. Sign in with Apple, Google or Discord.

frlmods is an unofficial fan community for FR Legends players. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to FR Legends or its developer.

name: furui note
description:
furui note brings notes, tasks, albums, and a calendar together for everyday records and plans.

Notes and timeline
Capture ideas and organize them with folders, search, and pinned notes. Switch between a list and a timeline to revisit entries by creation date. Copy or share notes with the system share sheet, and import TXT or Markdown text.

Tasks and reminders
Add task details, priorities, and due dates. Browse all tasks, today's tasks, overdue tasks, or completed tasks. Set a separate reminder time for tasks that need a notification, and allow notifications when you are ready.

Albums and photo places
Import photos, organize albums, and add photo descriptions. Photos with location information can appear together on a map. Select a place to browse its albums and photos. Photos without a location remain available in your albums.

Calendar and events
Browse months, select a date, and create regular or all-day events. Tasks due on the selected day appear alongside your events.

Optional weather records
Turn on note weather to save an Apple Weather snapshot when creating a note. Weather needs a network connection and approximate location permission. You can still save a note if weather is unavailable.

Connect a computer or AI client
On the same trusted Wi-Fi, turn on computer access and pair a browser with a one-time code to manage notes, tasks, albums, photos, and events. Connect a compatible MCP client and choose individual tool permissions in functional groups. AI access starts turned off, with read-only permissions enabled on first use. Browser management and AI tool permissions are separate.

On-device storage and optional iCloud
Content stays on your device by default, with no app account required. You can turn on iCloud and independently choose whether to sync notes, tasks, album names, photos, and calendar events. A category syncs through your current Apple account only when both the master switch and that category are enabled. Language, access credentials, AI tool permissions, and notification scheduling remain local to each device.

Choose Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English in Settings. Reminder delivery depends on device notification settings and Focus. Maps, weather, iCloud, and computer access need their respective network connections, permissions, or system account.

name: furui reader
description:
Bring your own books, and let your AI assistant find passages in them.

furui reader is a personal-file reader for iPhone and iPad. Import books you have the right to use, read, save thoughts, listen with iOS voices and connect your own AI client. No app account is required.

CONNECT YOUR BOOKS TO AI
Enable MCP under Me → AI Assistant Connection and approve access. A compatible client with your token on the same local network can find local books, read text, notes and activity, and add excerpts. Connections start off. Turning MCP off withdraws this session's consent; regenerating the token revokes old clients. Choose your own client and model service; no chat model is embedded.

DIRECT WI-FI TRANSFER
Open the phone's address in a computer browser on the same Wi-Fi. Enter the six-digit one-time code to transfer EPUB, TXT, PDF, DOC, DOCX or Markdown directly to the phone. Resume confirmed chunks within a valid session.

LISTEN OFFLINE WITH IOS VOICES
Installed system voices generate audio segments on your device. Choose a voice, adjust 0.5x–2.5x speed, change chapters, resume listening or set a sleep timer. Background audio and lock-screen playback controls are supported. System narration works offline once the required voice is installed.

CHOOSE YOUR ICLOUD SYNC
Data is saved locally first. iCloud sync is off by default. Turn it on under Me → iCloud & Storage and separately choose books and covers, reading/listening positions, notes/thoughts and daily activity. Progress includes total listening time per book; activity includes daily totals. Only selected categories sync through your private CloudKit database between devices using the same Apple Account. Turn it off anytime; downloaded local data and existing cloud copies are kept. The system schedules sync asynchronously, with transfer status and recoverable errors.

READ YOUR WAY
Browse covers, search your shelf, navigate chapters and resume reading. Adjust text size and line spacing; choose paper, warm or night themes. Text is extracted and reflowed. Three original short sample books are included.

KEEP MEANINGFUL PASSAGES
Select text to highlight, underline or add a wavy line. Pick colors and write thoughts. Find notes by book and chapter, search excerpts, return to the passage, copy or share. Removing a book keeps notes. Conflicting synced edits keep versions for you to choose.

FOLLOW YOUR READING HABITS
View actual reading and listening time by week, month, year, lifetime or calendar. Enable daily local reminders with notification permission.

BEFORE YOU START
• Free, with no ads or in-app purchases. English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese; follow the system or choose under Me → Language. Book text is not translated.
• Optional OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech and Reader /v1/tts use your endpoints and credentials; providers may charge separately. Explicit consent is required before sending current and limited preload text. Revoke it in Speech Settings; changing protocol or endpoint requires new consent. System narration sends no text to TTS providers.
• iCloud needs a system Apple Account, app permission, network and storage. Sync choices stay on this device. Audio caches, TTS credentials and other device settings do not sync. Notes include titles, excerpts and location metadata. Keep original files.
• TXT/Markdown: 15 MiB per book; other formats: 60 MiB. PDFs: 2,000 pages, with text extraction and reflow. Scans need OCR first. Encrypted or DRM text is unsupported; complex layouts may change.
• LAN HTTP is unencrypted. Current tasks can continue only for limited iOS background time; unlock and return afterward. No continuous background connection listening. AI client and model-service retention follow their policies.
• Your own files only: no commercial bookstore or publication downloads.

name: FZ Vendor
description:
FZ Vendor is the all-in-one app for restaurant partners on FoodZippy. Manage your orders, menu, offers and earnings from one place, wherever you are.

ORDER MANAGEMENT

• Accept, prepare and complete orders with a single tap
• View live and past orders with full item details

MENU & PRODUCTS

OFFERS & PROMOTIONS

POS & DINE-IN
