• Handle dine-in orders alongside delivery orders

EARNINGS & PAYOUTS

SUBSCRIPTIONS

PROFILE & NOTIFICATIONS

Download FZ Vendor and take your restaurant business to the next level.

name: Garagerr
description:
Garagerr keeps track of everything your car costs, beautifully.

LOG FILL-UPS IN SECONDS
Enter any two of price, amount and total and the third fills itself in. Your last price and station are remembered, and partial fills are handled correctly.

HONEST FUEL ECONOMY
Full-to-full MPG (or L/100 km / km/L). Garagerr spots impossible readings that mean a fill-up was missed and leaves them out of your averages. Plug-in hybrids are detected automatically.

NEVER MISS A SERVICE
Reminders by miles and by months, whichever comes first, with a projected due date based on how much you actually drive. Set your own interval for every service type.

SEE WHERE THE MONEY GOES
Monthly fuel spending, price per gallon, MPG trend, cost per mile, projected yearly cost, a station breakdown and a side-by-side of all your vehicles.

BRING YOUR HISTORY
Import the export from Drivvo, Fuelly, Fuelio, aCar, Simply Auto, Road Trip MPG or any spreadsheet. Columns, units and date formats are detected automatically, and re-importing never creates duplicates.

MAKE IT YOURS
Vehicle photos, logos with pinch-to-zoom, VIN on file, US or metric units, and English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian.

GARAGERR PRO
Start with a 3-day free trial, then $1.99 per year. Your vehicle data stays on your device (and in your own iCloud on iPhone and iPad). No ads, no account, no tracking.

name: GdzieStart

GdzieStart to kalendarz zawodów sportowych w Polsce i za granicą: biegi uliczne, trail i ultra, triathlon, HYROX, OCR, kolarstwo i pływanie na wodach otwartych.

Wybierz dyscypliny i miasto, a starty ułożą się od najbliższych. Zagraniczne też zobaczysz, z odległością od Ciebie. Filtruj po dystansie (5 km, 10 km, półmaraton, maraton, ultra), terminie, odległości i otwartych zapisach.

Starty, na które masz pakiet, trafiają do „Mojego sezonu” z odliczaniem do dnia startu. Jednym dotknięciem dodasz start do kalendarza w telefonie.

SPRZĘT
Rankingi butów biegowych i sprzętu na podstawie testów, promocje w polskich sklepach i alert, gdy cena spadnie. Do sprzętu i alertów cen potrzebne jest konto: wystarczy adres e-mail i kod, bez hasła.

Dane startów zbieramy ze stron organizatorów i sprawdzamy na bieżąco. Zapisujesz się zawsze na stronie organizatora.

name: GearMate
description:
Keep your gear ready and your adventures organized.

GearMate brings equipment care, trip planning, packing checklists and outdoor journals together in one place. Prepare for your next outing, record what happened and keep a useful history of the gear that went with you.

YOUR GEAR, ORGANIZED
Build an equipment collection with photos, specifications, purchase details, warranty information and attachments. Review usage records, maintenance history and costs for each item.

CARE FOR YOUR EQUIPMENT
Create maintenance plans for cleaning, inspections and repairs. Set service intervals by date, usage count or recorded hours, with optional reminders to help you stay on schedule.

PLAN AND PACK
Organize trip dates, team members, required gear and expenses. Create reusable packing templates and track checklist progress as you prepare.

WORK WITH ROUTES
Import GPX files, review route geometry and elevation, and add or edit waypoints. Keep planned routes separate from imported tracks recorded during your trip.

KEEP AN OUTDOOR JOURNAL
Capture trip events, photos, weather observations and notes. Confirm actual gear use and supply consumption when your trip is complete.

MANAGE YOUR SUPPLIES
Track consumables by batch, quantity and expiry date. Maintain a stock ledger for food, fuel and other outdoor essentials.

REVIEW AND EXPORT
Explore gear usage and cost summaries. Create PDF reports, export records and back up your data with its attachments for later restoration.

No account is required. Your records are stored locally on your device, with system sharing available when you choose to export them.

From the first packing list to the final trip report, GearMate helps you build an organized record of your outdoor life.

name: Gekka Tarot: AI Tarot Reading
description:
Turn a card under the moon.

Gekka Tarot is a tarot app with 78 original illustrations. Each reading is paired with tonight's moon phase and sky, so the cards speak to this very night.

DAILY CARD
One card for you each day, with a short note on tonight's sky: the moon phase, the season and your local weather. Optional reminders at the time you choose.

YES / NO
When you can't decide, ask one question. The card shows a leaning: yes, no, or wait.

12 SPREADS
Single Card, Past–Present–Future, The Crossroads Cross, The Fork in the Road, The Horseshoe, The Two of You, The Red Thread, Phases of the Moon, Seven Nights and more. Shuffle the deck with your finger and choose your own cards from the fan.

HAND-WRITTEN READINGS
Every card has upright and reversed readings for five themes: love, work, money, relationships and general.

MOONLIT READING (AI)
From your cards, your question and tonight's sky, AI writes a reading just for you. Open deeper questions, draw one more card, or ask follow-ups.
- Standard reading: once a week for free, 3 a day for Members
- In-depth reading: 30 a month for Premium

ORIGINAL ART
Art Deco lines, gold leaf and deep indigo nights. All 78 cards were drawn for this app.

JOURNAL
Keep the date, your question, the cards and the readings.

PLANS

- Member (monthly): all spreads, detailed readings by theme, 3 AI readings a day

name: GK Meteo
description:
GK Meteo je besplatna aplikacija za Gorski kotar: vrijeme, snijeg, ceste, kamere i priroda na jednom mjestu, za mještane, vozače, planinare, berače i sve koji kroz Gorski kotar samo prolaze.

PITAJ GK
Pitajte kao što biste pitali susjeda: „hoće li biti mraza noćas u Lokvama”, „stanje na A6”, „koliko ima snijega na Platku”, „gdje ima vrganja”. Glasom ili tipkanjem, na standardnom jeziku ili na dijalektu: „kaj bu vreme v Čabru”, „ča bu sutra kiša”, „di rastu lisičarke”. Pitaj je tražilica, a ne umjetna inteligencija: svaki odgovor sastavljen je iz stvarnih podataka i odmah otvara kartu koja mu pripada.

KARTA UŽIVO
Trodimenzionalna karta Gorskog kotara sa slojevima temperature, vjetra i bure, oborina, novog snijega, visine snježnog pokrivača, radara, satelita, naoblake i visine nulte izoterme. Vremenskom crtom krenite kroz sljedeće sate i dane i pogledajte kako se vrijeme mijenja nad svakim mjestom.

PROGNOZA PREMA VISINI
Prognoza po satima i danima za Delnice, Fužine, Lokve, Mrkopalj, Čabar, Ravnu Goru, Vrbovsko, Skrad, Brod Moravice, Crni Lug, Platak, Bjelolasicu i druga mjesta, prilagođena nadmorskoj visini mjesta.

CESTE I PUT
Rizik od poledice, snijega i bure po dionicama za sljedeća 24 sata, stanje na A6 i staroj cesti, planer puta s procjenom rizika i prijenos rute u Apple Karte ili Google Maps. I za dulje putovanje: „koji je najbolji put do Zagreba”.

KAMERE I UPOZORENJA
Kamere uz ceste i na planinama, upozorenja DHMZ-a, vodostaj rijeka, potresi, kvaliteta zraka i opasnost od požara.

POLJE I ŠUMA
Kada špricati, sušiti sijeno ili sijati, kada prijeti mraz, kako je blagu i pčelama. Karta povoljnih područja za dvadesetak biljaka i gljiva te Šetnja šumom: kompas koji vas vodi do najbližeg povoljnog područja, s jasnom napomenom kad vrsta nije u sezoni. Jestivost gljiva ne potvrđuje nijedna aplikacija: pokažite ih iskusnom beraču.

BERBA
Pokrenite berbu i aplikacija bilježi vaš trag, a poslije vas vodi natrag do auta. Trag ostaje samo na vašem telefonu.

NA ZASLONU I U ŽIVO
Widgeti za početni i zaključani zaslon, obavijesti o upozorenjima i Live Activity za vrijeme berbe ili vožnje.

KLIMA
Kako se klima Gorskog kotara mijenjala: izmjereni podaci i dugi niz godina unatrag, jasno objašnjeni.

PRIVATNOST
Bez prijave, bez reklama, bez praćenja. Lokacija se koristi samo na telefonu. Glasovno pitanje šalje se na naš poslužitelj samo radi prepoznavanja govora i ne sprema se.

GK Meteo je projekt zajednice, financiran vlastitim sredstvima. Podaci: DHMZ, Open-Meteo, Copernicus, HAK i drugi izvori navedeni u aplikaciji.

name: Glaze Maze: Porcelain Puzzles
seller_name: Beijing Jianren Jianzhi Technology Co., Ltd.
description:

name: Glowcast: Aurora & Stargazing
description:
Glowcast answers one question: is tonight worth going out to see the aurora or the stars? It puts the aurora forecast, the clouds over your head, how dark it gets and the Moon together and tells you when to go: "Aurora likely, go out 22:40–01:30".

AURORA CHANCE FOR YOUR PLACE
• A real chance, in plain words: how likely you are to see the northern or southern lights with your own eyes, and how likely a phone camera will catch them.
• Clouds and darkness are already inside the number. A high Kp under a cloudy sky is not a good night, and Glowcast says so.
• See which Kp your place needs: "Here you need about Kp 5 to see it by eye, Kp 4 on camera."
• Works in both hemispheres: aurora borealis and aurora australis.

ALERTS THAT RESPECT YOUR SKY
• The strong-storm alert is free: one message when a major geomagnetic storm makes the aurora visible where you are, and only if your sky is dark and clear.
• With Pro, pick your own threshold and hours: "tell me when the chance reaches 30 % between 8 pm and 2 am". No alerts in daylight, under cloud or for the other side of the world.
• With Pro, an evening heads-up when tonight has an aurora window or a clear, dark window for the stars, with meteor shower peaks named.

FIND CLEARER, DARKER SKY (PRO)
• Cloudy at home? Glowcast checks every place within 150 km and lists where the clouds break tonight and the sky is darker, with distance, direction, the best hours and an estimated Bortle class. One tap opens directions in Maps.

FOR STARGAZERS AND ASTRONOMERS
• Hour by hour (Pro): cloud that matters with low, middle and high layers, astronomical darkness, Moon rise and set, moonless dark hours, and the best time to go out.
• Seeing and transparency estimates for your telescope (Pro), with smoke and dew warnings.
• Light pollution at your place as an estimated Bortle class.

SPACE WEATHER, LIVE
• Kp now from NOAA. With Pro: the 3-day Kp forecast and real-time solar wind (Bz, speed, density).

HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
• Right now at a glance. With Pro, tonight's best time and the hours ahead.

WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
Kp, the Kp forecast and solar wind come from NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center. Clouds, temperature and wind come from NOAA's GFS global model (about a 25 km grid), haze and smoke from NOAA's GEFS aerosol model. Light pollution is estimated from NASA's Black Marble night-lights data. Seeing is our own estimate from the model's upper air. These are forecasts for an area, not guarantees: the aurora can surprise in both directions.

FREE AND PRO
Free: the sky right now for your location plus one saved place: the aurora chance, clouds and darkness at this moment, the Kp index now and light pollution, plus the strong-storm alert. No ads, ever.
Pro: tonight hour by hour with the best time to go out, tomorrow and 7 nights ahead with the Kp forecast, smart aurora and clear-sky alerts, the clearer-sky finder, seeing and transparency, cloud layers, live solar wind, unlimited places and the hour-by-hour widget.
Pro is $19.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $3.99 a month. Traveling? The 14-day Trip Pass is $4.99 once and simply ends: no subscription, nothing to cancel. There is no weekly plan. If we ever raise prices, current subscribers keep their price.

Subscription: Glowcast Pro, yearly or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. The Trip Pass is a one-time purchase for 14 days and does not renew.

name: Gravemark
description:
Gravemark is a small notebook for homebrew gravity numbers. Save a batch, record an original gravity and a final gravity, and keep the alcohol figure that comes from that drop. A separate sugar note multiplies the batch volume by the grams-per-litre rate you type.

What you can do

Keep batches with a name, a volume in litres, and a note.
Save readings with original gravity and final gravity. Alcohol by volume is the drop times 131.25.
If the final gravity is not below the original, the stored alcohol figure is zero.
Work out priming sugar as litres times the grams per litre you enter.
Use the bench calculator before you save a reading.
Read short notes that explain exactly which arithmetic the app runs.
What it does not do

Gravemark does not correct for temperature, recommend a carbonation level, or decide whether a bottle is safe. The grams are the multiplication you asked for, not a bottling chart. Records stay in a file on this phone.

Make a yaku, then decide: call "Koi-Koi" and keep going for a bigger score, or stop and lock in your points. That one decision is the heart of the game.
No ads, and no internet connection needed.

HOW TO PLAY
Play a card from your hand and capture a matching card of the same month from the table. Then flip a card from the deck and capture in the same way. Collect Brights, Animals, Ribbons and Chaff cards to form yaku, then choose: call Koi-Koi to continue, or stop to end the round. Play through 3 or 6 months (12 months in the Full Version), and the higher total wins; a tie is a draw.
New to hanafuda? A tutorial of about 2 minutes walks you through a round, and the rules screen shows every yaku with illustrations.

- Classic Koi-Koi rules with 15 yaku
- Big yaku get dramatic effects
- Three CPU strength levels
- A tutorial of about 2 minutes

- No ads, no connection needed
- Native on iPhone, iPad and Mac
- Available in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Korean

THE FULL VERSION
Short games of 3 and 6 months are yours to play as they are. A single one-time purchase of the Full Version unlocks the following for good (no subscription):
- Full 12-month games
- The Strong CPU level
- Switchable House Rules
- Detailed play records
- The Showa-era manga card art
It only adds the Strong level; the other CPU levels play exactly the same.

Enjoy one round at a time, and make the call: Koi-Koi, or stop?

name: Hang Tight: Logic Puzzle
description:
Hang the ornaments. Balance every rod. Breathe out.

Each level is a hanging mobile, like the ones over a crib: wooden rods on strings, with hooks one, two or three steps out from each rod's string. Tap an ornament, tap an empty hook, and watch the rod tip and settle. A rod hangs level when weight × distance is the same on both sides. Level every rod and the whole mobile balances, the lights come on and the confetti falls.

Rods hang from rods, so a finished rod counts as one weight for the rod above it. Balloons pull up, and presents hide their weight until their rod balances. Every level can be worked out one ornament at a time, so there's never any guessing.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap an ornament in the tray, then tap an empty hook to hang it.
• The numbers at a rod's ends show weight × distance on each side. Make them match.
• Heavy ornaments go near the string, light ones near the ends.
• A finished rod is one weight for the rod above it: its number is on its string.
• Tap a hung ornament to take it back down. Take none back for three stars.

FEATURES
• Easy to learn, with a real puzzle in every level
• Levels that never run out, bringing in one new idea at a time: rods on rods, balloons, presents
• Today's puzzle: a new one every day, the same for everyone, with a streak to keep going
• A theme for every day: planets and rockets, fish and bubbles, candy, fruit, gardens and parties, and the holidays' own, from pumpkins and ghosts to a Christmas tree
• Sunday specials: all ones, no two weights the same, a mirror, a tower
• A hint when you're stuck, no timer, and no way to lose
• Calm, clean and simple, with gentle sounds as every rod clicks into balance

Hang Tight is free to play, with ads. One optional purchase, No Ads, ends the ads between levels for good.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you at onedeskstudios.com/hang-tight/support

name: HardryGig
description:
HardryGig on käytännön työkalu pohjoisen rannikon perinteisen kuivakalan (harðfiskur) tekijöille.

Kirjaa kuivauserät, seuraa myyntituloja ja vertaa tuloksia eri sääluokkien sekä erien välillä. Saat selkeän kuvan siitä, milloin ja millä erällä myynti kannattaa.

MITÄ VOIT TEHDÄ
• Hallitse kuivauserät vaiheittain (suunnittelu → ripustus → tarkistus → valmis)
• Kirjaa myyntitulot euromääräisesti ja painon mukaan
• Vertaa tuloja sääluokittain ja erittäin
• Tarkastele kuukausittaisia yhteenvetoja
• Luo ja jaa analyysiraportti PDF-muodossa

HardryGig toimii ilman kirjautumista. Tiedot tallentuvat laitteellesi. Sovellus on suunniteltu vaakasuuntaiseen käyttöön.

Tuki: support-makeeone812@gmail.com

name: Helm: OUPV Captain Exam Prep
description:
Study for your OUPV six-pack captain's license with short daily sessions that work with no signal.

Every answer shows the rule behind it, so you learn why it's right instead of memorizing a letter.

- Practice by topic, with official sample questions and original practice questions
- See lights in a night scene, and flip to the matching day shapes
- Hear fog and maneuvering signals played out loud
- Flashcards with spaced review
- A study plan paced to your exam date, with gentle daily reminders
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Timed mock exams with a topic-by-topic score
- A readiness score that weights your weakest module
- An optional account to keep your progress in step across your devices

Helm covers Rules of the Road, Deck General & Safety, and Navigation General. It doesn't include the Chart Plot module.

Start free with 20 questions in every module. Helm Full Access unlocks every question, every mock exam and every flashcard.

Helm is an independent study aid. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Coast Guard or the National Maritime Center. Official sample questions come from the National Maritime Center's public sample examinations. Helm is for exam study, not navigation.

Helm Full Access is an auto-renewing subscription: $4.99 per month or $29.99 per year, in U.S. dollars, or the equivalent price shown in your country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

name: Hemline
description:
Hemline turns a window and a cloth into a curtain cut. Enter the window width and drop, then pair them with a cloth that carries fullness, usable width, hem, and header. The app returns the finished fabric width, the number of panels rounded up to a whole width, and the cut length that includes the allowances you typed.

Save windows, cloths, and cuts on this phone. A saved cut keeps the panel count and cut length from the moment you stored it, and the detail page also shows the count from the sizes you use now. Short notes explain fullness, panels, and cut length in the same arithmetic the app runs.

Hemline does not estimate lining, pattern repeat, or heading tape. It uses the measurements you enter.

name: Het Huis van Sinterklaas
description:
Welkom in Het Huis van Sinterklaas, een speurtocht-app voor kleuters van Meester Sander.

Tik op een kamer en ga op zoek. In elke kamer liggen drie dingen verstopt. Vind je ze alle 39, dan wacht er een verrassing.

In het huis:
• 13 kamers vol details, van de Pakjeskamer tot de Chocoladeletterkelder
• 12 spelletjes: tellen, sorteren, memory, letters, patronen en meer
• 3 niveaus, van makkelijk tot moeilijk, met 1, 2 of 3 pepernoten
• Meester Sander vertelt bij elke kamer wat je gaat doen

Rustig en veilig:
• Geen reclame
• Geen aankopen in de app
• Geen account nodig
• Werkt zonder internet

Geschikt voor thuis en in de klas, op iPhone en iPad.

name: Hingefish
description:
Hingefish is a fish-tagging game that turns your phone's hinge into a research pole.

You are a marine researcher. You are not here to catch fish, but to get to know them: tag every creature, record it in your research log, watch it in your aquarium and release it back to the sea whenever you like. No fish is ever harmed.

The plank is on the left, the water on the right. Place your poles in the holes on the plank and watch the fish swim. The moment a fish slips under the ring, close the phone: the pole drops into the water and puts a tiny tag on the fish. Open it again and your tagged fish is waiting at the tip of the pole; tap it to bring it into your research aquarium.

On iPhone Duo you really fold the phone. On other iPhones and iPads, just tap the Fold button: the plank flips over onto the water.

FIVE REGIONS, 55 LEVELS
• Harbor, Marsh, Fjord, Open Sea and Glacier
• Bonus levels in every region and a giant boss at the end
• 31 creatures to catch: fish, crabs, octopuses, penguins, rare visitors and the legendary golden fish

THINK FIRST, THEN CLOSE
• Jellyfish melt your pole, sharks snap it
• Turtles and seals are protected: leave them alone
• Watch out for divers: hit one and that catch swims away
• Use bait to lure fish where you want them

FIVE POLES, FIVE STRATEGIES
Wood, silver, turquoise, purple and red poles each have their own power: a wider catch area, or resistance to jellyfish and sharks.

YOUR OWN AQUARIUM
The fish you catch swim in your aquarium: on the outer screen of iPhone Duo when it is closed, and on other devices after Fold or from the Aquarium button on the map. Grow your aquarium, decorate it with coral, a shipwreck or a lighthouse, add a swimming diver and share it with your friends.

RESEARCH LOG
Every species you discover goes into your log. Find every species in a region to earn its reward.

A FAIR GAME
• The first region, Harbor, is completely free
• The Full Game is a one-time purchase that unlocks the other four regions
• No ads, no data collection

Hingefish is designed for iPhone Duo and also plays on every other iPhone and iPad in landscape, using the Fold button.

name: Hinoko: Hazmat Otsu-4 Japan
description:
Study app for Japan's Hazardous Materials Handler exam, Class Otsu-4 (乙種第4類), in Japanese.

Start from the flash point ruler: line up flash points on a thermometer-style scale, see each category and its designated quantity at a glance, and compare 30+ substance cards.

One question, one answer: practice the three subjects (law, physics and chemistry, properties and fire fighting) by unit. All questions are written for this app, each with an explanation and the article of the Fire Service Act, Cabinet Order or Ordinance behind it. Missed questions return on a spaced schedule.

Mock exam: 35 questions as in the real exam (15 law, 10 physics and chemistry, 10 properties), 120 minutes, with the 60%-per-subject pass check and a practice mode for the subject exemption. 6 sets.

Calculation drills: designated quantity multiples and physics and chemistry calculations with fresh numbers every time.

Stay on track: exam-date countdown, a daily menu of 5, 15 or 30 minutes, one rest day a week that keeps your streak, a small stoat mascot that changes outfit as you answer correctly, a widget and reminders.

Some units, 1 mock set, 8 substances and 10 drills a day are included. The full version is a one-time purchase: no subscription, no ads. Study records stay on your device and the app works offline.

This app is independent and not affiliated with the Fire and Disaster Management Agency or the exam body (Japan Fire Service Examination Center). The questions are original, not past exam questions. Content follows the law as of November 2026.

name: Hobimio: Plant & Garden Guide
description:
A simple, friendly guide to your potted plants, balcony and home garden. With Hobimio, find out when to water, what to do this month and what that spot on a leaf is. Your guide Mio, a little leaf character, is always by your side.

My pots and My garden
• Add your plants and keep pots and garden separate
• Track watering and care days for each plant
• The "Today" list on the home screen shows what to do that day, one task at a time
• Your plants and settings stay on your phone

Plant guide: 360 plants
• Houseplants, flowers, succulents, kitchen herbs
• Light, water, temperature, humidity and soil needs; toxicity for pets and children
• Month-by-month care calendar and common problems
• Pruning, feeding, repotting and propagation, step by step
• Can't find a plant? Request it with a photo; voice search is there too

Diagnosis
• Identify my plant: recognizes your plant from a photo; up to 4 photos
• Find the problem with a photo: shows the problem and how to fix it
• Rather not take a photo? Pick the symptom you see, and we'll figure out together whether it's a nutrient problem, a disease or a pest
• Leaf analysis interpretation: enter your lab results and see which nutrient is low or high

See it in place and light meter
• See it in place: before you buy a plant, put it in your room or garden through the camera; enlarge, rotate and take a photo
• Light meter: hold your phone where the plant sits and find out if it's in the right spot

Mio and privacy
• Mio greets you on the home screen, shows what you can do and looks into problems with you
• No account needed; no name, email or location required
• No ads
• Photos are sent for analysis only with your permission and are not stored
• Use "Write to us" inside the app to send a message; replies arrive in the app

Hobimio Plus
Everything is open for the first 7 days. After that you keep the free version, or continue with Plus if you like it.

In the free version
• Basic guide info (light, water, temperature, humidity, soil, toxicity)
• Identifying plants in the guide
• Watering and care tracking for 1 plant
• Find the problem with your first 2 photos
• 2 See it in place tries

With Plus
• All care steps and fix steps for problems
• Watering and care tracking for all your plants
• 10 photo checks a month
• Identifying plants that aren't in the guide, with care info
• Optional, more detailed AI review
• Unlimited See it in place
• "What to do this month" every month
• Leaf analysis interpretation

Subscription: Plus is available as a monthly or yearly subscription; the price is shown in the App Store. Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Diagnoses and suggestions are general information.

Privacy policy: https://hobimio.net/en/privacy/
Terms of use: https://hobimio.net/en/terms/
Support: destek@agromio.net

name: HomeCraft
description: Track a renovation on your iPhone: room files, measurements, material estimates, costs, tasks, before-and-after photos, and a project report. HomeCraft works offline with no account. Records stay on the device until you export a backup. Estimates follow the sizes and coverage you enter, so check product specs before you buy.

name: HomeNom: Recipe Box
description:
HomeNom is a recipe box made for cooking with HomeView.

HomeView has a great step-by-step cooking view, but it only appears for recipe pages opened in Safari. HomeNom gives every recipe you save a clean page of its own, so the recipe from your notes, a reel, or a blog buried in ads opens on HomeView the same way: one step at a time, with the ingredients a tap away.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
• Share a recipe page from Safari. HomeNom keeps the recipe and leaves the life story behind.
• Share a reel or video with the recipe in its caption.
• Share or paste a note, however it is written. HomeNom works out the ingredients and the steps.
• Each recipe keeps its photo, times, servings and a link back to where it came from.

READ ON YOUR DEVICE
On iPhone and iPad with Apple Intelligence, notes and captions are read into ingredients and steps on the device.

KEEP IT ORGANIZED
• Sort recipes into lists: weeknight dinners, baking, Sunday brunch.
• Tag them, mark favorites, and search by title, ingredient or tag.
• Fix anything by hand. Ingredients and steps are plain text, one per line.
• Your recipe box syncs between iPhone and iPad with iCloud.

COOK ON HOMEVIEW
• Tap the Safari button on any recipe to open its page.
• Hand it off or AirDrop it to HomeView and choose Start Cooking.
• Pages work in any browser too, so a link is an easy way to send someone a recipe.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. A recipe gets a page only when you ask for one, and the link is long and unlisted. The page comes down by itself a week after you last opened it, and removing the page or deleting the recipe takes it down right away.

FREE TO START
HomeNom is free for your first 10 recipes, with every feature included. HomeNom Unlimited removes the limit for $1.99 a month or $19 a year (prices vary by region). It is an auto-renewing subscription: payment is charged to your Apple Account, and it renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://homenom.app/privacy

name: Hopsa: Family Play Ideas
description:
Out of ideas? Hopsa has one ready in 10 seconds.

Hopsa suggests a screen-free activity that fits your kids’ ages, your situation and your energy, then walks you through it step by step. Made for parents, grandparents and carers of children aged 3 to 12.

WHAT’S INSIDE
• Today’s idea: one activity a day, matched to every child playing today
• 240+ illustrated activities in 11 categories: active play, arts and crafts, little experiments, cooking, games and puzzles, word games, storytelling, pretend play, music, outdoors and calm time
• Situations for real life: no supplies, from the couch, waiting games, rainy day, sick day and keepsakes
• Step-by-step mode with a timer, tips, easier and harder versions, and safety notes
• 15 conversation decks with 196 questions that get more than “fine”
• Mood check-in for 8 feelings: what to ask, what can help and activities that fit
• Story dice for making up stories together
• Playlists: ready-made sets for a specific moment
• A 20-minute daily goal, a streak and a journal of your moments together
• An optional daily reminder with one idea, never more than one notification a day

WRITTEN FOR YOUR LANGUAGE
Hopsa is available in English, Polish, German, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese. Each language has its own local games, songs and recipes, not word-for-word translations.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account and no ads. Your children’s names and ages stay on your phone. All activities and illustrations are on your phone, so Hopsa works without an internet connection.

FREE AND HOPSA PLUS
The free version stays useful: today’s idea, 48 activities, 2 conversation decks, all moods, story dice, the journal and the daily goal, with one child profile.

Hopsa Plus unlocks all 240+ activities, every conversation deck and playlist, and profiles for all your children.
• Annual plan with a 7-day free trial. We remind you 2 days before the trial ends.
• Monthly plan.
• Lifetime: one payment, no subscription.
Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers your family. Cancel in two taps: Settings › Manage subscription.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://labtwominds.com/hopsa/privacy

name: Hospitalium: Shift to Insanity
description:
Welcome to Hospitalium, the hospital where no disease is normal!

You start alone, with one bed and a box of bandages. Treat your first patients, collect the cash and turn a tiny clinic into a giant hospital with five wings full of crazy rooms.

ABSURD DISEASES
Green Flu that makes people sneeze broccoli, Duck Cough, Balloon Head, Endless Hiccups, Runaway Skeleton, Lava Fever... Every disease needs the right room, and some leave the hospital in chaos: feathers, confetti, lava and jelly all over the floor!

BUILD AND EXPAND
Open the General Practice, the Ward, the Pharmacy, the X-Ray, the Head Inflation Machine, the Invisibility Lab and much more. Upgrade beds and equipment to earn more and treat patients faster.

MANAGE YOUR STOCK
Order bandages, IV fluid, pills and other supplies at the Storeroom terminal. Fetch the boxes from the unloading bay and shelve them before the rooms run out.

HIRE YOUR TEAM
Specialist doctors, receptionists, janitors and stockers. They start as interns (slow and sleepy!) and, with training, become unstoppable experts. But watch out: salaries are due every payday. No money, and they go on strike... and may even quit!

KEEP IT CLEAN
Unmade beds and dirty floors drive patients away and cost your hospital its stars. The better your reputation, the more patients arrive.

DIRECTOR'S CAREER
Every time the hospital levels up you earn Medals. Spend them on 100 Career levels to walk faster, carry more boxes, treat and clean quicker and earn more.

SEASON PASS
New rewards every season: Cred-Hosp, cash and special items.

Have fun, manage wisely and prove you can keep your sanity in the most insane hospital ever!

name: Hotseat Pro
description:
Hotseat Pro is the app for salons, barbershops and the stylists who work in them. It's your calendar, checkout and client book in one place, built by a working stylist of 25 years.

Hotseat Pro is for shops that use Hotseat. Shop accounts are set up on hotseatbooking.com; once your shop is on Hotseat, everyone on the team signs in here.

A CALENDAR THAT UNDERSTANDS HAIR
- Day and week views for one stylist or the whole team, side by side
- Colour processing time stays bookable, so a toner never blocks out an hour
- Hold and drag to move a visit, block off time, add breaks, repeat standing appointments
- See who's here, who's in the chair, and who's running early

DYNAMIC PRICING
- Prices that follow demand: busy times earn a little more, and you see exactly what it added
- You set the floor and ceiling; rebooking clients keep their regular price

CHECKOUT IN A FEW TAPS
- Check out from the appointment, with the whole visit already on the bill
- Tips, discounts, cash, card, split payments and gift cards
- Receipts by text or email, with a one-tap way to book the next visit

KNOW YOUR CLIENTS
- Client cards with visit history, notes, photos and what they spend
- Text, call or email from the card
- Search by name, phone or email

REMINDERS AND A FULL BOOK
- Clients get confirmations and reminders automatically
- A waitlist that fills cancelled spots
- Rebook offers at checkout

RUN THE SHOP
- Reports: today, this week, by stylist, rent and retail
- Team roles for owners, managers, stylists and booth renters
- Gift cards, retail and products

BUILT FOR YOUR PHONE
- Sign in with Face ID
- Notifications when a client books, cancels, moves, pays or arrives, and you choose which ones
- Tap a notification to jump straight to that appointment

Questions? Tap Help inside the app, or visit hotseatbooking.com/help.

name: Hovercast: Drone Weather & UAV
description:
Hovercast shows, hour by hour, whether the weather fits your drone at the height you plan to fly. Pick your model, set your altitude and read a simple fly / caution / don't-fly strip, with the reason for every warning in one sentence.

YOUR DRONE, YOUR HEIGHT
• Choose from about 23 DJI, Autel and Potensic models. Each one uses the wind resistance its manufacturer publishes. Flying something else? Enter your own wind limit.
• Set your flight altitude anywhere from 10 to 120 m (about 30 to 400 ft). Hovercast looks at sustained wind and gusts at that height, not just at ground level.
• Rain and snow, thunderstorm risk, visibility, cloud ceiling, temperature and the Kp index (geomagnetic activity that can affect GPS and compass) count for every hour.
• Each caution or don't-fly hour tells you why in one sentence, for example: "Gusts at 100 m are above your drone's wind limit."

BUILT AROUND DAYLIGHT
• Flight windows only count daylight hours, so a windy night doesn't spoil a calm morning. Night flying can be switched on in Settings.

BEFORE YOU TAKE OFF
• Return-wind tip: which way to launch so the trip home is downwind, when your battery is lower.
• Cold-battery warning below 10 °C (50 °F) and a stronger one below 0 °C (32 °F). If it's colder than your model is rated for, Hovercast tells you.

WIND BY ALTITUDE (PRO)
• Wind at 10, 30, 60, 90 and 120 m side by side, so you can pick a height that works.

FLIGHT-WINDOW ALERTS (PRO)
• The evening before, you get a note like "Tomorrow 7:00–10:30 AM looks flyable for your Air 3 at Beach."
• If that window disappears overnight, a morning update lets you know.

AIRSPACE: ALWAYS CHECK THE OFFICIAL SOURCE
• In the US, Hovercast shows the FAA UAS Facility Map (LAANC grid) ceiling at your spot and links to B4UFLY.
• In other countries, a button opens the official national drone map.
• Hovercast never tells you an area is allowed. You are the pilot: the decision is yours, and so is checking the local rules.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
• The next hours at a glance. The large widget comes with Pro.

WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
Weather comes from NOAA's GFS global model at 0.25° (about a 25 km grid). The Kp index comes from NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center. This is an area forecast: trees, buildings and hills can make gusts stronger right where you stand, and any forecast can be wrong. Look at the sky before you launch.

FREE AND PRO
Free: today and tomorrow, your current location plus one saved spot, and every warning in the app. Warnings are never behind the paywall.
Pro: 7 days ahead, unlimited spots, wind by altitude, flight-window alerts and the large widget.
Pro is $19.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $3.99 a month. The date your trial ends is shown before you pay. There is no weekly plan.
Our price promise: if we ever raise prices, current subscribers keep the price they signed up at.

Subscription: Hovercast Pro, yearly or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vayronapps.com/hovercast/privacy.html

name: HubStation Order Pager
description:
HubStation turns your order slip into a pager on your phone.

Scan the QR code printed on your order slip at any restaurant or café that uses HubStation, and your order page opens instantly, with no sign-up and no account:

• Your order number and live status: "We're preparing your order", then "Your order is ready".
• Tap "Notify me" and your phone rings with a pager tone as soon as your order is ready, even when it's locked.
• A Lock Screen card lets you follow your order without unlocking your phone.
• Your e-invoice is kept for 30 days, to view or save whenever you need it.
• We never ask for your name or phone number. No ads, no tracking.

No download needed: scan the code with your iPhone camera and the HubStation App Clip opens right away. Install the app to keep all your orders and invoices in one place.

HubStation is a POS and management system for restaurants and cafés.

name: huch Cargo
description:
huch Cargo is the work app for cargo companies on the huch.mn platform and their warehouse staff in China and Mongolia.

One app for everyone: what you see depends on your account. The interface is in Mongolian and Chinese and can be switched at any time.

• China warehouse — receive parcels by scanning the tracking barcode, weigh them and take a photo; the customer code links each parcel to its owner. Bag parcels and assign them to a truck.
• Mongolia warehouse — unload and check arriving trucks, put parcels on shelves, release parcels to customers, take payments and prepare home deliveries.
• Company overview — parcels in China, in transit and in Mongolia, overdue and unclaimed parcels, today's receiving and pickups, revenue and account balance. Set the day's exchange rate, manage staff access and look up customers.

Accounts are issued by the cargo company's administrator. huch.mn

name: Huddlewise: Class Groups
description:
Huddlewise makes fair groups in seconds, following the rules that matter in a real classroom.

Load your class once, set your rules, and tap Make groups. Huddlewise does the juggling for you.

SMART RULES
• Keep apart: these two never end up together
• Keep together: pair a new student with a buddy
• Mixed or similar ability levels, your choice each time
• Balance gender
• Spread home-language speakers out, or group them for support
• Spread strong leaders and students who need support across groups
• Avoid repeat partners from recent lessons
• If a rule can't be met, the app tells you which one

ROLES THAT ROTATE
Leader, scribe, timekeeper and presenter (or your own roles) are shared out fairly, so the same student isn't always in charge.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Tap to swap or move anyone
• Lock people in place and reshuffle the rest
• Undo and redo

MADE FOR THE CLASSROOM
• Full-screen projector view with a shuffle reveal
• Private details are never shown on screen
• Random name picker that doesn't repeat anyone until everyone has had a turn
• Group work timer
• Mark students absent with one tap

FAST SETUP
Paste a list, import a CSV or Excel file, or import a Google Sheet.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save groupings with a date and label. Share them as an image, copy them as text for Google Classroom or WhatsApp, or print a PDF.

WORKS EVERYWHERE
Use it on iPhone and iPad, or sign in on the web from any PC or Mac at huddlewise.expo.app. Your classes sync automatically. Prefer no account? Use it on your device only.

Built by a teacher with over 20 years in international schools. No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions.

name: Hug Back: Calm Parent Journal
description:
Every parent loses it sometimes. What matters most is what happens next.

Hug Back is a small, quiet app for the moments after you've raised your voice. It helps you go back to your child, notice your patterns, and try one small change at a time. No judgment, no streaks, no lectures.

LOG IT IN SECONDS
When things calm down, tap once: you held it in, you were a bit sharp, or you blew up. Add how tired you were, and a one-line note if you want. That's it.

GO BACK AND HUG
After a hard moment, Hug Back offers a simple sentence you can say to your child, like "I was too loud just now. It wasn't your fault." It doesn't need to be perfect. Going back matters more than never getting angry.

SEE YOUR OWN PATTERN
Once you've logged a few hard moments, Hug Back looks at the last four weeks and tells you when they tend to happen, for example "between 6 and 8 pm," and whether you were exhausted each time. If it doesn't sound like you, tap "That's not me" and it stops guessing.

ONE SMALL THING A WEEK
Pick one thing to try next week: eat something before your hard hour, ask your partner to take over for half an hour, or your own idea. Hug Back can send a gentle reminder just before your tired hours.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• No cloud, no tracking, no AI
• Your entries stay on your phone
• Export your entries as a CSV anytime

ALSO
• Light and dark mode
• English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português

Hug Back is not therapy or counseling. If you often feel you can't cope, please reach out to people close to you or to a professional.

name: HUK - Treasure Hunt
description:
The official app of the Hizb Ul Khair Fun Drive Treasure Hunt in Dubai.

Gather your team, register your car, and on the day follow the clues to real places across the Emirates. Every place you reach wins gold coins for your team.

SOLVE THE CLUES
Your route opens at flag-off. Each clue may be a picture, a poster, a riddle or a voice clue. Work it out together and drive there.

ARRIVE AND WIN COINS
When your car reaches a place, it is marked found by itself and the coins are added at once, with a celebration on the screen. Some places have a task to do or a marshal to meet.

STUCK? BUY A HINT
Spend coins to open a hint, a second hint, or the answer. Your companions see what the captain opens.

SCAVENGER HUNT
Find and photograph the items on the scavenger list along the way for extra coins.

YOUR WHOLE TEAM
The captain registers the car; up to three companions join with the team code and follow the same clues on their own phones.

HELP ON THE DAY
Chat with the organisers, get announcements and notifications, and see the leaderboard when the organisers share it.

THE RESULTS, LIVE
At the end, the top teams are revealed one by one on every phone.

SAFETY FIRST
Clues hide while the car goes faster than the event's limit. The passenger handles the phone, never the driver.

The app is for registered participants of Hizb Ul Khair events. Registration is approved by the organisers.

name: Hum: Haptic Calm
description:
Hum is a calm-down tool you feel instead of watch. It uses your iPhone's haptics, so you can use it with your eyes closed, under a desk or in bed.

HOLD
Press and hold anywhere for a slow, heartbeat-like pulse. It gradually slows down while you hold, and fades out gently when you let go.

FIDGET
Four tactile toys, each in its own corner so your thumb always finds them: a crisp switch, a ratchet dial, poppable bubbles and soft sand. A double tick tells you when you cross from one to the next.

BREATHE
Vibration guides your breathing. Taps grow stronger as you breathe in, and one smooth fade follows as you breathe out. Choose 1, 3 or 5 minutes. The screen dims by itself.

TUNE
Set the strength so it feels right for you.

FREE, WITHOUT THE NAGGING
Hold, two fidgets, slow breathing and the widget are free, with no ads, no time limits and no account.

ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Pay once to unlock everything. There is no subscription.
- All four fidgets
- Box and 4-7-8 breathing
- Tune the feel and the pace
- Pocket mode: a black screen and a slow breathing pulse for your pocket, your desk or bedtime

Also included: a Home Screen and Lock Screen widget, and a shortcut for the Action Button and Siri that starts calm breathing right away.

Hum collects no data. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Hum is a relaxation tool, not a medical device, and it does not diagnose or treat any condition. It requires an iPhone, because haptics are not available on iPad.

name: Hushi: White Noise for Babies
seller_name: FUTUROMY BILISIM VE YAZILIM DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Hushi helps your baby fall asleep with calm, steady white noise — and stops gently on its own.

Pick a sound, pick how long, press play. When the timer ends the sound fades out slowly, so your little one isn't woken by a sudden silence.

SOUNDS FOR BABIES, TODDLERS AND KIDS
• White, pink and brown noise
• Rain, fan, ocean
• Shush and heartbeat (womb-like sounds for newborns)
Every sound loops seamlessly, with no gaps or clicks.

SLEEP TIMER WITH GENTLE FADE-OUT
• 15, 30, 45, 60 or 90 minutes, all night, or your own time
• Fade-out from 10 seconds to 2 minutes, optional soft fade-in

KEEPS PLAYING WITH THE SCREEN OFF
Lock your phone or switch apps — the sound keeps going, with controls on the lock screen.

SLEEP LOG
See how long each nap and night ran, your 7-day average and your baby's favorite sound.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

Safe use: keep the phone about 2 m (7 ft) from your baby and the volume low. Hushi is not a medical device.

Subscription: 3-day free trial, then $0.99/month. Cancel anytime in your App Store settings.

Terms of Use: https://apps.futuromy.com/hushi/terms
Privacy Policy: https://apps.futuromy.com/hushi/privacy

name: Hushlight: Baby Night Light
description:
Hushlight turns your iPhone into a soft, dim night light for night feeds, diaper changes, and cuddles, without waking anyone. Including you.

MADE FOR THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT
• Warm reds and ambers, the gentlest colors on sleepy eyes, plus a soft white for diaper checks
• Swipe anywhere on the light to dim it, all the way down to the lowest brightness your phone allows
• It opens at your last brightness, so you're never blasted with daytime light in a dark room
• A sleep timer fades the light out slowly when your little one is down, then lets your phone lock
• Your screen stays ON while the light is ON, so your hands stay free

ON IN ONE TAP
• Add Hushlight to your Lock Screen or Control Center
• Home Screen widgets, lovely in StandBy while your phone charges
• Turn it on from Shortcuts or the Action button

A SLEEPY LITTLE FRIEND
A sleepy baby rests in the glow and keeps you company through the night. Watch closely: they might do something cute.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Nothing about you or your family leaves your phone.
• The sleep-friendly colors, warm white, sleep timer, and sleepy baby are free.

HUSHLIGHT PLUS
A one-time purchase unlocks 19 more colors (blues, greens, purples, pinks, and neutrals) and every future Plus feature. It's shared with your family through Family Sharing.

Tip: plug in your phone if you'll leave the light on all night.

name: Hushmoth
description:
Some nights are quiet. Some are restless. Every night deserves a place to land.

Hushmoth is a personal nightly ritual where your feelings become part of a growing moth garden.

Choose how you feel, leave a little note if you wish, and release a moth into your garden. Each moth marks a moment in your life. Over time, your garden becomes a visual collection of the nights you've lived.

A small ritual, with room to grow.

YOUR NIGHTLY RITUAL

Choose from six feelings with a single tap.

Add a personal note of up to 280 characters.

Release a moth to mark your night.

A GARDEN OF MEMORIES

Watch your moth garden grow with each check-in.

Revisit past entries through your personal journal.

Explore your feelings through a monthly calendar.

YOUR WEEKLY REFLECTION

Receive a weekly Moon Letter reflecting your recorded mood patterns.

Keep your reflection or share it with others.

A GENTLE REMINDER

Set an optional daily reminder.

Choose a time that fits your routine.

Turn reminders on or off whenever you like.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your journal belongs to you.

No account or sign-in required.

Journal entries are stored locally on your iPhone.

No advertising or tracking.

No data collection or external servers.

Delete your journal data at any time through Settings.

Hushmoth is a personal journaling and reflection tool, not a medical application. It does not diagnose, treat, or prevent medical conditions.

Take a moment. Release a moth. Let your garden grow.

name: I.S Stage Plot
description:
I.S Stage Plot is the stage plot maker that plans the whole event. Built by a sound engineer, for sound companies, engineers, production managers, staging companies and bands.

Draw the stage – or just type the line-up the way you would text it – and everything else comes from that one plot.

STAGE PLOT
• 50+ instruments, amps, monitors, speakers, risers and stage items
• Type "6 piece band, drums on a riser, wedges for everyone" and the stage is drawn
• Rectangle, round, half-round and curved-front stages, in feet or meters
• Pinch to zoom, drag to move, press and hold for the item menu

INPUT LIST, MONITORS AND OUTPUTS
• Channels numbered in FOH order, with the mic, stand and 48V for every input
• Monitor mixes linked to each musician; Main L/R, subs and every mix numbered
• Pick the console by brand and model and see when the stage has more inputs than it mixes

CABLES AND POWER
• Every cable measured on the plot – across the floor, up the riser and up the stand
• Sub-snakes and stage boxes placed for you
• Power drops, extension cables and power strips counted

COMPANY INVENTORY AND RENTALS
• Enter your stock once: mics, consoles, speakers, cables, stands, wireless and your own items
• Every event shows what comes from stock, what is short and what to rent
• A load list for the warehouse and a rental order grouped by supplier

MULTI-STAGE EVENTS
• A main stage, a second and a third stage in one event, each with its own plot and time
• One equipment list and one technical rider for the whole event

STAGING PLAN
• Every deck and riser with size and finished height
• Deck counts, stairs, guardrails and skirting
• Export as PDF, Excel or CAD (DXF)

3D
• See the stage from the audience, front of house or the drummer's seat
• Export a 3D picture, a 3D model or a fly-around video

ONE TECHNICAL RIDER
• Stage plot, input list, monitors, outputs, power and 3D views in one PDF
• Send it with the share sheet: Files, AirDrop, Mail or a printer
• Or share a link, so the band, the venue and the crew always see the latest version

The same account works on the web at is-stage-plot.vercel.app, so a plot started on your iPhone or iPad opens on a computer and the other way round.

Free to start. Sign in with your email and a password.

name: Ice Colony: Penguin Puzzle
description:
Welcome to the colony! Penguins are waiting on the ice with colored blocks to carry, and the ice hole is open.

Tap a squad and watch the penguins waddle out, grab blocks of their color and drop them into the hole. Clear the board before your slots run out of room.

- Picture levels: the blocks make up a drawing that gets more detailed as you go
- Four boosters: Extra Slot, Recall, Ice Pick and Shuffle
- Daily rewards to claim every day
- A colorblind mode with a shape for every color
- Music, sound and haptics you can switch off

Ice Colony is free to play. It shows short ads between levels and optional reward ads, and offers optional in-app purchases, including one to remove the ads between levels. New levels are downloaded over the internet when available.

name: Idle Great Voyage
description:
Idle Great Voyage is an idle naval RPG set in the age of sail. Build a fleet, trade across 29 ports and fight pirates on the seas of 1588. Your ships battle on their own, and your voyage keeps going while you're away.
Start with one small ship. Read the markets, hire a crew from every culture, upgrade your fleet and choose where to sail next. You make the plan; the ocean does the rest.

■ A FLEET THAT FIGHTS FOR YOU
- Your ships fight naval battles on their own against enemy fleets, flagships and chapter bosses on the Battle screen.
- Skill cut-ins such as Volley and Focus Fire.
- Spend gold on six upgrades: attack, defense, maneuverability, sailing speed, hull and fire rate.
- Buy bigger ships, including the new Galleass, Great Carrack and Great Galleon. Repair costs scale with ship size.

■ NEW IN 1.7.0: FORTRESS ASSAULTS AND DIPLOMACY
- Assault 19 harbor fortresses in five waves and watch their defenses fall in three stages.
- Open the Diplomacy screen to check your reputation with each nation.
- Battle weather (rain, snow and fog), upgraded cannon effects and sounds, and new boss battle music.

■ A MARKET YOU CAN READ
- Sail and trade between 29 ports in six regions: Europe, Africa, North America, South America, Persia and Asia.
- Prices change every hour. Use the price board, 24-hour charts and the world price table to buy low and sell high.
- Storms, tailwinds, rich catches and pirate encounters can strike at sea. A voyage report tells you how it went when you arrive.

■ OVER 150 CREW WITH THEIR OWN STORIES
- Hire sailors in the tavern and station them where they fit: gun deck, rigging, repair crew, cargo hold.
- Crew come from every region with names and clothing of their own culture.
- Every sailor has strengths, a weakness and a signature skill. Pay their wages, or they go on strike.

■ GOALS THAT KEEP GROWING
- Pick one of seven captains and follow port stories and the main quests.
- Meet monarchs in the Audience Hall, earn Renown and unlock new skills in the Renown Tech Tree.
- Take on the Pirate Den and Fleet Dungeons. New continents open as your Fleet Level grows.
- Come back to a Return Reward (up to 3 hours per return, with a daily limit).

■ FOUR LANGUAGES
Play in English, Korean, Japanese or Traditional Chinese.

■ GOOD TO KNOW
- Contains optional rewarded ads for reward multipliers, resting, extra dungeon entries and revives. Base rewards need no ads.
- Optional in-app purchases: one-time packs with every item listed.
- Your progress is saved to the cloud. Delete your account and saved data any time in Settings > Account · Cloud Save > Delete Account.

This is a work of fiction set in a historical age. People, events and places are reimagined for the game.

Official website: https://great-voyage-official.web.app/
Support: shortshootai@gmail.com

name: IdleSlice
description:
Thanks for being with us! We are constantly iterating and improving—please feel free to leave your suggestions at any time.

Stop wasting the gap between one place and the next. IdleSlice turns a wait into a bite-sized pack—only as long as the window you still have—so a clinic lobby, train ride or counter queue becomes a few clean slices instead of blank scrolling.

PICK A WAIT WINDOW
Name the gap you keep falling into and dial the minutes you still have:
- Built-in kinds: Clinic, Commute, Queue, Meal wait, Pickup, or Custom
- Sample windows load on first launch so you can try a pack immediately
- Set a default length, then override minutes on the home dial (3, 5, 8, 12, 20)
- Bite this pack opens a short list sized for that window

BITE A PACK
- Each pack is a short run of micro-tasks matched to your minutes
- Mark Done, Skip or Later as you go; Focus opens one task with its steps
- Swap pack mid-window if the list no longer fits the time left
- End the window anytime; finished sessions land in the Wait log

YOUR MICRO-TASK LIBRARY
- Tasks carry a tag—Reply, Money, Body, Home, Learn, Admin—and a rough time estimate
- Filter the Library by tag, add your own micro-tasks, and browse packs by minute range
- Sample packs clear from Controls when you’re ready to keep only what you built

STREAK AND WAIT LOG
- Streak board shows minutes bitten this week and how many days in a row you used a gap
- Wait log lists closed windows with type, length and finish rate
- Filter the log by window kind when you want one slice of history

GENTLE LOCAL NUDGES
- Optional daily window ping at the hour you set in Controls
- Default window length lives in Controls so the dial starts where you usually are
- Park a short bench note locally if something should feel faster next time

NO ACCOUNT, NO TRACKING
There is no sign-in, no ads, no analytics and no IdleSlice server. Windows, packs, sessions and preferences stay on this iPhone. Clear sample packs or wipe all local data anytime in Controls.

IdleSlice is a wait-window notebook for micro-tasks, not a productivity coach or medical advice. Use the minutes you have—and leave the rest of the gap alone.
