name: Improve Yourself
description:
Improve Yourself ist deine Challenge-App für 30, 90 oder 365 Tage.

Du legst deine täglichen Regeln fest, zum Beispiel Training, Wasser, Schlaf oder Laufen, und hakst sie jeden Tag ab. Sind alle Regeln erledigt, ist der Tag gewonnen.

DEINE CHALLENGE
• 30, 90 oder 365 Tage
• Über 100 Regel-Vorlagen mit Suche, dazu eigene Regeln, auch mit Tagesziel zum Hochzählen (z. B. 3 L Wasser, 5 km)
• Trainingstage pro Woche frei wählbar: an den übrigen Tagen zählt der Tag auch ohne Training
• Flex-Tag, wenn mal etwas dazwischenkommt
• Serie, beste Serie und Übersicht über alle Tage
• Erinnerungen zu deinen eigenen Uhrzeiten: Aufstehen, Training, Trinken in frei wählbarem Abstand und mehr
• Dunkler und heller Modus

APPLE HEALTH
Auf Wunsch liest die App Schritte, Wasser, Schlaf und Trainings aus Apple Health, damit sich passende Regeln selbst abhaken. Die App schreibt nichts in Apple Health, und die Daten bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

PREMIUM
• 8 Trainingskurse mit geführten Einheiten, Fotos zu jeder Übung und Pausen-Timer
• Eigener Trainingsplan: Übungen nach Bereich und Gerät filtern, Tage pro Woche festlegen oder mit einer Vorlage starten
• 64 Rezepte mit Kalorien und Makros: Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Snacks und Shakes
• Einzelne Kurse und Rezepte sind kostenlos

DEINE DATEN
• Kein Konto nötig
• Dein Stand wird auf dem Gerät gespeichert und über iCloud gesichert

ABO
Premium gibt es monatlich oder jährlich, mit 7 Tagen kostenloser Testphase für neue Abonnenten. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, wenn es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf gekündigt wird. Verwalten und kündigen kannst du es in den Einstellungen deines Apple-Accounts.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://www.adkid.de/datenschutz

name: Ingrevia: Food Scanner
description:
Ingrevia shows you what is in a product before you buy it.

Scan the barcode of a food, cosmetic or hygiene product and see its ingredients, additives, allergens and nutrition, plus a score from 0 to 100 with a full breakdown of how it was calculated.

WHAT YOU GET

• A clear score for every product, with the reasons behind it
• Nutrition at a glance: sugar, salt, saturated fat, calories, protein and fibre
• Additives explained, with their level of concern
• Nutri-Score, NOVA processing group and Eco-Score where available
• Cosmetics checked for ingredients such as fragrance, sulfates and parabens

MADE FOR YOUR DIET

Tell Ingrevia what matters to you: vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free or lactose-free. Products that conflict with your choices are flagged right away, including ingredients that are easy to miss, such as gelatine or carmine.

NOT IN THE DATABASE?

Take a photo of the ingredients list. The text is read on your iPhone, you can correct it, and Ingrevia analyses it on the spot.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Only the barcode number is sent, to look the product up
• History, favorites and preferences stay on your device

ALSO

• Scan history and favorites, with search
• Type a barcode by hand when scanning is not possible
• Share a product analysis when you choose to
• Available in English, German, French and Italian

Product data comes from Open Food Facts and Open Beauty Facts, two community-maintained open databases, and may be incomplete. Ingrevia does not provide medical advice and does not guarantee that a product is safe or suitable for you. Always check the label if you have an allergy.

name: Ink Slit
description:
Ink Slit is for the moment the ink is still wet and one Uyghur letter is still joined in the word.

Thirty-two letters sit on the slit. Hold one and draw it from alone, through the start, the middle, and the end. The shape in your hand changes at each seat. The slit tells you whether the letter holds the next one or lets go. A consonant shows its eight open syllables. A vowel shows itself after b. When all four seats are drawn, pin the letter. Letters pinned, letters holding on, letters letting go, and letters still bare are counted on this iPhone.

The pinned letter stays on this iPhone for you. There is no account, network, sample pin, vocabulary lesson, grammar, audio, or payment. Nothing is shared.

name: Inovar Service
description:
O Inovar Service reúne as informações do atendimento técnico em campo e conecta profissionais, clientes e parceiros autorizados à central da Inovar.

ORDENS DE SERVIÇO
Consulte os atendimentos liberados para seu perfil e registre informações do equipamento, horários, deslocamentos, diagnóstico e trabalho realizado.

REGISTROS DO ATENDIMENTO
Adicione fotos, relatos de áudio e assinaturas. Consulte fichas, documentos, avisos e informações disponibilizadas pela Inovar conforme as permissões da sua conta.

TRABALHO OFFLINE
Após o primeiro acesso e a sincronização com internet, registre o trabalho mesmo sem conexão. Sincronize com a central quando houver internet e o envio estiver autorizado.

PRIVACIDADE E CONTROLE
Consulte a política de privacidade e gerencie a autorização de envio de dados em Minha conta → Privacidade e suporte.

O aplicativo é gratuito. O acesso aos serviços exige uma conta fornecida pela Inovar. Os recursos disponíveis variam conforme o perfil e as permissões atribuídas. O primeiro acesso exige conexão com a internet.

Suporte: contato@grupoinovarservice.com.br

Na Área do cliente, consulte as máquinas, a agenda da frota e os relatórios em PDF liberados para sua conta. Na entrega técnica, a equipe pode preencher o checklist e solicitar as assinaturas do cliente no aplicativo.

name: Is It a Sign? - Omen Meanings
description:
Is It a Sign? helps you find out whether the owl, the song or the 11:11 you keep noticing really means something. Describe the moment and get an honest reading in seconds, so you can stop wondering and know what to do next.

Seeing owls everywhere? A cardinal at the window on a special day? Your song playing the moment you think of someone? Write what happened in your own words and get a clear answer: is it meaningful, what kind of message it could be, and what it might be telling you. For entertainment and self-reflection.

Honest Readings
• Not every coincidence is the universe talking, and we say so: everyday moments get an honest “Just a coincidence, for now”
• When something truly stands out, you can trust that it’s worth your attention

Your Score From 0 to 100
• A Sign Score based on how unusual, specific and repeated your experience is
• The kind of message: Confirmation, Warning, Change coming, Let go, Love or Pay attention
• The symbol’s meaning, a short interpretation and one small step to take next

150 Symbols and Their Meanings
• Birds and feathers: owl meaning, cardinal meaning, crow, hawk, dove, hummingbird
• Spirit animals: black cat, fox, deer, snake, wolf, plus butterflies, dragonflies and moths
• Repeating numbers like 111, 333 and 11:11, songs and sounds, names and words
• Dreams, rainbows, flowers, the moon, coins, keys, lights, scents, déjà vu and crossroads

Patterns That Build Over Time
• Notice the same symbol twice and it’s marked; three times and you watch the pattern form
• Your log keeps every reading, so you finally see which omens keep finding you and what your coincidences have in common

Share, Calm and Private
• Story-sized cards for your strongest readings, and for the honestly funny “18 / 100” ones too
• A calm night-sky design in light and dark, with gentle readings for grief, big decisions and hard days
• No account, no email, no location: your readings stay on your phone

One Price, Forever
• One free reading every day
• Unlock everything with one small, one-time purchase: unlimited readings, your full history, pattern alerts and a weekly summary
• No subscription. Ever.

Is It a Sign? is for entertainment and self-reflection. It doesn’t predict the future and isn’t a substitute for professional advice. If you’re going through something heavy, please reach out to someone you trust, or call or text 988 in the US.

name: Japan Travel Stickers
description:
Share a travel moment with a little of Japan.

Japan Travel Stickers brings together 48 illustrated stickers for iMessage: 16 in Japanese and 32 in English. Choose a collection for a trip around Japan or a visit to Ise.

JAPAN TRAVEL — 16 ENGLISH + 16 JAPANESE
Original poster-style illustrations feature Mount Fuji, Asakusa, Fushimi Inari, Arashiyama, Nara, Himeji Castle, Miyajima, Shirakawa-go, Kenrokuen, Otaru, Biei, Kusatsu Onsen, Matsumoto Castle, Amanohashidate, the Tottori Sand Dunes and Ishigaki Island. Share a meeting spot, a photo moment, an arrival or a well-earned break.

ISE TRAVEL — 16 ENGLISH
Meet at Uji Bridge, let friends know you have reached the Outer or Inner Shrine, admire the Isuzu River, and share a visit to Oharaimachi or Meoto Iwa. Invite your travel companions to try Ise udon or tekone sushi, take a tea break, and wish them a safe trip home. Each sticker pairs a short English phrase with an original illustration of scenery or objects.

• 48 static stickers: 32 English and 16 Japanese
• Separate Japan travel and Ise travel collections
• Short, bold phrases and original travel artwork
• All included stickers available with one purchase
• No advertising, in-app purchases or separate account

Open Japan Travel in Apple's Messages app and choose a collection to use the stickers.

These original illustrations are inspired by travel destinations. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ise Jingu, the featured destinations or tourism organizations. It is an iMessage sticker app, not an official shrine guide, map, navigation tool or religious service.

name: Japanese Onomatopoeia Guide
description:
Sound natural in Japanese by mastering 1,293 onomatopoeic and mimetic words (擬音語・擬態語, giongo & gitaigo) — essential everyday expressions like しっかり, ぴったり, わくわく, ぎりぎり, or ぱちぱち — with an offline dictionary, flashcards, SM-2 spaced repetition, and context quizzes.

1,293 WORDS RANKED BY CORPUS FREQUENCY
Every word is ranked by real corpus frequency (#1 is the most common), grouped into Top 100, Top 500, Core, and Rare tiers so you learn what native speakers actually use first. Each entry shows detailed meanings, grammatical usage patterns (～と, ～する), synonyms, and crisp highlighted forms inside example sentences.

7,097 VOICED EXAMPLE SENTENCES
Nuance lives in context: every meaning includes authentic Japanese sentences with translations in English and Russian. Tap any speaker icon to hear the word or full sentence pronounced aloud with your device's built-in Japanese voice — completely offline.

INTERACTIVE FLASHCARDS
Browse cards in frequency order or shuffle them at random. Filter by Top 100, Top 500, or Favorites, flip any card to inspect usage patterns, synonyms, and examples, and add words to your study list in one tap.

CALM SPACED REPETITION (SM-2 SRS)
Lock subtle mimetic nuances into long-term memory with the SM-2 algorithm. Rate each card — Forgot, Barely, Got it, or Easy — and let the scheduler plan your next review automatically. Pick your session size (5 to 30 cards) and monitor your progress directly on the Practice tab, with zero daily streak pressure or notifications.

2 QUIZ MODES
• Guess the Meaning: choose the accurate translation from 4 options.
• Context Quiz (Fill in the Blank): pick the onomatopoeic word that fits a real Japanese sentence.
Train with all words, your SRS study list, or your Favorites.

INSTANT SEARCH
Search by hiragana, katakana, or English/Russian meaning. Filter by Favorites or SRS status and sort by corpus frequency or kana order.

100% OFFLINE, PRIVATE & DISTRACTION-FREE
• Works completely offline on iPhone and iPad.
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking, and no subscriptions.
• Distinct, eye-friendly Light and Dark themes.
• Full interface and translations in English and Russian.

name: JASARA Aman
description:
JASARA Aman is the safety app for JASARA employees. It connects you directly to the HSE response team, so help is only a few taps away wherever you are on site.

EMERGENCY SOS
Press and hold SOS for two seconds. The response team immediately receives your name, contact number, location and phone status (battery and network) so they can reach you fast. From the same screen you can call the emergency hotline or prepare an emergency SMS.

REPORT AN INCIDENT IN THREE TAPS
Choose what is happening (medical, fire, security, structural, hazardous material or general assistance), add a short note and send. You get a reference number straight away.

FOLLOW YOUR REQUEST
See the live status, whether a responder is assigned, the target response time and every update from the team. If it was a false alarm, stand the request down yourself.

SHARE YOUR LIVE LOCATION, ONLY WHEN YOU CHOOSE
While your request is open, you can share your live location with the response team. Sharing stops automatically when the request closes, and you can stop it at any time.

ANSWER SAFETY ALERTS
Answer alerts with one tap: I am safe, Acknowledged or I need assistance. Choosing "I need assistance" raises a request for you automatically. Alerts reach you as notifications, even when the app is closed.

ROLL CALL
During an emergency, site supervisors and wardens see who is safe, who needs help and who has not answered yet, and can mark people as accounted for at an assembly point.

NEAREST SITE AND WEATHER
See your nearest JASARA site and current conditions: temperature, humidity, wind and UV index.

SAFETY AWARENESS
Read safety tips, guides, photos and documents from the HSE team. New and pinned posts are highlighted.

MY SAFETY DASHBOARD
Track your requests, alert answers, reading and response times over the last six months.

QUICK, SECURE SIGN-IN
Sign in with your JASARA Microsoft account, an SMS code, or your work email and password, then use Face ID next time. There is nothing to register.

BUILT FOR THE SITE
Large touch targets, high-contrast colours, light and dark mode, and full Arabic and English support with right-to-left layout.

YOUR PRIVACY
Your location is used only when you send an SOS or a request, check your nearest site, or turn on live sharing. No ads and no tracking.

JASARA Aman is for JASARA employees and authorised personnel and requires an account provided by JASARA. If there is an immediate threat to life, contact the official emergency services first.

name: JJ's App
description:
JJ's Convenience & Café brings Brazilian and Portuguese products to Kitchener.

With the JJ's app you can:
• Show your member card (with barcode) at the counter to earn and use JJCoins
• See your JJCoins balance and which ones expire soon
• Check your history of JJCoins earned and used
• Add your photo so our team can recognize you at the counter
• Sign in with a code sent by email: no password to remember

New here? Enter your email and we'll create your JJRewards account.

name: Jos Bergevoet Coaching
description:
LET OP: je hebt een account van Jos Bergevoet Coaching nodig om in deze app in te loggen. Die krijg je van mij als je met de coaching start.

Dit is de app van mijn 1-op-1 coaching. Hier staat alles wat we samen afspreken, zodat je niet elke keer opnieuw hoeft te beginnen.

In de app:
• zie je je trainingsschema, met uitleg en video bij elke oefening
• vind je je voedingsplan en je doelen
• houd je je gewicht en metingen bij en zie je je voortgang
• zie je wat er deze week op de planning staat
• app je me met één tik als je ergens tegenaan loopt

Geen standaard schema en geen crashdieet, maar een plan dat past bij jouw week en iemand die met je meekijkt.

Je kunt deze app syncen met de Apple Gezondheid App. Wanneer je deze connectie activeert, worden je workouts in de Gezondheid app automatisch toegevoegd aan je activiteitenkalender.

name: K&S Ofis
description:
K&S Ofis, Kepekçi & Sepetçi Hukuk Bürosu çalışanları için geliştirilmiş iç iş takip uygulamasıdır. Yalnız büro tarafından hesap verilmiş kişiler giriş yapabilir; uygulamada hesap açılamaz.

BUGÜN
• Açık işler, geciken işler, yaklaşan duruşmalar ve dolmak üzere olan süreler tek bakışta
• Sıradaki duruşma ve katılım planı

İŞLER
• Size atanan işleri görün, durumunu güncelleyin, not ve fotoğraf/belge ekleyin
• Yeni iş oluşturun ve dosyaya bağlayın

DOSYALAR
• Dava ve icra dosyalarının özeti: taraflar, mahkeme, son aşama, ilgili süre ve duruşmalar

AJANDA
• Duruşma listesi, aylık takvim görünümü ve süre takibi

TEBLİGATLAR
• Gelen tebligatların listesi ve bağlı işler

GÜVENLİK
• Oturum yalnız cihazın Anahtar Zinciri'nde saklanır, Face ID ile kilit
• Reklam, analitik ve izleme yoktur

Anlık bildirimlerle size yeni iş atandığında, tebligat geldiğinde ya da duruşma planı değiştiğinde haberdar olursunuz.

name: KaiDeck: Leren & Toets AI
description:
Maak leren voor je volgende toets overzichtelijk, slim en leuk met KaiDeck!

Heb je een proefwerk, woordjeslijst of hoofdstuk te leren? Maak in de KaiDeck-app tot 10 foto's van je boek, werkblad of aantekeningen. Binnen enkele tellen zet KAI AI jouw lesstof om in een compleet oefen-Deck met 6 verschillende toetsvormen:

• Flashcards (tot 100 kaarten per toets) — inclusief uitspraak en ezelsbruggetjes bij talen. Wat je nog lastig vindt, komt vanzelf terug.
• Speed-Quiz — snelle meerkeuzevragen tegen de klok met combo's.
• Oefentoetsen — tot 10 proeftoetsen van 10 vragen met direct een indicatief cijfer en uitleg.
• Spiekbriefjes — heldere mini-samenvattingen van de belangrijkste begrippen.
• Fouten herhalen — oefen gericht precies de vragen die je eerder fout had.
• Hoofdtoets — tot 5 eindtoetsen van 20 vragen zodat je vóór je echte toets weet of je er klaar voor bent.

JOUW SLIMME STUDEERMAATJE KAI
Loop je vast op een begrip of grammaticaregel? Rechtsonder in de app staat KAI voor je klaar. KAI kent de toetsen in jouw actieve Pool, ziet waar je op stukloopt en legt de stof stap voor stap op jouw niveau uit — zonder het voor te zeggen, zodat je het écht begrijpt.

DAGELIJKSE ROUTINE, KAI ARCADE & GOUDEN DAG-RAD
• Stel je actieve toetsenpool samen en werk elke dag je 6 studietaken af.
• Speel KAI Arcade vrij: oefen je eigen toetsstof solo of race live via een code/QR tegen je klasgenoten in 5 snelle 2.5D minigames (Glazen Brug, Vulkaan Toren, Tempel Rush, Wolken-Arena & Kasteel Duel).
• Draai aan het Gouden Dag-Rad voor XP, Streak-Redders, Kamer-Frames, Thema's en 10 unieke KAI-personages.
• Deel je gemaakte Deck in 1 tel via QR-code met je klasgenoten (iedereen houdt zijn eigen voortgang!).

OOK VOOR OUDERS & DOCENTEN
Met een apart Ouder/Docent-account koppel je eenvoudig via QR-code (alleen-lezen). Bekijk in één oogopslag de studietijd per week, actieve streaks, behaalde oefencijfers en de studievragen die aan KAI zijn gesteld.

GRATIS STARTEN & KAIDECK PRO
• Gratis: elke maand 1 nieuwe toets inscannen met AI, elke dag 5 vragen stellen aan KAI AI én onbeperkt al je bestaande en gedeelde toetsen oefenen.
• KaiDeck Pro (automatisch verlengend abonnement): onbeperkt toetsen scannen en onbeperkt chatten met KAI AI (beschikbaar per maand of voordelig per 6 maanden; voor Ouder/Docent-accounts geldt 50% korting).

Privacybeleid: https://kaideck.nl/privacy.html
Gebruiksvoorwaarden (EULA): https://kaideck.nl/terms.html

name: Kalas
description:
Kalas er appen til medlemmerne af Kalas, festudvalget på Nakskov Gymnasium. Her har du styr på alt, du skal lave til fester, fredagscaféer, MGP, julecafé og translokation.

LIGE NU OG NÆSTE
Forsiden viser, hvad du skal lige nu, og hvad der kommer bagefter – din vagt, dit punkt i planen eller din opgave.

DINE VAGTER
Se dine vagter i baren, i indgangen, med opfyldning og oprydning, hvornår de starter, og hvem du står sammen med.

AFTENENS PLAN
Hele programmet for aftenen med klokkeslæt og ansvarlige. Ændres planen, får du besked med det samme.

TJEKLISTER
Opstilling og nedpakning delt op i områder. Kryds dine opgaver af, og se hvad der mangler. Materialelisten viser, hvad der skal hentes og hvor.

PÅMINDELSER
Du får en påmindelse før dine vagter, opgaver og mødetiden – også selvom telefonen ikke har net.

BESKEDER
Beskeder fra formanden kommer direkte på telefonen.

VIRKER UDEN NET
Appen gemmer planen og filerne på telefonen, og kryds sat uden net sendes, så snart der er forbindelse igen.

Appen er kun til medlemmer af festudvalget. Du logger ind med den personlige kode, du får af formanden.

name: Kaputle
description:
Kaputle is a daily word game with a twist: your keyboard wears out.

Every day brings eight new questions. Name a dog breed. Name a pasta shape. Name a Roman emperor. You have 35 seconds for each, and the rarer your answer, the further your little red airship flies.

The catch is the keys. Vowels never run out, but every other key only works four times. Spend your R's on an early answer and you may find the perfect one later is out of reach. When a key is used up, it's kaput.

EVERY DAY
• Eight questions, the same for everyone in the world
• A new journey each day, through the Valley, the Farmland, the Pinewood, the Lakes and on towards the stars
• See how your flight compares with other players, and what everyone else answered
• Keep your streak going and collect badges

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• One free practice flight every day, with hundreds of extra questions
• Race friends in real time: ready up, same questions, same clock, furthest flight wins
• Start a crew: a private daily leaderboard for you and your friends, with reactions and a weekly crown
• Share your result, or send a friend your score to beat

THEMED PACKS
• Movies, Science, Music and History, each with its own questions and its own world to fly through
• Try one flight of each pack free

THE ARCHIVE
• Replay any past daily game
• Yesterday's game is always free
• Unlock the whole archive, including 100 bonus games and unlimited practice flights, with a single one-off purchase

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• No adverts, no tracking, and no email or password
• Play without signing in. An optional passkey (Face ID or Touch ID) keeps your crews and purchases on all your devices
• Works offline for daily and practice games
• British and American spellings, alternative names and near-miss typos understood

Short answers save keys. Rare answers fly further. Choose carefully.

name: Kartenlabor: Flashcards
description:
Create your own flashcards for vocabulary, technical terms, and definitions. Add cards by hand or import them from photos, scans, PDFs, and CSV files. Organize your cards into collections and lessons.

Practice with flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, written answers, or a matching game. Choose which side of the card to see first and share your collections as PDF or CSV files.

Kartenlabor is ad-free. The free version includes two collections with up to two lessons and 60 cards each. A one-time purchase of Kartenlabor Plus unlocks unlimited collections, lessons, and cards.

name: KaruiVideo
description:
動画を選んで、小さくして、見比べて、保存。
KaruiVideoは、iPhone・iPadの動画を端末内で圧縮するアプリです。

【3段階から選ぶだけ】
「きれいに」「おすすめ」「もっと小さく」から圧縮レベルを選べます。動画に合わせて画面サイズとビットレートを調整し、音声付きの動画は音声も残してMP4に保存します。

【保存前に見比べる】
元動画と圧縮後を切り替えて、再生しながら確認できます。ピンチで拡大し、細部も確認できます。切り替えても、再生位置と拡大位置を保ちます。

【最初の3本は無料】
すべての圧縮レベルを試せます。写真ライブラリへの保存に成功したときだけ無料回数を使います。キャンセルや圧縮・保存の失敗で回数は減りません。
無料体験後は、アプリ内の買い切り購入で本数の制限を解除できます。サブスクリプション、広告、ウォーターマークはありません。

【元動画はそのまま】
圧縮動画は別の動画として保存します。元動画を整理したい場合は、保存後に「元動画を置き換える」を選び、確認してから削除できます。

【動画は端末内で処理】
動画・音声を開発者のサーバーへ送信しません。iCloudの動画を読み込む場合や購入の確認には、Appleとの通信が発生することがあります。

・対応：iOS／iPadOS 17以降、日本語
・出力：H.264のMP4。HDR動画はSDRへ変換します。
・容量の減り方や見た目は素材・設定によって変わります。すでに小さい動画は、さらに小さくできない場合があります。
・長い動画の処理中は、完了までアプリを開いたままお待ちください。
・無料利用記録は端末内に保存します。再インストールや別端末との同期は保証しません。
・Google Playでの購入はApp Storeの購入権には引き継がれません。

プライバシーポリシー：https://manabink.com/karuivideo/privacy-ios.html
サポート：https://manabink.com/app-support/

name: KiddoBoard: Family Star Chart
description:
KiddoBoard is a star chart for parents. Give your children stars for chores and habits, see the week at a glance and swap the stars for rewards you have chosen together.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add your children and the goals that matter right now – brushing teeth, tidying up, homework.
• Tap a goal's day cell on the weekly board to give a star. Tap again to remove it, provided it has not already been redeemed.
• Choose rewards together and redeem them when the stars add up.
• Look back week by week to see the progress.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Invite another adult by email. You share the same board, and changes show up on both phones.
• In English, Swedish and Spanish.

PRIVACY
Children have no accounts of their own – the app is used by the adults. No ads, no in-app purchases and no third-party tracking. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

name: Kilomate: Mileage Tracker
description:
Kilomate logs your car trips automatically and keeps your mileage log only on your own phone. No account, no Kilomate server, no analytics.

Tap Business or Private after each drive, right in the notification. Export your log as a CSV file for your tax records, your accountant or a mileage claim at work.

AUTOMATIC TRIP LOGGING
• Kilomate notices car trips on its own, using motion and location in the background.
• Nothing to start or stop.
• Missed a drive? Add it by hand.
• See the route of a drive on the map.
• Start or end not quite right? Adjust the start and end of the drive.
• Distance off? Correct it. The measured distance stays next to it in your export.
• Merge two drives that belong together, or split a drive at a stop.

BUSINESS OR PRIVATE
• Mark each drive Business or Private with one tap.
• Drive the same route often? Let Kilomate sort it for you from then on (Kilomate Plus).
• Add a note to a business drive, such as its purpose.
• For a private drive, Kilomate keeps only the date, time and distance by default. The route is deleted.

YOUR CARS AND ODOMETER
• Keep several cars, with name and number plate (Kilomate Plus).
• Enter a starting odometer reading, and the export shows the odometer at the start and end of each drive.
• Enter the real reading now and then to see whether your log adds up with the car.
• Choose km or miles.

EXPORT AND BACKUP
• Export your drives as a CSV file that opens in any spreadsheet app.
• Or make a PDF log with odometer readings, ready to print or send (Kilomate Plus).
• Save a backup file and restore it on a new phone.

PRIVACY
• Your drives stay on your phone.
• No account, no sign-in, no Kilomate server, no analytics.
• Street names and the map come from your phone's own map service (Apple).
• Your drives are only shared when you export them or save a backup yourself.

Light and dark mode.

GOOD TO KNOW
Kilomate is a tool for keeping a mileage log. It is not tax advice and it does not calculate allowances or deductions. Check that your log contains what your tax authority (for example the IRS or HMRC) or your employer asks for.

Automatic trip detection uses your location in the background, which uses some extra battery.

KILOMATE PLUS
Kilomate is free for the first 20 drives each month: they are logged, sorted and exported. Every drive after that is still logged and exported, but sorting it needs Kilomate Plus. Plus also adds the PDF log with odometer readings, more than one car, and rules that sort by route or working hours.
Kilomate Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, per month or per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account.
It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kilomateapp.com/privacy

name: Kindpaw: Cat & Dog Training
description:
Kindpaw is pet training the kind way. It turns your cat's or dog's behavior
problems into a simple daily plan: tell us about your pet, pick what you want
to fix, and get one short lesson a day, about 10 minutes, with clear steps.
No punishment, no yelling, only humane, reward-based methods that build
trust.
FIX REAL PROBLEMS
• Cats: scratching furniture, peeing or pooping outside the litter box,
spraying, biting hands, night meowing and zoomies, jumping on counters, fear
and hiding, fights with another cat
• Dogs: leash pulling, barking, jumping on people, chewing, puppy biting,
potty accidents, being alone at home, not coming when called, lunging on
walks, fear of fireworks
• Kitten and puppy basics for the first weeks at home
A PLAN MADE FOR YOUR PET
Answer a few quick questions about your cat or dog. Kindpaw puts the right
programs in the right order and starts with what matters most.
ONE LESSON A DAY
Every day has a goal, simple numbered steps, common mistakes to avoid and a
tip. Finished? Mark it done and rate how it went. If it was hard, the same
lesson comes back tomorrow, so your pet can go at its own pace.
SEE WHAT'S WORKING
Log incidents in two taps and watch them drop week by week. A calendar shows
your training days and your streak.
IS THIS NORMAL?
Answer a few yes or no questions about common symptoms and see how urgent it
is: watch at home, see a vet soon, or go now. Plus a library of answers about
behavior, food and care.
ALL YOUR PETS, ALL THEIR CARE
• Reminders for meals, litter, walks, meds, flea treatment and vet visits
• Health passport: vaccinations, treatments, vet visits, medications and
notes
• Weight tracking with a chart
• Share the passport as a PDF with your vet or pet sitter
• First-year guide for kittens and puppies, week by week
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your pet's data stays on your phone.
35 programs for cats and dogs, written for real homes and real pets.
Terms of Use: https://getpetnara.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getpetnara.com/privacy
Kindpaw gives general training and care guidance and doesn't replace a
veterinarian. In an emergency, contact your vet right away.

name: KINER
description:
KINER is a private map for you and your friends. Choose who to share with and what they can see. When you end a share, your live position and shared status are removed from that friend’s map.

• See friends who are sharing with you on one map.
• Check local weather and a seven-day forecast. On the map, turn on traffic, points of interest, weather, precipitation, or nearby aircraft.
• Choose which details to share, including battery level, charging, movement, or time at a place.
• Send one-to-one messages and see unread messages in the app.
• Send an SOS with your location to a friend from chat.
• Save Home, School, Work, and other favorite places on your iPhone.
• Turn on Quiet Mode to stop sharing from this iPhone.
• Add friends by invite code or email request.

Location access shows your position on the map. KINER can continue updating in the background while a share or SOS you started is active. The app interface is in Simplified Chinese.

name: Kitetown
description:
Build a town, then watch it come alive.

Kitetown is a calm city builder where everything you place has a life of its own. Lay the roads, paint the neighborhoods and design your own buildings, then sit back: buses run the lines you draw, shops open their doors in the morning, people stroll through the park and fly kites, and the lamps come on when the sun goes down.

A CITY THAT LIVES
- Traffic that stops at the lights and pulls over for the fire truck
- Buses and trams on the lines you plan
- Fire, police and ambulance services on call
- People who walk, wait at bus stops and enjoy your parks

SHOPS WITH A LIFE OF THEIR OWN
Every shop has its own name, opening hours and busy times. The bakery is busy at breakfast, the cinema at night. Tap any shop to see who is inside.

THE WORKSHOP
Design any building you can imagine from hundreds of pieces. Stack walls, windows, roofs and awnings, paint them in brick, stone or wood, then place your design in the city or let it grow in your neighbourhoods. Share your designs with friends using a simple code.

DAY, NIGHT AND SEASONS
Watch your town change through the day and the year. Snow in winter, golden leaves in autumn, and celebrations with fireworks whenever you like.

SHARE YOUR CITY
Frame any view, add your own greeting and share it as a photo card.

MADE TO BE YOURS
- Free to try: build a small town with roads, parks and homes
- One purchase unlocks the whole city: every piece and building, shops and offices, the workshop and every future update
- No ads. No subscriptions. No tricks.
- Plays offline
- Collects no personal data
- Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple silicon

Your city. Your rules.

name: Knowledge Yard
description:
Notes are easy to collect and easy to forget. Knowledge Yard turns the facts you actually use at work into short, source-backed questions that return when they need another look.

Write a question, answer, topic and source. The Review Dock brings due cards forward in a focused session. Recall the answer before revealing it, then choose Again, Hard or Good to shape the next review date. Defer with a reason, stop midway without losing completed work, and use the library to search, edit, archive or retry a card. Topic insights and a seven-day activity view show what is sticking and what needs attention.

RecallDock includes an adjustable session limit, light and dark appearance, optional sound and an in-app guide. Your knowledge stays offline on your device. No account or notification access is required.

name: KoFUN - 古墳さんぽ
description:
近くの古墳が、すぐ分かる。
KoFUN（コフン）は、全国の古墳を地図で探して、歩いて巡るアプリです。

■ 航空写真で探す
全国の古墳をGoogle Mapsの航空写真に表示。地図を動かしながら、気になる古墳を見つけられます。

■ 現在地の近くから
近くの古墳を距離順に表示。散歩や旅行の行き先探しに役立ちます。

■ 名前・地域・形で検索
古墳名、都道府県、前方後円墳や円墳などの形から検索できます。

■ 訪ねた古墳を記録
「行った」「行きたい」を保存して、自分だけの古墳さんぽの記録を残せます。

■ 今日の一基
日替わりで紹介される古墳から、新しい行き先を発見できます。

位置情報は許可した場合のみ利用します。許可しなくても検索や記録を利用できます。記録は端末内に保存されます。アプリには広告が含まれます。

古墳情報は現況と異なる場合があります。見学可否や立入制限は、現地や管理者の案内をご確認ください。

name: Kognen
description:
A Kognen orquestra agentes de código (Claude Code, Codex e Gemini) no seu computador, com as contas de IA que você já tem. Este app é o Remote Control da Kognen: acompanhe e converse com essas conversas pelo celular, de qualquer lugar.

COMO FUNCIONA
• No app da Kognen no computador, ligue o Remote Control numa conversa.
• Ela aparece aqui na hora, ao vivo.
• O que você manda pelo celular roda no computador onde a conversa foi aberta, como se você estivesse na frente dele.

O QUE DÁ PARA FAZER PELO CELULAR
• Ver a conversa ao vivo: respostas, ferramentas usadas e o andamento.
• Mandar mensagens e instruções para o agente.
• Responder às decisões que o orquestrador pede (aprovar um PR, escolher um caminho).
• Parar o agente quando quiser.

Por segurança e por design, o celular não cria conversas novas: ele dá acesso só às conversas que você ligou no computador.

NO COMPUTADOR, A KOGNEN
• Junta todas as suas contas de IA e troca de conta quando uma chega no limite, sem perder o contexto.
• Super Auto: conduz os agentes até a tarefa ficar pronta, perguntando só quando precisa de você.
• Supervisor de roadmap, agentes em paralelo e travas de recursos da máquina.
• Cofre de credenciais criptografado e modelos locais.

PLANO ÚNICO
Kognen Pro, mensal ou anual, com todos os recursos. A mesma assinatura vale no app desktop, no celular e no navegador. Contas novas têm 14 dias de teste grátis.

A assinatura renova automaticamente até ser cancelada nos ajustes da loja, até 24 horas antes da renovação.

Termos de Uso: https://kognen.com/termos
Política de Privacidade: https://kognen.com/privacidade
Suporte: suporte@kognen.com

name: Kometa: Gravity Flight
description:
Hold your finger down and a planet pulls your comet in. Let go and the comet flies straight. That is the whole control scheme. The rest is up to you.

Kometa is a free one-finger arcade game about flying through endless space. Swing around planets, collect stars and skim past surfaces to push your multiplier up to ×9. Just don't circle for too long: the dark is rising from below.

ENDLESS FLIGHT
Space is built anew on every flight and never repeats. Each sector is faster and denser, with orbiting moons, rock swarms and giant planets.

DAILY SKY
The same sky for every player in the world. Three tries a day. Share your result and see which friend flew furthest.

CLEAR FROM THE FIRST SECOND
A dotted line always shows where the comet goes if you switch, and turns red when a crash is ahead. The tutorial takes one planet.

TAILS
Unlock eight comet tails by reaching far sectors, collecting stars and keeping daily streaks. Your tail appears on the picture you share.

HONESTLY FREE
No ads, no purchases, no sign-up. Works offline. The game collects no data.

name: Konekto
description:
Konekto je aplikacija za radnje koje prodaju preko svoje online prodavnice na Konektu (radnja.konekto.ba). Sve što vam treba za svakodnevni rad je na telefonu.

NARUDŽBE
• Obavještenje za svaku novu narudžbu, i kad je aplikacija zatvorena
• Prihvatite, spakujte, pošaljite i označite isporuku jednim potezom
• Broj pošiljke upišite ili skenirajte barkod kamerom
• Pozovite kupca ili mu pišite na Viber, WhatsApp ili SMS
• Zadnje narudžbe ostaju vidljive i bez interneta

PROIZVODI
• Novi proizvod iz kamere: slikajte, izrežite, upišite cijenu i količinu
• Dodajte više proizvoda odjednom iz galerije
• Brza izmjena cijene i zalihe, sakrivanje proizvoda
• Kategorije, popusti i status uvoza iz Excela

PRODAVNICA
• Početna sa prometom, narudžbama i posjetama
• Izgled prodavnice, dostava, radno vrijeme i stranice za kupce
• QR kod prodavnice i dijeljenje proizvoda na društvene mreže
• Radnici sa svojim nalogom: vide narudžbe i katalog, ne vide novac

Kupci plaćaju pouzećem; Konekto ne uzima proviziju od narudžbi. Nalog za radnju otvarate u aplikaciji ili na konekto.ba.

name: Kongdak
description:
Kongdak is a night light that beats like a heart.

Turn it on and the light swells and fades in time with a heartbeat, and a heartbeat sound plays on the same beat. Pick a color, a brightness and a size, set the tempo, and leave it glowing by the crib or the bed.

HEARTBEAT LIGHT
• One round light that brightens and dims on every beat
• Your own color, brightness and size, or a full-screen glow
• Tempo from 50 to 90 beats per minute
• Full screen: swipe sideways for the next sound, up or down for volume; double-tap to leave

16 SOUNDS
• 8 heartbeat sounds, from a deep, soft thump to a clear, close one
• 8 white noises: white, brown, shush, rain, waves, fan, hair dryer and vacuum
• Set an auto-off time, and the sound and light fade out together

FOLLOW MOM'S HEART RATE WITH APPLE WATCH
• Wear your Apple Watch and the light and sound can follow your heart rate
• The watch also works as a remote: on and off, next sound, color, volume
• Your heart rate only sets the tempo, live. Kongdak keeps no history of it, and it stays on your own watch and iPhone.

SLEEP LOG
• Tap once when your baby falls asleep, once when they wake up
• See the week at a glance and fix or add entries any time
• Entries stay on your iPhone until you delete them; erase them all in Settings any time

CRY DETECTION MODE
• Turn it on in Settings: while the sound plays, a cry changes the sound, color and brightness to soothe again
• It listens on your iPhone only. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent
• It is not a baby monitor and can miss a cry or mistake another sound for one

ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
• Home Screen widgets (small and medium)
• Lock Screen card and Dynamic Island while the sound plays
• The sound keeps playing with the screen locked or the app in the background

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking
• Your settings and sleep log stay on your iPhone. We have no server.
• The only data that leaves your phone is the purchase receipt handled by Apple and RevenueCat.

MEMBERSHIP
Kongdak is a paid app with no free trial. Choose one:
• Lifetime: pay once, keep it
• Monthly: an auto-renewing subscription
Prices are shown in the App Store for your country. Monthly renews automatically until you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. You can also restore purchases inside the app.

Terms of Use: https://kongdak-app.github.io/kongdak-legal/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://kongdak-app.github.io/kongdak-legal/privacy.html

Kongdak is a night light and sound player. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or monitor anyone's health. Please follow safe-sleep guidance from your pediatrician.

name: KotoHashi コトハシ
description:
KotoHashi (言橋, "a bridge of words") turns speech into text on the spot, translates it, and reads the translation aloud. It also transcribes by speaker, showing who said what, and summarizes the conversation with AI. It is handy when traveling abroad too: a face-to-face mode, example conversations for travel and more (16 free, 64 with the paid plan), and, once the recognition and translation data are downloaded, it works without a connection. It supports Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

Speech recognition, translation, speech synthesis, and summaries all run on your device. Recordings and text are never sent to any server. Only the speaker model used by the paid plan (about 21 MB) is downloaded once, the first time it is used.

LIVE
Press the microphone and speak. Your words appear as text right away, with the translation underneath, and the translation can be read aloud. When the other person speaks, just press their microphone button.

FACE-TO-FACE MODE
The screen splits in two so that two people sitting across from each other can each read their own language. Change languages at any time, and tap a sentence to hear it again.

SESSIONS
• Conversations are organized into folders by date
• Play back recordings, edit the text, and name the speakers
• Tell speakers apart by voice (up to 4 on the free plan)
• Summarize the key points as a bulleted list
• Trim recordings and re-analyze transcriptions
• Import and transcribe audio files
• Clear history by range

KATAKANA DISPLAY
Show the reading of Japanese, or the approximate pronunciation of Chinese, in katakana.

CONVERSATION EXAMPLES
64 example conversations with audio (16 in the free plan) for travel and everyday situations: directions, restaurants, hotels, airports, night markets, the Airport MRT, and more.

APPLE WATCH
Recording starts as soon as you open the app, and the recording is delivered to the Library on your iPhone when you stop. Transcribe it later on the iPhone.

KOTOHASHI PREMIUM (monthly subscription)
The basic features are free (up to 5 transcriptions a day, up to 4 speakers, and 16 example conversations).
Premium adds:
• Unlimited transcriptions
• Saving and exporting files (txt / md / srt / vtt / json)
• Separate up to 8 speakers (similar voices can be mixed up)

The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://github.com/nu-sx/KotoHashi/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Note: on iOS 26 or later, recognition data for each language is downloaded once on first use. Summaries are written by the on-device AI where Apple Intelligence is available; on other devices the app picks out the key sentences.

name: Kuido: For Your Best Friend
description:
Kuido is the app for people who look after a pet together. Dog, cat, rabbit, bird, fish, whatever lives at your place: their ID card, their health and their daily routine in one spot, shared with whoever needs it.

DIGITAL ID CARD
A card that looks like a real ID, with a front and a back you flip with a tap. The front has the photo, name, species, breed, sex, birth date and the person responsible. The back has a QR code, the microchip number and the line "If you find me, call this number".

Whoever scans the QR sees your pet's photo and name, your name and a button to call you. They never see an address: Kuido does not ask for or store your home address.

The card works on paper too. From the app you download a printable sheet with a foldable card and two round tags with the QR, for a collar or a bag. If your phone dies, your pet is still identified.

CARE AS A FAMILY
Invite the people who help with a five-character code. You approve every request. Everyone sees the same thing and knows what is going on:

· Quick actions on Home: "Ate", "Went out and played", "Feeling unwell".
· A daily log of what each person did.
· Alerts to the whole family. Running late? Send one message and someone else takes the walk.
· Tasks and walks assigned to a person, with a time, and a reminder for whoever's turn it is.

HEALTH, UP TO DATE
· Vaccines, with a photo of each record, the next due date and a reminder before it comes up.
· Medication with doses and schedules. Each dose is confirmed with the name of who gave it, and if nobody confirms, the family finds out.
· My vet: the clinic's name, phone and address, also shown on the back of the card.
· Food: what they eat and how much.
· Documents: passport, reports and test results, with a photo.

A SHORT TOUR TO START
The first time, a quick tour shows you each tab: Home, Card, Health, Family and Settings. You can replay it from Settings whenever you like.

FREE, WITH A PLUS PLAN IF YOU NEED IT
Kuido is free, and the free plan does not expire and is not a trial. It covers one pet, you and one more person, and the essentials of care. The card, the QR, printing the card and tags, and family alerts are always free.

Kuido Plus lifts the limits: up to five pets, up to six people per pet, and no cap on vaccines, treatments, documents and tasks. Only the person who registers the pet pays. The people who help never do. If you leave Plus, nothing is deleted: what you saved stays and you can still edit it.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
Kuido shows no ads and does not track you. Sign in with Apple, with Google or with a code we email you, no passwords. You can delete your account from Settings at any time.

Kuido is available in English, Spanish, French and Portuguese.

KUIDO PLUS SUBSCRIPTION
Kuido Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, chosen in the app. The App Store shows the price and currency before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: http://lombanaapps.com/kuido/privacy/

name: Kujibako: Wheel & Team Picker
description:
A spinning wheel, seat shuffle, team maker, ladder lottery, bingo caller, turn order and dares, all in one app. Made for classrooms, clubs, parties and family game nights, where everyone is looking at the screen.

WHAT IT DOES
- Wheel: give each item a weight from 1 to 10 and see its chance as a %. Turn on "No repeat winners" to leave out people who already won.
- Seat Shuffle: set seats across and rows deep, then shuffle. Empty seats are placed at random too. Pin someone to a seat or keep two people apart.
- Team Maker: split by number of teams or by people per team. Team sizes differ by at most one.
- Ladder Lottery: names on top, results like Win or Miss at the bottom. Tap a name to follow the line (up to 12 people).
- Bingo: draw 1 to 75 with no repeats, with a board of drawn numbers and undo.
- Turn Order: shuffle who goes first.
- Dares: a wheel of party dares. Add your own.
- Finger Picker: everyone puts a finger on the screen to pick 1 or 2 people or split into 2 teams.
- Numbers, Coin & Dice: a number in any range, a coin flip, or 1 to 6 dice.

ENTER NAMES ONCE
Paste "Emma, Liam, Olivia" to add everyone at once. Save class or club lists and use them in any tool.

ADS THAT WON'T EMBARRASS YOU
- No ads while spinning or on a result screen.
- Full-screen ads only when you go back home after a result, at most once every few minutes.
- General-audience ads only.
- Remove ads forever with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Random numbers come from iOS's cryptographic generator (SystemRandomNumberGenerator). Shuffles use the Fisher–Yates method, so every arrangement is equally likely. The wheel and the ladder decide the result fairly first, then draw it. Read more under "How fair is it?" in the app.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
Names and results never leave your device. No server, no account.

Contact: support@algorist.jp

name: Kursi Pro
description:
Kursi is the free app for barbershops on Meqast. Run your whole day from your phone: the live queue, bookings, your team and your prices.

LIVE QUEUE
• Walk-ins and bookings for every chair on one screen
• Add a walk-in customer in seconds
• Call the next customer, mark arrived, start and finish
• Running behind? Add a delay and every customer is told

YOUR SHOP ON MEQAST
• Customers find you on the Meqast app and website with your live wait time
• Prices, services and opening hours in Kurdish, Arabic and English
• QR code poster for your door: customers scan and join the queue
• Reviews, ratings and replies

WORKS GALLERY
• Post photos of your best haircuts, with before and after
• Customers like them and book "this look" with you
• Climb the "Top barbers this month" ranking in your city

TEAM AND HOURS
• Every barber with their own login, hours and days off
• Owners, barbers and reception, each with the right access

AND MORE
• Customer list and visit history
• Statistics: served, revenue, peak hours, no-show rate
• AI Style Preview: show a customer how a cut will look before you start

Kursi speaks Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic and English. New shops get a free trial.

name: Kurumicho: Expense Ledger
description:
Snap a receipt and you're done. Kurumicho is a simple daily expense ledger that can split one receipt into several categories, like groceries and household goods.

On-device receipt reading
Reads the total, date, store and line items right on your iPhone. Photos are never uploaded. Pick a category per item and save a supermarket receipt as separate entries in one go.

One-tap "usuals"
Record the same store and amount three times and it becomes a one-tap button: coffee, commute, lunch. Also works from Shortcuts and Siri.

Budget from your payday
Set the day your month starts. See what's left and how much you can spend per day until the next payday.

Calendar and report
Daily totals on a calendar, a category chart and a comparison with the last period.

Chip's nest
On every day you record, or mark as a no-spend day, Chip the chipmunk stores one walnut in his nest.

Also
- Fixed costs (rent, phone) recorded every month automatically
- Face ID lock
- Backup file export and restore
- Evening reminder that skips days you already recorded
- No bank linking, no ads, your data stays on your iPhone

Kurumicho Pro (one-time purchase)
- Budgets for every category, with carry-over
- One-tap home screen widget
- CSV export
- 6-month report
Recording, receipt reading, the calendar and the monthly chart work without Pro.

name: Kvadrat Home
description:
Kvadrat is an app for people who have bought an apartment in a new development or already live in one. Access is opened by your developer or management company.

WHILE THE BUILDING IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION
• Building readiness and construction stages with photo reports
• Contract payment schedule and the next payment
• The contract and other deal documents
• Your manager's contacts

ONCE YOU HAVE THE KEYS
• Requests to the management company and their status
• Rating of completed requests
• Charges on your account and payments received
• Announcements from the management company

HOW TO SIGN IN
Enter the email from your contract and you will receive a code. There are no passwords. If the app says access is not open yet, contact your manager or the management company.

The interface is available in Armenian, Russian and English.

name: La Hotte
description:
Everyone knows what to give, nobody knows what they will get.

La Hotte is the Christmas gift-list app for families: everyone writes their list, the others reserve gifts in secret, and big gifts are funded together. No more duplicates, no more "what did you want again?", no more spoiled surprises.

THE SECRET IS GUARANTEED
You never see who reserved something on your list, nor what is said about it. Reservations and notes about your list are filtered by the server before they even reach your phone. Everyone else sees everything: no duplicates.

YOUR LIST IN TWO MINUTES
Paste a product link and the card fills itself: title, photo, price, store. Add a comment (size, colour, version), your own photos, and a favourite badge for what matters most.

BIG GIFTS, TOGETHER
A bike, a console, a weekend away: everyone enters their contribution, a bar shows how the pool is doing, and notes help decide who buys and who wraps. Money never goes through the app: you settle between you, as usual.

KIDS AND BABIES TOO
No account for the little one: the admin creates a managed profile and chooses the parents who feed its list. Like the baby, the parents do not see reservations, so their surprise stays whole.

SEVERAL FAMILIES, ONE ACCOUNT
Your family, your in-laws, the cousins: each group has its lists, and you switch between them in one tap.

WHAT LA HOTTE DOES NOT DO
No purchases in the app. Gifts are bought from the merchants, through the product link or in store. No ads, no public content, no selling of data.

FREE FOR THE WHOLE 2026 SEASON
No card, no in-app purchase, no ads: every family enjoys everything until 15 January 2027. From autumn 2027, a season will be activated once per family, by the admin, on hotte.agencewebup.fr (EUR 0.99 per member for the first 6, decreasing after that). Members never pay anything.

YOUR DATA STAYS IN THE FAMILY
Nothing is public or indexed. Photos are visible to your family only. Servers are in the European Union. You can export your data and delete your account in two taps, from your profile.

La Hotte is published by Agence Web Up, La Garde, France. Questions? hotte@agencewebup.fr

name: La marque – Game Scorekeeper
description:
No more pen, paper and mental maths: La marque keeps score for your game nights and knows the rules of each game.

32 GAMES, SORTED BY FAMILY
• Cards: French Tarot for 3, 4 and 5, Belote and Coinche, President, Rummy, Crazy Eights, Oh Hell, Dutch, Canasta and more
• Dice: Yams with its full score sheet, 10,000…
• Board games: crosswords, tiles, end-of-game score sheets with automatic totals…
• Skill & outdoor: Pétanque, Breton Palet, Finnish skittles, Darts 301 / 501, Bowling with strikes and spares, best-of matches
• And “Any game” for everything else

A DEAL IN A FEW TAPS
Each game has its own entry screen. A preview shows the points before you confirm, and any deal can be fixed later.

CRAFTED LIKE A GAME
Animations, sounds, haptics, a podium with confetti and a crown for the winner.

YOUR GAME NIGHTS
• Reusable players with their pieces
• Games saved automatically, to resume later
• End-of-night recap (MVP, biggest comeback, legendary deal…) to share as an image
• Profiles, rivalries and badges

LA MARQUE PRO, ONE PURCHASE
Free: 2 games of your choice plus “Any game”. La marque Pro unlocks every game (and future ones), player groups and their leaderboards, the live scoreboard shared by QR code, 48 pieces and coloured felts. No subscription.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your games stay on your phone.

In French, English and Spanish.

name: La Taltafit · لا تلتفت
description:
An interactive horror story set in the hills of the Levant. One autumn evening a darkness spreads over the city, putting out the lights street by street, and shadows begin to follow people at their backs. Whoever turns around is taken.

Ziad is nine. Tonight he walks out of the city with his mother and a lantern, toward his grandparents' village above it.

The prologue, The Night, is a complete short story of eight to twelve minutes, in English and in Arabic.

- Turning is always a choice: a long press on the turn mark, never a slip of the thumb.
- Standing still never takes anyone. It lets the dark come closer.
- No one tells Ziad what the dark does to the hand that holds his. He learns it on the way.
- Who walks beside Ziad, what he carries, whether his lantern stays lit, and whether he turns: 72 paths through one night.
- The fear comes from sound, darkness and loss. No gore.

THE MAP OF THE NIGHT (one optional purchase)
After a finished walk, the night is drawn as a map of all 72 paths: the ones walked are lit, the rest stay dark. Looking at it is free. The purchase makes any fork a starting point, so every path can be reached without walking the night again from the roof. It also opens the lines heard at the edge of the city, to read one by one, and each place of the night on its own, as a gallery.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tas-games.vercel.app/la-taltafit/privacy.html

name: Lampwalk
description:
Someone is sleepwalking toward a gap. You can't touch him, but you can move the lamp.

In Lampwalk, shadows are solid. Drag a lamp, and the shadow a crate casts swings, stretches and shrinks. Line it up so it reaches across the gap, tap Wake, and the sleepwalker walks across the dark you made for him.

World 1 · Dusk has 15 hand-built levels, each adding something new:
• Drag a lamp to swing a shadow into place
• Dim a lamp to shorten its shadow
• Lamps fixed in place, or kept inside a marked area
• Several lamps at once, where one lamp's light can erase another lamp's shadow

Every level has a one-line hint. If the sleepwalker falls or gets stuck, he's back at the start in a moment, so try as often as you like. No timers, no lives.

• Free, with every level included
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Plays offline
• For iPhone and iPad, in landscape
• Sound effects and ambient music, each with its own switch

name: LanternRain
description:
A rainy night in a Jiangnan water town. You hold a tray of warm lanterns — place them on the board, and any row, column, or 2×2 block you fill lights up and is released, drifting down the river as tiny lights.

The rain never stops. Unlit cells erode under the weather, and the board decays around your lanterns. Hold out for 180 seconds, release as many lanterns as you can, and watch the river carry them away.

No accounts. No ads. No timers pushing you to pay. One quiet round at a time.

name: Laptype: Lowercase Keyboard
description:
Laptype is a keyboard for iPhone that types the way a laptop does: lower case unless you press Shift.

On a laptop, a quick reply in work chat comes out as "sounds good, on it". On a phone, the keyboard capitalises it for you, and the same person suddenly reads differently. Laptype removes that. Switch to it in any app and your messages start in lower case, including after a full stop.

WHAT IT DOES
• Lower case by default. No automatic capitals at the start of a message or a sentence.
• Shift when you want it. One tap for a single capital, double tap for caps lock.
• A full keyboard: letters, numbers, symbols, a number pad for number fields, hold to delete, and double space for a full stop.
• Light, dark and landscape.
• A setting to turn sentence capitals back on.
• Usage stats, if you want them: keys typed, capitals skipped and your streak, kept on your iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Nothing you type is stored or sent. There are no accounts, ads or tracking, and the keyboard makes no network connections. Allow Full Access is optional: lower case works without it. Turning it on lets the keyboard follow the options you choose in the app, and adds key haptics and usage stats.

FREE
Laptype is free. There are no in-app purchases, no subscription and no ads.

name: Last Box In: Packing Planner
description:
Every move has one question that matters, and it usually gets answered at the worst moment: van booked, sofa on the pavement, doors that won't close.

Last Box In answers it the evening before.

Make a list of what's going. A two-metre sofa, a fridge-freezer, sixteen moving boxes, a bike. Pick most of it from typical things, or measure your own with a tape that clicks under your thumb. Then choose where it all has to go: a suitcase, a car boot, a van, a lorry or a storage unit.

Slide the latch and the doors swing shut. Everything is packed in 3D, piece by piece, right in front of you. You see where each thing lands, what ends up by the doors, and what is left standing on the curb.

When something doesn't make it, you know why. The fridge has to stay upright. Nothing goes on top of the TV. The wheel arches eat into the van floor. A little wiggle room is kept around every item, so a two-metre sofa never gets squeezed into a two-metre gap.

Then ask the bigger question. Last Box In packs your list into every van from the small one to the 7.5-tonne lorry and points to the smallest that takes it all. If none of them does, it tells you how many trips to plan for.

Pin what absolutely must go, and it goes in first. On the day, follow the load order step by step, so nothing has to come back out to make room.

It works just as well for a holiday: two suitcases, a pram and a cool box into a hatchback. Or for winter tyres and skis heading to the storage locker.

Every check stays with the load. Add three more boxes, shut the doors again and see what changed.

For anyone moving flat, renting a van for the weekend, packing the car for a road trip or clearing the hall cupboard into storage.

Pack it on your phone before you lift a single box.

name: LậtTrang
description:
LatTrang lets you read your own documents as comfortably as a book.

Pick a file from Google Drive or right on your device (Files app, iCloud): PDF, EPUB, DOCX, TXT, photos, scans… LatTrang detects the format and turns it into an easy-to-read e-book:

• AI text recognition: reads scanned pages and photos of paper.
• Automatic margins; removes page numbers, headers and repeated logos; reflows text to fit your screen.
• Adjustable font, size, line spacing; light / sepia / dark themes.
• Realistic page turns, or vertical scrolling.
• Looks great on iPhone, iPad and foldable phones.
• Translate a whole document into another language and read side by side. Translation is an aid and may not be 100% accurate.
• Remembers where you stopped reading.

Your documents stay yours
LatTrang only opens files you choose, in Google Drive or on your device. Documents are processed so you can read them, never shared and never used to train AI. You are responsible for the content and copyright of the documents you open.

Free and LatTrang Pro
• On-device text recognition and translation: always free.
• 20 free AI pages per month (hard scans / high-quality cloud AI translation).
• LatTrang Pro: 500 AI pages per month, 7-day free trial. Auto-renewing; cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
• Extra packs of 500 or 2,000 AI pages, no expiry.

Terms of Use: https://lattrang-514603.web.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://lattrang-514603.web.app/privacy/

name: Lavis: Draw & Paint
description:
Lavis is a drawing and painting app for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with brushes, layers and color. No account, no watermark and no time limit on your drawings.

Free:
• 8 base brushes, the eraser included: pencil, inker, marker, airbrush, watercolor, round brush, charcoal and eraser.
• Up to 3 layers.
• Undo and redo.
• Color picker and recent colors.
• Eyedropper.
• Move, scale, rotate and flip the active layer.
• Rectangle, ellipse or lasso selection, with copy, cut and paste.
• Smudge, to blend the colors on the canvas.
• Text in three fonts, applied to its own layer.
• Save and open .ora files.
• Export PNG.
• AI chat: use your own AI (your API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or another provider, or a local AI) to have it draw for you with Lavis's tools, live and editable. Pro tools still need Pro.

Pro: 7 days of everything in Pro from the day you install the app, no card needed. After that, 1.99 EUR a month or 14.99 EUR a year in Spain; in other countries you see the price of your App Store. Pro includes:
• Unlimited layers from the fourth one on.
• Eight blend modes besides normal.
• Perfect Shape: pause your stroke and the app snaps it to a line, an ellipse or a rectangle.
• Symmetry: vertical, horizontal or by quadrants.
• Export PSD.
• 6 Pro brushes: pastel, chalk, dry brush, mist, fine pen and stamp.
• Liquify: push, twirl, pinch and expand parts of your drawing.
• Timelapse: recording is free; exporting the video of your drawing is Pro.
• Brush editor: create your own brushes.

Pro tools without a subscription: each one opens for 20 minutes after you watch a rewarded ad to the end. On iPhone and iPad the ad plays in the app. On Mac, scan the QR code on the screen with your iPhone, watch the ad there, and the tool opens on your computer. Without a watched ad, the tool does not open.

Ads: only in the free version on iPhone and iPad: a fixed banner, an app-open ad now and then, and a full-screen ad when you export. Pro removes all of them. The Mac version shows no ads of its own.
