name: LayNAS Player
description:
NasPlayer plays your own library — straight from your NAS, no transcoding, no cloud.

■ CONNECT YOUR WAY
· WebDAV and SMB (Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS, Windows and macOS shares)
· Auto LAN / remote switching: fill in both addresses and NasPlayer picks the one that answers
· Scans your Wi-Fi for WebDAV servers

■ DIRECT PLAY, REAL HDR
· Containers: MKV, MP4, MOV, AVI, WMV, RMVB, TS/M2TS, WebM, FLV, VOB, ISO
· Video: H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9, VC-1 — FFmpeg demuxing with hardware decoding
· HDR10 and Dolby Vision through the native system pipeline (actual HDR, not software tone mapping)
· Audio: AAC, AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, TrueHD, FLAC — switch tracks while playing
· Subtitles: ASS/SSA, SRT, PGS, plus external files with automatic GBK / Big5 detection

■ BUILT FOR WATCHING
· Resume where you left off, A-B loop, 0.5x–2x speed
· Gestures for brightness, volume and seeking; double-tap to skip
· Aspect ratio, fill/fit, zoom
· Picture in Picture and background audio when the screen locks

■ CLEAN BY DESIGN
· No ads, no recommendations, no content sources, no account
· Your NAS address and password stay on your device (password in the iOS Keychain)
· We collect nothing — no analytics, no tracking, no crash SDK

■ PRICING
Free download with a 7-day full-featured trial. After the trial, playing videos needs the one-time lifetime unlock (US$3.99 in the U.S. store). Browsing folders, adding a NAS and your history stay free. No subscription.

NasPlayer is a player only: it ships no video content. It plays files you own or are allowed to access — please respect copyright and local law.

name: LeanPlate 健身食譜
description:
LeanPlate 是給在意蛋白質和熱量的人用的食譜 App。不需要帳號，資料都存在你的手機。

【好找】
・39 道台灣與國外的健身料理：三杯雞胸肉、泰式打拋雞、親子丼、隔夜燕麥……
・依菜名或食材搜尋，可用地區（台灣／國外）、目標（減脂／維持／增肌）和標籤篩選
・依蛋白質密度、蛋白質、熱量排序

【看得懂營養】
・每道都有熱量、蛋白質、碳水、脂肪，以及膳食纖維和糖
・調整份數，食材份量和營養一起換算
・營養素依食材份量估算，僅供參考

【照著做】
・備料和做法分開寫，每一步標出火力和時間
・料理模式一步一頁，按一下就開始計時，時間到會震動，螢幕不會自動變暗
・食材可以逐項打勾

【一週菜單】
・選目標後帶入每日熱量和蛋白質，再用滑桿微調
・設定一週預算和人數，自動排出七天早午晚餐
・每一餐都能換一道或鎖定，不滿意可以復原
・顯示每天合計和整週預估花費

【採買清單】
・食譜或整週菜單一鍵加入，同樣的食材自動合併
・依賣場區域分類，買到的打勾劃掉
・常備調味料另外收起來

【記到健康】
・吃完按一下，把這一餐的營養寫入 Apple「健康」App
・只寫入、不讀取任何健康資料，剛記的那筆可以復原

【自己的食譜】
・新增自己的食譜，可加入收藏、採買清單、料理模式

注意：本 App 的營養數值與價格皆為估算，不能取代醫師或營養師的建議。

name: Learn Norwegian with Comics
description:
Learn Norwegian with funny comics: read, listen and tap any word to understand it.

Learn Norwegian through comics. Read short illustrated stories, listen to every line in Norwegian and tap any word to see its translation. Komiks·Lab is made for people moving to Norway, expats, students and teachers. The stories follow real life: the doctor, BankID, work, school and everyday conversations.

WHAT YOU GET
• A big library of illustrated comics, A1 to B2
• New content every day
• Norwegian voice audio for every line
• Tap a word to see its translation
• Words with pictures, sorted by topic
• Grammar topics with exercises
• Tests that explain your mistakes
• Daily lessons and a personal study plan

REAL LIFE IN NORWAY
The doctor and the pharmacy, NAV and the tax card, BankID and a bank account, renting an apartment, job interviews, school and kindergarten, shopping, buses and trains, dugnad and neighbors, Christmas and 17 May.

PRACTICE FOR NORSKPRØVEN
Level tests from A1 to B2, listening and reading practice and writing tasks.

START IN 3 STEPS
1. Find your level with a short test or start at A1.
2. Read a comic and listen to every line in Norwegian.
3. Practice with a quick test. Your mistakes come back after 1 and 3 days.

PLAY TOGETHER
Teachers can start a class game in seconds. Students scan a QR code and play on their phones, with nothing to install.
Schools can use school accounts: teachers create classes, pupils sign in with a login and PIN from their teacher, and teachers follow their progress.

MORE TO EXPLORE
Math Rocket, chess, crosswords, typing practice and a coding game for kids.

The app is available in 23 languages.

All stories, characters, drawings and voices are fictional and created with artificial intelligence.

Terms of Use: https://bilohash.com/comiks/#/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bilohash.com/comiks/privacy.html

name: LearnIQ TimesTable
description:
Times tables finally stick when you can SEE them! LearnIQ Times Tables pictures every multiplication fact, then helps you practise with quick quizzes, rewards and a friendly robot study buddy.

THREE WAYS TO SEE A FACT Arrays, groups and number lines show what 7 × 8 really means, so the answers make sense instead of being memorised blind. Pick your favourite picture or mix them all together.

FOUR QUIZZES, ONE STEP AT A TIME • Multiply: count the picture and pick the answer • Missing Number: work backwards, like 7 × ? = 56 • Divide: every fact has a division twin, like 56 ÷ 7 • Compare: which is bigger, 6 × 7 or 5 × 8? Choose greater than, less than or = Each quiz unlocks when you score 7 out of 10 in the one before it, so you always build on what you already know.

60-SECOND BLITZ How many can you answer in one minute? Beat your own best score!

QUIZZES THAT GROW WITH YOU Junior practises the friendlier tables (2 to 6 and 10). Advanced covers every table up to 12 × 12. Easy, Medium and Hard levels unlock automatically as you win, and the facts you miss come back more often.

MEET IGGY Iggy the robot cheers for your right answers, encourages you through the tricky ones and celebrates your results. Tap him to say hello! A wrong answer is never a big deal: Iggy just helps you try again.

LEVELS, XP AND BADGES Earn XP for every right answer, level up through fun ranks and collect 12 shiny badges for perfect scores, speed bonuses, streaks, Blitz records and mastering every fact.

CHESTS, SPARKS AND POWER-UPS Finish your daily goal, level up or earn a badge and Iggy gives you a chest with two surprises: new places for Iggy to visit and handy power-ups like 50/50 and Second chance. Spend the Sparks you earn in the shop. Everything is earned by playing: no ads, no in-app purchases, nothing to buy with real money.

BUILD A HABIT Set a daily goal, keep your streak going and turn on an optional daily reminder. Prefer to take your time? Relaxed Mode switches the timer off.

TIMES TABLE LIBRARY Browse every table from 2 to 12 with a handy trick for each one, and flip any fact through every picture style.

SAFE AND SIMPLE • No ads and no tracking • No account or sign-up • Works completely offline; your progress stays on your device • Sharing is protected by a parent check • Light and dark appearance and large, easy-to-read text

Questions or feedback? Visit learniqapps.com.

name: Lector: Read Me Aloud
description:
Lector reads your documents aloud — in the language you choose.

Open a PDF, a Word document, an EPUB book or a text file, press play, and listen. Lector highlights each sentence as it reads, so you can follow along or look away and just listen: on a walk, while cooking, on the commute.

LISTEN TO ANYTHING
• PDF, DOCX, DOC (older Word), EPUB and TXT
• Scanned PDFs too: Lector recognizes the text on the page
• Sentence highlighting with the current word marked
• Tap any sentence to start reading from there
• Speed from 0.5× to 3×, skip ±15 seconds, sleep timer
• Keeps playing with the screen locked, with lock-screen controls

TRANSLATE WHILE YOU LISTEN
• Read an English document in Spanish, French and many more languages
• Translation runs on your iPhone with Apple's Translation feature
• "Show original" switches back instantly

YOUR FILES, YOUR WAY
• Add files from iCloud Drive, Google Drive (through the Files app) or your iPhone
• Save a copy for offline listening, or keep the file in the cloud
• Share to Lector from Mail, Safari or any app

PICKS UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
• Your library, reading position and settings sync across your iPhones through your own iCloud
• No account to create, no sign-in

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Free, with no ads and no tracking
• Reading, translation and speech happen on your device
• We don't collect any data — we can't see your files or your library

Tip: for the most natural sound, download an Enhanced or Premium voice in Settings › Accessibility › Read & Speak › Voices.

name: LendNest-Item Lending Tracker
description:
Keep track of tools, camping gear and other items you lend out. LendNest groups records into spaces so you can see what is due and how many items are still to be returned.
RECORD WHAT YOU LEND  Keep the item, borrower, quantity and due date together. Browse active, overdue and returned records in the lending list.
ORGANIZE BY SPACE  Create spaces for different uses, switch between them and review each set of records separately. Rename a space when your needs change.
FOLLOW RETURN PROGRESS  See the returned and outstanding quantities for each record, including when items come back in parts.
REVIEW RECENT ACTIVITY  See returned and overdue totals, returned item counts and recent lending and return activity for the current space.
MORE ROOM AND EXPORT  Membership provides additional spaces and record capacity, plus CSV export and sharing for the current space.

name: Lexiboo
description:
Lexiboo is a cheerful flashcard app on a green chalkboard. Lexi, a little fox in a graduation cap, keeps you company while you learn words, capitals, definitions or anything else.

MAKE A DECK
Tap "New deck" on the chalk tray, give it a name, an emoji and a chalk colour, then add cards with a front and a back. Got a list already? Open a deck's menu, tap "Import cards" and paste one card per line, like "perro - dog".

FLIP AND SWIPE
Tap "Study due" to review the cards that are due today. Tap a card to flip it, then swipe right (or tap "Got it") if you knew it and left (or "Again") if you didn't. "Cram all" lets you go through the whole deck.

FIVE LEITNER BOXES
Every card climbs five boxes. A card you know moves up a box and comes back after 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 days. A card you miss goes back to box 1 and returns tomorrow, so you spend your time on what you still need.

MORE WAYS TO PRACTISE
• Quiz: type the answer. Lexiboo ignores capitals, accents and punctuation, and "I was right" fixes a typo
• Listen: Lexiboo reads the front and the back aloud with the iPhone's built-in voices, in 15 languages, with adjustable speed and pause
• Match: pair 6 words with their meanings against the clock and beat your best time for each deck

REPORT CARD
See your study streak, cards mastered, cards due now, a chart of the cards you studied this week and the mastery of each deck.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline
• Your decks, cards and study history are stored only on your iPhone
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Account optional: tap "Skip class", or sign in with Google
• Erase your data or delete your account at any time

NEW HERE?
Lexiboo starts with three sample decks (Spanish Basics, World Capitals and Science Words) so you can try everything right away. Remove them with Me → Erase all app data, or add them again with "Load sample decks".

PRIMARY CATEGORY: Education
SECONDARY CATEGORY: Productivity
AGE RATING: 4+
COPYRIGHT: 2026 Lexiboo

name: Libero League
description:
You are the head coach of a professional volleyball club. Pick one of 82 clubs in eight leagues, build a squad, and try to finish where the board expects. Then see who calls in the summer.

THE SQUAD IS YOURS
Nobody signs players for you. Every deal goes through an agent: wage, years, a signing bonus, a promise of playing time, a release clause. Agents answer with exact terms and walk away after three rounds. Buy players out of their contracts, trade, or sell quickly when the bank runs low. The season won't start until you have two setters, three outside hitters, two middles, an opposite and a libero under contract.

MATCH DAY
Pick your starting six, set a plan for each set, and call timeouts as the rallies come in. Or simulate a week, run to the playoffs, or play the whole year and read the report.

EIGHT LEAGUES
Poland, Italy, Turkey, Brazil, Japan and the United States, each sized like the real thing. Italy and Poland have second divisions, two up and two down. The US league has a salary cap. The top two of each top league meet midweek in the Champions Cup.

THE NATIONAL TEAM
Win and your name gets around. The first offer comes from a small nation; the big ones want a record. 64 nations play qualifiers in five international breaks, a Nations Series every summer, a World Championship in odd years and the Summer Games from 2028. You pick the roster for each tournament and coach it game by game.

MONEY
Two numbers to watch: the board's wage budget and the transfer funds in the bank. Hit the target and the budget goes up next season. Miss it and it shrinks. Miss it twice running and the board sacks you.

MEN'S AND WOMEN'S GAME
Start a career in either, with three save slots.

FREE TO PLAY, NO TIMERS
The whole game is free to play with every club outside the biggest. The Big Club Pack opens the big clubs of each top league; it doesn't make any player better. No Ads takes the adverts away, and Premium is both for less. No timers, no account. It plays offline.

Clubs, players and coaches are invented. The countries and cities are real.

name: Lieger
description:
Lieger ajuda els infants de 6 a 8 anys a practicar la lectura, acompanyats d'una persona adulta.

Lieger està inspirada en la recerca científica sobre l'aprenentatge de la lectura (consciència fonològica, síl·labes i lectura repetida) per ajudar els nens i les nenes a aprendre a llegir de manera progressiva i divertida.

EXERCICIS PAS A PAS
Més de 180 exercicis en 8 blocs, de les vocals i les síl·labes directes fins a les frases i els textos breus. Cada exercici combina escalfament oral, taules de síl·labes, paraules de marcià (pseudoparaules,inventades, per llegir so a so), paraules de veritat, dictat i comprensió.

LA PERSONA ADULTA ACOMPANYA
Lieger no corregeix sola: l'adult escolta, marca les paraules que han costat, cronometra tres lectures i decideix si cal repetir o avançar. Cada pas té una guia.

UN VIATGE AMB MARCIANS
Cada exercici dona estrelles i descobreix un marcià nou per a l'àlbum. Sense ratxes que es perdin, sense competicions i sense missatges negatius: repetir no és fallar.

LECTOR AMB LA CÀMERA
Fotografia un text (un conte, un full) o importa'l d'una foto, i Lieger el mostra amb lletra gran, síl·labes de colors o separades amb punts, majúscules i espaiats a mida. Pensat per facilitar la lectura també als infants amb dificultats o trastorns de la lectura. El text i les imatges no surten del dispositiu. Fes-lo servir només amb textos que tinguis dret a utilitzar.

PENSAT PER LLEGIR BÉ
Tipografia per a primers lectors, paper sense distraccions, mode color amb paletes provades amb simulació de daltonisme, i text normal o en MAJÚSCULES.

UN PERFIL PER A CADA INFANT
Fins a 8 perfils al mateix dispositiu, cadascun amb el seu viatge i els seus ajustaments de lectura. Sense comptes, sense correu i sense dades personals.

CATALÀ I CASTELLÀ
Els exercicis existeixen en les dues llengües, adaptats a cadascuna (no són traduccions).

GRATUÏT I COMPRA ÚNICA
Els 3 primers exercicis de cada bloc i una captura setmanal amb el lector són gratuïts. Una sola compra desbloqueja tots els exercicis i el lector sense límit. Pagament únic, sense subscripcions. Les compres queden protegides per una porta parental.

Lieger és una eina per practicar la lectura; no és un tractament mèdic ni un diagnòstic.

name: Lifory
description:
Lifory(LIFE + STORY)는 사람들이 자기 이야기를 말로 들려주는 숏폼을 모아 보는 곳이에요.

■ 이야기를 들려준 사람과 함께
가게를 꾸리는 사장님, 새로 도전하는 직장인, 아이를 키우는 부모… 꾸미지 않은 목소리로 들려주는 경험을 위아래로 넘기며 만나요.

■ 영상 속 말까지 글로
영상마다 말한 내용 전체가 함께 있어요. 소리를 켜기 어려운 곳에서도 읽을 수 있고, 마음에 남은 한마디로 다시 찾을 수 있어요.

■ 이 영상에 담긴 이야기
영상이 들려주는 이야기와 '이런 게 궁금했다면'을 짧게 정리해 두었어요.

■ 함께 보기
마음에 드는 이야기에 별을 남기고, 저장하고, 들려준 사람을 팔로우하세요. 댓글로 이야기를 이어 가요.

■ 편하게 보기
볼륨 키를 누르면 바로 소리가 켜지고, 화면을 한 번 누르면 멈춰요.

■ 안심하고
불편한 영상이나 댓글은 신고할 수 있고, 원치 않는 계정은 차단할 수 있어요. 신고는 운영진이 확인해 처리해요.

영상은 꽁AI(얍꽁)로 만들어 올려요. 운영: 주식회사 해이전시

name: Light Finder: Sun Tracker & AR
description:
Find the light, then measure it. Light Finder is a sun and moon tracker with AR and a camera light meter in one app. Pay once. No subscription, no ads, no account, no tracking.

SEE WHERE THE SUN WILL BE
• Sky: hold up your phone and see today's sun and moon paths drawn over the camera view, with hour markers and the golden and blue hour stretches marked on the arc.
• Drag through the day or pick any date to see exactly where the sun will rise, set or sit at 4:58 PM.
• Map: sunrise, sunset, sun and moon direction lines on a map, with shadow direction. Search a place, type coordinates or drag the pin.

GOLDEN HOUR, TO THE MINUTE
• Today: a countdown to the next golden hour, blue hour or sunset, with a ribbon of the whole day's light.
• Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil, nautical and astronomical twilight, moonrise, moonset and moon phase.
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy, and a "Next golden hour" shortcut for Siri and Spotlight.

A LIGHT METER FOR ANY CAMERA
• Reflected light metering with the iPhone camera, shown as EV and as shutter, aperture and ISO.
• Solve for shutter, aperture or ISO with the other two locked. Third, half or full stops.
• Tap to meter a spot, or read the whole scene. Hold a reading with one tap.
• ND filters and filter factors up to 20 stops, and reciprocity correction for popular film stocks.
• Meter off a gray card, a long-exposure timer, an exposure log, and calibration against your own meter or camera.

PLAN AND KEEP
• Save places and plans: a place, a date and time, a note and a meter reading.
• Open a plan and the whole app jumps to that moment.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works offline. Sun, moon and meter are computed on your phone; no signal needed. Map tiles and place search use a connection when one is available.
• Red night mode keeps your night vision at dark sites.
• Dark and light themes, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion support.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Light Finder has no servers and no accounts. Your location is used on your phone to compute the sun and moon and never leaves it. The camera is used live for the sky view and the meter; nothing is recorded or saved.

Meter readings are a guide: like any reflected meter, check your first frame and use calibration to match your camera.

name: Lilimind: Live Captions & AI
description:
Lilimind shows what is being said in a lecture or meeting as live captions on your iPhone or iPad, with a translation between English and Chinese.
Captions and on-device translation are free, with no time limit.
When you want more, AI features add a clearer translation, key points while you listen, answers to your questions about what was said, and notes at the end.

WHAT IT DOES
• Live captions: speech is turned into text on your device as people talk.
• Translation: English to Chinese, or Chinese to English, shown with the original.
• Key points while you listen: a short running summary, so you can catch up if you lose the thread.
• Ask: type a question about what was said and get a short answer.
• Notes at the end: a title, key points, sections, figures and dates, things to do and open questions.
• Meeting mode also suggests what you could say next and drafts a short follow-up email.
• Meeting cards: before a meeting or event, say who you are meeting and what you want, or import an email or file. Lilimind drafts a card with the people, opening lines and the steps to follow, shown during the session.
• Export: save a session as one file (notes, captions in both languages, summary) to keep or to use with your own AI tools.

TWO MODES
Lecture mode: captions, translation, key points and notes.
Meeting mode: everything in lecture mode, plus what-to-say suggestions and a follow-up email draft.

FREE AND PAID
Free, with no time limit: live captions and on-device translation.
Each device also gets one 30-minute trial of the AI features.
AI features are sold by time, as passes or as a subscription:
• Day pass: 3 hours within 24 hours
• Week pass: 8 hours within 7 days
• Term pass: 60 lecture hours within 16 weeks (lecture mode only)
• Monthly or annual subscription: 15 hours a month
Passes do not renew. When your time runs out, only the AI features stop. Your session keeps going, and captions and on-device translation carry on.

PRIVACY
• Audio is never uploaded; an optional recording stays on the device.
• Speech is turned into text on your device.
• For the AI features, text is sent to the AI model provider to be processed. It is not used to train models, and we do not keep your captions, questions or notes on our servers.
• Notes and transcripts are stored on your device only.
• No account or login is needed.
• A listening indicator is on screen whenever the microphone is on.

TELL THE PEOPLE PRESENT
Before each session the app asks you to confirm that you have told the people present. A notice card in English and Chinese is one tap away, so you can show it to the room. Some universities and workplaces have their own rules on captioning and transcription tools. Please check yours.

GOOD TO KNOW
• English and Chinese (Mandarin) only in this version.
• Needs iOS 26 or iPadOS 26, or later.
• It captions what the device microphone can hear, so sit where the speaker is clear.
• Captions and translations can contain mistakes, more so with strong accents, background noise and specialist terms. AI output is labelled "AI-generated. Please check."
• Captions do not show who is speaking.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel a subscription in your App Store account settings. Unused hours do not carry over.

Terms of Use: https://lilimind.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lilimind.com/privacy
Support: https://lilimind.com/support

Lilimind is made by an independent developer in the UK. I read every message: support@lilimind.com

name: Limzplayer: Lyrics Player
description:
A light, fast player for the music saved on your phone, with lyrics that scroll along with the song.

SYNCED LYRICS
• Reads lyrics stored inside your music files (MP3, FLAC, M4A)
• Timed lyrics (LRC) highlight the line being sung and keep it centred
• Tap a line to jump to that part of the song
• Nudge lyrics earlier or later in 0.5 s steps — remembered per song

FIND YOUR MUSIC
• All songs, Folders, Artists and Albums
• Quick search across titles, artists and albums
• Index bar for fast jumps, album art

PLAYBACK
• Shuffle, repeat all and repeat one
• Keeps playing with the screen off; lock screen and notification controls
• "Play along with other apps" keeps the music going when a game makes sound

Free with a small banner ad. Remove all ads with an optional monthly subscription.
Lyrics are never downloaded — only the lyrics in your own files are shown, and your music stays on your device.

Privacy Policy: https://vnamu.com/apps/limzplayer/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: LineaBusCR
description:
LineaBusCR shows where buses are in Costa Rica, in real time, thanks to the riders themselves.

When you're on the bus, tap "I'm on the bus" and your phone shares its location for the length of the trip. People waiting at the stop see the bus move on the map and how long until it arrives.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See routes on the map, with their stops, in both directions.
• Follow buses live when someone on board is sharing the trip.
• Share your trip with one tap and help other riders.
• Set alerts: pick a stop and we'll let you know a few minutes before the bus gets there.

PILOT ROUTES
• Cartago ↔ San José
• San José ↔ Heredia
• Heredia ↔ Alajuela
• Alajuela ↔ San José

We'll add more routes as people start using it.

YOUR PRIVACY
• No account needed.
• Your location is only shared while you have an active trip. The trip ends when you end it, or on its own at the end of the route or when you get off the bus.
• Location points are deleted after 15 minutes; we never show who is on the bus.

description:

description:
Turn on newborn bedtime sounds from one phone in the middle of the night.
Choose womb, heartbeat, white, pink, and brown noise, plus lullabies.

[Pick a sound]

[Check the sound by baby’s spot]
Place your phone near baby’s head and measure for 10 seconds to see whether the sound is above the 50 dB recommendation.
It uses your phone microphone as a reference, so readings can vary by room and device.
This is based on a Pediatrics 2014 study that found 13 of 14 infant sleep machines exceeded 50 dB at maximum volume.

[Logs and little tools]
Tap “Fell asleep” and “Baby woke up” once each to save sleep and wake times.
The night light has 3 light options and adjustable brightness for feeds or diaper changes.
You can also start and stop sounds with Siri.

[Only on your device]
Loary has no login and no server.
Sleep logs, sound settings, and parent voice recordings stay on your device.

[With Pro]
Play all night when you leave the app or lock your phone, with remaining time, stop, and 30-minute extension on the Lock Screen.
After the timer ends, Cry Restart can listen for baby’s cry and turn the sound back on softly. Audio is not saved. In the morning, Last Night shows when it restarted.
Mix up to 3 sounds and save your mixes. Record Mom’s or Dad’s voice.
Use the full 15-song lullaby library, dawn birds, weekly sleep graph, next nap reminder based on wake-window reference ranges, sleep helper, and Apple Watch remote.

Luxe talks to your lights over Wi-Fi with the LIFX LAN protocol. No account and no cloud for your lights. What leaves your network is what you send the AI designer (your prompt or photo, and the shapes of your lights) and, if you subscribe, your purchase record.

WORKS WITH
LIFX colour bulbs, LIFX Z and Lightstrip, the LIFX Beam and LIFX Candle Colour, on the same Wi-Fi as your iPhone or iPad. Luxe is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LIFX or Feit Electric.

name: Ma Télécommande TV LG
description:
Ma Télécommande TV LG transforme ton iPhone en télécommande pour les TV LG sous webOS, sur ton réseau Wi‑Fi.

TÉLÉCOMMANDE
Croix de navigation, OK, retour, accueil, volume, lecture et pause, accès rapide aux chaînes. Les boutons de volume de l'iPhone règlent le volume de la TV quand l'app est ouverte.

CHAÎNES
Favoris, TV et radio, recherche par nom ou par numéro. Pour chaque chaîne, le programme en cours et sa progression. Touche une chaîne pour zapper.

APPS
Lance les apps installées sur la TV. Trie-les dans ton ordre, de A à Z ou par usage.

MOLOTOV
Ouvre une chaîne dans Molotov sur la TV, en direct ou depuis le début.

ET AUSSI
Sources HDMI et entrées, pavé tactile pour le pointeur, envoi d'un lien vers la TV, choix de la sortie son.

PARTAGE
Depuis Safari, YouTube ou Messages, partage un lien vers l'app pour l'ouvrir sur la TV.

SIRI, RACCOURCIS ET CENTRE DE CONTRÔLE
Allume ou éteins la TV, change de chaîne, ouvre une app, mets en pause, règle le son, à la voix ou depuis l'app Raccourcis. Ajoute des boutons au Centre de contrôle : télécommande, allumer, éteindre, couper le son.

SIMPLE ET PRIVÉ
Pas de compte, pas de publicité. L'app trouve la TV sur le réseau local. À la première connexion, la TV te demande d'accepter l'iPhone.

CONDITIONS
Une TV LG webOS sur le même réseau Wi‑Fi que l'iPhone. Pour allumer la TV depuis l'iPhone, active sur la TV le réglage « Allumer la TV via Wi‑Fi / mobile ».

Cette app n'est pas une app officielle LG. LG et webOS sont des marques de LG Electronics.

name: Madavvero
description:
Ti è mai capitato di restare senza argomenti a una cena? Con Madavvero ogni giorno impari qualcosa di vero, curioso e facile da raccontare.

CURIOSITÀ VERE, IN 10 SECONDI
Scorri un feed di curiosità su storia, scienza, spazio, animali, corpo umano, parole, cibo, geografia, arte e musica, tecnologia, sport e notizie. Brevi da leggere al volo, o approfondimenti da un minuto quando hai più tempo.

PERCHÉ È VERO, E COME DIRLO
Ogni curiosità ha la sua fonte e una spiegazione per rispondere a chi ti chiede «ma davvero?». E c'è già la frase giusta per tirarla fuori in conversazione.

TE LO RICORDI?
Salva quelle che ti piacciono: tornano nel ripasso proprio quando rischi di dimenticarle, sempre più di rado man mano che le sai. Se vuoi, un promemoria al giorno te lo ricorda.

ESCO STASERA
Cinque curiosità facili da raccontare, scelte per la compagnia: amici, appuntamento, lavoro o famiglia. Le ripassi in un minuto prima di uscire.

UNA PAROLA AL GIORNO
Ogni giorno una parola italiana bella e poco comune, da scoprire: prima provi a indovinarla, poi leggi significato, origine ed esempio. Con il link al vocabolario Treccani.

SOLO PER TE
Il feed impara dai tuoi Mi piace e ti propone prima le curiosità che non hai ancora visto. Ognuno ha la sua curiosità e la sua parola del giorno.

WIDGET
Curiosità e parola del giorno, e le curiosità da ripassare, sulla Home e sul blocco schermo.

MANDA NEL GRUPPO
Trasforma una curiosità in un'immagine da mandare su WhatsApp o Telegram e fai partire la discussione.

MADAVVERO PLUS
Madavvero è gratis, con un annuncio ogni sei curiosità. Plus toglie la pubblicità e i limiti: salvate e ripassi illimitati, Esco stasera per ogni compagnia, le curiosità nuove in anteprima, le tue statistiche e le icone alternative.
Plus mensile: 0,99 € al mese. Plus annuale: 6,99 € all'anno, con 7 giorni gratis. Plus per sempre: 12,99 € una volta sola.
L'abbonamento si rinnova automaticamente; puoi disdirlo quando vuoi dalle impostazioni del tuo Apple ID, almeno 24 ore prima del rinnovo.

Condizioni d'uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://madavveroapp.github.io/privacy.html

name: MAFIA by Perkuno – Party Game
description:
An evening with friends, one story and one secret: which of you is the mafia?

MAFIA by Perkuno is a party game of bluff and intuition for 4–20 players in one room, plus a narrator. The narrator reads the story aloud from their phone, sees every role and runs the game. Everyone else plays on their own phone and joins with a code, QR code or link. You can also play with one phone passed from hand to hand.

At night the mafia quietly picks a victim, the doctor saves, the detective checks. In the day everyone talks, argues and votes on who leaves the game. The town wins when the mafia is found; the mafia wins when it is as numerous as everyone else.

• 3 free stories: Night of Perkūnas – an old Baltic village with werewolves; Harbour Shadows – a Hanseatic port with smugglers; Station Orbita – a space station with saboteurs
• 40 characters in every story
• Roles: mafia, doctor, detective, seductress, jester and civilians
• A quiet first night to get to know each other
• The narrator wakes the roles one by one – the night goes step by step
• Every story comes with storyteller texts – the narrator just reads
• Silent play – phones never vibrate or ring, nobody gives themselves away
• Sentences follow each player's grammatical gender in languages that have it
• 16 languages – every player can use their own

No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no chat – just you around one table.

name: Magdou Biomedical
description:
Magdou Biomedical is the app for customers and staff of Magdou Biomedical Services, a medical imaging equipment sales and service company.

FOR CUSTOMERS (hospitals, imaging centers, clinics)
- Request service for a system in a minute: pick the equipment, describe the problem, add a photo.
- Mark a request as equipment down so it reaches the on-call engineer straight away.
- Follow every request: who is assigned, when they are on the way, what was done.
- Download signed service reports and checklists for every visit.
- See your preventive maintenance schedule and approve quotes.

FOR FIELD ENGINEERS
- Today's jobs, upcoming jobs and jobs waiting for a time.
- Emergency alarm: equipment-down jobs ring until you accept.
- Map of your sites with your position, drive time estimate and one-tap navigation.
- On my way: one tap tells the office and the customer.
- Work notes, photos, PM checklists and the service report with the customer's signature.
- Ask Magdou: answers about a system's history, error codes and next steps.

FOR THE OFFICE
- Dispatchers, service managers, reviewers, parts and finance open their own pages from one home screen.

An account from Magdou Biomedical Services is required. The app does not create accounts. Location is shared with the dispatch office only while an engineer is on duty.

name: Magic Clipboard
description:
Magic Clipboard turns text you copy, select or share into one-tap actions. Copy a phone number, an address, a date or a sum, then tap. It calls, maps, adds the event or shows the answer.

It all happens on your iPhone. Nothing you copy, select, share or type is sent to us.

WHAT IT DOES • Phone numbers. Call, text, or save as a contact. The call opens in your phone app, ready for you to press. • Addresses. Open them in Apple Maps. • Dates and times. “Dinner Friday at 8” becomes a calendar event or a reminder, filled in for you to check and save. • Money. Convert a price, add or remove tax, take a discount, or split a bill with a tip. • Sums and units. 12*3+4 becomes 40. 5 km becomes 3.11 mi. • Links and email. Open a link with the tracking removed, or start an email.

HOW TO OPEN IT • Check clipboard. The system Paste button reads the clipboard once, when you ask. • Share text from any app. • Control Center, the Home Screen widget, and the Check clipboard shortcut on the app icon. • Shortcuts, Siri, Back Tap or the Action Button.

MAGIC KEYBOARD An optional keyboard with the same tools above the keys. • The wand tidies the text in place: answers a sum, converts a price, cleans a link, formats a number. • Live answers. Type 450/3 and “= 150” appears. Tap it to add it. • Encode turns a short message into ordinary sentences. Copy them back to reveal it. This disguises a message. It does not lock it. • Change case, word suggestions, T9, a paste page for recent and pinned copies, and keyboard designs. • Password fields stay on Apple’s keyboard. Nothing you type is stored or sent.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account. No ads. No analytics. History stays on your iPhone. The only download is exchange rates, and that request carries nothing about you.

https://magicclipboard.iovii.com

name: Magnetrix - Maze Studio
description:
Enter Magnetrix, a vibrant magnetic maze studio where every route is a new challenge.
Guide a glowing orb through twisting passages using smooth swipe controls or the directional pad.
Navigate magnetic walls, avoid roving obstacles and activate checkpoints on the way to the finish.
Explore six ready-to-play mazes with timed runs, star ratings and score tracking.
Design your own mazes using an interactive tile editor with walls, hazards, goals and more.
Save, edit, duplicate and favorite your creations, then return to play them whenever you like.
Build achievements through real progress while all mazes and records remain stored offline on your device.

name: Maintix
seller_name: VICTORY ARCH GROUP FOR COMPUTER SERVICES
description:

هو نظام أتمتة كافة عمليات الصيانة والأصول وتدفقات العمل داخل المنشآت والمصانع والقطاعات الخدمية (مثل الفنادق والمستشفيات). يهدف النظام إلى تحويل أعمال الصيانة الى تنظيم وقائي يضمن استمرارية التشغيل،و تقليل الأعطال المفاجئة، وتمديد العمر الافتراضي للأصول مع ضبط التكاليف.
ادوار المستخدمين في نظام Maintix ومهام كل دور:
مدير النظام (Admin):

المهام في النظام: إضافة وتعديل حسابات المستخدمين وتحديد أدوارهم، إعداد هيكلية الأصول والأقسام، تخصيص نماذج أوامر العمل والتنبيهات، وإجراء النسخ الاحتياطي وإدارة التكامل مع الأنظمة الأخرى.

مديرأمر العمل (WO Owner):
