آلية طلب الموارد والقطع داخل النظام :
يُتيح النظام لـ مديرأمر العمل (WO Owner) والفني (Technician) تقديم طلبات التزويد بالموارد مباشرة من داخل أمر العمل او المهمة وفق نظام الصلاحيات الآتي:

الطلبات المباشرة (Direct Requests - بدون موافقة):

تُصرف فوراً أو تُوجه مباشرة للمستودع/قسم الموارد البشري إذا كانت قطع الغيار أو الأدوات متوفرة ضمن الحدود المالية/الكمية المسموح بها للفني أو مديرأمر العمل، أو إذا كانت طلبات عمالة مساندة اعتيادية.

الطلبات المشروطة بموافقة (Approval Required):

يتم تحويل الطلب تلقائياً إلى المدير الأعلى / Admin / TeamLead لراجعتها.

name: MAKSET
description:
Make Every Set Count.

MAKSET is a workout journal focused on your weights, reps, rest time and training history.

• Log sets quickly
Enter your weight and reps, then mark a set complete. Apply values from your previous workout to unfinished sets.

• Compare volume while you train
See each exercise’s completed-set volume and its change from the previous workout for that exercise. Volume and differences use the default unit in Settings.

• Record in kg or lb
During a workout, choose kg or lbs for each exercise’s weight inputs and previous record. Your active workout’s choices survive relaunch. The default unit in Settings applies to total volume, statistics, routines and exercises without a separate choice. Changing units keeps actual weights unchanged.

• Rest between sets
Enter a rest time in seconds in Settings, for each exercise or in a routine. Completing a set starts that exercise’s rest timer. Add time or skip ahead when you are ready. Turn on Rest alerts in Settings and allow notifications to receive an alert when your rest ends. Turning them off in the app cancels pending alerts.

• See your training history
Find completed workouts on the calendar and view weekly workout counts, completed sets, volume and sets by muscle group.

• Compare your weeks
Compare the heaviest completed squat, bench press and deadlift sets with the previous week, with reps shown alongside the weight. See total workout time, including rest, and workout counts together.

• Add exercises of your own
Enter a name, choose a muscle group and optionally add equipment. Save your exercise and find it again during workouts or when editing routines.

• Make your own routines
Save your exercise order, sets, weights, reps and rest times. You can also start a free workout without a preset routine.

• Companion logging on Apple Watch
See the workout you started on iPhone on your paired Apple Watch. While connected, edit weights and reps, complete sets and control the rest timer. Start and finish workouts on iPhone. Watch editing is unavailable when the connection is lost.

• Korean and English
Choose Korean or English in Settings. Search built-in exercises using Korean or English names. Your own exercise and equipment names stay exactly as you entered them.

• Keep your records on your device
Workouts, routines and your custom exercise library are saved locally. Resume an unfinished workout. Automatic cloud sync and in-app backup file export or import are not included.

• Optional community
Share training experiences, questions and tips with a nickname. Posts, comments, photos, likes, reporting, blocking and deletion are available. Provider sign-in is optional. Your private workout journal is not automatically shared.

Workout logging needs no registration. There are no ads or in-app purchases.

Volume is the sum of weight × reps for completed sets. Bodyweight exercises can be logged at 0 kg or 0 lb and tracked by sets and reps.

name: Malefactor
description:
Malefactor is an aggressive virtual-analog mono/duo-synth for iPad. It is built for basses that growl, leads that scream and drones that never sit still, and it plays as a standalone app or as an AUv3 instrument inside your host. It is a sci-fi sound designer’s dream tool.

Nothing in Malefactor is clean by accident. Every stage is modelled as a circuit that can be pushed: oscillator level changes the tone, the mixer saturates, resonance fights the input signal, and drive is the amplifier itself misbehaving, not an effect added at the end.

SOUND ENGINE
• Two oscillators with continuous wave shaping, each with pulse, saw and triangle outputs you can combine
• Two FM inputs per oscillator, exponential or linear, plus hard and soft sync
• Sub oscillator, one or two octaves down
• Mixer with noise and a feedback path, made to be overdriven
• Nonlinear resonant filter with key tracking and two FM inputs
• Amplifier with drive and two AM inputs
• Analog drift, glide, and unison of up to four detuned voices
• Mono and duo modes: in duo, each oscillator plays its own note
• Three quality settings, so you can trade CPU for oversampling

MODULATION
• Routing matrix: send any source to any destination, audio or control, including feedback routes
• Two envelopes, an LFO with tempo sync, a vibrato LFO and sample & hold
• Two MSEGs that you draw with your finger
• Velocity, key tracking and other performance sources in the matrix

MADE FOR TOUCH
• An interface laid out for iPad, with large controls on every page
• On-screen keyboard with velocity by touch position, octave buttons and HOLD for drones
• RANDOM and VARY to find new sounds, with BACK and FWD to step through what you tried

PRESETS
• 16 factory presets, from playable basses to possessed drones
• Save your own, and share presets with the desktop version of Malefactor through the Files app. **Desktop version sold separately**

CONNECTIVITY
• AUv3 instrument, tested in AUM and GarageBand
• USB and Bluetooth MIDI
• MIDI learn: hold a knob to assign a controller

No account, no subscription, no in-app purchases, and no data collected.

Requires an iPad with iPadOS 16 or later.

name: Manga Ledger
description:
Manga Ledger is a local production control desk for manga-drama supervisors and producers.
Keep your slate organized without accounts or cloud sync. Everything stays on your device so you can work in meetings, on set, or offline.
CATALOG
Archive benchmark titles with covers, genre, platform, episode counts, scores, tags, and producer notes. Search quickly when you need a comparable reference.
PIPELINE
Track active productions from brief to delivery. Update stage, priority, progress, due dates, and milestones so the whole slate stays visible.
METRICS
Model episode load, storyboard pages, voice hours, render time, crew size, rates, and contingency. Save estimates you can revisit before locking a budget.
SCRAPBOOK
Collect visual, color, audio, pacing, and casting references next to your projects. Attach covers from Photos or Camera when you need a clearer note.
DESK
See workspace counts at a glance, export or import JSON backups, restore demo records, or clear local data when you start a new season.
Built for producers who want a focused, cover-forward workspace—private, practical, and ready when production moves fast.

name: Mangazette – Learn Languages
description:
Mangazette teaches you a language through the news, told as a manga.

Every morning five new stories from around the world arrive, taken from Wikipedia's current events. Tap one, and two friends, Mika and Tomo, talk it through in the language you are learning, panel by panel, with pictures drawn for the story. You play Tomo: on some of his lines a word is missing, and you pick it from three.

LEARN SPANISH, GERMAN, JAPANESE, ARABIC OR RUSSIAN
• Two levels: Simple and Advanced
• Every line with its English translation, the words to learn marked in yellow
• Tap a marked word for its meaning; it is kept for you
• Listen to every line, slowly if you like
• See how a word is read when you want it: kana for Japanese, Latin letters for Arabic and Russian

YOUR WORDS, ON A SCHEDULE
• Every word you meet is kept with the sentence it came in
• A trainer brings each word back after a day, three days, a week and three weeks
• Four kinds of exercises that get harder as a word gets stronger
• Train your words while your next lesson is being prepared

REAL NEWS, CLEARLY MARKED
• The stories come from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0), with links to the original reports
• The dialogs and pictures are made by AI for language learning. They are not news reports and can contain mistakes. You can report a mistake in any lesson without leaving the app.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO TRACKING
There is no sign-in and nothing to buy. Your words and choices stay on your phone.

Mangazette shows the news of the world, which includes conflicts, crime and disasters.

name: Manx Club
description:
The member app of the Manx Club, the club for Manx-style dune buggy owners and fans.

THE CLUB
• Club news and announcements
• Events: dates, details and registration
• Your membership card, with renewal reminders
• Manx Mania, the club magazine
• Send the club your stories, photos and tech tips

AT THE EVENT
• Announcements, schedule changes and messages from the organizers, with a notification the moment something changes
• Live map: see your group on the run and follow the route, and share your position with the other drivers at your event
• Sharing keeps going while the app is in the background, and even after you close it if you allow location "Always". It stops when you tap Stop, after 12 hours, or when the event ends.
• Emergency alert: one tap tells the organizers where you are
• Questions, polls, groups and direct messages
• Show & Shine photos and voting

Sign in with your member number and the email the club has on file. Event guests sign in with their email when organizers open an event to guests.

Your position is shared only during an event, only with the people at that event, and only after you open its map. Using location in the background for a long time can shorten battery life.

Terms and privacy: https://www.manxclub.com/app/docs/terms.html

name: Manylines Sushi Bar
description: Brand new look to make ordering easier and enjoyable. With faster performance and bug fixes, everything works better than ever! Enjoy the new design and improved features. Your favorite meal is just a tap away!

name: Maribo's:YuletideGlow
seller_name: TRUC VI INVESTMENT AND TRADING COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Step into a glowing North Pole night of velvet red, gold and aurora skies. Maribo's:YuletideGlow is a cosy collection of eight original Christmas games, each with its own way to play.

EIGHT FESTIVE GAMES, EIGHT DIFFERENT IDEAS

• Snowdrift Seek — Four rings of wrapped boxes circle the Grand Gift. Every ring shows its one Christmas gift from the start; send the lantern racing round with a single or double draw and find it before the ring's draw limit runs out.

• Time-Warp Santa — Santa stands on a giant clock of time portals, from Christmas Past to Christmas Yet to Come. Gift requests tick down around the dial: warp across time to deliver them, keep your combo alive, and spend your Time Energy wisely — travelling forward is cheaper than going back.

• Fireside Stockings — Four stockings hang by the fire, each wanting an exact number. Santa's sack hands you gifts worth 1 to 5: plan where each one goes, hit the number perfectly for big combos, and don't overstuff — one too many and the stocking bursts.

• Elf Workshop — Tap groups of matching toys to craft them into better ones. Puzzle pieces become teddy bears, game pads and guitars, then wrapped parcels — and finally the shining Golden Gift.

• Chimney Drop — Ride along on Santa's sleigh as it sweeps over the village row by row. Time each drop so the gift falls down the chimney of a lit, red-roofed home. Build delivery streaks and find the Golden House.

• Snow Globe Tumble — Shake the globe and watch every column spin on its own reel. Clusters of matching ornaments burst and tumble, leaving frost marks that double each time — and multiply everything that lands on them.

• Ornament Links — Roll the tree and link matching ornaments into garlands that stretch across five or six columns. Magic Snow fills the gaps, and three stars bring a flurry of bonus rolls.

• Jingle Swap — Swap festive treats to line them up. Four in a row rings a Bell that clears its row and column; five makes a Snow Star that sweeps away a whole colour. Chain reactions build your combo.

A WHOLE CHRISTMAS TO EXPLORE

• Santa's Sleigh Trail — a winding 36-stop map unlocked by playing the games. Every stop asks for a different challenge, and every third stop returns one of Santa's 12 lost keepsakes, each with its own little story.
• My Tree — spend the points you earn to hang 12 decorations on Santa's tree, from a silver bell to the tree-top star.
• Festive Bonus — levels, decorations and keepsakes all raise a bonus that boosts every round you finish.
• Daily Gift — open a present every day; keep a 7-day streak for the biggest sack.
• Awards, levels and statistics — milestones to collect, 12 levels to climb, and per-game charts of your best scores and recent rounds.

MADE TO GLOW

Every screen is dressed in red velvet, gold trim and falling snow. Popups arrive with ribbon bows and snow-capped corners, and every tap, burst, cascade and delivery sparkles with its own effect. Each game opens on a showcase of every symbol you'll meet, so you always know what you're playing with.

name: Marivolt
description:
Marivolt is a relaxing physics puzzle game set on bright cartoon seas.

Drag to aim, release to launch your little boat, and bounce across colorful buoys to reach the dock. Plan your angle and power carefully—every rebound can open a smarter route, uncover hidden stars, and help you clear the level with fewer launches.

Explore 100 handcrafted levels across 10 ocean chapters. Discover power buoys, spring pads, rotating markers, moving targets, magnetic pulls, portals, currents, gates, and more. Collect stars and shells, unlock boat skins, and take on the Daily Challenge whenever you want a fresh run.

No Wi-Fi needed. Just pure offline puzzle fun.

Features: • 100 physics-based ocean levels
• Drag-to-aim launching with bounce combos
• 7 buoy types and special sea mechanisms
• Stars, shells, and boat collection
• Daily Challenge mode
• Soft music, sound effects, and haptic feedback
• Fully offline single-player gameplay

Set sail in Marivolt and bounce your way to victory.

name: Marka Digital Signage Player
description:
Marka Digital Signage turns an iPad or iPhone into a screen you run from the Marka panel. Pair the device once with a code or a QR code, and it plays whatever your organisation schedules.

What it does
- Plays multi-zone layouts designed in the Marka panel: images, video, text, web pages, documents, a clock, weather and news
- Shows screens shared live from the panel
- Stores content on the device and keeps playing when the network drops, even after a restart
- Follows the working hours set in the panel and shows your off-hours screen outside them
- Turns content for portrait or landscape mounting, as set in the panel
- Sends proof of play and screen health to the panel

Built for unattended screens
The player runs full screen in landscape and keeps the display awake. For a kiosk or a wall-mounted screen, lock the device to the app with Guided Access or MDM Single App Mode.

A Marka account is required. Create content and manage your screens at my.markasignage.com.

name: MASAR Labbeh
description:
Labbeh brings the manpower companies registered with MASAR into one app: choose a service, compare the companies' prices in your city, then book and pay in one place.

By the hour
• Choose a service: cleaning, cooking, childcare, elderly companionship, a driver and more, depending on what the companies in your city offer.
• Compare companies: each shows its hourly price and minimum hours.
• Pick the day, start time, number of hours and your address.
• See the total with VAT before you pay, and pay MASAR securely through Moyasar: card, mada or Apple Pay.

By the month
• Request a worker on a monthly contract: choose the start date, the length of the contract and a preferred nationality.
• The company reviews your request, proposes a worker and prepares the contract; you pay each month by a MASAR pay link.

Follow your request
• See every request's status: paid, worker assigned, in progress, completed.
• Know the worker's name and nationality before the visit, and when they arrived.
• Cancel in the app, and see the refund rule and amount before you confirm.
• A receipt for every paid request, in the name of the company that served you, with its VAT number.

Your privacy
• Sign in with your email and a one-time code; no password.
• Your mobile and email are shown to the company only once a worker is assigned.
• Delete your account in the app at any time.

In Arabic and English, in light and dark.

Labbeh, by MASAR Workforce.

name: Masil Beep
description:
Masil Beep is a digital pager for restaurants, cafes and shops on the Masil platform. Instead of a buzzer that vibrates on the table, your own phone rings.

How it works:
• Order at the counter and take your receipt.
• Scan the QR code printed on the receipt with your phone's camera.
• The App Clip opens straight away, with nothing to download and no sign-up.
• Follow your order on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island: received, preparing, ready.
• The moment your order is ready, your phone rings with a pager sound, even when it is locked.

Features:
• No account and no phone number: we never ask for your name or any personal details.
• A Live Activity in the store's colours shows your order number and its status.
• A pager-style alert, with a reminder if you have not collected your order.
• The full app adds a QR scanner and keeps your recent orders.
• Arabic and English.

Masil Beep works at stores that use the pager service on the Masil platform. If your receipt has no QR code, ask at the counter.

name: Mat Fit
description:
Mat Fit is a small calculator for window mats. You type an opening, a sheet of board, a border, and an overlap. The app works out the outer mat size and tells you whether that sheet is large enough.

Save openings and sheets in millimetres, then pair them in a fit. Outer width is the opening plus the border twice. Outer height works the same way. The sheet can be used either way around: Mat Fit says whether it covers the mat as it is, only after you turn it, or not at all.

Overlap is how far the mat covers the paper. Mat Fit reports the paper size as the opening plus the overlap twice in each direction.

Each saved fit keeps the outer size and the yes or no from that check. You can open it later and check again with the sizes you have now. Records stay in a file on this phone.

Mat Fit does not cut a bevel, price a frame, or apply a shop standard. It only does the size check.

name: Mat Slip
description:
Mat Slip is for the moment a print is on the board and the blade is still capped. You write the print width and height, how far the mat covers each edge, the border outside the window, the print name, and your name and contact.

This iPhone subtracts the overlap from both sides, adds the border, and shows the window and the outer mat in millimeters. The slip is a PDF on this iPhone, named for the print, and you hand it over with the system share sheet. The file carries your name and contact. It does not carry the product name.

There is no account, no network, and no sample print. Millimeters are used in every region. The record stays on this iPhone and is removed with the app.

name: MathPath: K-8 Math Coach
description:
MathPath is a math coach for kindergarten through 8th grade that follows the US Common Core learning path. It figures out what your child already knows, then picks the next right thing to practice — so they spend time on skills that matter, not on things they've mastered or aren't ready for yet.

START AT THE RIGHT LEVEL
A short placement check finds your child's starting point across 51 Common Core skills, from counting to linear equations.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS
• Each answer updates a mastery estimate for that skill, and MathPath chooses what comes next based on it.
• Skills unlock as their prerequisites are mastered.
• Spaced review brings back older skills before they're forgotten.
• Mixed challenges blend skills, just like real tests.
• Worked examples show the steps before a new skill.

HELP WHEN THEY'RE STUCK
• Common mistakes (like adding denominators) are spotted and explained.
• Step-by-step walkthroughs break hard problems into small pieces.
• Answer by typing, tapping on pictures, or writing with a finger or Apple Pencil.

PICTURES THAT MAKE MATH CLICK
Clocks, fraction bars, number lines, coordinate grids, shapes, and area diagrams — many you can tap and move to answer.

FACT FLUENCY
Quick sprints build automatic recall of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division facts, with a grid that shows exactly which facts are solid.

FOR PARENTS
• Progress dashboard, badges, and a weekly summary of what was practiced and what's next.
• Settings protected by a parent PIN.
• Daily practice reminders.
• Sync across a parent's iPad and a child's iPhone with iCloud.
• No ads. No social features. No chatting with other people.

MATHPATH PLUS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
The core practice app is free for one learner. MathPath Plus adds:
• An AI tutor that gives hints and explains mistakes at your child's level (it's designed not to just hand over the answer).
• AI-generated fresh problems tailored to each skill.
• AI coach reports for parents.
• Up to 6 learner profiles.
• Family device sync for kids with their own Apple Account (end-to-end encrypted).
AI features turn on only after a parent gives consent in the Parents tab. The AI gets the math problem, the answer and the grade level. We don't send your child's name or account.

MathPath Plus is available as a monthly ($2.99) or yearly ($24.99) auto-renewing subscription, each with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers. Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Family Sharing supported.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mathpath-ai.mathpath-mik.workers.dev/privacy

name: Matisa
description:
Matisa connects you with the people you work with, and with their agents.

When someone, or their agent, needs you, Matisa shows it on your phone. Answer with a tap, or in your own words, and your answer goes back to them.

- See what's waiting for you: questions from people and their agents that need you.
- Answer with a tap, or in your own words.
- Ask someone something, and get their answer back.
- Follow the work going on with others, grouped by topic.
- Get a notification when something needs you.

Matisa also works on your computer, and in the AI apps you use. Sign in with your email. Matisa is free.

name: Matrix Salon
description:
Matrix салоны албан ёсны апп. Үсчин, гоо сайхны цагаа хүссэн үедээ, хэдхэн товшилтоор захиалаарай.
• Цаг захиалга — салбар, үйлчилгээ, мастераа сонгоод сул өдөр, цагаа шууд харж захиална.
• Мастерууд — мастер бүрийн танилцуулга, ажлын зураг, ажиллах салбар, цагийн хуваарь.
• Онлайн төлбөр — QPay, StorePay, Lendy-ээр урьдчилгаа эсвэл бүтэн төлбөрөө төлнө.
• Миний цагууд — захиалгын дэлгэрэнгүй, төлбөрийн төлөв, цуцлах хүсэлт.
• Сануулга — цаг баталгаажсан, төлбөр төлөгдсөн, үйлчилгээний өдрийн өглөө болон цагаас өмнөх сануулга. Мэдэгдлээ тохиргооноос өөрөө удирдана.
• Look — шинэ загвар, үйлчилгээ, урамшууллын мэдээ.
• Matrix Club — үнэнч үйлчлүүлэгчийн хөнгөлөлт.

Утасны дугаараараа SMS кодоор бүртгүүлж, 4 оронтой PIN-ээр нэвтэрнэ.

name: Mealy: Meal Planner & Recipes
description:
Mealy is a calm, private meal planner. Save recipes, put them on the week, and let the shopping list write itself — all on your phone, with no account and no ads.

RECIPES, YOUR WAY
• Import from almost any recipe website with a link, or share the page straight to Mealy
• Scan a recipe card or cookbook page with the camera
• Paste text or type recipes in by hand
• Scale servings and switch between metric and US measurements in one tap
• Collections, favorites, tags and search across ingredients

PLAN THE WEEK
• Drag meals onto days: breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks
• Let Mealy suggest dinners, or copy last week
• Leftovers and eating out count too

A SHOPPING LIST THAT WRITES ITSELF
• Built from your plan, merged and sorted by aisle
• Subtracts what is already in your pantry
• Tick things off in the shop, add your own items, share the list

PANTRY
• Keep track of what is in the cupboard
• "Can make now" shows recipes you have the ingredients for

COOK MODE
• Step-by-step walkthrough with big type
• Timers pulled from the steps
• The screen stays awake while you cook

NUTRITION
• Calories and macros per serving, estimated on your device
• A simple food log, with optional write-only sync to Apple Health

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything lives on your device and works offline
• No account, no ads, nothing sold
• Export a backup any time and bring it to a new phone
• Optional, anonymous usage statistics that you can switch off

Mealy is free. Household sync for sharing a plan between phones is an optional, self-hosted feature for advanced users.

name: Measure Lot: Acre Calculator
description:
Measure Lot tells you how big a yard, lot, field, roof or driveway is.

Tap the corners on a satellite map. The size shows in big numbers, with the distance around it.

The map tells you what to do next. "Find your place." "Tap each corner, going around the edge." "Looks right? Tap Done." There is nothing to learn first.

TAP OR WALK
• Tap the corners on the map. Drag a corner to move it. Tap a corner to keep it or remove it.
• Or walk around the edge with your iPhone and drop a corner at each turn.
• Measure a fence line, curb or string of lights as a length.
• Search an address, or tap Go to where I am to start where you are.

SEE IT IN EVERY UNIT
Acres, square feet, square yards, square meters and hectares, all at once. Feet, yards, meters, miles and kilometers for lengths. Your region sets the first choice.

QUOTE THE JOB
• Tap Done to save each measurement with a name. Add a note and a price later.
• Enter your rate, like $0.12 a square foot or $3.50 a foot, and see the total.
• Make an estimate sheet (PDF): one page with the outline and the numbers. Print it or send it.

WHO IT IS FOR
Lawn care, snow removal, paving and sealcoating, roofing, fencing, holiday lights, farming, homeowners and gardeners.

PRICE
3 free measurements, then a one-time $14.99 unlock, called Unlimited Measuring (US price; other countries differ). No subscription.
How the free ones count: a measurement counts when a new shape first has an area (the third corner) or a length (the second point). Deleting a saved measurement does not give one back. The map shows how many free ones are left.
Looking at, editing and sharing the plain numbers as text is always free. Printing, saving or sharing the one-page PDF needs the unlock.
Refunds are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.

PRIVACY
No account. Your measurements stay on this iPhone. Location is optional. The app asks for it only when you tap Use where I am, Go to where I am or Walk around it, and uses it only while the app is open. It is never sent to us. Address search, place names and the map come from Apple Maps.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Keep the screen open while you walk.
• The area math is tested on known sizes: a football field, a square mile and a hectare. Your result depends on the map picture and where you tap, so check it before you order materials or bid a job.
• Map pictures can be off, sometimes by many feet, or out of date. Trees and hills hide edges.
• Areas are measured flat. A steep roof or a hillside has more surface than its outline, so it will read low.
• For the best result, zoom in before you tap each corner.

This is an estimate from a map or GPS. It is not a legal survey. Don't use it to settle a property line.

Terms of Use: https://thrivingbird.com/measurelot-terms
Privacy: https://thrivingbird.com/measurelot-privacy
Support: https://thrivingbird.com/measurelot-support

Requires iOS 17.0 or later.

name: Melon Stack: Triple Merge
description:
Drop a little cherry. Make room for something bigger.

Melon Stack is a fruit puzzle with a twist: three matching fruits that touch merge into the next size. Aim each drop, let the fruit roll into place and build chains without overflowing the basket.

FROM CHERRIES TO GIANT MELONS
Discover 16 fruit stages, from cherries and grapes to pineapple, watermelon and a golden giant melon. Each fruit has its own size and shape, with physical rolling, soft bounces and lively merge effects.

10 CHALLENGES, THEN KEEP STACKING
Start the first challenge with cherries and work toward a pineapple. Later levels raise the target, add multiple-fruit goals and ask for longer chains within a drop budget. Endless mode lets you chase a bigger score at your own pace.

FOUR WAYS TO RESCUE A STACK
Use Undo, Hammer, Swap and Ripen when you need a new angle. Earn coins in play and spend them on tool supplies. There are no in-app purchases or ads.

MADE FOR A QUICK BREAK
• Drag to aim and release to drop
• Three-fruit merges and chain reactions
• Sound, haptics and reduced-motion settings
• English and Simplified Chinese, following your device language
• Progress saved locally, with no account required

The game can be played offline. On the first available connection, an app-specific anonymous activation is sent to our server to count new installations. This is not a cloud save; progress stays on your device.

Support and privacy requests: https://accounts.minmonkey.cn/fruitfall/support.html

name: Melt Sheet
description:
Melt Sheet builds one furnace charge on this iPhone.

Drag the scrap share. The spec column and the predicted column move against each other, and the fresh copper, tin, and zinc kilograms change. Save an assay that sums to 100. The next sheet uses the learned recovery so the predicted analysis returns toward the spec.

Heats, lots, and alloys stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. The sheet does not replace the alloy specification.

name: MEMBR HAUS
description:
MEMBR HAUS is your one account for every salon that takes bookings with ORDR HAUS. Book in seconds, know the moment your appointment is confirmed, and keep your bookings, coupons and points together.

BOOK IN SECONDS
- Open your salon's booking link and it opens right in the app
- Pick your services and the stylist you want — or let the salon choose
- See only the times that really fit everything you picked
- Book for yourself or bring guests, all starting at the same time

STAY IN THE LOOP
- Get a notification when the salon confirms, changes or cancels your booking
- Reminders the day before and shortly before your appointment
- Change the time or cancel online when the salon allows it

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
- All your upcoming and past appointments across every salon
- Coupons with a code to show at the counter
- Points you earn at each salon, with your recent activity
- Saved cards for salons that hold a card or take a deposit

YOUR ACCOUNT
- Sign in with email, Google or Apple
- English and Korean
- Delete your account any time from Profile

MEMBR HAUS works with salons that use ORDR HAUS. Ask your salon for their booking link to get started.

name: Meqast
description:
Meqast is the easiest way to get a haircut in Kurdistan and Iraq, without sitting on the bench waiting.

FIND A BARBER
• See barbershops near you on a list or a map
• Live wait time for every shop: "No wait", "~20 min" or closed
• Filter by open now, rating, home visits and price
• Real photos of each barber's work, prices, opening hours and reviews

BOOK OR JOIN THE QUEUE
• Join the live queue from anywhere and arrive just in time
• Or book a fixed time with the barber you choose
• Home visits where the shop offers them
• Pay at the shop, or pay online where the shop allows it

YOUR LIVE TICKET
• Your number, people ahead of you and the expected time, updated live
• A reminder before your turn
• Show your QR code at the shop to check in
• Running late? Tell the barber with one tap

DISCOVER
• The best haircuts in your city, posted by real barbers
• "Top barbers this month" ranked by likes and reviews
• Like a cut and tap "Book this look" to book the same style

Meqast speaks Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic and English.

Barbershop owner? Get Kursi, the free app for barbershops, and put your shop on Meqast.

name: Merik Viewer
description:
Merik Viewer shows the song that Merik is playing, on every iPhone and iPad in the band. Lyrics light up word by word, the chords run along with the next ones coming, and you see the section, the beat and a countdown to the next line.

Merik Viewer is a free companion app. It needs Merik, the MIDI backing tracks player for iPad and Mac, or Merik Studio for macOS and Windows, on the same Wi-Fi network.

FINDS MERIK BY ITSELF
Open the app and the song is there. Merik on an iPad or a Mac is found on the network automatically, with no address to type. If there is more than one, you pick one. A manual address is always possible.

EVERYTHING FROM THE BAND PAGE
• Song title, next song and time left in the setlist
• Progress bar, time signature and beat
• Song sections: intro, verse, chorus and more
• Lyrics, lit up word by word and scrolling along
• Countdown to the next line
• The current chord and the next four
Choose which items you see and how big the text is.

A REMOTE WITH THE CONTROL KEY
Enter Merik's control key and the viewer becomes a remote: play, pause, stop, next, search for a song, jump in the setlist, and the family mixer. The key is kept in the Keychain on your device.

MADE FOR THE STAGE
• The screen stays on during the gig
• Clock and battery always in view
• iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape, Split View and Slide Over
• The color themes you know from Merik and QSheets

No account, no ads and no tracking. The viewer only talks to Merik on your own network.

name: MeteoPanel
description:
**MeteoPanel – Il meteo della tua stazione, in tempo reale.**

Tutti i dati della tua stazione meteo, le previsioni e gli strumenti di analisi in un'unica applicazione.

Con MeteoPanel puoi seguire le condizioni meteorologiche della tua stazione direttamente dal tuo iPhone, con un'interfaccia moderna, intuitiva e ricca di informazioni.

**CONDIZIONI METEO AGGIORNATE**

Consulta rapidamente le principali rilevazioni della tua stazione:

- Temperatura attuale e temperatura percepita
- Umidità e punto di rugiada
- Pressione atmosferica
- Velocità e direzione del vento
- Raffiche massime
- Pioggia accumulata e intensità delle precipitazioni

**PREVISIONI METEO DETTAGLIATE**

Scopri come cambierà il tempo grazie alle previsioni orarie e giornaliere.

Visualizza temperature minime e massime, probabilità di precipitazioni, vento e condizioni atmosferiche previste.

**PIOGGIA E PRECIPITAZIONI**

Monitora la pioggia registrata dalla tua stazione, controlla gli accumuli giornalieri e consulta l'intensità delle precipitazioni.

I grafici ti permettono di osservare l'andamento della pioggia e confrontarlo con le previsioni.

**VENTO E ROSA DEI VENTI**

Analizza la direzione e la velocità del vento attraverso indicatori intuitivi.

Consulta il vento attuale, la velocità media, le raffiche e la direzione prevalente.

**GRAFICI E ANALISI METEOROLOGICHE**

Esplora i dati della tua stazione attraverso grafici dettagliati e resoconti.

Confronta valori minimi, massimi e medi di temperatura, umidità, pressione e altri parametri meteorologici.

**RADAR METEO**

Consulta il radar delle precipitazioni per osservare l'evoluzione dei fenomeni meteorologici sul territorio.

**TUTTO A COLPO D'OCCHIO**

MeteoPanel è progettata per rendere semplici anche i dati meteorologici più dettagliati.

Dalla panoramica immediata alle analisi approfondite, puoi passare rapidamente da un'informazione all'altra.

Che tu sia un appassionato di meteorologia, un proprietario di una stazione meteo o semplicemente voglia conoscere meglio il tempo nella tua zona, MeteoPanel ti aiuta a interpretare i dati che contano.

**MeteoPanel. La tua stazione meteo, sempre con te.**

name: Mille-Feuille
description:
Mille-Feuille is a flashcard app for English speakers learning French. You can learn two ways, and mix them:

• Start from scratch: ready-made decks of words, verbs, grammar and sounds. Words and grammar are sorted by level, from beginner (A1) to advanced.
• Learn from what you read: photograph a page from a comic, a novel, an article or a menu, and turn the words you meet into flashcards, with their sentence.

READ
• Photograph a page or choose a photo. The text is recognised on this device.
• Every word is coloured by how well you know it.
• Tap a word for its meaning and the form it is in: partions → partir, present subjunctive, nous.
• See the grammar points the passage uses.
• Add a word to your flashcards with its sentence and the page image.
• Look up any word from the Library, in any form or by its English meaning.

STUDY
• Words: 20,000 entries with gender, pronunciation and example sentences. Levels A1 to C2, estimated from frequency.
• Gender: le or la for each noun, with the ending rules and their exceptions.
• Verbs: one card per tense, from the present to the subjunctive. Conjugation tables coloured by status.
• Grammar: 150 points from A1 to C1, each with an explanation, examples, common mistakes and gap-fill questions. Points found in your reading come first, and your own sentences become questions.
• Sounds: spellings and their sounds, nasal vowels, silent letters and liaison.
• Dictation: listen to a word and type it. Accents are checked.
• Pronunciation check: say a word and see what was recognised. Speech recognition runs on this device.

Spaced repetition schedules every card, and a daily reminder tells you how many are due. Memory aids flag false friends (actuellement means currently) and irregular verbs.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on this device, or in your own iCloud account if you turn on sync. Backups are plain files you keep.

Dictionary data from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0). Example sentences from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

name: Mindset: Daily Check-in
description:
Mindset helps you look at yourself and your day in a kinder, more positive way. No clichés, no pressure. Every entry takes less than a minute.

Mornings
A thought for the day that you didn't write yourself. Below it, three of your own principles. Then a short check-in: energy, mood, one intention and up to three things you'll do for yourself today.

Evenings
A calm evening review: what went well, what you take with you, what you let go of. For each of your three goals: done or not today, and what it gave you or what would help you tomorrow. No judgment.

Principles
Write down what you want to live by. Starred ones appear on the Today screen and in the widget for Home Screen, Lock Screen and Mac.

Reminders
Morning and evening at the time you choose. If something is still open, Mindset reminds you up to three times. Everything can be turned off.

Review
7 or 30 days at a glance: energy, mood, what you did for yourself, what went well. Optionally, with your own Claude or ChatGPT API key, a personal review focused on what went well.

Private
Your entries stay on your devices and in your private iCloud. No account, no ads, no tracking. For the AI review, entries are sent to the chosen provider only with your own key and your consent.

German or English, switchable in Settings.

Mindset is free. If it helps you, I'd love a short thank-you right from the app.

name: Minibrot
description:
Minibrot is a fractal app for the Mandelbrot set and other formulas. Type your own formula and the picture changes as you type.

FORMULAS
• Use z² + c, or type your own, such as conj(z)^2 + c or z^2 + sin(c)
• Functions: sin, cos, tan, exp, log, sqrt, abs, conj, sinh, cosh
• The picture updates with every character
• If a formula can't be shown, the app tells you why and how to fix it

ZOOM
• Drag to move. Pinch to zoom and rotate
• Double-tap to zoom in 2×. Double-tap, hold, and drag up or down to zoom with one hand
• Formulas of the form zⁿ + c (z² + c, z³ + c, …) can zoom past 10^300. Other formulas have lower limits

SAVE
• Add places to your Collection and come back to them later
• Save to Photos in three sizes: Wallpaper, Large, and Extra Large (4× the screen in each direction)
• Share the image and the formula

VIDEO
• Export a zoom video to any place in your Collection and save it to Photos
• HD videos up to 15 seconds are free. No watermark

MINIBROT PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• Export videos longer than 15 seconds, and in Full HD and 4K
• Not a subscription. Pay once

ALSO
• 6 color palettes
• No ads. No account
• No data is collected. Your formulas and Collection stay on your iPhone
• Free features will stay free
• You can leave a tip to support development. Tips don't unlock any features

name: Ministrant Manager
description:
Ministrant Manager pomaga w organizacji Liturgicznej Służby Ołtarza w parafii. Zapewnia wygodny dostęp do informacji o służbie z telefonu.

GRAFIK SŁUŻBY
Sprawdzaj terminy swoich dyżurów i planowane posługi.

OBECNOŚCI I PUNKTACJA
Przeglądaj informacje o obecnościach, zdobytych punktach i rankingu.

ZASTĘPSTWA
Korzystaj z giełdy zastępstw, aby łatwiej organizować zmiany w grafiku.

DLA MINISTRANTÓW, RODZICÓW I OPIEKUNÓW
Dostępne widoki i funkcje zależą od roli użytkownika oraz konfiguracji systemu w parafii.

KORZYSTANIE Z APLIKACJI
Do korzystania potrzebne jest konto w parafii używającej systemu Ministrant Manager. Dane dostępowe uzyskasz od opiekuna swojej wspólnoty. Zakres dostępnych funkcji zależy od pakietu i ustawień parafii.

name: MINTMARK Appraisal
description:
Photograph a coin. Learn what collectors would pay.

Mintmark reads the front of a single coin and answers three questions: what is it, how worn is it, and what is it worth.

WHAT YOU GET

• Identification — country, denomination, design, year, mint mark and any visible variety, with a confidence figure. Details it cannot read come back empty rather than guessed.
• Grade — a Sheldon 1–70 number and the plain-English grade, judged on the wear the photo actually shows.
• Value — a collector-market range in US dollars at that grade, with what the range assumes: a dealer's price at the low end, fair retail at the high.
• The reasoning — what drives the value (key date, mintage, metal, grade, demand), what to check next to confirm it (reverse, mint mark, edge, weight), and any red flags: cleaning, polishing, damage, corrosion, artificial toning, or a cast fake.

WHY A RANGE, NOT A PRICE

One photograph cannot see the reverse, the edge, or a coin in hand. Mintmark is deliberately conservative: a worn common coin stays worth cents, and a cleaned coin is worth bullion or less, however old it is. The checks it suggests are the ones a collector would make before paying.

YOUR COLLECTION

Every appraisal is saved with its photo, so you can look back at what you have and what it was worth. Delete any coin, or all of them, whenever you like.

NO ACCOUNT, NO TRACKING

There is no sign-up. Your collection belongs to this device and is keyed to an anonymous id — no email, no password, no advertising identifiers, and nothing is used to track you across other apps.

Free to appraise. Estimates come from one photograph and are not a professional grading or an offer to buy.

name: Minutely: Daily Time Log
description:
Minutely is a private time log for the small things in your day. Start a timer when you begin, stop it when you're done, and see how much time showers, scrolling, cooking or gaming really take.

TIME ANYTHING
• One timer at a time. Starting a new one asks before stopping the current one.
• Pause and resume whenever you need.
• Timers keep counting even when the app is closed.
• Start with presets (Toilet, Cooking, Gaming, Scrolling, Showering, Reading) or create your own.

SEE WHERE YOUR MINUTES GO
• Today and Week views show your totals, with a filter for each timer.
• Each timer shows your usual duration, based on your last 20 sessions.
• Add, edit or delete past sessions, with undo.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
• Home Screen widgets keep your totals one glance away.
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island show the running timer (Pro).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no servers, no analytics, no ads.
• Your data stays on your iPhone and leaves only when you export it.

MINUTELY PRO
• Unlimited timers and presets (Free includes 3).
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island.
• Export your data as CSV or JSON.
• Switch to the exclusive Pro app icon.

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://minutely-website.jcsnpch-dev.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://minutely-website.jcsnpch-dev.workers.dev/privacy

Requires iOS 26 or later.

name: Mirra: Symmetry Puzzle
description:
Every model in Mirra is almost perfect. A robot, a lighthouse, a dragon, a fish — each one built from colorful blocks and each one just slightly off. A few blocks are in the wrong place, and the model has lost its symmetry.

Your job: spin it around, spot what doesn't match its mirror, and fix it in as few moves as you can.

HOW TO PLAY 
• Drag to spin the model and look at it from every side 
• Pick up the blocks that break the pattern 
• Place them where the mirror says they belong 
• Solve it in the fewest moves for three stars

100 HAND-BUILT PUZZLES 
From a cupcake and a mushroom to a pirate ship, a carousel and a space station. Five tiers — Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert and Master — take you from a gentle warm-up to models with hidden blocks and more than one mirror.

THINK IN 3D
Some mistakes hide around the back. Some only show up from above. Mirra rewards looking carefully and planning your moves, not rushing.

STUCK? GET A HINT 
Hints show you exactly which block to move next. Earn them by three-starring a puzzle and by completing a difficulty tier.

MADE TO BE CALM 
• Soft colors that shift with every model 
• Relaxing music 
• No timers, no lives, no pressure 
• Plays fully offline

name: Mission Languages
description:
Missão Idiomas is an app to learn Brazilian Portuguese with a military theme, in short lessons you can do anywhere.

HOW IT WORKS
• 3-minute lessons with everyday and military sentences
• Audio for every sentence and tap any word to see the translation
• Listening, speaking, reading and writing exercises
• Placement test, daily review and a daily goal with reminders
• Text-only mode for when you can't listen or speak

WHAT YOU LEARN
About 1,600 sentences in 120 units: greetings, numbers, time, family, food, the barracks, equipment, radio and phonetic alphabet, maps, logistics, first aid, peacekeeping and more, from beginner to the Elite module.

MOTIVATION
• Ranks by XP, daily streak and weekly leaderboard
• Friends and leaderboard with your class
• Military avatar to customize

FREE AND PREMIUM
The app is free, with limited energy (each mistake in a lesson costs 1, and it refills over time) and ads. Missão Idiomas Premium (monthly or annual, with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan) gives you unlimited energy and no ads. Payment is charged to your Apple account, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; cancel anytime in your iPhone Settings.
Terms of use: https://missaoidiomas.com/en/terms-of-use · Privacy: https://missaoidiomas.com/en/privacy-policy

NO RED TAPE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email. The app doesn't ask for your rank or unit, and your name is optional.

The app is also available in Portuguese for Brazilians learning English, Spanish, French, Italian and German.

Independent study project: not an official app of the Brazilian Army or any armed force, and it doesn't replace official proficiency exams.

name: Mixtake Stage Link
description:
Mixtake Stage Link is the remote for Stage Link, the Mixtake device that sits next to the mixing desk and records the desk sound for the audience. The app connects to Stage Link over Bluetooth, so you can control it even where there is no Wi-Fi or signal. When Stage Link is online, control also works through the cloud.

What you get:
• Live: MASTER and AMBIENT meters, compressor and limiter, recording time and upload status. Start and stop recording with one tap
• Start for fans, Split and Break while the band plays. Songs are named from your account's setlist
• Input: USB audio interface or Dante, gain and channel routing
• Sound: compressor, limiter and bands for the whole desk sound
• Wi-Fi: connect Stage Link to a network right from your phone, even to an iPhone hotspot
• Player: music to the desk from playlists and voice overs between and inside songs, with the music ducking under them
• Cloud recordings: listen on your phone, move the song markers and send them to the band
• Landscape: a desk display with big meters
• Stage Link location is saved from your phone so fans find your sound faster

You need a Stage Link and a Mixtake account, the same one as in Mixtake Stage. Without a Stage Link you can try everything in the demo.

Fans then use the Mixtake app to add the mixing desk sound to the videos they filmed.

name: Mochi Mochi Puzzle
description:
Move the little shiratama and guide each Japanese sweet onto a plate of the same color!

Mochi Mochi Puzzle is a squishy logic puzzle starring traditional Japanese sweets (wagashi).

■ Every sweet moves differently
・Sakura mochi sticks to shiratama — pull it along, but if it snags, it tears apart!
・Matcha yokan sticks to other matcha and is stiff — if one part is blocked, the whole piece stops.
・Chestnut kinton doesn't stick — a classic push block.

■ 1,000 stages
Gentle at first, then truly brain-bending. Every stage is verified solvable.

■ Daily Mochi
One puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going and share your result.

■ Relaxed and friendly
・Undo and restart as often as you like — free
・Stuck? Watch a short video for a hint (the next 4 moves)
・Earn stars by clearing within the target moves and time
・Climb today's Game Center ranking

■ 6 languages
English, 日本語, Español, Português, 한국어, 中文

Prefer no ads? A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase is available.

name: Modern Stay
description:
Modern Stay is a guide to the cities and mountains of Serbia — everything a visitor needs in one place, beautifully organised and in your language. It is also the guest guide for hotels, apartments and every other kind of stay.

19 destinations: Belgrade, Novi Sad, Niš, Kragujevac, Subotica, Pirot, Kosovska Mitrovica, Kopaonik, Zlatibor, Tara, Divčibare, Stara Planina, Vrnjačka Banja, Sokobanja, Fruška Gora with Sremski Karlovci, Đerdap and Golubac, Mokra Gora and Šargan, Uvac, and the Valley of the Kings (Žiča, Studenica and Sopoćani monasteries).

What's inside:
• Landmarks, nature, day trips and places worth seeing — with photos
• Where to eat, cafés and nightlife
• Events
• Culture, museums and stories — tales and legends from every place
• Skiing, trails and equipment rental in the mountains
• Wellness and spas
• Pharmacies, health, emergency numbers, exchange offices and ATMs
• Transport, petrol stations, shops and pet-friendly places
• A map of every place and “Near me” — what's closest to you (with location permission)
• Directions — opens Apple Maps, Google Maps or another map app on your phone
• City photo gallery
• Ready-made tours and walks — stop by stop, with a map
• “Saved” — your places and tours, only on your phone
• “Practical info” — emergency numbers, transport, money and tips for visitors
• Audio guide — your phone’s voice reads the place description
• “Ask the guide” — recommendations and a day plan from the guide (AI; please double-check important details)

Your stay’s own guide
When a property uses Modern Stay, guests scan the QR code on the TV in their room (or open a link from the host) and get that property’s guide on their phone, in their language:
• offers and perks during the stay
• the restaurant menu and drinks list, with an order basket
• the spa and wellness price list
• property services, Wi-Fi and reception contacts
• the weather, a “Rate your stay” link and the city guide around the property
Try an example without a QR code: modernstay.app/g/demohotel1 (the fictional Demo Hotel).

Run a hotel, apartment, villa, guesthouse, hostel or holiday home? You edit offers, menus, price lists and Wi-Fi yourself in the Modern Stay panel — guests see them on the in-room TV and on their phone, and reception messages appear on the TV. Send an inquiry from the “For hotels and stays” page in the app.

25 languages, including English, German, Russian, Chinese, Spanish, French, Italian, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi and Japanese.

Works offline — download a city and its guide, photos and area map work without a connection for 30 days.

On iPhone: pick your destination on first launch, “Near me” using your phone’s location (it stays on your phone), directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps (or Amap/Baidu if installed), share places, pull to refresh, quick actions on the app icon and hotel links that open straight in the app.

No account and no ad networks. Only anonymous usage statistics (no IP address stored); distances are calculated on your phone and your coordinates are not sent. Questions for “Ask the guide” are processed by Anthropic (Claude) and we don’t store them. Details: modernstay.app/privatnost

Something not right? Every place has a “Suggest an edit” button. Support: support@modernstay.app

name: Mofisi Calc
description:
No phones in the exam room, just your graphing calculator. Mofisi Calc is here so you can actually use it.

Do a calculation in Mofisi Calc: a root, the intersection of two curves, a binomial probability, a regression, a matrix inverse… The answer appears, and right next to it the exact keys and menus to do the same on your own calculator. What trips students up in the exam is rarely the maths. It is finding the menu.

SUPPORTED CALCULATORS
• TI-84 Plus CE
• Casio fx-CG50
• TI-Nspire CX II
• NumWorks
Key sequences were checked against the manufacturers' official documentation. Features that exam mode switches off (such as Casio's vector menu in IB exam mode) are flagged next to the operation.

WHAT TO WRITE ON PAPER
A calculator answer on its own earns little. For every operation you get the line to write in your working: in English for IB and AP, in Turkish for YKS.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Graphing: zeros, intersections, minimum/maximum, dy/dx, definite integrals, tables; pan and pinch to zoom
• Statistics: one-variable summary with box plot, 7 regression models, Spearman's rank correlation
• Distributions: normal, inverse normal, binomial, Poisson, geometric, t and chi-squared, with the area shaded
• Equation solver: polynomial roots (complex included), linear systems, numerical solve
• Matrices: determinant, inverse, product, powers
• Finance: TVM for interest, loans and savings
• Euler's method and slope fields
• 3D vector geometry: points, lines, planes, spheres

WHAT YOUR CALCULATOR CAN'T DO
• Graph theory studio: shortest path, minimum spanning tree, Chinese postman, travelling salesman bounds
• Voronoi diagrams
No handheld can draw these IB Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation topics.

OUR PROMISE
• Free, no ads
• No account
• Works offline
• Collects no personal data

Mofisi Calc is made by MatematikOfisi. When you want real exam questions on a topic, it can link you to the MatematikOfisi Question Bank on your tablet. The suggestion never interrupts a calculation and can be switched off in Settings.

TI-84 Plus CE and TI-Nspire are trademarks of Texas Instruments, fx-CG50 of Casio, NumWorks of NumWorks. Mofisi Calc is not affiliated with these companies.

name: monocalc
description:
MONOCALC is a calculator for long calculations that you can see, fix and reuse.

FIX ANY NUMBER
Your whole calculation stays on screen. Tap a number to replace it, tap it again to fix a single digit, slide a finger to move the cursor. The result updates with every key.

EVERY STEP SHOWN
The result of each parenthesis is written small above it. Forgot the opening parenthesis? Type 3×2) and it becomes (3×2).

LINES THAT STAY LINKED
Start a new line for a second calculation, then insert the result of line A into line C from the bar above the keypad, or drag a result onto another line. Change A, and everything using A updates.

EXACT
Fractions under the hood, no floating-point surprises: 0.1 + 0.2 is 0.3. An approximate result is marked ≈.

MADE TO BE TOUCHED
• Its own keypad, never the system keyboard
• Light haptic on each key, a shake when a key is refused
• Hold ⌫ to erase continuously
• Tap a result to copy it
• Undo, step by step

YOURS
• Five themes, light and dark
• Number format follows your region, or pick one of five
• English and French

PRIVATE
No account, no tracking, no network access. Your sheet stays on your iPhone.

MONOCALC is part of the MONOLAG family.

name: Monstera Breeder: Rare Plants
description:
A calm collecting game that starts from a single Monstera node.

Grow a Monstera, pick a node you like, and take a cutting. Each new plant rolls its variegation again. Keep choosing well-marked nodes and the pattern in your line grows stronger over generations.

■ Cut, root, unfurl
• Choose a node in the lab and take a cutting.
• Let it root in a jar on the propagation station, then plant it in your greenhouse.
• Swipe down to unfurl each rolled new leaf and see its pattern.

■ A collection worth keeping
• 4 species: Deliciosa, Adansonii, Standleyana, Dubia
• 21 varieties, including Albo, Aurea, Mint and a starry speckled type
• Rare leaves such as half moons are saved to your leaf album.
• Let plants flower and fruit to harvest seeds from your own line.

■ Once a day, your greenhouse
• Water your plants and wait for the next leaf. There is no rush.
• Plants never die. A thirsty plant only droops and grows slowly.
• A weekly show and rehoming requests give you fresh goals.

■ Odds, shown in full
• Every node shows the chances for each pattern before you cut.
• Shop items list their odds for species, rarity and lineage.

■ On your Lock Screen
• See how long a cutting has left to root, right from the Lock Screen.

■ Good to know
• Pink variegation is an in-game variety. Be careful: "pink Monstera seeds" sold in real life are often a scam.
• Sign in with Apple or Google to save your progress to the cloud.
• Contains optional rewarded ads and in-app purchases, including random items.

name: MoonlitCourier
description:
The night mail is open. Little letters. Lasting wonder.

MoonlitCourier is a gentle, story-driven postal journey designed for peaceful moments of discovery. Take on the mantle of a nocturnal letter carrier, traveling across quiet countryside paths, misty river ferries, and tucked-away hamlets to deliver messages that matter.

DELIVER STORIES THAT MATTER
Each journey invites you to carry a single letter to someone unexpected. Read beautifully crafted narrative chapters, consider your decisions thoughtfully, and choose your route forward. Every letter features multiple paths and three distinctive endings with no timers, fail states, or wrong choices.

COLLECT MEMORABLE POSTCARDS
Completing a delivery unlocks an illustrated ending postcard to commemorate your journey. Browse your accumulated postal collection in Postcards, mark your favorite routes, or export illustrated keepsakes to share with friends.

DESIGNED FOR FOCUS & CALM
- Pure Storytelling: An atmospheric epistolary experience crafted for peaceful reading.
- Tactile Haptics: Subtle choice vibrations bring tactile weight to key decisions.
- Reading Customization: Tailor typography and layout for a personalized reading atmosphere.
- Local State & Backups: Your journey notes, drafts, and postcards stay safe in local storage.

Four complete delivery routes are entirely free to enjoy. An optional one-time purchase unlocks eight additional Night Routes for those who wish to wander deeper under the stars.

name: MORE MORE MOTION
description:
MORE MORE MOTION は、iPhone を持って動かして遊ぶリズムゲームです。
画面にはさわらず、流れてくる矢印に合わせて iPhone を奥・手前・上・下・左・右に動かします。

■ 遊び方
・矢印が来たら、その向きに iPhone をすばやく動かすだけ
・はじめての方は「チュートリアル」で、お手本を見ながら練習できます

■ たくさんの曲で遊べる
・オリジナル曲
・クラシックの名曲(トルコ行進曲、天国と地獄、ラデツキー行進曲 など)
・iPhone のミュージックライブラリやファイルの曲でも遊べます

■ 腕だめし
・「本番」モードのベストスコアを集めて、「ふつう」「むずかしい」をアンロック
・キラキラノーツでスコアアップ

■ 自分に合わせて設定
・モーションセンサーの感度(1〜10)
・振動の強さ、曲・BGM・効果音の音量

■ 安心して遊べる
・個人情報は集めません。通信・広告・トラッキングもありません

※ iPhone をしっかり持ち、まわりに人や物がない広い場所で遊んでください。

name: Movva.
description: Movva is a home strength app for adults who train with a kettlebell or dumbbell they already own. It builds a session from the equipment saved on the iPhone and the time available: under 20 minutes keeps one movement, 20–39 minutes is a short session, and 40 minutes or more is a full session. You can preview the workout, log sets, keep a private history, and record a photo, clip, or voice note for your own review. Movva offers general exercise guidance, not medical care or a training prescription.

name: Multi Player: Quad Video
description:
Four of your videos. One screen. One floats.

Multi Player plays up to four of your own videos side by side in a 2×2 grid. Only the tile you tap has sound — tap another tile and the sound follows. Press FLOAT and tile 1 rises onto your Home Screen in Picture in Picture, so it keeps playing while you use other apps.

YOUR VIDEOS, WHERE THEY ARE
Pick videos from Photos or from the Files app. They play right where they are — nothing is copied, nothing is uploaded.

TAP, HOLD, DRAG
• Tap a tile: it gets the sound.
• Press and hold a tile: full-screen player with ±10 s, rotate and loop.
• Drag a tile onto another: they swap places.

CLIP IT
In full screen, mark a start and an end. The tile then plays just that part, over and over if you like. Save it as a new video, and it shows up under Clips.

FAVORITES
Tap the heart to keep your own copy inside the app — it stays even if the original is later deleted from Photos.

ALSO
• Remembers where you stopped in each video
• Photos float above the grid as cards you can move and pinch
• iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• English, 日本語, 繁體中文

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. No data collected. Multi Player never sends anything over the internet.

name: Mumbly: the pet that learns
description:
Mumbly is a virtual pet unlike any other: it really learns from you.

HATCH IT
Warm up the egg, pick a name and welcome your new friend. Feed it, bathe it, put it to bed and play together.

A LITTLE ROOM OF ITS OWN
Mumbly wanders around, drinks from its bowl, curls up in its bed and chases the ball. As it grows, it moves differently too: first it crawls and trips, then it hops, then it runs!

FOOD AND DRINKS
Over 20 meals, snacks and drinks, some only for older pets. Every Mumbly has a favourite food and one it hates: find them out!

TEACH IT TO TALK
At first it only makes funny noises. Then it repeats the words it hears most, puts them together and finally builds sentences of its own using the vocabulary you gave it. Type "learn: …" to teach it a whole phrase!

IT REMEMBERS YOU
Your name, your favourite food, your dog's name… Mumbly remembers, and one day it will ask how they're doing.

IT PICKS UP HABITS
It dances, sings, blows raspberries, tries somersaults. Reward it and it will do them more; discourage it and it will stop.

A UNIQUE PERSONALITY
Affection, curiosity, liveliness, courage, sweet tooth: everything you do shapes it. As it grows, its colour and look change. There are six forms to discover.

WARDROBE
Colours and accessories to unlock: bow, crown, glasses, headphones and more.

6 GAMES AND A DIARY
Bubbles, fruit, memory, "Where's Mumbly?" and more games that unlock as it grows. The diary shows how many words it knows and what it knows about you.

STRESS-FREE
Mumbly never dies. It goes to bed and wakes up by itself at the times you choose, and notifications only arrive when it needs you.

ITS BRAIN LIVES ON YOUR PHONE
No account and no external AI: what you teach it never leaves your device. Works offline too.

Available in English, Italian, German, Spanish and French. Free to play, contains ads.

#GrowYourMumbly

name: Murder Files: Interrogation AI
description:
Murder Files is a detective game you play with your voice. Hold the microphone, ask the suspect whatever you like and listen to the answer. There is no list of questions to pick from. The people across the table are played by an AI that stays in character, remembers what you have already put on the table and lies when it has something to hide. A session lasts a few minutes, a full case takes an evening, and no two interrogations play out the same way.

THE INTERROGATION ROOM
Every suspect walks in with a story, and some of it is true. Press the right spot and the story bends: a pause, a detail that no longer fits, a time that quietly moved. When you catch a contradiction, call it out. Put a piece of evidence on the table and watch the pressure rise. Push too hard with nothing in your hands and they will ask for a lawyer. An interrogation is a budget, not a free-for-all. Every question counts.

TEN CASE FILES, ONE CITY
Set in New York, the first chapter takes you from an antique shop in Cobble Hill to the Staten Island Ferry, a watchmaker's workshop in the Village, a rooftop in Brooklyn Heights and a locker at Grand Central. The second chapter moves into the Diamond District, a Bowery guesthouse, a tango studio in Astoria and a hangar at Teterboro. Not every file is a murder. Some are a disappearance, an accident somebody covered up, a theft pinned on an innocent man. Read the brief, then decide what really happened.

BEFORE YOU SIT DOWN
Sweep the crime scene by flashlight and find what the first officers missed. Some evidence is locked behind a number code or a letter lock, and the key is somewhere in the file if you read carefully. Everything you find goes on your evidence board, next to the testimony you have drawn out of other suspects. One person's statement is often the thing that breaks another. Your chief leaves a note on every file and will point you in a direction if you get stuck.

CLOSE THE CASE
When you think you know, make the accusation: name the person responsible, attach the evidence that proves it and the motive behind it. The right name closes the file. The right evidence and motive earn the extra stars. Nobody confesses in the room. The truth comes out afterwards, in your chief's office, in the culprit's own voice.

YOUR CAREER
Start as a trainee under a chief who has seen it all. Each closed case adds to your service record, from trainee to superintendent, with medals for the sharp eye, the clean interrogation and the perfect chapter. Replay any closed file to raise your stars.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No account, no sign-up. Your progress is saved on your device.
• Voice is optional. If you would rather not use the microphone, type your questions instead.
• Interrogations need an internet connection, because the suspects' voices are generated live.
• Suspects are fiction played by an AI and may occasionally say something odd. You can rate or report any reply with one tap.
• The Academy case and the first file are free. Further case files are available as in-app purchases.

Murder Files is a work of fiction. The cases, characters and places are invented, and any resemblance to real events is coincidental.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://murderfiles.candevecioglu.com/support.html
Terms of Use: https://murderfiles.candevecioglu.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://murderfiles.candevecioglu.com/privacy.html

name: Murmur - Meeting transcription
description:
Murmur transcribes your meetings live, in Catalan and Spanish. Leave your phone on the table and read what's being said as you talk.

IT ALL STAYS ON THE PHONE
Transcription happens on the phone, offline. Neither the audio nor the text goes to any server.

WHO SAYS WHAT
Murmur tells voices apart. Name each speaker, or let them name themselves by saying "Murmur, I'm Laia". Save your voice and it will know you as "You".

NOTES AT THEIR MINUTE
Write notes with headings, lists and checkboxes, take photos of the whiteboard and mark the important moments: all tied to the exact minute of the meeting.

WITH THE PHONE LOCKED
Recording goes on with the screen off. From the lock screen and the Dynamic Island you can mark a moment, pause or stop.

AND ON YOUR COMPUTER
With Murmur on your computer (macOS, Windows and Linux) on the same network, every meeting goes there on its own, encrypted. The computer listens to it again with Whisper, writes the summary, decisions and tasks, and sends them back to the phone.

Also: search across all meetings, tags, sharing as text, three colour themes and dark mode.

name: My BioJournal
description:
My BioJournal is a private journal that writes your life story.

Write about your day in your own words. A thoughtful follow-up question or two helps you get to what really mattered, and a short reflection at the end shows you something about yourself you might have missed. At the end of each month, My BioJournal turns your entries into a chapter of your biography, written in the clear, honest style of a great biographer.

WRITE
• Quick daily entries, or one entry that covers a whole trip or a busy week
• Optional follow-up questions that build on what you actually wrote
• Add photos to your entries
• Mark the moments that matter as Core Memories
• Catch up on past days whenever you want

YOUR BIOGRAPHY
• Turn any month into a chapter of your life story
• Write a whole year of chapters at once
• Answer a few quick questions first, so each chapter gets the details right
• Every chapter stays true to your entries: no invented events
• Download entries and chapters as beautiful PDFs

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• End-to-end encrypted: your journal is locked with a vault password only you know. We can't read it.
• Unlock with Face ID or a PIN
• Locks automatically whenever you leave the app
• AI features are optional and off until you turn them on
• No ads, no tracking, no selling your data
• Delete your account and all of your data anytime, right in the app

Sign in with Apple or Google, create your vault password, and start writing the story of your life, one day at a time.

BIOJOURNAL PRO
Journaling, encryption, Face ID and PDF downloads are free. The AI features (follow-up questions, reflections, biography chapters and AI search) are free for your first 7 days, then available with BioJournal Pro: $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://journal-e2d22.web.app/privacy.html

name: My Drohobych
description:
An unofficial guide for residents of and visitors to Drohobych, Ukraine.

• City bus map — every line in its own colour, both directions and the full list of stops.
• Stops — tap a stop to see which lines call there.

name: MyCost: Travel Price Scanner
description:
Point your camera at a price tag and see what it costs in your own currency. No typing, no switching apps.

SCAN ANY PRICE MyCost reads prices through your camera and converts them on your iPhone in an instant. It picks the price on the tag, not the weight or the barcode, and knows €, $, £, ¥, ₹, kr and more. Tap any number to lock it.

WORKS OFFLINE Exchange rates are stored on your iPhone, so conversions work on a plane, underground or without roaming. Rates refresh once a day when you're online.

FORCE A CURRENCY Travelling where prices show no symbol? Pin the local currency and every price reads in it.

MADE FOR TRIPS Save prices with a name and category, plan a trip with a budget, and see what you've spent. Add your card's fee to see what you'll really pay. Free includes one trip and 20 saved prices; Pro removes the limits.

ALWAYS ONE TAP AWAY (PRO) With Pro: widgets on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, a Control Center button that opens straight to the camera, and Siri: "Convert 20 euros with MyCost".

MYCOST PRO • Unlimited trips and saved prices, with CSV export • All Prices: see every price on a menu or shelf at once • Unit price and Tip & tax tools • Remember where you saw a price • Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, the Convert control and Siri

Pro is a one-time purchase, or a 30-day Trip Pass that never renews. Try every Pro feature free for 7 days.

name: MySnowDays
description:
Which day this week is worth skiing, and can you get there? MySnowDays helps you decide.

Pick your favorite mountains once. Each one gets a card with what you actually want to know: lifts open, runs open, the temperature, the wind, and snow. See how much fell in the last 24 hours, how much is coming in the next 5 days, and what the forecast says for days 6 to 10. The snow circles go from white to light blue to deep blue as the totals climb, and when a big storm is on the way they start to snow.

KNOW THE ROADS BEFORE YOU DRIVE
Tap "Getting there" on a mountain to see the roads you would take: closures, chain and traction law, and snow or ice on the road. Road information comes from the state transportation departments and is shown for mountains in California and Colorado, with more states to come. Every road has a link to the official map.

PLAN YOUR MYSNOWDAYS
Tell us the days you will be on the snow, and where. The evening before, and again the morning of, you get a message with the forecast, new snow, the roads you would drive and what the mountain last reported. You choose the times.

ALERTS WHEN IT MATTERS
Turn on alerts in Settings and we tell you when a road to one of your mountains closes or reopens, and when a lift closes during operating hours.

THE BEST DAY, YOUR WAY
Not everyone wants the same day. Some of us chase the deepest powder, some want sun and light wind, some just want the lifts running. Set what matters to you with simple weights (Off, Low, Medium, High) and MySnowDays scores the next seven days for every mountain you follow, so the best day and mountain rise to the top.

HONEST ABOUT WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
Forecasts come from the National Weather Service and the NOAA National Blend of Models. Snowpack comes from USDA SNOTEL stations. Road information comes from Caltrans and the Colorado Department of Transportation. Lift and run counts come from each mountain's own published report, and when a mountain does not allow us to read its report, we show a link to the mountain's own page instead of guessing. Data is provided as is and can change quickly, so check the official source before you drive.

NO SIGN-UP
You do not create an account. Your name and rules stay on your phone. If you turn on alerts, your favorite mountains, the days you plan and a notification code for your phone are stored on our server so we can send them.

SEASON PASS
Try everything free for 3 days. After that, the MySnowDays season pass is $14.99 per year, billed once a year through your App Store account and renewing automatically until you cancel in your account settings at least 24 hours before the period ends. Terms: https://mysnowdays.com/terms. Privacy: https://mysnowdays.com/privacy.

Questions or ideas for what we should add? hello@steamboatsoftware.com

Use of MySnowDays is also subject to Apple's standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (Terms of Use): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
