name: Namaz – Elegant Prayer Times
description:
Namaz is a calm, beautiful companion for the five daily prayers. Prayer times are calculated on your iPhone for exactly where you are, so they work offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking.

PRAYER TIMES YOU CAN TRUST
• The right method for your region, chosen automatically: Diyanet in Türkiye, ISNA in North America, the official boards in Kazakhstan and Russia, and more
• In Kazakhstan, the official timetable of the Spiritual Administration of Muslims (muftyat.kz)
• Choose any of 14 methods yourself, Hanafi or standard Asr, high-latitude rules and minute-by-minute fine-tuning
• Optional Tahajjud and Duha times

ALWAYS AT A GLANCE
• A live countdown to the next prayer over a sky that follows the sun and moon
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for the next prayer, today's times, the Ayah, Hadith or Dua of the Day, and the next holy day
• A Live Activity counts down on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• An Apple Watch app with complications

NEVER MISS A PRAYER
• Alerts for each prayer you choose, plus an optional reminder before it
• Reminders for holy days and nights: Ramadan, the Eids, Laylat al-Qadr, Mawlid, Ashura and more
• Travel without worry: Namaz can follow your location in the background, so widgets and alerts stay correct in a new city

QIBLA AND THE HIJRI CALENDAR
• A Qibla compass that shows when you're facing the Kaaba
• The Hijri date and a calendar of holy days, with what each one means and how it is observed

DAILY INSPIRATION
• An Ayah of the Day from the Quran, with its translation in your language
• A Hadith of the Day from Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, at-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud
• A Dua of the Day from the Quran and the Sunnah

Namaz is available in English, Turkish, Arabic, Russian, Kazakh and Uzbek.

name: Neon Laser: Mirror Puzzle
description:
Bend the light, solve the puzzle!

Neon Laser is a calm but clever mirror puzzle. Tap mirrors to turn them and guide every coloured laser into the target of the same colour. Sounds easy? It gets interesting fast!

◆ OVER 1000 LEVELS
Every level is designed to be solvable. It starts gentle and ramps up step by step, with the odd tough level to really make you think.

◆ NEW MECHANICS AS YOU PLAY
• Linked mirrors: mirrors with the same number turn together.
• Portals: a laser enters one portal and comes out of its twin.
• Bombs: if a laser touches a bomb... BOOM! Plan the order of your moves.

◆ CHASE 3 STARS
The fewer moves you make, the more stars you earn. Can you 3-star every level?

◆ WORLD LEADERBOARD AND FRIENDS
Collect stars and climb the world leaderboard. Add friends with a code or in one tap from the leaderboard, and see which level they are on right on the level map.

◆ DAILY QUESTS
New quests and new rewards every day.

◆ POWER-UPS
Stuck? Use a hint, undo a mistake, start over or skip the level.

◆ EASY ON THE EYES
Dark neon style, glowing lasers, satisfying sounds and haptics. No timers, no rush.

One laser, a few mirrors and your brain. Let's go!

name: NEON RIFT: One More Run
description:
Dodge the swarm. Break the guardian. Go deeper.

NEON RIFT is a vertical space shooter built around one irresistible question: can you make it through the next world?

Weave through enemy fire, earn weapon upgrades and choose the moment to unleash your limited ammunition. Fight through sculpted alien landscapes and face the guardian waiting at the end of each world. Keep the worlds you have unlocked, learn from each defeat and launch another run.

YOUR FIRST WORLD IS FREE
Take on all three stages of the Ash Sea, defeat its guardian and replay it as often as you like. Try limited superweapon charges during your free runs.

ONE PURCHASE. THE FULL EXPEDITION.
Unlock 10 additional worlds and 30 more stages, with new environments, attack patterns and guardians. The full campaign contains 11 worlds and 33 stages. Your victories open the route to each next world.

UNLEASH YOUR ARSENAL
Pull enemies into a Singularity. Release a Resonance shockwave. Call in Command Wing for a devastating drone pass. Choose one superweapon for your loadout and earn its charges in combat.

CHOOSE YOUR SHIP
The full campaign includes a hangar with six distinctive ship designs. Find your favorite look and take it into the Rift.

BUILT FOR YOUR NEXT RUN
- Touch controls with automatic primary fire and manual special weapons.
- Saved world unlocks and direct starts from worlds you have reached.
- Adjustable music and combat effects, haptics and reduced-motion settings.
- No account required. No ads. No subscriptions.

The Ash Sea is free. Access to worlds II-XI, the full arsenal and hangar requires a one-time in-app purchase. Restore purchases using the same Apple Account. World progress is stored on your device.

name: NetSender
description:
NetSender turns your iPhone or iPad into a simple network controller for lighting, audio and media systems.

Send messages over Wi-Fi to any device on your local network:

• OSC – send any address with int, float, string and true/false arguments
• UDP – send text or raw HEX bytes, with optional CR / LF line endings
• DMX – control channels over Art-Net or sACN (E1.31). Add only the channels you need and adjust them with faders

Handy features
• One destination IP shared by all tabs, with separate ports for OSC, UDP and DMX
• Send history – pick a previous message from the list and resend it
• Shows your device's IP address and subnet, and warns when the destination is on a different subnet
• English and Japanese interface

Ideal for testing and controlling show-control software, media servers, lighting consoles, Art-Net nodes and any OSC- or UDP-capable device.

Subscription
NetSender is offered as a monthly auto-renewing subscription with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://rikiishi-art.github.io/netsender/privacy.html

name: NextSpot Recruiting
description:
College recruiting, done for you.

NextSpot does the recruiting work for high school, club and junior college soccer players. We find the schools that fit you, write your first emails and follow-ups to their coaches in your words, and send them from your own Gmail. Coaches reply to you directly, and every reply shows up in the app.

WHAT WE DO FOR YOU
• Build your list of schools, with your match, cost after aid and admit rate for each one. You approve the list before any coach is emailed.
• Write your first emails in your own words and send them from your Gmail, signed by you. You can read each one before it goes, and edit or remove it.
• Send the follow-ups, so no coach slips through.
• Read every coach reply and note what the coach asked for, like film, your schedule or a call.
• On Pro and Elite, draft an answer to each reply for you to check before it's sent.
• Keep your film page: one link with your full game and your best clips. See which coaches watched, and for how long.
• Send you a report every Monday with what happened and what to do next.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign up with Apple, Google or email. A player or a parent can start.
2. Build your profile in about 6 minutes: your game, your school, your grades and the levels you'd play.
3. Approve your schools and read your first emails.
4. We send them and follow up. Coaches reply to you, and you answer them.

FOR PARENTS
Players under 18 need a parent or guardian's permission before anything is sent, and nobody under 13 can use NextSpot. We never sell your information or use it for advertising.

PLANS
The app is free to download. Emailing coaches needs a NextSpot plan.

No one can promise you an offer. We do the recruiting work so you reach the right coaches, and your play does the rest.

Questions? team@nextspotrecruiting.com

name: NFC Doctor: Tag Tools
description:
NFC Doctor reads, writes, protects and diagnoses NFC tags, and tells you in plain words why a tag won't do what you want.

READ
See a tag's serial number (UID), chip type, memory used and whether it's locked, plus every record on it: links, text, phone numbers, email, SMS, locations, Wi-Fi networks, contact cards and more. Open links, copy values, or look at the raw bytes.

WRITE
Put a link, text, phone number, email, contact card or Wi-Fi network on a tag. A contact card lets anyone who taps it save your name and number. NFC Doctor shows the size before you write, checks it against the tag, and formats blank tags first.

DIAGNOSE
Can't write or erase a tag? NFC Doctor reads the chip's own settings and explains what's stopping it: permanent lock bits, a tag password, or the key that guards an NTAG 424 DNA card. For NTAG 424 DNA cards it can check whether the factory key is still set, and reset the card to a blank, writable tag when it is.

PROTECT
Lock an NTAG21x or MIFARE Ultralight EV1 tag with its built-in password so nobody else can overwrite it. Secure an NTAG 424 DNA card with your own AES key, made from a passphrase you choose. Remove the lock again whenever you like.

ERASE
Clear a tag so it's blank and ready to write.

HISTORY
Every read, write, erase, lock and diagnosis is saved on your phone, so you can look back or write the same content again. Passwords, passphrases and keys are never saved.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing leaves your phone.

OPEN SOURCE
NFC Doctor is free and open source under the MIT License.

Works with NTAG213, NTAG215, NTAG216, NTAG 424 DNA, MIFARE Ultralight, ICODE (ISO 15693), MIFARE DESFire and FeliCa Lite-S tags. What each phone supports varies: the app's Supported tags screen shows the list for yours.

Requires a phone with NFC. On iPhone, Wi-Fi tags can be written but iPhones don't join networks from them.

ÔN TẬP NGẮT QUÃNG

SỔ TAY TỪ VỰNG CỦA RIÊNG BẠN
- Tự tạo bộ từ, xếp theo thư mục, nhập hàng loạt, học bằng đủ các chế độ.

SHADOWING & DICTATION
- Luyện nghe - nói theo video có phụ đề từng câu.

LỘ TRÌNH VÀ BẢNG XẾP HẠNG
- Lộ trình học theo chặng, chuỗi ngày học và bảng xếp hạng để giữ nhịp mỗi ngày.

DÀNH CHO TÀI KHOẢN PREMIUM
- Chụp đồ vật: chụp một đồ vật quanh bạn, AI cho biết tên tiếng Anh, phiên âm, nghĩa, câu ví dụ và tạo thẻ từ có hình.

GÓI CREDIT AI (MUA TRONG ỨNG DỤNG)
- 1.000 / 5.000 / 10.000 credit AI cho Chụp đồ vật và Quét chữ (3 credit mỗi lượt), dành cho tài khoản Premium. Credit không hết hạn.

name: Nibbook
description:
Nibbook turns one bottle of fountain-pen ink into three numbers: converter fills, lines written, and notebook pages.

Keep the records on your phone.

Bottles. Name the ink and enter the millilitres in the bottle.

Pens. Name the pen, enter the converter volume, and the number of lines you counted from one real fill. Nibbook does not guess from nib size.

Fills. Pair a bottle with a pen, set how many lines fit on a page, and save the result. If you change the bottle or the pen later, the fill still shows the page count from the volumes you have now.

Bench. Run the same sum without saving first. Pick a bottle, pick a pen, type lines per page, and read how far that ink goes. Short notes explain each step: fills are bottle volume divided by the converter, lines are fills times your count, and pages are lines divided by the lines on one page.

Everything stays in a file on this phone. Nibbook does not identify an ink, suggest a nib, or track drying time.

name: NOBODYLIES
description:
Your body never lies.

Tap where it speaks: a shoulder, your jaw, your lower back. Read what that part of your body may be saying. Then sit with the question.

NOBODYLIES brings the body reading of somatic therapist Kevin Polak to your iPhone: 30 years of practice and more than 2,500 clients. 59 points on the front, the back and the face. Every reading is written in advance. No AI.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap a point on the body chart: front, back or face
- Big R and L, so right and left are always clear
- Pick how it feels, from pain to tingling, and it becomes part of your reading
- Right side, left side and the back of the body each add their own layer
- One question to sit with

HOLD IT
Every body part leads to its mudra in The Healing Hand, Kevin's mudra app with its own music. Right side, right hand. Left side, left hand.

MY NOTES
Write what you notice. Save it in My notes, or add it to your calendar with the date, so you can look back on when your body spoke.

FREE
What your body may be saying, for all 27 parts of the body. How it feels. One question. Your notes.

PRO: YOUR BODY CODE
The script underneath: the sentence your body keeps repeating.
The energy of it, and your element: what to do when it's too much, or too little, from Kevin's Five Elements chart.
A movement for every part of the body.
Three questions, with room for your answers.
Kevin's own words for every part.
One payment. No subscription. Shared with your family.

No account. No tracking. No ads. NOBODYLIES collects nothing. Your notes never leave your phone.

NOBODYLIES is a space for self-reflection, not a medical service. It never diagnoses, treats, or replaces professional care. If a symptom is new, severe or worrying, see a doctor first.

Your body deserves both: a doctor for the symptom, and this conversation for the story.

name: Nod Guard
description:
Nod Guard is an Apple Watch app that helps you stay awake in meetings and lectures. When your hands stay still for 60 seconds, your watch taps your wrist.

Tap “Start meeting” on your watch before the meeting. Each time your hands stop moving, Nod Guard taps your wrist:
• Still for 60 seconds: one light tap
• 90 seconds: two taps
• 120 seconds: three strong taps
Move your arm for 2 seconds to stop it. No need to look at the screen.

GOOD FOR
• Long meetings and video calls where you start to feel sleepy
• Lectures and seminars

HOW TO USE
1. Open Nod Guard on your Apple Watch and tap “Start meeting”.
2. Each round lasts 30 minutes. An alarm rings for the last 5 minutes. Tap “Open” to continue for another 30 minutes.
3. Tap “End meeting” when you are done.

COUNT ONLY (NO TAPS)
Runs the same check without tapping, so you can see how often it would alert in your own meetings.

WAYS TO WAKE UP
Simple things you can do in your seat, under the desk.

PRIVACY
Hand movement and heart rate are used only on your watch and are never sent anywhere. Heart rate is read only to check that the watch is on your wrist before it taps.

PLEASE NOTE
• Requires Apple Watch. The iPhone app explains how to use it and lets you send feedback.
• It alerts when your hands stop moving, even if you are awake.
• It does not treat sleepiness. Do not use it while driving.

name: Noorva: Prayer, Qibla, Quran
description:
Noorva keeps the things a Muslim opens every day in one calm place, set against the real sky.

PRAYER TIMES
• The time left until the next prayer, counted down to the second.
• All five prayers and sunrise for any day, with the Hijri date.
• Standard calculation methods, Hanafi or Shafi‘i Asr.
• “Match my mosque”: enter the times from your mosque’s board and the app picks the matching method.
• A reminder when a prayer begins and another before its time runs out.

QIBLA
• A compass that tells you how far to turn.
• The line from where you stand to Makkah, drawn on the Earth, with the distance.

DHIKR
• Tasbih after prayer and your own dhikrs with your own counts.
• Every dhikr lights one real star from the Hipparcos catalogue — 5,044 in all. Your sky fills in slowly, like dusk.

QURAN
• The complete Arabic text in Uthmani script from the Tanzil Project, unchanged.
• Translations in English, Russian and Uzbek.
• Recitation by Mishary Rashid Alafasy, ayah by ayah.
• Optional quiet recitation in the background of the main screen; one switch turns it off.

CORNER
• Tell the app what is on your heart — sadness, anxiety, illness, loss — and read ayahs and authentic hadiths on it.
• An ayah of the day.
• Hadiths, their grading and explanations are taken from HadeethEnc.com, unchanged.

THE SKY IS REAL
The Earth, the Moon, the Sun, the planets and the stars are shown where they actually are at this moment, calculated on your phone.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Everything works without signing in, and there are no ads. If you want to keep your sky when you change phones, sign in with Apple. Your location is never sent to the Noorva server.

Noorva is available in Uzbek, Russian, English and Arabic.

The app does not replace a person of knowledge: for rulings, ask a scholar you trust.

name: Noria Hoops
description:
Noria Hoops is French basketball the way you live it courtside. NM1, Élite 2, LF2 and LFB first, plus Betclic ÉLITE, the French Cup, the NBA, the WNBA and the EuroLeague.

LIVE SCORES
Every game of the day, the day before and the days ahead. Score, quarter and game clock update on their own during games.

A PAGE FOR EVERY GAME
Score by quarter, top players for each team, stat battle, lead tracker, full box score and shot chart for NM1, LF2 and LFB. Data comes from the official game sheets.

THE STARTING FIVE IN 3D CARDS
After each round, the five best efficiency ratings as flip cards: photo, jersey, flag, and their stats on the back.

FOLLOW YOUR TEAMS
Pick up to six teams. See their rank, next game and last result, and get an alert before tip-off.

CLUBS AND PLAYERS
A page for every club with its season, roster and player stats. A page for every player with averages and games.

STANDINGS
NM1 groups A and B, Élite 2, LF2, Betclic ÉLITE, LFB and NBA.

NEWS AND VIDEOS
Articles from the newsroom, reels, the Météo des Paniers and the Le Temps-Mort podcast.

PICKS
Predict every round and climb the fans' leaderboard. Same account as on noriahoops.com.

Noria Hoops is an independent media outlet, not affiliated with the FFBB, the LNB or the clubs. The app is in French.

name: Not Sorry PostCards
description:
Some cards say "you're special". These ones tell the truth.

Not Sorry PostCards is a collection of hand-drawn ironic cards to send over iMessage to people who deserve them (or don't).

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a card: birthdays, love, friendship, work, apologies that aren't really apologies…
• Write your message inside, or keep the one that's already there.
• Choose the card's language: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German or Italian.
• Send it over iMessage. They see the cover and open the card.

ON FOLDING IPHONES
Closed, you see the cover. Unfold the phone and the card opens with it.

FREE TO START
There are free cards to send right away. Premium (one-time purchase, no subscriptions) unlocks every card, lets you change the cover and inside text, add your own photo and pick the colours.

No accounts, no ads, no data collection. Just cards. And no apologies.

name: Noteall
description:
Записывайте разговоры и возвращайтесь к важному. Noteall сохраняет аудио на телефоне и помогает отправить выбранные записи на расшифровку и анализ в ваш аккаунт Noteall.

ПЛАТФОРМА NOTEALL
Noteall — платформа для работы со встречами и знаниями команды. На noteall.ru можно загрузить аудио, видео и документы, получить расшифровку, выделить выводы и договорённости, подготовить рабочий документ по выбранному сценарию. Например: протокол встречи, коммерческое предложение, техническое задание или отчёт по исследованию.

Начать можно прямо в браузере на https://noteall.ru — мобильное приложение для этого не требуется. Приложение дополнит работу с платформой, когда понадобится записать разговор на телефон и отправить его в тот же аккаунт. Переход на noteall.ru доступен прямо из приложения.

ЗАПИСЬ НА ТЕЛЕФОНЕ
• Запись звука с микрофона, в том числе при блокировке экрана после запуска записи.
• Локальная библиотека без обязательного входа и интернета.
• Импорт аудиофайлов и приём записей через «Поделиться».
• Прослушивание, пауза, ползунок и перемотка на 10, 20 или 39 секунд.
• Переименование, экспорт копии и удаление записи.

ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЕ К NOTEALL
Войдите в свой аккаунт, выберите запись, задайте название проекта и укажите приватную или публичную папку. Аудиоанализ подготовит транскрипт и результаты на сервере. Доступны стандартный режим с подтверждениями дальнейших шагов и Fast-track. Готовые результаты можно читать прямо в приложении и открывать на сайте Noteall. Для Fast-track можно дополнительно выбрать сценарий анализа: поиск, фильтры и описание помогают найти нужный вариант. После завершения результат доступен в DOCX, PDF или Markdown (MD). Меню «Сохранить или поделиться» позволяет сохранить документ на телефон или передать его в другое приложение. По вашему действию можно создать внешнюю ссылку на итог, доступную без входа в Noteall, и затем отозвать её.

ОБРАБОТКА ПО ССЫЛКЕ
Передайте ссылку на видео или аудио: Noteall загрузит запись на сервер и запустит выбранный аудио- или видеоанализ. В настройках можно задать язык записи и конечного анализа для новых отправок. Доступность источника зависит от его ограничений.

PUSH-УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ
По желанию включите уведомления о готовности анализа в настройках. Нажатие на уведомление открывает нужную отправку и её результат.

ЕСЛИ СВЯЗЬ ПРЕРВАЛАСЬ
Приложение показывает объём и скорость загрузки. После обрыва связи или перезапуска можно продолжить отправку с проверкой частей, уже принятых сервером. Локальная копия сохраняется.

ВАЖНО ЗНАТЬ
Noteall записывает звук вокруг телефона. Приложение не перехватывает обе стороны мобильных звонков и звук других приложений. Системный звонок может прервать микрофонную запись. Получите необходимые согласия участников перед записью и передачей аудио.

Запись и прослушивание доступны без аккаунта. Серверная обработка требует аккаунт Noteall и использует его тариф и баланс. Покупок внутри приложения нет.

Поддержка: zapros@noteall.ru
Конфиденциальность: https://noteall.ru/mobile/privacy.html
Удаление аккаунта: https://noteall.ru/mobile/delete-account.html

name: Ocean Depths - Dome Defense
description:
Your glass dome is the last city on the sea floor — and something big is swimming straight toward it.

TAP TO DEFEND
Tap creatures to hit them with a magic beam. Lock on, build combos of up to +100% damage and aim for the golden weak spot on bosses. Sore finger? Hold it down and the harpoon fires on its own.

UPGRADE YOUR BEAM
Your beam changes as you level it up: from a tiny spark, through violet rune magic and gold, all the way to a rainbow blast. The dome grows with you, from a small shelter to a legend of the abyss.

RECRUIT A CREW
Spark the clownfish, Pincer the crab, Inky the octopus, Echo the dolphin, Shell the turtle and Abyss the whale — each one fights in its own way.

BUILD A CITY THAT EARNS FOR YOU
Six buildings produce pearls on their own, even when you are not playing. Reach levels 10, 25, 50 and 100 to double their income.

BOSSES EVERY 5 WAVES
Dread sharks, ancient reptiles and the Kraken itself. Use the Shockwave, Frenzy and Pearl Tide skills at the right moment.

ASCEND AND COME BACK STRONGER
Stuck? Ascend to the surface, keep your starfish and start again with permanent bonuses.

• Wave too strong? You only drop back one wave — collect pearls, upgrade and push on
• Trophies, artifacts and daily rewards
• Friendly tips that explain what to upgrade next
• Plays in portrait, one hand is enough
• 7 languages

Free to play. Contains optional rewarded ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: Oddstar
description:
Name something nobody else would.

Oddstar is the trivia party game where the obvious answer loses. Every question has hundreds of right answers – but only the rare ones launch your ship across the galaxy.

"Name a fruit." Apple? That's a Satellite. Durian? Supernova. Rambutan? You're an ODDSTAR!

HOW IT WORKS
• Read the question and type any answer you can think of
• The rarer your answer, the farther you fly: Satellite → Comet → Nebula → Supernova → ODDSTAR
• Every light-year counts on the weekly leaderboard
• Endless mode gets harder with every galaxy – one miss and your run is over

14 THEMED GALAXIES
• NEW: Movies, TV Series, Music & Stars, The 2000s, Games & Internet, Sports and Brands
• Plus space, geography, food, nature, culture, tech and everyday life
• Fresh questions every day – and a live check for answers we have never seen

FLY THROUGH REAL GALAXIES
• Start at Earth, jump past the Moon, Mars, Andromeda and beyond
• 21 real galaxies, then endless new ones you get to name
• Unlock ships, badges and the legendary Oddstar Prime

PERFECT FOR
• Quick brain breaks on the go
• Game nights with friends and family: who finds the rarest answer?
• Trivia fans, word lovers and everyone who thinks a little differently

Play in English or German. Free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads.

Can you think odd enough to become an Oddstar?

name: Offlingo - Offline Translator
description:
Translate entirely on your iPhone, with no internet connection.

Offlingo is an offline translation app. Translation, speech recognition, read-aloud, and text recognition all run on your device using Apple Intelligence — so it works in airplane mode, abroad with no signal, or underground.

Four translation modes
- Conversation: real-time two-way translation for face-to-face talks, with read-aloud. Offlingo listens for both languages and works out who is speaking.
- Text: translate what you type, as you type
- Camera: take a photo of a sign or a menu and tap the text to translate it
- Voice: just speak to translate

Privacy by design
Your text, voice, and photos are never sent to any server. Your translation history is stored only on your device. Your words never leave your iPhone.

Supported languages
English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Turkish, and Vietnamese.
The list follows the languages Apple Intelligence supports on your device. Voice input and read-aloud are available for the languages your iPhone provides on-device speech for; Settings in the app shows what is available for each language.

Requirements
An iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 16 or later) with Apple Intelligence turned on. An internet connection is needed only for the first-time setup, when the system downloads the on-device model and speech data. After that, everything works fully offline.

From other apps
Share text to Offlingo from any app to translate it on the spot.

About ads
This app shows a banner ad at the bottom of the screen. A one-time in-app purchase removes ads permanently — no subscriptions.

For travel, business trips, and language learning. Take your words to the world, no signal required.

Contact: tanabee.dev@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: https://tanabee.github.io/offlingo/privacy/

name: Oil Game Story
description:
It is 1900. You have twenty-five thousand dollars, a hunch and a hat.

Every sensible man in town says there is nothing under that hill. Lease it anyway. Sink the hole. And when she comes in, do it again, for a hundred and thirty years.

OIL GAME STORY is a calm, deep game about getting rich in the oil business: the land, the wells, the cheques, and the long patience in between.

THE DECISIONS ARE YOURS
• Read the map and take the lease before the big companies do.
• Sign the paperwork for every well. Keep it all, or lay the risk off on partners.
• At casing point the rig wires you what the hole shows: run pipe, or plug her and keep the money.
• Drill it up, flood it, sell it, or sit on it and wait for the price.

THEN THE MONEY COMES IN
• A cheque on the first of every month, and a counter at the top that never stops turning.
• A file for every well: what it cost, what it made, whether it ever paid out.
• Barn burners, dusters and dogs. You will have all three.

A CENTURY OF BOOMS AND BUSTS
• Real prices, real history: the gusher age, the boomtowns, a dime a barrel in the Depression, the embargo, the long bust, the shale revolution.
• Thirteen eras, from cable-tool rigs to three-mile laterals.
• Leases on the Arctic coast that nobody wants, and no pipeline for nine years. Seventy-million-dollar wildcats in the deep water of the Gulf. Countries abroad that keep their share and sometimes change their minds.
• And after 2030 the game does not stop. There is always another frontier, and the next one is further out than you think.

A COMPANY WITH A PAYROLL
• Landmen, geologists, tool pushers, bookkeepers: each with a face, a knack and an opinion, and now and then the nerve to voice it.
• Two dozen rival companies with silly names, every one of them after your acreage.
• Thirty-two painted newsreels for the big moments. None is ever forced on you.

A GAME TO LEAVE RUNNING
• Made to sit beside your work: the wells pump, the rig turns, and you look up when one comes in.
• Stops the clock for the big news, or never, as you like.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, either way up.

ONE PRICE. THAT IS ALL.
No ads. No timers. No gems. No account. No internet needed, and nothing collected: the game makes no network calls at all. The only thing it wants you to buy is more acreage.

The companies in the game are inventions, and any likeness to a real one is parody. The voices are AI-generated.

name: Ôn thi GPLX 2027: Đậu Ngay
description:
Ôn thi lý thuyết giấy phép lái xe với bộ 600 câu hỏi chính thức, thi thử đúng như đề thật và biết trước khả năng đậu của mình.

BỘ ĐỀ CHÍNH THỨC
• Đủ 600 câu theo bộ đề của Cục Cảnh sát giao thông, áp dụng từ 01/6/2025, đáp án theo đúng bộ đề.
• Đủ 8 hạng: A1, A, B1, B, C1, C, D, E. App tự lọc đúng số câu và câu điểm liệt của hạng bạn thi.
• Hình biển báo và sa hình rõ nét, bấm vào để phóng to.

HIỂU VÌ SAO ĐÚNG, VÌ SAO SAI
• Mỗi câu có lời giải thích ngắn, dễ hiểu.
• Hơn 400 câu có mẹo nhớ một dòng.
• Trả lời sai, app hỏi lại ở cuối buổi và vào hôm sau.

HỌC ÍT, NHỚ LÂU
• Kế hoạch mỗi ngày theo ngày thi và số phút bạn muốn học.
• App tự hỏi lại câu bạn sắp quên, ưu tiên 60 câu điểm liệt.
• Ôn nhanh theo nhóm: câu sắp quên, câu hay sai, câu chưa học, câu đã lưu.

THI THỬ NHƯ THI THẬT
• Đề chuẩn đúng số câu, thời gian, mốc đậu và câu điểm liệt của từng hạng.
• Đề khó của riêng bạn, trộn từ những câu bạn hay sai.
• Thi nhanh 10 câu khi rảnh vài phút.
• Xem lại câu sai và biết phần nào còn yếu sau mỗi đề.

BIẾT TRƯỚC KHẢ NĂNG ĐẬU
• Ước tính khả năng đậu theo mức độ nhớ từng câu và cấu trúc đề của hạng bạn thi.
• Theo dõi điểm các đề thi thử, chuỗi ngày học và chủ đề còn yếu.

TRA CỨU BIỂN BÁO
• Biển báo chia theo nhóm, so sánh các cặp biển dễ nhầm.

Học hoàn toàn offline, không cần tài khoản. Có giao diện sáng và tối.

Mọi câu hỏi, lời giải thích và đề thi thử đều miễn phí. Ứng dụng có quảng cáo; bạn có thể tắt quảng cáo bằng gói tháng, gói năm (tự gia hạn, hủy bất cứ lúc nào) hoặc gói vĩnh viễn.

Lưu ý: Ứng dụng do nhà phát triển độc lập làm, không phải ứng dụng của Cục Cảnh sát giao thông hay cơ quan nhà nước nào. Câu hỏi và đáp án lấy từ bộ 600 câu hỏi sát hạch lý thuyết do Cục Cảnh sát giao thông ban hành (công văn 2262/CSGT-P5 ngày 07/5/2025). Lời giải thích và mẹo nhớ do ứng dụng biên soạn để tham khảo.

Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://oneonedevelop.github.io/gplx-privacy/
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: One More Parcel
description:
Every parcel has a place. Can you find it before the truck leaves?

One More Parcel is a cosy 3D packing puzzle set on a busy warehouse loading dock. Drag chunky cardboard boxes off the dock, spin them into shape and pack the truck until not a single space is left. Then slam the doors and watch it drive away.

• 40 solver-checked deliveries, from a gentle first stop to snug fits around wheel arches, fragile glassware and this-way-up boxes
• A shared Daily Parcel: the same puzzle for everyone, every day
• Turn, undo, restart and a friendly hint whenever you're stuck. No timers, no pressure
• Bright toy-like 3D, a cheerful parcel mascot, satisfying snaps and light haptics
• Built for iPhone and iPad, with layouts that adapt when you rotate or unfold your device

The first 12 stops and the Daily Parcel are free. One optional, one-time purchase unlocks the whole route. No subscription, no ads.

No account needed. Puzzles work offline and progress is saved on this device. Restore your purchase from Settings with the same Apple Account.

name: one SFA Universal
description:
oneSFA è l'app che accompagna i tuoi agenti in ogni fase della giornata sul campo: gestione clienti, creazione ordini, appuntamenti e obiettivi di vendita, tutto da dispositivi mobile.
Dashboard sempre aggiornata
Obiettivi di vendita, KPI e statistiche in tempo reale, con accesso rapido alle funzioni più usate e ai clienti visitati di recente.
Gestione clienti a 360°
Portafoglio clienti assegnato, anagrafica, situazione crediti e pagamenti, documenti, note e contatti in un'unica scheda.
Ordini in pochi passaggi
Catalogo articoli, listini e sconti calcolati automaticamente, promozioni attive, riepilogo prima dell'invio.
Calendario e appuntamenti
Pianifica le visite, gestisci i task collegati ai clienti, non perdere nessun impegno della giornata.
Funziona anche offline
I dati restano disponibili senza connessione: le modifiche si sincronizzano automaticamente non appena torni online.
Pensata con un'interfaccia nativa pensata per la velocità sul campo.
Progettata per la massima flessibilità, la nuova versione consente di lavorare in totale mobilità ed è perfettamente ottimizzata sia per smartphone che per iPad.

name: OnlineQuran AI:  Learn Quran
description:
OnlineQuran is a complete Quran companion: read the Mushaf, listen to the Imam, and recite with an AI that listens and corrects you.

READ
• Clean Mushaf pages with tap-to-open meaning for every aya
• Translation in English, Tamil, Urdu and Hindi
• Bookmarks, starred surahs, juz and surah index
• Continue reading where you left off

LISTEN AND RECITE (OnlineQuran AI)
• Listen to the Imam recite each aya, then repeat it
• OnlineQuran AI checks every word and shows what was missed
• Speech is processed on your device

LEARN
• Basic Arabic: speak letters and words, get corrected, play games, take an exam and earn a certificate
• Noorani Qaida: letters, harakat, madd, tanween, tajweed basics and waqf
• Tajweed with the Imam: sound games and rule exams
• Quran Words: master the most common root words with games and an exam
• Meaning of all 30 juz, aya by aya

PRAYER COMPANION
• Step-by-step prayer guide with audio, so you can pray hands-free
• Tarawih planner: set your target, follow the Imam's recitation and track your progress across the month
• Topics and duas with references that open directly in the Quran

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• My Progress shows your reading days, tests and certificates

Available in English, Tamil, Urdu and Hindi.

OnlineQuran AI can make mistakes. Please confirm your recitation with a qualified teacher.

name: Onza Notas
description:
Onza Notas graba tus reuniones y notas de voz, las transcribe y las convierte en algo que puedes usar: un resumen, las decisiones que se tomaron y los pendientes con su responsable y su fecha.

Graba sin pensarlo
• Un toque para empezar, desde la app, la pantalla bloqueada o el Centro de control.
• Sigue grabando con la pantalla apagada. El reloj se ve en la pantalla bloqueada y en la Isla Dinámica, con un botón para detener.
• Si nadie habla durante un minuto, se pausa sola y retoma cuando vuelve la voz.

Privada desde el primer día
• Por defecto transcribe con Apple en tu iPhone: el audio no sale del dispositivo y no necesitas cuenta ni llave.
• Tus notas se guardan en tu teléfono y en tu propio iCloud, y se sincronizan con tu Mac.
• Sin publicidad, sin analítica, sin rastreo.

Resúmenes, decisiones y pendientes
• Conecta tu propia llave de OpenAI o de Claude para que cada nota llegue con resumen, puntos clave, decisiones y pendientes.
• Para transcripciones con hablantes separados, usa OpenAI o Soniox con tu llave.
• Antes de enviar algo a esos servicios, la app te dice qué recibirán y te pide permiso. Lo puedes retirar cuando quieras.

Todo a la mano
• Pendientes de todas tus notas en una sola lista, con los vencidos a la vista.
• Con tu llave de OpenAI o Claude: resumen del día y chat con tus notas. Pregunta qué se acordó con un cliente y recibe la respuesta con la cita.
• Reconoce las voces de las personas que ya identificaste.
• Widget de pendientes con botón para grabar.

Transcribe en español o en inglés.

name: OpenCodeRemote: AI Coding
description:
Keep your OpenCode workflow within reach.

OpenCodeRemote is a native iOS client for OpenCode Desktop on your Mac. Pick up the same tasks from your iPhone, send the next instruction and review what changed. Your Mac runs the models and tools.

CONNECT TO YOUR MAC
Open Settings → Pairing → Pair device in OpenCode Desktop. Scan the QR code in the app or paste the one-time link. OpenTunnel supports connections across networks.

CONTINUE THE SAME TASKS
Search existing tasks or create a new one. Choose an available model, follow progress and add instructions. Subagent work stays within its parent conversation.

STAY IN CONTROL
Answer agent questions, approve permission requests and inspect file diffs from your phone. Native conversations support formatted text, code blocks, tables and streamed responses.

FOLLOW RUNNING WORK
See running-task status in the list and a Live Activity timer on supported devices. After an extended period in the background, open the app to synchronize the latest status.

The interface follows your system or per-app language setting. English, German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese are supported.

Requires a Mac running a compatible version of OpenCode Desktop with Pairing support. Keep your Mac awake and online. Model access, provider costs and tool execution are managed on your Mac. Network performance depends on your connection and OpenTunnel availability.

OpenCodeRemote is an independent client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenCode team.

name: OpenMP3
description:
Turn a public Google Drive folder into your personal music player.

OpenMP3 is a simple, free iPhone app for the MP3 recordings you own or have permission to stream. Paste a public folder link, load its tracks, then choose when to press Play. No OpenMP3 account or Google sign-in is required.

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR CONTROLS
• Discover MP3s in a public folder and its subfolders.
• Play, pause, seek and skip with native audio playback.
• Keep listening when you leave the app.
• Shuffle your queue or repeat one track or all tracks.
• Save folder links locally on your iPhone.
• Browse the active play queue separately from saved folders.
• Load another folder while listening: its tracks wait in Up Next until the current song ends or you press Next.

FREE AND SIMPLE
No ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases or app-operated analytics. Folder links stay on your device, and audio streams directly from Google.

BEFORE YOU START
An internet connection is required. Folders and MP3 files must be publicly accessible and allow downloads. Public links can be opened by anyone with the link, so do not use private or sensitive recordings. Streaming uses cellular data when available.

Public-folder discovery depends on Google's available folder information. Some files or subfolders may be missing, shortcuts are skipped, and Google may limit streaming or downloads. OpenMP3 does not provide offline downloads or a music catalogue.

OpenMP3 is independent of Google and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

Support: https://asymmetri.co/mymusic/openmp3/support
Privacy: https://asymmetri.co/mymusic/openmp3/privacy

name: Oraelya: Bibbia e Preghiera
description:
Prega ora. Resta nella Parola.

Oraelya prende il gesto che già conosci — il pollice che scorre — e ci mette dentro la Scrittura. Un versetto per schermata, a tutto schermo, senza rumore. Su molti versetti, una nota breve di lettura: non è un commento della Chiesa. Quando ti accorgi che stai scorrendo, stai pregando.

IL FEED DELLA PAROLA
• Versetti di consolazione e di promessa, come il Salmo 23, Isaia 41, Matteo 11 e Giovanni 14
• Temi per quando il giorno pesa: pace, speranza, fiducia, consolazione
• I primi 8 versetti sono gratuiti; il feed intero fa parte di Oraelya Premium
• Preferiti, con Oraelya Premium: salva i versetti che ti parlano e ritrovali quando servono
• Condividi un versetto come immagine, su WhatsApp o nelle storie

OGGI, IN UNA SCHERMATA
• Il tempo e il colore liturgico del giorno, sul calendario proprio dell'Italia — dall'Epifania del 6 gennaio al Corpus Domini della domenica
• Il versetto del giorno
• Il santo del giorno, quando il calendario ne ricorda uno, con una scheda breve
• Una preghiera breve del mattino
• L'Angelus, che nel tempo pasquale lascia il posto al Regina Caeli

I SANTI
Un santo per ogni giorno dell'anno, 29 febbraio compreso: 366 schede brevi, da sfogliare mese per mese o da cercare per nome.

IL ROSARIO, GUIDATO
• I misteri gaudiosi, luminosi, dolorosi e gloriosi
• I misteri del giorno sono già scelti per te
• Le preghiere scritte per intero, riga per riga. Se non ricordi come si recita, l'app te lo mostra.

LE PREGHIERE DI SEMPRE
Segno della Croce, Padre Nostro, Ave Maria, Gloria al Padre, Angelus, Regina Caeli, Salve Regina, Credo degli Apostoli, Angelo di Dio, preghiera del mattino e preghiera della sera. In italiano, con il Padre Nostro nella forma in uso oggi in Italia.

L'ANGELUS A MEZZOGIORNO
Un promemoria alle 12. Trenta secondi, dove ti trovi. Poi torni a quello che stavi facendo. Se vuoi, anche un versetto all'ora che scegli.

TRE MINUTI, PRIMA DEL CAFFÈ
Non serve un'ora al giorno. Un versetto, il santo di oggi, una preghiera: il tempo di un caffè. Ogni giorno.

DUE COSE DETTE CHIARAMENTE
1. Il testo biblico di Oraelya è la Riveduta 1927 di Giovanni Luzzi, di pubblico dominio. Non è la traduzione CEI 2008 e non comprende i libri deuterocanonici. Preferiamo dirtelo prima che dopo.

name: Orb Remote
description:
Orb Remote shows you the text messages and calls of a phone you leave at home — the one with your SIM — on this iPhone, wherever you are.

Travelling, keeping a work number on a second phone, or living abroad with a SIM from home? Leave that phone plugged in at home with the free Orb Relay app. Orb Remote then shows you every SMS it receives, lets you answer from the same number, and tells you about its calls.

SEALED END TO END
Every message, call and reply is encrypted on one of your phones and decrypted only on another. OrbVPN carries them but cannot read them: our servers see only when something arrived, never a number or a word of text.

YOUR PHONES ONLY
A handset joins your account only when you scan a code it shows, or type a one-time code, on a phone you already hold. You can see and remove every handset and every phone at any time.

WHAT YOU GET
• The SMS of your home phone, in threads, as they arrive
• Answers sent as ordinary SMS from your home phone's number
• Calls made to your home phone, with who called and when
• More than one handset on one account (for example two countries)
• Face ID lock for the app
• Messages and calls are kept on our relay for 30 days, sealed, then deleted

WHAT YOU NEED
• An OrbVPN account with any paid plan. Orb Remote is included with every paid plan. The free plan does not include it.
• A second phone with your SIM, running Orb Relay.

You can delete your OrbVPN account from the app at any time: Settings, then Delete account.

name: OrbiPost-Ring Mail Puzzle
description:
Ohjaa rauhallista postiluotainta samankeskisten painovoimarenkaiden halki.

Suunnittele jokainen liikevaihe käyttämällä neljää toimintoa: Liuku, Siirto sisään, Siirto ulos ja Jarrutus. Renkaat pyörivät omien aikataulujensa mukaan, joten odottaminen muuttaa sekä suuntaasi että telakointipaikkaa, jota tavoittelet. Tarkastele seuraavaa pyyhkäisyä ennakkoon, väistä kiinteitä esteitä eri sektoreilla ja kuluta polttoainetta vain silloin, kun kiihdytät.

Myöhemmillä reiteillä vastaan tulevat käänteisesti pyörivät renkaat, ajautuvat telakointipaikat ja ajastetut siirtoportit. Laadi lentosuunnitelmia, vertaile yrityksiäsi lokikirjassa, tutustu renkaiden toimintaan laboratorion harjoituksissa ja palauta kaikki asemat kuuden luvun harkituissa kiertoratatehtävissä.

Ei kiireistä naputtelua. Vain selkeät kokonaislukusäännöt, huolellista ajoitusta ja onnistumisen iloa, kun kirje saapuu perille täsmälleen oikeaan aikaan.

name: Orbit: Habits That Stick
description:
Orbit helps you build habits that stick — and plan the rest of your day around them.

Track the habits that matter, plan your workouts and meals, and get deep work done with a built-in focus timer. Everything lives on your iPhone. No account, no sign-up, no ads.

HABITS THAT STICK
• Build good habits or quit bad ones
• Daily, specific days, or a few times a week
• Morning, afternoon and evening routines
• Tick off a whole week at a glance in the Weeks view

SEE YOUR PROGRESS

PLAN YOUR DAY

FOCUS TIMER
• Pomodoro timer with focus, short break and long break
• Live countdown stays visible above the tab bar while you work
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island

HYDRATION
• Water goal with reminders through the day

name: OrbitCue
description:
Welcome! We’ve put great care into building this product and look forward to your valuable suggestions.

Seasonal chores and yearly tasks return on a quiet orbit. OrbitCue helps you capture them once, wake before they matter, then sleep with a note for the next round.

CAPTURE A CYCLE
Name a seasonal, yearly, quarterly, or custom-day cycle, set its wake window, and add a short checklist. Sample cycles load after welcome so every screen is ready to explore.

WAKE BEFORE IT MATTERS
Home surfaces the next wake, a month ribbon, and bands for waking and active cycles. Open a desk to review the checklist, start Wake Board, tick lines as you go, then sleep with a note for next year.

BROWSE THE YEAR
Horizon and Shelf sort cycles by season and status. Trail keeps a short history of wakes and sleeps so last year’s note is never lost. Optional local nudges fire when a cycle is about to wake.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Cycles, checklists, and sleep notes stay on this iPhone. Cabin holds privacy text, reminder hour, and a wipe-all control when you want a fresh orbit.

OrbitCue only times the return. It never uploads your cycles or sells your data.

name: PadelSP
description:
PadelSP is Pakistan's padel app. Find a game, earn your Level and score every match live.

FIND A GAME
Games near you at your Level, in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad and more. Post your own match, Americano or Mexicano for up to 32 players. Full? Ask for a spot.

Tournaments and leagues from clubs and organisers, with your own team name. Challenge any pair to a rematch. Weekly city tables and monthly prizes in the Showdown.

Find clubs near you, book courts where clubs take bookings, and find a coach for lessons and drills.

Partners, rivals, head-to-head records, chats, Rallies (short match videos) and SP Sahib, the Superintendent of Padel, who answers your questions about your game.

Free to join with your WhatsApp number.

name: Pagewump
description:
Pagewump is a cosy reading tracker with a cartoon bookshelf and Wump, a bookworm who keeps you company while you read.

READING NOW
See every book you're reading with its cover, page and progress bar. Tap "Log pages" to record where you stopped and how long you read, or tap "Timer" to start a reading session.

A REAL-LOOKING BOOKSHELF
Your books stand on wooden shelves as coloured spines. Filter by Want, Reading or Finished, search by title or author, and sort by title, author, progress or rating. Tap a spine for its details, star rating, quotes and reading sessions.

READING TIMER
Pick a book and start the hourglass timer. When you finish, tell Wump the page you stopped on and the session is logged automatically. The screen stays awake while the timer runs.

PLANNER & LOANS

• Library loans: note borrowed books and get a reminder 2 days before they're due. Mark them returned or renewed

QUOTE JAR
Save favourite lines with the book and page. Shake the jar for a random quote and share it.

STATS AND BADGES
• A yearly reading goal ring
• Day streak, minutes read and pages per session
• A pages-this-week chart and recent sessions
• 12 badges such as First Chapter, Night Owl and Marathon

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline
• Your books, quotes, sessions and loans are stored only on your iPhone
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Account optional: browse as a guest, or sign in with Google
• Erase your data or delete your account at any time

NEW HERE?
Pagewump starts with a few public-domain classics so you can explore. Remove them with Profile → Erase all app data, or bring them back any time with "Load sample books".

Happy reading!

PRIMARY CATEGORY: Books

name: Papervale: Cozy Daily Planner

Papervale is a calm daily companion made of cut paper. Every real thing you do, a task done, a page written, a quiet minute of breathing, turns into paper scraps. With them you build your own little village, one cottage at a time.

TODAY
Tear off the morning page like an old desk calendar. Pick up to three things that matter, stamp them when they're done, and fold the page in the evening. Every task you finish lights a window in your village that night.

JOURNAL
A soft question each day, a mood made of paper, and room for your words. Add a photo and it becomes a paper-cut sticker. Your pages stay on your phone.

YOUR PAPER VILLAGE
Build homes, roads, gardens and a post office with the paper you earned in real life. Residents move in, write you letters, celebrate birthdays and walk through rain and snow. Turn your phone sideways to see the whole village.

CALM CORNER
Origami breathing in a few gentle rhythms, a candle for quiet focus, and paper boats to let thoughts float away.

Prayer times for your city, a daily Quran portion, morning and evening adhkar, a tasbeeh, sadaqah, and gentle support through Ramadan and Eid. Turn it on or off anytime.

name: Paralegal File Lab
description:
Build an exhibit binder that keeps each selected page connected to its source.

PDF WORKSPACE
Import your PDFs through Files. Select the original pages you want, arrange their exhibit order and add your own issue notes. Private app-owned copies and source fingerprints are stored on-device; original files are not changed.

BATES LABELS AND SOURCE MAP
Choose a Bates prefix and first number. Move pages earlier or later, or use Edit to rearrange the sequence. Labels update with the current order while original page references remain attached. SHA-256 fingerprints identify imported copies, not their authenticity or legal admissibility.

GENERATED OUTPUT
Create a letter-size visual PDF containing a paginated source index and labeled content pages. A separate text source map retains full issue notes and fingerprints. Preview the generated PDF, then choose whether to save or share it. Visual copies do not retain searchable source text, forms or links. PDF index notes are short excerpts; full notes remain in the text source map.

TRY IT WITHOUT CLIENT FILES
Four fictional sample PDF pages demonstrate selection, notes, numbering and export. The earlier three-file training lab, saved handoffs and reference concept cards remain available in Training, Handoffs and Reference.

BOUNDED, OFFLINE ORGANIZATION
Save up to 30 binders. Each holds up to 25 source PDFs, 100 selected pages and 100 MB of imported source data. Source PDFs must be unencrypted and no larger than 25 MB or 100 pages each. No account, developer-server upload or AI analysis is required. A Files provider or sharing destination you choose has its own data practices.

All binder tools and retained learning content are free with ads. Optional US$4.99 one-time Remove Ads removes advertising only. No subscription; Apple displays local prices and supports restoration with the same Apple Account.

This is an organization and learning tool, not legal advice, a redaction tool, a deadline calculator, a court-filing compliance check or a certification of evidence. Verify source permissions, document completeness, legibility, page order and numbering before use. Keep confidential files out of support emails and use sharing controls deliberately.

name: Parched: Plant Watering
description:
Parched tells you which houseplants need water today, and leaves you alone the rest of the time.

Add a plant with a name, a photo and its type. Parched works out a watering cycle from the plant, its pot, its light and the season where you live, then nudges you on the right day. Water it with one tap, from the app or straight from your Home Screen.

LEARNS YOUR HOME
Soil still damp when it's due? Tap Still damp. Parched waits a little longer and adjusts that plant's cycle, so the schedule gets more accurate the longer you use it.

ONE LAP OF THE HOUSE
Choose your watering days and Parched groups plants into rounds, ordered by room. One nudge, one lap with the watering can.

WATCH THEM GROW
Add a photo each month and every plant builds its own growth journal. Swipe between plants to see how far they've come.

SEASONS THAT MATCH YOUR HEMISPHERE
Each plant shows whether it's growing, flowering, slowing or resting, based on your approximate location. Cycles stretch in winter and shorten in summer, in the north, the south and the tropics.

A BIGGER HOME, AT THE RIGHT TIME
Parched tells you when a plant has outgrown its pot, and waits for the growing season to suggest repotting.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• One calm nudge per watering round
• Away mode pauses everything while you travel
• Backed up to your own iCloud
• No account, no ads, no tracking

PRICING
Free for two plants. Parched Unlimited is a single one-off purchase for unlimited plants and every widget. No subscription.

name: ParkFluent: NYC Street Parking

name: Pathlink: Slide Puzzle
description:
A puzzle where you slide panels to link a path and roll the ball to the goal.

Tap a panel next to the empty space, and it slides into it.
Tap a panel farther along the gap's line, and the ones in between slide with it.
Slide your first panel or tap the ball, and it starts rolling.
Keep linking the path while it rolls, and get it to the goal to clear.
Until it starts rolling, take all the time you need.

- 300 stages
From a small 3×3 board up to a wide 6×6, in 15 chapters of 20 stages.
・Stones: panels that can't move. They block the way.
・Detours: grooved panels that can't move. The ball must pass through all of them before the goal.
Some stages have wavy, sharply bent or bulging grooves.
Clear a stage in the target moves for 3 stars.
And once you have every star, there's more to aim for.

- Daily
A new puzzle every day.
Everyone gets the same one on the same day. Your streak is recorded.

- Endless
Solve generated stages one after another, without a break.
Each one starts rolling after 3, 2, 1. One fall and it's over. How far can you go?

- Looks
Unlock new ball and board colors and patterns with your stars and records.

- Play quietly
A clean screen with soft, pale colors.
Gentle sounds and light haptics.

- About ads
A banner ad is shown at the bottom of the game screen.
Full-screen ads appear now and then at natural breaks, such as moving on to the next stage.
In Stages, you can watch an ad for a hint (the panels that link the path are marked) or to see the answer. In Endless, you can watch an ad to continue after a fall.
Buy "Remove Ads" (one-time purchase) to turn off ads, and use Hint, See the Answer and Continue without watching one.

name: Pawst Lives
description:
A cat has nine lives. Yours all fight at once.

When the lights go out, the house becomes a dungeon. The garden sprinkler is a hydra. The toaster is a dragon. And somewhere in the dark under the stairs, THE VACUUM is waiting.

Pawst Lives is an idle RPG with one big twist: when a life has gone as far as it can, you begin the next one, and the cat you were comes back as an Echo, a ghost that fights at your side from then on. Up to eight Echoes join you. Nine cats. One hero. All yours.

YOUR PARTY IS YOUR OWN PAST
• Play a life as a Clawblade, a Hexpaw or a Whiskershot.
• Push as far as you dare. The further a life gets, the stronger the Echo it leaves behind.
• Choose who you will be next and build the party you want out of the lives you have lived.
• Nine lives, for real: fall to a boss and an Echo steps into your place so the fight goes on. Each Echo is one spare life.
• Echoes remember how they lived. Each keeps the skill you trained highest and a trait you earned: Pouncer, Unbroken, Stubborn or Dreamer.
• Build a pride: bonuses for three of a kind, one of every class, all six coats, or a full house of eight.
• Name every cat and pick its coat: Ginger, Midnight, Cream, Smoke, Snow or Calico. Each Echo keeps the coat it wore.

IDLE WHEN YOU WANT, HANDS-ON WHEN YOU DON'T
• Your cats fight on their own. Step away and they nap: you come back to a little pocket money and a well-rested cat that earns double for a while.
• Tap to pounce, time your skills, or let it all run on auto.
• Stuck on a boss? Train, gear up, or start a new life and come back with one more ghost.

EIGHT ROOMS OF A VERY HAUNTED HOUSE
• From the Garden Gate to the Roaring Dark, each with its own monsters and boss.
• Can Crabs. Sock Goblins. A washing machine with tentacles. An overdue library book with teeth.
• Beat the story and fall into the Dream: the whole house again, stranger and stronger, without end.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO UPGRADE
• Train five stats, level three skills per class and enhance four gear slots.
• Find gear in six rarities, from Common to Mythic.
• Weave Yarn into the Tapestry: permanent upgrades that never reset.
• Daily quests, lifetime feats and a daily gift, all paying free gems.

FAIR AND QUIET
• No ads. No account. No tracking. Nothing is collected about you.
• Plays offline.
• Optional in-app purchases: gems, and two one-time upgrades that last forever. No subscriptions. Chest odds are shown before you buy.

Nine lives. Spend them well.

name: Paxune
description:
Meet Paxune, a quieter way to care for the things you live with.

Paxune is a private household ledger for product warranties and recurring upkeep. Keep purchase details close at hand, see when coverage ends, and give filters, cleaning, inspections, and seasonal care their own simple rhythm.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Record appliances, electronics, furniture, and other household items.
• Calculate warranty end dates from purchase date and warranty length.
• See which items are covered, ending soon, or expired.
• Create weekly, monthly, seasonal, yearly, or custom care routines.
• Complete a routine to save a dated history entry and move the next due date forward.
• Add optional notes and care costs.
• Choose local reminders with your own advance notice.
• Review room distribution, recorded value, warranty deadlines, and care momentum.
• Search and filter your household catalog.

name: Peach Fighter
description:
Pick one of three heroes from Japanese folk tales and travel from a small town all the way to Onigashima, the island of the oni. A top-down action game.

PLAY WITH ONE FINGER
Just walk and your weapons fly by themselves. Guard when an oni glows, dodge the red marks on the ground, and shove away a crowd that closes in.

THREE HEROES, EACH WITH THEIR OWN FRIENDS
Choose Momotaro, Kintaro or Urashima Taro. Each fights with different weapons and has different friends: a dog, a monkey and a pheasant for Momotaro; a boar, a bear and a deer for Kintaro; a turtle, an octopus and a flying fish for Urashima Taro. Up to two friends travel with you at a time. Feed them kibidango to keep them going.

ONE LONG JOURNEY
Town, wasteland, forest, cave and coast. Beat each region's boss to open the gate to the next. From the coast, board a ship to Onigashima, where the oni general waits.
The cave is a maze in the dark: glowing eyes warn you of what is coming, bat swarms rush in, a map fills in as you walk, warps join far-apart places, and the Great Earth Spider waits at the back.
At post towns, rest at the teahouse, mend weapons at the blacksmith and buy kibidango. Any post town you have visited can be reached by riding the flying cloth spirit, Ittan-momen.

THINGS TO FIND, WEAPONS TO MEND
Chests, offerings at roadside shrines, and what strong yokai drop. Rare Fine and Legendary weapons each have a name of their own. A broken weapon is not lost: the blacksmith restores it - common ones for koban, Fine and Legendary ones for Pichi.

FIGHT WITH THE FIVE ELEMENTS
Oni have a nature too: wood, fire, earth, metal or water. Fire beats metal, water beats fire. Read your enemy and pick the right weapon.

AFTER ONIGASHIMA: ROUND 2
Beat the oni general and you can start Round 2: a new world, from the town again. The oni are much stronger, and Pichi and fine weapons drop far more often. Your level and weapons carry over. (There is no Round 3.)

TRAVEL TOGETHER (ONLINE)
- With friends: make a room, send the 6-letter code, and join the same journey as a hero or as a hero's companion. One journey holds up to 9 players.
- Everyone nearby gets 70% of the experience from each kill. Chests and Pichi belong to whoever opens or picks them up. Oni do not get stronger with more players.
- Drop-ins: turn them on to meet other parties at post towns, and to fight other heroes in lawless zones (you are asked before you enter; players far apart in rank cannot fight). Off by default.
- At post towns you can trade weapons and kibidango with someone standing close.
- Players talk only with fixed phrases and stamps. No free typing, no voice.
- You can block and report players. A player you block is never put in your room.

ADS AND PURCHASES
- The game shows video ads. Every second time you cross a gate into the next region, a video plays that you cannot skip. Watching a video to get back up on the spot after a defeat (once per boss fight, up to 3 per 30 minutes) or to get a few Pichi at the teahouse is your choice. No ads during a fight, a talk or before a boss.
- Pichi, the currency you collect in play, buys time-limited items: an Ad-free tag (no more gate videos) and an Unbreakable charm (weapons do not wear down), for 10, 50 or 100 hours of real time from the moment you use them. Pichi also buy looks (outfits) that do not change your strength.
- For real money there are five things only: Kintaro and Urashima Taro (480 yen each; Momotaro is free from the start) and three Pichi packs.
- Entering an online room costs a fee: watch one video, or pay 10 Pichi (refunded if you leave within 3 minutes). Free while an Ad-free tag is running. No ads while other players are in your room.

Playing alone needs no sign-in and no connection. Online play needs a connection; Drop-ins need you to sign in with an account.

name: Pedals: Rate Your Citi Bike
description:
Not every bike share bike rides the same. Pedals helps you remember which ones are great and which ones to skip.

Scan a bike’s QR code to see how it rode before. Ride with your bike share app as usual, then rate the bike when you dock: stars, a couple of tags like “Smooth ride” or “Weak brakes”, and a note if you want. After a few weeks you’ll have your own map of good bikes.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Scan any bike to see your past rating, tags and notes
• Rate a ride in seconds; half stars allowed
• Browse every bike you’ve rated: best first, most ridden, or only the ones to avoid
• See live classic bike and e-bike counts and open docks on the map
• Find where a bike you liked was last docked
• Label stations Home and Work and get a heads-up when your destination has no open docks
• A ride notification with a reminder at 45 minutes, so you don’t overstay

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your journal stays on your phone. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Export a backup any time.

OPTIONAL COMMUNITY RATINGS
Turn on sharing to pool your star ratings and tags anonymously with other riders, see how they rated a bike, and find well-rated bikes they recently docked on the map. Notes are never shared, and you can withdraw your ratings.

Pedals works with Citi Bike in New York City. It keeps your journal; your bike share app still unlocks bikes and handles payment. Pedals is an independent app and isn’t affiliated with or endorsed by Citi Bike, Lyft or Motivate.

name: Perne
description:
Perne домбыра тартуды нөлден үйретеді. Телефонды жаныңызға қойыңыз — қосымша ойыныңызды тыңдап, нотаның дұрыс-бұрыстығын бірден айтады.

ҚАЛАЙ ЖҰМЫС ІСТЕЙДІ
• Экранда домбыраның мойны: қай пернені басу, қай саусақпен, қай ішекті қағу керек.
• Микрофон қағысты естіп, нотаны тексереді — екі ішекті қатар қаққанда да.
• Көмек біртіндеп азаяды: алдымен бәрі белгіленеді, кейін жатқа ойнайсыз.
• Баяу бастаңыз — фраза таза шыққанда қарқын өседі.

ІШІНДЕ НЕ БАР
• Бастаушы курсы: ашық ішектер, пернелер, төмен және жоғары қағыс, қос қағыс.
• Қысқа сабақтармен күйлер: «Балбырауын», «Адай», «Көроғлы», «Қосалқа», «Тойбастар» және басқалар.
• Халық әндері мен Абай әндері: «Еркем-ай», «Көзімнің қарасы», «Беу айдай», «Үкілі қыз».
• Кварта және квинта құлақ күйіне арналған тюнер.
• «Өзіңді тыңда»: сабақтан кейін өз ойыныңның жазбасы.
• Әлсіз тұстар: қосымша қиын тақтарды есте сақтап, қайталауды ұсынады.
• Күндер сериясы, атақтар және достар — бірге үйрену қызықырақ.

ҚҰПИЯЛЫҚ
Дыбыс телефонның өзінде өңделеді және ешқайда жіберілмейді. Аккаунтсыз және интернетсіз де үйренуге болады.

Интерфейс қазақ, орыс және ағылшын тілдерінде.

name: Personality Test – Big Five
description:
Take a real 50-statement Big Five test and see a score for each of your five traits.
Then pass the phone to a partner or friend and compare your results side by side.
No ads before your results, no trial tricks, no account.

The Big Five (also called the five-factor model or OCEAN) is the personality framework psychologists use most in research. Instead of squeezing you into a four-letter box, it shows where you sit on five scales:

• Openness – curiosity, imagination, love of new ideas
• Conscientiousness – planning, follow-through, order
• Extraversion – energy from people and activity
• Agreeableness – warmth, trust, cooperation
• Emotional sensitivity – how strongly you feel stress and mood swings

HOW IT WORKS
• Start with 6 quick questions and find your core trait.
• Take the full 50-statement test in about 5 minutes.
• Get a 0–100 score and a plain-English read for each trait: what it means when it is high, middle or low.
• Tap "Compare with someone", hand over your phone and let them take the same test. See both of you on the same bars, with a note for each trait on where you are alike and where you balance each other out.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no login, no ads.
• Your answers and scores stay on this device.
• Delete a profile at any time.

SUBSCRIPTION
Personality Test – Big Five offers weekly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions that unlock the full test, your report and partner comparison. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://fod-team-org.github.io/app-legal/personality-test/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://fod-team-org.github.io/app-legal/personality-test/terms/

This app is for self-reflection and fun. It is not a psychological assessment, diagnosis or professional advice.

name: Phomic
description:
Phomic turns your iPhone into a wireless microphone for your Windows PC.

Install the free Phomic app on your PC, open Phomic on your iPhone and tap your computer. Your iPhone's microphone then shows up on the PC as a microphone called "Phomic", so you can pick it in any app that uses one: voice chat, video calls, streaming and recording.

WI-FI OR BLUETOOTH
• Wi-Fi: uncompressed 48 kHz audio with low latency on your local network.
• Bluetooth: no network needed, within about 10 meters of the PC.
• Switch between them while you talk. The microphone stays on.

MUTE FROM ANYWHERE
• One big button: green when you're live, red when you're muted.
• A Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with its own mute button.
• Muting fully releases the microphone.

SOUNDS LIKE YOUR IPHONE
• Phomic sends the microphone as it is and adds no processing of its own.
• Choose Standard, Voice Isolation or Wide Spectrum with the iPhone's Mic Mode.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Audio goes straight from your iPhone to your PC, over your own network or Bluetooth. Nothing goes through the internet.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• An optional pairing code keeps other phones out.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Windows 10 or 11 PC with the free Phomic app: github.com/Nordohm/Phomic
• VB-CABLE, a free virtual audio driver by VB-Audio. The PC app shows you how to get it.

name: Phoneo
description:
Phoneo is a free app to listen to gospel radio from many countries, hear the Bible read aloud and follow your church's videos, all in one place.

LISTEN
Gospel and Christian radio stations from your country or from around the world. Save your favorites and add your own stations.

THE BIBLE IN AUDIO
Hear the Bible read aloud with the voice of your device. Translations whose rights we checked: Bíblia Livre (Portuguese), Reina-Valera 1909 (Spanish), Louis Segond 1910 (French), World English Bible, Berean Standard Bible and King James Version (not shown in the United Kingdom). Search by book, chapter or passage.

CAR MODE
Large buttons to change station, pause or switch to the Bible without looking away from the road. Your car's audio screen shows what is playing.

NEAR YOU
See churches, ministries, projects and events within 30 km and open the route in your maps app. Your location stays on your device.

YOUR CHURCH
Add your church's YouTube channel or any video link and follow services in one place.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no in-app purchases. Your preferences stay on your device, and you can save them in a backup file to move to another phone. Partner listings are labeled "Partner", or "Sponsored" when paid.

Phoneo is made by Technologies EzerIT inc., Québec, Canada.

name: Photo Report Camera
description:
Send a photo update from the field with your iPhone. Capture shipping labels, dispatch slips, or completed cleaning work, then check a saved recipient and send photos by email from the app.

GETTING STARTED
Email sending requires connection details issued by the service administrator. Set them up manually in Settings or scan a QR. Installing the app alone does not register you for the email service. Check how to obtain access before using email reporting.

CAPTURE AND REPORT
• Include multiple photos in one report.
• Save the sender name and recipient details.
• Add a comment when needed.
• Create and edit report fields manually, or configure them by QR (text, number, and selections).
• Keep photos, drafts, and report history on your device.

CHOOSE HOW TO SEND
Email is the standard method. Recipients can view the photos in their usual mailbox. Use the iOS share sheet for apps such as LINE, then select a person or group in that app. Advanced settings also support direct HTTPS POST to a compatible receiving system.

UNDERSTAND THE STATUS
“Email accepted” means the email service accepted the request. It does not confirm delivery or that the recipient read it. If the outcome is unknown, check the report history before sending again.

PHOTOS AND DATA
Photos stay on your device and are processed by the relay service when you send email. The service does not provide an online photo album. Recipient mailboxes and sharing destinations may retain the photos you send.

Requires iPhone with iOS 17 or later. The app interface is currently Japanese only. OCR, video, digital photo signatures, and guarantees of authentic capture time or location are not included.

name: piata - 自炊メニューブック
description:
自分の作った料理が、レストランのメニューになる。

piata は、自炊した料理を「美しいメニューブック」として集めるアプリです。料理の写真と名前を登録するだけで、まるでお店のメニュー表のように並びます。登録するほどメニューが充実していく楽しさを味わえます。

■ レストランのようなメニュー表
・料理はカテゴリごとにメニュー表のように並びます
・お気に入りの一品を「本日のおすすめ」として大きく飾れます
・お店の名前は自由に決められます

■ 写真を自然に美味しそうに
・写真を選ぶだけで、明るさや色味を自然に整えます
・Natural / Warm / Clear のプリセットと、明るさ・色温度・彩度などの細かな調整
・トリミングと、補正前後の比較
・元の写真は加工せずにそのまま保存。料理を描き足したり形を変えたりはしません

■ 着せ替えられるデザイン
・テーマ 8 種類：ナチュラルカフェ、クラシックビストロ、ジャパニーズモダン、ファインダイニング、トラットリア、黒板カフェ、パティスリー、北欧キッチン
・レイアウト 7 種類：写真付きグリッド、クラシック、雑誌風、大きな写真、3 列、文字だけのメニュー、アルバム風
・テーマを変えても料理データはそのまま

■ 食事の記録とカレンダー
・「食べた！」をタップするだけで記録
・カレンダーで、食べた料理を写真で振り返り
・今月の記録回数や、いちばん作った料理もひと目で

■ メニュー表を画像で書き出し
・作ったメニューを画像にして、写真に保存したり共有したり

■ 安心のプライバシー
・アカウント登録は不要です
・データはすべて iPhone の中に保存され、外部に送信されません
・料理・写真・記録・テーマ設定をまとめてバックアップ／復元できます

name: PickleballBu.com - Scoreboard
description:
Pickleball scoring, fair rotations for your sessions and practice planning, in one app. Tap the side that won each rally and the score call (0-0-2) and the serving order follow the official rules. Turn on Analysis mode to record where every shot was played, then watch the match back as an animated replay and see its stats. At a session, just pick who came and get a rotation where everyone plays as often as everyone else. Sign in with Google or Apple to plan practice with your members and share match records with them.

■ Just tap the side that won the rally
- One tap per rally: Tap the panel of the side that won the rally: a point if they were serving, otherwise a change of server or a side out. Big numbers you can read from outside the court.
- The call and the serve, shown for you: The score call such as “4-2-1” (0-0-2 to start a game), who serves and from which side, and server 1 or 2, all as the official rules say.

■ Fair rotations for your sessions
- Pick who came: Choose from your members and recent players, or add names. Make it from a practice plan and everyone who said Going is already in.
- Courts and partners: From 1 to 8 courts. Doubles with new partners every round or fixed pairs, or singles. It shows straight away how many sit out each round.
- The games appear: The round on court and the next one, court by court, with who sits out. Someone arrives late or leaves early? The rounds from the next one are made again.
- Scores and standings: Enter scores on a number pad, or keep score on the scoreboard. Standings go by wins, then point difference, and you can share the rotation.

■ Plan practice and find a place to play
- Plan practice: Add a title, time and place, and pick who to invite. You can also invite someone straight from their member page.
- Add to your calendar: Add plans straight to Google Calendar or the calendar on your iPhone.
- Court map: Find pickleball courts and gyms on the map, and pick one for your plan. Read and write reviews with photos, and save favorites. If a place is missing, you can request it from the app.

■ Connect with members and share your records
- Saved to the cloud: Once you sign in, matches are saved to the cloud too. See the same records on a new phone or on your computer.

■ Record where every shot was played
- Tap the court: Just tap where each shot was played, in order. The serve goes in by itself. Tap where it bounced too, and the replay bounces it there.
- Double-tap where it lands: Double-tap where the ball came down to end the rally: in or out follows from the spot, and a net is a double tap on the net band. A serve into the kitchen takes a single tap: a service fault. Double bounces and kitchen faults on a volley can be recorded too.

■ Watch the match again as an animated replay
- Moving avatars: Each hitter's avatar runs to where the shot was played, so doubles rotations show too.
- Commentary: The server's call (4-2-1) at the start of each rally, then “third-shot drop”, “dinks, 5 in a row”, “kitchen fault!” and more tell the rally in words, in all 7 languages.
- Match stats: Key points (comebacks, runs, third-shot drop success and more) and the score flow, summed up for you.

■ Fast doubles? Score with two phones
- Invite a helper: The scorer taps “Invite a helper” on the match screen. A QR code and a 6-character code appear.

■ Great for
- Getting side-out scoring and the score call (0-0-2) right every rally
- Running open play or a session where everyone gets as many games
- Recording shots and rallies to analyze and review your matches
- Sharing practice plans and head-to-head records with the people you play with

■ Use it in 7 languages
Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Korean, Thai, Indonesian

■ Price
Free, no ads

Members and practice plans need a Google or Apple sign-in. Your name and avatar are visible to other signed-in users.
Keeping score, rotations and the court map work without signing in.

name: Piclong: Long Screenshot
description:
Turn screen recordings and screenshots into long images with Piclong. Capture, stitch, edit, and share the content you want to keep.

SCREEN RECORDING TO LONG IMAGE
Record a scrolling page and turn the video into a long screenshot. Select frames and adjust seams when you want more control over the result.

STITCH PHOTOS AND SCREENSHOTS
Combine multiple screenshots or photos into one image. Review and adjust the joins to create a continuous result.

CAPTURE FULL WEBPAGES
Save webpages as long images for easy reference and sharing.

EDIT YOUR IMAGES
Crop images, remove unwanted sections, add text or image watermarks, and annotate your captures. Apply watermarks to multiple images at once.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save your finished image or share it with others. You can also trim a video and save or share the trimmed version.

PICLONG PRO
Unlock advanced editing and export tools with a one-time purchase. Available features and pricing are shown in the app.
