https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/RCkZwtPRWiJJPqkfSE7cXqiQnzc?from=from_copylink

Terms of Use:
https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/WIrkw0hdqioydckdAbmcMv5bnfd?from=from_copylink

name: Pillaro
description:
Pillaro is a friendly pocket pill organiser for your pills, vitamins and supplements. It lays out each day's doses by time of day, lets you mark them with one tap, and counts your stock down so you know days ahead when a pack is about to run out.

YOUR DAY, COMPARTMENT BY COMPARTMENT
Today groups every dose into Morning, Noon, Evening and Bedtime. Tap Take and a blister on the card pops open. Skip a dose you're leaving out, or Snooze it for 10, 15 or 30 minutes and get a gentle nudge when the snooze ends. A strip along the top shows how many blisters are still sealed today.

A CABINET THAT KNOWS WHAT'S LEFT
Add each item once: name, strength, form (tablet, capsule, drops or powder), dose per intake, times of day (preset slots or exact times), days of the week and pack size. Pillaro takes one dose off the stock count every time you tap Take and turns that into a clear countdown such as "8 days left". Pick your own "refill soon" mark for each item and the cabinet flags it in time.

REFILLS WITHOUT GUESSWORK
The Refills page puts the item that runs out next front and centre on a countdown dial. Log a new pack with its quantity, where you bought it and when, and the stock tops itself up. Every refill stays in a tidy month-by-month log, and a mistaken entry can be removed in a tap.

SEE HOW THE MONTH WENT
A 30-day calendar colours each day by how many doses you took, with a streak count and a day-by-day breakdown. Every item also has its own history and a 30-day taken percentage.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Optional local notifications arrive at your dose times and a day before a pack runs low. Turn them off any time in the Drawer.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
Flip-lid compartments for navigation, soft plastic snaps, foil pops and a bottle rattle when you log a refill. Sound and haptics each have their own switch. Choose between three colour themes: Mint Tablet, Night Shift and Sorbet.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start straight away as a guest with "Open the cabinet", or create an account with email and password, or use Sign in with Apple. Guests can save their cabinet to an account later from the Drawer. Pillaro works fully offline and syncs when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your data is stored only in your own account. Delete your account and every item, dose record and refill from the Drawer at any time.

PLEASE NOTE
Pillaro is a reminder and stock-counting tool. It does not give medical advice or check doses or interactions. Always follow your pack instructions and your doctor or pharmacist.

name: Pinball Duo
description:
Pinball Duo brings back the look and sound of 90s PC pinball: chunky pixels, dithered skies and chiptune music, on four original tables.

SHAREWARE, LIKE IT USED TO BE
The first table, BOOSTBACK, is free and complete. A single in-app purchase registers the full version: every other table, plus the ones added later. No ads, no subscription.

• BOOSTBACK (free) — a rocket pad at night. Light L-A-U-N-C-H for multiball, sling around Mars, land on the Moon and work your way up from Intern to Space Legend.
• GOLD CANYON — sunset in the desert. Shoot the mine, knock down W-A-N-T-E-D and use the third flipper.
• NEON METRO — the city after dark. Ride the subway across the table and spell M-E-T-R-O.
• BAD SECTOR — inside a 90s PC. Collect every data bit to open the exit, type commands on the terminal and squash the virus.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap the left or right half of the screen for the flippers.
• Pull the plunger back with your finger and let go. Release on the mark for a skill shot.
• Shake the phone to nudge the table. Shake too hard and it tilts.
• Each flipper press moves the numbered lights, so you can line up the one you need.
• Wire ramps, spinners, missions and ranks, multiball, jackpot, super bumpers, extra ball, ball save and an end-of-ball bonus.
• Leave it alone and the camera tours the table.

MADE FOR FOLDABLES, GOOD EVERYWHERE
On a foldable iPhone the table fills the open screen, and folding it slightly switches on high gravity: faster ball, double points. On every other iPhone and on iPad you get the full table with a backglass scoreboard.

WORLD RANKING
Every table has a free worldwide leaderboard: see the top ten and where you stand after each game (Game Center).

Separate music and effects volume. A high score per table.

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

name: ping me: Order Ready Alerts
description:
ping me tells you the moment your café or restaurant order is ready.
Scan the QR code at the counter or open the link the café gives you, and follow your order live: received, preparing, ready. When it's ready, your iPhone pings you, even when it's locked. No account, no sign-up, nothing to type.
• Live order status in the café's own colours and logo
• An alert with sound the moment your order is ready
• All the orders you opened today in one place, with live status
• English and Arabic
ping me works at cafés and restaurants that use ping me. Orders stay on your phone for a day, then disappear.

name: Pingo Bot
description:
Pingo Bot is the phone app for Pingo, the software that runs your AI agents on your own computer or on a server of yours. You need Pingo installed and running to use it: the app connects to your Pingo and shows what happens there, but it doesn't run agents by itself.

When you open it, you see your agents and channels, each with its latest message, and whatever is waiting for you. Tap an agent to open the conversation full screen and type, dictate or talk by voice. Replies arrive right there, as they do on the computer. Dictation and voice use whatever is set up in your Pingo.

When an agent wants to do something sensitive, like deleting, sending or publishing, it stops and waits for your yes. In the app you see the request, with what is about to happen, and approve or decline it with one tap. Questions the agents leave for you are in the same place, under For you.

You can also create a new agent in a few taps, with a name, a character and a colour, or talk to Pingo itself and let it put an agent together with you.

If you like, your iPhone tells you when an agent needs you, even with the app closed. A notice says only who and what, like "Lia needs your approval", never what the conversation says. One tap opens the app on the right conversation.

To connect, open Pingo on your computer, go to Settings › Phone and scan the QR code with the app. For a server, paste the connection link it makes. The connection is kept on your iPhone, and the app goes straight back to it. You can keep more than one, such as your computer and a server, and switch between them.

With Pingo on your computer at home, your iPhone needs to be on the same Wi-Fi to open your conversations. Notices reach you wherever you are; to answer one, get back on your home Wi-Fi. With Pingo on a server, the app works from anywhere with an internet connection.

Privacy: the app has no account, no ads and collects no data. Your conversations stay between the app and your own Pingo. So that notices can come through Apple, the app gives a small Pingo service the notification token Apple assigns to your iPhone and gets a sealed code back. That service keeps nothing, and no conversation content goes through it.

The app speaks English and Portuguese. To install Pingo on a computer or a server, see pingoai.app.

name: PINK Cloud Team
description:
PINK PRO Cloud is the staff app of PINK PRO, a beauty and barber supply store in Kosovo (pink-pro.com).

It brings the PINK PRO order and support panel to iPhone:
• New orders from the online shop, with status, delivery and cash-on-delivery tracking
• Live chat with customers in real time
• Instant notifications for new orders and chat messages, even when the app is closed
• Order tracking links for customers by WhatsApp, Viber, SMS or email
• Printing of delivery notes and export of orders

Sign-in is for authorised PINK PRO staff only. The app is in Albanian.

PINK PRO Cloud është aplikacioni i stafit të PINK PRO: porositë, dërgesat dhe live chat-i në iPhone, me njoftime në kohë reale.

name: Pixas: Life Simulation
description:
What would it be like to live in a simulation?

Pixas is a multiplayer life simulation built from real-world map data: real streets, squares and seasides in a colorful block world, where you build a life.

FIRST CITY: AYVALIK
The journey starts in Ayvalık, Türkiye. More cities and towns will follow, one by one.

BUILD YOUR HOME
Pick a plot, watch your house go up, draw rooms, place walls, doors, windows and furniture, add floors and a garden.

OPEN A SHOP
Bakery, boutique, barber… residents become your customers. See the most loved shops on the Market Board.

AN AI MAYOR
Every morning the mayor looks at the city and makes a decision. You vote on tomorrow's.

EXPLORE
Discover landmarks and collect stamps. Hundreds of residents live their own day. Visit friends, send gifts, dance together.

SAFE AND CALM
No ads, no tracking, no real-money purchases (Pixa is an in-game currency you only earn by playing). No free chat: you greet others with preset phrases. Some features for under-13s unlock with parent approval. No passwords: sign in with an email code or play as a guest. Delete your account and data any time in the app.

The game is currently in Turkish.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Pixel Atelier: Pixel Art
description:
Pixel Atelier is a pixel art editor for drawing characters, making 2D game sprites, and bringing them to life frame by frame. Start with a transparent canvas and build anything from a tiny icon to a looping walk cycle.

DRAW PIXEL BY PIXEL
Choose a canvas size, zoom in for details, and draw with an adjustable pencil and eraser. Use a pixel grid and guides to line up details. Create your own color palettes, pick colors directly from your artwork, or generate lighter and darker shades from a single color.

ANIMATE SPRITES IN LAYERS
Keep separate parts of your artwork on their own layers. The animation timeline shows layers in rows and frames in columns, so you can go straight to the part you want to edit. Start a blank frame or duplicate one to build the next pose. Use onion skin to see neighboring frames as you draw, then preview your loop at 3, 6, 12, or 24 frames per second.

DRAW SEAMLESS TILES
See your tile repeated in a 3 × 3 preview as you draw. Brush strokes wrap across tile edges, so you can check how the pattern joins while you work on terrain, textures, or backgrounds.

EXPORT YOUR ARTWORK
Export a transparent PNG, save your animation frames as a PNG sprite sheet, or create a looping GIF. Save an editable Pixel Atelier project to reopen it later with its frames, layers, and palettes intact.

name: pixelday: daily pixel art
description:
One tiny pixel drawing a day. That's it.

pixelday is a small, calm habit: make one tiny piece each day and watch your month calendar fill up, square by square.

YOUR MONTH
- A calendar board that fills up with each day's piece.
- A streak that counts your days in a row.
- A word of the day, in your language, for when you need an idea.
- 16 medals to earn along the way.
- A daily reminder at the time you choose.

DRAW
- Canvases of 16, 24, 32 or 48 pixels, in 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16 or 16:9.
- Pencil, eraser, fill bucket and eyedropper.
- Mirror mode for symmetric drawings.
- Undo and redo.
- Ready-made palettes plus a full colour picker.

PHOTO TO PIXEL ART
- Turn any photo into pixel art: 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit or HD.
- Automatic colours or one of the palettes, with optional dithering.
- Then retouch it pixel by pixel.
- Photos are processed on your iPhone and never leave it.

STICKERS
- Sticker mode: automatic crop, white outline, transparent background.
- An iMessage sticker pack made of your own pixels.

SHARE
- Share cards sized for stories, in several formats.
- A summary card of your whole month.
- A replay video of your drawing, ready for Reels or TikTok.

WIDGETS
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: today's pixel, your month and your streak.

MAKE IT YOURS
- Light and dark theme.
- 25 languages, from English and Spanish to Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account needed, no ads, no analytics.
- Your drawings stay on your phone and in your own iCloud, unless you choose to share them.
- A backup file you can keep in iCloud Drive or Files and restore on a new phone.

Open pixelday, make today's pixel and keep your streak going.

name: Pixels & Us
description:
Pixels & Us is a shop of printable gifts and products, every one drawn in pixel art.

Find something for the people you love, family, friends or coworkers, for a birthday, a holiday or just because. Buy it with your Apple account and it opens straight away in My gifts, ready to print at home as often as you like.

HOW IT WORKS
• Browse by who it’s for, what we make, or the occasion
• Buy with your Apple account: no sign-up needed
• Open and print from My gifts any time
• Restore Purchases brings everything back on a new iPhone or iPad
• Sign in if you like, to keep favourites and see gifts bought on pixelsandus.com

ALWAYS GROWING
New gifts arrive in the app as the shop grows, without an app update. Bundles put gifts together for less than buying each one on its own.

WHY PIXELS
Every square, on purpose. Bold, bright and easy to love, whoever you’re giving to. The gift aisle is full of the same mugs and swirly fonts; a pixel gift you’ll spot across the room, and remember.

Gifts are for personal use only.

name: PlateSurf
description:
PlateSurf helps you find a California personalized plate that isn't taken yet.

Type your idea right on the plate, up to 7 characters, and tap Check. PlateSurf asks the DMV's own plate checker and tells you if it's available, taken, or not allowed.

Taken? Tap Generate variations for ideas built from your plate: shorter spellings, sound-alikes, rearranged words and add-ons. Check any of them with one tap.

- Variations follow the DMV's rules: no zeros, 1 and I count as the same, a space doesn't make a new plate, and look-alikes of regular plate numbers are left out.
- DMV rules are one tap away.
- History keeps every plate you've checked, on your phone only.
- Two plate styles: the white California plate and the classic black and yellow.

How it works: you agree to the DMV's terms once on the DMV's own page inside the app, and each check is one request from your phone to the DMV, started by your tap. No account, no tracking, nothing stored on our servers.

PlateSurf is independent and not affiliated with the California DMV. Availability comes from the DMV's public plate checker; the DMV reviews every order and has the final say.

name: Playcelist
description:
Some songs belong to a place. The café where you wrote your first real thing. The park where you learned to run. The corner table where you first had your heart broken.

Playcelist lets you pin those songs where they belong.

PIN A PLAYLIST TO A PLACE
Pick a spot on the map, a restaurant, a trailhead, or a pin you drop yourself, then search Apple Music and add the songs that go with it. Write a short note on each one about why it belongs there.

FIND WHAT OTHERS LEFT NEARBY
Open Nearby and see the playlists other people pinned within a quarter mile of where you’re standing. Read their notes and open any song in Apple Music.

NOT A SOCIAL NETWORK
No followers, likes, comments or messages. Nobody sees who made a playlist. Your location is used in the moment to find what’s nearby, and it’s never stored.

You can hide any playlist, block everything from one person, or report anything that breaks the community standards.

name: Pocket Unjam
description:
Make a little room. Find a way out.

Slide colorful parcels across a crowded board and guide each one through its matching exit. Every parcel and doorway carries a symbol as well as a color. The goal is simple: clear the board. The satisfying part is finding the right order.

200 PUZZLES. A JOURNEY OF YOUR OWN.
Travel through 20 chapters, collect chapter stamps, earn 600 mastery stars, and unlock eight achievement medals. Start with a single parcel, then work toward densely packed expert rooms with larger boards, narrow routes, key-locked doors, directional parcels, and demanding clearing orders. In special remix puzzles, rotate the exit colors clockwise and decide when a new route is worth a turn.

EVERY CLEAR MOVES YOU FORWARD
Clear a room for one star, solve without hints for two, and meet the authored move target without hints for three. Earn experience and six growth titles from your best results. Chapter and medal gifts grant free hint credits on this iPhone, once per achievement. Replays keep your best mastery and do not farm experience.

A SHORTER ROUTE TO DISCOVER
Compare your personal best, the design target, and verified voluntary player records. After signing in, choose to submit a completed solution for server verification. Public results show best move counts and participating-account totals, with no names or solution steps. A puzzle with no submissions has no player record yet.

A DAILY LITTLE KNOT
Play a shared daily selection from a fixed pack of 30 puzzles. The selection refreshes at midnight UTC. Keep your personal records and share a score card showing the puzzle, moves, and whether you used hints.

TAKE YOUR TIME
No countdown. No lives or energy. Undo and restart for free. If you need a nudge, a hint highlights one next move without playing the puzzle for you.

MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE
Drag parcels or select one and use direction buttons. Adjust sound effects, music, haptics, and motion. Core puzzles and local progress work offline, without an account.

OPTIONAL ADS AND PURCHASE
You start with three hint credits. Additional hints are available through optional rewarded ads when available. A one-time purchase removes interstitial ads between levels; optional rewarded hint ads remain a separate choice. No subscription. Network access is required for ads, purchases, and online support.

Play as a guest, or use optional Apple sign-in to back up progress privately. Before switching iPhones, check your latest cloud backup; sign in on the new iPhone and choose Restore cloud progress. Better local completion records are kept when restoring. One iPhone manages automatic backups at a time. No public profiles or ranked player list.

name: PocketEdit: Photo & Video Kit
description:
PocketEdit is a pocket studio for the small edits you make every day. Shrink a photo for email, cut a video small enough to send, turn a clip into a GIF, make stickers for WhatsApp, fix an ID photo — each in a few taps.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. PocketEdit has no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and it never uploads your photos or videos. Your originals are never changed: every tool makes a new copy.

32 TOOLS IN ONE APP

Photo
• Resize & Compress — the right size for email, WhatsApp, Instagram or a file-size limit
• Convert Format — JPG, PNG, HEIC or one PDF
• Crop — circles and shapes, plus Passport & ID photos with official sizes and a print sheet
• Collage — classic layouts, shapes and patterns
• Film Filters, Watermark, Blur & Pixelate, Remove Location
• Carousel Splitter and Profile Grid — seamless carousels and grid puzzles for Instagram and TikTok
• Meme Maker, Color Picker, Palette Studio, Remove Background

Video
• Compress Video — small enough to send, with the size shown before you save
• Trim & Join, Video to GIF, Rotate & Flip
• Resize for Stories, Speed, Reverse & Boomerang, Loop Video
• Convert Video, Video Sound, Frame Grab, Photo Slideshow, Live Photos, GIF to Video, GIF Cutout

Stickers
• Sticker Maker — cut out a subject, add an outline and text
• Sticker Packs — build packs and add them to WhatsApp
• Animated Sticker and Batch Stickers

SIMPLE BY DESIGN
Every tool works the same way: pick, adjust, save. Smart defaults mean most jobs take one tap, and you can share straight from the Photos share sheet into any tool.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
PocketEdit is made for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo — folded or open, with tools spreading across both pages when you open it up. Available in 17 languages.

FREE + PRO, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The everyday tools are free, with no watermarks. PocketEdit Pro is a single one-time purchase that unlocks all 32 tools, every Pro option, 7 theme colors and app icons, and every future pack — shared with your family through Family Sharing.

WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC. Instagram is a trademark of Instagram, LLC. TikTok is a trademark of ByteDance Ltd. PocketEdit is not affiliated with these companies.

name: Pocketlink
description:
## Description (4000)
Pocketlink turns your contact details or a link into a Lock Screen wallpaper with a QR code. When you meet someone, show them your phone: they point their camera at it and save your contact or open your link. No app on their side, no typing, no business cards.

A CONTACT CARD OR A LINK
• Share your name, role, email, phone and website as a contact card people save in one tap.
• Or share a single link: your LinkedIn profile, your Linktree, your portfolio or any web page.
• Only your name is required. Add a role, email, phone, website or a short tagline if you like.

YOUR LOOK
• 14 gradients, or a colour of your own with beams, rays or glass.
• Or use your own photo: zoom, crop and darken it so the card stays readable.
• Move the card clear of the clock. A live preview shows where the clock and widgets will sit.

SIZED FOR YOUR IPHONE
• Wallpapers are made at your display’s native resolution, so nothing is cropped or scaled.
• Pocketlink recognises your iPhone, from iPhone SE to iPhone 18 Pro Max, including the iPhone Duo outer display, where the code sits beside the clock.
• Works on iPad too: make the wallpaper there and send it to your iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no server.
• Your details stay on your device, encrypted and excluded from backups.
• The code contains only what you type.

APPLE WALLET
Save your wallpaper, then use Wallet’s own Create a Pass to keep your code in Wallet as well. Pocketlink’s help explains how.

FREE, EVERY FEATURE
No subscription, no purchase, no watermark.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add your details.
2. Pick a background and place the card.
3. Save to Photos and set it as your Lock Screen.

name: PodiumReady
description:
Practice your talk out loud and see every "um".

PodiumReady listens while you rehearse and counts your filler words – "um", "uh", "like" – in English, German and French. You see exactly where they were, how long you spoke and how fast.

FREE
• Count your ums right on your iPhone – your recording never leaves the phone
• See where every um was, your time and your pace
• Track your talks and share a result card

PODIUMREADY PRO
• Predicted grade for every talk – know your grade before you give it
• 3 concrete fixes, each with your exact sentence
• Questions your teacher might ask – answer them out loud once before the real thing
• Add your teacher's grading criteria (photo or text) and the coach fills them in for your talk
• More reliable um count on our server, word for word
• See your progress over time

Perfect for school presentations, oral exams, speeches and pitches.

Privacy: no account, no ads, no tracking. AI feedback only sends the text of your talk, only when you tap "Get feedback", and nothing is stored.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly; the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial). Payment is charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://pelikan-studios.com/Apple/privacypolicy/podiumready/datenschutz.html

name: Porchlight: Stoic Quotes
description:
Pick how you feel. Get a line to change your mood.

Porchlight is for the moment a mood has hold of you. Say what it is, and get one line to help you turn it around.

PICK HOW YOU FEEL
Can't get going. Overwhelmed. Worried. Feeling low. Doubting myself. Angry or annoyed. Heartbroken.
Seven picks. One tap. A line that fits.

REAL QUOTES, PLAIN WORDS
Most lines come from the Stoics: Marcus Aurelius, Seneca and Epictetus. They taught on a porch in Athens, and that is where the name comes from. Their words are given in plain modern English, so nothing reads like a school text. You will also find lines from Emerson, Thoreau, Twain, Nietzsche, Lao Tzu and others.

ONE QUOTE A DAY
A new quote every day. Big type, lots of space, nothing else on the screen. Tap for the next one when you want more.

WIDGETS
Put a quote on your Home Screen or Lock Screen. It changes every three hours, so the right line finds you during the day.

KEEP THE ONES THAT LAND
Save the lines you want to come back to. They stay on your iPhone.

A QUIET REMINDER
One optional notification a day, at the time you choose, with that day's quote.

HONEST SOURCES
Every quote is real. A Sources page in Settings lists who said it and where it comes from. No made-up internet quotes.

PRIVATE
No account. No ads. No tracking. Nothing leaves your iPhone.

Porchlight is a book of quotes. It is not medical advice and it does not replace professional help.

name: PostOnce: Share Everywhere
description:
Made a video? Share it everywhere without writing the caption four times.

Pick a video from your camera roll or record one, write your caption once, and tap Share. PostOnce copies the caption and opens the share menu with your video, ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or Facebook. Paste the caption in, post, then tap the next platform.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick or record a video.
2. Write one caption. The counter shows the shortest limit of the platforms you picked, so nothing gets cut off.
3. Tap Share to TikTok. Your caption is copied and the video goes straight to the app.
4. Paste, post, come back and tap the next one.

YOUR PICKS, REMEMBERED
Only post to some platforms? Switch the others off and PostOnce remembers for next time.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
No sign up and no social media passwords. Your video and caption stay on your phone and go straight to the apps you pick.

FREE TO TRY
Your first 5 posts are free. After that, subscribe to keep sharing. One video counts as one post, however many platforms it goes to.

Subscriptions renew monthly until cancelled. Cancel any time in your Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before renewal.
Terms: https://khaidaodev.github.io/kd-video-poster/terms/
Privacy: https://khaidaodev.github.io/kd-video-poster/privacy/

PostOnce isn't made by, endorsed by or affiliated with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or Facebook. You need those apps installed to post to them.

name: Potluck Trivia:Game Night
description:
Host a real American trivia night from one phone — no TV, no extra devices, just family, friends and a pen.

Potluck Trivia turns your iPhone into a quizmaster's console. It reads each question aloud, shows only you the answer, and keeps score for every team. Every question ends with a fun fact in English, with an optional Chinese or Spanish translation, so you learn a little more about America every round.

HOST MODE — YOU'RE THE QUIZMASTER
• The app reads each question aloud; teams write their answers on paper
• Only the host sees the answer, then taps every team that got it right
• Live scores, a scoreboard every 5 questions, and a champion at the end

TEAM MODE — PASS & PLAY
• 2–6 teams take turns on one phone
• Every team gets the same difficulty each round, so it's always fair

FUN FACTS IN ENGLISH, 中文 & ESPAÑOL
• A short fun fact after every question
• Optional Chinese or Spanish translation — great for families, newcomers and language learners

DAILY 10
• Ten new questions every day, from easy to hard — the same set for everyone
• Keep your streak alive and check it from your Lock Screen

MISTAKE BOOK
• Every question you miss comes back on a spaced-review schedule until you've mastered it

1,160 AMERICAN TRIVIA QUESTIONS
• 10 categories: US History, US Geography, Americana, Movies, Television, Music, Sports, Science & Nature, Food & Drink, Literature
• Easy, Medium, Hard — or Mixed, which ramps up as you go
• Holiday packs: Thanksgiving, the Big Game, Fourth of July and Halloween
• Fresh questions first: the game remembers what you've seen

MADE FOR IPHONE
• Answer the Question of the Day right from a Home Screen widget
• Read-aloud in clear American English — good listening practice, too
• Works completely offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE & PRO
Free: all solo play and categories, the Daily 10, widgets, the Mistake Book, fun facts and read-aloud, Host Mode and Team Mode for 2 teams, and this season's holiday pack.
Potluck Trivia Pro is an optional one-time purchase — not a subscription: up to 6 teams, 20- or 30-question Host games, every holiday pack all year, and full Mistake Book practice. Family Sharing supported.

Perfect for Thanksgiving with the relatives, family game night, a party with friends, or anyone who wants to know America a little better.

name: PQC NOW Browser
seller_name: ZINCIRX BILISIM TEKNOLOJI VE DANISMANLIK ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
PQC NOW Browser opens the web over post-quantum connections, and the .pqc network that no other iPhone browser can open.

POST-QUANTUM, MEASURED
The browser makes every connection itself. It offers a hybrid post-quantum key exchange to every site, and the padlock shows what was actually negotiated: a green PQ padlock for a post-quantum connection, an orange one for a site that only supports classical encryption. Tap the padlock to see everything measured on the connection. Nothing is assumed.

THE .PQC NETWORK
.pqc sites are reached only over post-quantum connections with post-quantum certificates, checked against the pinned PQC root. Start at home.pqc, or put your own site on a .pqc name.

POST-QUANTUM ONLY
Turn on "Post-quantum only" to refuse every site, and every plain http page, that can't offer a post-quantum key exchange.

THE CERTIFICATE RULES OF MAJOR BROWSERS
Certificates of ordinary websites are checked against a public root store, with Certificate Transparency and revocation, and these lists update automatically.

PQC CHAT BESIDE ANY PAGE
Link the browser to PQC Chat and chat with keys of its own on this browser: scan its code with PQC Chat on another phone, or link it on the same iPhone with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
History and bookmarks stay on your iPhone. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, no notifications. Search with DuckDuckGo (default), Google or Brave Search.

name: Printerix - Print & Scan
description:
Printerix prints and scans without an account, a cloud upload or a manufacturer app.

BEST WITH EPSON
• Tuned for Epson printers and tested on the Epson EcoTank L3250.
• Prints to Epson models without AirPrint, which iPhone cannot print to on its own.
• Scans from Epson multifunction printers over Epson's own protocol, even without AirScan.

PRINT
• Print a PDF or up to 30 photos to a printer on the same Wi-Fi, or choose any printer from Apple's print list.
• See exactly what will come out: page count, sheets, copies, two-sided and black & white, before you print.
• Photo layouts: one per page, several per sheet, or a true-size ID card copy (front and back) with cut lines.
• Two-sided printing on printers that support it, and a guided manual two-sided mode for printers that don't.
• Print quality and paper type for printers that report them.
• A built-in test page checks margins, colours and the print head in one sheet.

SCAN
• Capture pages with the camera, reorder and rotate them, and save one PDF.
• Scan from a multifunction printer or scanner on the same Wi-Fi.
• Save to Files, share, or send scans straight to print. Your scan history stays on the device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Documents leave your iPhone only for the printer you choose; scans come straight from the scanner to your iPhone.
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collection.

HONEST STATUS
Printerix tells you when the printer accepted a job. It never claims a page printed when it cannot see the paper, and helps you check the tray if nothing comes out.

Works in English and Vietnamese.

name: Printlight: Analog Film Camera
description:
A free film camera for iPhone. Printlight develops every photo the way a film lab does, and shows the print live before you shoot. No subscription, no account.

It captures RAW. It prints the RAW through a model of a film negative and a film print. The viewfinder shows the style live, so you decide once, before you shoot.

STYLES
Natural, Moody and Vivid. Auto picks one from the light in the scene.

PRINT ANY PHOTO
Printlight also prints photos you already have. Pick up to 30 at a time from your library.

EDIT
Warmth, tint, brightness, grain, glow, mist, vignette, sharpness and shadows. Crop to 4:3, 3:2, 1.43 or 2.20, and straighten. Save a look and use it on other photos.

SHARE
Share the print, a framed print, the original beside the print, or a short video of the photo developing.

HDR
Printlight saves each photo to Photos as an HDR HEIC. It keeps the original, so you can print the photo again.

FREE
Printlight has no account, no subscription and no tracking. The film tables come from spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato (CC BY-SA 4.0).

name: Prism Valley: Light Puzzle
description:
Place mirrors. Guide the light. Light every lamp.

The rules are simple: a mirror bends the light, and the stage is cleared when every lamp is lit. Yet you will find yourself lost in thought. This is a puzzle of light and mirrors.

■ All 100 stages are free
Five mines with 20 stages each. New stones appear little by little.

■ Split colors and mix them
A prism splits white light into red, green and blue. Color stones mix it again. Bring exactly the right color to each colored lamp.

■ A tough puzzle every day
Solve it and a gem lights up on your calendar. Missed a day? Watch one video to play it.

■ Hell mode that stumped AI
20 stages that a state-of-the-art AI struggled with or could not solve. For those who want a real fight.

■ Play at your own pace
No timers. A hint button when you are stuck. Retry freely and aim for three stars.

"Unlock all" opens every day on the calendar and Hell mode, and removes the videos for hints.

name: PritschensStudios Verwaltung
description:
PritschensStudios Verwaltung ist die Handy-App zum PritschensStudios Verwaltungssystem für Speditionen und Busunternehmen in Euro Truck Simulator 2 und American Truck Simulator.

Am PC fährst du, am Handy behältst du deine Firma im Blick. Alles läuft live: Was am PC passiert, siehst du sofort auf dem Handy.

Spedition und Busunternehmen
Bist du in beiden, wechselst du oben mit einem Tipp. Jeder Bereich zeigt dann nur die gewählte Firma.

Dispo und Linien
Aufträge planen, Fahrern und Trailern zuteilen, Leerfahrten und eigene Frachten anlegen. Im Busunternehmen planst du Linien mit Halten.

Live-Karte
Sieh, wo deine Fahrer gerade unterwegs sind, mit Ziel, Ladung und Tempo.

Werkstatt und Lager
Zustand der Fahrzeuge, Reparaturen beauftragen, Fahrzeuge abgeben, Ersatzteile im Lager.

Finanzen
Kasse, Buchungen mit Filtern, Überweisungen, Kredite und dein Privatkonto.

Mitglieder, Bewerbungen und Jobagentur
Wer ist online, wer fährt. Bewerbungen annehmen, KI-Fahrer einstellen.

Statistik und Ziele
Fahrten, Kilometer und Erlöse, Bestenlisten und das Ziel deiner Firma.

Postfach und Support
Nachrichten und Ankündigungen lesen, Support-Tickets schreiben und beantworten.

Firma & Regeln
Einstellungen deiner Firma wie Tempolimit, Spesen, Maut und Bußgelder.

Anmelden
Mit Apple, mit Steam oder mit einem Code aus der PC-App. Du brauchst ein Konto im PritschensStudios Verwaltungssystem.

Preis
7 Tage kostenlos testen, danach einmalig 4,49 € für die dauerhafte Freischaltung. Kein Abo.

Euro Truck Simulator 2 und American Truck Simulator sind Marken von SCS Software. Diese App ist ein eigenes Projekt und nicht mit SCS Software verbunden.

name: ProChatDesk Chat
description:
ProChatDesk Chat is the mobile app for businesses that use Pro Chat Desk to talk to their customers. Answer chats, run message campaigns and watch your sales numbers — wherever you are.

CHATS
• All customer conversations of your business numbers in one inbox
• Unread badges, search by name, number or message text, and filters for unread, your own and each business number
• Reply with text, photos and documents; see sent, delivered and read ticks live
• When the 24-hour reply window has closed, send an approved template with its variables and header image
• Start a chat with a new customer
• Notifications for new customer messages

CAMPAIGNS
• See every campaign with live progress: sent, delivered, read and failed
• Create a campaign in four steps: pick a business number and an approved template, add the header image and variables, choose customers from your chats, by tag or by pasting numbers, then review and send
• Wallet cost estimate before you send
• Pause, resume, cancel or retry failed messages

SALES
• Messages, new customers, bot conversations and campaigns for Today, 7 days, 30 days, this month or any dates, compared with the previous period
• Campaign performance: reach, delivery, read and failure rates, top campaigns
• Chat pipeline: follow-ups, engaged, assigned and tagged customers
• AI Sales Agent results with leads, win rate and follow-ups (when the add-on is on)

ALSO
• Switch between organisations you belong to
• Role-based access: agents see only the chats assigned to them
• App lock with Face ID

You need a Pro Chat Desk account (app.prochatdesk.in). Business numbers, templates and team members are managed in the Pro Chat Desk portal.

name: ProofBox: Receipt Organizer
description:
Keep receipts, product details and home inventory together. ProofBox gives the things you own and the services you use one place for original documents, purchase history and notes — even offline.

FIND THE DETAILS WHEN THEY MATTER
Looking for the receipt for your headphones or the serial number on your washing machine? Search by item name, store, serial number, notes, tags or location. Browse your collection as a grid or a list.

KEEP YOUR ORIGINAL DOCUMENTS
Add receipts, product photos and manuals from Photos or Files. Import JPEG, PNG, HEIC and PDF files, or scan a paper document with your camera. Open and share the original file whenever you need it.

RECORD PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
Save a new appliance, a bicycle or your last air conditioner cleaning. Start with a name and choose Product or Service. Add the purchase date, provider, price, currency and other details when you are ready.

GIVE EACH ITEM A HISTORY
See purchases, documents and dated notes in a simple timeline. Add a note about an installation, a visit or anything you want to remember.

CHOOSE WHAT YOU SHARE
Preview a record summary before sharing it. Serial numbers, stores and prices are hidden until you choose to include them. Review original documents separately before sharing.

YOUR DATA, IN YOUR HANDS
Create a full backup with records, history and original files. Restore missing records without duplicating existing ones, or export a CSV list. Backup and export are included.

No account required. No ads or tracking. Your library works without an internet connection. Choose English, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Japanese or Spanish, with dark mode and support for larger text.

Keep up to 30 active records and 3 attachments per record. Archive older records to make room; reading, searching and exporting your saved records remain available. Backups are manual, so keep a copy outside the app before changing devices.

name: prosnooz: Snore Recorder
description:
prosnooz records your whole night and shows how much you snored, how loud, and when.

Put your iPhone by your pillow, tap start and lock the screen. In the morning you get a snore score and a timeline of the night. Tap any point to hear what happened.

WHAT YOU GET
• A snore score for every night
• Time spent snoring, split by loudness
• A timeline of the whole night with instant playback
• History and trends across nights
• Tags such as alcohol or side sleeping, to see what makes a difference

MADE FOR THE NIGHT
• Delayed start so it begins after you fall asleep
• Keeps recording with the screen locked
• Calls and alarms still ring; recording resumes afterwards
• Music and white noise from other apps keep playing

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Snoring is detected on your iPhone
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Export everything as a file, or back up to your own iCloud

prosnooz is not a medical device and does not diagnose any condition. If you are worried about your sleep or breathing, talk to a doctor.

name: Puffy Garage Spatial
description:
Open the night garage on Apple Vision Pro!

A glowing toy garage appears on your table. Ten cute cars wait in their own bays: Police Car, Fire Truck, Digger, Monster Truck, Race Car, City Car, Off-Roader, Buggy, Ice Cream Van and Camper. Tap a car and it jumps onto the turntable in front of you.

TAP TO PAINT
• Tap any part of your car and paint it: the body, the stripes, the wheels or a part you added
• Spin the car around with your fingers to see every side

40 COOL PARTS
• Sirens, rockets, shark fins, dragon heads, bubble makers, magnets, disco balls, fireworks, rainbow exhaust and more
• Toy, sport and giant monster wheels
• All parts are ready to use, no stars or unlocking needed

PICK A DRIVER
• Ten plush puffs can drive: Teddy, Bunbun, Mochi, Pandy, Ribbit, Puffy, Rexy, Coco, Hamham and Fifi
• Dress them up with racing helmets, police caps, fire helmets, crowns, cowboy hats, shades and goggles

DRIVE!
Your car jumps onto the little road, races two laps around the garage and comes back. Sirens flash, rockets roar and fireworks pop.

BIG CAR!
Tap Big car! and your car appears life-sized on your floor. Walk around it, look inside and keep painting.

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• Just look and tap your fingers
• Big picture buttons, no reading needed
• Cheerful garage music and fun sounds

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No accounts and no internet needed
• Nothing leaves the device

name: Pukumo
description:
A little jar. A big chain reaction.

Drop colorful characters into the jar and merge matching ones into bigger surprises. Pick your cards, plan each drop, and keep the stack under control as every world changes the rules.

MAKE EVERY DROP COUNT
Aim, drop, and watch the physics unfold. Set up satisfying merges and chain reactions without overflowing the jar.

PICK YOUR NEXT ADVANTAGE
Choose a card for each Journey level. Discover combinations that change how you play, then earn XP toward a 10-level progression path with lasting bonuses.

EXPLORE CHANGING WORLDS
Different jar shapes, world rules, bonus goals, and world-final bosses keep each stage fresh. Earthquakes, sideways gusts, and magnetic pulses can turn a quiet stack into a scramble.

FIND YOUR FAVORITE MODE
Follow the Journey, build a run in Roguelike mode, or return for the Daily Jar challenge. Earn stars and discover more cards along the way.

MADE FOR A QUICK BREAK
Pastel colors, expressive characters, and portrait controls make Pukumo easy to pick up whenever you have a few minutes.

Available in English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French, and Portuguese.

Pukumo includes ads and an optional one-time Remove Ads purchase. You can restore your purchase from the in-game store.

Support: https://www.coganka.com/pukumo/
Privacy: https://www.coganka.com/pukumo/privacy.html

name: PulTalk
description:
풀톡은 외국어를 "읽는" 앱이 아니라 "말하는" 앱이에요. 영어, 중국어, 독일어 및 프랑스어 중에서 배우고 싶은 언어를 골라 시작해요.

■ 그림 카드로 문장 만들기
단어를 그림 카드로 보고, 카드를 이어 문장을 만들어요. 그 언어를 거의 처음 하는 분도 카드만 보고 말할 수 있어요.

■ AI 선생님과 단원 학습
언어마다 입문부터 A1까지 40단원. 코어 선생님의 질문에 말이나 글로 답하면, 틀린 곳을 쉬운 한국어로 짚어 주고 고친 문장을 다시 말하게 해요. 벌점도 목숨도 없어요.

■ AI 영상통화
코어, 미나 박사, 정비 로봇 볼트와 주제를 골라 자유롭게 이야기해요. 하고 싶은 주제를 직접 적어도 돼요. 막히면 힌트와 자막(배우는 언어·한국어)이 도와줘요.

■ 말할수록 자라는 이야기
배운 말이 쌓일수록 마지막 새싹 푸리가 자라고, 회색이 된 그린하트 세계가 다시 초록으로 돌아와요. 오늘의 복습은 잊어버릴 때쯤 다시 물어봐요(간격 반복).

■ 내 수준에 맞게
레벨테스트(5~8분)로 시작 단원을 찾고, 한국어 도움 정도를 4단계로 고를 수 있어요.

그림 심볼: Mulberry Symbols (CC BY-SA 4.0)

기본 학습은 무료예요. PulTalk Plus는 1개월·3개월·1년 자동 갱신 구독이며 AI 영상통화를 광고 없이 무제한 이용할 수 있어요. 무료 계정도 선택형 보상 광고를 시청하면 AI 답변을 한 번 받을 수 있어요. 가격과 결제 조건은 앱의 구독 화면에서 확인할 수 있어요.

이용약관 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: PurrPurr: Pomodoro Focus Timer
description:
Focus with a cat that grows.

For study, work, coding, writing or any task. Start a 25-minute focus session and your kitten grows a little. Keep going and it grows from Newborn to Royal, then moves into your Cat Café.

• Plan your 3 things for today
• Pomodoro timer with short and long breaks
• Talk it out: say what's on your mind, AI makes the to-do list
• To-do list with AI help to fix and split tasks
• 19 categories, picked for you automatically
• Park distracting thoughts for later
• Streaks, badges and daily bonus goals
• Stats and day-by-day history
• Rain sound included
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no account

PREMIUM
Optional. Adds 5 more focus sounds, every cat breed right away, any timer length, full stats and history, and unlimited AI help. Choose monthly, yearly (with a free trial for new subscribers) or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://purrpurr-ai.amharicbible.workers.dev/privacy

name: PutawayNook
description:
Putaway Nook is a quiet 3D tidy-up. Each room is a little dollhouse: the floor is close to you, and the named boxes sit back on the shelf. Drag a loose thing into the box that wears the same name.

Six rooms, four pages each. Homework Nook, Shoe Shelf, Toy Corner, Window Ledge, The Closet, and Night Lamp. A page is clear when the floor is clear and every thing is in a legal open box. A wrong box is a spill. You can always finish. Grades are Spotless, Neat, Lived-in, and Rumpled, saved only on this phone.

Some pages have a twist. A cushion, blanket, towel, shirt, or hoodie can hide a smaller thing until you lift it. A lid can be shut until you tap it. A full box can be joined by another if you have cardboard. On lamp nights, the lamp waits until the floor is clear.

Today's scatter builds a fresh mess from the date on this phone. Your best for that day stays local. There is no account, no upload, and no board of other people.

Step inside. Read the name on the box. Put it away.

name: Quarto Head
description:
Quarto Head shows whether each page still points to the head of the section after you fold.

A right-hand page turns over on the first fold. A bottom-row page turns over on the second. An odd cell turns again on the third fold, and only when all eight pages are placed.

Turn a page in its own cell when it comes out upside down. Pages that are already head up stay where they are. Step from quarto back to folio and a bottom page can come out head up without moving.

Sections stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Quaylight
description:
Quaylight is a night ferry puzzle. Stow lantern casks on a three-dimensional hull until the keel sits quiet, then cast off.

Drag a cask onto an empty plank. Swing the view to read the bow, the port rail, and any number the fog is hiding. The keel radar shows the center of mass. Two needles show how the bow and the port side lean. When the still-ring closes, cast off.

Five coves change the water. Fog hides the numbers. Painter lines tie casks into mirror pairs. Wet planks slip a cask one step downhill. A yaw current leans the hull, so the quiet trim sits a little to port. Grades are Calm, Glide, and Drift. There is no star track.

A Night Bell on this device uses today's date for one local puzzle and keeps only your best. Nothing is compared with anyone else.

name: Qubx
description:
Qubx keeps every store running the same way, every day.

Built for restaurants, retail and multi-location teams, Qubx puts daily operations in one app: opening and closing checklists, food safety readings, tasks, approvals, announcements and staff schedules.

CHECKLISTS WITH PROOF
Open your store's checklists for the day and complete each item with a photo, a signature or a temperature reading. Out-of-range readings are flagged right away so they get fixed.

TASKS AND APPROVALS
Assign tasks to a person, a store or a role, set due dates, and track them to done. Managers approve sign-offs from their phone.

SCHEDULES
See your shifts, and managers can build and publish the week for every store.

ANNOUNCEMENTS AND TRAINING
Share announcements that staff acknowledge, keep SOPs and documents in the Library, and train with flashcard decks.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT MATTER
Get notified when a task is assigned to you, something is due or overdue, a checklist is missed, an approval is waiting, or your schedule changes. Turn each type on or off in Settings.

Qubx accounts are created by your employer. If your company uses Qubx, sign in with the username your manager gave you.

name: Questly
description:
Questlyは、配達クエストの進捗と開始・終了を見渡すためのアプリです。Uber等の外部サービスにはログインせず、手元でテンプレートを作り、そこからクエストを登録して管理します。

【できること】
・テンプレートからクエストを作成（種別・必要回数・報酬・時間帯）
・一覧で「あと◯分で開始｜終了」と進捗バーを確認
・受託／完了で達成回数を更新
・履歴で日別の獲得額を確認
・無料はクエスト2件まで。追加無制限・CarPlay向け表示は買い切り（各¥320）

【買い切りプラン】
A クエスト追加無制限（app.questly.ios.unlimitedQuests）
B CarPlay Now Playing表示（app.questly.ios.carPlayNowPlaying）
C 秒表示（時計・相対時間）（app.questly.ios.preciseTiming）

プライバシーポリシー: https://questly-app.pages.dev/privacy/
利用規約（Apple標準EULA）: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
サポート: https://questly-app.pages.dev/support/

name: Quiltmark
description:
Quiltmark figures quilt yardage from the sizes you type.

Save a finished top by width and height. Save a bolt with usable fabric width, binding-strip width, overhang, and join allowance. On the yardage bench, pick a top, a bolt, a block size, and a sashing width. Quiltmark then shows:

How many whole blocks fit across and down (remainders are not partial blocks)
The shorter backing length, after checking both fabric orientations
How much fabric the binding strips take when they are cut across the width
Save the result as a plan. A plan keeps the block count, backing length, and binding length, so later edits to the top or the bolt do not rewrite it. Notes explain the arithmetic. Records stay on this phone.

Quiltmark does not write a pattern, add seam allowance inside a block, or match a print.

name: Quizfix: AI Quiz & Flashcards
description:
Quizfix turns the material your exam is on into a quiz, shows you what you got wrong, and helps you fix it before exam day.

Add what your exam is on
- Take photos of your notebook or textbook pages
- Upload a PDF, slides or a Word file
- Paste a link to a video or an article, or paste text
- Record a lecture as you listen
- Import cards you already have, or write your own

Quiz first
Quizfix writes questions from your material: multiple choice, true or false and fill in the blank. Answer a short quiz and see your score in a couple of minutes.

See what you missed, and why
Every wrong answer comes with the right one, a short explanation and the place in your own source it came from, so you can check it yourself.

Fix it with flashcards
Your misses become flashcards. Go through them in a fix round and mark what you got and what you are still learning. The ones you miss come back sooner.

A short session every day
Tell Quizfix your exam date. Each day it gives you one session with the cards that are due and a few questions on your weakest topics.

Know how ready you are
Your readiness number comes only from your own answers. See it by Set, by topic and day by day, so you know where to spend your time.

More ways to study the same material
- Notes: your material rewritten as short sections
- Podcast: your notes talked through, for when you cannot look at a screen
- Mock exam: timed, no hints, like the real thing

Good to know
- Questions, cards, notes and podcasts are generated by AI from the material you add. AI can make mistakes, so every answer links back to your source and you can flag anything that looks wrong.
- You can take your first test without an account. Create one to keep your Sets on every device.
- Sign in with Apple, Google, an email link or a password.
- Reminders are optional and always show the real number of cards due.
- You can export your data or delete your account at any time in Settings.

Questions or feedback: hello@quizfix.guru
Privacy: https://quizfix.guru/privacy
Terms: https://quizfix.guru/terms

name: Quran Knowledge Puzzles
description:
Quran Knowledge Puzzles bring free puzzles for students/seekers of knowledge wanting to test their knowledge of the Quran. Puzzles include : missing word from ayahs, crosswords, and knowledge quiz based on ayahs from the Quran. New puzzles in the daily puzzles section. Users have option to register an account to keep track of progress.

MISSING WORD
• A random ayah with one word hidden. Choose from four options — the wrong ones are real words found beside the same words elsewhere in the Quran.
• Or switch to Recalling: think of the word, reveal it and mark yourself.
• Show the ayah before for extra help, and go back to ayat you have already seen


AYAH CROSSWORD
• An Arabic crossword where every clue is an ayah with one word left blank.
• Answers use mushaf (Uthmani) spelling without harakat.
• Type with your iPhone's own keyboard for a clean, uncluttered screen — or show the on-screen Arabic keyboard if you have not added an Arabic keyboard.
• Check your letters, or reveal a letter or a word.
• Your unfinished crossword is saved.

KNOWLEDGE QUIZ
• Multiple-choice questions in English and Arabic: prophets and stories, who said it, where is it, numbers, and names and places.
• After every answer the ayah it comes from is shown.

TODAY'S PUZZLE
• A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone: a small crossword one day, five Missing Word ayat the next.
• Keep your day streak going, and watch the month calendar fill with ticks.
• Finish every daily puzzle in a month to win that month's trophy, with the month printed on it.

CHOOSE WHAT TO REVISE
• Missing Word and the crossword work on the whole Quran, one juz or one surah.
• Pick the quiz topics you want.

MADE WITH CARE
• Every ayah is shown in Arabic from the verified Uthmani text (Noble Qur'an Encyclopedia, quranenc.com), in a mushaf-style font. Every quiz question is checked against the ayah it cites.
• English and Arabic interface, light and dark mode.
• Works offline. No tracking, and signing in is optional: sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your progress on all your devices.
• Share any ayah, question or crossword with friends and family — they can open it at www.quranpuzzles.com.

name: Raccoon Sneak: Home by Dawn
description:
Pip is a little raccoon with a big appetite, and every night he needs your plan to get home before sunrise.

Press on Pip and draw one line to the den door. Every square takes a minute, and every minute the people and pets around him take a step too. Slip past Dad's flashlight, wait for the cat to look away, duck into a cardboard box, and grab the snacks on the way if you dare. When the line is drawn, watch the night play out.

FIFTY NIGHTS, FIVE PLACES
• A family home, a late-night diner, a pet shop, an aquarium and a grand hotel
• Patrollers on their rounds, pets that turn on the spot, and a sleepy dog who can wake the whole house
• New tricks along the way, like a TV remote that keeps everyone busy and a lampshade disguise

PLAN, THEN WATCH
• One finger to draw, tap Pip to wait a minute, undo any step
• Every night has a solution, and the best routes earn a Golden Feast
• Grandma's Map shows the way when you are stuck
• Flashlight Cam shows what a guard sees when it gets close

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
• Most nights take a minute or two
• A Nightly Stash for coming back each day
• A Game Center leaderboard for your best haul
• Play in English, Español, Português, Français, 简体中文, 繁體中文 or العربية

Raccoon Sneak is made for iPhone and needs iOS 17 or later.

name: RadioFluent - Ham & RF
description:
RadioFluent helps you pass the US amateur radio license exams: Technician, General and Extra. Every question comes from the current official NCVEC question pools, diagrams included. After the exam, the Shack tab keeps going with the tools you use on the air.

PRACTICE EXAMS
Take full practice exams built the way the real ones are: one question from every group in the pool. See your score, every question you missed, and how you did in each topic. Leave mid-exam and pick up right where you stopped.

STUDY BY TOPIC
Work through the pool one subelement at a time. Mark each answer Sure or Unsure, so a lucky guess doesn't count as knowing it.

SMART REVIEW
Spaced repetition brings each question back right before you would forget it. Due reviews and new questions are kept apart, so you always know which is which.

RECALL CRAM
Flashcard-style recall for the final push: see the question, think of the answer, then reveal it. No choices to lean on.

THE SHACK
• Band privileges: enter a frequency and see what your license class may transmit there, checked against the FCC Part 97 rules
• 8 RF calculators: antenna lengths and J-pole, SWR and return loss, decibels, Ohm's law, coax loss, ERP and EIRP, RF exposure, 60 m power
• Drills for the on-air language: phonetic alphabet, Q-codes, prosigns and RST reports
• Setup guides for MeshCore and Meshtastic mesh radios

FAMILY AND EMERGENCY RADIO
GMRS family radio setup, NOAA weather radio, and an emergency communications card for your household.

MADE FOR REAL STUDY SESSIONS
• Home Screen widget with your study streak, exam readiness and a question of the day
• Progress syncs between your iPhones through your own iCloud
• Optional reminder when reviews are due
• Works fully offline

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your progress stays on your devices and in your own iCloud.

description:

Rage Bait turns what's said into text on the phone, picks out the claims that can be checked (numbers, dates, records, "everybody knows" facts) and checks each one against sources. Seconds later the phrase on screen is marked Checks out, Sus or Lies. Tap it to see why, and the sources behind the verdict.

WHAT IT DOES

WHAT STAYS

AUTOMATED, WITH SOURCES
Checks are made by software. No person listens to or reads your conversation. A verdict is about a claim, not a person: someone can be wrong without lying. Automated checks can be wrong too, so every verdict shows the sources it used.

MINUTES

name: Rare Feather – Daily Quiz
description:

“Name a river in the United Kingdom.” Thames? Correct, but almost everyone says that. Wharfe? Also correct – and much rarer. In Rare Feather you don’t win by knowing something fast. You win by finding the answer hardly anyone thinks of.

name: Red Light, Green Light: Hoot!
description:
THE OWL IS WATCHING! The classic family game of red light, green light, now with a smart camera referee.

For once, the phone gets everyone on their feet: it keeps watch while the whole family runs, freezes and laughs. One phone, as many players as the camera can see. Even one is enough: you against the owl.

Prop up your phone, step back and get moving. Hoot! turns your phone's camera into the referee of a playground favorite. No more "I didn't move!" arguments: the camera spots the movement and shows exactly who it was in a slow-motion replay.

HOW TO PLAY
GREEN LIGHT - the owl turns away and the music plays. Run!
RED LIGHT - the owl spins around and blows its whistle. Freeze!
Anyone caught moving goes back to the start, everyone else stays put. The first player to reach the owl and tap it wins.
A short animated tutorial explains the rules in under a minute.

A SMART CAMERA REFEREE
- Watches the whole group and checks for movement 30 times a second
- Catches even slow creeping, not just big jumps
- Ignores a lamp switching on, a passing cloud or a bumped phone
- Forgives breathing and wobbling on Easy, catches a twitching hand on Tricky
- Instant slow-motion replay with a spotlight on exactly who moved
- Runs entirely on the phone: no extra gadgets, no internet needed

A PARTY GAME FOR ALL AGES
- Birthday parties, sleepovers and playdates
- Family game night and holiday get-togethers
- Rainy days indoors or summer days in the backyard
- Classroom brain breaks and PE warm-ups
- Kids, tweens, teens and grown-ups who still love to play can all join in

THREE LEVELS FOR EVERY AGE
Easy for the youngest players, Normal for the whole family, Tricky for big kids and grown-ups who think they can't be caught.

PLUS: FREEZE DANCE
Dance while the music plays and freeze the moment it stops. The camera referee spots anyone still wiggling. Whoever moves is out, and the last dancer wins.

PLAYS IN 7 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Polish and Czech, each with its own local version of the game: Luz roja, luz verde / Ochs am Berg / 1, 2, 3, Soleil / Un, due, tre, stella / Baba Jaga patrzy / Cukr, káva, limonáda.

SAFE AND PRIVATE

TRY IT FREE, PAY ONCE

Tip: prop the phone up so it can't wobble, turn on the lights and start as far away as the room allows. Ready? Green light!

name: Reel: Lifelog Time-lapse
description:
Reel is a life-log camera: just film, and your day becomes a record.
Studying, commuting, heading out, working — press START and drop it in your
pocket or set it on a stand, and Reel films your day at a set interval. No
tapping while it records. Just one tap before you start and one when you're done.

■ Two capture modes
・Time-lapse: recorded as sequential photos at a set interval. Look back on the
  flow of a whole day in moments.
・Video: recorded with ambient sound, for the moments you'll want to revisit.

■ On-device AI prepares everything for you (all free, all on-device)
・Face blur: faces caught in frame are blurred automatically before saving.
・Transcription: your video's audio becomes text on the device (nothing is sent
  to the cloud).
・OCR / scene index / tags: automatically structured so it's easy to find later.
・GPS, capture time and interval are bundled into the record (location is optional).

■ Privacy-first by design
・What you capture is saved to Photos on your own iPhone (on this device by default).
・You choose whether anything leaves the device — saving to iCloud or a folder of
  your own is opt-in, and off unless you pick it.
・Nothing is ever sent to or stored on our servers (analysis finishes on-device).
・No account, no sign-in. No tracking.

■ Power-saving "screen-off recording"
To save battery on long sessions, Reel can keep recording with the screen off,
running in a low-power state. When it detects that things have gone still, it
pauses automatically to cut wasted power and needless footage.

■ Pricing
・Every feature is free (including face blur, transcription and scene index).
・The free plan lets you record once a day.
・A one-time purchase makes recording unlimited (it is not a subscription).

■ About iOS limits (stated honestly)
iOS does not let apps use the camera while the app is closed.
Reel is built to film while the app is open and in the foreground.
Fully hands-off, all-day recording isn't possible by design.

Keep every day of your life, with zero friction. Reel is the one app for that.

• 한글을 포함한 텍스트와 키보드 입력
• 클립보드와 파일 보내기·가져오기
• 원격 화면에 함께 그리는 캔버스

시작하기
1. 접속할 PC에 RemoteDuo 데스크톱 앱을 설치하고 필요한 권한을 허용합니다.
2. iPhone 또는 iPad에서 RemoteDuo 계정으로 로그인합니다.
3. PC의 기기 ID와 접속 코드를 입력해 연결합니다.

무료 계정은 두 장비 사이의 연결을 최대 2개 등록할 수 있습니다. 등록한 연결은 변경할 수 없으며, 이용 시간과 화질에는 제한이 없습니다. 기존 계정의 이용 권한은 로그인 후 적용됩니다. 이 앱에는 구매 기능이 없습니다.

화면과 입력은 장비 사이에서 직접 전달됩니다. 공유기·방화벽·통신사 환경에 따라 직접 연결이 제한될 수 있습니다. 원격 PC에는 RemoteDuo가 실행 중이어야 합니다.

name: RepDay for Trainers
description:
RepDay helps personal trainers keep track of sessions, packages and payments. No more juggling notebooks, spreadsheets and chat notes: manage your clients, sessions and packages in one place.

FREE FOR 14 DAYS
No account and no card needed. Install it and start right away.

SESSIONS AND CALENDAR
• Today's sessions on one screen; log a session with one tap
• Duet and group sessions: no session is taken from the package of someone who didn't show up
• Daily and monthly calendar, weekly session plan
• Shared calendar with the other trainers at your gym (join with a QR code)

CLIENTS AND PACKAGES
• Log a session and it comes off the package automatically
• Packages that are about to run out come to the top
• Client profile: age, height, weight, goal, notes
• Add from contacts; name and number fill in by themselves

MEASUREMENTS AND PROGRESS
• Weight, waist, body fat or any measurement you add
• Measurement history and chart
• A ready-made progress report you can send to your client

PAYMENTS AND EARNINGS
• Paid and pending payments
• Earnings for the last 12 months; tap a month to see who paid what

MESSAGES AND NOTIFICATIONS
• Ready session, package and birthday messages, one tap to WhatsApp
• Notification 15, 30, 60 or 120 minutes before a session
• Your day's plan every morning
• Home Screen widget: today's sessions and what's next

DATA AND PRIVACY
• Your clients' details are stored only on your phone
• App lock with PIN and Face ID
• Import clients from Excel, export to Excel; paste your session list from your notes
• Make your own backups and protect them with a password if you like
• No ads, no tracking

SUBSCRIPTION
After the 14-day free trial, you can get a monthly or yearly RepDay Premium subscription to keep using all features. Without a subscription you can still view and export your records.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.repdayapp.com/en/terms/
Privacy policy: https://www.repdayapp.com/en/privacy/

name: ReplyFlow-Keyboard & Voice
description:
Not sure how to reply to a message, or want to express the same thought in a different tone? ReplyFlow gives you more ways to put everyday thoughts into words.
FIND A REPLY  Paste a message, choose a relationship and an expression style, and get three suggested replies. Copy or save the one that fits.
REWRITE YOUR WORDS  Enter your own text and explore rewritten or playful variations, including different tones, character styles and emoticons.
HEAR YOUR TEXT  Turn text into speech and preview a voice. Full access unlocks more voice styles and lets you save speech as a WAV file.
KEEP EXPRESSIONS YOU LIKE  Save favorite phrases, search your expression history, or turn history off in preferences. You can also export your favorites.
Explore More Styles The basic version includes a selection of expression styles and voice previews. Unlock the full version for all 10 Scenario Profiles, three voice styles, voice export, and an ad-free experience.

name: RescueFit
description:
**GET FIT. EARN PAW POINTS. CHANGE A RESCUE DOG'S STORY.**

What if every workout brought you closer to your fitness goals while helping a virtual rescue dog find its forever home?

Welcome to RescueFit, where fitness meets a heartwarming rescue journey. Build healthier habits, stay motivated, and watch your rescue dog's story unfold as you complete workouts and earn rewards.

*YOUR WORKOUTS MAKE A DIFFERENCE*

Choose from 18 guided workouts featuring 31 exercises designed to help you build strength, improve endurance, and stay active.

Whether you're starting your fitness journey or looking for a fresh way to stay motivated, RescueFit makes every workout feel rewarding.

**MEET YOUR VIRTUAL RESCUE DOG**

Start by choosing a rescue dog to accompany you on your fitness journey.

As you complete workouts, your dog progresses through a heartwarming rescue story, growing closer to finding a loving forever home.

Celebrate special milestones and watch your rescue's journey unfold.

**EARN PAW POINTS & CARE FOR YOUR RESCUE**

Every completed workout earns Paw Points!

Use your rewards in the Care Shop to provide toys, treats, and other comforts for your virtual companion.

The more consistently you work out, the more opportunities you'll have to care for your rescue.

**TRACK YOUR FITNESS PROGRESS**

Stay motivated with features designed to make fitness rewarding:

- 18 guided workouts and 31 exercises
- Exercise demonstration videos
- Personalized workout suggestions
- Workout history and progress tracking
- Paw Points earned through exercise
- A virtual rescue journey with meaningful milestones
- A Care Shop with rewards for your companion
- A Rescue Album to celebrate your journey

**FITNESS WITH HEART**

RescueFit brings together two things worth celebrating: improving your own well-being and experiencing the joy of helping a rescue dog find happiness.

Every workout is another step forward, for you and your virtual companion.

**RESCUEFIT MEMBERSHIP**

RescueFit requires an active subscription to access its workouts and rescue journey features.

Choose from:

- Monthly Membership: $1.99/month
- Annual Membership: $14.99/year

Both plans offer a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription through your Apple Account settings.

RescueFit features fictional, virtual rescue dogs. No real animals are adopted, sponsored, or supported through the app, and no donations are made to animal rescue organizations.

Privacy Policy:
https://sites.google.com/view/stennedysolutions/rescuefit/rescuefit-privacy

Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: RestTrain Myself: Rest Timer
description:
Stop scrolling between sets.

RestTrain is a gym rest timer that locks your apps the moment your rest is over. No more "one more video" while your next set waits.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap START after your set. Your rest counts down (60 seconds to start, change it in 15-second steps or set any time you like).
• Rest over: your apps lock. Open any app and you hit the freeze screen instead.
• Freeze: everything stays locked for a few seconds (10 by default), long enough to put the phone down and pick up the weight.
• Or choose "Lock until next set": your apps stay locked until you tap START again.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
• Live countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• A clear alert when rest is over, even if you're in another app
• Classic or Ice look

BUILT FOR LIFTERS
• Weightlifting, powerlifting, bodybuilding, strength training, circuits, any workout with sets and rest
• Big, easy-to-read timer you can use with sweaty hands
• Works on iPhone, including the iPhone Duo (folded and open)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• App locking uses Apple's Screen Time: RestTrain never sees which apps you use or what you do in them
• Turn the lock off any time in Settings

RestTrain shows a small banner ad on the timer screen. A one-time Ad-Free purchase removes it for good. No subscription.

Questions or ideas? Settings > Send feedback. We read every message.

name: Retake: Contractor Exam Prep
description:
Use your results to focus your next study session for California contractor exams.

Retake helps you prepare for another attempt at Law & Business or B General Building. Confirm the sections you want to strengthen, then build a study schedule around the days you have available.

FIT STUDY AROUND YOUR WEEK
Choose a target date or leave it unbooked. Select your study days and 15-, 25-, or 40-minute sessions. Adjust the suggested 21-day template as your plans change.

PRACTICE WITH A CLEAR FOCUS
Answer one question at a time. Read the explanation and supporting source. Revisit missed questions and bookmarks. Short sessions use the available material and may finish before your selected session length.

SEE OBSERVED PROGRESS
Track first-attempt accuracy with its denominator, section coverage, and practice history. Reattempts preserve the original result. Each exam track keeps its own history.

KNOW WHAT IS INCLUDED
The library contains 36 original source-backed practice questions across both tracks. Qualified content review has not been performed. Full-length practice assessments and report scanning are unavailable. Manual entry records your own weaker-section selections.

Try the clearly labeled sample experience without an account. Personal practice requires Retake Pass. One pass covers both tracks for 90 days from purchase, with one payment and no automatic renewal. Checkout shows the localized price. Internet access is required to verify purchased access after relaunch.

Study records stay on your device. Settings lets you delete local study data. Apple and RevenueCat process purchase information as described in the privacy policy.

Retake is independent exam preparation and is not affiliated with CSLB or PSI. Practice results do not predict an exam score or guarantee passing. Your study plan does not book an exam or determine eligibility.

name: Retro Forecast
description:
Vintage TV weather, right on your Home Screen.

Retro Forecast turns the weather into widgets inspired by television forecasts of the 1970s and 80s.

• Pick an era — 1980s computer graphics or 1970s studio boards
• Pick a design — America, Europe, East Asia or Showa-era Japan
• Pick the picture — clean, normal or worn VHS with blur, colour fringing and noise

Widgets
• Small & Medium: now plus every 3 hours — conditions, temperature, chance of rain, and a station clock
• Large: a forecast map of your area with nearby towns and state lines, or a national map of Japan

Anywhere in the world: use your current location or search any city or town. Times are local.

Available in English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Korean, French, German and Spanish.

No ads, no tracking. Weather data by Apple Weather.

name: Revixar
description:
Revixar is the app your car club uses on meeting days. The organizers post; you see what matters right now.

• Announcements and change notices, with a notification the moment something changes
• Your own tour, group and departure time
• The programme, with addresses that open in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze
• Live convoy map: share your position with your group while you drive and follow the route
• SOS: one tap alerts the organizers, with your location
• Questions, polls, sign-up groups and group chats
• Photo wall for the meeting
• Roadbooks, info sheets and documents
• English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano

Joining is easy: open the invitation link from your club, scan the QR code on your welcome letter, or type your club's name. No password: you sign in with a one-time code sent by email.

Revixar is free for members.

name: Rhythm：健康データの書き出し
description:
Rhythm は、Apple の「ヘルスケア」に貯まった毎日の健康データを、読みやすいひとつのサマリにまとめて、あなた自身の iCloud Drive や Dropbox へ書き出すアプリです。
通信も、広告も、アカウント登録もありません。データの保存先は、あなたが選んだストレージだけです。

■ 自分の健康データを、自分の手元へ
・睡眠（合計・深い/レム/コア・就寝/起床）、安静時心拍、心拍変動（HRV）、歩数、距離、アクティブエネルギー、運動時間、体重、ワークアウト、服薬を日次でまとめます
・毎日ひとつの JSON（YYYY-MM-DD.json）として iCloud Drive › Rhythm に自動で書き出します
・「フォルダ」を選べば Dropbox など（Files アプリ対応の保存先）にも同時に書き出せます
・起動時・新しいデータの到着時・バックグラウンド更新・手動ボタンの4つのタイミングで自動化。24時間書き出しが途切れると通知でお知らせします

■ 通信しない。あなたのデータは、あなたのもの
・開発者のサーバーへは一切送信しません
・アカウント登録・ログイン・クラウドアカウントの作成は不要です
・広告なし、行動トラッキングなし
・書き出し先はあなたの iCloud／選んだフォルダだけ。行き先はいつもあなたが決めます

■ 書き出すだけでなく、アプリ内でも読める
・「記録」タブ：今日のサマリと、過去30日の日別リスト。タップすると睡眠ステージ・バイタル・活動・体重・ワークアウト・服薬まで読めます
・「トレンド」タブ：睡眠時間・歩数・安静時心拍の推移を、7日／14日／30日でグラフ表示。期間の平均もひと目で分かります

■ 「記録」タブに、なかまがいます
・毎日の書き出しが続くと、記録画面のなかまが少しずつ育ちます。名前は自由に付けられます
・その日の睡眠や歩数に、短い一言を返します。ノルマも、達成率の表示も、催促の通知もありません
・続けた日数や記録の節目で、バッジときせかえアイテムが増えます
・なかまの計算はすべて端末の中で完結し、通信はしません

■ 筋トレも、ここで記録
・「筋トレ」タブでワークアウトを記録。前回の重量×回数が並び、空欄のままチェックすると前回と同じ値で記録できます
・ウォームアップ／ドロップ／限界セット、自動のレストタイマー、ロック画面からのセット完了に対応
・自己ベストを更新するとお知らせします
・記録した筋トレは毎日の JSON にも入るので、書き出したデータにそのまま残ります

■ 書き出したデータは、自分のAIや Obsidian へ
・構造化された JSON なので、お使いのAIに読み込ませて健康の振り返りに使えます
・Obsidian の保管庫や自作スクリプトに取り込んで、自分だけの記録に育てられます
・データを外に出すか、どこに置くかは、いつもあなたの選択です

■ 服薬記録にも対応（iOS 26）
・「ヘルスケア」で服薬を記録している場合、許可した薬の服用記録も日次サマリに含められます
・許可は「読み取る薬を選択」から。プライバシーのため、対象の薬はあなたが個別に選びます

■ 料金について
書き出し・記録・トレンド・なかま・筋トレの記録まで、これまでの機能はすべて無料です。サブスクリプションはありません。
ルーティンを4つ以上保存したい方、種目ごとの推移グラフと自己ベストの分析を見たい方は、買い切りの「Rhythm Pro」（アプリ内課金）で追加できます。購入は Apple の仕組みで完結し、Rhythm がデータを送ることはありません。

※ 本アプリは健康管理を補助するツールであり、医療機器ではありません。診断・治療の判断には使用しないでください。

自分の健康データを、自分の手元に取り戻す。Rhythm で、静かに書き出しておきましょう。

name: Riff Bounce
description:
A glowing ball bounces out a famous melody, one note per bounce. Four names appear. Tap the right one, and the sooner you do, the more it is worth.

- 61 well-known tunes in 10 categories: Classical Hits, Piano Favourites, Opera & Ballet, Christmas, Nursery Rhymes, Celebrations, American Folk, World Folk, Marches & Anthems and Everyday Tunes
- Play one category, all of them mixed, or let the game pick
- The ball never stops: get one right and it hops straight onto the next tune
- A leaderboard for every category: enter three initials and see where you land
- No account, no ads, no in-app purchases

Every tune in the game is in the public domain.

name: RII Parts Profile
description:
RII Parts Profile is an iPhone companion app for the RII Inspector Touch industrial videoscope. It keeps photos and videos organized by part number.

Live capture requires a compatible Inspector Touch. An offline activation code is available from RII Support.

name: Ringlet: Ringtone Maker
description:
Ringlet turns any sound you love into a ringtone or a wake-up alarm, and presses it into a record that's all yours.

PICK ANY SOUND
• A song stored on your iPhone
• A file from Files: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, FLAC and more
• The sound from any video in your library
• Your own voice: record up to 30 seconds
• Five free starter tones to begin with, plus seasonal sound packs with Pro

FIND IT IN A SECOND
Search your songs and files as you type. "Spinning lately" keeps the sounds you used most recently close at hand, and you can tap any record to hear a 10-second preview before you choose.

CUT THE BEST PART
Ringlet suggests the intro, the chorus or the drop, so you start in the right place. Pick 10, 15, 20 or 30 seconds, nudge it a second at a time, and a smooth fade in and out is added for you. With Pro, set the fades yourself, speed it up or slow it down, change the pitch and boost quiet sounds.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose the vinyl, the label color, the grooves, a matte or gloss finish, and a sound-meter pattern. With Pro, add the holo finish, your own photo, your own words on the label and five typefaces. Try them all before you pay. Every ring sits on your shelf as its own record, and you can keep up to 5 for free.

SET IT FOR CALLS OR ALARMS
• Calls & texts: adds it to your iPhone sounds
• Just one person: their calls get this sound
• Wake-up alarm: Ringlet wakes you with it, even on silent. With Pro, it can start soft and rise.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your sounds never leave it, unless you turn on iCloud sync with Pro, and then they go only to your own iCloud.

RINGLET PRO
One purchase unlocks it all:
• Unlimited rings (a free shelf holds 5)
• Your look: the holo finish, your own photo, your own words and five typefaces
