• Fades and effects: fade in and out, speed, pitch and a loudness boost
• Make a beat: tap a rhythm right onto a record and turn it into a ringtone
• Sound layers: choose which parts of a song play
• Seasonal sound packs of ready-made tones
• Gentle wake-up alarms that start soft and rise
• iCloud sync between iPhone, iPad and Mac
Pay once, it's yours for good. No ads, no subscription.

Apple Music streams are protected by Apple and can't be used. Ringtones for calls are 30 seconds or less.

name: Risemark
description:
Risemark is a stair layout bench for the numbers you mark before you cut.

Type a total rise, a target riser, and a tread depth. Risemark rounds that rise to a whole number of risers, then gives the actual riser height, the tread count, the total going, and the straight stringer length. A flight has one fewer tread than risers.

Save the plan, keep the flight, and count balusters from the going, the baluster width, and the gap you type. Short notes explain how each figure is rounded.

Code approval, nosing, and winders stay outside this app. Follow the rule that applies where you build. Records stay on this phone. Lengths are in centimeters.

name: RiserBand
description: RiserBand is for the moment the tape is still on the upper floor. Write the floor-to-floor rise, the going, and which stair this is. The phone splits the rise into equal risers and the going into equal treads, starting near a 7 inch riser. Flick the board up to add a riser, or down to take one away. It shows each riser, each tread, and twice the riser plus the tread, and whether that sum sits from 24 to 25 inches. Keep the stringer on this iPhone. There is no account, no network, and no file. Inches are used everywhere. The record stays on the phone until you take that stringer off.

name: Ritim Hi-Fi Player
description:
Ritim is a hi-fi player for your own music files. Make your playlists in Ritim Hi-Fi Player on your Windows PC, free on the Microsoft Store, and they come to your iPhone over Wi-Fi with their covers, ready to play without an internet connection.

SYNC WITH YOUR PC
1. On the PC, give a list a name in Ritim and turn on "Sync with iPhone" in the list menu.
2. Open Ritim on your iPhone. On the same Wi-Fi network, your PC shows up by itself.
3. The first time, enter the 6-digit code shown on the PC. You only pair once.
4. Tap "Sync": the tracks download with their covers.

When you add or remove tracks on the PC, the iPhone sees the change and downloads only the new ones. A sync that was cut off picks up where it stopped. Files the iPhone can play, such as FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, AAC and MP3, are copied as they are; the PC converts Ogg Vorbis, Opus and WMA files to FLAC on the way.

MUSIC FROM OTHER APPS
Send audio files to Ritim from another app's Share menu, or add them from the Files app. They show up in the list "Added to this iPhone".

PLAYBACK
- FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, AAC/M4A and MP3
- The next track always waits ready, so an album plays on from track to track
- Each track asks iOS for its own sample rate, so a USB DAC can run at the file's rate
- The format and quality of every track at a glance, with a gold Hi-Res badge on high-resolution files
- Lock screen, Control Center and headphone controls, AirPlay and background playback
- Shuffle and repeat

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Syncing happens only on your home network, directly between your PC and your iPhone. Ritim does not connect to the internet, needs no account, shows no ads and collects no data.

The interface is in English and Turkish.

name: RKsell: Buy, Sell, Discover
description:
RKsell is the classifieds marketplace that brings buyers and sellers together across Kosovo, Albania, North Macedonia and Serbia. Cars, homes, phones, furniture, jobs or services: everything you are looking for, in one app and in your own language.

FREE TO LIST
• Create a listing in a few steps: category, photos, price and contact.
• Add up to 12 photos per listing.
• Set your price in euro, Albanian lek, Macedonian denar or Serbian dinar.
• Edit, unpublish or republish your listings at any time.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED, FAST
• Vehicles, rental vehicles, real estate, electronics, home & living, fashion, jobs, services, hobbies, mother & baby, pets and more.
• Filter by category, country, city and price; sort by newest or cheapest.
• "Near you" shows listings from the cities closest to you. Your location stays on your device.
• Save the listings you like to your favourites.

TALK SAFELY
• Message sellers inside the app, no need to share your number.
• If the seller allows it, call or reach them on WhatsApp or Viber with one tap.
• Report inappropriate listings and block users you don't want to hear from.

FOR BUSINESSES
• Create your store page with a business account: logo, cover photo and contact details.
• Verified businesses carry a badge.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE, IN YOUR POCKET
• Albanian, Serbian, Macedonian, English and Turkish.
• Translate a listing's title and description into your language with one tap.
• Instant notifications for new messages and listing updates.
• Dark mode.

Buy, sell and discover across the Balkans with RKsell.

Privacy policy: https://www.rksell.com/en/legal/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.rksell.com/en/legal/terms

name: Roadster Hover
description:
Hold to fire the cold-gas thrusters, release to drop. Fly a white roadster through cranes, drones and swinging robot arms, refuel from tanker trucks in mid-air, then touch down softly on the landing pad.

REAL THRUST
• Tap once to start the engine, tap again to launch.
• Hold longer and nozzle pressure builds up; a quick touch is just a puff. Let go and gravity takes over.
• Every level has a fixed length and a limited tank. Fly into the glowing zone under a tanker and tap FUEL to refuel in the air – miss it and you won't reach the pad.

30 FREE LEVELS IN 3 WORLDS
• Launch Yard – cranes, towers, traffic and floating beams.
• Factory – patrol drones and swinging robot arms.
• Orbital – fast, tight and packed with moving hazards.

STYLE POINTS
• Fly through rings to build combos: 3, 5, 7, 10 in a row for big bonuses.
• Kickflip 360° through rings for flip chains – but you can't thrust while spinning.
• Skim hazards for close calls, land soft, save gas, keep the engine cool.
• 3 stars and Gold / Platinum medals per level, fireworks when you land.

LEADERBOARDS
A Game Center leaderboard for every level, shared by players worldwide, plus a total ranking that grows with every level you land.

ALL 30 LEVELS FREE
Every level and every leaderboard is free for everyone. Land levels to unlock new paints and smoke colors. Left-handed controls available.

HOVER PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• No ads, ever.
• Every paint and smoke color right away, plus Pro-only Gold Edition, Liquid Chrome and Rainbow smoke.
• Race your ghost: replay your best flight on every level.
• Practice mode: start from any fuel station.
• Flight stats: see where you crash most.
Family Sharing supported. No subscription. No account needed.

name: Roam Xiangxi
description:
One map, one journey — Xiangxi in your pocket.

Roam Xiangxi is a cultural quiz-and-collect app about Xiangxi and the greater Wuling mountain region of western Hunan, China. Travel across 9 themed maps, answer questions, and collect 84 cultural cards as you explore the history, literature, folk customs, intangible heritage, food, and landscapes of the Miao and Tujia peoples.

Start in Fenghuang (Phoenix Ancient Town) on the Tuo River, trace the Qin-dynasty bamboo slips of Liye, stand among the sandstone peaks of Zhangjiajie and the natural arch of Tianmen Mountain, then continue through festival calendars, local cuisine, notable figures, living heritage crafts, and traditional architecture — 45 main stops plus workshops and story chapters. Clear one map's main route to unlock the next.

Every stop draws from a curated question pool spanning ten categories — literature, history, legends, crafts, folk customs, geography, people, food, architecture, and language — with explanations for every answer. Finish a stop flawlessly to earn a gold stamp, and collect all 84 cards to light up the ultimate card.

A new Daily Question keeps the journey going, with a limited card for a 7-day streak, and real-world festival dates — such as the Miao April 8th Festival and the Tujia Sheba Festival — light up seasonal stamps on the map.

Perfect preparation for a trip to Fenghuang and Zhangjiajie, and a friendly companion for family learning. Fully playable offline. No data collected.

Coming in a future update: on-site check-ins at real landmarks — Fenghuang's Hong Bridge, the Aizhai Bridge, the Liye Qin Slips Museum and more — unlocking location-exclusive cards.

name: Romeo & Giorgio: Leerspellen
description:
Speel en leer met Romeo en zijn hond Giorgio!

Romeo & Giorgio is gemaakt voor kinderen van 4 tot 6 jaar die nog niet kunnen lezen. Romeo legt alles uit met zijn eigen stem, dus je kind kan helemaal zelf spelen.

REKENEN
• Tellen tot 10, tot 100 en verder
• Eerste sommetjes: erbij, eraf, splitsen en delen
• Meer, minder en evenveel
• Klokkijken met hele uren
• Bouwen, vormen en patronen
• Spelen met geld: winkeltje, spaarpot en kraampje

TAAL
• Klanken en rijmen
• Het ABC, letters schrijven en de letters van je eigen naam
• Eerste woordjes zelf lezen
• Nieuwe woorden: familie, fruit, kleuren, voertuigen
• Je eerste Engelse woordjes

IK EN DE WERELD
• Hoe voel jij je?
• Tanden poetsen, aankleden, opruimen
• Veilig oversteken en "eerst vragen"
• Gezond eten en sporten
• Rondje wereld: landen op de wereldbol
• Auto's: garage, race en een auto bouwen

ZO LEERT JE KIND
• Elk spel past zich aan: gaat het goed, dan wordt het iets moeilijker
• Geen tijdsdruk en geen foutgeluiden: bij een fout krijgt je kind een hint
• Korte sessies, daarna gaan Romeo en Giorgio slapen
• Stickerboek en "Kijk wat ik kan!" met medailles
• Profielen per kind en een weekoverzicht voor ouders

VEILIG VOOR KINDEREN
• Geen reclame
• Geen account nodig, geen gegevens verzameld
• Werkt helemaal zonder internet
• Aankopen en links alleen achter een oudervraag

ROMEO & GIORGIO PLUS
Drie spellen zijn altijd gratis. Met Romeo & Giorgio Plus speel je alle spellen, en nieuwe spellen komen er gratis bij. Eén abonnement voor het hele gezin.

Het abonnement wordt afgeschreven via je Apple ID en verlengt automatisch, tenzij je minstens 24 uur voor het einde van de periode opzegt. Beheren en opzeggen kan in Instellingen › je naam › Abonnementen.
Voorwaarden: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://romeogiorgio.com/privacy/

name: Rosalein Team
description:
Rosalein Team is the app for the team members of Rosalein Cleaning Services, a family-owned house cleaning company in the San Francisco Bay Area. Sign in with the account our office created for you.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
See today's homes and the next ones: the time window, the address, who you're cleaning with, and the home details, like the gate, the key, pets and products.

AUTOMATIC ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE
With your permission, the app records the time you arrive at and leave each home on your schedule. It uses your phone's location only near those homes and only on the days you are scheduled. Outside those areas, nothing is recorded. You can read exactly what is recorded in More › Privacy and turn it off at any time in Settings.

TRIPS WITH GPS
When you leave for a cleaning, tap Start trip and the client sees you arriving on the map. Sharing stops when you arrive.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• The cleaning checklist for each home
• Your houses, times, ratings and complaints for each month
• Your payments
• Messages with the office and team notes
• Time-off requests

In English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Accounts are created by Rosalein Services for its team members; there is no sign-up in the app.

name: Rowmend — List Workbench
description:
Rowmend is your focused, high-precision workbench for cleaning, deduplicating, sorting, and transforming text lists. Whether you are standardizing inventory items, parsing CSV rows, or reformatting creative draft notes, Rowmend delivers swift, predictable results directly on your device.

KEY CAPABILITIES:
• Step-by-Step Transformations: Stack operations such as Remove Duplicates, Natural English Sort, Prefix/Suffix Wrapping, Trim Whitespace, and Case Normalization.
• Instant Visual Compare: Easily switch between your Original source and transformed Output to inspect exact line changes and count variations.
• Reusable Custom Recipes: Save your most frequent transformation sequences as custom workflows and apply them with one tap.
• Drag-and-Drop Sequencing: Easily adjust the processing sequence of pipeline steps in real time.
• Secure Local Architecture: All text processing executes entirely on your hardware. Your raw drafts and transformed output remain private on your device.
• Export & Sharing: Export clean lists as plain text or standard CSV files to your favorite document editors and spreadsheets.

Experience effortless text refinement with Rowmend.

name: Royal Poker Clash
seller_name: LOST IN MONTANA WOOD FLOORS LLC
description:
Thirteen cards. Three hands. One crown.

Take your seat in Royal Poker Clash: Crown of Cards, an offline poker strategy game where every card has a place—and every placement matters.

Build a three-card Crown Hand, a five-card Knight Hand, and a five-card Royal Hand from the same deal. Keep your strongest hand in the Royal lane, balance the other two, and reveal your cards to challenge your opponent. Win individual lanes to score points, or claim all three for a sweep bonus.

A TABLE BUILT FOR STRATEGY
Tap to select cards, place them into lanes, and swap cards as your plan takes shape. Undo a move, reset your arrangement, or use Auto Arrange for a helping hand. Authentic poker combinations and kicker comparisons decide each showdown.

CONQUER THE ROYAL CAMPAIGN
Play 30 levels against six royal rivals, from Jack of Embers to Shadow King. Compete across three rounds per battle, unlock new levels, earn stars, and replay past opponents to improve your results. Choose a quick match whenever you want another seat at the table.

LEARN THE CARDS
Explore the Card Academy with illustrated examples of poker hands. Test your knowledge in practice mode, identify combinations, earn practice XP, and learn how to avoid a foul in three-lane play.

RELIVE YOUR SHOWDOWNS
Battle Records preserve your scores and played cards. Review each round, compare lane results, and follow your wins, streaks, sweeps, and hand combinations.

BUILD YOUR ROYAL COLLECTION
Earn virtual crowns and XP through play. Claim daily rewards, work toward achievements, unlock card backs, and customize your table experience.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Enjoy offline single-player play, adjustable difficulty, optional sound and haptics, and progress saved on your device.

Royal Poker Clash is made for entertainment. There is no real-money gambling, betting, deposits, or withdrawals. Crowns and points are virtual, cannot be purchased, and cannot be redeemed for money or prizes.

Deal your cards. Shape your strategy. Claim the crown.

name: RozzleCue
description:
RozzleCue är ett snabbt pokerpussel där du vrider fyra kort runt runda noder.

Så spelar du
• Tryck på en nod för att vrida korten medurs
• Håll inne för att vrida moturs
• När fyra kort uppfyller regeln försvinner de

Tre spellägen
• Färgmatch – samma färg runt noden
• Perfekt set – samma färg och samma värde
• Måltal – samma färg och summan blir målvärdet

Varje parti har begränsade drag. Nå målet, spara ditt resultat och slå ditt rekord. Spela dagens utmaning eller välj läge när du vill.

Funktioner
• Kodgenererade pokerkort
• Ångra, nollställ och tips under spelet
• Rekordlista och enkel statistik
• Guide, inställningar och om-sida
• Mörkt spelkänsla utan köp i appen

Ingen Game Center. Ingen iCloud-synk. Ingen reklamköp. Bara rent pusselspel – när som helst, offline.

name: Run Anyway Couch to 5k
description:
RunAnyway gets you from the couch to a full 5K with a real plan, a coach in your ear, and a game that makes you want to keep the streak alive.

THE PLAN
A gentle run/walk ladder of 35 guided sessions takes you from 15 seconds of running to 30 minutes nonstop and a full 5K. Every workout adapts: finish easily and the plan moves up; struggle and it eases off. Start at any level.

A COACH IN YOUR EAR
Pick one of four recorded coaches — the Drill Instructor (loud, strict, secretly proud of you), the Cheerleader, the Comedian or the Zen Master. They count down every change 15 seconds ahead, keep you company on long intervals, and never say the same line twice in one run. Your own music keeps playing and simply ducks while they talk.

MADE FOR THE REAL WORLD
GPS tracks your outdoor runs and your pace; treadmills work too, with distance you enter at the end. Your workout shows live on your Apple Watch, and on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, so your phone can stay in your pocket.

A GAME THAT REWARDS SHOWING UP
Finish workouts to defeat eight bosses of excuses, unlock achievements, level up a runner you can dress, and complete daily quests. Weekly leaderboards with friends and the world show who showed up this week. Squads let you cheer each other on — no locations, no chat, just accountability.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your runs live on your device. Squads only ever see your name and finished workouts. No ads, no tracking, no subscription.

Try 3 full workouts free. Unlock everything forever with a single one-time purchase — all 35 sessions, all four coaches, all eight worlds.

Lace up. Your couch called. We told it you're busy.

name: Runehold: Idle Realm Builder
description:
Build a realm. Rise through the lands.

Runehold is a relaxing fantasy idle game. Grow mushroom groves, goblin mines, elven lumberyards and dragon roosts, send their goods to market, and watch your gold pile up, even while you're away.

BUILD AND HAUL
Every building makes goods. Tap to gather them, send the wagon round every stop on the road, and sell the load at the market. Level up your buildings to earn more and work faster.

HEROES RUN THE REALM
Each building has its own hero, from Pip the halfling forager to Ember the dragon tamer. Hire a hero and they carry every batch for you. Collect their cards and promote them through five ranks, from Recruit to Legend, and every rank doubles what their building earns, for good.

AUTOMATE EVERYTHING
Hire the Wagon Master and your goods are sold while you're away. Come back to a welcome-back haul of gold.

ASCEND TO NEW LANDS
When your realm becomes a legend, ascend to the next level and start again in a brand-new land, stronger than before. Twenty hand-painted lands await, from the Haunted Moors to the Sunken Reef, each with its own magical flyer to catch for a prize.

QUESTS, CHESTS AND RELICS
- Complete quests for renown, gems, gold and chests
- Open free chests through the day for hero cards and gems
- Spend gems in the Gem Market on time warps, income boosts and the hero cards you want
- Trade starshards for powerful relics that last through every ascension

PLAY YOUR WAY
- A short tutorial gets you started
- Plays great on iPhone, with a full-screen map and side panel on iPad
- Your realm syncs between your devices with Game Center
- Original music and hand-painted art

Runehold is free to play. Everything can be earned by playing. Optional in-app purchases speed things up, and reward videos only play when you choose to watch one. Chest contents and odds are shown in the game before you buy.

name: RyvSet: Gym Workout Tracker
description:
Your workout deserves more than a checklist.

RyvSet is an offline-first gym workout tracker built for people who take their training seriously. Log sets and reps, organize your routines, track personal records, and see how your performance improves over time.

Whether you're lifting weights, building muscle, training for strength, or simply staying consistent, RyvSet helps you stay focused on what matters: your progress.

TRACK EVERY SET AND REP

Make every training session count.

- Log weights, repetitions, and exercise performance.
- See your current set and workout progress.
- Track your sessions with a focused training interface.
- Manage rest between sets.
- Pick up where your training left off.

BEAT YOUR LAST SESSION

Progress starts with knowing where you've been.

- Compare your performance with previous sessions.
- Review your training history.
- See how your lifts change over time.
- Identify personal records and training milestones.

BUILD YOUR OWN ROUTINES

Your training should fit the way you work out.

- Create personalized workout routines.
- Choose exercises from the exercise library.
- Configure sets for each exercise.
- Organize your training around your goals.

SEE YOUR STRENGTH GROW

Go beyond simply recording numbers.

- Explore progress charts.
- Monitor personal records.
- Review training consistency.
- Look back at completed workouts in your training journal.

DOCUMENT YOUR BODY EVOLUTION

Your progress isn't always measured by the weight you lift.

Capture progress photos, revisit earlier milestones, and compare your physical changes over time through Body Evolution.

TRAIN OFFLINE

No internet connection at the gym? Keep training.

RyvSet is designed around an offline-first experience, so you can record workouts and review your locally stored training history without depending on a constant connection.

START FREE. GROW WITH RYVSET PRO.

Start with one active workout routine and up to three exercises in that routine. Log unlimited workout sessions and sets.

Ready for more flexibility?

Unlock RyvSet Pro with a one-time purchase for unlimited routines and exercises per routine.

No recurring Pro subscription.

EVERY REP COUNTS.

Build your routine. Track your work. See how far you've come.

Make your next workout count with RyvSet.

name: Sağlık Köprüsü
description:
Sağlık Köprüsü, Apple Sağlık verilerini yapay zekâ asistanlarının kolayca okuyabileceği Markdown (.md) dosyalarına dönüştürür.

Apple Sağlık ile yapay zekâ arasında doğrudan bir bağlantı yok. Her seferinde tüm geçmişi dışa aktarıp yeniden yüklemek yerine Sağlık Köprüsü ilk seferde tüm geçmişini, sonraki her çekimde yalnızca aradaki yeni günleri hazırlar. Her dosya bir öncekinin devamı olduğunu belirtir; yapay zekâ bağlamı kaybetmez.

NE AKTARIR
• Günlük adım, mesafe ve aktif enerji
• Nabız, dinlenik nabız ve HRV
• Uyku süresi ve evreleri
• Kilo ölçümleri
• Antrenmanlar

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR
• Artımlı çekim: ilk seferde tüm geçmiş, sonra sadece yeni günler
• Geç senkronize olan Apple Watch verileri otomatik olarak "güncellenen günler" olarak eklenir
• Tek dokunuşla Paylaş veya Kopyala: dosyayı istediğin yapay zekâ uygulamasına gönder ya da Dosyalar'a kaydet
• İlerleme göstergesi; çekim kesilirse kaldığı yerden devam eder
• Seçtiğin gün ve saatte hatırlatma bildirimi
• Türkçe ve İngilizce arayüz

GİZLİLİK
• Sağlık verilerin cihazında kalır; geliştiriciye veya herhangi bir sunucuya gönderilmez
• Reklam, analitik, hesap veya izleme yoktur
• Uygulama Apple Sağlık'a hiçbir veri yazmaz, yalnızca okur
• Paylaşımı yalnızca sen başlatırsın

Sağlık Köprüsü tıbbi tavsiye vermez ve tıbbi bir cihaz değildir.

name: Salah Teacher
description:
Salah Teacher helps you learn and say your prayers in a guided way. Lay the iPad on your prayer mat: each page shows the words to say in large, clear type with a picture of the position, and the words light up as you say them.

PRACTISE, THEN PRAY
• Practise: read each page at your own pace and tap Next. Salah Teacher learns how long you take on each page.
• Pray: the pages turn by themselves at your pace, so you never have to touch the screen. Need a moment? Tap the words to pause.

EVERY PRAYER, EVERY PART
• All five daily prayers with their Sunnah, Fard and Witr parts, in order
• Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki and Hanbali methods
• Roman English or Arabic as the large text, with the meaning underneath
• Large type made to be read while standing on the mat

BEAUTIFY YOUR PRAYER
• Take turns with the four Quls after Al-Fatiha
• Add the optional rak'ahs
• Recite Ayat al-Kursi after each Fard, at your own pace

TIMES & QIBLA
• Prayer times calculated on your iPad, with a choice of calculation methods
• The direction of the Kaaba on a globe, with a live compass

WUDU AND TRACKER
• A step-by-step guide to wudu
• Tick off your prayers and see your month at a glance. Fard prayed in Pray mode is logged for you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Everything stays on your iPad.

Made for children and adults learning to pray, and for anyone who wants a calm guide on the prayer mat.

name: Salony - Salon Booking
description:
Salony helps you find the right salon in Egypt and book your appointment without the phone calls and the waiting.

DISCOVER SALONS
- Browse salons for men, women and everyone, with ratings, photos, opening hours and prices in Egyptian pounds.
- Search by name or service, and filter by area, type and price.
- Open the Nearby map to see salons around you. Location is optional: you can always pick Cairo, Giza or Alexandria by hand.
- Save your favourite salons so they are one tap away.

SEE BEFORE YOU BOOK
- Each salon page shows its services, specialists, gallery, reviews and what to expect.
- Compare services and prices, and choose the specialist you like.

BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT
- Pick the services, the specialist, the day and a time that works for you.
- Follow your upcoming and past appointments in one place, with your check-in code ready when you arrive.
- Get notifications about your booking.

FOR SALON OWNERS
- Register your salon, add your services and your team, and set your working hours.
- Your salon is reviewed by our team before it appears publicly, so customers can trust what they see.

MADE FOR EGYPT
- Arabic first, with full English support and right-to-left layout.
- Light and dark mode.

You can browse as a guest. Sign in with Google or Apple when you are ready to book or save favourites.

Questions or feedback? Write to zynovatech.eg@gmail.com. Salony is made by Zynova Tech.

Download Salony and book your next visit in a few taps.

name: Salt & Sage staff
description:
Salt & Sage Staff is the staff rota, holiday, kitchen operations and business management app for the Salt & Sage team.

PLAN YOUR ROTA

View weekly rotas, scheduled shifts, open shifts and team cover in one place. Managers can plan rotas, review staffing by department and keep the team informed.

HOLIDAYS AND AVAILABILITY

Staff can request holiday through a simple personal PIN portal. Managers can review requests, approve or reject leave, and keep holiday balances, sickness and unavailable dates up to date. The shared holiday calendar helps prevent staff being scheduled while away.

STAFF COMMUNICATION

Send updates to individual team members or the whole team. Staff can view important messages, rota updates and holiday-request outcomes in the app. Optional notifications can alert staff when relevant updates are available.

KITCHEN OPERATIONS AND FOOD SAFETY

Use Salt & Sage Staff to complete daily kitchen and operational checks. Record fridge, freezer and hot-holding temperatures, cooking, cooling and reheating records, deliveries, wastage, opening checks, closing checks and other due-diligence records.

SALES, STOCK AND INGREDIENTS

Upload and review sales information, track ingredient usage, create order sheets, review stock takes and monitor wastage. These tools help the team make more informed purchasing and kitchen-planning decisions.

BUSINESS MANAGEMENT

Management users can review daily takings, cash-ups, supplier invoices, bank transactions, labour figures and profit-and-loss information. The app brings operational and financial records together for easier review.

SECURE TEAM ACCESS

Management areas are protected by secure sign-in and session controls. Staff portals use individual PIN access, helping ensure holiday requests, kitchen checks and operational records are linked to the relevant team member.

Salt & Sage Staff is designed for Salt & Sage employees and management. It helps the team spend less time managing rotas, leave requests and paper records, and more time delivering great hospitality.

name: Santa's Helper: Gift Finder
description:
Stuck on what to get someone this Christmas? Tell Santa's Helper a little about them, then swipe through gift ideas with real product photos. Save the ones they'd love, pass on the rest, and keep a list for everyone you're buying for.

HOW IT WORKS
• Describe the person in your own words: what they're into, what they already have, and your budget. Or answer a few quick questions instead.
• Swipe through ideas one card at a time. Every card shows a real product photo and explains why it fits.
• Tap for a closer look, save it to that person's list, or pass and see the next one.
• Ask for "Cheaper" or "Treat them" to steer the ideas, or start again for someone else.
• Share a list when you want a second opinion.
• Follow a link to look at an idea at a retailer, where you can check the price, stock and delivery for yourself.

FOR EVERYONE ON YOUR LIST
Mum, Dad, a partner, a teenager, grandparents, a colleague or your Secret Santa. Set any budget, and tell us what they'd rather not get.

NO ACCOUNT. YOUR LISTS STAY WITH YOU.
There's nothing to sign up for. The people and ideas you save are kept on your device.

AI ONLY IF YOU SAY SO
Ideas come from our own reviewed gift library first. The first time fresh AI ideas would help, Santa's Helper tells you what would be sent to its AI provider and asks once. It only uses AI if you agree, and you can change your answer in About.

HOW WE MAKE MONEY
Santa's Helper costs nothing to use. Shop links are affiliate links and are labelled "Ad": if you buy something after following one, we may earn a commission from the retailer, at no extra cost to you. Gift ideas are ordered by how well they fit your details, not by what we earn. Commission can affect the order of some matched shop listings, but only listings that pass our matching and safety checks are shown. Any paid placement is labelled "Sponsored".

GOOD TO KNOW
• Santa's Helper is for adults (18+) shopping for other people.
• We haven't bought or tested the products. Please check the seller, safety, age guidance and total cost before you buy.
• We can't guarantee stock or prices, which are set by the retailers.
• Please leave names and sensitive details out of a gift request.
• You can report any idea from inside the app.

Santa's Helper is run by NOAH Neurotech Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales.
Questions or feedback: support@christmasidea.co.uk

name: Saw Set
description:
Saw Set keeps one hand saw on the phone. Six teeth bend left and right.

Neighbors must bend opposite ways. Each number is the set on the gauge, from 0 to 8. Two, three, or four can stay. Tap a tooth, then flip it, set it, or ease it. The sentence names the first tooth that matches its neighbor, then the first light tooth, then the first heavy tooth.

Rip already clears. Cross still matches at the first tooth. Dull is light on the first tooth. Heavy is still heavy on the second. Each saw stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Scrollah: Daily Bible Verses
description:
Scrollah turns the habit of scrolling into a few quiet minutes with God.

Swipe through a calm, full-screen feed of Bible verses, one beautiful card at a time. Every verse is chosen for real life: worry, weariness, grief, marriage, forgiveness, gratitude and hope. Tell Selah, your gentle sheep guide, what you are carrying, and your feed starts with verses for exactly that.

SCROLL SCRIPTURE, NOT STRESS
- A vertical verse feed that feels as easy as social media, without the noise
- Hundreds of hand-picked verses across nine themes, plus the complete Bible offline
- Like, save and share any verse as a beautiful image card

TAP ANY VERSE TO UNDERSTAND IT
- See the surrounding passage for context
- Read a short, plain-English explanation of what the verse meant then and what it can mean today
- Optional AI explanations for any verse, only after you agree

BUILD A DAILY HABIT WITH SELAH
- Set a daily goal of 5, 10 or 20 verses
- Keep a streak and celebrate milestones with Selah
- One gentle daily reminder at the time you choose

READ THE WHOLE BIBLE IN A YEAR
- The Year Quest: 365 days, about 11 minutes a day, with Selah walking the path beside you
- Choose a Balanced plan (Old Testament, New Testament and a Psalm or Proverb every day) or read cover to cover
- A short plain-English summary of every chapter before you read, plus one thought for today
- A calm reading view with adjustable text, a journey map, badges for each section of the Bible, and a quest streak
- Fall behind? Catch up at your own pace or shift your plan. Your progress is never lost
- Optional daily reading reminder and a Quest widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen

YOUR VERSE OF THE DAY, ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show a fresh verse every day

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account needed
- Your saved verses, streaks and answers stay on your device
- No ads and no tracking

SCROLLAH PLUS
Read free every day, or upgrade to Scrollah Plus for unlimited verses, every theme, the full Bible-in-a-Year Quest (the first 7 days are free), and AI explanations. Choose an annual plan with a free trial or a monthly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://scrollah.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://scrollah.app/privacy

name: See the Beat: Music Visualizer
description:
Turn your music into the trippy visuals of a 90s VHS tape. Pick a tape from the shelf, press play, and watch neon lasers, liquid color, starfields, rainy city nights and sunlit forests move to every beat.

PLAY A TAPE
• 9 curated tapes, from SPECTRUM '98's classic bouncing bars to RAINY NIGHT '91 and FOREST WALK '96.
• 41 visual styles drawn live in code: spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, plasma, kaleidoscopes, fractals, galaxies, ink and water, rain on a window, swaying leaves and more.
• The auto-VJ changes scenes on the beat, the drop and the next section of your song, with VHS-style tracking, rewind and fast-forward transitions.
• A real VCR on-screen display: PLAY, the tape counter and the scene title, like the tapes you used to rent.

IT LISTENS TO YOUR MUSIC
• Listen: play music out loud from any app or speaker nearby and See the Beat hears it through the microphone. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
• Other Apps (iOS 27): visuals follow the sound your iPhone is playing, even with headphones on.
• My Music: play songs you import from Files.
• Beat tracking, tempo and key detection keep every flash and pulse on time.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Looks: VHS, CRT, Tape on TV, Kaleido, Quad Mirror, Echo and Glow.
• Color palettes, transition styles, beat haptics and a flashlight strobe.
• Mixtape: collect your favorite scenes into your own tape.
• TV mode: AirPlay or a cable puts the visuals on the big screen while your iPhone becomes the remote.

SOUND TOOLS (free)
• Sound Boost: with headphones on, quiet voices and faraway sounds get easier to hear.
• Live Captions: see speech as text, right on your device.
• Beat Finder: tempo (BPM) and key of whatever is playing.
• Sound Meter: decibel levels at a glance.

Comfort first: a photosensitivity guard limits harsh flashing, and Reduce Motion and Dim Flashing Lights are respected automatically.

SEE THE BEAT PRO
The free version includes 3 tapes with ads. Pro removes all ads and unlocks every tape, style and look plus your Mixtape: $3.99 per month, or $19.99 per year with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers (prices may vary by country). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kevinsmak.com/privacypolicy

name: SeedGrid: Garden Bed
description:
SeedGrid: Garden Bed is your offline-first interactive vegetable bed planner, square foot gardening grid calculator, and companion planting guide. Designed for backyard gardeners, raised-bed growers, greenhouse hobbyists, and balcony planters, SeedGrid turns seasonal crop layout into a clear, stress-free routine.

Interactively drag and drop vegetables, herbs, and flowers onto a scaled 2D soil grid, visualize mature canopy spreads, and verify companion plant compatibility without needing an active internet connection.


Key Features and Garden Planning Utility Tools

Interactive SpriteKit Soil & Crop Grid
- Touch-to-Plant Garden Canvas: Drag crops onto 1x1 ft (30x30 cm) square grid cells to optimize raised bed density.
- Canopy Spread & Shade Visualizer: Preview mature plant spacing circles and prevent tall crops from blocking sunlight.

Companion Planting & Spacing Engine
- Friend vs. Foe Matcher: Automatically highlight beneficial plant pairings (e.g., tomatoes + basil) and warn against antagonistic neighbors.
- Seed & Seedling Count Scaler: Calculate exact plant counts per square based on root depth and mature width.

Garden Vault & Seasonal Log
- Multi-Bed Layout Journal: Save custom planting maps for backyard plots, greenhouses, and container gardens offline.
- 100% Offline Field Access: Plan and adjust crop rotations directly in your garden or greenhouse with zero cellular signal.

Designed for:
- Raised-bed gardeners maximizing yields using Square Foot Gardening rules.
- Backyard growers avoiding soil depletion and pest-attracting crop neighbors.
- Beginner gardeners visualizing exact spacing before sowing seeds.

name: Seerah Stories for Kids
description:
The life of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), told in order in 62 short animated episodes for children aged about 6 to 12.
Every story comes from the Quran and authentic (sahih or hasan) hadith, and the Prophet and his companions are never shown.
Free, with no ads, no account and no data collected.

Seerah Stories for Kids is a calm, simple way for your child to learn the Seerah: where the Prophet was born, how he grew up known as al-Amin, the Trustworthy, how the Quran began in the Cave of Hira, and what happened next, all the way to the end of his life. Each episode is 2 to 4 minutes long, so it fits into a car ride, a break after school or a few minutes before bed.

WHAT YOUR CHILD GETS
• 62 animated episodes with English narration, in the order the events happened
• 9 chapters, from Arabia before Islam to the final years in Madinah
• One clear lesson at the end of every episode, such as honesty, kindness or patience
• A short quiz after each episode, with stars to earn
• Episodes marked complete, so your child can see the journey grow
• A printable certificate when the whole Seerah is finished

MADE CAREFULLY
• Every episode is built from the Quran and authentic hadith (sahih or hasan)
• The Prophet Muhammad, his family and his companions are never drawn or voiced; the story is told through places, objects and narration
• Gentle, child-friendly animation in the style of Islamic stories for kids, without the noise of many cartoons

MADE FOR PARENTS TOO
• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No account and no sign-up
• No data collected: progress, stars and downloads stay on your device
• Download episodes and watch offline, for travel or limited data
• A parents' section explains how the stories were sourced

WHO IT IS FOR
The episodes are written for children aged about 6 to 12. Younger children can watch with a parent, and many adults who want a short, clear Seerah enjoy them too. They work well at home, in weekend Islamic school and in family time together.

ABOUT MUROUJ ACADEMY
The app is made with Murouj Academy (muroujacademy.com), which teaches online, one-to-one Quran, Arabic and Islamic studies classes for children from age 4, and for teens and adults. If your child enjoys these stories and you would like a teacher to take their learning further, you will find details in the parents' section. The app works fully without it.

Questions or a correction? Contact us through the support link on this page. We read every message and fix mistakes in the stories as soon as they are confirmed.

name: Self Mirror: Daily Stories
description:
Three short stories a day. Pick what you'd do. At the end of the day, see what your choices say about you.

Self Mirror turns everyday situations — friends, family, work, love — into quick interactive stories. There are no right or wrong answers. Over time, your choices build a private profile of how you tend to act and what you value, always backed by the choices you actually made.

• 3 short stories every day, about 5 minutes
• Day-end results with the exact choices behind every insight
• Your trends across big-five style traits and five core values — compared only with yourself
• Detective cases that show how you investigate
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your phone.

Self Mirror is for reflection and entertainment. It is not a diagnosis or a clinical assessment.

Days 1–7 are free. Self Mirror Plus (auto-renewing, with a free trial on the yearly plan) unlocks new stories every day, your full profile, weekly letters, career directions to explore and every detective case.

name: Send equipment
description:
Plug Master — Connect & Match

Match plugs to the right sockets in a hands-on lab. Study pin shapes, rotate to the correct angle, and lock connectors into place before time or mistakes run out.

Features

100 lab trials across 10 chapters, from basic ports to complex multi-pin gear
Drag-and-drop 3D plugs with rotation and locking challenges
Distractor plugs and adapter puzzles that test real matching logic
Daily lab challenge plus a connector catalog to study families and pin layouts
Clean English UI with sound, haptics, and progress tracking
Observe carefully. Align precisely. Master every connection.

name: Sentinelle Parking , compass
description:
Find your car with Sentinelle Parking.

Save your spot when you park, add a photo and record the level, space number or a landmark. On your return, check the approximate distance and a compass pointing towards your saved position.

• Car location stored on your device
• Manual point correction on the map
• Photos, level, space and notes
• Parking search using OpenStreetMap data
• Paid-time timer and local history
• English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Danish and Dutch
• Data export and deletion in settings

GPS can be inaccurate, particularly in covered and underground parking. The app does not provide indoor navigation or guarantee available spaces. Online maps, address searches and routes are optional and require Internet. Timer warnings require the app to remain open.

Automatically renewing monthly subscription. Eligible customers receive a 7-day free trial, followed by billing at the price shown by Apple. Manage and cancel in your Apple account.

Terms of use and subscription: https://sentinelle-parking-informations.vercel.app/en/terms
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sezam: Vault Heist
description:
Behind every door there is a lock. The alarm is already counting down. Open the lock, step through, and the next one is waiting.

Sezam is a free, endless heist game where every lock plays differently:

• Pin tumbler: lift each pin until it clicks at the shear line
• Bolts: tap when the pointer is in the bright zone
• Safe dial: turn it and feel the clicks get stronger near the number
• Circuit: rotate tiles to carry power to the lock
• Keypad: the worn keys give the code away, find the order
• Laser channel: guide the key without touching the walls
• Mercury lock: tilt your phone to roll the ball to the center

EVERY OPEN LOCK BUYS TIME
Solve a lock and the alarm gets extra seconds. Make a mistake and it loses them. Every fifth door is a safe with triple loot.

LOCKS THAT LEARN YOU
Sezam measures how you play each lock and tunes the difficulty to your skill from the very first heist. Get better and the locks get trickier. Five security levels unlock as you go deeper.

SHARE YOUR RECORD
Every heist ends with a card to share. Challenge friends to beat your streak.

HONESTLY FREE
No ads, no purchases, no sign-up. Works offline. 10 languages.

name: SGK Kết nối tri thức 2027
description:
Từ năm học 2026–2027, cả nước học chung bộ sách "Kết nối tri thức với cuộc sống". SGK Kết nối tri thức 2027 giúp học sinh, phụ huynh và giáo viên tiểu học mở đúng sách, đúng trang mỗi ngày.

HÔM NAY HỌC GÌ
• Nhập thời khoá biểu một lần (có sẵn lịch mẫu theo chương trình), app xếp sách của hôm nay theo từng tiết.
• Toán, Tiếng Việt, Tiếng Anh, Hoạt động trải nghiệm: gợi ý đúng bài của tuần, bấm là mở đúng trang.
• Các môn khác: mở tiếp chỗ đang đọc.
• Xem trước sách của ngày học tiếp theo, cuốn nào khác hôm nay được đánh dấu.

ĐỌC NHƯ SÁCH THẬT
• Lật trang có hiệu ứng giấy, vuốt hoặc bấm nút; xem 1 hoặc 2 trang trên iPad.
• Phóng to đến 500%, chạm hai lần để phóng nhanh, bản đồ nhỏ cho biết đang xem phần nào của trang.
• Mục lục theo chủ đề, đến trang bất kỳ, toàn màn hình. App nhớ trang đang đọc của từng cuốn.

ĐỦ 66 CUỐN LỚP 1–5
• Mọi môn: Tiếng Việt, Toán, Tiếng Anh, Đạo đức, Tự nhiên và Xã hội, Khoa học, Lịch sử và Địa lí, Tin học, Công nghệ, Âm nhạc, Mĩ thuật, Giáo dục thể chất, Hoạt động trải nghiệm.
• Tìm theo tên bài, chủ đề; gõ "toán 5 trang 83" để mở thẳng trang.
• Tải sẵn sách để đọc khi không có mạng.

AN TOÀN CHO TRẺ
• Không tài khoản, không theo dõi. Học sinh chỉ thấy quảng cáo dành cho trẻ em, không có quảng cáo khi đang đọc sách. Giao diện sáng và tối.

GÓI BỎ QUẢNG CÁO (TUỲ CHỌN)
• Gói tháng và gói năm tự động gia hạn; gói vĩnh viễn trả một lần. Sách và mọi tính năng đọc vẫn miễn phí.
• Tiền được trừ vào tài khoản Apple khi xác nhận mua. Gói tự gia hạn trừ khi bạn tắt tự gia hạn ít nhất 24 giờ trước khi hết kỳ; quản lý hoặc huỷ trong phần cài đặt tài khoản App Store.
• Điều khoản sử dụng (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://sachgiaokhoa.nhatnguyenduc-dev.workers.dev/privacy

Nội dung sách: bộ sách "Kết nối tri thức với cuộc sống", Nhà xuất bản Giáo dục Việt Nam.

name: ShareMyDine
description:
Share My Dine connects food lovers with home cooks who host dinner events in their own kitchens across the UK.
 
FOR GUESTS
• Search dinners by location, host or cuisine
• View kitchens, hosts, menus and dishes, including nutrition details
• Send a booking request and track it from request to confirmation
• Add dinners to your calendar
• Save favourite kitchens to your wishlist
• Rate your host after the event
 
FOR HOSTS
• Build your recipes, menus and food items
• Create listings with your available dates and prices
• Accept or decline booking requests
• Plan each event with menu, shopping list and cleanliness checklists
• Rate your guests and build your reputation
 
TRUST AND SAFETY
Every member's identity is verified, and host kitchens are inspected before they can take bookings, so you can dine with confidence.
 
Join Share My Dine and bring people together around great home-cooked food.

name: Shinkoiwa Sardistic
description:
The night shift will not end.

Step into an original neon-noir action and surveillance game by Nick, Baris & Max. Play as Kei, Max or Leon, survive the first five-room night, and investigate the resonance loop with the fictional researcher Dr. Vale.

MOVE, AIM, SURVIVE
Responsive movement, aimed pistol combat, limited ammunition, timed melee attacks and character abilities reward careful positioning. Leon trades the dodge for a braced charge and shockwave.

BUILD A CLEAN STREAK
Avoid damage to earn disruption at seven kills, a supply refill at fifteen, and a Nightfall charge at twenty-five. Activate Nightfall to secure the current night.

ONE MORE NIGHT
Choose upgrades between rooms. Later nights remix room order, cover and enemy positions while the challenge grows. Continue with your character, upgrades and score.

RECOVER THE ARCHIVE
Earn research through play and open randomized character and relic rewards. View their odds in the research interface. There are no real-money purchases, subscriptions or advertisements.

WATCH THE CAMERAS
Visit the U-Cafe surveillance base and explore original interpretations of DK House, Shinkoiwa Station and Sophia University.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Voiced dialogue with captions, separate audio controls, Reduced Motion and optional damage numbers. iPhone and iPad use an analog joystick and action icons with optional haptics. Mac uses keyboard and mouse.

Single-player and offline. No account required. Unlocks, research and settings save on your device; ongoing night runs are session-only.

Contains fictional combat, weapons, horror themes and occasional startling effects.

name: Short Script
description:
Short Script is a local writing desk for short-drama script review. Compare sample structures, score manuscripts, map episode rhythm, and keep margin notes—without accounts or cloud sync.

Samples
Browse reference episodes with covers, loglines, beat ladders, and sample pages. Bookmark strong hooks and save notes for later.

Desk
Create and review manuscripts by lane: Inbox, In Review, Needs Polish, Approved. Score clarity, emotion, and cliffhanger strength, then refine cold opens, body scenes, and closing beats.

Rhythm
Build pace charts with timed beats—hook, rise, twist, payoff, button—and compare your draft against reference curves.

Marks
Pin notes, quotes, bookmarks, and issues. Filter quickly and keep review feedback attached to each cover.

More
Edit your writer profile, read the privacy policy, export or import a workspace JSON file, and manage local data. Everything stays on this device.

Built for short-drama writers and editors who want a focused, offline review workflow.

name: ShortformBeGone
description:
ShortformBeGone blocks short-form, infinite-scroll video on your iPhone or iPad: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and feeds like them. Messaging, long-form video and ordinary browsing keep working.

WORKS IN A MINUTE
The app adds two Safari extensions. Switch on the ShortformBeGone content blocker in Settings and Shorts and Reels stop loading in Safari straight away. Switch on ShortformBeGone Guard and allow it for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat, and you are also taken back to the home page when you reach a Short or Reel from inside a site you already have open. Long-form YouTube keeps working.

A LOCK FOR WHEN WILLPOWER RUNS OUT
A blocker you can switch off in a tap does not survive a weak moment. For people who have tried app timers and deleted-then-reinstalled their way through every softer option, the app includes a full guide to locking your device down: a content filter that cannot be switched off in Settings, the apps themselves blocked, and a removal password that you hand to someone else.

The lock needs a Mac and erases your device once. iOS only allows it on a supervised device, which means a one-time erase and restore using Apple Configurator (free). The app walks you through it, including what to back up first.

WHAT IT BLOCKS
• Whole sites that are only a short-form feed, such as tiktok.com
• Just the short-form sections of sites worth keeping: youtube.com/shorts, instagram.com/reel and /explore, facebook.com/reel and /watch, snapchat.com/spotlight
• The links and shelves that lead into them
• With the lock: the apps themselves, other browsers, and deleting the filter

WHAT IT LEAVES ALONE
• Long-form YouTube in Safari
• Instagram and Facebook messages and posts on the web
• Everything else

IN THE APP
• Status: which layers are running
• Rules: what is blocked, and a box to test any address
• Setup: the full guide, with a link to the profile for your Mac

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Safari applies the blocking rules itself; the app never sees what you browse. The Guard runs only on the four sites it covers, looks only at the page address, and keeps nothing. The content filter checks each address against a list on your device and keeps no history. No account, no analytics, no ads, no purchases. Nothing leaves your device.

Free, and staying free.

name: ShotSlate
description:
ShotSlate — Professional Film Shot Logging Made Simple

From the first slate to the final editorial handoff, ShotSlate helps filmmakers organize essential production information in one convenient app.

Designed for independent filmmakers, camera assistants, script supervisors, and production crews, ShotSlate simplifies shot logging, continuity documentation, and camera reporting.

**DIGITAL FILM SLATE**

Keep track of essential production details, including:
- Production and director
- Scene, setup, and take numbers
- Roll and media information
- Camera assignments
- Interior/exterior and day/night
- Sync/MOS status
- Lens, filters, and camera settings

**SHOT AND TAKE LOGGING**

Record individual takes, add production notes, identify preferred takes, and organize camera coverage by scene and setup.

**CONTINUITY PHOTOGRAPHY**

Use your iPhone camera to capture scene references, wardrobe details, props, and continuity photographs. Attach notes and organize references for easy access.

**CAMERA REPORTS**

Maintain camera and media information and generate professional PDF reports for production documentation.

**EDITORIAL HANDOFF**

Export shot logs in CSV format and generate PDF reports to share with your editing team. Keep essential scene, take, and camera information organized for post-production.

**BUILT-IN TUTORIAL**

Learn how to complete digital slate fields, document scenes, record takes, and prepare reports through ShotSlate's guided tutorial.

**SECURE BACKUP AND RESTORE**

Create password-encrypted backups of your production records and photographs. Verify backups and restore production information when needed.

**WORKS OFFLINE**

ShotSlate operates without requiring an internet connection, cloud account, or subscription.

Whether you're filming a short, feature, documentary, commercial, or independent production, ShotSlate helps keep your production records organized and ready for editorial.

ShotSlate — Log the take. Protect the continuity.

name: ShowForge: Podcast Planner
description: Always wanted to launch your own podcast but didn’t know where to start, or already hosting a show but tired of scattering notes, timecodes, guest lists, and gear checklists across different apps and chats? This app is designed to turn creative chaos into a clear, streamlined process. A step by step wizard helps you build an episode structure in just a few taps, an intuitive reference guide suggests the right equipment without confusing technical jargon, and a dedicated guest manager alongside a real time timecode marker let you stay fully focused on the conversation. Enjoy seamless access to your scripts anytime from your home studio to recording on the go. Pre production, recording, and post-production for your show are finally together in one sleek, reliable workspace.

name: ShuleSoft Teacher Assistant
description:
ShuleSoft Teacher Assistant puts your school day in your pocket. Take attendance, enter marks, follow your timetable and teach live online, all from your phone, in English or Kiswahili.

Built for teachers at schools that use ShuleSoft. Sign in once with the WhatsApp number your school has on record. No school code, no password to remember.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• See today's lessons, marking tasks and what is still pending the moment you open the app
• The next lesson is always at the top, with a one-tap way in
• Reminders to complete your lesson log

TIMETABLE AND LIVE CLASSES
• Your weekly timetable and the classes you teach in one place
• Teach online with ShuleSoft Live: tap Start Online Lesson and you are in the room as host, with no extra account and no login to type
• Parents and students are told when the lesson starts and join from their ShuleSoft app
• Works with Google Meet or other meeting links when your school prefers them

ATTENDANCE
• Mark a class present or absent in seconds
• Works even with a weak connection: it saves on your phone and syncs when you are back online

MARKS AND EXAMS
• See every exam waiting for your marks
• Enter marks in a simple spreadsheet-style grid, with each mark saved as you move on
• Results and averages for each class and subject

ASSIGNMENTS AND LESSON PLANNING
• Record assignments and scores
• Follow your scheme of work and log what you covered
• Look up any student's profile

YOUR WORK LIFE
• Apply for leave and track your requests
• Read school notices and holidays
• Check your payslips and your money in one place
• Build your Talent Profile, and apply to teach on ShuleSoft Academy with your Head Teacher's approval

SAFE AND SIMPLE
• Protect the app with a 4-digit PIN, Face ID or Touch ID
• Your data stays within your school's ShuleSoft account
• English and Kiswahili

Only teachers registered at their school in ShuleSoft can sign in. Not registered? Ask your school administrator to add your WhatsApp number.

Questions or feedback? Visit shulesoft.africa.

name: Shutdesk TV
description:
Shutdesk TV turns your Apple TV into a live photo wall for weddings, birthdays, parties and company events.

Create a room on the TV. Guests scan the QR code with their phone and upload photos straight from the browser – no app and no login. The photos appear on the big screen right away as a slideshow.

• Create a room, or join one with a four-character code
• The QR code and room code are shown on screen
• Press up on the remote to switch between everything visible, QR code only and clean full screen
• New photos are shown first, so everyone sees their photo right away
• Guests can see and delete their own photos from their phone
• Also show existing Mini Desk rooms from Shutdesk
• Choose the time per photo in Settings
• The screen does not go to sleep while a room is showing
• Previous rooms are ready on the start screen
• Photos are deleted automatically after 72 hours

One-time purchase. No subscription, no ads and no tracking.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Side Quest: Legends & History
description:
Every place has a story. Side Quest finds them for you and reads them aloud.

Open the app wherever you are and hear the history and legends of that exact place: the battle fought on the hill, the ship that never came home, the ghost that still walks the old fortress at night.

HISTORY AND LEGENDS, READ ALOUD
• History: real events, people and buildings from the town around you.
• Legends: local folklore, ghost stories, curses and strange tales, told like a story by the campfire.
• A natural voice reads every story aloud, even with the screen locked. Choose the voice and the speed.

WALK TO WHERE IT HAPPENED
• Every story shows how far away it is, with an arrow that points the way.
• See all stories on a map, and get a walking route to the exact spot.
• Open any place in Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze or Citymapper.

POINT YOUR CAMERA AT A LANDMARK
• Take a photo of a church, castle, statue or monument.
• Side Quest recognises it and tells you what it is, its history and a tip for your visit.
• Explanations in many languages.

MADE FOR CURIOUS TRAVELLERS
• Works in any town: pick a place in Settings to explore it from home.
• Save your favourite stories and listen again later.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

Stories are written with the help of AI from public sources and local folklore. Legends are folklore, not facts. Check anything important on site.

name: Siftlet
description:
From anywhere to your kitchen.

Siftlet turns the recipes you find into clean recipe cards you can cook from, and keeps track of your kitchen so you know what you can make and what to buy.

SAVE A RECIPE FROM ANYWHERE
• Paste a link from a recipe website, or share the page to Siftlet
• Scan a cookbook page or a handwritten card
• Import screenshots and photos, several pages at once
• Import a cooking video you saved: Siftlet reads what is on screen and what is said
• Paste the words of a recipe someone sent you
You check every recipe before it is saved. Siftlet never invents an amount: anything it could not read clearly is flagged for you.

COOK FROM IT
• One step at a time, in large type, with timers that count down on your Lock Screen
• Hands-free: say "next", "back", "repeat" or "start timer"
• Cook a Meal puts several recipes on one timeline, worked back from when you want to eat
• Scale servings with exact fractions

KNOW YOUR KITCHEN
• Keep a pantry by typing or dictating a list, or by photographing your fridge and shelves
• What Can I Cook? shows what you can make now and what is nearly there
• A shopping list of only what is missing, grouped by aisle, ready to hand to a grocery service

KNOW WHAT'S IN IT
• Calories, carbs, protein and fat as the recipe's source states them
• A clearly marked estimate when the source gives none
• Diet labels such as keto, low carb and vegetarian, each with the reason it is there

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your recipes, pantry and lists stay on your iPhone
• Reading photos and videos and Apple Intelligence all run on your iPhone
• One backup file holds everything, to keep or to move to a new iPhone

FREE TO START, ONE PRICE TO KEEP GOING
Your first 20 recipes are free, with every feature. Siftlet Full is a single purchase, once, for as many recipes as you like, and it covers your Family Sharing group. No subscription.

Some features use Apple Intelligence where your iPhone has it. Everything works without it.

Siftlet does not give nutrition, allergen or food-safety advice. Recipes belong to their authors; the original page stays linked on every recipe you import.

name: Sigilliketjut
description:
Yksinpelin strateginen korttiselailu, joka vie Egyptin mytologian kahdeksan jumalan maailmaan. Rakennat oman kortistosi, kutsut joukkosi kentalle ja ratkaiset ottelut omalla tavallasi. Tavoite on yksi: herättää auringon järjestys takaisin elämään.

TAISTELU
Kahdella puolella kenttää seisoo kaksi sankaria. Joka kierroksella nostat auringonvoimaa, valitset kortin käsiisi ja joko kutsut yksikön kentalle tai lamata loitsun vastustajan yksikköön. Yksiköt hyökkäävät, suojautuvat ja tukevat toisiaan. Ottelu päättyy, kun vastustajan sankarin voima loppuu.

SIGILLIKETJUT
Tämän pelin erikoisuus on sigilliketju. Kun kentällä on kolme saman jumalan yksikköä, ketju syttyy ja jumalan oma sääntö käynnistyy koko ottelun ajaksi. Ra vahvistaa omat yksikkönsä, Nuit kasvattaa käsikorttien määrää, Thot palauttaa hylätyn kortin pöytään, Anubis säilyttää rauhan silloinkin kun yksikkö kaatuu. Jokainen jumala muuttaa ottelun sääntöjä, ei vain korttien lukuja.

OMAT KORTISTOT
Rakenna kortistosi valmiista korteista tai aloita valmiilla esikokoonpanolla. Jokaisella kortilla on oma tehtävänsä: aurinkohaukka nostaa kortin, kivikirjoittaja paljastaa tulevan, hiekavartija kestää iskuja, kuun kukka avaa uusia mahdollisuuksia mutta vie yhden yön. Yhden tai kahden hallitsevan voiman kortisto on usein vahvempi kuin kaikkien kahdeksan sekoittelu.

KYKYTTARHAT
Voittetuista otteluista kertyy sigillipalasia, joilla nostat jumalien pysyviä kykyjä. Jokaisella jumalalla on kolme sääntölinjaa: voima, viisaus ja suojelus. Kyky muuttaa ottelun rakennetta, esimerkiksi Thotin viisaus laskee loitsujen hintaa ja Hathorin suojelus vahvistaa sankarin elinvoimaa. Sigillipalat kertyvät suoritetuista otteluista.

SOLIN 30 PIHAA
Eteneminen jakautuu kolmellekymmenelle pihalle. Jokainen piha on oma kenttä, jossa odottaa oma vartija, ja jokainen piha vaatii useamman ottelun. Ensimmäiset kymmenen pihaa ovat oppipoikien, seuraavat kymmenen pappien ja viimeiset kymmenen aurinkolähettien. Joka kymmenes piha on päällikön piha, jossa vastustajan voima nousee selvästi. Lukittu piha aukeaa vasta, kun edellinen piha on saatettu loppuun, ja eteneminen tallentuu laitteelle.

KOKOELMA JA PIHAVUORISTO
Kokoelmasta löytyy jokaisen jumalan kaikki kortit, ja pihavuaristo näyttää avatut sekä vielä avaamattomat osuudet. Jokainen jumala saa oman yksilöllisen tunnuksensa, kun kokoelma täyttyy.

VALMIS KOKONAISUUS
Kaikki sisältö, taideteokset, äänet ja värähtelyt ovat sovelluksen mukana. Peli toimii itsenäisesti ilman tunnistautumista, ja kaikki edistyminen tallentuu laitteelle.

name: SignUtils
description:
SignUtils takes the busywork out of preparing code signing assets for your Apple Developer Program team.

Instead of creating a certificate signing request, registering an App ID, ticking capabilities, picking device UDIDs, downloading a certificate, exporting a .p12 and generating a provisioning profile by hand, you answer a few questions and SignUtils does the rest through the App Store Connect API.

ONE GUIDED FLOW
• Choose Development or Ad Hoc signing and the certificate type
• Pick an existing App ID or register a new one, including wildcards
• Turn on the capabilities the app needs, such as App Groups, iCloud, Push Notifications, Associated Domains or Network Extensions
• Select registered devices or register new ones by UDID
• Create a new certificate or reuse one SignUtils made before

READY-TO-IMPORT ARCHIVES
Every bundle is a zip with the .p12, its password, the .mobileprovision, the certificate and a summary, ready for your signing tool of choice.

A LIBRARY YOU CAN TRUST
SignUtils keeps every bundle you generate, shows when it expires and notices when its certificate was revoked or its profile deleted. Share an archive again or copy its password anytime.

CLEAN UP JUST AS EASILY
Revoke certificates, delete provisioning profiles and App IDs, edit capabilities, and register, rename, enable or disable devices.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your API key and private keys stay in this device’s Keychain. SignUtils only talks to Apple’s App Store Connect API and has no accounts, analytics or servers of its own.

SignUtils requires an App Store Connect API key with the Admin or App Manager role. Explore the built-in demo to try every feature without one.

SignUtils is open source: github.com/itoolio/signutils

name: Single Instance
description:
Single Instance keeps each site you choose in a single tab. When a link to that site is opened from another app or another page, it opens in the tab you already have, and the extra tab is closed.

WHY YOU MIGHT WANT IT

• Discord: the web app asks you to log in again when a link opens in a second tab. With Single Instance the link opens in your existing Discord tab and you stay logged in.
• WhatsApp Web: only one session can be active at a time.
• Slack, Figma and other heavy web apps: no second copy eating memory.
• Music and video sites: no two tabs playing at once.

It works like a desktop app that only ever has one window.

YOU CHOOSE THE SITES, AND IT ONLY SEES THOSE

Installing shows no permission warning. The extension asks for access to a site only when you add it, and it can only see the address and title of tabs on the sites you added. It cannot see tabs on any other site, and it cannot read or change the content of any page. Your rules are stored on your device.

HOW TO USE IT

1. Open the site you want to keep in one tab.
2. Click the Single Instance button in the toolbar.
3. Turn on "Keep this site in one tab" and allow access to that site.

From then on, links to that site open in its existing tab. You can also add, disable and remove sites on the options page, using a site name such as discord.com or a match pattern such as https://*.example.com/*.

WHAT IT LEAVES ALONE

• Links you open from the site itself with Ctrl/Cmd+click or middle click.
• Login and other popup windows opened by a page.
• Navigation inside a tab that is already open.
• Private windows are kept separate from normal windows.

OPEN SOURCE

The source code is on GitHub: https://github.com/rxliuli/single-instance

name: SingSay: Kpop Lyrics Romanizer
description:
Sing foreign songs the way they sound.
SingSay turns song lyrics into their pronunciation, written in letters you can read. Korean lyrics (K-pop) become clear romanization, and Japanese lyrics (J-pop, anime songs) become romaji, so you can sing along line by line. It is not a translator: it shows the sound, not the meaning.

■ Great for
· K-pop fans who want to sing along but can't read Hangul yet
· J-pop and anime fans who get stuck on kanji and kana
· Karaoke nights with songs in a language you don't read

■ Features
· Korean → romanization that follows real Korean pronunciation rules (liaison, nasalization and more), not letter-by-letter spelling
· Japanese → romaji, with kanji readings looked up in dictionaries
· One-tap extraction: open a lyrics page in the built-in browser and tap a button
· Paste and convert: copy lyrics from anywhere and paste them in
· Original and pronunciation shown line by line
· Adjustable font size and dark mode
· Library: save lyrics into categories, stored only on your device
· App available in 14 languages

■ How it works
SingSay uses a rule-based engine built on dictionaries and pronunciation rules, so results are consistent every time.

■ Passes (no auto-renewal)
SingSay is free with ads and a daily conversion limit. For no ads and more conversions, buy a 1, 3, 6 or 12-month pass with a single payment. Passes never renew automatically. This is not a subscription, and you are never charged again unless you buy another pass. Sign in with Google or Apple (only needed for passes) to keep your remaining time after reinstalling or changing phones.

■ Privacy
Lyrics you convert are not stored on our servers. Your library stays on your device. Sign-in is optional.

name: Skewback
description:
Skewback lays out one masonry opening.

Set the span, the rise, and how deep each stone is. Drag the crown. The radius follows the span and the rise. The stones share the center angle, and the middle one is the keystone.

The two stones on the piers are the skewbacks. Under 28 degrees they are too flat to cut, and they turn red. A soffit under 1.5 inches is too narrow.

The openings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: SkiExis
description:
Trip booked? Start the countdown.

SkiExis turns the weeks before your ski trip into a program you can see, edit and tick off. Every session moves your cable car up the mountain. Reach the summit by trip day.

ONE SCREEN, ONE SNOWFLAKE
Today's session sits on a six-point snowflake: quads, hamstrings, hips, trunk, stretch and mobility. Tap a point, log your work, and watch that spoke turn to steel. Finish the day and the whole snowflake is steel.

BUILT FOR THE TRAINING FLOOR
Big buttons. One-tap logging. A hold timer you can read mid-hold, with side switching. A rest timer that starts itself. "Find a demo" opens a YouTube search for any exercise.

YOURS TO SHAPE
Set your trip date and pick 2, 3 or 4 sessions a week. SkiExis lays out a starting program up to the trip. Change sets, reps and holds, swap or add exercises, and add your own. Train on the days that suit you.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
A cable car tracks your sessions against the program total, so you can see how far up you are. The home screen widget shows days to your trip and your week. Reminders arrive on the days you choose.

MADE WITH CARE
Phases marked like pistes, green to black. A chalet for home. Snow on the peaks. Small alpine details in a clean, quick app made for one job.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
Your first 5 sessions are free. One payment unlocks every remaining session. No subscription. No account. Your data stays on your phone.

SkiExis is a tracker. It suggests no weights and gives no personal, medical or injury advice. Check with a doctor or physio before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have an injury or health condition.

Privacy: https://skiexis.app/privacy
Terms: https://skiexis.app/terms

name: Skive Run
description:
Skive Run keeps each strap on this iPhone. Four stations run from the neck to the tip. Pare the first station that is not thinner than the one before it. A tip at zero is cut through. Leave it once and the skive runs out. A tip thicker than three still needs the skive carried. When the stations fall through one, two, or three, the skive runs out.

Collar stays even at the tip, so pare that station. Belt is cut through. Leave the tip once and it runs out. Bridle still carries. Pare the tip once and it runs out. Wallet is thick at the toe. Pare that station twice and it runs out. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Skyborn: Odyssey
description:
A crash in space strands astronaut Adam on a planet no one has ever charted. His ship is wrecked, his radio is silent and Earth is a long way off. He has to survive, get to know the planet's people and find a way home.

Skyborn is a story-driven open-world adventure with a bold comic-book look.

EXPLORE
• From frozen peaks to blazing craters, every region plays by its own rules
• Take the wheel of your rover and drive toward the horizon
• Desert villages, an abandoned base and hidden corners

FIGHT
• Combos, parries, dodges and finishers
• Fight with whatever you can grab: take an enemy's weapon and turn it on them
• Boss battles against towering foes

MEET
• Lively villages, traders and side quests
• Everyone has a story, and some have a secret
• Voice acting in English, German and Turkish

YOUR WAY
• Touch controls: point-and-click or joystick, or play with a gamepad
• Upgrade your suit and capture the moment in photo mode
• English, German, Turkish, French, Spanish and Arabic
• No internet needed. No ads, no in-app purchases.

name: Slate Line
description:
Slate Line is a first look at the thirty Tibetan consonants, one traditional line at a time.

The slate starts dusty. Open a line and drag each cloth from the left across to the cup on the right. When the cloth arrives, that letter locks and shows its Wylie spelling, a short note about the breath, and the five readings with the vowel seats: a, i, u, e, and o. Keep the line only after every letter on it is clear. The slate then counts how many lines are clear, how many letters have been read, and how many of the thirty are still dusty.

Eight lines sit on the slate: Ka, Ca, Ta, Pa, Tsa, Zha, Ra, and Ha. Nothing is read aloud. There are no words, stacks, prefixes, or grammar. A line you keep stays on this phone.

name: SmartPallet
description:
SmartPallet turns an iPhone Pro into a measuring and load-planning tool for warehouses, distribution centres and anyone who ships cartons.

MEASURE A CARTON
Point the camera at a carton and tap its top. SmartPallet uses the LiDAR scanner to measure its length, width and height, photographs its faces, and reads the description, pack size and barcode printed on it.

SEE IT ON A PALLET
The app works out how to stack that carton: how many per layer, how many layers and how many in total. You see the finished pallet in 3D, built from photos of your own carton, and can turn it with a finger. Swipe between Australian, Euro and US pallets, or switch to a 20 ft, 40 ft or 40 ft high cube shipping container.

PLAN A CONTAINER LOAD
Combine several products in one container and set the carton quantity for each. The percentage full, cubic metres and floor length used update as you change the numbers, alongside a 3D view of the load. Save a load and come back to it later to try different quantities.

A SAFETY BUFFER YOU CONTROL
A margin is held back on every pallet and container, so a plan never calls for more cartons than will physically fit. You choose how big the margin is.

YOUR PRODUCT LIST
Every carton you measure is saved with its photo, dimensions and volume, along with pictures of its pallet and container loads. Share a product, or export the whole list.

MEASURE A LOADED PALLET
Tap the load and walk around it to get its overall length, width and height.

CONNECT YOUR OWN SYSTEM
Optionally send each saved product straight to your organisation's own system.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no advertising, no tracking. Everything you measure stays on your iPhone unless you choose to share it.

GOOD TO KNOW
SmartPallet needs an iPhone with a LiDAR scanner (iPhone 12 Pro or a later Pro or Pro Max model). Measurements are estimates. Check critical dimensions with a tape before you commit a shipment to them.

SUBSCRIPTION
SmartPallet is a subscription, priced per user, with monthly and yearly plans. Both start with a 7-day free trial that includes everything. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, and the subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.scipsolutions.com.au/smartpallet-privacy-support

name: Smashy: Locals & Brackets
description:
Smashy is one place for the competitive smash community: find locals near you, follow brackets, look up any player's results, watch clips, and find the guides that help new players get started.

EVENTS AND BRACKETS
• Find locals, regionals and majors near you, with dates, venues and who's going
• Follow brackets live, set by set
• Run your own bracket on Smashy: seeding, co-TOs, a waitlist, and results when it's over
• Get a reminder the day before an event you're going to

PLAYERS AND RESULTS
• Every player's tournament history and sets in one profile
• Link your start.gg account to claim your results
• Compare two players head to head
• Seasons, online ladders and pick'ems

CLIPS
• Reels: short clips from the community, from Twitch and YouTube
• Share your own clips and highlights

COMMUNITY
• Posts, replies, photos and polls
• Direct and group messages
• Scene pages for your region, with the rulesets your TOs use
• Find someone to play right now

NEW TO COMPETITIVE SMASH?
Start with the new player guides: what a local is, how brackets work, and where to learn your character.

NOTIFICATIONS
Replies, mentions, follows, messages, majors going live and event reminders. You choose which ones you get.

BUILT WITH YOUNGER PLAYERS IN MIND
Accounts are for ages 13 and up. Teen accounts are protected: they approve who follows them, their posts are hidden from people who aren't signed in, and teens and adults can't message each other. Every uploaded photo is checked automatically. You can report or block anyone, and delete your account in the app at any time.

FREE, NO ADS
Smashy is free. It shows no ads and doesn't sell your data.

Games: Melee, Ultimate and Project+, with results for 64, Brawl and Smash 4.
In English, Spanish, French and Japanese.

Smashy is a community project for players of the Super Smash Bros. series. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

name: SoirlWindMx
description:
Save the things you want from the stores you like, give them a little time, then decide with a clear head.

Add an item by pasting a product link, scanning its barcode or typing it in. Each one gets a cool-off: a day, a week, or until a shopping date like Black Friday. While it waits, you can log the prices you see or check its link again for the current price.
