When the wait is over, it shows up on Today, where you can keep it for your bag, wait longer or let it go. What you let go adds up as "kept in pocket".

Your bag groups items by store and compares the total with your monthly plan. Once you've ordered from the store, move items to Orders to keep tracking numbers, delivery dates and return deadlines in one place. For the things you own, log each use and watch the cost per use come down.

Prices from foreign stores can be converted with the latest ECB reference rates. Add your hourly pay and prices can also show as hours of work.

name: SoloKoala: AI Travel Companion
description:
Travelling alone is great until you're hungry, tired and scrolling through fifty reviews. SoloKoala gives you one good pick, right now, nearby.

TAP A MOOD, GET A PICK
Hungry, Tired, Social or Surprise me. Coco, your koala companion, suggests one place at a time with the walking time and when it closes. Swipe to skip or save, tap Go and start walking.

ASK COCO ANYTHING
"Somewhere quiet to read?" "Is the castle worth it today?" Coco already knows where you're staying, what you like, the weather and what's open, so you skip the explaining.

CHECK IN, COLLECT STAMPS
Explore the map, check in where you are and stamp the places you've been. Earn passport badges along the way.

A JOURNAL THAT WRITES ITSELF
Your day becomes a trail on the map and a postcard written by Coco. Look back on the whole trip, stop by stop.

PAY FOR THE TRIP, NOT THE YEAR
The map, check-ins, stamps and your journal are free. Unlock picks for every mood, Ask Coco and daily postcards with a one-off Trip Pass that covers your dates (nothing renews), or go Pro Yearly if you travel often.

- Weekend Pass (3 days), Week Pass (7), Fortnight Pass (14), Month Pass (30): one-off, no subscription
- Pro Yearly: everything all year, with a 7-day free trial

Pro Yearly renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your account settings.

Privacy: https://solokoala.com/privacy/ · Terms: https://solokoala.com/terms/

name: Soluciones Hogares y Negocios
description:
Soluciones para Hogares y Negocios reúne en una sola app las cuatro áreas del grupo. Cada una funciona por su cuenta y eliges la que necesites en cada momento.

SOLUCIONES PARA HOGARES
Cuéntanos lo que pasa en casa escribiendo, dictando o con una foto. La inteligencia artificial calcula el presupuesto al momento, con un precio máximo garantizado, y cuando lo confirmas buscamos un profesional verificado: fontanería, electricidad, cerrajería, limpieza, pintura, reformas, cuidado de mayores y de niños, mascotas y vehículos.

SOLUCIONES PARA NEGOCIOS
Un solo proveedor para tu empresa, tu comercio o tu actividad como autónomo: mantenimiento de locales y oficinas, limpieza, informática, web y marketing, gestoría, flota y reformas de locales. Presupuesto antes de empezar y una sola factura.

TIENDA DEL HOGAR
Muebles, iluminación, textil, cocina y menaje, baño, organización, jardín y bricolaje.

TIENDA DEL NEGOCIO
Herramientas, fijación, cerrajería, construcción, material eléctrico, seguridad y mobiliario de hostelería, oficina y comercio, con precios sin IVA y con IVA.

CÓMO FUNCIONAN LOS SERVICIOS
1. Pide presupuesto sin cuenta: escribe, dicta o haz una foto.
2. Recibe el precio al momento, con un máximo garantizado antes de confirmar. Pedirlo no cuesta nada.
3. Cuando confirmas, buscamos un profesional verificado en tu zona.
4. Sigue cada paso en «Mis servicios» y anula sin coste mientras no haya profesional asignado.

CÓMO FUNCIONAN LAS TIENDAS
Catálogo, buscador, fichas con fotos ampliables, favoritos y carrito con cupones. Ves el coste del envío antes de pagar y pagas en la página segura de la tienda: tarjeta, Apple Pay, Bizum o transferencia.

TU CUENTA
La cuenta de servicios vale en Hogares y en Negocios; cada tienda tiene la suya. Puedes eliminar cualquiera de ellas desde la propia app.

Soluciones para Hogares y Negocios S.L. · 858 21 52 80

name: Sori: Learn & Speak Korean
description:
Learn Korean by speaking it out loud, from your very first minute. Sori puts you in real moments in Seoul: a coffee at 지민's café, a subway exit, a taxi, chicken delivered to your door.
Hear each moment, say every line yourself, and see right away what came through.
Then step into a scene and keep the conversation going.

YOUR FIRST MINUTE
지민 says hello from behind the counter. Hold the button and say 안녕하세요 back, then order: 커피 주세요. Keep your two takes for Review.

HOW EVERY LESSON WORKS
Listen: two people talk at a counter, on a street or in a taxi. The first time you only hear it. Then the text appears, and any line plays again, slower if you like.
Say it: hold to speak each key phrase. Sori shows the syllables it heard, marks any that came out differently, and Compare plays her line, then yours.
Make it yours: answer an English prompt in Korean with one piece swapped, like asking for a latte instead. More than one answer can be right.
Your turn: a short exchange. Someone says a line, you answer out loud, and the conversation follows what you said.

12 UNITS, 46 LESSONS, 280 PHRASES
Hello. Nice to meet you. At the café. Numbers and won. The convenience store. Getting around. At a restaurant. Shopping. Time and plans. Making friends. Feeling unwell. On the phone.
Every phrase comes with its English meaning. Along the way: top up a transit card, meet a friend at exit 3, take a taxi to Myeongdong, ask for it less spicy, order chicken for delivery and have it left at the door.

TALK: CONVERSATION PRACTICE IN A SCENE
Step into a scene with a partner who answers out loud, in Korean, at your level. Four scenes open with units 1 to 4: hello in the lift with your neighbor 수진, meeting 지호 at a get-together, ordering at 지민's café, and the hotteok cart on a cold evening. Each has three goals to reach.
The partner's replies are written by an AI language model that stays inside the scene, so the conversation follows what you actually said. Beginner gives you two or three replies you could say after every line; Open leaves the words to you. Stuck? Hear their line again slowly with its meaning, or type what you want to say in English and Help me say it gives you the Korean. At the end: the lines you said well, the corrections, and phrases to keep for Review.

UNDERSTOOD, ALMOST, NOT QUITE
Almost marks the syllables that came out differently. Not quite lets you hear the line again, slowly, and try once more.

REVIEW IN ABOUT FIVE MINUTES
The phrases you learn come back when they are due, on a spaced repetition schedule, up to 20 cards at a time. Some you hear and choose what they mean; some you say from their meaning. Search your phrases any time, or practice recent ones when nothing is due.

READ ALONG, OR GO BY EAR
Korean is shown in Hangul with romanization above it, so you can read along from day one. Choose how much Korean text you see: Show text, After first listen, or Ear only. Every line is spoken by four Korean voices, at natural speed and slowed down.

WHEN YOU CAN'T SPEAK OUT LOUD
Switch to In my head: say each line silently, then check it. Your progress counts the same. Prefer not to hold the button? Turn on Tap to speak. A daily reminder is there if you want one.

ONLINE AND OFFLINE
All lesson audio is on your iPhone, so listening, slow replays, In my head and Review's listening cards work without a connection. Checking what you say out loud, and Talk, need the internet.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Sori listens only while you hold the button. Your takes stay on your iPhone and are deleted when the lesson ends. To check what you said, a take with speech in it is sent to Sori's server, turned into text, and not kept.

ALSO ON THE MAC
The same course on the Mac, made for the keyboard: hold the space bar to talk, in one big window. Each device keeps its own progress.

Your first coffee in Seoul is one minute away.

name: Sourdough Starter Tracker: Fed
description:
Feed your sourdough starter and Fed tells you when it will peak.

Fed is a sourdough starter tracker that does one thing well. Log a feeding, and it estimates when your starter will be at its strongest, so you know when to bake and when to feed again.

FEED
• Pick a ratio: 1:1:1, 1:2:2, 1:5:5, 1:10:10 or your own
• Enter the starter you are keeping, or the total you need for a recipe
• Fed works out the grams of starter, flour and water

WATCH IT RISE
• The jar on the home screen rises with your starter
• See the time to peak at a glance: rising, at peak, or hungry
• Get a notification when it reaches peak and when it needs feeding

IT LEARNS YOUR STARTER
• The estimate uses your ratio, flour and kitchen temperature
• Tap "It's at peak now" when you see the dome, and the next estimate adjusts
• Peak times are estimates, not promises. Every starter and kitchen is different

KEEP A LOG
• Every feeding with ratio, grams, temperature and notes
• Predicted and actual time to peak, side by side

FREE
The feeding log, ratio calculator, history and a daily reminder are free. No account, no sign-up.

FED PRO, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Peak prediction and alerts for every feeding (the first three are free)
• More than one starter
• A photo on each feeding
• CSV export of your history
You pay once. There is no subscription.

Your starters, feedings, notes and photos stay on your iPhone.

Privacy Policy: https://fed-sourdough.web.app/privacy

name: SpeakAny: AI Teleprompter
description:
SpeakAny is a next-generation AI teleprompter for recording videos that sound natural — in your language or any other.

FOLLOWS YOUR VOICE
The script scrolls exactly to the word you are saying. Pause and it waits. Go back a sentence and it scrolls back. No more chasing text or losing your place.

READ ANY LANGUAGE
Paste a script in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German and more. SpeakAny shows a phonetic reading line written for your native language, so you can speak foreign words confidently on camera.

RECORD IN ONE TAKE
• Front or back camera, 9:16 or 16:9
• Auto-cut: stumbles and retakes are trimmed for you
• Live subtitles you can turn on or off
• Floating teleprompter (Picture in Picture) while you use other apps

AI SCRIPT TOOLS
• Fix mistakes, split long sentences, rewrite to sound natural
• Scan a script from a photo
• Import scripts from PDF, Word or text files
• Ready-made templates for intros, product videos, short videos, speeches and more

REHEARSE AND IMPROVE
• Practice sentence by sentence and get a score for clarity, pace and emotion
• Hear each sentence in a natural, lifelike voice — works offline
• On-device voice analysis: intonation, emphasis and pauses — your recordings stay on your phone
• Guided practice tracks from basic to pro

MAKE IT YOURS
Fonts, colors, text size, scroll speed, mirror mode, countdown and more.

SpeakAny Pro unlocks all templates, unlimited AI edits and watermark-free export. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://speakany.stevenguyenbt.dev/terms
Privacy: https://speakany.stevenguyenbt.dev/privacy

name: Spendly Cycling Log
description:
Cycling Log is an offline-first cycling computer in your pocket.

Record

Adaptive 1 Hz GPS: 1 s at speed, 2 s cruising, 5 s only once a stop is already detected — a ride is never thinned while you move.
Automatic pause for stops of about 20 seconds or more, plus manual pause; average speed always uses moving time.
Precise Location required, and the app says so instead of silently saving an empty ride.
Understand

Monthly statistics with daily distance bars and an average-speed trend, and a year calendar of riding days.
Dashboard: this week vs last week (distance and average speed), a this-month vs last-month speed trend, and a recovery band with today’s suggestion.
Per-ride detail: 5 km splits, elevation profile, distance, moving vs elapsed time.
Maintain

Chain, rear tyre and brake pad wear counters that grow with every recorded ride.
Default intervals 3000 km / 200 h, 3500 km, 1500 km; orange at 80%, red at 100%. Imported GPX files do not wear the bike.
Share

GPX / ZIP / database export and import.
“Share for AI”: a readable ride, week or month summary plus a JSON block, ready to paste into a local model such as Pocket LLM or Pocket LLMG — no coordinates.
Stay private

No account, no analytics, no server. Rides live on your iPhone.
Live Activity and Dynamic Island are rendered locally by iOS.
Free: unlimited recording, Live Activity, AI advice, dashboard, wear counters and sharing, with 8 saved rides. CyclingLog Member (US$4.99, one-time) removes the limit. Requires iOS 27 or later.

name: Spendly Mileage Tracker
description:
Drive. The log writes itself.

Spendly Mileage notices when you drive, records the route and stops when you park. Five minutes later the trip is waiting for the four details a tax office asks for — destination, purpose, client and odometer readings — and the app proposes the readings from the last one it accepted.

Built for German freelancers, usable in the US and the UK • 0,30 €/km business trips and 0,38 €/km commute, counted once per workday • United States (70 ¢/mile) and United Kingdom (45 p/mile) presets, per-mile • Currency follows the region — €, $ or £ — and can be changed by hand • GoBD/Fahrtenbuch checklist that blocks an incomplete export and names the trip • DIN A4 PDF mileage log with a legal footer, plus CSV for your accountant • Rates editable per year, frozen into the database when first used

Made for the battery • Full accuracy only while the car moves • GPS stops at a red light and resumes when you pull away • Movement inside 500 m of home, office or your regular café is ignored

Proof that nothing was changed afterwards • Every edit appends a revision whose SHA‑256 includes the previous one • Settings → Data → Verify records recomputes the chain on the device • A filed report locks its trips; unlocking needs a written reason • The PDF prints a report id and a SHA‑256 of the database

While you drive • No account, no server, no analytics • One SQLite database on the phone, receipt photos beside it • Optional iCloud Drive snapshots (database + receipts + checksum), 14 kept • Export, import and delete backup files in Files → Spendly Mileage

A Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island shows the distance and the clock — status only, no buttons.

Receipts • Photograph parking, toll or fuel receipts • The amount and date are read on the device, then confirmed by you

Free: 20 automatic trips per month, unlimited manual trips, exports and backups. One purchase of 5,99 $ unlocks unlimited automatic detection — no subscription.

Spendly Mileage is a record-keeping aid, not tax advice.

name: Spring Charm
description: Spring Charm te ajută să pregătești darurile de 1 martie, inspirându-se din tradiția mărțișorului românesc. Notează persoanele, relațiile, schimburile din anul trecut și preferințele lor. Împarte bugetul după prioritate, urmărește cheltuielile și planifică timpul pentru mărțișoarele lucrate manual. Verifică necesarul de șnur, piese decorative și carduri, consultă pașii de cumpărare, lucru și dăruire, apoi păstrează un bilanț cu aprecieri și note pentru anul următor. Fără cont: planul este păstrat local pe dispozitiv, iar rezumatul poate fi copiat la cerere.

name: Squabble: Party Game
description:
Squabble is the party game for you, your friends and your phones.

Put the big screen on a TV or laptop, everyone joins on their own phone with a 4-letter code, and the fun begins. Questions appear on the big screen, answers stay secret on your phone, and then the votes, the bluffs and the forfeits come out.

15 GAMES IN ONE APP
• Who's Most Likely To: vote for the friend it fits best
• Would You Rather: side with the crowd
• Hot Takes: rate spicy opinions
• Never Have I Ever: confess... or lie

name: Squish Keeper: Squishy Tracker
description:
Keep track of every squishy you own, every one you want, and every trade you make. No account, no ads, and nothing leaves your device.

Squish Keeper is a photo shelf for a squishy and fidget collection. Snap a picture, tap a type, and it's on the shelf in seconds. It works with any brand, and with squishies that have no brand at all.

YOUR SHELF
• A photo grid of everything in the collection
• Search, sort and filter by brand, favorites or what's up for trade
• Doubles are grouped with a count, so spares are easy to spot
• Squish rating, where it came from, what it cost and notes, all optional
• Display mode shows just the squishies. Press, hold and drag to put them in your own order

TAGS AND PHOTO SUGGESTIONS
• Tag each squishy by color and look: pink, glitter, scented, squeaky and more, or make your own
• Search the shelf by tag to find all the pink ones in a second
• Take the photo and the app suggests tags for you. On iPhones and iPads with Apple Intelligence it can suggest a name and type too
• The photo is read on your device and never leaves it. Nothing is saved until you tap Save

SHARE THE WHOLE SHELF
• Send the shelf or wishlist as one tall picture, a Top 12 poster, or a simple list
• Made only from your own photos, in your own order

YOUR WISHLIST
• Keep a list of the ones still on the hunt
• Tap "Got it!" and a wish moves to the shelf
• Share the wishlist as a picture or a list before a birthday or the holidays

YOUR TRADES
• Log what was given and what was received on one screen
• Add who it was with, when, and how it felt afterward
• A one-line note says whether it was an even swap, based on counts and the squishies you've marked rare. No prices, no scores
• Changed your mind? Undo a trade and everything goes back

FINISH THE SET
• Browse a built-in list by brand and series and tap what you have
• See progress for every series, and which sets are close to done
• Add your own brands and lines in a few seconds

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Up to 10 shelves on one device, each with its own name, color and face
• No account, no sign-in, no chat, no feed, no strangers
• No ads and no tracking. The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected"
• Save a backup file, photos included, wherever you keep files
• Export the collection and the trade log as spreadsheets

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose a squishy color and the whole app follows
• Light and dark looks
• A share card for any single squishy
• Made for iPhone and iPad, including the iPhone Duo

FREE TO START
The first 12 squishies are free. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited squishies: no subscription, and Family Sharing covers the household.

Squish Keeper is an independent app made in Texas by 3351 Labs. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any toy maker.

name: Stalówka
description: Stalówka to salon piór stalowych w Twojej kieszeni. Przeglądaj kronikę czterech kolekcji — Klasycznej, Biurowej, Vintage i Artystycznej — poznaj historię każdego egzemplarza i dobierz stalówkę (EF, F, M, B) do swojego pisma. Zamówienia śledzisz od przyjęcia, przez wysyłkę, po dostarczenie.

name: Stamped: Parent-Approved Video
description:
Stamped puts you in charge of what your children watch and for how long.

You choose the channels and videos from YouTube that each child may watch. You set the screen-time rules. Your child sees only what you approved, on a simple home screen of pictures and titles, and when the time is up the screen locks.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a family account and a parent PIN.
2. Add a profile for each child (a first name or nickname and a colour is all it takes).
3. Approve YouTube channels and videos for each profile. Paste a link or an @handle, share a link to Stamped from another app, or start from the curated collections.
4. Set the rules: weekly schedules, a daily limit per profile, and a quick timer when you want a short, fixed session.
5. Hand over the device. Your child picks a profile and watches.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Approve what is watchable: whole channels, or single videos. Block a video you do not like with one tap.
- Schedules and daily limits: set the hours each profile may watch and a daily time limit, with different limits for school days and weekends.
- Quick timer: start a short session, for example 20 minutes before dinner.
- Extra time on request: your child can ask for more time, you get a notification on your phone and answer yes or no. You can also grant time yourself.
- Reports: see what each profile watched, when and for how long, and which blocked videos were attempted.
- Several devices: use Stamped on iPhone and iPad, on the web, and on a TV. Sign a TV in by scanning a QR code with your phone or by typing a short code.
- Remote control: lock a device from your phone, or set quiet hours per device.
- Co-parents: invite another adult to manage the family with you.
- Parent area locked by your PIN, with Face ID or Touch ID to open it faster on your own device.
- Sign in with email and password, with Apple or with Google.

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
- Stamped shows no ads of its own and has no advertising code.
- Children do not create accounts and are not asked for an email, photo or location. A profile is a first name or nickname, a colour and, if you like, a birth year.
- Videos play in YouTube's own embedded player, so YouTube's terms and privacy policy apply to what YouTube collects while a video plays.
- You can delete your account and all family data any time in Settings.
- Read the privacy policy at stampedkids.com/privacy.

GOOD TO KNOW
- You decide what is approved. Videos on an approved channel can include new uploads, so check the channels you add. Stamped does not review video content for you.
- Shorts and live streams are not shown. Videos that the owner does not allow to be embedded cannot be played in Stamped.
- Stamped is free. There is nothing to buy in the app.

Terms of use: https://stampedkids.com/terms

Stamped is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by YouTube or Google. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: Stampel: Digital Stamp Card
description:
Paper punch cards get lost, forgotten or stamped twice. With Stampel your customers get a digital stamp card in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet – no extra app, no sign-up.

How it works
Customers scan the QR code at your counter and save the card with one tap. On their next visit they show the card, you scan it with this app and the stamp is on. When the card is full, you see right away that a reward is waiting.

Made for
Cafés, bakeries, restaurants, takeaways, ice cream shops, bars, hairdressers, barbershops, beauty and nail studios – anyone who wants to reward regulars.

What’s included
• Your own design: name, colour, logo and stamp symbol
• Scanning at the counter, also on several devices
• Customer list with search, history and open rewards
• Offers for individual customers and messages to all card holders
• “We miss you”: an automatic reminder when someone hasn’t been in for a while
• Lock screen hint when customers are nearby
• Printable A6 counter display

Trial and subscription
The first 30 days are free, no payment details needed. After that you need a subscription (monthly or yearly) to keep stamping. Rewards your customers have already collected stay redeemable.

The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. You can manage and cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy: https://getterminly.de/datenschutz

name: Staradars 追星雷達
description:
追蹤你喜歡的藝人，來台演唱會、見面會一公布、售票一開賣，Staradars 就通知你。

・本命追蹤：選好你追的藝人，首頁只看你在意的消息

name: StarzGaming: Lobby Rankings
description:
StarzGaming turns your private lobby into a real league.

Play your matches, post the scoreboard, and StarzGaming keeps score: who's on top, who's climbing, and who needs to stop talking in the group chat.

POWER RANKINGS
• Rankings for every league, updated after every match
• A projected rank before you've played enough matches to be ranked
• An overall leaderboard across every game you play

STATS THAT SETTLE ARGUMENTS
• K/D, wins, losses and streaks for every player
• Full match history for your league
• Head-to-head series between teams

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Leagues are invite-only: only members see matches and rankings
• Create your own league and run it as admin
• Delete your account any time from the Me tab

StarzGaming is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any game publisher.

name: Stellata Puzzle
description:
Place one star in every row, every column and every coloured region, and never let two stars touch, not even at the corners.

Stellata is a calm logic puzzle under the night sky. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, found by reasoning alone, with no guessing. Tap once to mark a cell that can't hold a star with a dot, and double-tap to place a star. Drag across cells to mark several at once.

TONIGHT'S SKY
• A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone, released at midnight UTC.
• Your first try is the one that counts: be quick and avoid wrong stars for the best score.
• Keep your streak going and share your result without giving the answer away.

LEVELS AND PRACTICE
• Levels the same for every player, from a quick 5×5 to a tricky 10×10.
• Each level shows whether it's Easy, Medium or Hard, and harder levels are worth more.
• No clock on the levels: take your time.
• Stellina, your guide, celebrates every 50 levels and hands out bonus hints along the way.
• Five practice puzzles for each difficulty, with free hints.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• A short tutorial teaches the rules on a real board.
• Colour-blind patterns, light and dark themes, sound and haptics you can switch off.
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.
• Daily and weekly leaderboards with Game Center, for everyone or just your friends.
• Your progress syncs across your devices with iCloud.

No accounts, no ads and no tracking. Nothing is sent unless you choose: anonymous usage counts and crash reports are both off until you turn them on in Settings or agree when asked.

name: Stencilo: Tattoo Stencil Maker
description:
Turn any photo, sketch or artwork into a clean tattoo stencil in seconds. Print it at true size, try it on skin, trace it on a lightbox.
Stencilo is built for tattoo artists, apprentices and anyone planning a piece. Everything runs on your device: no account, no credits, no upload.

SIX STENCIL STYLES
• AI Lines: an on-device AI model draws clean contour lines
• Fine and Bold line weights
• Shade: lines plus a dot shading map
• Blackwork: solid black areas
• Outline: main contours only

EDIT IN ONE TAP
• Cut out: remove the background in one tap
• Mirror and Invert
• Four ink colors: violet like real thermal transfer, black, red, blue
• Before/after slider to compare
• A 2D pad sets detail and line weight with one finger, plus darkness and clean sliders

CROP, TURN AND RETOUCH
• Crop to the part you want, free or 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3
• Turn the picture a quarter turn at a time
• Retouch with your finger: erase stray marks or draw new lines, with undo and redo

TRY ON SKIN
Place the stencil on a photo of the arm, leg or back. Drag, pinch and rotate. Switch between a "stencil" look and a "healed ink" look, then share the picture with your client.

PRINT TRUE TO SIZE
• Set the width in cm or inches
• AirPrint at exact size
• Large stencils split over several pages with overlap marks
• Exact-size PDF
• Transparent PNG with the print size embedded, made for thermal stencil printer apps
• "Print in black" for thermal printers
• Save to Photos

TATTOO MODE
A full-brightness screen for tracing on paper. Show the stencil in black, the original photo, or both with the stencil laid over the photo. Lock it against stray touches.

LIBRARY AND SAMPLES
Your stencils are kept in a library on your device. Twelve public-domain sample pictures let you try it right away: marble statues, Hokusai's wave, a tiger, koi, a rose, a skull, a lion and more.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The AI and the background removal run on your iPhone or iPad. Your photos are never uploaded. No account. No credits. Works offline.

FREE TO TRY
Download for free and make 3 free exports. Stencilo Pro unlocks unlimited exports.

SUBSCRIPTION
Stencilo Pro is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription (yearly includes a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings.

name: Steplight: ADHD Task Starter
description:
You know what to do. Starting is the hard part.

Steplight is built for that moment. Add the thing you've been putting off and it breaks it into small steps, then shows you only the first one. Finish it and a lantern lights on a path through quiet places. Lanterns never go out.

ONE STEP, NOT THE WHOLE MOUNTAIN
• Add anything in a few words. Steplight breaks it into small, concrete steps.
• Only the next step is on screen. "Make it smaller" cuts it down again.
• Not sure where to begin? "Pick for me" chooses one that fits your energy today, and says why.

A PATH THAT LIGHTS UP
• Every step you finish lights a lantern. Light a whole place and the next one opens.
• Your companion carries the light, and finds small keepsakes along the way.
• No streaks to break. Take a day or a month away and every lantern is still lit.

START WITH SOMEONE
• "Start with me" walks you up to the starting line in about two minutes: one movement, one tap at a time.
• Stuck? It asks which kind of stuck, and answers that.

TIME YOU CAN SEE
• A focus timer drawn as a disk that shrinks, so you can see time without reading it.
• The countdown stays on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Park a stray thought in one tap and get back to the step.

MADE FOR HOW ADHD ACTUALLY FEELS
• Tell it how your energy is today and it sizes the day to match.
• Choose the voice: warm, playful, brief or firm. Ask it to go gently and it does.
• Routines for mornings, evenings and leaving the house. Ticks reset on their own; a missed day leaves no mark.
• An easier-reading font, read-aloud, calmer motion, and full Dynamic Type.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No analytics.
• What you write stays on your iPhone.
• On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, steps are written on the device itself.

STEPLIGHT PLUS (OPTIONAL)
The walk, the timer, your companion and every accessibility setting are free. Plus adds:
• Your own routines, beyond the three starters
• A reward menu you set for yourself
• Leave on time: counts back from when you need to arrive
• The 48-hour list: park a purchase until the urge has passed
• Pink and white noise alongside brown

Plus is a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial, and Steplight can remind you two days before it ends. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before renewal.

Steplight is a planning aid, not medical care. It does not diagnose or treat ADHD or any other condition.

Terms of Use: https://leantensify.github.io/steplight/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://leantensify.github.io/steplight/privacy.html

name: Sticky Cozy: Tidy Puzzle
description:
A messy desk, sticky notes in every color… and all the time in the world.

Sticky Cozy is a gentle tidying puzzle. Seen from above: a pale wooden desk, a felt desk pad, a cork board and an open notebook, all buried under sticky notes. Peel them off, slide them around, turn them and stick them back where they belong. No timer, no game over, nothing to lose: just the quiet joy of putting things in order.

EVERY LEVEL HAS ITS OWN LITTLE LOGIC
• Line notes up on the pencil marks or along the wooden ruler
• Sort a gradient from light to dark, or put a rainbow back together
• Stack from biggest to smallest, like nesting dolls
• Piece together a felt-tip doodle cut across 4, 6 or 9 notes
• Group by color or by symbol: stars, crosses, waves, hearts…

DESKS THAT PUSH BACK
• The coffee mug you really shouldn't knock
• Paper clips and a ruler pinning notes in place
• The desk fan that blows away any note whose glue is tired
• Wafer-thin notes that tear if you peel them too fast
• Botched notes to crumple up and toss in the bin

THE GLUE WEARS OUT
Every peel costs a note a quarter of its glue. At 50%, its corners start to curl. With none left, it slides off the desk when you tilt your phone, and a fresh one comes off the pad. So think before you peel.

PRECISION AND CARE
Your score blends precision (notes placed just right, nice and straight) and care (as few peels as possible), for 1 to 3 stars per level. Some levels hide two valid logics: find both to earn the bonus “Clever mind” star.

120 LEVELS, 6 CHAPTERS
The art of alignment, Color chart, The messy desk, Fragile & crumpled, Doodles & symbols, The big mix: twenty levels per chapter, one new idea at a time, gently introduced.

A LITTLE ASMR MOMENT
Paper rustles and crinkles in step with your finger, a soft kalimba chime greets every well-placed note, and fine haptics follow your every move (sounds and vibration can both be turned off).

Sticky Cozy is free with ads: a banner at the bottom of the screen and an ad every two completed levels, never while you are tidying. The one-time “No ads” purchase removes them all, forever.

No account, no sign-up: your progress stays on your phone, and the game works offline. In English and French.

Privacy: https://stickycozy.shadowlinkdigital.workers.dev/privacy

Terms: https://stickycozy.shadowlinkdigital.workers.dev/terms

Support: https://stickycozy.shadowlinkdigital.workers.dev/support

name: Storage Cleaner: Spatium
description:
Spatium is a space cleaner for your photos, videos and files. It finds what you don't need, and you clear it in minutes.

• PAY ONCE. No subscription. Free to try with two cleanups; one purchase unlocks everything, forever.
• NO ADS, NO TRACKING. No accounts, no servers and no network code at all. The App Store privacy label says it plainly: Data Not Collected.
• NOTHING LEAVES YOUR DEVICE. Every photo is analyzed on your iPhone or iPad. Spatium even works in Airplane Mode.

MORE THAN EXACT DUPLICATES
Spatium also finds photos that are merely similar: burst shots, ten takes of the same sunset, near-identical selfies. It picks the best shot in each group with Apple's on-device image analysis, favoring open eyes in photos of people. Keep the best one and clear the rest.

FIND WHAT YOU DON'T NEED
• Blurry photos and accidental pocket shots
• Receipts, documents and whiteboards you only needed once
• Old screenshots, sorted into codes, receipts, chats, memes and more, each kind expiring on its own schedule
• Screenshots showing card numbers, passwords or ID numbers
• Large videos, repeated takes and screen recordings
• Exact duplicates, even resized or re-saved from chat apps
• Photos and videos WhatsApp and other apps saved on their own

SMART CLEAN
One tap clears what's certain: extra copies, hidden burst frames and expired screenshots. Every suggestion says why it's there.

SHRINK INSTEAD OF DELETING
Compress all your large videos at once, or trim a long clip to the part worth keeping. PNG screenshots become HEIC, about 70% smaller, and Live Photos can become stills. Copies keep their date, location, favorites and albums.

RECEIPTS TO PDF
Turn photos of receipts and documents into one searchable PDF in Files, then clear the photos.

FILES, TOO
Find copies and big old files in the folders you pick in Files. Files stored only in iCloud are never downloaded.

CLEANING THAT FEELS LIKE A GAME
Swipe left to delete, right to keep, up to favorite, down to hide, and undo any swipe. Go month by month, see what's new since you last checked, keep your streak alive, and share a card of what you freed this year. A storage forecast shows when space runs out at your pace.

SIRI, SHORTCUTS AND WIDGETS
Ask Siri how much space you can free. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show what's ready to clean and open Spatium where you need it.

MADE FOR IPAD
Every category sits in a sidebar. Add a keyboard and triage at full speed: ← to delete, → to keep, ↑ to favorite, number keys to file into albums, ⌘Z to undo.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Spatium never deletes anything without asking. Your device asks you to confirm every photo deletion, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days. Protect albums you never want touched.

FREE TO TRY, PAY ONCE
Free to try: scan everything and run two cleanups of up to 25 items each. One purchase unlocks unlimited cleanups forever, on both iPhone and iPad. No subscription, ever: everything runs on your device, so there are no server costs to pass on to you.

name: Storivie: Your Story Life
description:
ADD ONE BOOK. GET THE WHOLE SERIES OR UNIVERSE.
Storivie puts everything in reading order for you, including novellas, bonus books, and upcoming releases, and shows whether a series is complete. When the next book is announced or gets a release date, Storivie lets you know. Reading a whole universe? Choose your favorite reading order and we'll put everything On Deck. Chapter-by-chapter tandem reading guides are available for select series.

A TBR BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU READ
See what's ready in To Choose From and line up what's next On Deck. Storivie automatically sets incomplete series aside in Waiting on Series, and you can pause a book when you don't want to DNF it.

ADD BOOKS THE LAZY WAY
Upload a screenshot, snap a photo, scan a barcode, paste a list, or import from another tracker. Only remember "that popular book about dragons"? Start there.

NEVER RESEARCH A BOOK AGAIN
We've done the digging on tropes, themes, spice levels, cliffhangers, content notes, and MORE so you know what you're getting into.

DISCOVER BOOKS NEW TO YOU
Search the entire Storivie catalog by genre, length, format, or the exact trope you're craving.

KEEP TRACK OF BOOKS YOU OWN, DOWN TO THE EDITION
Track the editions you own, including special editions, and log which reading services you use. Use Bookstore Companion to check your collection while you shop.

FUN STATS. ZERO PRESSURE.
No streaks, no timers, no games, no pesky reading reminders. Set a goal if you'd like, and see fun stats about your reading, like how many pages you turned this year, which month you finished the most books, your most-read genre, and what your longest read was. Celebrate your story life without worrying about whether you read enough.

MAKE IT FEEL LIKE YOURS
Choose light mode or dark mode and your favorite accent color, along with a profile icon and calendar frames to make your Storivie yours.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT. SOCIAL BY CHOICE.
No feed. No followers. Share what you want with friends, including lists of books you'd recommend.

YOUR MONTH IN COVERS
A beautiful cover calendar you can save and share. Make it your own with light mode or dark mode, 10 decorative frames, and the accent color of your choice.

AND SO MUCH MORE
On-screen adaptations, immersive reading (reading and listening as one entry), unlimited re-reads, Your Year in Books, and Book Talk for readers in the US and Canada.

BUILT BY A READER, FOR READERS
"I built Storivie because I read, well, a lot, and keeping up with my TBR, piles of screenshot recommendations, incomplete series lists, books I'd already read, and everything else was starting to feel like…work. And something as beautiful as disappearing into other worlds should never come with a chore attached." Samantha, Founder

A different take on support: Talk directly to Storivie's founder, who can fix a problem or turn your brilliant idea into a real feature, sometimes the very same day.

A catalog written for readers, with consistent tags, tropes, themes, and book details for every genre, kept current as new books are announced.

AND THAT'S JUST THE PROLOGUE
Find out what happens next with your free 7-day trial. One login works in the app and on the web, so your whole story life comes with you on every device.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within the 24 hours before that period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. If you cancel, your Storivie stays readable, and export is always free.

Terms of Use: storivie.com/terms

name: StoryB: Script
description:
When a scene comes to you, write it. StoryB: Script gives you a screenplay editor on iPhone, with a shared project library on Mac through iCloud Drive.

WRITE IN SCREENPLAY FORMAT
Write scene headings, action and dialogue with automatic formatting. Get suggestions for characters and locations as you type. Jump to a scene from the scene list or focus on one scene at a time.

PLAN THE STORY
Arrange color-coded scene cards and add a synopsis to each one. Keep character and location profiles, the title page, synopsis and treatment in the same project.

CAPTURE THE IDEA BEFORE IT GOES
Add text notes or record a voice note. Use on-device transcription on supported devices and languages, and search inside your notes. Highlight passages and keep comment threads attached to the script.

MOVE BETWEEN IPHONE AND MAC
Choose iCloud Drive to open the same project on both devices. You can also keep projects on your iPhone and write offline. The app is free and has no built-in purchases.

PREVIEW AND SHARE A DRAFT
See the paginated script before exporting. Open Final Draft (.fdx), Fountain (.fountain) or Story Architect (.starc) files. Export PDF, Final Draft, Fountain or plain text.

Requires iOS 26 or later. iCloud sync requires iCloud Drive. Transcription may require downloading an Apple language model.

name: SubmeterSplit
description: SubmeterSplit laskee huoneiden sähkö- ja vesiosuuden päämittarin ja alamittarien lukemista. Tappio on päämittari miinus huoneet, ja se jaetaan pääluvun, pinta-alan tai tasan. Esimerkkipiha avautuu lukemilla 100, 40 ja 35. Yksikköhinnat kirjoitetaan itse. Sovellus ei maksa laskuja eikä hae tariffia.

name: Sudoku Book: Hints Explained
description:
Enjoy 40,000 classic sudoku puzzles in a thoughtfully designed digital puzzle book, with step-by-step hints that explain the reasoning behind your next move. Play offline, take notes, and discover techniques as you solve.

HINTS THAT EXPLAIN THE LOGIC

When you get stuck, follow a sequence of logical deductions based on your current board. Each step names the technique, explains the reasoning, and highlights the relevant cells and candidates.

Move backward and forward through the explanation at your own pace, then apply the final placement when you’re ready.

DISCOVER SOLVING TECHNIQUES

See how techniques work in the puzzle you’re playing, from Naked and Hidden Singles to pairs, X-Wing, Swordfish, XY-Wing, and X-Chains. Build your understanding through practical examples on the board.

40,000 PUZZLES, FOUR DIFFICULTIES

Choose from Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert, with 10,000 puzzles in each level. Browse numbered puzzles, return to unfinished games, and revisit puzzles you’ve completed.

TOOLS FOR YOUR OWN REASONING

• Add pencil marks manually or fill in candidates with Auto Note.
• Mark candidates you’ve ruled out.
• Highlight matching numbers and related cells.
• See conflicts when a number repeats in a row, column, or box.
• Undo and redo your moves.
• Use Recover Board to roll back moves until incorrect entries are cleared.

MADE FOR UNINTERRUPTED PLAY

Your progress, notes, and move history are saved automatically on your device. Pick up an unfinished puzzle when you return.

Enjoy a book-inspired design with carefully chosen typography and clear controls. Adaptive layouts support iPhone, including iPhone Duo, and iPad in portrait and landscape.

ONE PURCHASE, THE COMPLETE EXPERIENCE

All 40,000 puzzles, solving tools, and explained hints are included. No ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases, or account required. Puzzles and hints work offline.

name: Sun X Moon Trace
description:
Sun X Moon Trace calculates the positions and paths of the Sun and Moon and overlays them on the camera view and on a map. Use it to check sunlight, scout photo locations, or document site surveys.

FEATURES
• Home: a sky compass with today's Sun and Moon paths, plus the Sun's paths on the June and December solstices and the equinoxes
• AR: paths, hour marks and an azimuth scale over the live camera view (zoom buttons and pinch zoom)
• Photos: save photos with azimuth, elevation and date stamped along the bottom (optionally also a second photo without paths, from the same frame)
• Map: Sun and Moon azimuth lines on the map, true/magnetic north switch, and magnetic declination (WMM-2025)
• Moon: moon age and phase calendar, next full and new moon
• Pick any date and time to check past or future positions
• Calculations work offline (the map needs an internet connection)
• Available in English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish and Traditional Chinese

ACCURACY
Positions are calculated with Astronomy Engine (about ±1 arcminute). Terrain and buildings are not taken into account. AR accuracy depends on the device compass.

CAUTION
Never look directly at the Sun, even through the camera.

PRIVACY
No account required. The developer does not collect your location, photos or any other data.

name: Sunrise: Bedtime by the Sun
description:
Go to bed with the sun, not against it.

Sunrise sets your bedtime with one simple rule: the next sunrise where you are, minus the hours you want in bed (9 by default). Your night always ends at dawn, and your bedtime gently follows the seasons, a little each day.

WHY SUNRISE
Your inner clock is set by light. As it gets dark, your body starts releasing melatonin and gets ready for sleep; morning light switches it off.
• After a week of camping with only natural light, melatonin rose about two hours earlier, close to sunset (Wright et al., Current Biology, 2013).
• A mismatch between your body clock and your daily schedule, known as social jet lag, is linked to poorer sleep (Roenneberg et al.).
• When you sleep relative to your body clock affects, among other things, how much REM sleep you get (Dijk & Czeisler, 1995).
Research points to a direction, not a guarantee. And the direction is consistent: sleep when it's dark.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your place: use your location or type a city.
• Choose how many hours before sunrise you want to be in bed: 6 to 11, in half-hour steps.
• Sunrise recalculates your bedtime every day. Summer means earlier nights, winter later ones.
• The week-ahead view shows how much your bedtime will drift.

GENTLE REMINDERS
One heads-up before bed (15 min, 30 min, 1 h or 1.5 h ahead, your choice) and one more when it's time to lie down. Nothing else. No streaks, no points, no nagging.

FIVE LIVING LANDSCAPES
Every screen is an animated landscape lit by the real position of the sun where you are, from afternoon light through sunset and twilight to a starry night:
• Mountain Lake: a painterly sky, snowy peaks, the Milky Way
• Paper Alps: illustrated mountain ranges, fireflies at dusk
• Valley: a mirror-still lake in an alpine pass
• Dunes: warm sand, silence and a moonlit night
• Ocean: open sea, clouds and the aurora at night

FOUR WAYS TO SEE YOUR NIGHT
Reflection, Dial, Bands or Hourglass. Each shows the same two things in its own way: how long until bed, and when the sun comes back.

WIDGETS AND STANDBY
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep tonight's bedtime in view without opening the app. They also work in StandBy, while your iPhone charges on the nightstand.

APPLE WATCH
A native Apple Watch app plus complications for your watch face:
• Bedtime: a countdown to bed; at night, the sunrise time
• Night: your night from bedtime to sunrise, and how far into it you are
• Sky: the sun or moon in the sky right now, with sunrise and sunset
Circular, rectangular, corner and inline styles.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Sunrise and your bedtime are calculated on your device. There is no Sunrise server.
• Your location is used only to work out sunrise. To show your town's name, the app asks a public map service once; city search works the same way.

FREE
Sunrise is free. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

Sunrise is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat anything. If you have trouble sleeping, talk to a doctor.

name: Super Čelik
description:
Super Čelik reads a Serbian electronic ID card, ID card for foreigners or residence permit (RP2024) and shows the data on your iPhone or iPad.

• Read the card with a smart card reader connected over USB-C. The app shows right away when a reader is plugged in and when a card is inserted.
• See personal data, photo, document validity and whether the card's signature is genuine (checked against the MUP certificate chain).
• View the official-style printout (PDF), print it with AirPrint or share it.
• Token certificates and their validity.
• Sensitive fields (personal number, address, document number) are hidden until you reveal them; data is cleared automatically.
• Languages: Русский, English, Srpski (latinica), Српски (ћирилица).
• Private by design: no account, no analytics, no servers. Card data never leaves your device.

Super Čelik is an independent app. It is not affiliated with the Ministry of Interior of the Republic of Serbia (MUP RS) or NetSeT/Veridos.

No card at hand? Settings > Show demo data shows the app with fictional data.

name: Super Intelligence: The Game
description:
The government says it's not "AI" any more. It's "SI". Same product, new name, valuation up 300%.

You are a scrappy startup bot with a dream, a GPU cluster and absolutely no safety team. Survive 10 minutes in the server room and your company goes public. Don't, and the board fires you (they'll rehire you immediately anyway).

A cute, chunky pixel-art survival game with one-thumb controls: you move, your company fires automatically. Collect tokens, level up, stack upgrades, and watch the screen fill with bullets.

PICK YOUR UPGRADES
• Hallucinate: confidently fires wrong answers that bounce between enemies
• GPU Cluster: orbiting chips. Very expensive. Very spinny.
• Prompt Injection: tells enemies to ignore all previous instructions
• Ship It: fires wherever you're heading. Tests are for later.
• Data Leak: randomly exposes nearby enemies. Deeply regrets nothing.
• Move Fast: ...and break things
• Data Scraping: hoover up tokens from further away. Consent optional.
• Water Cooling: uses roughly one lake
• Guardrails, Fine-Tuning, Context Window, Mixture of Experts and more
• Max a weapon, hold the right passive and it evolves into something worse (for them)

THREE FUNDING ROUNDS
Every run is three chapters: Seed, Series A and Series B, each with its own music and its own twist (surprise compliance audit, anyone?). Between rounds the floor clears and you sign one of three term sheets. Hype Round, Acqui-hire, Bridge Loan: every deal is a trade-off. Read the small print.

SURVIVE THE BACKLASH
Regulators, lawsuits, angry artists and overheating servers swarm in from every direction, and some of them shoot back. Elites drop chests. Each round ends with its own boss (the Senate Hearing, the Class Action, the Rival Lab) that flashes a warning, then fills the screen with beams and bullet patterns. Beat all three and reach 10:00 to IPO.

RAISE FUNDING
Your score is your company's valuation. Spend it between runs to hire a safety team, buy a bigger cluster, expand your datacenter, tune your benchmarks or pay some lobbyists.

• Short runs, made for phones: 10 minutes to win, pause any time
• Pay once: no ads, no in-app purchases, no account, plays offline
• Built for iPhone Duo: unfold for the big-screen version
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards
• Progress syncs across your devices with iCloud
• Play with touch or a game controller
• Smooth 120Hz on ProMotion displays, haptics and juicy screen shake

Every company in the game is made up. Any resemblance to your favourite AI lab is a coincidence. Probably.

name: Suprayz
description:
Suprayz, arkadaşına birkaç dokunuşla eğlenceli bir sürpriz göndermenin yolu.

Katalogdan komik bir resim, kısa ses efekti veya hareketli içerik seç. Kutuyla mı açılsın, yoksa silerek mi ortaya çıksın? Paketini hazırla, istersen bir not bırak ve Mesajlar, WhatsApp veya kullandığın başka bir uygulamayla paylaş.

• Komik resimler, özgün ses efektleri ve hareketli sürprizler
• Kutuyu aç veya parmağınla silerek keşfet
• Kişisel not ve gönderen adı
• Rehberin kendi kişi seçicisinden arkadaşını seçme
• Gelen sürprizleri telefonda saklama
• Tepkini paylaşarak karşılık verme

Hesap açmak gerekmez. Rehberin sunucuya yüklenmez. Katalog uygulamanın içinde olduğu için sürpriz içerikleri açıldıktan sonra çevrimdışı da kullanılabilir.

Arkadaşında uygulama yoksa bağlantıdaki adımları izleyerek uygulamayı indirebilir. Kurulumdan sonra aynı bağlantıya geri dönmesi veya sürpriz kodunu uygulamaya yapıştırması yeterlidir.

Bağlantıya sahip herkes sürprizi açabilir. Paylaşım geçmişi teslim veya okunma bilgisi vermez.

Biraz saçma olması gayet normal. İlk sürprizini gönder!

name: SushiJaro
description:
일본 병원의 마운자로 참고 가격과 진료 조건을 한곳에서 비교하세요.

• 용량과 기간에 맞춘 가격 비교
엔화 가격, 원화 환산 참고값과 확인된 추가 비용을 살펴보고 병원을 비교 목록에 담을 수 있어요. 한국 비교 가격과 환율·할인 조건은 설정에서 확인하고 바꿀 수 있어요.

• 지도와 병원 문의
지역별 병원을 지도에서 찾고, 병원이 안내한 전화·공식 사이트·LINE 문의 경로로 이동할 수 있어요. 한국어·영어 안내 여부와 관광객 진료 조건도 함께 확인해요.

• 익명으로 나누는 커뮤니티
병원 방문과 준비 과정에 관한 질문·경험을 나눠요. 익명 작성은 기기에 보관한 작성 권한으로 관리하고, 선택 로그인으로 내 글과 댓글을 모아볼 수 있어요. 신고·작성자 차단·본인 작성 내용 삭제를 지원하며 첨부 사진은 검토 후 공개됩니다.

• 방문 준비 도구
문의할 내용을 일본어 문구로 정리하고, 추가 비용·필요 서류·보관과 운송·귀국 전 반입 기준을 체크리스트로 확인해요. 작성한 문의는 사용자가 직접 병원에 전달합니다.

가격 안내
매일 0시에 병원 공식 페이지를 확인하는 갱신 작업을 실행합니다. 확인에 실패한 정보는 마지막 정상 자료를 유지하며, 병원별 기준일과 미확인 비용·조건을 표시합니다. 모든 항목이 매일 새로 확인되었다는 의미는 아닙니다. 가격·재고·진료 대상·환율은 달라질 수 있으므로 실제 결제 금액과 수령 조건은 병원에 확인해 주세요.

의료 안내
SushiJaro는 가격 정보와 방문 준비를 돕는 참고 앱입니다. 진단·진료 예약·처방·의약품 판매를 제공하지 않습니다. 의약품 사용과 용량은 담당 의사·약사와 상담해 결정하고, 반입·운송 기준은 관계 기관의 최신 안내를 확인해 주세요.

가격 비교·저장·지도·방문 가이드는 로그인 없이 이용할 수 있습니다. 커뮤니티는 만 14세 이상 이용자를 대상으로 합니다.

name: SVG Motion Studio
description:
Create vertical app-promotion videos by combining your own SVG assets, app screenshots, and text in one local workspace.

Register app information, icons, and screenshots for the apps you want to introduce. Paste SVG code to build an asset library, then find assets by name and place them in your scenes.

Create a project with an app, theme, audience message, and final message. Edit four scenes with your text, display time, background color, SVG assets, screenshots, and animation settings. Play the scenes in order to preview the project before export.

Your app information, assets, and projects are saved locally. Export them as a JSON backup and import them when needed. MP4 export is available on the desktop version.

SVG Motion Studio is for people who want to build app-promotion videos from their own materials and refine a repeatable scene-based workflow.

name: swarm: rewards for posting
description:
Post brand videos. Collect coins. Redeem real rewards.

Swarm is a network of real people who run dedicated brand accounts on TikTok and Instagram. Brands give us finished videos and captions — you set up the account, post by hand, and get rewarded for every approved post. No filming, no editing, no followers needed.

HOW IT WORKS
• Sign in and verify your identity with a quick selfie and photo ID (reviewed by our team, usually within 12 hours)
• Claim an open brand account and set it up from the profile we give you
• Save the video, copy the caption, and post it with the #ad disclosure
• Paste your post link — once it's approved, coins land in your wallet

REWARDS
Redeem coins for gift cards from popular food, retail and gaming brands, or save up for bigger goals like a game console, laptop or headphones. Rewards are delivered in the app, usually within 2 business days.

LEVEL UP
• Earn XP for every approved post and level up
• Climb from Bronze to Legend by posting on time and keeping quality high
• Complete missions for bonus coins and weekly quests for extra XP
• Collect badges, unlock frames and titles, and join opt-in leaderboards that use display names only

MORE
• Quick side quests like replying to comments on your brand account
• Live Activities and widgets keep today's posts on your lock screen
• Lessons on ad disclosure, privacy and platform rules

GOOD TO KNOW
• For residents of the US and Canada aged 16 and older; under 18 requires a parent's or guardian's permission
• Every post carries a clear #ad disclosure and uses the platform's ad disclosure setting where available
• Coins have no cash value and can only be redeemed for listed rewards
• Task availability varies; rewards are not guaranteed
• Swarm is not affiliated with TikTok or Instagram

Gift card brands are not sponsors of, or affiliated with, Swarm. All trademarks belong to their owners.

name: Swipe & Keep
description:
Review your iPhone photos with a simple swipe.

• Swipe left to mark a photo for deletion; swipe right to keep it
• Tap to play a Live Photo and double-tap to zoom
• Filter by date, album, screenshot type, or city
• Undo multiple decisions and see reminders for photos you previously kept
• Review marked photos before confirming deletion

Photo originals and review progress stay on your device and are never uploaded to Swipe & Keep. If you use city filters, coordinates already stored in a photo are sent to Apple Maps to identify the city.

name: SyncStays

CHANNEL MANAGER

• Update room inventory and availability across your connected OTAs
• Push room rates for any date range instantly
• Rate Planner: create rate plans and push them in one tap

BUILT FOR YOUR TEAM

Whether you manage 5 rooms or 100, SyncStays keeps your bookings, billing and online channels in sync, so you can spend less time on admin and more time on your guests.

name: TakeIt: Essentials Reminder
description:
TakeIt is a simple checklist for the things you must not leave home without: wallet, keys, phone, passport, or anything else you add.

On the days and at the time you choose, TakeIt sends a notification that asks “Got everything?” and lists the items due that day that are still unchecked. If everything due today is already checked, no reminder is sent. Answer right from the notification: Got everything, remind again in 2, 5 or 10 minutes, or Skip today.

TakeIt is free. Two features need TakeIt Pro, a one-time in-app purchase with no subscription: the reminder when you leave home and schedules for individual items. Everything else is free, including the Apple Watch app.

YOUR LIST
• Add, rename and delete items, and pin the important ones to the top.
• Templates to start from or add later: Essentials, Office, Gym, Travel.
• Sort items into groups, each with its own name and color.
• Check items off as you pack. Checks start fresh every day.
• “Got everything” checks the whole list and mutes reminders until tomorrow.

SCHEDULE
• A general reminder time and weekdays for the whole list.
• With TakeIt Pro, each item can have its own schedule: Always, One-time (a specific date) or Weekly (selected weekdays), and a custom time.
• Upcoming shows what is due on later days (for items with their own schedule).
• Exceptions: Skip weekends, and Vacation mode to pause reminders for the dates you select.
• Write your own notification text.
• Times and dates follow your local clock: a reminder set for 8:30 arrives at 8:30 in whatever time zone you are.
• Reminders are scheduled several weeks ahead. If TakeIt is not opened for that long, a single notification asks you to open the app so that they continue.

LEAVING HOME (TAKEIT PRO)
• Optional: turn on “Remind me when I leave home”.
• Set your home on the map: search for an address, tap the map or use your current location. Adjust the radius of the home area.
• When you leave that area and items due today are still unchecked, TakeIt reminds you about them. At most once per interval you choose (45 minutes by default), and never on days you skipped or paused.
• This reminder needs “Always” location access with Precise Location on: it has to work while the app is closed, and iOS watches the home area only with precise location. iOS reports the exit, so the reminder can arrive shortly after you actually leave.

APPLE WATCH
• See today’s items and tap Got everything on your wrist.
• Add an item to the list from the watch.
• Reminders show the list of items and the same actions.
• The watch app is a companion to the iPhone app and syncs with it. Open TakeIt on iPhone once so that your list appears on the watch; until then the watch can only add items.

HISTORY TODAY
• A log of today’s actions: got everything, snoozed, skipped, with the number of items checked.

TAKEIT PRO
• One purchase, once: no subscription and nothing to renew.
• Unlocks the leave-home reminder and item schedules.
• Restore Purchases brings it back on a new device or after reinstalling.

PRIVACY
• No account and no sign-up.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Your list, schedule and home location are stored on your device. Your location is used on the device to notice that you left home and is not sent to the developer.
• Address search and the map are provided by Apple Maps.

Available in English, French, Italian and Russian.

name: TakeTidy: Cut Pauses & Ums
description:
Recorded a great take, but it's full of long pauses, "um"s and lines you said twice? TakeTidy cuts them out for you, right on your iPhone, so you can post in minutes instead of scrubbing a timeline.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Import a video or film one in the app.
2. TakeTidy listens to it on your iPhone and finds the dead air, filler words and retakes.
3. Watch the edited version, fix anything you don't like with a tap, and export.
WHAT IT CUTS
• Pauses: the gaps between sentences, with a natural breath left in so it doesn't sound choppy.
• Filler words: "um", "uh" and the words you add yourself. "Like" and "so" are only marked, because they're often real words. You decide.
• Retakes: when you stumble and say a line again, TakeTidy keeps your last take and removes the earlier one.
• Dead air at the start and end.
YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• One slider: Gentle, Standard or Tight.
• Every cut is listed with the words it removes. Tap Keep to put anything back, or select words in the transcript to cut or keep them.
• Undo everything. Your edits survive when you change the strength.
• If it would remove a lot, TakeTidy tells you before you export.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything runs on your iPhone with Apple's on-device speech recognition.
• Your videos are never uploaded. No account, no sign-in, no tracking.
EXPORT
• Same frame rate and colors as your original, including HDR.
• Full resolution or 1080p, HEVC or H.264.
• Save to Photos or share anywhere.
• Analysis and export keep going if you switch apps, and you'll get a notification when they're done.
BEST RESULTS
TakeTidy is built for one person talking to the camera, in English, in takes up to 30 minutes. Background music and loud rooms make pauses harder to find; TakeTidy will tell you when that happens.
TAKETIDY PRO
Your first export is free (up to 10 minutes). TakeTidy Pro unlocks unlimited exports and videos up to 30 minutes:
• Yearly: $39.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers
• Weekly: $5.99 per week
• Lifetime: $79.99 one-time purchase
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or at the end of the free trial). Manage or cancel any time in Settings › your name › Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

name: Tango פתרונות לאירועים
description:
Tango פתרונות לאירועים מרכזת את סידור ההושבה ואת אישורי ההגעה של האירוע במקום אחד.

אישורי הגעה
• רואים במבט אחד כמה אישרו, כמה לא מגיעים, מי עוד לא ענה ומי צריך טיפול.
• מחפשים הזמנה לפי שם או טלפון ומסננים לפי מצב.
• פותחים הזמנה ורואים את היסטוריית הניסיונות לאשר הגעה.
• מתקנים כמות מאושרת ידנית כשצריך.

סידור הושבה
• מפת האולם עם כל השולחנות, ובכל שולחן כמה מקומות תפוסים וכמה פנויים.
• שולחנות שדורשים בדיקה מסומנים בבירור.
• כל הזמנה יושבת בשולחן אחד. מעבירים הזמנה לשולחן אחר רק כשיש בו מספיק מקום.
• בוחרים פריסת שולחנות מתוך הפריסות של האולם.
• סוקרים את השינויים לפני שמעבירים את ההושבה למערכת העמדה באירוע.

נכנסים עם כתובת המייל שצוות Tango הוסיף לאירוע, בלי סיסמה. אפשר גם לפתוח אירוע לדוגמה עם נתונים בדויים ולראות איך הכול עובד.

name: TangoTako: Learn Japanese
description:
Learn Japanese – clearly explained, lovingly designed and with no account required.

In TangoTako, Tinte the little octopus guides you from your first words all the way to JLPT N2 grammar. You see every rule as a picture first and live it in a small game – so you understand when to use it instead of just memorizing it.

GRAMMAR YOU CAN SEE
• Over 550 grammar points from N4 to N2, plus the key particles
• For every point: a visual guide, an example sentence with furigana and a scene with Tinte
• 563 little games: hold, drag, decide – you experience the rule yourself
• Look-alike patterns side by side, with an explanation of why the wrong choice doesn't fit

WORDS IN REAL SENTENCES
• Over 5,800 words, each with an example sentence and translation
• Only one new word per sentence
• Over 2,000 word scenes: Tinte and Obake act out what a word means
• Recorded pronunciation on your iPhone, available offline

KANJI WITH STROKE ORDER
• 972 kanji from N5 to N2
• Watch the stroke order, readings and example sentences

FOR BEGINNERS
• Learn to read hiragana and katakana, plus N5 grammar – switch it on in Settings

SMART REVIEWS
• FSRS scheduling: cards come back just before you would forget them
• "Today" shows at a glance what is due and which lesson comes next
• Study goal with an exam date – Tinte plans how much is due each day
• Rate with a swipe or four buttons

name: Tawla: Backgammon & Friends
description:
Backgammon the way it's played at home — with your people.

Tawla brings the two classics of the Levant and the Gulf to one beautiful board:
• Tawla 31 (Shesh Besh): the classic game with hitting.
• Mahbouseh: the pinning game — trap a lone checker instead of hitting it.
• Fevga: the Greek race — no hitting, no pinning.
• Mixed and Tavli: alternate the games, match by match.

PLAY YOUR PEOPLE
Add friends with a short code (like Sami#4821) or send a WhatsApp link — iPhone and Android play each other. See who's online, invite them in the app, and open any friend's profile for your full record together: matches, points and every game you've played. Play live, or take 1, 3 or 7 days per move.

PLAY ONLINE
Play live (45 seconds a move plus a reserve) or a daily game with one move a day — close the app and we'll tell you when it's your turn. Rated matches, a leaderboard and quick phrases in your language.

FAIR DICE, PROVABLY
No coins. No betting. No "rigged dice". Before every match the server locks in a secret, both phones add their own randomness, and when the match ends your phone re-checks every single roll. You can see the proof yourself.

A BOARD WORTH LOOKING AT
An inlaid walnut box with mother-of-pearl, ivory and ebony checkers with brass rims, dice that tumble across the felt, and warm wooden sounds. In English, Arabic (right to left), Turkish and Greek.

PRACTISE ANYTIME
Play the computer offline on three levels, or pass the phone between two players.

ACHIEVEMENTS AND LEADERBOARDS
Earn medals and frames for your emblem, and climb the global, friends, country and weekly boards.

TAWLA PLUS (OPTIONAL)
Your latest match's replay and Coach are free. With Plus:

• A new board design every month, plus premium boards, pieces, dice, emblems and frames
• Your full stats: win rate per game type, recent form and dice luck
• No ads
Plus never changes the dice or matchmaking: it's the same fair game for everyone.

THE SHOP
Seasonal designs to keep forever — and send one to a friend as a gift.

description:
Snap any trading card and know what it's worth in seconds. Then meet TCG Coach, the AI mind that remembers your whole collection.

Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Digimon, Flesh and Blood and 130+ card games, from today's hits to the 90s classics other apps forget.

INSTANT AI CARD SCANNER
- Point, shoot, done: AI vision identifies the game, set, number, variant and language
- Works on vintage, rare, graded-style photos and foreign-language cards
- Scan one card or a whole stack
- Every card shows the official art and your own copy side by side

LIVE PRICES IN US DOLLARS
- See what every card, and your whole collection, is worth today
- Prices update automatically
- Your most valuable cards ranked, with rising cards highlighted
- Find the hidden gems in your binder before you trade or sell

TCG COACH: A MIND, NOT A CHATBOT
TCG Coach runs on PAI, the persistent personal AI built by Punky Tiger Labs. It remembers your games, goals, decks and chase cards from one chat to the next, and grows with your collection.
- "What's my most valuable card?" "Should I grade it?" "What should I complete next?"

THE CARD WIKI FOR EVERY GAME

name: Temola
description:
Life has a lot of little things. Give them a place with Temola, an offline routine planner for your home, your wellbeing and everyday admin.

START SMALL
Create your own routine or choose an editable starter template. Pick daily, weekdays, weekly or monthly repeats and an estimated duration.

LET YOUR DAY CHANGE
Complete a routine with a tap, skip it for today or move it to tomorrow. A moved routine merges with the same routine’s next card, so your list stays manageable.

MAKE IT YOURS
Search, edit, pause or delete routines as life changes. Today’s saved details and past history stay available when you edit a routine.

SEE WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DID
Review completion, skipped and moved records by date. A weekly completion rate and consecutive-day streak help you notice your progress. Templates never add completed history.

KEEP IT LOCAL
No account is required. Routines, history and your optional display name are saved on your device. Settings includes help, privacy information and a confirmed reset for local data. There is no cloud sync; system backups follow your device settings.

Temola is made for small, repeatable steps, at your own pace.

name: Template Diary: Daily Journal
description:
Create a journal that fits your day.

Template Diary lets you choose your own fields and capture text, tags, mood, weight, categories and a daily score. Build a little collection of days with a friendly pixel companion.

• Custom templates: Start from a provided format or add fields to a blank template.
• Simple entries: Pick a date and score, then write about your day. You can also import a previous entry.
• Calendar and statistics: Review recorded days, average scores and streaks by period.
• Team journals: Invite others to write in a shared template.
• Optional reminders: Choose the days and time that suit you.

Sign in with Apple, Google, Kakao or a separately issued service email account. Entries are stored on the server. Personal entries are private. Entries and author labels in team templates are visible to members with access to that team. name: Ten Sittings
description:
Ten Sittings helps you finally read the classics: one short, chapter-sized sitting at a time, with a guide beside you that never spoils what comes next.

Each book is split into sittings that follow its own chapters. Read at your own pace, and when you reach the end of a sitting you get a short recap of what just happened and a question to think about or discuss.

SPOILER-FREE CHARACTER NOTES
Lost track of who someone is? Tap the characters button for notes on the people you have met so far, and nothing about the ones you haven't.

A GLOSSARY FOR OLD WORDS
Archaic and unfamiliar words are explained in a per-chapter glossary, so you can keep reading instead of searching.

A RECAP AFTER EVERY SITTING
Every sitting ends with a short recap and a discussion prompt. They're good for remembering where you were, or for a book club.

CALM, PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
- Light, dark and sepia themes, with adjustable text size
- An optional daily reading reminder
- Every book is in the app, so it works without a connection
- No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your reading progress stays on your iPhone.

THE SHELF
Free to read:
- A Christmas Carol (Charles Dickens)
- The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde (Robert Louis Stevenson)
- The Time Machine (H. G. Wells)

With Ten Sittings Plus:

- Frankenstein (Mary Shelley)

name: Tentative: Plans & Reminders
description:
Save any plan. Never miss it.

The party invite in the group chat. The flyer on the café wall. The "we should totally go" you'll forget by Friday. Tentative turns any plan into a reminder in seconds, so the events, birthdays and important dates you care about actually happen.

PHOTO TO CALENDAR IN SECONDS
Snap a photo of a flyer or a party invitation. Share a screenshot. Paste a link. Drop in a PDF. Or just use your voice and say it, or ask Siri: "New plan in Tentative." Tentative's AI reads the date, time and place and fills in the plan for you. Check it, tap Save, done.

NEVER MISS IT
Reminders with notifications land before every plan, right on your Lock Screen: a month, a week and a day before, and on the day. Add your own reminders for the plans that need more notice. And when the host changes a plan you saved, you're the first to know.

REMINDERS WITH ALARMS
For the important dates you can't afford to miss, turn a reminder into an alarm (iOS 26 and later). Pick the moment that matters, like the morning of the wedding or two hours before the flight, and Tentative rings like an alarm clock, so you never miss a plan or an event again. Your other reminders stay quiet notifications.

BIRTHDAYS AND IMPORTANT DATES
Birthday reminders, anniversaries and other important dates come back every year, reminders and all.

COUNTDOWN TO ANYTHING
Put a countdown widget on your Home Screen and see the days until the trip, the vacation, the birthday, the wedding, the graduation, the retirement party or Christmas, without opening the app.

KEEP YOUR MAYBES
Calendars are for yes. Tentative is for maybe. Every "maybe" waits in your pre-calendar, one calm place to track every event you might go to, until you're ready.

ADD IT TO YOUR CALENDAR
Ready to say yes? One tap puts the plan in the calendar you already use.

SCHEDULES, ITINERARIES AND LINE-UPS
Drop in your kids' school schedule, a sports season, a conference agenda, a trip itinerary, a festival line-up or a venue's concert programme. Tentative finds every date, and one tap saves them all, neatly organized into a group. Keep track of every school event, game, session and concert in one place.

EVERY KIND OF PLAN
• Trips, weddings, date nights and dinners with friends.
• Classes, run club, book club: weekly and monthly plans repeat on their own.
• Your year at a glance: fold the months into calendars and the busy weekends and the free ones jump right out.

SHARE PARTY INVITES AND FAMILY PLANS
Hosting a birthday party, a dinner or a night out? Send one invite link to the group chat. Guests open it in any browser, add it to their calendar or save it to Tentative for their own reminders. No app needed to say yes.
Families can share plans the same way: send the school play, the match or the family reunion to the family chat, and everyone has the date and their own reminders.

YOUR PLANS STAY YOURS
Your saved plans, notes and reminders live on your iPhone. No ads, and we never sell your data.

Stop losing plans to the group chat. Save it with Tentative.

name: TermRoad: SSH Client
description:
TermRoad is a native SSH client for iPhone and iPad that keeps every server you look after one tap away. Your hosts, keys, identities and snippets live in a vault that's encrypted on your device before it ever syncs, so our server only ever stores data it can't read.

EVERYTHING YOU CONNECT TO, IN ONE PLACE
• Hosts and groups: set the username, key, jump host and theme once on a group, and every host inside it follows. Override anything on a single host.
• Search that connects: type to filter your hosts, or type ssh user@host -p port to connect straight away.
• Tags, duplicate, swipe to edit, and long-press for more.

KEYS AND IDENTITIES
• Generate Ed25519 and ECDSA keys, or import them from Files or the clipboard.
• Copy or share a public key in one tap.
• Identities pair a username with its key or password, so you can reuse them across hosts.

A REAL TERMINAL
• A fast, native terminal with an extra-keys row for Esc, Ctrl, Tab, arrows and function keys.
• Themes, text size, scrollback, find, and Option as Meta.
• Snippets: save the commands you run often and send them in one tap, or run one when a session starts.
• Several sessions open at once, with Reconnect when iOS ends one in the background.

BUILT FOR SERIOUS WORK
• SFTP: browse a server's files, upload from Files, download, rename, delete and make folders.
• Port forwarding: local, remote and dynamic SOCKS forwards you can save, start and stop.
• Jump hosts and agent forwarding, with every hop's host key checked.
• SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies, and environment variables sent when a session starts.
• Connection logs: when you connected to what, and whether it worked. They stay on your device and never include what you type or see.

SECURE BY DESIGN
• End-to-end encrypted: your vault is locked with a key made from your master password and a Secret Key that never leaves your devices. We never receive either.
• Host keys are always verified. You're asked on first contact, and a changed key is a hard stop. There's no setting to skip it.
• Secrets stay in the iOS Keychain, on this device only.
• Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or Optic ID, with optional auto-lock.
• Encrypted export and import of your whole vault.
• No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, no tracking.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• iPad: a sidebar, Split View, Stage Manager and every orientation, with keyboard shortcuts for new hosts, quick connect, switching sessions, find, text size and lock.
• iPhone: a tab bar, and full-screen sessions that keep the extra-keys row clear.

WORKS WITH TERMROAD FOR MAC
Use the same account on your Mac and your vault follows you, end-to-end encrypted.

An account is required and is created in the app. Once you're signed in, TermRoad works fully offline.

Privacy: https://termroad.com/legal/privacy/

name: Tesbeat
description:
Tesbeat puts your Tesla's pulse in your hand. See your car's status live, control it with a tap and understand how you drive and charge — in a fluid, animated design made for iPhone and Apple Watch.

LIVE STATUS
• Battery, range, doors, windows, tire pressures and cabin temperature at a glance
• Live data streamed from your car, without waking it up and draining the battery

CONTROLS
• Climate: temperature dial, seat and steering wheel heating, defrost, Dog Mode and Camp Mode
• Charging: charge limit, current, start/stop and time to full
• Lock, trunk, frunk, lights and Sentry Mode — press and hold to confirm, so nothing happens by accident

HISTORY & INSIGHTS
• Drive and charging history
