name: Tesseract et al
description:
# Tesseract — Explore the Fourth Dimension

What would a four-dimensional object look like?

Discover the fascinating world of higher-dimensional geometry with Tesseract, an immersive visualisation app designed for Apple Vision Pro.

A tesseract is the four-dimensional equivalent of a cube. Just as a cube can be represented on a flat screen, a four-dimensional object can be projected into three-dimensional space.

Tesseract brings these remarkable mathematical structures to life, allowing you to explore geometric forms that extend beyond our familiar three-dimensional world.

From the elegant symmetry of a tesseract to other extraordinary four-dimensional figures, the app offers a new perspective on geometry, mathematics and the nature of space.

Whether you're a mathematician, student, teacher or simply curious about the fourth dimension, Tesseract invites you to discover a world beyond everyday experience.

**Step into the fourth dimension.**

name: Tetramark

See how gold, oil, currencies and crypto are doing today, all in one place. The home compass shows at a glance which of the four markets is moving, with a one-line summary of who is ahead and who is behind.

Open any market for its price, today's range and a chart from minutes to weeks.

Compare markets with each other — gold against silver or oil, bitcoin against gold — and see how today stacks up against the past year.

name: Thaw Pals: Ice Rescue ASMR
description:
Crack the ice. Free the animal. Give it a home.

Thaw Pals is a calm, satisfying ice-breaking game. A little animal is frozen inside every block. Tap to make small cracks, hold and release for a strong hit, and listen as the ice crackles, splits and shatters until your new friend is free.

BREAK THE ICE
Tap for small cracks, hold and release for a big hit
Clear, bubbly, crystal, layered and fruit ice, each with its own look and sound
Broken chunks fall and shatter on the ground
Timed bonus levels for extra gold

RESCUE 60 ANIMALS

Baby animals waiting to join their families

Keep every friend in your album

name: The Painters Desk
description:

The wheel works without an account. Sign in with Apple, Google, Discord, GitHub or email to sync your collection across devices and share your work.
Swatch colours are estimates: screens and paint batches vary, so always check on the model.
The Painters Desk is an independent project by AK Tabletop Studio. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by any paint manufacturer. Brand and paint names belong to their owners and are used only to identify paints.
No adverts. No tracking.

name: The Spread: Hunting Log
description:
The Spread is a hunting log made by hunters, for hunters. Log a hunt in the blind, and The Spread fills in the weather and moon for that spot and time. Over a season, it shows you what's actually working.

LOG EVERY HUNT
• Waterfowl, big game, turkey, upland and small game hunts
• Species with drake and hen counts, birds taken and seen
• Wind, temperature, pressure and trend, rain and cloud cover filled in automatically from Open-Meteo for your spot and time. Edit anything by hand.
• Moon phase worked out on your phone
• Save your spots with a map pin, add field notes and photos
• Works offline in the field. Your log lives on your phone first.

SEE WHAT'S WORKING
• Patterns: how your hunts went by wind direction, moon, temperature, pressure, time of day and sky
• Find my best spot: matches today's wind and temperature to your similar past hunts and ranks your spots
• 7-day outlook: rates each part of the coming week against how your past hunts went in similar conditions
Estimates only, built from your own hunts. Not a guarantee, and not safety, navigation or legal advice.

DUCK TALES
• A room for every state. Post a hunt report, share a photo, like and comment
• Friends and private messages
• Share a hunt with chosen friends. Exact location is off unless you turn it on for that share.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
• No ads and no tracking
• Photos are stripped of location data before they leave your phone
• Optional account backup so you can restore your log on a new phone. You can turn it off any time.
• Export your hunts, or delete your account right in the app
• Report and block tools in every room and conversation, plus a word filter on posts and messages

Use of The Spread requires you to be 18 or older and to agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. You are responsible for knowing and following all hunting laws, seasons, bag limits and licensing rules where you hunt.

Terms of Use: https://www.usethespread.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.usethespread.com/privacy/

name: The-Summit
description:
The Summit is a simple game where your goal is to reach the highest altitudes!

You can unlock equipment to help you, along with many items: backgrounds, chests, or gems! Playing without an internet connection is possible, and your progress can be ranked in the leaderboard!

name: Thermal Report: IR Inspection
description:
Open thermal photos from FLIR cameras and DJI drones, measure temperatures and hand your client a PDF inspection report, all on iPad and iPhone.

Thermal Report is made for drone and building inspectors, energy auditors, electricians and solar technicians who do not want to go back to a Windows PC to analyse a job.

MEASURE
• Spot, line, box, ellipse and polygon tools with minimum, maximum and average
• Hottest and coldest point marked on every image
• Temperature difference between any two measurements
• Line profile chart
• Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin

SEE
• Iron, rainbow, white-hot, black-hot and more palettes
• Level and span with a live histogram, automatic contrast
• Isotherms above, below or between temperatures
• Thermal and visual image side by side

ADJUST
• Emissivity, reflected temperature, distance, humidity and air temperature per image
• Every temperature is recalculated at once
• The app shows whether the values came from the file or are defaults

REPORT
• Project with all images of a job; your original files stay untouched
• Findings and severity per image, client, site and weather details, your logo
• PDF in A4 or US Letter, CSV tables of measurements and of every pixel

SUPPORTED FILES
• FLIR radiometric JPEG, including FLIR-sensor drone cameras such as Zenmuse XT2 and XT R: temperatures from the calibration stored in the file
• DJI R-JPEG from Mavic 3 Thermal, Matrice 30T, Mavic 2 Enterprise Advanced, Zenmuse H20N and H30T: temperatures are estimates that follow DJI's own conversion closely at typical settings and are labelled as estimates
• Zenmuse H20T, Zenmuse XT S and early Matrice 30T firmware files open as pictures without temperatures
• 16-bit TIFF with your own scale

PRIVATE
No account, no tracking, no uploads. Your photos and reports stay on your device.

IMPORTANT
Thermal Report computes temperatures from the data in the image file and the parameters shown. It is not a calibrated measuring instrument. Confirm critical readings with a calibrated instrument.

THERMAL REPORT PRO
Analysing images with every tool needs no subscription. Exporting reports for projects with more than two images, and without the "Made with Thermal Report" footer, needs Thermal Report Pro, an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://apps.dautov.dev/thermal-report/terms/
Privacy policy: https://apps.dautov.dev/thermal-report/privacy/

name: Thornhold: Grove Defense
description:
Thornhold is a bite-sized forest strategy game: explore an enchanted hex map between battles, then defend your living fortress in fast lane-defense sieges.

EXPLORE AND EXPAND
Push back the fog one hex at a time. Claim groves for sap, mossbeds for moss, and shrines for light, while a rival blight camp races you for the same ground.

HOLD THE SAPLINE
When the blight attacks, plant defenders on the battlefield and stop every wave before it reaches your roots. Every enemy has a counter:
• Bramble Archers shoot down flyers
• Moss Walls stop the line cold
• Briar Knights hold a lane and cut down beetles
• Dew Sprayers slow fast pests
• Ember Pods scorch swarms
• Vine Lash shreds armor

Learn which defender beats Bark Gnawers, Swarm Moths, Iron Beetles, Shade Skitters, and the towering Blight Hulk.

RESEARCH THE TECH ALMANAC
Spend what your grove produces on research that unlocks new defenders, wider movement, deeper sap taps, and sharper scouting.

FAIR, ONE-TIME UNLOCK
The tutorial and the first campaign island are free. A single Full Grove purchase unlocks campaign islands 2–8 and endless procedurally grown wild groves. No ads, no subscriptions, no loot boxes. Plays fully offline.

name: Three Against AI
description:
An evil AI runs the world, and it has locked everyone away for their own good. But Elena, Julia and Paul are no ordinary prisoners. Each of them hides a special power.

Three Against AI is a pixel-art puzzle platformer about teamwork. You control one sibling at a time and switch between them whenever you like. The other two wait where you left them, holding a switch, standing guard, or ready for their turn. All three must reach the portal to clear a level.

THREE POWERS
• Elena turns all three into animals. She becomes a dog that digs through dirt. Julia becomes a cat that jumps high and always lands on her feet. Paul becomes a little dragon that flies and breathes fire.
• Julia slows down time for everything except the three of them.
• Paul rules machines near him: lasers switch off, robots fall asleep, broken lifts work again.
Every power lasts only a few seconds and then has to recharge, so timing matters.

WHAT STANDS IN THE WAY
• Patrol robots and laser beams
• Crushers that slam to the floor
• Lava, acid and spikes
• Doors that need a switch held down, or a button and a fast run
• Wooden gates only dragon fire can open
• Pipes only an animal can crawl through

DO NOT LOOK AT THE PHONE
The AI does not only use force. It talks to you all the way, with promises and little lies. And it leaves glowing phones in your path. Touch one and you stand frozen, staring at the screen, until a brother or sister comes close and breaks the spell. Wait too long and you turn into a robot.

12 HAND-BUILT LEVELS
Break out of the cell block, dig under the prison yard, cross an old mine and a robot factory. Pass through an occupied village, whispering woods, frozen peaks and a captive town. Then go down into the sewers, up through the dark keep and the server farm, to the core of the AI itself. Each level has three gems to collect.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Plays in portrait or landscape, on iPhone and iPad
• Five big on-screen buttons: left, right, jump, power and swap
• Works with a hardware keyboard on iPad
• Works offline

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• The first 3 levels are free
• One single purchase unlocks all remaining levels, forever
• No ads. No subscriptions. No data collected.

Three siblings. One evil AI. Switch it off.

name: TideBreak: Ocean Runner
description:
Outrun the Tide!

TideBreak is a fast three-lane boat runner on the open sea. Swipe to switch lanes, jump ramps and dive under docks while the world rushes at you. Every gate opens a new map, with its own sea, sky and obstacles.

RIDE THE WAVE
Grab the Wave Rider and surf a giant wave over everything in your path. Magnet, Shield, Nitro, a 2x Multiplier, Time Bubble, Coin Rain and a Dolphin Escort keep every run different.

ESCAPE THE KRAKEN
Far out at sea, the Kraken rises beside the channel. Watch the water, wait for a tentacle to break the surface and swerve to safety. It is not the only thing hunting in these waters.

A NEW WORLD AT EVERY GATE
Race from the turquoise water of Emerald Isles to the burning sky of Ember Coast and the midnight lights of Neon Harbor. 13 maps in all, from the icebergs of Frostfjord to the glowing water of Glow Lagoon, and a flooded gold mine that pays 4x the coins.

MAKE IT YOURS
Collect boats and captains, many with special perks, and upgrade your power-ups.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
Take on a daily challenge with a twist, complete missions, unlock achievements and climb the Tide Pass.

TideBreak is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases, including premium boats and captains, Tide Pass Premium and Remove Ads, which turns off the ads between runs. Ads you choose to watch for a reward stay available.

name: Time Record: Proof Camera
description:
This app's screens are in Korean only.

Time Record is a camera that records the date and time right inside your photos. Use it for check-in photos, daily logs and work records — any photo where "when it was taken" matters — and add your own message too.

■ 23 time record styles
• Classic, Check-in card, Meal (breakfast/lunch/dinner shown by time of day), Seal, Big time, Calendar, Film, Simple, Digital, Mini bar, Vertical, Challenge, Place and more
• 24h, 12h with AM/PM (or Korean 오전/오후), seconds, date format, text color and size

■ Honest time
• Camera photos record the moment you took them.
• Imported photos show the real capture time saved in the photo, or the current time if you prefer.
• There is no way to type in an arbitrary time, so your records stay trustworthy.

■ Videos, too
• In video mode, the running time record and logo are burned into the video, exactly as shown on screen.

■ Easier records
• Challenge day counter: set a start date and "30-day challenge, day 12" is added automatically.
• Composition guide: overlay your last photo to shoot the same pose every day.
• Self-timer (3/10 s), volume-button shutter
• Optional place name and weather

■ Review and compare
• Check-in calendar with streaks
• Before/after collage
• Time-lapse video from your daily photos
• Stamp many album photos at once

■ Trustworthy check-ins
• Anti-forgery verification code (QR): scan in the app to see the record time and its source
• Team style sharing via QR/code
• Daily check-in reminders

■ 23 designs · 10 time fonts
• Premium design pack: neon, receipt, scoreboard, ticket, analog clock, magazine and more
• Letter spacing, line height and background box controls

■ Camera basics
• Square 1:1 by default, 4:3 and 16:9 available
• Front/back switch, pinch zoom, 1x/2x buttons, tap to focus
• Flash (off/auto/on/torch), selfie mirroring
• Album button opens your gallery

■ Text editor
• Add your own message to the photo, with color, font, shadow/box/outline styles and size. Drag to move.
• Recently used messages are remembered.

■ IDEALLY logo
• The orbit-style IDEALLY logo is added to your photos. Buy 'Remove ads & logo' to turn it off.

■ Your photos stay on your device
• No sign-up needed.
• Photos are never uploaded; they are saved only to the "타임레코드" album on your device.

■ Remove ads & logo
• Remove the bottom banner ad and the IDEALLY logo on your photos permanently with a one-time purchase.

Contact: contact@ideallylabs.com

name: Tiny Steps: Toddler Routines
description:
Tiny Steps turns daily routines into a picture game your toddler can follow on their own.

Wake up, potty, brush teeth, get dressed, shoes on: each step is a big friendly picture. Your child taps it, hears their buddy read it out loud, and watches the timer. When the routine is done, the buddy jumps for joy and a star lands in their chart.

MADE FOR LITTLE ONES (2-6)
- Big pictures, no reading needed
- A girl or boy buddy who reads every step in a cheerful child voice
- Gentle countdown timer for each step
- Cheers, stars and a celebration at the end
- Calm night mode for bedtime

EASY FOR GROWN-UPS
- Ready-made routines: Morning, Bedtime, Leaving the house, After daycare
- Make your own: pick from 68 voiced step ideas, choose a picture, or snap a photo of your child doing the step
- Plan routines for weekdays or weekends and get a reminder
- Skip a step on busy days
- Progress tab with stars and streaks
- Grown-up areas are protected by a grown-up check

THE WHOLE FAMILY, IN SYNC
Routines sync with your iCloud. With Premium, share them with your partner, grandparents or a sitter so everyone uses the same routine on their own iPhone.

PREMIUM
- More children and unlimited routines (free: 1 child, 1 routine)
- Family sharing with partner, grandparents and sitters
- Record your own voice for any step
- Buddy voice made for your own step names
- Yearly or one-time lifetime purchase

No ads. No tracking. Your family's data stays in your iCloud.

Privacy Policy: https://hauhc93.github.io/tinysteps/#privacy
Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Titi
description:
Find your campfire people.

Titi is a social app for people who love camping. Whether you spend your weekends tent camping, traveling by van, or backpacking, Titi gives you a place to meet campers who share your interests and find inspiration for your next trip.

• Discover fellow campers. Explore profiles by camping style and interests, and follow people you’d like to get to know.
• Explore camp life. Browse camping photos and short videos, save posts you want to revisit, and join the conversation in the comments.
• Find camping events. Browse event details, see who’s going, and mark yourself as attending.
• Keep in touch. When you and another camper follow each other, you can start a private chat and share photos and videos. You can also join group conversations in campfire chat rooms.

name: Today Tile: Daily Puzzle
description:
Every day at 00:00 UTC (9 AM in Korea), a brand-new puzzle opens — and it's the same board for everyone in the world.
Clear it faster than anyone else and top today's ranking.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap any tile that isn't covered to move it into the 7-slot tray below.
• Collect three of the same picture and they disappear.
• Fill all 7 slots and you lose. Clear the whole board and you win!
• Your record is your clear time. Undo, Magnet and Shuffle can each be used once per game, and each adds 5 seconds.

A NEW BOARD EVERY DAY
• The shape and layout change daily — a pyramid one day, twin towers the next.
• Every board is guaranteed to be solvable. But it won't be easy.
• 3 free tries a day. Want more? Watch a short ad for another try.

RANKINGS & HONORS
• See instantly where you stand on the daily Game Center leaderboard.
• The next morning, the higher you ranked, the more candy you get.
• Earn streak badges and hunt for 8 hidden honors.

YOUR OWN TABLE
• Spend candy on tiles, trays, felt and lighting — mother-of-pearl tiles, a brass tray, purple velvet…
• Your tile and badge show up next to your name on the ranking.
• Candy is earned only by playing. It can't be bought or exchanged, and there are no random draws.

Relaxing lounge piano and sound effects can be turned on and off separately.
Works offline too (offline games don't go on the ranking).

Note: the game's text is currently in Korean. The rules are simple — tap, match three, clear the board.

name: Tool Bridge: MCP by Voice
description:
Tool Bridge connects Siri to MCP servers: the same tools Claude and ChatGPT use to read and change your own services. Add a server's address, and you can ask Siri for what it knows or have it make a change, hands free.

"Ask Tool Bridge what's on my groceries list."
"Ask Tool Bridge to add figs to groceries."
"Ask Tool Bridge what's on the calendar Friday."

HOW IT WORKS
• Add a server by its address. Sign-in is automatic: servers that use OAuth open their own sign-in page, with no client ID or setup.
• Tool Bridge reads each server's tools and learns how to ask for them, then picks the right one for what you said and fills in the details.
• You hear a short answer and see a card with the result, in Siri or in the app.
• Anything that changes something asks you first. Nothing is sent or changed without your OK.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Requests are understood by Apple's on-device model, with Apple's Private Cloud Compute for the harder ones. No account, no analytics, no tracking.
• Your servers, tokens and history stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.
• An AI provider of your own (with your own key) is optional, and History shows exactly what went where.

MORE
• Recipes: several steps under one phrase, like a morning briefing of the weather and today's events.
• Names put right: say a name the way it sounds and the app finds the one the server means.
• "How this was answered": every request shows which tool ran, with what, and how long it took.
• Widgets, Shortcuts actions, Spotlight, and an Apple Watch app.
• Works on iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad.

TRY IT FIRST
No server yet? Try the built-in demo server, or our hosted sample server with lists, notes, a calendar and a forecast (its address is on our support page).

Use it free for 14 days with every feature, then unlock it once, shared with your family. Nothing renews.

Tool Bridge isn't made by Apple. Siri is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: topspin
description:
Topspin Indoor Tennis Space สนามเทนนิสในร่ม ศรีราชา ชลบุรี — แอปสำหรับสมาชิกที่อยากจองคอร์ทและจัดการคอร์สเรียนได้เองจากมือถือ

จองคอร์ท • ดูตารางคอร์ทว่างตามเวลาจริง เลือกวันและเวลาที่สะดวก • จองเช่าคอร์ทรายชั่วโมง แล้วแนบสลิปโอนเงินได้ในแอป • ดูรายการจองของตัวเองย้อนหลังและล่วงหน้าได้ในที่เดียว

คอร์สเรียน • เรียนส่วนตัว เรียนคู่ หรือสามคน • คลาสกลุ่มผู้ใหญ่ และคลาสเด็กแยกช่วงวัย 3-6 ปี และ 6-14 ปี • พิกเคิลบอล • เช็กจำนวนครั้งคงเหลือและวันหมดอายุของคอร์สที่ซื้อไว้

เช็กอินและแจ้งเตือน • เช็กอินที่สนามด้วย QR • รับแจ้งเตือนข่าวสารและประกาศสำคัญจากสนาม

ทำไมต้องเล่นในร่ม • ฝนตกแดดออกก็เล่นได้ ตารางเรียนไม่ล่ม • พื้นสนามระบบ Roofkote Sport Mastic ได้รับการจัดระดับจาก ITF เป็น Category 4 (Medium-Fast) ลูกเด้งสม่ำเสมอ • พื้นแบบมีชั้นรองรับแรงกระแทก ช่วยลดแรงกระแทกที่ข้อเข่าและหลังเมื่อเทียบกับพื้นแข็งทั่วไป • เล่นกลางวันไม่ร้อน กลางคืนไฟสว่าง

เข้าสู่ระบบง่าย ใช้ชื่อผู้ใช้และรหัสผ่าน หรือเข้าสู่ระบบด้วย Apple หรือ LINE ได้

name: TraceBasin
description:
Understand the points behind your GPX track. TraceBasin turns a local track file into a clear path, measured elevation profile and point-by-point inspection, then lets you keep a selected section as an independent track.

• Import GPX tracks from Files and review continuous segments and parsing issues before saving.
• Inspect recorded coordinates, optional elevation and timestamps, with available point speed.
• View a path without a network map, and explore measured elevation without filling data gaps.
• Crop an inclusive point range while preserving the original track and segment boundaries.
• Compare two saved versions using consistent distance, available-duration and elevation metrics.
• Export real GPX, UTF-8 point-table CSV or a vector summary PDF, then preview and share the generated snapshot.
• Keep projects and export history in the App and erase them when you choose.

Distance uses a spherical model within continuous segments. Available duration includes only adjacent, increasing recorded timestamps. Raw ascent and descent are unsmoothed and can reflect measurement noise. Missing samples are not interpolated. TraceBasin is a file inspection utility, not a navigation or route-safety service. It supports GPX track points, rather than waypoint-only or route-only files. Import limits are 10 MB and 100,000 track points.

name: Train Lost & Found: Ride Log
description:
When you leave something on a train or bus, lost and found will ask: when, which line, between which stops, and which car?
Most of us don't remember.

Train Lost & Found: Ride Log keeps that for you. Tap a button when you board, and the app saves the line and the time. If you lose something, it shows exactly what you'll be asked.

TAP WHEN YOU BOARD
- Tap a ride button to log which line you took, when, and from which station
- Save your usual boarding station, or let the app log the nearest station
- The car number is optional: one tap on buttons 1 to 16, with your usual car suggested first
- Add the door number and where you were sitting or standing if you like
- Tap Get off when you leave to save the time and station. The nearest station is filled in, and you can change it (your ride is kept even if you forget)

SAVE YOUR FAVORITE ROUTES
- Save routes like your commute, including transfers
- After that, tap Board, Transfer on the way, and Get off at your destination
- Get a reminder with Get off and Transfer buttons as you approach your stop (stations in Japan)
- Ride the same way a few times and the app offers to save it as a favorite route
- Create the return route in one tap

IF YOU LOSE SOMETHING
- Pick the ride to get an inquiry card with the date and time, line, section, car and position, and a description of the item
- Copy or share it into a chat or email
- Show it to station staff on a large, clear screen
- Find the operator's lost and found
- Keep track: inquiry in progress, found, picked up

MY ITEMS
- Note what your umbrella, wallet or earbuds look like, ready for when you need to describe them
- Get a "Got everything?" reminder after you get off

ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD
- Type any line, station or stop name
- Works for buses, trams, monorails and ferries too
- Allow location access to see nearby stations and stops as suggestions
- About 9,000 stations in Japan are suggested by name

AUTOMATIC LOGGING IN JAPAN
- Choose Automatic in Settings to log the stations, times and line of your train rides in Japan from your location
- Location is used only near stations and while you ride
- On Toei Subway lines, the app also estimates the train (type and destination) from the timetable
- Underground or on parallel lines the app can get it wrong. Fix it with one tap

FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
- Board, get off and set your car from a widget, without opening the app
- Works with Siri and Shortcuts

SOFT, FRIENDLY DESIGN
- 9 theme colors
- iPhone and iPad. With iCloud sync, you can check your latest ride on your iPad even if you leave your iPhone behind
- English and Japanese

PRIVACY
- No account needed
- Your log stays on your device and in your own iCloud. The developer never receives it
- If you only log manually, no location access is needed

PRICE
- Free with ads
- Remove Ads (one-time purchase) turns off all ads

PLEASE NOTE
- Automatic logging and train estimates are a guide and are not guaranteed to be accurate
- The app can't guarantee that a lost item will be found. Please contact the transit operator's lost and found
- Timetable information is based on data from the Public Transportation Open Data Center

name: Training Insight
description:
Training Insight turns your Intervals.icu data into a clear answer to one question: how much training can you take today?

Fatigue and recovery
Estimated fatigue on a 0–100 scale, derived from your own activity load over the last 28 days. See the load trend, the short- and long-term response, and how the current week compares with the one before it.

Sleep against your own baseline
Every night is compared with your own average, not with a population norm. Sleep duration, resting heart rate and HRV from your Intervals.icu wellness records, plus a daily check-in you write yourself.

Activities and analysis
Browse your activities by sport, open a single session for its details, compare periods, and read the intensity distribution. Charts come from the data you synchronized; there is no estimate dressed up as a measurement.

Gear and maintenance
Keep your equipment ready. Usage is tracked from your activities, maintenance cycles are configurable, and the app tells you when a service is due.

Workouts sized to you
A library of ride and run sessions, from recovery spins to VO2max intervals. Targets come from your own FTP and threshold pace in Intervals.icu, the number and length of the hard blocks follow your fitness, and a session that does not suit today's fatigue says so. Send a workout to your Intervals.icu calendar and it arrives on your watch or bike computer as a structured workout.

Plans
Build your next weeks locally and keep the plan on the device.

Share a session as an image
Turn a ride or run into a story-sized picture: distance, time, pace or power, the elevation or speed profile, or the route line with its first and last 400 m cut off. Heart rate never goes on a shared image.

Private by design
Your data stays on your phone. The app talks to Intervals.icu directly with your own API key and to nothing else. There is no account, no analytics, no advertising and no AI service. The key is kept in the system keychain or keystore. You can delete all local data inside the app at any time.

Free
Everything is included. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no credits.

Training Insight is not affiliated with Intervals.icu. An Intervals.icu account is required to synchronize data.

name: TravelTalk: Speak & Translate
description:
Speak with confidence anywhere you land — even in airplane mode.
TravelTalk is a 100% offline, privacy-first travel conversation simulator, survival phrasebook, and live two-way voice translator built for real-world moments in Japan, France, and English-speaking destinations.

Most translation apps leave you staring at a blank microphone when a waiter asks how firm you want your ramen noodles, or when an immigration officer asks how many days you are staying. TravelTalk prepares you before you walk in and backs you up on the spot — with zero sign-ups, zero ads, and zero cloud uploads.

KEY FEATURES

1. 21 Interactive Branching Travel Scenarios:
Rehearse authentic multi-turn conversations for restaurants, ramen counters, izakayas, airport customs, hotel check-in, train stations, tax-free shopping, pharmacies, and clinics. Choose polite or casual phrasing, hear 234 bundled studio-grade neural voice recordings at 1.0x or 0.75x slow speed, and practice speaking aloud with instant pronunciation feedback.

2. Top 100 Survival Cheatsheet & Full-Screen Emergency Show Cards:
Access 100 atomic, bite-sized survival phrases (4-8 words each) with clear Romaji and phonetic guides. Need help fast in a noisy station or restaurant? Tap once to display a high-contrast Full-Screen Show Card in Japanese, French, or English — complete with interactive reply buttons so local staff can tap an answer right on your screen.

3. Symmetrical Two-Way Live Voice Translator:
Hold the thumb-friendly dual microphones at the bottom of your screen for natural face-to-face bilingual conversations. Powered by Apple on-device Speech Recognition and iOS 18 TranslationSession with a built-in offline travel lexicon fallback.

4. Personal Travel Passport & Dietary Allergy Guard:
Set your party size, dietary restrictions (peanut/nut allergy, shellfish allergy, gluten-free, lactose-free, vegetarian, halal, no cilantro, no spicy), and French grammatical gender once. TravelTalk automatically injects your details into scenario slots and generates personalized dietary & emergency cards.

5. Built for iPhone, iPad & iPhone Duo:
Crafted with a warm Boarding Pass editorial aesthetic, Dark Mode for night flights, and adaptive dual-screen layouts tailored for both compact cover screens and wide unfolded displays.

name: True Solar Clock
description:
NowSolar: True Solar Clock shows the moment the sun actually crosses your meridian — the real noon where you are.

WHAT TRUE SOLAR TIME IS
"12:00" on a clock is the standard time of your time zone, but the sun does not cross due south at 12:00 (north of the equator). True solar time follows the sun's real position: first the clock is corrected for the longitude offset from 120°E (about 4 minutes per degree), then the equation of time is added, which comes from Earth's orbital eccentricity and axial tilt. That is why true solar noon in Chengdu falls around 12:40 Beijing time, and why cities far west of their zone's meridian differ even more.

WHAT YOU GET
· True solar time: local standard time on the left, true solar time on the right, ticking every second and following the system time zone and daylight saving.
· Sunrise, solar noon and sunset, computed from the sun's altitude and your local zone, plus the length of daylight — with a note for midnight sun and polar night.
· Hourly weather for the next hours, with data from Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).
· Key time periods: the app syncs a public "take time" page once a day and marks those periods on a 0–24 hour axis in green (cold or mild) or red (hot or mild). While you are inside a period, the true solar time digits change colour too.
· The twelve shichen: derived from true solar time, Zi starting at 23:00, showing early/late half and the current shichen.
· Chime reminders: one sound when the next shichen begins, another at the start of a key time period — delivered on time by the system even when the app is in the background.
· Day and night theme: the interface switches to a dark palette the moment the sun sets, following the sun rather than the system setting.
· Location: 20 preset cities, GPS tracking, or manual coordinates.

PRIVACY
· Your location is used only on the device for astronomical math. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored on a server, and there is no account.
· Coordinates are sent to Apple's reverse geocoding service only when a place name is needed; if that fails, OpenStreetMap is tried. Results are cached on the device.
· No ads, no in-app purchases, no third-party analytics SDK, no tracking.

LANGUAGES
The interface follows your system language: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) and English. District-level place names are shown when available (for example Manhattan, New York); otherwise the country is shown.

Open it when you just want to know what the sun says the time is — or dig into shichen and key time periods.

name: Ultifasting
description:
Ultifasting helps you fast intermittently on your own terms and understand what is happening in your body, on iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac.

A TIMER THAT FITS YOU
• Choose 13:11, 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD, 36, 48 or 72-hour fasts, or set any number of hours.
• Count down to your goal and see how long you have fasted; adjust the start time if you forgot to tap.
• See the time since your last fast and your next scheduled start.

8 STAGES, BACKED BY SCIENCE
From digestion and stable blood sugar to glycogen depletion, the metabolic switch to fat, ketosis, autophagy, growth hormone and immune renewal. Each stage has an animated illustration, a clear explanation, tips and references to published research. Get a notification as you reach each milestone and when you hit your goal.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with an End button.
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets that start or end a fast right from the widget.
• A Start/Stop Fast control in Control Center.
• Siri and Shortcuts: start, end, or ask for your status.

APPLE WATCH
Tap the ring to start or stop, with a gentle haptic. Log your weight with the Digital Crown. 7 complications: fasting timer, countdown, stage, stage strip, eating window, weight and streak.

WEIGHT AND WHAT-IF FORECASTS
• Weight chart, BMI and a goal weight.
• A forecast of the day you will reach your goal, based on your own weight and fasting history, drawn as a dashed line on the chart with a likely range.
• Try scenarios: how much sooner if you fast one more day a week, or a few more hours each time?
• The forecast updates whenever you add or edit data, and is capped at a safe 1 kg per week.

FOOD PHOTO JOURNAL
Snap or pick a photo of each meal, add a note and mark the meal that broke your fast.

STATISTICS
Current streak, 7-day average, personal best, goal completion rate and a full, editable history.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your devices and syncs through your own iCloud between iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac.

Note: Information in the app is for general reference and is not a substitute for medical advice. Fasting longer than 24 hours is not suitable for people with diabetes, those who are pregnant or breastfeeding, anyone under 18, or anyone with a history of eating disorders.

name: Unpark Quest
description:
Every parking lot is a puzzle. Can you get every car out?

Welcome to Unpark Quest, a colorful 3D logic game where one well-timed tap can set the whole parking lot in motion.

HOW TO PLAY

- Check the arrow on each car to see which way it will drive.
- Tap a car to send it toward an exit.
- If another vehicle blocks the path, rethink your order.
- Clear every car to complete the level!

THINK BEFORE YOU TAP

Start with simple layouts and work your way up to crowded parking lots with cars facing different directions and exits on multiple sides. The secret is choosing the right car at the right moment.

PLAY YOUR WAY

- Explore increasingly tricky parking puzzles.
- Use a hint when you need a fresh idea.
- Undo a move or restart a level to try another strategy.
- Track your time and attempts as you improve.
- Earn up to three stars for clever, efficient solutions.
- Replay completed levels to beat your best result.

BRIGHT 3D, SIMPLE CONTROLS

Enjoy cheerful cars, smooth driving animations, and clean, easy-to-read parking lots. No steering wheel or complicated controls - just tap, think, and clear the way.

Have a minute? Solve a quick puzzle. Want a challenge? Go for three stars on every level.

Start your Unpark Quest and let the cars roll!

name: Urushi: Maki-e & Lacquer Art
description:
Step into a serene Japanese lacquerware atelier with Urushi. Designed for lovers of fine craftsmanship, tactile art, and aesthetic calm, Urushi turns your iPhone into a studio for traditional Maki-e gold painting and lacquer polishing.

DEEP GLOSSY LACQUER LAYERS
Apply rich coats of black and vermilion urushi lacquer onto carved cypress wood vessels. Experience realistic optical depth, smooth brush physics, and mirror-like light reflections.

MAKI-E GOLD & RADEN INLAY
Paint delicate motifs and sprinkle fine gold and silver powders through a traditional bamboo tube. Place iridescent mother-of-pearl fragments with precision tweezers to capture shifting rainbow highlights.

TACTILE TOGIDASHI POLISHING
Seal your artwork under a final coat of dark lacquer, then gently rub the surface with magnolia charcoal. Feel subtle velvet friction via CoreHaptics as your golden design slowly emerges from the depths.

TABLETOP SILK STANDBY
Mount your device horizontally to showcase your finished lacquerware resting on a silk cushion under soft, shifting ambient light.

Built native for iOS with zero internet required, zero ads, and absolute offline privacy.

Download Urushi and craft timeless beauty today.

name: Us Two: Couples App

Us Two is a private space for the two of you.

Create your space, send your partner the invite code, and everything you share stays between you two: your story, your photos, your plans and your little rituals.

A SELFIE A DAY
Take one photo a day, keep a streak going together, flip through your faces over the months, and turn them into a time-lapse video of just you or both of you side by side.

YOUR STORY
A timeline of the moments that made you, a countdown to your next special date, and a wall of your favourite photos and videos.

LISTS FOR TWO
Watchlists, bucket lists and your own tier rankings for movies, food, anything. Drag to reorder, tick things off together.

LETTERS & CHAT
Write each other letters and chat in a space that's only yours. Schedule a letter to arrive tonight, tomorrow morning or on your anniversary.

GOALS TOGETHER (Premium)
Shake your phone to open Goals: set real KPIs for your relationship, health, money and travel, start them together, check in and watch your progress.

US TWO PREMIUM
One subscription unlocks it for both of you: Goals & KPIs, the AI coach, time-lapse videos and scheduled letters. €29.99 a month, auto-renews until cancelled.

name: V Compass - Vaidik Compass
description:
V Compass — a beautiful, accurate compass from the Vaidik Apps family, with handy everyday tools. Completely free, no ads, and everything works on your phone without internet.

A compass you can trust
• Large, clear dial with degrees and all eight directions
• Smooth, steady needle — even when you hold the phone upright
• True north (geographic) or magnetic north — your choice
• Declination is worked out on the phone from your location using the World Magnetic Model
• If the direction is off, the app guides you to calibrate with a quick figure-8 and tells you when it is accurate again
• A light tap of vibration each time you reach a direction

Lock a direction
Point the phone, lock the direction, and see exactly how many degrees you turn left or right.

Sun
• Today’s sunrise, sunset, solar noon and day length for your place
• Where the sun is right now and how high — also shown on the dial

Spirit level
Check whether a table, floor, shelf or picture frame is level — flat and edge modes, with zero calibration.

Location
Latitude, longitude and altitude — copy or share in one tap.

Camera view
See the direction over what the camera sees — handy for checking which way a room, door or house faces. No photo is taken or saved.

Ten languages
हिन्दी, English, ગુજરાતી, मराठी, বাংলা, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, தமிழ், తెలుగు, ಕನ್ನಡ, മലയാളം — and you can show the compass directions in English while using the app in your own language.

Private by design
Your location is used only on your phone. It is never sent to us or anyone else. No ads, no tracking.

Light and dark themes · Works on phones and tablets · Help & contact chat inside the app.

name: VAFOR
description:
There is no account, no login, no user-generated text, and no network call. The sample ledger is ready on first launch.

How to review, on iPhone SE (3rd generation), portrait:
1. The first screen is Wake. Tap Open the desk.
2. Desk shows unused card credits for the sample seat Alder. Open Burn order, or tap a credit, to reach a slip. Capture and Half write the local ledger only.
3. The bottom bar is Desk, Shelf, Stack, Lots, and More.
4. Stack lists household debts. This month posts a minimum. Path switches Avalanche, Snowball, and Hybrid and moves the extra-payment slider.
5. Lots lists three fictional properties. Open one, then Dial or Target. Assumptions uses steppers only. There is no keyboard.
6. More opens the month fold (a local date-seeded list), year windows, the folio, settings, privacy, and the colophon.
7. Settings can reset the sample desk. Tone plays every sound. Due bells are optional local notifications and start off.

Sample names such as Northfold Plate, Harbor Preferred, and 14 Hemlock Court are fictional. They are not bank or merchant brands. Dollar figures are illustrative math stored in Application Support on the device. Nothing is uploaded. There is no advertising, no purchase, and no tracking.

Optional launch arguments: -qaTour walks every screen. -qaShot desk opens one screen by id.

name: Vaha: Tasbih & Dhikr Counter
description:
Vaha is made for doing your daily dhikr inside a calm, living scene. With every count the scene you choose changes a little: dry land turns green, a star appears over the night sea, a lantern lights up in a courtyard. Every dhikr you complete stays as a plant in your own oasis (My Oasis).

FIRST LAUNCH
You start straight away with 100 × Astaghfirullah. No account, no sign-up.

7 SCENES
• Oasis: from desert to garden (always open)
• Night Sea: stars, the moon, the Milky Way and dawn
• Lanterns: lanterns lighting up one by one in a courtyard
• Day Cycle: prayer beads and the rising and setting sun
• Tulip Garden: a tulip opens with every count
• Sailboats: boats set out to sea at sunset, their lanterns lighting up as it gets dark
• Winter Night: windows lighting up in a snowy village
Each scene has its own sound, and ambient sounds such as rain, waves, wind and fountain water can be turned off in Settings. Small surprises appear along the way: a rainbow, a kite, hot air balloons, a windmill, a shooting star, the northern lights…

13 DHIKR AND YOUR OWN
Istighfar, Salawat, SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, post-prayer tasbih (33-33-33 + tahlil), La ilaha illallah, La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, SubhanAllahil-Azim, HasbunAllahu wa ni'mal wakil, the dua of Yunus, SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum. You can also write your own.

DAILY WIRD
Add dhikr to your daily list with a count (33, 99, 100, 500, 1000 or any number), a scene and a reminder time. The Today screen shows only the next dhikr; when it is done you move on to the next one. The day resets at midnight.

VERSES AND HADITH
While you count, complete verses related to that dhikr are shown (Arabic and translation), and a hadith with its source appears at the end. The cards change every day. Arabic texts were taken from quran.com and sunnah.com and checked against a second source. English translation of the Qur'an: Saheeh International (via QuranEnc.com), unchanged. Hadith translations: HadeethEnc.com.

TASBIH COUNTER
A free counter with no target: a round every 33, and your count is kept even after you close the app.

GOALS, STREAK AND MY OASIS
Set count goals over 7, 30 or any number of days. Your streak allows a 1-day break every 7 days. My Oasis shows your 7-day calendar, and you can create a card to share.

ALSO
• Reminders per dhikr and a daily reminder
• Backup and restore (as a file you can send to Drive or a message)
• Sound and vibration settings
• 13 languages: English, Arabic, Turkish, Indonesian, Malay, Urdu, French, Bosnian, German, Hindi, Bengali, Russian, Uzbek
• Works on phones and tablets
• No internet needed to count

ADS AND SUPPORT
There are never ads on the counting screen or in your dhikr list, and no full-screen ads that interrupt you. The Oasis scene and all dhikr are always free. The other 6 scenes open for 6 hours after an optional short ad. Some screens show a small banner ad at the bottom.
If you wish, you can support the developer with an in-app purchase. This is not a charity or a charitable project, and supporters get no extra features.

PRIVACY
No account, no server. Your counts, list and settings are stored only on your device.

name: VanLog

• Trips: start and end a trip with odometer readings and see the distance travelled.
• Fuel: log your fills and see your L/100km, with towing and not towing shown separately.
• Service: track items like wheel bearings, brakes, tyres and the annual check by kilometres, months or both. See what is due soon or overdue, and log a service to reset the items you did.
• Diary: write notes and add photos as you go.
• Log: every entry in one searchable list.
• Vans: keep more than one caravan.
• Backup: save all your data, photos included, to a file you keep, and restore it whenever you need to.

Private by design. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking, and your data stays on your iPhone.

Free to try with up to 20 entries. A one-off unlock removes the limit, with no subscription.

name: VeilPage
description:
Make a separate image-based PDF copy with opaque rectangular covers over visible areas you select.

Import a PDF from Files, or use Create practice PDF to try the normal editing workflow with an invented example. Review the document before saving the local import. Open any page, draw a rectangle, move or resize it, and use Undo or Redo before saving your page edits. Pan and zoom changes your view without changing the saved cover coordinates.

Choose Standard or Sharp resolution and generate the new copy. Every output page is newly rendered as an image, and the selected covers are burned into those image pixels. The generated PDF does not contain the original selectable text or removable cover annotations. The imported original remains a separate file.

Review every generated page in the PDF preview before sharing the new copy. Saved copies remain independent of later working-document edits or deletion. Supported imports are unlocked PDFs up to20,000,000bytes and30 pages, with bounded page geometry. Output resolution is capped at1536 or2048 pixels on the longest edge, so small text may lose detail.

VeilPage covers visible regions you choose. It does not detect sensitive information automatically or promise comprehensive document sanitization. Uncovered content, filenames and basic producer metadata may still identify information. Keep your own backups and share the covered copy, rather than the original, when that is your intention.

Documents and copies are stored locally. No login is required.

name: VerbouwingSpoor
description:
Houd uw verbouwing overzichtelijk met VerbouwingSpoor. Leg projecten, werkzaamheden en voortgang vast en bewaar belangrijke informatie bij elkaar, van de eerste planning tot de controle op locatie.

**Projecten en werkzaamheden**  
Maak projecten aan, voeg taken toe en houd per ruimte de verantwoordelijke, planning, voortgang, werkuren en notities bij.

**Werkpakketten als startpunt**  
Kies uit tien werkpakketten voor onder meer keuken, badkamer, balkon en vloer. Voeg de voorgestelde stappen toe aan een project en pas ze aan uw situatie aan.

**Diensten en middelen**  
Registreer diensten voor personen, ploegen, apparaten of ruimtes. VerbouwingSpoor controleert of hetzelfde middel in overlappende perioden is ingepland.

**Foto’s, handtekeningen en controle**  
Voeg foto’s toe aan werkzaamheden en leg een handtekening vast. Registreer een beoordeling en bewaar de bijbehorende momentopname met foto’s en handtekening.

**Inzicht en uitwisseling**  
Bekijk open taken, voortgang en geregistreerde werkuren. Exporteer gegevens als CSV, maak een PDF-rapport of zet een reservekopie terug op een ander apparaat.

**Herinneringen**  
Schakel een herinnering in voor het geplande tijdstip van een werkzaamheid.

Uw gegevens worden lokaal op het apparaat bewaard. Een lokale handtekening is een registratie op het apparaat; identiteit en rechtsgeldigheid worden niet door de app geverifieerd.

name: VI Companion

Your habits build your future. Here, they build a house.

In Vilume, every habit you check turns into XP and coins. The XP builds your house, level by level. The coins decorate your lot. And your friends live in the same village.

HOW IT WORKS
• Create your habits: drink water, read, work out, study, anything you like. Pick the days and a reminder time.
