name: Elkvart – Electricity price
description:
Elkvart shows the electricity price in your price area (elområde) – SE1, SE2, SE3 or SE4 – quarter-hour by quarter-hour, today and tomorrow.

WHAT YOU GET
• The price right now and the whole day in one chart. Cheap, normal and expensive quarter-hours are shown with colour, a pattern and a word.
• Tomorrow's prices as soon as they're published, usually just after 13:00.
• Plan: choose laundry, the dishwasher or the tumble dryer, for example, and the app works out the cheapest time to start and what you save compared with starting now.
• Widgets for the Home Screen, the Lock Screen and StandBy that change price every quarter-hour and show the cheapest hours.
• Notifications you turn on yourself: a summary of tomorrow, a price above or below your own limit, and negative prices.
• History with the average price per month since November 2022.

WHICH PRICE IS SHOWN?
By default you see the spot price excluding VAT: the power exchange's day-ahead price for your price area. You can switch to:
• Incl. VAT: the spot price plus 25% VAT.
• Total: (spot price + supplier markup + grid fee + energy tax) × 1.25. You enter the supplier markup and the grid fee yourself; you'll find them in your electricity contract and on your grid company's bill.

NOT INCLUDED
• Fixed monthly fees, capacity charges and other fees that aren't charged per kWh.
• Your own consumption. The app isn't connected to your meter or your electricity supplier.
The price on your bill can therefore differ from what the app shows. Prices are converted from euros to kronor and can differ slightly from the exchange's official prices in kronor. Costs in Plan are based on typical usage, for example about 1 kWh for a load of laundry.

PRIVACY
• No account and no sign-in.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Your settings are stored only on your phone, and notifications are worked out there.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Prices are in öre per kWh (100 öre = 1 krona). All times are Swedish time.
• Widgets and notifications use the prices the app last fetched. iOS decides when the app may fetch new prices in the background, so tomorrow's summary can arrive a while after the prices are published. Open the app to update straight away.
• The app is in English and Swedish and covers Sweden's four price areas.

SOURCE
The power exchange's day-ahead prices from ENTSO-E. Electricity prices provided by Elpriset just nu.se.

Questions, or found a mistake? Write to support@elkvart.se. How we calculate: https://elkvart.se/sa-raknar-vi

name: Jitterzzz: Random Alarm
description:
Jitterzzz is an alarm that picks the moment for you.

Choose a window, for example 6:00 to 6:30 AM, or 5:00 to 7:45 PM, and Jitterzzz rings at one random minute inside it. You won't know which. Repeating alarms get a fresh random minute every day.

WAKE UP OUTSIDE THE PATTERN
An alarm at the same minute every morning is easy to sleep through or snooze on autopilot. A random minute inside your window keeps it from becoming routine.

BREAK UP YOUR DAY
Deep in work and keep putting off that walk, stretch, or break? Set a wide window and let Jitterzzz decide when. When it rings, that's your moment.

RANDOMIZED OR TRADITIONAL
Use a window from a few minutes up to 24 hours, or set an exact time like any other alarm.

SNOOZE YOUR WAY
Fixed snooze, randomized snooze (for example 5 to 15 minutes, picked each time you tap), or no snooze at all. Set how many snoozes you're allowed.

NO LATER THAN
Set a hard limit. Nothing, including snoozes, is ever scheduled after it.

REAL ALARMS
Jitterzzz uses iOS's own alarm system, so alarms ring when the app is closed, the phone is locked, or Silent mode is on. Test My Alarm lets you check on your device.

SOUNDS
Five original sounds, or import your own audio file and choose the part you want.

HISTORY
See your snoozes over time, compare randomized and traditional alarms, and optionally answer "Did you get up?" after an alarm. Only what actually happened is counted.

PRESETS
Save setups like Workday, Weekend, or Afternoon Walk and reuse them in a tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Everything stays on your device. Export or delete your history any time.

Jitterzzz is an alarm clock. It isn't a sleep tracker or a medical or health product.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

description:

تصفّح الأعمال وما تقدمه من سلع وعقارات ومركبات وخدمات ومعروضات للإيجار، وافتح تفاصيل كل معروض للتعرف على السعر والشروط وخيارات التنفيذ المتاحة.

ما يمكنك فعله في كتالوج:
• البحث المعتاد والذكي في الأنشطة والمعروضات والمحتوى المنشور.
• اكتشاف السلع والعقارات والمركبات والخدمات وفق المعلومات التي ينشرها أصحابها.
• إرسال طلب شراء أو استئجار أو حجز عندما يتيح المعروض ذلك، ومتابعة حالة الطلب.
• التواصل مع النشاط والرسائل المرتبطة بالمعروض، والمفاوضة عندما تكون متاحة.
• مشاهدة المنشورات والقصص والريلز، والمشاركة والتعليق والحفظ والمتابعة.
• استخدام مساعد كتالوج لاكتشاف نتائج من بيانات المنصة المنشورة.
• التحكم في المظهر الفاتح أو الداكن، وإدارة الحساب والبلاغات وحظر المستخدمين وحذف الحساب.

يمكن التصفح كزائر، بينما تتطلب وظائف مثل الرسائل وإرسال الطلبات والمشاركة حسابًا. تختلف الوظائف والأسعار وشروط الإلغاء والإتاحة باختلاف النشاط والمعروض؛ راجع التفاصيل قبل التأكيد. إرسال الطلب لا يمثل إثبات دفع أو قبول نهائي، ولا ينفذ المساعد دفعًا نيابة عنك.
